itm01_011.bytes|05000199|0:
This bell is the same as the one on Helmut's collar,
right?
itm01_011.bytes|05000199|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} The bell is something of a trademark for
Mr. Kanis.
itm01_011.bytes|05000199|2:
An assassin with a trademark?{E108:0010} You'd think he'd want
to stay anonymous!
itm01_011.bytes|05000199|3: Isn't that true of Great Thieves, too?
itm01_011.bytes|05000199|4:
Oh, Mr. Edgeworth...{E108:0010} {E280}You don't know anything about
great thieving, do you?
itm01_011.bytes|05000199|5:
Great Thieves are only great BECAUSE they stand out
from the crowd!
itm01_011.bytes|05000199|6:
(And what's in it for a thief to stand out like that,{E108:0008} other
than to attract the police's attention...?)
itm02_000.bytes|050001D0|0:
Your badge is in the shape of a sunflower,{E108:0008} right,
Mr. E?
itm02_000.bytes|050001D0|1: Does that have some kind of special meaning, or...?
itm02_000.bytes|050001D0|2:
It does.{E108:0010} Sunflowers follow the sun, correct?{E108:0010}
In other words,{E108:0008} they always face the light.
itm02_000.bytes|050001D0|3:
Just as we attorneys do.{E108:0010} We should always aim to be
on the side of liberty and justice.
itm02_000.bytes|050001D0|4:
Wow!{E108:0010} {E285}Then I'm going to work hard and be just like a
sunflower when I'm an attorney!
itm02_000.bytes|050001D0|5: Heh.{E108:0010} I've no doubt that you will.
itm02_000.bytes|050001D6|0: Is this your badge number here on the back?
itm02_000.bytes|050001D6|1:
That's right.{E108:0010} The number itself doesn't mean much, of
course.
itm02_000.bytes|050001D6|2:
Well, if it doesn't really matter,{E108:0008} then I want mine to be
a string of repeating digits!
itm02_005.bytes|05000210|1:
...Really?{E108:0010}
Just seems a bit out there to me.
itm02_005.bytes|05000210|2: Like,{E108:0008} how do you even get your tea in there?
itm02_005.bytes|05000210|3: Art isn't about function, Eddie --{E108:0008} it's about form.
itm02_005.bytes|05000210|4:
Hmm...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}Guess I'll have to take your word for it, Mr. E.{E108:0010}
{E282}This art stuff is way beyond me!
itm02_005.bytes|05000215|0:
Look!{E108:0010} There's something stamped on the bottom!{E108:0018}
It says...{E108:0008} {E284}"PH"...
itm02_005.bytes|05000215|1:
I suppose that must be Paul Halique's pottery mark.{E108:0010}
Those are his initials, after all.
itm02_005.bytes|05000215|2: Ms. Bound said she is a big fan of his work.
itm02_005.bytes|05000215|3:
His initials, huh?{E108:0010}
So if I'd made it,{E108:0008} {E285}it would say "EF"?
itm02_005.bytes|05000215|4:
...Perhaps you should practice by initialing your
personal belongings first.
itm02_009.bytes|05000250|1: No.{E108:0010} Unfortunately,{E108:0008} it appears to be broken.
itm02_009.bytes|05000250|2: Would have been nice to see it all lit up just once.
itm02_009.bytes|05000250|3:
Ms. Scone said it's good for relaxation, right?{E108:0010}
I could use some of that!
itm02_009.bytes|05000250|4: (Perhaps I'll get one for the office...)
itm02_009.bytes|05000255|1:
I still can't believe it...{E108:0010}
A murder weapon stashed away in a candy castle...
itm02_009.bytes|05000255|2: You don't have to look, Eddie.{E108:0010} It's okay.
itm02_009.bytes|05000255|3:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}I'm fine!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I mean,{E108:0008} if I'm going to be an attorney,{E108:0008}
{E280}I need to get used to this stuff, right?
itm02_009.bytes|05000255|4:
Yes...{E108:0010} I suppose you do.{E108:0010}
(I look forward to seeing the man you become.)
itm02_009.bytes|0500025A|0:
So the lamps both have these hexagonal stands on the
bottom, right?
itm02_009.bytes|0500025A|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} I imagine the indentations in the pillars were
made to accomodate them.
itm02_009.bytes|0500025A|2: And boy do they fit like a glove!
itm02_00b.bytes|05000290|0:
A roll of cloth of navy blue.{E108:0010}
It's a very calming hue.{E108:0010} I like it.
itm02_00b.bytes|05000290|1:
Yeah,{E108:0008} that was real deep and all, Mr. E!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}But let's get to the main event already and light it up!
itm02_00b.bytes|05000290|2:
A-{E108:0008}Alright.{E108:0010}
{E284}(But I wasn't trying to be deep or anything, though...?)
itm02_00b.bytes|05000293|0: Whoa!{E108:0018} Look at all these buttons!
itm02_00b.bytes|05000293|1: I believe they're for changing the color of the light.
itm02_00b.bytes|05000293|3: There.{E108:0010} Now the cloth is all lit up.
itm02_00b.bytes|05000293|4: It's so pretty no matter how many times I see it...
itm02_00b.bytes|05000298|0:
The cloth is now glowing with a pale blue hue thanks
to the light-emitting device.
itm02_00b.bytes|05000298|1:
Didn't Ms. Scone say {E284}one of these cloths and its
machine are missing?
itm02_00b.bytes|05000298|2: Who do you think could've taken them?
itm02_00b.bytes|05000298|3:
I have no idea.{E108:0010} But I suspect it might have something
to do with our case somehow.
itm02_00b.bytes|0500029C|0:
This dark shade of blue...{E108:0010} Being around such a calming
color from time to time just might do me some good.
itm02_00b.bytes|0500029C|1:
Jeez Louise, Milesarino!{E108:0010} {E282}Talk about corny!{E108:0018}
You could fill an entire extra-large bucket by yourself.
itm02_00b.bytes|0500029F|0:
These must be the switches that change the color of
the cloth.
itm02_00b.bytes|0500029F|2: Well...{E108:0010} the cloth has certainly changed color.
itm02_00b.bytes|050002A2|0: It's glowing with a pale blue hue.
itm02_00b.bytes|050002A2|1:
And according to Detective Gumshoe,{E108:0008} {E285}this is what it
looked like when it was still draped over that statue.
itm02_00b.bytes|050002A2|3: (But what does that have to do with the case...?)
itm02_00b.bytes|050002A6|0:
This dark shade of blue...{E108:0010} Being around such a calming
color from time to time just might do me some good.
itm02_00b.bytes|050002A6|1:
It's also just the right color for sneaking around in the
dead of night!
itm02_00b.bytes|050002A6|2:
But I'd need something a lot brighter if I wanted to
make a big, splashy entrance...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Hmm...
itm02_00b.bytes|050002A6|3:
...You can do both with this cloth through the power of
buttons, though?
itm02_00b.bytes|050002A6|4:
Oh, yeah!{E108:0018}
In that case,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I'll take five!
itm02_00b.bytes|050002AB|0:
This cloth went missing at the time of the IS-7
Incident...
itm02_00b.bytes|050002AB|1:
...only to be found eighteen years later floating in the
Zodiac Hall fountain.
itm02_00b.bytes|050002AB|2:
And there was another one that was all lit up and
draped around the Pisces statue, right?
itm02_00b.bytes|050002AB|3:
(It seems these cloths may have a connection to both
cases,{E108:0008} past and present.)
itm02_01d.bytes|050002D0|0:
Looks like this pedal lets you adjust the height of the
platform, Mr. Edgeworth!
itm02_01d.bytes|050002D0|1: Indeed.{E108:0010} Let's give it a try.
itm02_01d.bytes|050002D0|5:
A single person could transport quite a heavy load
using one of these.
itm02_01d.bytes|050002D0|6: I'll say!{E108:0010} {E285}I bet I could even cart Gummy off with it!
itm02_01d.bytes|050002D0|7: (And for what purpose exactly, may I ask...!?)
itm02_01d.bytes|050002D8|0: The top of the platform is wet...
itm02_01d.bytes|050002D8|1:
Maybe someone used it to move something liquidy
around?
itm02_01d.bytes|050002D8|2: (Yes,{E108:0008} but the question is who?{E108:0010} ...And what?)
itm02_01d.bytes|050002DB|0:
To think this was disguised as a serving cart and used
to transport the body.
itm02_01d.bytes|050002DB|1:
Don't forget the body was inside a hollow ice block.{E108:0010}
At least now we know why the platform was wet.
itm02_01e.bytes|05000310|0: Boy did this thing get smashed up good, huh?
itm02_01e.bytes|05000310|1:
Indeed.{E108:0010} To the point where it's hard to make out what
it might have once been.
itm02_01e.bytes|05000310|2:
It'd be nice if it had some kind of distinguishing
feature or something...
itm02_01e.bytes|05000313|0: Wait,{E108:0010} haven't we seen these letters before?
itm02_01e.bytes|05000313|1:
...This is the mark of the sculptor Paul Halique,
I believe.
itm02_01e.bytes|05000313|2:
But how did a chunk of ceramic end up in the middle
of a puddle of tea anyway?
itm02_01e.bytes|05000313|3:
(It's just a hunch,{E108:0008} but one suspect quickly comes to
mind...)
itm02_01f.bytes|05000350|1:
That's one way of putting it.{E108:0010}
I lean more towards "eccentric", myself.
itm02_01f.bytes|05000350|2:
Whatever it is,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E280}it won't do for a Great Thief to remain
so ignorant about such chic things!
itm02_01f.bytes|05000354|0: These letters say "PH",{E108:0008} right, Mr. Edgeworth?
itm02_01f.bytes|05000354|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} They show that the teapot was made by Paul
Halique.
itm02_01f.bytes|05000354|3: Right,{E108:0008} but...{E108:0010} I thought his real name was {E284}Artie Frost?
itm02_01f.bytes|05000354|4:
...It was.{E108:0010} Thereby making this a piece by the victim of
the IS-7 Incident as well.
itm02_01f.bytes|05000354|5:
(And his works seem to be everywhere here in Zodiac
Hall...)
itm03_00b.bytes|05000390|0: The prongs of each arm are covered in blood.
itm03_00b.bytes|05000390|1:
The spacing matches that of the wounds in the victim's
chest.
itm03_00b.bytes|05000390|2: But is this really {E108:0010}the murder weapon?
itm03_00b.bytes|05000393|0:
The candelabrum with which the victim's chest
wounds were inflicted.
itm03_00b.bytes|05000393|1:
Now that we know the head wound was the real cause
of death...
itm03_00b.bytes|05000393|2:
...are we to conclude that this was simply used to
mislead investigators?
itm03_00b.bytes|05000396|0:
The base is a very unique shape.{E108:0018} If it were removed
from a dusty shelf or something...
itm03_00b.bytes|05000396|1:
...it would be immediately obvious what had been
standing there.
itm03_012.bytes|050003D0|0:
The right horn seems intact,{E108:0008} but I can't say it's doing
much for the overall symmetry of this stuffed toy.
itm03_012.bytes|050003D0|5:
It would seem there is a recording device hidden
inside.
itm03_012.bytes|050003D0|7: Could this be...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}{E175:001000030000}the moment of the murder?
itm03_012.bytes|050003D0|8: And someone made a recording of it...
itm03_012.bytes|050003D9|0: Twisting this horn makes it play the recording.
itm03_012.bytes|050003DB|0:
I knew it was you the moment I laid eyes on you.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D5}You can't hide that burn from me.
itm03_012.bytes|050003DB|3:
I've waited so long for this day,{E108:0010} and now,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I'll finally
have my revenge!
itm03_012.bytes|050003E1|2: It looks like that's where the horn would have gone.
itm03_012.bytes|050003E1|3: But that doesn't look like stuffing in there.
itm03_012.bytes|050003E1|5:
(Let's take a look at the rest of this toy and see what
else we can find.)
itm03_012.bytes|050003E7|1: I can't help but wonder where it went.
itm03_012.bytes|050003E7|2:
Although,{E108:0008} even if we were to find it,{E108:0008} it might not be
easy to fix up, either.
itm03_012.bytes|050003EA|0: There's a cherry blossom petal caught in the fur here.
itm03_012.bytes|050003EA|1: There were petals on the raincoat, too.
itm03_012.bytes|050003EA|2:
And a cherry tree in bloom up on the viewing
platform.
itm03_012.bytes|050003EA|3:
It would definitely appear that this was taken outside
at some point.
itm03_012.bytes|050003EA|4: (But what did the victim want with this thing...?)
itm03_012.bytes|050003EF|0: There's a cherry blossom petal caught in the fur here.
itm03_012.bytes|050003EF|1:
Kay told us she saw the toy fall to the ground at the
foot of the cherry tree upstairs.
itm03_012.bytes|050003EF|2: I guess that explains how this petal got stuck here.
itm04_000.bytes|05000410|0: This is the pin Kay always wears.
itm04_000.bytes|05000410|1:
It's shaped like the mark of the Yatagarasu, and is
very eyecatching indeed.
itm04_000.bytes|05000410|2:
I can't imagine any thief other than Kay would
want to wear it...
itm04_000.bytes|05000413|0:
There's something I've been wondering for a while
now, but...
itm04_000.bytes|05000413|1: ...is this pin something you inherited or...?
itm04_000.bytes|05000413|2: Nope!{E108:0020} There wasn't one, so I made it myself!
itm04_000.bytes|05000413|3: I suppose that makes sense.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It is quite flashy.
itm04_000.bytes|05000413|4: I can't imagine any other thief wanting to wear it.
itm04_000.bytes|05000413|5: Whaaat!?{E108:0020} You don't have to be so mean, you know!
itm04_000.bytes|05000419|0: Can you show me the inside of your pin again, Kay?
itm04_000.bytes|05000419|2:
But you don't have to ask me to do it.{E108:0010}
You can just do it yourself...
itm04_000.bytes|05000419|3: Oh, wait!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}Is it too tricky for you?{E108:0010} Is that it?
itm04_000.bytes|05000419|4: Just hurry up and open it, will you?
itm04_000.bytes|05000419|6: This is where the bug was hidden.
itm04_000.bytes|05000419|7:
Can't believe I let somebody slip that on me.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I'll NEVER live that down!{E108:0008} Ever!
itm04_000.bytes|05000419|8: (There's no need to get quite so upset...)
itm04_000.bytes|05000424|0: This is the pin Kay always wears.
itm04_000.bytes|05000424|1:
It's shaped like the mark of the Yatagarasu, and is
very eyecatching indeed.
itm04_000.bytes|05000424|2:
I can't imagine any thief other than Kay would
want to wear it...
itm04_000.bytes|05000427|0: The listening device was hidden inside it.
itm04_000.bytes|05000427|1:
There's nothing in there anymore, but
perhaps we should check it just in case.
itm04_011.bytes|05000450|0:
Let's open it up, shall we?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}(We can only hope there's something of value inside...)
itm04_011.bytes|05000450|1: Could this be...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}the bell that was on Mr. Kanis's chisel?
itm04_011.bytes|05000450|2:
Perhaps there's some trace evidence that can
prove that one way or the other.
itm04_011.bytes|05000454|0:
Mr. Kanis's bell.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}As we've established, it doesn't
have a whole lot to tell us.
itm04_011.bytes|05000454|1: Never mind the bell!{E108:0018} Look at the paper it's wrapped in!
itm04_011.bytes|05000457|1: !{E108:0020} And look --{E108:0008} it's covered in {E1D1}some sort of oil!
itm04_027.bytes|05000490|0: Let's look over the sides of the basket just in case.
itm04_027.bytes|05000490|1: Alright!{E108:0010} I'll start from over here!
itm04_027.bytes|05000490|2:
Hey!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}What are you doing just standing there!?{E108:0010}
Help them too, will you?
itm04_027.bytes|05000490|5: This side's clean!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Not even a speck of dirt!
itm04_027.bytes|05000490|6:
(Hmm...{E108:0010} But I'm right about this, I know I am.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}I need to think about the sound it made when it hit.)
itm04_027.bytes|05000490|7:
(It sounded like something harder than the wicker
part of the basket.{E108:0010} Like metal, in fact...)
itm04_027.bytes|05000498|0: I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}was carried in this basket, right?
itm04_027.bytes|05000498|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} Although you were asleep, so I imagine you
have no memory of it.
itm04_027.bytes|05000498|2:
Ugh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Would've been nice to have at least gotten
some fun flying memories out of it...
itm04_027.bytes|05000498|3:
Curse you, Mr. Mastermind!{E108:0018}
I'm gonna kick your butt, just you wait and see!
itm04_027.bytes|05000498|4:
But...{E108:0008} that's not the main reason you want to 
get your revenge...{E108:0008} is it...?
itm04_027.bytes|0500049D|1: With a bullet stuck in it!
itm04_027.bytes|0500049F|0:
The sound we heard on that tape must have been
the president firing a gun.
itm04_027.bytes|0500049F|1:
And this must be all that remains of the bullet he fired.{E108:0010}
There's no denying it now.
itm04_027.bytes|0500049F|2:
You'll find the truth behind all this,{E108:0018} won't you,
Mr. Edgeworth!?
itm04_027.bytes|0500049F|3:
I had to get kidnapped so we could get our
hands on this piece of evidence!
itm04_027.bytes|0500049F|4:
(I wouldn't exactly say that's how we got our hands
on it, Ms. Great Thief.)
itm04_027.bytes|0500049F|5:
But, of course, Kay.{E108:0010} You can count on me.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}I'll bring your kidnapper to justice!
itm04_027.bytes|050004A5|0:
There's a {E107:0003}suuuper long {E107:0002}rope curled up in the
bottom of the basket here.
itm04_027.bytes|050004A5|1:
Look it over --{E108:0008} are there signs of it having been
struck by a bullet?
itm04_027.bytes|050004A5|2:
On it!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}Hey, Mr. Black-Suit --{E108:0008} take the other end,
will you?
itm04_027.bytes|050004A5|5:
Nothing here, either.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Huh...{E108:0010} Guess this isn't what it hit...
itm04_027.bytes|050004A5|6: Then let's move on and find out what it did...
itm04_027.bytes|050004AC|0:
When we've finally proven who was behind all this,
let's tie them up with this rope!
itm04_027.bytes|050004AC|1:
I'll teach you a way of doing it so that even a
professional escapologist couldn't get free!
itm04_027.bytes|050004AC|2:
I understand the sentiment, but perhaps you could
apply that fervor to the pursuit of the truth instead?
itm04_027.bytes|050004AF|0:
There's a gas tank here.{E108:0010} It's fixed to the side
of the basket.
itm04_027.bytes|050004AF|1: Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Doesn't look like it's been hit by {E108:0018}{E107:0003}{E1D1}any bullets.
itm04_027.bytes|050004AF|2:
Which is lucky --{E108:0008} that would not have ended
well for anybody nearby.
itm04_027.bytes|050004AF|3: Alright, let's look elsewhere, shall we?
itm04_027.bytes|050004B3|0: Don't worry!{E108:0020} I've got my eyes on that tank!
itm04_027.bytes|050004B3|1:
Simeon {E108:000C}{E107:0001}{E1D1}won't be escaping in his balloon
if I have anything to do with it!
itm04_027.bytes|050004B3|2:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}struggle to imagine him choosing to make
his getaway by balloon...
itm04_027.bytes|050004B3|3:
Look, you just leave this to me!{E108:0018} Go and concentrate
on nailing him for his crimes, alright!?
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|0: The stage isn't wet at all, {E108:0010}despite the recent rain.
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|1: It must have been covered up somehow.
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|2:
Though it can't have remained covered once
the president's speech began...
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|3: Which means {E108:0018}{E107:0002}{E151:00010038003A}{E188:00300000}{E1D1}the rain stopped before then, right sir?
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|4:
And yet look, Detective --{E108:0010} the spectators' footprints{E108:0008}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}are a muddy mess.
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|5:
That tells us that the rain was still falling when the
spectators began to arrive.
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|6:
From which we can conclude that it must have
stopped not long before the president's speech.
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|7:
And that {E043}the cover was then removed{E040}.{E106}{E198:00000002}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E12D:0001004C}{E100:0000}{E150:00010018}{E101:00010001}{E107:0002}{E282}Nice work, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}That's some top-notch logicking!
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|8:
Hm.{E108:0010} I simply made the connection between two pieces
of {E041}information{E040}.{E108:0010} That's how we discover the truth.
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|9:
(Make the wrong connections, however, and{E108:0010}
we'll only wind up further from the truth.)
logic00_00.bytes|05000510|10:
(Which means I must make well-reasoned
connections if I intend to draw {E041}logical{E042} conclusions...)
logic00_01.bytes|05000530|0:
There is a bullet hole in the flag...{E108:0010} And it seems highly
likely the balloon was popped by a bullet, too...
logic00_01.bytes|05000530|1: Which means two shots were fired...{E108:0010} right, sir?
logic00_01.bytes|05000530|2:
Possibly even three --{E108:0010} the president was shot at
as well, remember.
logic00_01.bytes|05000530|3:
Equally,{E108:0008} the hole in the flag and the hole in the balloon
could have been made by the same bullet.
logic00_01.bytes|05000530|4:
What we need to know is {E041}how many gunshots{E040}
there were...
logic00_02.bytes|05000570|0:
If we knew how many gunshots were heard, we'd
know how many bullets were fired.
logic00_02.bytes|05000570|1: Fortunately, we have a way of finding out.
logic00_02.bytes|05000570|4:
Would you mind playing us your recording of the
president's speech?
logic00_02.bytes|05000570|5:
I surely wouldn't! You just gotta make it worth
my while is all!
logic00_02.bytes|05000570|6: You're gonna make us pay you!? With what!?
logic00_02.bytes|05000570|7:
All's I want is for y'all to answer a few questions.

The only reason the president's alive is because
we bodyguards did our job.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006A0|27: One of us did, anyhow.{E108:0018} {E12F:000F0000}Our boss.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006A0|28: Put himself in the line of fire.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006A0|29: You're referring to your colleague --{E108:0008} Mr. Rook?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006A0|35:
Yeah.{E108:0010} Your friend here killed my colleague.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}My brother in arms.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006A0|36:
Aw,{E108:000C} {E107:0001}{E280}heck no!{E108:0020} I didn't do it!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I didn't kill anybody!{E108:0010}
I could never!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006A0|37:
I'd shut my mouth if I were you.{E108:0018}
Murderer.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006A0|39:
Sure, we did what we had to do.{E108:0010} Sacrificed one of
our pieces to protect the king...
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006A0|40:
But to lose someone like him during a castling...{E108:0018}
It's a real shame.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|2:
Very simplistically speaking,{E108:0008} it's a move where a rook
switches places with the king.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|3: Then why didn't he just say so!?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|6: We'll need to see the victim's body right away.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|7:
And if possible,{E108:0008} I'd like to ask the president a
few questions.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|10:
That's the third piece of news.{E108:0010}
And it's the piece you're gonna like the least.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|11: (I thought you said there were only two...?)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|12:
The {E041}National Police Force of Zheng Fa{E040} will be
handling things from here.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|15:
This investigation was assigned to us.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}We're not about to hand it over!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|17:
The one who solved the {E041}Yatagarasu{E040} case?{E108:0018}
The president mentioned you.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|18: I'm honored to have warranted his attention.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|19:
Makes sense that the Chief Prosecutor would assign
this one to you.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|20:
(Wait,{E108:0008} did the Chief assign me to appease the
president...?)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|21: But that was a mistake.{E108:0010} A big one.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|22:
He should have given the case to somebody with
a spine.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006C9|23:
You're free to take it up with President Wang --{E108:0018}
{E1D1}if you enjoy diplomatic incidents, that is.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|1: We'll continue this on the presidential plane.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|4:
We can do this the hard way if you like.{E108:0010} {E1D1}But in Zheng
Fa,{E108:0008} justice is served one way or the other.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|5: Ruffles!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}C'mon,{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E280}you gotta help me out here!{E108:0008} Please!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|7:
(She was the one in the {E041}red hood{E042} --{E108:0008} there's no denying
that now...)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|8:
(But I can't help feeling we still don't know the whole
truth behind this case.)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|10:
(Can I really let this happen?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Is this really how it
ends?)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|11:
(The look in her eyes...{E108:0010} {E1D1}The crack in her voice as she
begs me to help her...)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|12:
(This is no act by a criminal --{E108:0010} she's genuinely
scared...!)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006E2|13:
(And if I let him take her,{E108:0008} we'll never know what really
happened...)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|1:
...Quiet now.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Is that really any way to greet me?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|2:
Your neck has barely begun to heal, and you've
already forgotten who I am.{E108:0010} I'm disappointed.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|5:
What do you think you're doing, pal!?{E108:0020}
Put the knife down and give it up!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|6:
You got some nerve,{E108:0010} pulling a stunt like this in
front of a bunch of police officers!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|7:
D-Don't even think about it!{E108:0020} {E1D2}You don't stand a
chance against this guy!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|9: Let's just say...{E108:0010} that I'm no simple ice cream seller.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|10: G-Guy's a pro!{E108:0010} {E1D1}A hitman!{E108:0018} His name's--
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|13:
There's not a legal professional in the country
who doesn't know that name.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|14:
An assassin capable of taking down any target,{E108:0010}
anyplace,{E108:0010} anytime.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|15: This isn't the first time our paths have crossed.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|16: It's been too long, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|17:
But of course,{E108:0010} {E107:0003}this is the first time we've met
face-to-face.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|18: YOU'RE the assassin we've been looking for!?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|19:
In a sense, yes.{E108:0010} A certain someone did indeed
hire me to carry out a contract.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|20:
And that contract did indeed specify{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}that I was
to assassinate President Wang...
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|21:
(I swear I've seen his picture in one of my old files
before, but...)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|000006F1|22: (Arngh!{E108:0018} {E107:0003}How could I have been so careless!?)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|0:
My bandage proved useful for bringing a knife
into the park undetected.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|1: But...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I miscalculated in certain other regards.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|3:
Now,{E108:0010} shall we play a little game, Mr. Knight?{E108:0010}
I know how fond you are of such diversions.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|4:
The stakes must be high in order for it to be fun,
of course.{E108:0010} Shall we wager, say...{E108:000C} {E107:0003}{E1D1}your life?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|6:
...I would like for you to allow Mr. Edgeworth to
remain in charge of the case.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|8: What are you up to, de Killer?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|9:
I would simply like our mutual friend to see things
through to their conclusion.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|11:
Bastian Rook was a man of great skill.{E108:0010}
One with whom I felt a certain...{E108:0010} connection.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|12:
It is only right that the truth behind his death be
brought to light.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|13:
With Mr. Rook's departure,{E108:0008} the case is now yours to
investigate, is it not, Mr. Knight?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|14:
I'm simply asking you to transfer that authority to
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|15: It's not something worth losing your life over, surely?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|16:
You're just using the investigation as an excuse to get
close to the president!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|17:
Am I, really?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I suppose it is true that in order for the
investigation to proceed...
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|18: ...we will need to enter the {E041}presidential plane{E040}.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|19:
You think I'm gonna let you near him!?{E108:0018}
I'm his chief bodyguard!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|20:
Are you?{E108:0018} And here I thought you were only second in
command.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|21: Rook's not around --{E108:0010} that means I'm number one!
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|22:
Hmm...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I wonder if you have what it takes to step into
such capable shoes...
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|24:
If that is indeed the case,{E108:0008} then I would ask that you
make a choice worthy of a leader.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|25:
Will you needlessly throw away your life,{E108:000C} or will you
allow the investigation to continue?
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|27:
(Is he really doing this to gain access to the president?{E108:0010}
Does he even need to?)
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|29:
You have no objections, I trust, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0018}
Come,{E108:0010} let us continue the investigation.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|32:
It would seem we have little choice but to do as
we're told.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|33:
That said...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E155:000000000007}Listen, Detective,{E108:0008} and listen well.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|34:
I'll buy us some time as I investigate.{E108:0010}
Meanwhile,{E108:0008} you gather the other officers.
sce0_c0_08.bytes|0000070B|35:
Have them surround the plane, and make absolutely
certain that there is no way he can escape.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F08|0:
When attempting to draw out an entrenched opponent,{E108:000C}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}one must employ certain {E041}tactics{E040}...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F08|1:
Let us picture the board --{E108:0018} {E1D1}and see if we can anticipate
our adversary's next move!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|0: Now, {E108:0010}we must analyze the state of play.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|1:
Y'all ain't gettin' nothin' outta me!{E108:0010}
{E282}Not until you give me somethin' in return!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|2:
(My opponent has dug herself in deep.{E108:0010}
Her defenses won't be easily broken...)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|3:
(But I can't afford to try her patience by taking too
long to plot my next move.)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|5: If my opponent gets too agitated...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|6:
If you're fixin' to ask me somethin',{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E283}will you danged
well ask it already!?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|7:
(...I may be able to gain a tactical advantage{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}{E1D1}by calmly {E041}biding my time{E042}.)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|8:
Then,{E108:0008} when I see {E041}a crack in my opponent's armor{E040}...{E108:0010}
I pounce.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F0A|9: I should begin{E108:0008} {E284}by finding out {E043}what it is that she does{E040}.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F16|0:
Why don't you begin by telling me about what it is
that you do?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F16|1:
Sure!{E108:0010} Or I could totally NOT do that!{E108:0018} {E284}Think I don't
know when to keep my mouth shut?{E108:0010} That's my job!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F16|2:
Is it now?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000009}{E282}So you do something you won't --{E108:0008} or can't --{E108:0008}
tell anybody about?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F16|3:
I--{E108:0008} No, I--{E108:0010} {E280}{E107:0001}SHUT UP!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I AIN'T NO LAW-BREAKER,{E108:0008}
{E1D1}IF THAT'S WHUT YOU'RE INSINUATIN'!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F1A|1:
I'm a law-abidin',{E108:0008} everyday citizen.{E108:0010}
And you got no reason to say otherwise.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F1A|2: Forgive me.{E108:0010} I meant nothing by it.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F1A|3:
If it's something you can't tell me about,{E108:0010} {E12F:00000002}I imagine it
must be {E188:00300000}{E1D1}very important work indeed...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F1A|5: Leastways,{E108:0010} {E1D1}it will be once I bag me my first big scoop.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F20|1: I see...{E108:0010} It's a "scoop" you're after.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F20|2: So you're a journalist.{E108:0010} Is that correct?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F20|4:
Uh, sure...{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E282}I'm your friendly neighborhood reporter!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F20|5: The hungriest cub on the beat!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F20|6:
That's the mystery of what she does for a living
solved.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F20|7:
Perhaps our hungry young cub{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}{E043}has gathered
information{E040} vital to the case.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F20|8: Let's make that our next line of inquiry.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F20|9:
With the opening moves concluded,{E108:0008} the midgame
approaches.{E108:0018} {E283}{E173:0001}What else does she have to tell us?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F2A|0:
At the time of the incident,{E108:0008} were you present at
the scene of the crime?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F2A|1:
C'mon now, Ruffles.{E108:0010} You ain't gonna give little ol'
Tabby somethin' first?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F2A|3:
THEN I AIN'T GIVIN' YOU NOTHIN' NEITHER!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}YOU THINK I'M A SUCKER?{E108:0010} THINK AGAIN!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F2E|1:
C'mon,{E108:0008} this is my career we're talkin' about here!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}You gotta give me SOMETHIN'!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F2E|2:
Sadly,{E108:0008} the more you know,{E108:0008} the more you might find
yourself in danger.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F2E|3:
I,{E108:0008} I ain't scared...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I'm a pro.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Takes more'n the sound of a little gunfire to faze me.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F32|1:
You may be a "pro", as you put it,{E108:0008} but I'd say you're
still a little wet behind the ears.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F32|2:
You say you heard gunfire,{E108:0008} which proves you were
here at the time of the crime.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F32|3: Therefore,{E108:0008} you MUST have seen something!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F32|5:
Fine.{E108:0010} I was here.{E108:0010} I saw it.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Came to report on the
big speech,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}wound up reportin' on a shooting...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F32|6:
And you won't get no more outta me than that!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E282}{E12F:00100008}I'm done with your tricks, Ruffles!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F32|7:
(If she came to report on the event,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}she must have
made {E043}a record of some kind{E042}.)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F32|8:
(A record I would very much like to get my
hands on...)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F32|9:
(This is quite the {E041}clue{E042} as to where to take the
conversation next.)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F3C|0:
I've exhausted this avenue of enquiry.{E108:0010}
Let me try another angle.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F3D|0:
You're a reporter,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}which means you must have been
making a record of some kind.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F3D|1:
You got more questions, {E108:0010}{E107:0002}{E12F:00100002}you gotta give me
somethin' first!{E108:0010} That's the deal!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F3D|2:
I am not in the habit of making deals!{E108:0010}
Now tell me what I need to know!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F42|0:
No self-respecting reporter would leave the house
without a means of putting things on the record.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F42|1: So tell me, Ms. Lloyd --{E108:0010} {E282}where is yours?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F42|3:
Course I made a record!{E108:0018} I told you,{E108:0008} I'm a pro!{E108:0018} {E282}Danged
near wore my shoes out runnin' round on this one!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F42|4:
Which is why I'm not about to just hand it over
to the first person who asks me!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F42|5:
I am not just anyone, young lady.{E108:0010}
I am the prosecutor in charge of this case.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F42|6:
Don't you "young lady" me!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You ain't gettin' it!{E108:0010}
No matter how many times you ask!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F49|0:
You are bringing this on yourself.{E108:0010}
I hardly see how I'm to blame!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F49|1:
Oh,{E108:0008} {E281}{E12F:00100008}you don't, huh!?{E108:0020} Well, how about I {E1D1}spell it out
for you!?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F49|2:
I told you,{E108:0008} you ain't gettin' it!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E283}Now back off,{E108:0008} or I might stop playin' nice!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F49|3:
(Seems I pushed her too far.{E108:0018} {E1D1}I have to be careful to
{E043}pick my words more wisely{E042}...)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F4D|1:
You understand, don'tcha, Ruffles?{E108:0010}
It ain't nothin' personal.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F4D|2: I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}understand that your job is a difficult one.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F4D|3: You do?{E108:0010} Well, ain't that sweet!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F4D|4:
And in such a competitive field,{E108:0008} you must sometimes
doubt that you'll ever succeed...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F4D|6:
Just as long as I got my trusty tape recorder,{E108:0008}
{E1D1}I'll always be ready to nab me a scoop.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F54|1: A young reporter,{E108:0008} hungry for success...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F54|2:
So dedicated to her craft{E108:0008} {E284}that to leave such an
important event unrecorded would be unthinkable.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F54|3:
And indeed she did not.{E108:0010} She committed the entire
event...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F54|6: ...Fine,{E108:0010} sure --{E108:0010} {E285}I recorded the whole darn thing.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F54|7: It's all right here.{E108:0010} You got me, okay?
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F5D|1:
Hey, partner!{E108:0010} This ain't no time for the silent
treatment, y'hear?{E108:0018} {E1D1}I'm a busy woman!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F60|0:
It's more effective to {E041}bide my time{E040} the more agitated
or upset my opponent seems.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F60|1:
And when they're vulnerable,{E108:0010} {E12F:00000009}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}that's the time to go
on the {E041}verbal offensive{E040}!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F62|0:
Uhh...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I'm not rightly sure whut you're gettin' at
here, Ruffles...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F62|1:
(C-Curses...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I should have {E043}picked my words more
wisely{E042}...)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F64|0:
Uhh...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I'm not rightly sure whut you're gettin' at
here, Ruffles...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F66|0:
I have you now!{E108:0010} {E282}Your last statement leaves you
wide open!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F67|0: Don't you see?{E108:0018} {E12F:00000009}{E282}There's nowhere left to hide!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F68|1:
I don't have a {E041}clue{E040} as to how to push the conversation
forward.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F68|2: I'll have to try another tack...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6B|0:
No offense, Ruffles,{E108:0010} {E1D1}but you done lost me a little
ways back.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6B|2: I can't give up now.{E108:0010} I have to keep pushing...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6F|1:
I was tryna be all strong and silent...{E108:0010} but you had me
singin' like a canary...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6F|2:
Never mind that.{E108:0018}
{E12F:00000008}{E1D1}Now play us the tape.
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6F|3:
(This should finally tell us {E041}how many shots were
fired{E042}...)
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6F|5:
You played me like a fiddle, Ruffles.{E108:0010}
Only the Chief ever played me so good...
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6F|6:
So you gotta agree to be{E108:0008} {E285}Chief Number Two!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}And be mentor to a rising star,{E108:0010} AKA me!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6F|7:
"Chief Number Two", huh?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Kinda like a second
parent?{E108:0018} {E282}{E12F:00010004}That's a big responsibility, sir!
sce0_c0_09.bytes|00001F6F|8:
And one more thing --{E108:001E} {E107:0001}{E1D5}{E1D2}{E12F:00100008}{E12F:00000006}{E188:00200000}{E178:00010000}I want exclusive reporting

Two whole days, in fact!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AD8|3:
So a member of the media had to rely on...{E108:0010} the media
to find out about this event...?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AD8|4: Hey, I'm still gettin' started in this here business!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AD8|5:
If you give me a little more to work with next time,{E108:0008}
maybe I'll be on the scene sooner!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000ADF|0: Hey,{E108:0008} you never did pay me for this here vital evidence!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000ADF|1:
Alright,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}let's get some basics down first --{E108:0018} {E12F:00100004}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}favorite
food?{E108:0010} Favorite drink?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000ADF|2:
Oh, it's gotta be tea!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Mr. Edgeworth loves tea!{E108:0010}
Even has his own special blend at the office!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000ADF|3:
Well now, well now...{E108:0018}
{E12F:00100003}So our prosecutor likes to put on airs and graces...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000ADF|4:
"Airs and graces", hmm...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D5}{E188:00300000}{E12F:00000008}And why is the detective answering on my behalf?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000ADF|5:
Who better, sir?{E108:0012} There's nothing I don't know about
you, after all!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000ADF|6: Oh ho ho!{E108:0018} Is that so?{E108:0010} Tell me more...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AE7|0:
Well, this ain't the work of a pro,{E108:0008} I'll tell you that.{E108:0010} No
paper's gonna run some snapshot over a real photo.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AE7|1: I think the photographer would beg to differ.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AE7|2:
Naw,{E108:0010} you gotta have more drama!{E108:0018}
You gotta capture a moment!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AE7|4: So...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}the president was felled by a bullet after all?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AE7|5:
You tell me, Ruffles.{E108:0018} {E12F:00100000}I was just paintin' word pictures
is all!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AE7|6:
Then I suggest you leave "word pictures" to an actual
pro{E108:0008} and stop muddying the facts any further!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AEE|0:
Way I heard it,{E108:0008} that there president's got enemies{E108:0008} and
then some --{E108:0010} both in and outside his country!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AEE|1:
I figured he was gonna get shot someplace,{E108:0008} somehow.{E108:0010}
Was only a matter of when.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AEE|2:
Wait,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000009}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}you're not telling me you came here expecting
him to get shot?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AEE|3:
Hey now,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E280}don't go puttin' words in my mouth!{E108:0020}
{E12F:00100000}I came 'cause the president's a great man!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AEE|4: I figured there was a scoop just in him bein' here!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AEE|5: ...Doesn't seem like much of a scoop, if you ask me.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AEE|6: Awww...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}C'mon, Ruffles,{E108:0008} cut me some slack, will ya?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AF5|0:
Well,{E108:0008} this is quite the situation, wouldn't you say,{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E173:0000}Mr. Edgeworth?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AF5|2:
It's Payne, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:000C} Winston Payne?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}We work together at the Prosecutor's Office.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AF5|3:
(H-He's a prosecutor!?){E108:0024}
{E107:0002}{E150:00000029}Um,{E108:0008} what brings you here today, Mr. Payne?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AF9|0:
Well,{E108:0008} this is quite the situation, wouldn't you say,{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Mr. Edgeworth?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AF9|1:
It's Payne, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:000C} Winston Payne?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}We work together at the Prosecutor's Office.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AF9|2: What brings you here today, Mr. Payne?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AFC|0:
Heh heh heh!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}What indeed!{E108:0018} Why,{E108:0010} only the invitation of
the Chief Prosecutor himself.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AFC|1: (His voice...{E108:0020} I recognize it from the tape recording...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AFC|2:
(Was he one of the men who was standing in front of
Ms. Lloyd?)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AFC|3: And where is the Chief Prosecutor?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AFC|4:
He had to leave, I'm afraid.{E108:0010} He's a busy man.{E108:0010} They
let him --{E108:0008} and only him --{E108:0008} out through the cordon.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000AFC|5:
(So he had me summoned on short notice,{E108:0008} and then
left before I even showed up?)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B03|0: Man,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}the lens is cracked!{E108:0018} {E1D1}What am I gonna do?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B03|1:
The circuit board's hanging out...{E108:0010}
The whole thing's spitting sparks...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B03|2:
It's like a firework show in there.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Probably not a good idea to touch it, I guess...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B03|3:
D-Definitely not!{E108:0010} Fireworks can be deadly!{E108:0020}
{E156:0001002A00000000}{E107:0002}{E1D1}Right, sir?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B03|5:
(The cameraman is clearly otherwise occupied.{E108:0010}
Perhaps I can talk to him later.)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|0: You're with one of the news channels?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|2:
You must have footage of the event.{E108:0018}
Do you mind if I take a look?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|3:
Ah...{E108:000C} {E1D1}Wish I could help you, but...{E108:0018}
{E284}That might be a little tricky...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|4:
And why's that,{E108:0018} huh, pal?{E108:0020} You got a problem with
doing your civic duty or somethin'!?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|5:
No,{E108:0008} it's just that my camera was knocked over
in all the panic.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|6: And now {E107:0003}I can't get it to work...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|7: That footage would have helped immensely...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|11: You look like you need a little help, {E1D1}Mr. Edgeworth!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|14:
Honestly!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I leave you alone for two seconds!{E108:0018}
But don't worry --{E108:0010} {E107:0001}your hero's here to save the day!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|15:
That's right!{E108:0010} The one, the only...{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}Kay Faraday!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|16:
("Hero"...?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Only you would give yourself a title like
that...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|17: So you're not a "Great Thief" anymore?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|18:
Not right now.{E108:0010} But it's not like I quit!{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}I'm just...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}on sabbatical.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|19:
I'm taking time out for some intensive training.{E108:0010}
Being the second Yatagarasu doesn't come easy!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|20:
Kay helped me out on a few occasions about two
weeks ago when I was working a case.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|21:
The case of the {E041}Yatagarasu{E040} --{E108:0008} a mysterious thief
who seemed to appear and disappear at will...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|22: And who claimed only to steal the {E041}truth{E040}.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|23:
She calls herself the "second Yatagarasu".{E108:0010}
The successor to the so-called {E041}Great Thief{E040}.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|24: There's not a lock I can't open{E108:0008} or a trap I can't escape!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|25:
And when it comes to stealing...{E108:0010} {E12F:00020004}{E1D1}well, I'm still in
training.{E108:0010} But I'll get there soon enough!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|26: What are you doing here, Kay?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|27:
What do you think I'm doing?{E108:0010} I've been enjoying the
festivities, of course!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|28:
(I suppose she did mention being fond of such
things...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|29:
And afterwards,{E108:0008} I was thinking of dropping by your
office to see you guys --{E108:0010} but now I don't have to!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|30:
Good to see you, kiddo!{E108:0010}
You're as bright and breezy as ever!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|31:
Hey, Gummy!{E108:0010} How ya been?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}You're looking pretty full of beans yourself!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|32: So, Kay --{E108:0012} {E107:0002}are you really here to save the day?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|33:
Yup,{E108:0008} heh heh!{E108:0018} Prepare for your jaw to hit the floor!{E108:0010}
Your best pal in the world here only went and...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|35:
Did you now...?{E108:0024}
{E12F:00000008}{E285}Then you'd better show them to me.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|36:
Wow!{E108:0010} Your jaw didn't even drop an inch!{E108:0020}
{E12F:00020002}What's a girl gotta do to impress you, huh?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|37:
I know, right?{E108:0010} Mr. Prosecutor here's about as much
fun as {E1D1}a danged toothache!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|38: Won't even let me call him "Chief"...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|39:
Aw, but I'm forgettin' my manners.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Tabby Lloyd,{E108:0006} {E107:0002}ace reporter,{E108:0010} at your service!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|40:
Nice to meet you, Tabby!{E108:0020}
{E12F:00020002}You're right,{E108:0008} he's no fun at all.{E108:0010} This one time, he--
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|41:
You two can chat later.{E108:0018}
Kay, can I see those pictures?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|43: I took this one right when the gun went off!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|44: It was total chaos!{E108:0018} People running everywhere!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B09|46:
(The names on the security plan were...{E108:0010}
"{E041}Knight{E042}" and "{E041}Rook{E042}", I think?)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B38|1:
Thank you, indeed, Kay.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000004}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}I think you've provided us
with a vital clue.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B38|2:
Hoowee!{E108:0010} {E1D1}Your eyes just lit up like a pair o' {E1D2}danged
Christmas trees!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B38|3:
Well, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0010} Care to tell the readers
whut you've spotted?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B38|5: Huh?{E108:0010} A whut now?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}I don't see nothin' strange...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B38|7:
(This picture shows the {E041}moment of the incident{E042}.{E108:0010} But
another piece of {E041}evidence{E042} shows something different.)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B38|8: (I need to highlight the point of contradiction...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B38|10: (First,{E108:0008} to find the contradiction in the photograph...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B43|0:
(Yes, this is it.{E108:0010} I'll simply press {E2B0:0003} to make my
deduction...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B44|0: I don't see anything of interest there.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B44|1: (I need to find the contradiction in the photograph...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B46|0:
(Now,{E108:0008} to {E1D1}{E041}Present{E042} the evidence that proves the
contradiction!)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B47|1: If you say so, sir.{E108:0018} I can't see anything myself...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B47|2:
Hmph.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You don't see it?{E108:0010} Something so obvious?{E108:0018}
{E12F:00000004}That's a contradiction in itself...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B47|3:
Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0010} you, uh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}You know if you made a
mistake you can just tell me, don't you?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B47|4: A mistake!?{E108:0010} I have done no such thing!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B47|5: And I'll prove it to you!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B47|6:
(I've already located what's contradictory between this
photograph and the evidence.)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|0:
Look closely at the picture of the president in this
newspaper clipping, if you would, Ms. Lloyd.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|1:
Now look at Kay's photograph.{E108:0010}
Compare the two carefully.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|2: Huh?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Whut am I lookin' for here...?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|4:
Indeed.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}There's something on the president's forehead.{E108:0010}
Something that wasn't there in the other picture.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|6:
Yeah...{E108:0010} Guy's got a big, {E043}red birthmark{E040}, right in the
middle of his forehead!{E106}{E198:00000008}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E12D:00010052}{E10D:000100010002}{E10E}{E110:00020002}{E111:000000010000000100000000}{E112:0000}{E10D:000000010002}{E10E}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}{E1D1}I highly doubt a birthmark just sprang up there since
the other picture was taken.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|7: Did he get bitten by a bug, then, maybe?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|8: Yeah, that's it!{E108:0010} That right there's a big old bug bite!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|9:
And here I thought it was somethin' important!{E108:0010}
The look on your face!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|10: Hmph.{E108:0010} You should know that the road to the truth...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|11: ...is paved with just such seemingly trivial details.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|12:
Ooh!{E108:0010} Again with the face!{E108:0020}
{E12F:00100003}{E1D1}Alright, alright!{E108:0010} Duly noted, Chief!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B4E|13:
Kay's Photograph data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B5D|0: Is there no way you can recover the footage you lost?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B5D|2:
How come?{E108:0018} You can't even get a little of it back?{E108:0010}
Not even a few seconds?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B5D|3:
I'm not thrilled either, buddy,{E108:0010} {E1D1}but the tape's
completely busted, okay?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B5D|5: Afraid so.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Those people trampled it into the dirt.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B65|0:
Did you like my big entrance?{E108:0018}
Bet I really AM your hero now, huh?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B65|1: Well,{E108:0010} your evidence helped things along, certainly.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B65|2:
Hey,{E108:0008} I'm the second Yatagarasu, remember?{E108:0010}
All in a day's work!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B65|3:
...Kinda wish I coulda showed you how far I've really
come with the whole Great Thief thing, though.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B65|5: Don't worry!{E108:0010} {E1D1}I haven't stolen anything, yet!{E108:0010} I promise!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B6B|0:
So the whole Great Thief thing is just on hold.{E108:0010}
For now, anyway.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B6B|2:
Yeah.{E108:0010} I wanted to get out there and start stealing back
the truth like my dad.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B6B|3:
But I've still got a ways to go with my training.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E12F:00020002}{E1D1}And I need to find some partners in crime...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B6B|5:
I can't be the only girl in the world looking to pull off
the most daring heists ever attempted!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B6B|6:
(True,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}but not many people are looking to pull off a
career in larceny either, I'd wager.)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B72|0:
Yep,{E108:0008} no doubt about about it.{E108:0010} If you compare the pic
I took to the newspaper clipping...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B72|1:
...the red birthmark stands out like a sore thumb.{E108:0018}
That's a contradiction, alright.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B72|2:
Indeed.{E108:0010} Though I very much doubt it's due to a
birthmark suddenly appearing.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B72|3:
Oh, that reminds me!{E108:0010} I might have to steal that line of
yours.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B72|4:
"The road to the truth is paved with seemingly trivial
thefts."
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B72|5:
Funny,{E108:0010} I don't remember that being the exact
sequence of words I used.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B72|6:
Why just rob a house{E108:0008} {E1D1}when you can rearrange the
furniture, too!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B72|7:
(You may call it "rearranging",{E108:0008} but I call it
"irretrievably corrupting"...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B7A|0: Hey, I'm a Great Thief.{E108:0010} I totally sympathize.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B7A|1:
If you feel you gotta grab something,{E108:0008} you should just
go ahead and grab it.{E108:0010} Even if it's worthless.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B7A|2:
(She doesn't seem to think much of my little
"treasure"...)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B7D|1:
As it should be.{E108:0010} After all, it symbolizes both the
sanctity and the strictness of the law.
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B7D|3: Love, justice, peace, courage, duty, and compassion!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B82|0:
The Steel Samurai's great and all,{E108:000C} {E12F:00020008}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}but everybody
knows it's all about the Jammin' Ninja these days!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B82|1:
Running around in old timey Japan,{E108:0008} having amazing
adventures,{E108:0008} singing cool songs...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B82|3: Is he the one who isn't even an actual ninja?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B82|4:
That's him!{E108:0018} {E12F:00020008}{E280}He used the power of his amazing ninja
songs to become a superstar!
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B82|5:
Maybe I should give it a try...{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}"The Singing Thief"...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}What do you think?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B82|6:
(A singing thief would be arrested in a heartbeat.{E108:0010}
...Which is a good reason not to stop her, I suppose.)
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B89|1:
Some prankster must have snuck up while he was
sleeping and...
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B89|2:
So you're saying that this picture is irrelevant?{E108:0010}
That it's worthless as a piece of evidence?
sce0_c0_m01_npc.bytes|00000B89|4: After all,{E108:0010} I took it --{E108:0010} and taking things is what I do best!
sce0_c0_partner.bytes|00000CA1|0:
Well...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}the rain's stopped.{E108:0010} And it was falling right up
until the president got here.
sce0_c0_partner.bytes|00000CA1|1:
Even the mist has lifted.{E108:0010} Barely a cloud in the sky...{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}*sigh*
sce0_c0_partner.bytes|00000CA1|3:
I was supposed to be fishing --{E108:0008} right here on this lake,

{E281}AAAAAAAAAAAAAA{E1D2}AAAAAAAAAAAAARRR!{E108:003C}{E104}{E100:0001}{E10D:000200010004}{E10E}{E108:003C}{E110:00020000}{E111:000E00090002000000000000}{E112:000E}{E10D:000000010004}{E10E}{E188:00E90000}{E12F:000E000A}{E112:000E}{E12F:000E000C}{E112:000E}{E100:0000}{E12F:000E000B}{E101:000E0010}{E107:0003}Nngh...{E108:0010} Nnrgh...!{E108:0010} No!{E108:000C} {E1D1}No, I...{E108:0018}
I...{E108:000C} {E1D1}Aaaaaargh...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|49: (The presidential mask has well and truly slipped...)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|50: Admit it.{E108:0018} {E12F:00000008}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}The entire "assassination" was a lie,{E108:0010} wasn't it?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|51:
Arrrngh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}If that stupid chief prosecutor hadn't
insisted on assigning you...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|55: Sorry,{E108:0008} but I'm speaking with the president right now.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|56:
Yeah,{E108:0008} well I'm doing my job as a knight and protecting
my king.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|57: So go ahead.{E108:0010} Keep running your mouth.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|58:
Perhaps it would be better if we stuck to threatening
each other with words...?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|60: Nah.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I don't need this thing to shut you up.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|62: You claim I fired my gun from onstage.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|63:
How do you figure I did that{E108:0018} {E188:00340000}{E1DA}in front of a crowd
of thousands?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|64:
An excellent point.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00000000}Time for my counter-move, I suppose.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|000013C0|65:
You had a certain something that allowed you to
conceal your actions.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|0000140D|0:
(What did Knight use to hide his actions from the
crowd?){E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:00130005}{E100:0000}{E12F:00000001}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}You used this to hide your suspect actions,{E108:0010} {E12F:0000000B}didn't you?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|0000140D|1: And that makes me a suspect...{E108:0008} how?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|0000140D|2:
Sorry, Mr. Edgeworth, but...{E108:001E} {E12F:00020001}{E284}it IS a pretty suspect piece
of evidence to pin your case on.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|0000140D|3: Yeah.{E108:0018} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}Suspect enough to show I'm not your suspect.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|0000140D|4:
(The key question here is how Knight managed to fire
his gun without the crowd noticing.)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|0000140D|5: (He must have used something to cover things up.)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|0000140D|6:
(I'm sure there's something that captured the moment
the incident occurred that I can review for a clue...)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|1: Yes.{E108:0010} Take a look at Kay's photograph.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|2: Your right hand is completely obscured by the case.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|3:
At the very moment this picture was taken,{E108:0008} you were
firing your gun.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|4: And in such a way that you wouldn't be detected!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|5:
You don't like to let the facts get in the way of a good
theory, do you, Edgeworth?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|6: Shame you don't seem to have noticed.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|8:
That theories are all you have.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Conjectures --{E108:0008} nothing more.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|9:
The flag was billowing in the wind at precisely the
right moment?{E108:0010} {E1D1}I hid my gun with my attaché case?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|10:
We changed the security plan because I couldn't turn
my head?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|11:
It's all just speculation --{E108:0008} circumstantial evidence, at
best.{E108:0010} You can't prove any of it.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|13:
If you at least had the bullet that burst the balloon,{E108:0008}
you might have a scrap of credibility.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|14:
Imagine,{E108:0010} you could've run forensics to see if it
matched my gun.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|15:
But no.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}That bullet is at the bottom of the lake.{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}{E1D5}You gonna go dredge it up?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|16:
(I hate to say it, but he's right...{E108:0018} {E1D1}I don't have anything
concrete...)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|17: I thought not.{E108:0010} Maybe now you can shut your mouth.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|20:
(Of course!{E108:0010} {E1D5}She could shed some light on this whole
situation.{E108:0010} I just need to get her to talk!)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|21:
What's the matter?{E108:0018}
{E12F:000F0006}{E188:00590000}{E1D1}Something you wanna say, Miss Journalist?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|26:
I need you to be brave.{E108:0010} If you don't speak up,{E108:0008} the truth
will be lost forever.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|27: You are a journalist after all,{E108:0018} {E12F:00000004}{E188:00300000}{E107:0003}{E1D5}are you not...?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|30:
Hey!{E108:0010} You understand what you're doing, right?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}I'd think carefully before opening {E1D1}that mouth of yours.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|31:
I was so focused on baggin' me a scoop, I...{E108:0010} I forgot
the most important thing of all...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|33: Ain't no danged scoop if it ain't the truth!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|34:
I'm sorry, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
I shoulda showed you this before...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|36: It's the laser pointer I used on the president.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|37: But that's all I done!{E108:0018} {E12F:00100008}{E280}I never shot nobody!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|39:
I thought I told you!{E108:0010} You squeal,{E108:0008} and you go down as
an accomplice!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|40: It was him!{E108:0010} He told me to do it!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|41:
I was at Zheng Fa's embassy,{E108:0008} sniffin' out a story, like
I told you.{E108:0010} This was three days back.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|42: He comes up to me outta the blue,{E108:0008} just starts talkin'.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|43:
"Help me out an' I'll get you exclusive access to the
president."{E108:0010} That kinda stuff.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|44: But what about the gun in the trash can?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|45:
That I don't know nothin' about,{E108:0008} I swear it.{E108:0010}
All's he told me...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|46:
...was to wear a jacket with a red hood,{E108:0008} and to point
that there pointer at the president.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|47:
I never thought for a minute it'd blow up in my face so
bad.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}{E1D1}I'm sorry.{E108:0010} Truly, I am...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|48:
Thank you, Ms. Lloyd.{E108:0010} I'd like you to testify to that
effect when this goes to trial.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001415|49:
It ought to go a long way towards proving that the
assassination was a sham.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|0:
Argh!{E108:0010} What's wrong with you people?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Don't any of you know what's good for you?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|1:
My sympathies, Mr. Knight.{E108:0010} Had you successfully
removed me from this case as you'd intended...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|2:
...perhaps then you could have kept your "pawn" quiet,
hm?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|4: So let me get this straight.{E108:0010} You told Tabby...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|5:
"If you let slip about our fake assassination plot,{E108:0008} we'll
have you convicted for murder!"
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|10:
Give it up, Knight.{E108:0018} It's time we came clean.{E108:0010}
It's our only choice.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|11:
So, Mr. President, {E108:0018}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}you admit it.{E108:0010} You admit that there
was a plot to fake an assassination attempt?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|13: But why?{E108:0010} Why do something like that?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|14: M-My popularity has been on the wane back home...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|15:
I thought surviving an attempt on my life might give
me the boost I needed...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|16:
I know what we did was wrong!{E108:0010}
So yes,{E108:0008} it was all lies!{E108:0010} All of it!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|17: And the bullet in the vest...?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|18:
It was planted ahead of time.{E108:0010}
I wasn't hit by anything today.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|21:
And then he just appeared,{E108:0008} hell-bent on {E041}turning our
fake assassination into a real one{E040}!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|23:
(He'd hoped to get in close enough as the "fake
assassin" to finish the job...)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|24: There IS one thing I don't understand, though.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|25: Oh?{E108:0010} And what would that be?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|26: Why did Rook have to die?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|27:
If the whole thing was fake,{E108:0018} {E1D1}how did he wind up
getting killed for real?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|28: (That's true...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}And therein lies the real question.)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|29: He was a fine bodyguard.{E108:0010} The best, in fact.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001447|30:
He may not have been a native of Zheng Fa...{E108:0018} but he
was someone I could fully trust.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|1:
Mr. Rook must've been really something to gain the
trust of someone who'd hide from his own shadow!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|2:
Sounds like he was as trustworthy to the president as
I am to you,{E108:0008} huh, sir!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|3: (I believe that's for me to say, Detective,{E108:0008} not you.)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|4:
Mr. Rook must have known about the plan too, then,{E108:0008}
correct?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|5: He wasn't aware of any specific details,{E108:0008} so not really.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|6: ...I tried to involve him...{E108:0010} but he refused.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|7: And you would have done well to listen to him.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|8:
*sigh*{E108:0010} This is a tragedy.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The life of a good man has
been wasted.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|11:
He was just another piece on the board,{E108:0008} there to
protect you.{E108:0010} Nothing more.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|13:
Who was it that actually went along with your plan,{E108:0010}
huh, Mr. President?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|14:
While that pious coward backed down when you
needed him to step up the most!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|15: I, {E108:000C}{E1D1}I value your support too, of course, but...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|16:
Look,{E108:0010} I'm your chief bodyguard now.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}That's all that matters.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|17:
And now that that spineless fool Rook is gone,{E108:0008} things
are gonna change around here.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|18:
Thanks to me!{E108:0018} Genius strategist!{E108:0010} Grandmaster!{E108:0020}
Rightful leader of this team!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|19: We are all well aware of your ambitions, Knight.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|20: But...{E108:0010} doesn't this seem a little...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}imprudent to you?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|21:
Heh heh heh!{E108:0018} Why?{E108:0010} My plan this time was perfect!{E108:0010}
As they always are,{E108:0008} and as they always will be!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|23:
Especially considering that your "perfect" plan was an
abject failure.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|24: Yeah, no thanks to you...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:000F0008}{E280}and that buffoon Rook!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|25: And how exactly was it Mr. Rook's fault?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|26:
If he hadn't died,{E108:0008} de Killer would've never come after
me.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|27: And I wouldn't have had to let you on this plane!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|28: Please, Mr. Knight!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}You mustn't talk like that...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|29:
Fine.{E108:0010} The guy died protecting you, Mr. President.{E108:0010}
I'm sure that's just what he always wanted.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|30: (But DID he die protecting the president...?)
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|31: Wait!{E108:0020} {E12F:00020001}{E1D1}I thought the whole assassination thing was fake?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|32: Aw, come on!{E108:0010} Do I have to say everything twice!?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|33:
We planned a fake assassination.{E108:0010} But somebody else
came along and tried to make it real.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|35:
Like you said, Edgeworth,{E108:0008} one of them was the bullet
I shot through that balloon.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|37: Oh, really?{E108:0020} {E12F:00000008}Then who did fire it?
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|38:
The real assassin.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}...But not de Killer.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|39: His plan was to come after the president with a knife.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|40:
No,{E108:0010} the most likely suspect here...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}is the piece
cowering quietly in the corner...
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|44:
Again with this!?{E108:0018}
I'm not your danged assassin!
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|45: But is that really true?{E108:0018} I for one don't believe it.
sce0_c1_06.bytes|00001467|46: The gun in the trash can --{E108:0018} {E12F:000F0006}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E107:0002}it can only belong to you!
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|1:
As soon as I shot that balloon,{E108:0008} I rushed over to help
Rook escort the president back onto the plane.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|2:
I left Rook here in this room while I secured the
president in the safe room.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|3:
When I came back out,{E108:0008} Rook was lying there on the
ground.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|4:
Miss Journalist must have shot Rook while we were
escorting the president off stage.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|5:
That single, killer shot...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D5}was fired by the gun you
found in the trash can!
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|6:
So you don't actually know when the victim was struck
by the bullet, do you?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|7: The knight doesn't protect the rook, Edgeworth.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|10:
He means that his only concern was protecting the
president.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|11:
Lose the king and you lose the game.{E108:0010} Isn't that the first
rule of chess?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|12:
But a win in which a key piece is sacrificed is a hollow
victory indeed.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|13:
Doesn't matter,{E108:0008} it's still a victory!{E108:0018}
{E188:00310000}{E1D2}I kept the president safe!{E108:0010} I win!
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014C0|14:
Well, it's a bit early to be calling our little match, in
any case.{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E12F:00000009}{E1D1}For this is where our battle really begins!
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D0|0:
As soon as I shot that balloon, I rushed over to help
Rook escort the president back onto the plane.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D1|0:
I left Rook here in this room while I secured the
president in the safe room.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D2|0:
When I came back out, Rook was lying there on the
ground.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D3|0:
Miss Journalist must have shot Rook while we were
escorting the president off stage.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D4|0:
That single, killer shot... was fired by the gun you
found in the trash can!
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D5|0:
So Mr. Knight's suggesting that he first fired one shot,{E108:0008}
and then Ms. Lloyd fired one more.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D5|1:
Yeah,{E108:0008} basically implying that Tabby also had a gun on
her.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D5|2:
Beats me where she could have got one from,{E108:0008} but
hey...
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D5|3:
His entire testimony is pure conjecture.{E108:0010}
He can't prove any of it.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014D5|4:
You're right!{E108:0010} Let's hit him with some cold,{E108:0008} hard,{E108:000C}
{E12F:00020008}{E280}undeniable evidence!
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|0:
The victim really didn't take part in your little plan,
then,{E108:0008} did he?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|1: Nope.{E108:0010} And we kept him in the dark on the details.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|2: So he really thought the president was in danger?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|3:
But wait --{E108:0010} {E1D1}he must have noticed that the shot
came from right next to him...?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|4: Maybe he did.{E108:0010} Guess we'll never know.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|5: And even if he did know it was a sham...
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|6:
...he still had a job to do.{E108:0010} He still had to protect his
king.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|7:
And he was able to make a judgment like that in a split
second?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|8: Impressive.{E108:0010} He really was as capable as they say.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|9: Not so capable that I couldn't read him like a book.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014DA|10:
I made it so he had no choice but to go along with
our little performance.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014E5|0:
Why do that?{E108:0018} You and the president both knew the
whole thing wasn't real.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014E5|1:
But it had to SEEM real.{E108:0010}
There were people everywhere.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014E5|2:
It's not a good look, right?{E108:0018} Imagine if someone had
spotted a man who'd just been shot at...
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014E5|3:
...hanging out in his plane, sipping grape juice like he
didn't have a care in the world?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014E5|4: ...And what was the victim doing during all this?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014E5|5: Who knows.{E108:0010} I was in the safe room, like I said.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|1: Right where he is now --{E108:0010} the middle of the floor.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|2: The door to the outside was shut, though.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|3:
Guess the bullet must have hit him right before he
closed it.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|4:
And thanks to his little blunder,{E108:0008} my whole plan fell
apart.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|5: Mr. Knight!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You mustn't talk that way!
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|6:
He may have kept you safe, Mr. President,{E108:0008} but he isn't
here now to save your good name.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|7:
I'd call that dereliction of duty.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}What would you call it?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|8:
(An honorable try...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}which is more than what you'd
give, I'd say.)
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014EC|9: Sorry,{E108:0008} but that's just how it is.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|0:
Weren't you and Mr. Rook both carrying bulletproof
attaché cases?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|1:
Yeah.{E108:0010} Opened them right after Rook spotted the laser
sight.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|2:
We moved into covering positions and used them to
shield the president.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|3:
So the bullet that hit Mr. Rook traveled through a gap
in that defensive shield?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|4:
Do you really believe Ms. Lloyd to be that skilled a
marksperson?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|5:
Heh,{E108:0008} no.{E108:0010} She was aiming for the president.{E108:0010}
That makes her a lousy shot.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|6: So it was pure coincidence that Mr. Rook was hit?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|7:
And the bullet simply happened to find its way past
your attaché cases and through the gap in his vest?
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|8:
Seems crazy to me, too.{E108:0010}
But the facts are the facts.
sce0_c1_07.bytes|000014F6|9:
It was a shot in a million,{E108:0008} but the shooter hit the
