Um, sure.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(If it'll cheer her up,{E108:0008} I suppose I can let it slide...)
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE3|0:
Suddenly,{E108:0008} the prosecutor pulled out a revolver,{E108:0008} and
pointed it right at the innocent young reporter.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE3|1:
Her tragically short life over --{E108:0008} almost before it had
begun.{E108:0010} She crumpled, doll-like, into a watery grave...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE3|2:
Perhaps if you'd actually been shot I could understand
you saying such awful things, Ms, Lloyd...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE3|4:
But if I wait that long, I won't be able to say nothin'
at all!
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE9|0:
I didn't know the guy!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}I didn't have no reason to
kill him!
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE9|1:
Mr. Rook may have been the one who died,{E108:0008} but it
seems the president was the real target.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE9|2:
Well, I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I didn't have no reason to kill him, neither!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}I never even heard of the guy!
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE9|3:
Remind me again --{E108:0008} what it was you said you came
here to do today?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE9|4:
Well, I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}That is, uhh...{E108:0010} Well, you know how--{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}Aww,{E108:0010} just quit tryin' to trick a girl, will ya?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AE9|6: I...{E108:0008} I'm sorry.{E108:0010} You got me.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF0|0:
The bullet had torn through the vest like a knife
through hot butter.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF0|1:
Its raggedness is surpassed only by the agonized
screams of the president it had felled...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF0|2: I don't know if you heard,{E108:0008} but the president wasn't hit.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF0|3:
Hush, now.{E108:0010} Let a girl write what she wants, okay?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E12F:00100005}{E1D1}Not like it's gonna get published anyhow, anyway...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF0|4: (Have you ever considered just writing...{E108:0008} the truth?)
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF5|0:
I have high hopes for your investigation.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}I do hope you won't betray my trust in you.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF6|0:
I have high hopes for your investigation.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}I do hope you won't betray my trust in you.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF7|0: Things are progressing well, I hope?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF7|1:
There's no need to worry.{E108:0010}
Things are progressing just fine.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF7|2:
...Remember,{E108:0008} I absolutely despise betrayals of
all kinds.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF7|4:
...Indeed you do.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}So please,{E108:0008} do take care not to
double-cross me...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}accidentally or otherwise.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AF7|5:
(Nngh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I really have no choice but to do as he says
for now...)
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|0:
Can't believe...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D2}I let an assassin onto the president's
plane!
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|1:
You know very well it was for the good of the
investigation, Mr. Knight.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|2:
Don't give me that!{E108:0020}
{E1D2}I know what you really want!
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|3:
You do indeed.{E108:0010} Because you heard me say it already --{E108:0010}
I wish to know the truth behind Mr. Rook's death.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|4:
But you did also say you were asked to assassinate
the president.{E108:0010} By a...{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}"{E041}certain someone{E040}"?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|5:
.........{E108:0010}{E107:0002}You seem to have forgotten that there are more
pressing matters at hand.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|7:
I don't often carry out unpaid work...{E108:0010} but it's not
entirely unheard of...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|8: Arngh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Fine.{E108:0010} I'll get back to the investigation.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001AFD|9:
Good.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I am expecting great things from you,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B07|0: You really think that's the key to cracking this case?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B07|1:
It may not seem it, Mr. Knight,{E108:0008} but Mr. Edgeworth
has his methods.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B07|2:
His reasons for presenting such an item are myriad,{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}I am sure.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B07|3:
Uh...{E108:0010} Yes,{E108:0008} precisely.{E108:0010}
(I won't get away with that too many times...)
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B0B|0:
I must admit, I have never seen one of these up
close.{E108:0010} It's akin to a license, correct?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}I, too--
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B0B|1: No way,{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}you have a license to kill!?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B0B|2: No,{E108:0010} but if I must spell it out for you...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B0B|4:
You can keep that little nugget of truth locked up
nice and tight in your heart, okay?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B0B|5:
(So,{E108:000C} even a Great Thief's bravado quickly crumbles in
the face of an assassin.)
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B11|1:
...I see you are also quite a dark-hearted man,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B11|3:
If you would like to talk business,{E108:0008} we can do so later
in private...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B16|1:
This is today's security plan for the president's speech,
correct?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B16|3:
Yeah, that's right.{E108:0010}
There's me...{E108:0008} and there's Rook.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B16|4: Should've been me standing there,{E108:0008} not him...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B16|5:
(I can't help but feel that he has some unresolved
issues when it comes to Mr. Rook...)
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B1C|0:
...Such a frightfully blunt instrument.{E108:0010}
No knowledge or skill required.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B1C|1:
The use of such a tool speaks to a fundamental lack
of...{E108:000C} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}reverence for the craft, wouldn't you say?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B1C|2:
You're telling me there's a level of "reverence"
involved when choosing a murder weapon?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B1C|3:
Indeed I am, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0018}
You wouldn't agree?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B1C|5: (Wh-{E108:0008}What is there even to apologize for!?)
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B23|0:
This single piece of evidence was all it took for you to
track me down.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}You really are as good as they say.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B23|1:
I still don't get why you hid it under the Samurai Dog
stand.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B23|2: As I said,{E108:0008} I did not wish to be mistaken for the shooter.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B23|3:
A shooter you identified by means of a different jacket
entirely.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B23|4: ...Or do you doubt your own logical conclusions?
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B23|5:
(I have to admit,{E108:0008} there are no lies to be detected
in his words...)
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B29|0: I bet not even Rook saw it coming.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B29|1:
And who could blame him?{E108:0010} Guy like that getting
killed by some minor-league hack...
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B29|4:
Now, Mr. Edgeworth --{E108:0008} continue with your
investigation.
sce0_c1_m02_npc.bytes|00001B29|5:
...{E107:0002}Right.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}(What is he hoping to achieve here...?)
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B41|1:
Well, I don't know if we can say that with any
certainty just yet.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B41|2: But Mr. de Killer is a professional assassin, right?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B41|3:
And Tabby was pointing a laser sight at the
president...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B41|4: Ahh,{E108:0008} I give up.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}This one's a real mind-bender.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B41|5:
If the truth cannot be discerned,{E108:0008} it is because
something is obscuring it.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B41|6:
Oh, I gotcha!{E108:0010} So if we can swipe that something,{E108:0008}
{E1D1}the next treasure we bag will be the truth!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B41|7: Yes,{E108:0008} I suppose you could put it that way.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B49|0:
I've been studying up on how to investigate like a pro,
you know.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B49|1: Have you, really?{E108:0010} That's good to hear.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B49|2:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}So basically, you {E041}Examine{E040} stuff,{E108:0008} and that helps
you figure out what {E041}Evidence{E040} and {E041}Information{E040} to bag.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B49|3:
Then you Connect some of that {E041}Info{E040} you picked up,{E108:0008}
Present some {E041}Evidence{E040} you've pocketed...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B49|4:
And poof!{E108:0010} Suddenly, you're making off with the
greatest treasure of all --{E108:0008} the truth!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B49|6:
Well?{E108:0010} Can't say I haven't been putting the work in,
can you?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B51|0:
I can't believe a real-life assassin is asking us to
investigate a real-life crime!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B51|2: Either way, all we can do now is push on ahead.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B51|3: Let's do this, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} {E12F:00020008}{E1D1}For Mr. Rook!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|0: It's hard work being somebody's trusted sidekick.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|1: I don't remember ever asking you to be one.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|2:
And how come you get to do all the detectiving and
have all the fun?{E108:0014} {E107:0001}{E12F:00020006}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}It's no fair!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|3: I don't remember becoming a detective, either...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|4:
But you've got the brains for it --{E108:0010} all you're missing
is a pipe in your hand!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|5:
I'm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}not sure I know what we're talking about
anymore...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|6:
Are you kidding?{E108:0018} We're talking about how to be the
perfect sidekick!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|7:
Maybe I should keep a database where I can store all
the vital {E041}information{E040} we find...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B55|8:
But then I'd just be doubling up on what you already
do, huh...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B5F|0: Hey, I'm a Great Thief.{E108:0010} I totally sympathize.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B5F|1:
If you feel you gotta grab something,{E108:0008} you should just
go ahead and grab it.{E108:0010} Even if it's worthless.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B5F|2:
(She doesn't seem to think much of my little
"treasure"...)
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B62|1:
As it should be.{E108:0010} After all, it symbolizes both the
sanctity and the strictness of the law.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B62|3: Love, justice, peace, courage, duty, and compassion!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B67|0:
The Steel Samurai's great and all,{E108:000C} {E12F:00020008}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}but everybody
knows it's all about the Jammin' Ninja these days!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B67|1:
Running around in old timey Japan,{E108:0008} having amazing
adventures,{E108:0008} singing cool songs...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B67|3: Is he the one who isn't even an actual ninja?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B67|4:
That's him!{E108:0010} {E1D1}He used the power of his amazing ninja
songs to become a superstar!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B67|5:
Maybe I should give it a try...{E108:0014}
{E107:0003}"The Singing Thief"...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}What do you think?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B67|6:
(A singing thief would be arrested in a heartbeat.{E108:0010}
...Which is a good reason not to stop her, I suppose.)
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B6E|0: I knew I'd bagged the {E041}truth{E040} about the laser sight.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B6E|1: But who knew I'd swiped a shot of Mr. de Killer, too?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B6E|2: Yes.{E108:0010} We wouldn't have found him without your help.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B6E|3:
Hee hee!{E108:0014} {E1D1}{E188:00340000}{E12F:00020008}Well, just you wait!{E108:0010} Next time,{E108:0008} I'll be bringing
home the biggest treasure ever!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B6E|4: I don't want to sound like a broken record, but...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B6E|5:
Yeah, yeah!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Don't worry!{E108:0010} You know I wouldn't stealing
anything but the {E041}truth{E040}!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B6E|6:
For your sake, I hope that's the truth, the whole truth,
and nothing but the truth...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B75|0: I could really use one of these.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B75|1:
I wonder if Gummy can hook me up with a bulletproof
loot bag and some bulletproof ninja socks, too...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B75|2:
Does a true Great Thief really need all their gear to be
bulletproof?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B75|3:
Well,{E108:0008} how else do you expect me to survive the hail of
bullets at the end of every job?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B75|4:
Or do you want me and my {E041}treasures{E040} to end up like
Swiss cheese?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B75|5: (Just what kind of heists is she planning...?)
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B7B|0: So the bullet went in just under his armpit...?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B7B|1:
It did.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}One of the few parts of his torso not protected
by the vest.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B7B|2:
And the medics never made it in time...{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}Do you think he was in pain before he...?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B7B|3: We don't have time to think like that.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B7B|4:
The only way to end his pain now is to discover the
truth.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B7B|5: You're right!{E108:0010} And I'm going to help you do just that!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B81|0: So this is what a bulletproof vest looks like.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B81|1:
It's just...{E108:0008} a super-thick vest.{E108:0010}
Kinda disappointing, if you ask me.
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B81|2: It's exactly what it says on the tin...
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B81|3:
Sure.{E108:0010} I just expected it to be a little more...{E108:0008} {E284}chonky,
you know?{E108:000C} Like knights armor --{E108:0010} now that'd be cool!
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B81|5:
Yeah, but it shouldn't be a prisoner to its name!{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Otherwise, how would it evolve!?
sce0_c1_partner.bytes|00001B81|6:
(Hate to break it to you, but historically speaking,{E108:0008} your
suggestion is a devolution down the tree of armors...)

Here he comes!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}The presidential plane descends from
the western skies,{E108:0008} bringing a message of peace!{E108:001E}{E104}{E100:0001}{E100:0000}{E101:FFFF0040}{E107:0002}It's making its final approach,{E108:0008} and lands right on

sce0_opening.bytes|FFFFFFFF#2|0:
Just listen to {E1D1}that crowd!{E108:0032}{E104}{E100:0001}{E100:0000}{E101:FFFF0040}{E107:0004}{E1D1}Welcome, Zheng Fa!{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D2}Welcome, Mr. President!
sce0_opening.bytes|FFFFFFFF#4|0:
Honored friends and allies!{E108:0018}
I am here today to deliver a message!{E108:0028}{E104}{E101:FFFF003F}{E107:0002}The odious criminals that dogged my beloved nation
are no more!{E108:0028}{E104}{E101:FFFF003F}{E107:0002}Thanks to the {E1D1}Prosecutor's Office of your great

sce0_opening.bytes|FFFFFFFF#6|0:
We shall crush the wicked with the righteous hammer
of justice!
sce0_opening.bytes|FFFFFFFF#8|0:
Call the Prosecutor's Office!{E108:0014}
Get Miles Edgeworth here right away!{E108:001E}{E104}{E107:0003}If anyone can solve this, {E108:0010}{E1D1}he can!
sce1_c0_01.bytes|01000080|5: How long do they intend to keep us waiting!?
sce1_c0_01.bytes|01000080|6:
Now, now, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} I'm sure the guard will
bring him in any second now.
sce1_c0_01.bytes|01000080|8:
It's been two days since the incident at the park,{E108:0008} and
today,{E108:0008} we're paying a visit to the detention center.
sce1_c0_01.bytes|01000080|9:
Our aim, of course,{E108:0008} is to interview Bronco Knight,{E108:0008}
who has been charged with the murder.
sce1_c0_01.bytes|01000080|10:
His trial is due to start tomorrow,{E108:0010} {E107:0003}and I am to be
the prosecutor behind the bench.
sce1_c0_01.bytes|01000080|11:
What's taking so long...?{E108:0020}
{E107:0002}{E150:00000028}{E108:0008}You there!{E108:0010} What's going on!
sce1_c0_01.bytes|01000080|16:
Come on, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}What are you waiting for!?
sce1_c0_01.bytes|01000080|17:
Right.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Guard!{E108:0018} Take us to the scene of the crime at once!
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|0:
(So it didn't happen in the holding cells?{E108:0018}
But surely that was where he was being held?)
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|2:
Wh-{E108:0008}{E1D1}Where are you taking us?{E108:0010}
Doesn't this door lead to...?
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|4: You mean those other cells aren't part of the prison?
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|5:
Not exactly, no.{E108:0010} Those are the {E041}detention center's{E040}
holding cells.
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|6:
That's where defendants are kept while they're
awaiting trial.
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|7:
The area beyond this door...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}serves a rather different
purpose.
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|8:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E1D1}It's where the people who ARE convicted serve
out their time.
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|9:
I supposed you could say,{E108:0008} it's the last place a Great
Thief should ever want to be.
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|10:
I've unlocked it, sir!{E108:0018}
{E188:00340000}{E1D2}{E1D5}Please,{E108:0010} follow me!
sce1_c0_02.bytes|01000100|12:
(How could this have happened?{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}And how did he wind up inside the prison proper!?)
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|1:
Th-This is horrible!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}How did Mr. Knight get himself
murdered!?
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|2:
I can hardly believe it myself...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}but there can be {E1D5}no
doubting the evidence of our own eyes.
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|3:
And what's he doing here?{E108:0010} I thought he was being
held in the detention center, no?
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|4:
He was.{E108:0010} He must have been.{E108:0018}
His trial hadn't even begun yet.
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|5:
The law states that until convicted,{E108:0008} suspects are to be
kept in cells separate from the main prison.
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|6:
(Only those who have been found guilty are sent to
the prison proper.)
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|7: (There's no way Knight should have been in here...)
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|8: Maybe he wandered his way over?
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|9:
The detention center and the prison are seperated not
only by two heavy doors,{E108:0008} but also a lengthy corridor.
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|10:
That would have been a long way to wander.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}Especially for a detainee.
sce1_c0_03.bytes|01000180|12:
We'll need to examine the scene of the crime carefully

Do you remember what you were doing at the time of
the incident?
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000322|1: I was, uh...{E108:0010} catchin' some Z's.{E108:0010} We both was.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000322|2:
The incident happened only a short while ago.{E108:0010}
You seem wide awake,{E108:0008} all things considered.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000326|1:
Fighter's gotta be able to get up quick when he's down.{E108:0010}
But he needs his beauty sleep, too.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Builds muscle.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000326|2: Is that so?{E108:0010} Then I apologize for waking you.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000326|3:
I have read that rest is an important part of any
boxer's training regime.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000326|5:
So Mr. Prosecutor's savvy when it comes to the fight
game, huh?{E108:0010} {E1D1}Who knew?
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|1:
How do you know I'm a prosecutor?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I don't remember telling you...
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|4:
You've been listening to every word we said out here
in the corridor!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|5:
Which means you weren't asleep!{E108:0018}
And that you are lying!{E108:0010} Again!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|7:
You're {E1D1}good, kid.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Caught me clean with that one.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|8: Alright,{E108:0008} I admit it.{E108:0010} I wasn't catchin' no Z's.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|9:
But what?{E108:0018} {E285}A guy can't work out in his cell no more
{E282}without lawyers gettin' involved?
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|10: Or is a man takin' care of himself a crime now?
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|11:
(The fact that we now know he was awake is an
important development.)
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100032C|12: (It could well prove to be a useful {E041}clue{E042}.)
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000339|0:
I've exhausted this avenue of enquiry.{E108:0010}
Let me try another angle.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100033A|0:
Did you notice anything strange around the time of the
incident?
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100033C|0:
Answer the question!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Tell me what was going on around that time!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100033C|1: Wish I could help ya, boss.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100033C|2: But I was asleep.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}We both was.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100033C|3:
I don't have a {E041}clue{E040} as to how to proceed with this line
of questioning.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100033C|4: I need to reconsider my approach.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000342|1:
You weren't asleep,{E108:0008} you were exercising!{E108:0010}
{E283}You told me as much yourself!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000342|2:
Oof...{E108:0020} A counterpunch, huh?{E108:0010}
Shoulda seen that one coming...
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000342|3: It seems I have you on the ropes, Mr. Carcerato.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000342|4: It's time to come clean about what you know!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000342|5:
...!{E108:0020}
Alright, alright.{E108:0010} {E1D1}You don't gotta shout about it.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000342|6:
Stompin' around like ya own the place!{E108:0010} {E1D1}Teddy an' his
pals have been scared enough this morning already.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000349|0:
You've done well to endure this long,{E108:0010} {E1D1}but I fear you'll
soon be out for the count.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000349|1:
You say the animals have been scared enough already,{E108:0010}
{E285}which implies something happened here earlier.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000349|2: Well?{E108:0018} What was it, Mr. Carcerato?
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000349|4: Arngh...!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Quit it,{E108:0008} will ya?{E108:0010} {E1D1}I'm gettin' shellacked here!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000349|6:
Somebody yelled,{E108:0008} okay?{E108:0010} Real loud.{E108:0008} Real scared.{E108:0010}
Got all the little guys scared, too.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000349|7:
Yeah,{E108:0018} laugh it up, Mr. Bigshot Lawyer...{E108:0018}
{E283}Lemme see ya do the same thing in the ring!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000352|1:
Hey,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E283}get the heck outta the ring if you're not gonna
fight!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000352|2:
Arngh...{E108:0018}
I'll need to attack more if I am to win.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000355|1:
Hey,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E283}get the heck outta the ring if you're not gonna
fight!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000355|2:
Arngh...{E108:0018}
I'll need to attack more if I am to win.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000358|0:
He tends to adopt a boxing stance when he's raring for
a fight.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000358|1:
I should bide my time in such moments and aim to
strike when he drops his guard.
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100035A|0:
Haven't you noticed yet?{E108:0010}
You're backed into a corner here!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100035A|1:
Get a loada this guy, Teddy!{E108:0010}
Thinks he's got the champ on the back foot!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100035A|2: Guess I better knock some sense into him!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100035A|3:
(Curses...{E108:0010} I should have picked my words more
wisely.)
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100035E|0:
Haven't you noticed yet?{E108:0010}
You're backed into a corner here!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100035E|1:
Get a loada this guy, Teddy!{E108:0010}
Thinks he's got the champ on the back foot!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100035E|2: Guess I better knock some sense into him!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|0100035E|3:
(Curses...{E108:0010} I should have picked my words more
wisely.)
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000362|0:
You're wastin' my precious trainin' time!{E108:0010}
So put 'em up or get outta the ring, ya bum!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000363|0:
You're wastin' my precious trainin' time!{E108:0010}
So put 'em up or get outta the ring, ya bum!
sce1_c0_06.bytes|01000364|1: I can't give up now.{E108:0010} I have to keep pushing...
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|0:
I think we've now established that you know more
than you're letting on,{E108:0010} don't you?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|3:
Let's not get carried away, Kay.{E108:0010}
Our work here has only just begun.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|4:
Hey,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}can we call a "time out" here for a sec, guys?{E108:0018}
{E284}There's something super big I need to say.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|5:
It's just...{E108:0010} well,{E108:0008} it's like "fate" brought us here today
after all these years, Edgeworth.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|6:
And it's a real privilege watching how you work.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Eye-opening stuff, in fact.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|7:
...Just thought you should know I'll be telling
{E188:00300000}{E041}you-know-who{E040} what you've become.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|10: Keen to get the lowdown, huh?{E108:0010} Well--
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|11: That's enough.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E283}This has nothing to do with Kay.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|12:
...Whoa,{E108:0010} {E1D1}don't have a cow, man.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Why so sensitive?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|13:
Report whatever you wish to whomever you wish.{E108:0010}
Just do it on somebody else's time.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|14:
...Whatever you say, boss man.{E108:0010} But I think HE should
know, at least.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|15:
You know,{E108:0010} how you've been living your life since you
signed onto doing things the von Karma way.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|16:
After all,{E108:0010} {E285}you've disappointed him enough for one
lifetime already,{E108:0008} am I right?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|17: Wh-{E108:0008}What's he talking about, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|18:
Nothing that need concern you, Kay.{E108:0010} Our focus should
be on Mr. Carcerato.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|19:
Now,{E108:0008} shall we continue?{E108:0018}
{E280}{E173:0000}It's time to hear the truth at last.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|20: ...Heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Ya won't land a glove on me, kid.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|22: There was a show,{E108:0008} finished right around 10 AM.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|23: Came back here after.{E108:0008} Did me some trainin'.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|24:
Leastways,{E108:0008} I tried to.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Barely got to the count of two
before somebody screams,{E108:0008} {E280}"WHAT THE--!{E108:0008} AAAAAAH!"
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|25: Guy was hollerin' and howlin',{E108:0008} {E107:0003}cryin' for help...
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|26:
But what can I do?{E108:0008} I'm locked up in here, right?{E108:0010}
So I tunes it out,{E108:0008} and I gets back to work.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|27:
...I find it curious that you would pay so little heed to a
desperate cry for help.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|28: Like I say, boss,{E108:0008} what can I do?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|29:
Besides,{E108:0008} this is the joint.{E108:0010} Don't nobody thank nobody
for gettin' involved in what ain't none o' their concern.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|30:
I hear you, brother.{E108:0010} Best you could do is rubberneck
from in there anyway,{E108:0008} am I right?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|31:
You mentioned training, Mr. Carcerato.{E108:0010} I can't help but
notice how well equipped your cell is.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|32: There's a guy.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}The {E041}fixer{E040},{E108:0008} they call him.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|34:
Fella who can get his hands on just about anything ya
need.{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E107:0003}For a price...
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|36:
Because I can promise you that {E285}you'll be down for the
count in one.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|01000380|37:
You?{E108:0010} Put ME down!?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Try it,{E108:0008} ya bum!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003A9|0: There was a show, finished right around 10 AM.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003AA|0: Came back here after. Did me some trainin'.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003AB|0:
Leastways, I tried to. Barely got to the count of two
before somebody screams, "WHAT THE--! AAAAAAH!"
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003AC|0: Guy was hollerin' and howlin', cryin' for help...
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003AD|0:
But what can I do? I'm locked up in here, right?
So I tunes it out, and I gets back to work.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003AE|0: If only this wasn't a prison...{E108:0008} Mr. Knight might've lived.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003AE|1:
I somehow doubt it.{E108:0010} Frankly speaking,{E108:0008} there was no
saving him.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003AE|2:
What!?{E108:0018} {E1D1}But if somebody could've just gotten to him in
time...
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003AE|5:
(Let's see what I can uncover {E1D5}by pointing out the
contradiction in his testimony.)
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003B4|0: What kind of "show" was it, exactly?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003B4|1:
Depends on the day.{E108:0010} They bring 'em in from outside,
see.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003B4|2:
Singers,{E108:0008} dancers,{E108:0008} all kinds.{E108:0010} Gives us cons a little
somethin' to look forward to.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003B4|4: And you went along to see today's show?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003B4|5:
Sure I did.{E108:0010} Can't miss a chance to get a glimpse of the
outside world now, can I?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003BB|1:
Uh,{E108:0008} let's see now...{E108:0010} Today was stamina and rhythm
work.{E108:0008} Which means jump rope.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003BB|2: Whaaat!?{E108:0018} In that tiny cell?{E108:0010} How?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003BB|3: And what about Teddy?{E108:0010} Isn't that dangerous for him?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003BB|5:
Second I get my rope out,{E108:0008} he jumps up and holds on
tight.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003BB|6:
You jump rope with a polar bear clinging to your
chest...?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003BB|7:
I told ya, didn't I?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}We're partners.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}And besides,{E108:0008} a little extra weight's good for me.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003C4|0: Tell us more about the scream you heard.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003C4|1: It was the scream of a guy{E108:0008} about to scream his last.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003C4|3:
Wh-{E108:0008}Whoa there, good buddy.{E108:0010}
There's a time and a place, you know.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003C4|5:
Guy backed into a corner,{E108:0010} fightin' for his life...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You ever hear somethin' like that, boss?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003C4|6: Well, I have.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}And yeah,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}it was "clearly audible".
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003CB|0: And that's all you heard?{E108:0010} There was nothing else?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003CB|2:
So there WAS something.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}What else did the victim say?{E108:0010} You have to tell me.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003CB|3:
Oh,{E108:0008} I do, huh?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Why don'tcha come on over here and
I'll see if I can make ya squeal like he did!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003CB|4:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!{E108:0018}
Forgive the kid here,{E108:0010} he doesn't know when to quit.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003CB|5: Come on, Miles!{E108:0018} Apologize to the good man!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003CB|6:
(But this is clearly important!{E108:0010}
{E12F:00000009}And yet,{E108:0008} he insists on remaining infuriatingly vague.)
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003CB|7:
Look, friend,{E108:0010} how about you let this slide?{E108:0010}
Please!{E108:0008} For me!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003CB|8:
.........{E107:0002}Hmph.{E108:0018}
So yeah,{E108:0008} I heard the voice, like I said...
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D4|0:
You were able to concentrate on your training,{E108:0008} even
after hearing all that screaming?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D4|1:
Look,{E108:0008} if we was on the outside,{E108:0008} maybe things woulda
been different.{E108:0010} Maybe I'da seen what I could do.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D4|2:
But this ain't the outside.{E108:0010} I can't go no place,{E108:0008} even if I
want to.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D4|3:
And you didn't think to slip out from your cell to go
sneak a peek?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D4|4:
I don't think anybody else would've thought of doing
that except you, Kay...
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D9|0: Take a look at this, if you will, Mr. Carcerato.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D9|1: Looks like he's busy chasing a fly, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D9|2: I don't think he heard a word you said!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003D9|4:
In that case,{E108:0008} {E1D5}I'd better hit him with something that will
really get his attention!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003DF|0:
This piece of evidence contradicts your testimony,
Mr. Carcerato!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003DF|2: My grandmother has a better {E1D1}{E188:00310000}jab than you!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003DF|4: I thought I'd thrown a decent punch there...
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003DF|6: Indeed!{E108:0010} My next one will be {E1D1}{E1D5}right on the money!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003DF|7: And he'll be on the canvas before he knows it!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|0: Are you listening carefully, Mr. Carcerato?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|1: Huh?{E108:0018} {E280}{E107:0001}You tryna be cute or somethin'?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|2:
The victim died from a wound to the throat.{E108:0010}
And very quickly, at that.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|3:
He had neither the time nor the ability to scream as
you claim he did.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|5:
You say you heard the victim's cries,{E108:0008} and yet,{E108:0008} that
would have been impossible.
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|6:
I...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I...!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}But...{E108:0010} There musta been a scream!{E108:0010} He said there was!
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|8:
Nnrgh!{E108:0018}
Quit lookin' so smug, will ya?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|9: Fine,{E108:0010} I admit it.{E108:0018} {E280}I didn't hear nothin',{E108:0008} alright?
sce1_c0_07.bytes|010003E7|10:
But the guy in the next cell did!{E108:0010}
{E282}He told me so!
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000400|1:
Huh?{E108:0018} Whaddaya want?{E108:0018}
I heard a scream.{E108:0010} What of it?
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000400|2:
We came back from the show and they put us in our
cells,{E108:0008} same as always.
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000400|3:
Then,{E108:0008} just like I told this guy,{E108:0008} I heard it.{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}A scream.{E108:0010} A real scary one.
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000400|5: Didn't tell him this part, I guess,{E108:0008} but it was kinda like...
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000400|7:
"Someone!{E108:0018} Anyone!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E280}Come quickly!{E108:0010} H-{E108:0008}He's..."{E108:0018}
Something like that.
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000400|8:
Well...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}I guess it's safe to say that probably wasn't the
victim.
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000400|9:
Indeed.{E108:0010} It sounds more likely to have been the {E041}person
who found his body{E040}.
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000400|11: So Mr. Carcerato WAS telling the truth!{E108:0010} ...More or less.
sce1_c0_08.bytes|0100040C|0:
(Is that really the case, though?{E108:0010} Are there really no
problems now with his testimony...?)
sce1_c0_08.bytes|0100040D|0:
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Mr. Carcerato's testimony doesn't appear to
have any further issues.
sce1_c0_08.bytes|0100040D|3:
Then riddle me this:{E108:0010} If Carcerato's neighbor heard the
scream...
sce1_c0_08.bytes|0100040D|4:
...then how come Carcerato himself didn't hear it, too?{E108:0018}
Bit of a conundrum, no?
sce1_c0_08.bytes|0100040D|5:
Gnrk!{E108:0018}
(I should have thought of that...)
sce1_c0_08.bytes|0100040D|7: I thought we cleared all that up already.
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|0:
I'm afraid a new problem has reared its head.{E108:0010}
Namely...
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|1:
Why didn't you hear the scream yourself,
Mr. Carcerato?
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|3:
How come you didn't hear anything when your
neighbor heard it clear as day!?
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|8: Whaddaya think I did the crime, or somethin'?{E108:0010} Huh?
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|9: From inside of this here cell!?
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|10: Guy died over in the workshop,{E108:0008} in case you forgot!
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|11:
!{E108:0018} Well, uh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00010004}{E188:00300000}Yeah,{E108:0008} it does seem a little weird,{E108:0010} now that
you mention it...
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|12: He's right!{E108:0018} Neither of us coulda done it!
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|13:
Cause lemme tell ya,{E108:0010} if I could get outta this here cage
and murder somebody,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}you'd all be toast!
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|15:
Ain't that the truth!{E108:0010} You bums ain't leavin' this place in
one piece if any of us can help it!
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|16:
(I almost forgot that these men are hardened criminals.{E108:0018}
Well,{E108:0008} I won't be doing that again anytime soon.)
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|17:
Eh heh heh...{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Uhh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'm guessing this wasn't how you
saw this going, Edgeworth?
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|18:
(What's my next move here?{E108:0010} I won't get much more
out of them in this state...)
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|21:
Who died and made you the boss o' me, huh?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E280}Can'tcha see we're kinda busy here!
sce1_c0_08.bytes|01000415|25:
By the power vested in me,{E108:0010} I hereby sentence you...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}to
blissful silence.

pursuit of accurate facts and information.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000571|0: Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Looks like a pulley of some kind.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000571|1: Maybe the prisoners use it for work?
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000571|3: Okay,{E108:0008} so I know you're going to say no, but--
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000571|4:
Absolutely not, Kay.{E108:0010} You are not permitted to swing on
that rope.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000571|6: Argh,{E108:0010} I should've known you were being serious.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000578|0: There was a rope near Knight's body, too...
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000578|1: Speaking of which,{E108:0010} {E285}wanna see my super stealthy--
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000578|2:
Rope escape trick?{E108:0010} Thanks,{E108:0008} but I'll let you know when
I'm in need of saving.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100057E|0: What's with all the weird equipment?
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100057E|1:
I'm not sure.{E108:0010} But I don't see anything particularly
suspicious here.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100057E|2:
Smells weird, though...{E108:0018}
Kinda...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}musky,{E108:0008} like wet fur.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100057E|3: I didn't know you had such a keen nose.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100057E|4:
Oh,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}it's nothing special really --{E108:0010} {E156:0002001A00000000}{E285}except when it comes
to sniffing out treasure!
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100057E|5:
Remind me to seal all my valuables away in airtight
containers.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100057E|6:
No way, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
I'd never steal any of your stuff!
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100057E|7:
(But you would happily steal someone else's?{E108:0010}
I'm not sure that's entirely reassuring...)
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000586|1: It doesn't seem to contain any useful clues.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|01000586|3:
You do know we're not actually looking for treasure,
right...?
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100058A|0:
These seem to be lists of prisoner reservations for
this workshop.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100058A|1: What are all these numbers, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100058A|3: I'd hate to be given a number like that...
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100058A|4: I rather agree.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}People are meant to have names.
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100058A|5:
...I'd much rather be called "Great Thief",{E108:0010} or
"The Second Yatagarasu"!
sce1_c0_m07_check.bytes|0100058A|6: Alright,{E108:0008} no name for you then, I guess.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|0: So the victim asked you to represent him?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|1: Sure did.{E108:0010} We were supposed to have a little chat today.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|3:
But a guard showed up instead,{E108:0010} {E284}and told us that his
body had been found...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|4:
I'm as bummed about it as you.{E108:0010} Even brought him
some {E041}weenies{E040} to cheer him up.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|5:
Mr. Fender.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You know you can't bring food into
the prison.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|6:
Heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Oh yeah.{E108:0018} {E12F:000A0001}Well, it's here now.{E108:0010} {E285}Want some?{E108:0018}
Little vice I picked up on my travels.{E108:0010} So moreish!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|8:
Fine,{E108:0010} you do you.{E108:0018} What are you doing here, anyhow?{E108:0010}
Don't tell me you wanted to hear Knight's side?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|9:
Von Karma{E040} was always more of a "{E041}convict the
defendant at all costs{E040}" guy.{E108:0010} He didn't teach you that?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000600|11:
If you say so.{E108:0020}
{E107:0002}{E285}...Sure you don't want any weenies?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|0: Have you met with your client previously?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|1: Yes indeed, "Your Honor".{E108:0010} Just yesterday, in fact.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|2: The Broncster called me the minute he was arrested.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|3:
Sounded really freaked out, man.{E108:0020}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Oh yeah --{E108:0010} {E107:0002}mentioned your little performance, too.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|4:
According to him,{E108:0008} you really made a nuisance of
yourself.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|5:
(And not a kind word was spoken, I'm sure.{E108:0010}
Well,{E108:0008} sticks and stones and all that.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|6:
Boy, did he not like you!{E108:0010} Trash-talked you something
fierce!{E108:0018} {E1D1}Heh.{E108:0010} Can't say I didn't join in the fun, though!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|8:
Lighten up, kid.{E108:0010} I'm kind of a fixture in the visitor's
room here...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|9: ...and I don't think I ever had that much of a gas!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|10: Oh!{E108:0010} So you come here a lot?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|11:
Hey, hey, hey!{E108:0010} Don't go getting the wrong idea, little
sis.{E108:0010} {E284}I'm never on the wrong side of the bars.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|12: Just happen to know someone who is.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|13:
The visitor's room is usually "where I'm at",{E108:0008} but this
isn't exactly my first time in the clink, either.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100060D|14:
(In which case...{E108:0008} I'd better ask him what he knows
about this room.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100061C|0:
Tell me,{E108:0010} what do you know about the scene of the
crime?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100061C|2:
"Non, non", dude.{E108:0010} What do YOU know about it?{E108:0018}
I'll give you three choices:
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100061F|1:
What,{E108:0008} like they tied the Broncster up in here to teach
him a lesson!?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100061F|2:
Check out those powers of deduction!{E108:0010}
A pat on the head for our genius prosecutor!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100061F|3:
Now,{E108:0008} let's see what the answer key has to say,
{E176:00020000}{E108:0018}{E107:0003}shall we?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000623|1: Well...{E108:0010} {E12F:000A0004}{E107:0002}it does have a dead body in it...!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000623|2: And dead body equals morgue,{E108:0008} amirite?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000623|3:
Now,{E108:0008} let's see what the answer key has to say,
{E176:00020000}{E108:0018}{E107:0003}shall we?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000627|1:
Whoa!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I don't even want to know how you spend your
spare time, Edgeworth!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000627|2:
But I guess there's plenty here you could play with if
you used your imagination.{E108:0010} Probs.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000627|3:
Now,{E108:0008} let's see what the answer key has to say,
{E176:00020000}{E108:0018}{E107:0003}shall we?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|0:
Oh no!{E108:0010} You got it wrong!{E108:0020}
{E107:0002}{E12F:000A0001}This is actually...{E108:0008} a {E041}workshop{E040}!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|2:
(...So all the options he gave me were wrong.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}How infantile.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|3: The cons come here to perform "various duties".
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|4:
They can learn new skills, too --{E108:0008} bank some
qualifications for when they're back on the street.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|5: I see...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E285}And how is access to this room controlled?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|7: Chill out, Edgeworth!{E108:0010} I don't have all the answers!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|8:
My man over there probably does, though.{E108:0010}
Right, compadre?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|9:
Yes, sir!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}{E280}The workshops aren't locked with physical
keys.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|10: Their doors are fitted with {E041}sensors{E040} instead.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|12: Inmates are issued with special {E041}bracelets{E040}, sir!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|13:
When they walk through a workshop door,{E108:0008} the {E041}sensor{E040}
checks their {E041}bracelet{E040}...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|14:
...and if they're not supposed to be there,{E108:0010}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}{E1D2}{E178:00010000}DINGALINGALING!{E108:0018} {E179:00020000}{E150:002D0005}An alarm sounds.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|15:
If they let it ring for too long,{E108:0008} then --{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D2}{E1D5}BZZZZ! --{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}they get a real shock,{E108:0008} if you know what I mean!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|16:
And if they try to break or remove the bracelet --{E108:0010}{E150:002D001D}
{E107:0001}{E188:00360000}{E1D1}{E1D5}BZZZZZZZZT! --{E108:0018} {E107:0002}a shock three times worse than that!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|18:
(I guess they need to ensure that the inmates follow
the rules,{E108:0008} but that sounds a bit excessive...)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|19:
If they wish to pass through a door like this one,{E108:0008}
prisoners need to be accompanied by a guard.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|20: We disable the sensor for them and let them in.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|22: Have any prisoners used this workshop today?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|23:
No, sir.{E108:0010} No one's been in here for days.{E108:0010}
I'd know if they had.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|24:
(So no prisoners have entered,{E108:0008} let alone used, this
workshop today...)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|25:
Door Sensors data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0003}(Which means...)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|26: (...that there's {E041}a contradiction{E042} in this crime scene!)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|27: (Namely,{E108:0008} there's something here that shouldn't be.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100062B|28:
(I'll take another quick look over the crime scene,{E108:0008} {E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}and
employ my powers of {E041}deduction{E042} to solve this mystery.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000649|0: This room's a workshop for the prisoners.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000649|1:
Yes,{E108:0008} and the door has been fitted with a sensor to stop
them from coming and going without permission.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000649|2:
You got it.{E108:0010} Like,{E108:0008} if they try to make a break for it while
they're in here working,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it's "ding-a-ling,{E108:0008} you're done!"
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000649|3: But no one's heard so much as a "ding" today,{E108:0008} {E107:0003}so...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000649|4: (...So no prisoners have been in here.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000649|5:
(But if that were the case,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}this crime scene contains
{E041}a glaring contradiction{E042}!)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000649|7:
(I should look over everything one more time,{E108:0008} {E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}and
employ my powers of {E041}deduction{E042} to point it out.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000651|0:
Huh?{E108:0010} For me?{E108:0018}
You shouldn't have!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000651|1: Always wanted to rock one of these 'pon my lapel.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000651|3: I never said I was giving it to you.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000651|4:
Heh heh!{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}I'm just yanking your chain!{E108:0010}
{E12F:000A0009}I've already got {E1CB:006500000000}a badge of my own.{E108:0010} See?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000651|6:
Once in a blue moon.{E108:0010} Goes nicely with my winter coat,
as it happens.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100065A|0: Heard the Broncster was a bit of a chess fiend.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100065A|1:
Indeed.{E108:0010} Perhaps we might have enjoyed a game,{E108:0008} had
we met under different circumstances.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100065A|2:
Sounds like a riot.{E108:0010} Not my cup of tea, though, really.{E108:0010}
Too much thinking fries my noggin.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100065A|4: As I recall,{E108:0008} I've yet to beat you even once.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100065A|5: Yeah, well...{E108:0010} {E285}that was a long time ago.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100065A|6:
Now that you're a bigshot prosecutor,{E108:0008} I bet I wouldn't
stand a chance.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100065A|7:
...If you say so, Fender.{E108:0010} I suppose we can leave it at a
stalemate...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}for now.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100065A|8: (He never was one to show his hand...)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000663|1:
So this is it, huh?{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}The key to unraveling this whole
mystery?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000663|3:
Great.{E108:0010} You, uh...{E108:0008} You keep hold of it, then,{E108:0008} yeah?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Quickly now,{E108:0010} {E1D1}back in your pocket it goes.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000663|4: (...I guess he doesn't think much of it.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|0:
Arrested for murder on the afternoon of the 25th,{E108:0008} and
killed on the morning of the 27th...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|1:
Talk about instant karma!{E108:0010} Never would've thought our
perp would turn into a victim himself, though!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|2: Yes...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I don't like this at all.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|3: You don't think it was that ice cream guy,{E108:0008} do you, sir?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|4:
Knight had seen his face, right?{E108:0010} Maybe he couldn't
afford to let him live.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|6:
No.{E108:0010} If this were his doing,{E108:0008} he would surely have left a
calling card.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|7:
And besides...{E108:0008} Knight isn't the only one who knows
what he looks like.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E284}We do, too.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|8: Oh yeah...{E108:0010} And I guess we're still alive,{E108:0008} so...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000669|10: (I just don't understand how it was even possible.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000674|0:
Guess it makes sense having the detention center and
the prison in the same building.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000674|1: Means they can share the visitor's room.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000674|2:
Indeed.{E108:0010} It's an unusual design, but it's certainly
convenient for anyone visiting.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000674|3:
Yeah.{E108:0010} But then,{E108:0008} why have two different areas in the
first place?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000674|4:
For the two different classes of detainees, of course.{E108:0010}
Those pre-trial and those post-trial.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000674|5:
The two facilities may be housed in the same building
in this case,{E108:0008} but they are actually quite different.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000674|6:
Well,{E108:0008} all I know is that they're both cramped and
dark...{E108:0010} {E1D1}and don't let you leave when you want.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000674|7:
Perhaps spending a night in each would help clarify
the differences between them...?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100067D|0:
That thing's pretty small.{E108:0010}
You don't lose it all the time?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100067D|1:
The sacred symbol of my office?{E108:0010}
No, Detective.{E108:0008} I do not.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100067D|2:
Guess it's a good thing I'm no prosecutor, huh?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E12F:00010007}{E280}I'd have lost a hundred this week alone!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|0100067D|3:
I mean,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}I lose my badge at least that often.{E108:0010}
Heh...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000682|0:
Stabbed in the neck...{E108:0010}
Doesn't get much worse than that.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000682|1:
How's a guy supposed to slurp down his instant
noodles like that!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000682|2:
Very funny, Detective.{E108:0010}
Though I'd think carefully before saying any more.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000682|3:
Otherwise,{E108:0008} you might find that you, too,{E108:0008} are unable to
"slurp down" any more of your beloved noodles.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000682|5:
Your salary is performance-based.{E108:0010}
So you had better start performing...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000682|6: Uurgh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Talk about a hard pill to swallow...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|0: Waaaaaait a minute!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E280}It all makes sense now!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|1: I just figured out why people say "checkmate"!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|4: (...More logical than I'd expected, to be honest.)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|5:
I think you'll find, Detective,{E108:0008} that "checkmate" is an
expression meaning "the king is dead".
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|6: It has nothing to do with the pattern on the board.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|7:
O-Oh...{E108:0010} Dang.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Thought I'd made a real breakthrough
there...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|8:
Perhaps the breakthrough you ought to be striving to
make...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|9:
...is learning how to tell when you're the one doing the
checkmating{E108:0008} or the one being checkmated.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000689|10:
Yeah...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Guess I've still got a ways to go in the game of life...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000694|0:
Heh heh heh!{E108:0020}
Good one, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} ...I think?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000694|1:
You weren't showing me that for a reason, were you?{E108:0010}
Wouldn't know the first thing about it.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000694|2: (And yet,{E108:0008} that doesn't seem to bother you at all...)
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000697|0: Anything out of the ordinary to report, Officer?
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000697|1:
Yes, sir!{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}There is this one thing...
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000697|3: There's a body in the workshop, sir.
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000697|4: He's right!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}{E188:00340000}That's definitely out of the ordinary!
sce1_c0_m07_npc.bytes|01000697|5:
...If anything else occurs to you,{E108:0008} you know where to
find me.
sce1_c0_partner.bytes|010019A1|0:
So this is what the inside of a prison looks like!{E108:0018}
Good to know,{E108:0008} good to know...
sce1_c0_partner.bytes|010019A1|1: Someone's highly motivated to learn today.
sce1_c0_partner.bytes|010019A1|2:
You're just not on top of your game, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}This stuff is important!
sce1_c0_partner.bytes|010019A1|3: Gotta be prepared for when the time comes!
sce1_c0_partner.bytes|010019A1|4: ...Which will never come for me,{E108:0008} I must say.
sce1_c0_partner.bytes|010019A1|5:
Still,{E108:0008} I won't discourage you from finding out more.{E108:0010}
I need to gather a little more information myself.
sce1_c0_partner.bytes|010019A1|6: (And then use my powers of logic to piece it together!)
sce1_c0_partner.bytes|010019A8|0:
Guess it makes sense that the security's pretty tight
in a prison.

If nothing else...
sce1_c1_01.bytes|010007EC|34:
...it might help you to feel a little less alone.{E108:0020}
Now,{E108:0008} if you'll excuse me.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|1: So,{E108:0008} we talked a good game in there...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|2:
...but we can't even get back inside the main prison
to see the scene of the crime.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|3:
Maybe defending the guy in court is our best bet
after all...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|4:
Gummy!{E108:0018}
Can't defend for his life,{E108:0010} remember?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|5: Well,{E108:0008} who do we have here?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|6:
If it isn't Edgeworth and the gang!{E108:0018}
{E12F:000A0001}What are you cats doing here?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|7:
Listen, pal!{E108:0010} {E1D1}If you've come to harass Mr. Edgeworth
again,{E108:0008} I'll--
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|8:
Hey, hey!{E108:0010} Easy there, Detective Flatfoot Sholmes.{E108:0010}
I'm here to work.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|10:
Whoa!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The Kaymeister nails it in one!{E108:0018}
{E12F:000A0009}Aren't you just the über-intelligentes one of the bunch!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|11:
("Über-intelligentes"...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That's not how you use either of those words, Fender.)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|12:
Some may say I'm an "easy-going old rogue" about
town,{E108:0008} but I'm actually not a half-bad attorney.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|13:
Which is why I've been summoned to the old
jaileroonie for a meeting with a new client.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|16:
Wow!{E108:0010} That's freaky!{E108:0018} {E12F:000A0007}You know more about my job
than I do!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|17:
Wait,{E108:0008} Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} {E282}Mr. Fender's a defense attorney!{E108:0018}
Are you thinking what I'm thinking?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|18: (I fear I might be.{E108:0010} In fact,{E108:0008} it could be our {E041}only option{E042}.)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|19:
(Not so long ago,{E108:0008} I found myself embroiled in another
case that wasn't mine.)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|20:
(I managed to worm my way onto the crime scene by
agreeing to be a certain someone's {E041}subordinate{E042}.)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|21:
(Not an experience I ever wanted to repeat,{E108:0008} but I fear
I may have little choice...)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|23:
Before you say another word,{E108:0008} I just gotta point out the
fine print:{E108:0010} Eddie Fender doesn't take on associates.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|25:
"Say it ain't so!" I hear you protesting,{E108:0008} but pompous
prosecutors are a no-go.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|26: Especially those...{E108:0010} {E178:00010000}{E284}of the von Karma variety.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|27: (I should've known he wouldn't forgive me that easily.)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|28:
I...{E108:0001}{E179:00030000}{E108:000F} understand why you wouldn't want to work with
someone like me.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|29:
What's more,{E108:0008} I understand how you feel about all
things von Karma.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|30: But please,{E108:0008} believe me when I say...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|31:
...I'm not the man I was back then.{E108:0010} I'm no longer under
my old mentor's spell.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|32:
You better believe it, pal!{E108:0018}
Mr. Edgeworth's a changed man!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|33: Sure, he used to be the Demon Prosecutor...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|34: But he's not like that anymore!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|36:
Gummy's right!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Mr. Edgeworth's one of the good guys now!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|38: He got me off the hook just last month!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|39: You don't say!{E108:0010} Well, that escalated quickly!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|40:
But he was!{E108:0010} There's no other word for it!{E108:0010}
He was heroic!{E108:0010} Great-Thiefly, even!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|42:
Please, Fender.{E108:0010} Don't you think there's something odd
about the way the {E041}Committee{E040} stepped in yesterday?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|43:
There's more to this case than meets the eye.{E108:0010}
I'm certain of it.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|01000880|44:
I can't just walk away from this!{E108:0018}
{E188:00200000}{E1D5}{E1D2}I can't!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|0: Please,{E108:0008} allow me to help you with this investigation.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|2: ...Sheesh.{E112:000A} {E12F:000A0009}{E107:0002}A bow from the great Miles Edgeworth.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|3: Never thought I'd see the day,{E108:0008} but here we are.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|4:
So enlighten me, if you will.{E108:0010} {E285}{E12F:000A0001}What made the leopard
change his spots?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|6: I suppose I would have to say...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}the courtroom itself.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|7:
I have experienced so many things,{E108:0008} and met so
many people there within its four walls.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|8:
...Including some old friends who showed me a better
way to be.{E108:0010} How could that not change a person?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|10:
Heh heh heh...{E108:0010}
Well, I'll be!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|11:
The old you would never have bared his soul like that.{E108:0010}
That was beautiful.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|12:
You might've even surprised {E041}you-know-who{E040},{E108:0010} {E1D1}and you
know how much that takes.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|13:
...Tell you what,{E108:0008} here's what we're going to do.{E108:0010}
We're going to start again with a clean slate.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|15:
"{E041}Edgeworth and Co. Law Offices{E108:0010}
Eddie Fender, Senior Partner{E040}"...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|17: That's right.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Mr. Fender here began his legal career...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|18: ...as an assistant to my late father, Gregory Edgeworth.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|19: Whaaat!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}Your dad was a defense attorney!?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|20:
S-So...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}the {E041}"you-know-who"{E040} Mr. Fender keeps talking
about is...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|21:
The clever Kaymeister nails it in one yet again!{E108:0018}
That's right,{E108:0008} I was talking about his old man.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|22:
Guess you all noticed I kept his name over the door, so
to speak?{E108:0010} Least I could do for old Gregory, really.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|24:
I'm going to level with you here:{E108:0010} {E284}I don't trust you.{E108:0010}
Not fully, anyway.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|25:
I can't just forget about all those years you spent
licking von Karma's boots, you know?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|26:
Anyone can say they've changed.{E108:0010}
I'm going to need you to prove it.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|27:
And besides,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}you know it's what Gregory would've
wanted.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|29:
Okay.{E108:0010} Then that's enough hardball for one day.{E108:0010}
Let's move on to the fun stuff.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|30:
I hereby appoint you{E108:0008} {E285}"interim associate" of Edgeworth
and Co.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Congrats, man!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|31: I will try not to let you down.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|32: Well,{E108:0008} doesn't this bring a tear to the eye?
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|33:
The prodigal son,{E108:0008} coming on board at his late father's
firm.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|34: Permission to come on board, too!{E108:0018} Please, Mr. Fender!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|35:
You don't even have to ask, kiddo!{E108:0018}{E112:000A}
{E12F:000A0001}Welcome to the crew!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|37:
Alright.{E108:0010} I guess it's time to go to work.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}So...{E108:0010} where to begin...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|39:
(Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Where were we when we were so rudely
interrupted...?)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|40:
Well...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}I guess it's safe to say that probably wasn't the
victim.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|41:
Indeed.{E108:0010} It sounds more likely to have been the {E041}person
who found his body{E040}.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|42:
I believe we need to speak with the person who found
the body.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|43:
Just what I was thinking, eager associate!{E108:0018}
We do indeed!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|44:
(Heh.{E108:0010} Still the type to smile and nod, I see.{E108:0010} That will
certainly make my life easier...{E108:0008} "boss".)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|45: Now that that's decided,{E108:0008} let's get going!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|47:
I'm a detective.{E108:0010} I can't just hop on board as an
attorney's assistant like you guys...
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|48:
(He has a point.{E108:0010} I can't leave him adrift all on his own,
now can I...?)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|49:
Detective Gumshoe.{E108:0010} I have a special assignment for
you.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|50:
You are to continue investigating the case under
Mr. Winner.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|51:
And if you happen to discover anything that seems
useful,{E108:0010} {E285}you are to notify me immediately.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|52:
You're in a uniquely powerful position, Detective,{E108:0008} and
I'm going to need all the info you can pass our way.
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|53: Y-{E108:0008}You can count on me, sir!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|54:
I'm a real pro when it comes to letting things slip to
the defense!
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|55:
(Trust me,{E108:0008} I know.{E108:0010} But just this once,{E108:0008} those loose lips
of yours might be what saves our ship.)
sce1_c1_02.bytes|010008AD|56:
Throw wide the prison gates, good sirs,{E108:0010} {E280}because here
we come!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|1:
So,{E108:0010} any idea how we track down whoever found the
Broncster's body, Miles?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|2: I think our best bet would be to simply ask around.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|7:
Just faaabulously chic, darling!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Fabulously!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Facial hair is so very au courant, don't you think?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|8:
Enchanté, mademoiselle.{E108:0010} And much obliged.{E112:000A}{E12F:000A0000}
Defense attorney Eddie Fender,{E108:0010} at your service.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|9:
Let's get things off on the right foot, shall we?{E108:0010}
A little...{E108:0008} embrasser, perhaps?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|10:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo!{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}{E107:0002}I like the sound of that!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|13:
Well,{E108:0010} how else does one greet a new friend,{E108:0008} hm?{E108:0018}
A little smooch is entirely de rigueur,{E108:0010} don't you think?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|15:
Indeed.{E108:0010} An act so shameless,{E108:0008} it puts even Great
Thieves to shame.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|16:
Physical contact is so very important as a form of
expression for our little family.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|17: Everyone in this lovely {E041}home{E040} will tell you as much.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|18:
H-Hey,{E108:0010} if everyone else is hip to that,{E108:0010} I can be hip to
that, too...{E108:0010} Sure...
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|19:
Fifi Laguarde, by the way.{E108:0010}
Warden of this charming abode.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|20: You may call me Fifi, of course.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|21:
(So she's the warden of the entire detention center and
prison facility, is she...)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|22:
A pleasure to meet you, Ms. Laguarde.{E108:0010}
Miles Edgeworth.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|23:
I am a prosec--{E108:0008} erm...{E108:0008} an associate with Mr. Fender's
practice.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|24:
I hope you don't mind me asking, but...{E108:0010} {E285}were you here
in the prison yesterday?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|25:
Oh, don't be silly, darling!{E108:0008} Of course I was!{E108:0010}
Yesterday was a very important day, after all!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|26:
Important in what way, exactly?{E108:0010}
A big meeting of some kind, perhaps?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|27:
A meeting!?{E108:0010} Oh, heavens, no!{E108:0010}
I couldn't think of anything worse!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|29:
It was a simply spectacular event featuring some
terrifically talented animals!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|30:
Anyone who was anyone HAD to be there.{E108:0010} If you were
here at {E041}home{E040},{E108:0008} you were watching the show with me.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|31:
The performers set up a special stage in the yard just
for us!{E108:0010} We are one very lucky family,{E108:0008} n'est-ce pas?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|32:
(So she was at this circus performance for the inmates
yesterday morning...)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|33: (Mr. Carcerato mentioned a "show" yesterday as well.)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|34: (He must have been talking about the same thing.)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|35: What time did this show take place?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|36:
From around 8 until...{E108:0008} 10, maybe?{E108:0010}
Yes,{E108:0008} something like that.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|37:
(Meaning it finished right around when the body was
discovered...)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|38:
(And by dint of having attended the show,{E108:0008} she has a
reasonably solid {E041}alibi{E042}.)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|39:
Oh, would you look at the time!{E108:0010}
Sorry darlings,{E108:0008} but I really must dash.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|40:
Feel free to explore our {E041}home{E040}!{E108:0010}
Mi casa, su casa, and all that!{E108:0008} Ciao for now!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|42:
The person who found the body screamed.{E108:0010} And that
scream was heard by one inmate that we know of.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A00|43:
Therefore,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}our first task is to question this inmate,{E108:0008} and
see where his information will take us next.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|1: Nice try, kiddo,{E108:0008} but this isn't a bathroom stall.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|2:
Yo!{E108:0010} You there!{E108:0010}
Could you help us out here, my good man?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|3:
Yes, sir!{E108:0018}
What can I do for you?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|4: Is somebody using this workshop right now?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|5: Yes, sir!{E108:0010} {E1D1}One of the prisoners is in there.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|6: Just confirmed it myself during the noontime roll-call.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|7: We'd like to speak to this prisoner, if that's alright.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|8:
Sure,{E108:0008} I'll go fetch him right now.{E108:0010}
Won't take a sec.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|9: This one's all yours, Milesey boy.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|11:
Let's just say I'd rather not roll the dice on someone
I don't know, yeah?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|12:
Huh.{E108:0010} And I thought adults were all supposed to be
strong and brave.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|13:
Heh.{E108:0010} Well,{E108:0008} you're not looking so brave yourself right
now.{E108:0010} So let's call it even.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|16: I hear you wish to speak with me?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|17:
(Not exactly the hardened criminal we were expecting,
is he...)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|18:
My name is Miles Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
I'm a public prosecutor.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|21: (What happened to being too scared to handle this!?)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|22:
Listen,{E108:0008} sorry about my pal here.{E108:0010}
He gets the weirdest ideas,{E108:0008} {E1D1}heh heh.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|23:
"Prosecutor", indeed!{E108:0010} That'll be the day.{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}He's actually just an associate.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|24: Jeez, Miles!{E108:0010} Get a grip, will ya!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|25:
(Arngh,{E108:0010} he's right.{E108:0010} I mustn't forget that I'm a defense
attorney's assistant for the time being.)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|26:
Ah,{E108:0008} that explains it.{E108:0010} I did think you looked a little
different from the prosecutor I spoke with yesterday.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|28: Would you mind answering a few questions?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|29:
...N-{E108:0010}No,{E108:0010} of course not.{E108:0010}
I'd be delighted.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|31: The witness is all yours, my young associate!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|32: (Sure,{E108:0008} have the intern do everything.{E108:0010} Why not.)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|33:
Mr. Sahwit,{E108:0010} you are no doubt aware that a murder
took place yesterday.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|34:
Would you mind telling us where you were at the
time the body was found?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|35:
I...{E108:0008} Yes,{E108:0010} I was in that workshop there.{E108:0010}
Working,{E108:0008} as one might expect.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|36: What kind of work were you doing?
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|37:
Well, I'm actually retraining at the moment.{E108:0010}
I'm hoping to become a stylist, you see.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|38:
A pet stylist, that is.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Yes,{E108:0010} so I've been studying hard,{E108:0008}
and practicing every moment I can.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|39:
(An unusual field of study befitting an unusual prison,
I suppose.)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|40: A-And th-that's it.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I certainly didn't see anything!
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|41:
(Interesting.{E108:0010} I've barely asked him anything at all,{E108:0008} and
he's already sweating bullets.)
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|42:
So, uh...{E108:0008} Yes,{E108:0010} I,{E108:0008} I'm afraid I won't be able to help you.{E108:0010}
Sorry.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|43:
No,{E108:0008} I'm the one who's sorry, Mr. Sahwit.{E108:0010}
For this interview has only just begun.
sce1_c1_03.bytes|01000A2E|48:
(He's definitely hiding something.{E108:0010} I'll need to push him
a little harder if I'm to get any answers.)
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A80|0:
The first step is to analyze the situation.{E108:0010}
Let's take a look at our opponent.
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A80|1:
I didn't see anything.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I really can't help you, I'm afraid.
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A80|2:
(Something tells me he'd be a good poker player.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}It's hard to tell much at all from his face.)
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A80|3:
(And I don't think he'll be giving me much in the way
of physical cues either...)
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A80|4:
I'll have to rely solely on his words instead.{E108:0010} That's the
only way I'll know what's going on underneath.
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A80|5:
Alright.{E108:0010} Time to make my first move.{E108:0010}
{E284}Let's see {E043}who we're dealing with{E040} here.
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A80|6:
He may be good at hiding his emotions,{E108:0010} {E283}{E173:0000}but everyone
has a tell!
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A87|0: Tell me...{E108:0008} what's your connection to this incident?
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A87|2: Oh,{E108:0008} well,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it has nothing at all to do with me.{E108:0010} Nothing.
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A87|4:
I,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I wouldn't dream of getting involved in anything as
{E1D1}ghastly as that!
sce1_c1_04.bytes|01000A87|6:
