disadvantaged location, Mr. Sahwit.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|13:
Who the heck do you think you are, huh?{E108:0010}
Mr. Bigshot, acting like you know it all!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|14: ...I mean,{E108:0010} I saw what I saw.{E108:0008} I swear!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|15:
Oh, I know!{E108:0018} The man's arm...!{E108:0010}
It must've moved under that tarp after I peeked in...!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|16:
Nonsense.{E108:0010} You already told us that can't have been the
case.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|17: ...He wasn't moving at all.{E108:0010} He was just lying there.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|19:
You said it yourself that the victim was already dead.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}And dead men don't move, do they?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|21:
Hoooo-wee!{E108:0010} Is that the stench of Eau de Desperation
I smell?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|22:
What are you hiding, Mr. Sahwit!?{E108:0018}
{E282}Tell us!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|24:
You're...{E108:0010} {E280}You're wrong...{E108:0018}
I know what I saw...
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|28:
(...It seems the real Mr. Sahwit has finally revealed
himself.)
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|29: Whoa.{E108:0010} That's quite the rug he was rocking.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|30: Came straight at you like some kind of flying black cat!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|31: Look,{E108:0008} I'm just a sweet, innocent witness here!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|33:
Because I must say,{E108:0008} I have doubts.{E108:0018}
Very serious doubts...
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|35:
You saw something that should have been impossible
to see from outside the workshop.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CB8|36:
So,{E108:0010} how did you do it?{E108:0018}
{E284}That's simple.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CDE|0:
Mr. Sahwit.{E108:0010} This is where you were standing when you
saw the body!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CDF|0: This is where you were when you saw the body.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CDF|1:
But how could he have seen it from there,
Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CDF|2:
Wait!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Are you saying that Mr. Sahwit has special {E285}ESP
powers!?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CDF|4: (I need to think about this more carefully.)
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CDF|5:
(If he saw something that couldn't have been seen
from outside the room...)
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CDF|6: (...then there's only one place he could have been!)
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CE6|0: You were in the same room as the body!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CE6|1:
That's the only way you could have seen the relief on
the ring!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CE6|4:
Say what you want, but you don't have a shred of
evidence, do you?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CE6|5:
Nothing to prove I was in the room with the body,
anyway!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CE6|6:
You can't prove it, can you!?{E108:0010} Because I was in the next
room over!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CE6|7:
Minding my own business and looking after the
animals!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CE6|8:
Why else would I have signed out a pair of rubber
gloves!?{E108:0010} For fun!?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CEF|0:
Now put up or shut up!{E108:0010} I want to see evidence that
proves I was in that room with the body!{E040}{E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:00250027}{E100:0000}{E101:00160019}{E107:0002}What is this supposed to prove!?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CEF|1: Heh...{E108:0010} Do I have to explain everything to you?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CEF|4:
Gnrk!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(I guess I can't bluff my way through this one...)
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|0:
Remind me, Mr. Sahwit.{E108:0010} What were you doing when
you discovered the body?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|1:
How many times do I--!?{E108:0018}
I was practicing my pet styling techniques!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|2:
Of course.{E108:0010} Then perhaps {E1CB:002500020000}{E12F:00000008}{E1D1}this rubber glove might mean
something to you?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|4:
This glove was found by the victim's body.{E108:0010}
I believe it was dropped by the killer.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|5:
And I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E12F:0000000B}{E284}can't help but notice that you have a similar
glove tucked into your apron...
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|7: Yes, that "one" does seem awfully lonely, doesn't it?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|8:
I-It's just a rubber glove!{E108:0010} There are hundreds of them,
all over the prison!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|10:
Not yet, perhaps.{E108:0010} But if I were to ask the police to
check this glove for prints...
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|11:
...I have a feeling the results would be rather
fascinating.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|14:
Heh, heh.{E108:0010} {E1D1}That was a pretty rad "Objection!", am
I right?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|15: Please, Fender.{E108:0010} Now is not the time for tomfoolery.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|16: But I have a legit objection...{E108:0010} {E285}because this isn't over.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|17: There's something that still doesn't make sense.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|18:
Our man here's a prisoner, right?{E108:0010} And he's got one of
those {E041}bracelet{E040} doohickeys on.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|20:
That's true!{E108:0018} So how could he have left his workshop in
the first place?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|21: His bracelet would've {E1D1}triggered the alarm if he'd tried!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|22: (Right.{E108:0010} We don't have a good explanation for that yet.)
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|23:
Well?{E108:0010} Anything you'd like to share, good buddy?{E108:0010}
We're all friends here.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|25:
That's weird.{E108:0010} {E284}He should be clinging onto that {E041}bracelet{E040}
like the big, round lifesaver it is.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|27:
As in,{E108:0008} it's the best hope our wig-flinging friend here
has for getting off the hook for murder.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|28:
"Sorry,{E108:0008} can't get into the crime scene with a {E041}bracelet{E040}
on!"{E108:0010} If it was me,{E108:0008} I'd be arguing that for my life.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|29: And yet,{E108:0008} {E284}he hasn't said a peep about it.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|30: I wonder why that might be, hm?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|32:
The sound of silence.{E108:0010} I suppose Ms. Law Priestess did
preach that silence is golden yesterday, too.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|33:
Wh-Whoa...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}You sounded like an actual attorney for a
second there, Mr. Fender!
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|34:
"The worst of times are when lawyers calmly show our
biggest smiles."
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|35:
Gregory taught me that.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}It was part of the {E041}attorney's
code{E040} he lived by.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|36:
...So, friend, {E108:0008}{E107:0002}what's the dealio?{E108:0018}
Why so coy about your {E041}bracelet{E040}?
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|38: ...Well, to tell you the truth...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}it's broken.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|40:
I fell over a little while back, you see, and hit it on the
floor.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|41:
After that,{E108:0008} it didn't seem to set the sensors off
anymore.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|42:
I should have told the guards about it, I know, but...{E108:0010}
Well,{E108:0008} it was awfully convenient...
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|43: I see.{E108:0010} So your {E041}bracelet{E040} is broken.
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|44: (But do they really break that easily?)
sce1_c1_06.bytes|01000CF5|45: (If so,{E108:0008} then this prison has a serious security problem.)
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|0: You there!{E108:0010} Could we have a moment?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|1: Aww,{E108:0008} aren't mew just the cutest?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|3: M-{E108:0008}{E107:0001}Meow!{E108:0018} {E1D1}How can I help you, sir!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|4: This prisoner's {E041}bracelet{E040} appears to be broken.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|6: I'll get someone to find a replacement right away!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|7:
Thank you.{E108:0010}
We'll keep hold of the broken one for the time being.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|8:
Mr. Sahwit's Bracelet data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E040}{E108:0010}{E106}{E1CF}{E100:0001}{E1C0:0001}{E100:0000}{E150:002D0003}{E101:FFFF002A}{E107:0001}{E1D1}Of course, sir!{E108:0018} I trust you'll take good care of it!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|9:
Sweet.{E108:0010} Bracelet sorted.{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}Now,{E108:0008} to turn our murderer in, yeah?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|11:
Whoa there, pally-o!{E108:0010} You were the one who said {E188:00300000}your
{E041}bracelet{E040} was out of commission.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|12:
Or were there other inmates freely roaming the halls
while everybody was busy watching the show?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|13: No!{E108:0010} I,{E108:0008} {E280}I just found the body!{E108:0010} That's all,{E108:0008} I promise!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|14:
And when I did,{E108:0008} that enormous dog still had his mouth
wrapped around the poor man's neck!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|15: I only went into the workshop after the beast had left.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|16: And why did you go in?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|17:
Well...{E108:0010} I, uh...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Oh, fine!{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}I wanted to go through his pockets,{E108:0008} okay?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|18: (He was going to rob the corpse?)
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|19:
(That explains why he remembers Knight's ring in so
much detail.)
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|20: Hey!{E108:0010} {E280}Why are you looking at me like that?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|21:
I'm a Great Thief!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'd never stoop so low as to steal
from a--
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|23:
The show ended just after I'd entered the room,{E108:0008} and all
the other inmates came trickling downstairs thereafter.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|24:
I panicked,{E108:0008} rushed back to the other workshop,{E108:0008} and
started my fake screaming.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|25: And dropped the glove in your haste, huh?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|27:
Other than whether Mr. Sahwit is the one who did it?{E108:0018}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}I'd say one very significant question still remains:
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|28:
The question of how Knight made it into the prison
proper from his holding cell in the detention center.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|30:
I also can't help but wonder about another key feature
of Mr. Sahwit's testimony.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|31: (That dog's involvement can only mean one thing...)
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|34:
Were you the only prisoner who didn't go to watch the
show?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|36:
Am I right in thinking{E108:0008} {E284}that this person couldn't have
watched the show,{E108:0008} even if he'd wanted to?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|38:
(I knew it.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I had my suspicions when we first ran into
that black dog yesterday,{E108:0008} but this confirms it.)
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|39:
(For a criminal that dangerous to end up in a place like
this is unbelievable, but...)
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|42: Umm...{E108:0010} Who are we talking about here?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|43:
"Him"!{E108:0018} He's not like the other prisoners you know.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}He's special.{E108:0010} Gets treated like {E1D1}royalty...
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|44: .........{E107:0001}B-But you didn't hear that from me!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|45:
All I'll say is...{E108:0010} If you value your life,{E108:0008} {E107:0003}{E188:00300000}you'll stay well
away from him!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|46:
Whaaat!?{E108:0018} Will you please STOP trying to scare us all
the time!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|47:
Hmm...{E108:0010} The big cheese, huh?{E108:0018} Well, I for one definitely
value my life,{E108:0008} so that sucks.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|50:
({E041}Maximum security{E042}...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Well,{E108:0008} that's certainly one way of
treating someone differently...)
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|52:
......Let's just say he's highly skilled when it comes to
people's lives.{E108:0010} Better than anyone, in fact.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|53:
And, uh...{E108:0010} that's all I'm prepared to say on the subject!{E108:0010}
In fact,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I may have already said too much...!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|55:
Well, Milesey,{E108:0008} anything you care to share?{E108:0010} Or are you
going to leave Kay and I in the dark here, too?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|56:
The mystery man in {E041}maximum security{E040}...{E108:0010} {E284}is an old
acquaintance.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DA0|57:
Let's go pay him a visit.{E108:0010}
I suspect we'll find our dark canine friend there, too.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|1:
Wow,{E108:0008} it's pitch black in there!{E108:0010}
{E282}I can't see a thing!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|2:
But didn't you say that the Yatagarasu takes flight,{E108:0008}
even in the dead of night or something?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|3:
"Even in the depths of night,{E108:0010}
when no other bird dares to take flight..."
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|4:
"...one alone soars to shine{E108:0008}
the light of righteousness on the world's blight!"
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|5:
"And that one is me!{E108:0010}
For I am the Great Thief, {E041}Yatagarasu{E040}!"
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|6: Whoooa!{E108:0010} You are one powerful performer!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|7:
Thanks,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but that doesn't help me see in the dark!{E108:0010}
I'm a human,{E108:0008} not a three-legged raven!
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|12: It has been far too long.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|14:
Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}I could hardly forget now, could I?{E108:0018}
After all...
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|15: ...you are the one who put me away.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|16:
Um...{E108:0010} Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0018}
{E284}{E107:0003}Are you talking to that dog?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|17:
Or is there someone else in there?{E108:0018}
Still can't see a danged thing...
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|18:
Oh, but I am forgetting myself.{E108:0010}
Forgive me,{E108:0008} I do not often receive visitors.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|19: One moment.{E108:0010} I will turn on the lights.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|20:
Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}You are a heavy-footed lot.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Am I right in thinking there are...{E108:0008} three of you in all?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|21:
Very well...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Perhaps we should start by introducing
ourselves.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|23:
As you may have gathered,{E108:0008} Mr. Edgeworth and I are...{E108:0010}
old acquaintances.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Kheh heh heh.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|25: (Some knew him as...{E108:0010} the Blind Butcher.)
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|26:
His only weapons were a vicious hunting hound and a
fearsomely sharp knife...
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|27:
His appearance was always announced by the sound of
bells.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|28: ...The last sound his victims would ever hear.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|29:
Well, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0010} {E284}Am I to guess why you have
come to see me?
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|30:
You know why I'm here.{E108:0010} In fact,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}I'm willing to bet you
know every detail of this sordid little affair already.
sce1_c1_07.bytes|01000DDD|31:
Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Then I suppose we have nothing to
hide from one another.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|0:
Your faithful canine friend is currently the chief
suspect in a murder investigation.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|1:
The person who found the body saw a dog with its
mouth around the victim's throat.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|2:
Your witness is mistaken.{E108:0018}
Helmut is a gentle soul.{E108:0010} He is my eyes,{E108:0008} nothing more.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|3:
It is absurd to think that he would do such a thing.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Isn't it, boy?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|4: Yes.{E108:0008} Yes it is.{E108:0010} {E1D1}You're a good boy, aren't you?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|5:
(Helmut is more than a mere seeing eye dog.{E108:0010} And he's
certainly no "good boy".{E108:0010} He's also a trained killer.)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|6: (A weapon once used in this man's sordid trade.)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|7: This witness of yours.{E108:0010} He is...{E108:0010} trustworthy, I assume?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|8:
(Arngh.{E108:0010} Sahwit is anything but trustworthy.{E108:0010}
And he's still very much a suspect himself.)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|9:
(I can hardly claim that his testimony is beyond
reproach...)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|10:
...A "no", then?{E108:0010} I thought as much.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Yes I did, Helmut.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Yeees...
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E20|11: (It figures that he {E1D1}already knew who our witness is.)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|0:
What were you doing between 8 and 10 AM yesterday
morning, Mr. Kanis?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|1: During the show, you mean?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Kheh heh heh.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|2: I was here.{E108:0010} Ensconced in these humble surroundings.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|3:
I have developed a passion for wood carving, you see.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E188:00300000}An obsession, even.{E108:0010} I was engrossed in it all morning.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|4:
And you have permission to engage in such a hobby?{E108:0010}
I can't believe someone would actually let you.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|5: The warden and I have...{E108:0010} an understanding.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|6:
(An "understanding"?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E280}That's ridiculous!{E108:0018} This man
shouldn't be allowed one,{E108:0010} let alone {E041}five chisels{E042}!)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|7: (They're nothing but lethal weapons in his hands!)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|8:
I was carving Buddhist pieces at first,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}but by the
674th,{E108:0008} my interest had begun to wane.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|10:
Time is all I have, child.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}In any case,{E108:0008} my focus has now
shifted to pieces...{E108:0008} such as these.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|11: I didn't know you played chess.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|12:
You play too, do you not, Prosecutor?{E108:0018}
Perhaps one day you might indulge me?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|13:
Though you may find my game rather rudimentary.{E108:0010}
I only began after my arrival here, I am afraid.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|15:
Ah, yes.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}The {E041}dogs of war{E040}.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You must forgive my little joke.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|16:
Chess is, after all,{E108:0008} a game of war.{E108:0010}
Soldiers,{E108:0008} knights,{E108:0008} castles...
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|17:
All doing their utmost to protect the king.{E108:0010}
All loyal to the last.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|18:
I have always thought it strange that such a game has
no place for a {E041}dog{E040}.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|19:
After all,{E108:0008} what more loyal weapon could an army call
upon?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|20:
Still,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}it's simply a piece I made for fun.{E108:0010} Fear not,{E108:0008} I play
by the regular rules.{E108:0008} And with the regular pieces.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|21:
I can't imagine it's easy finding opponents to play here
in prison, though.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|23:
Correspondence chess{E040}, then?{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Sharing moves by post?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|24:
Yes.{E108:0010} Even prisoners are allowed to send and receive
letters.{E108:0010} Their contents are inspected, of course.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|25:
Although,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I have yet to receive the details of my
current opponent's next move.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E2C|26:
Dog Chess Piece data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E47|0:
(Sounds like this "current opponent" isn't a resident
here.)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|0:
I suppose you know the identity of the deceased,
Mr. Kanis?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|1:
His name was Bronco Knight, was it not?{E108:0010}
Poor, unfortunate soul.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|2: You keep your ear to the ground.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|3: My ears are all I have, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|4:
(Why am I not surprised that he's plugged into the
prison's information network?)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|5:
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But perhaps he was not so unfortunate after
all.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|7:
Mr. Knight's crime was a grave one.{E108:0010} A crime for which
he would have been made to pay dearly anyway.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|8:
The {E041}attempted assassination of a president{E040}...{E108:0018}
That is no small matter.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|11:
Yes.{E108:0010} We proved that he murdered his team leader,{E108:0010} {E12F:00000009}{E1D1}and
that there was no attempt on the president's life.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|12:
(Could it be...?{E108:0010} {E283}Are they attempting to cover up
President Wang's fake assassination scheme...?)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|13:
Whoawhoawhoa there, cowboy!{E108:0010} {E1D1}You're saying the
Broncster didn't actually have a pop at the prez?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|14:
I was hired to defend him on the charge of {E284}{E041}attempted
murder{E040}.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|15: You mean,{E108:0008} you don't know what really happened!?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|16:
So, what --{E108:0010} they just...{E108:0008} {E1D1}blamed the whole assassination
thing on Mr. Knight?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|17:
It would explain why the {E041}Committee{E040} was so keen to get
involved.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|18:
Of course!{E108:0010} They took you off the case to try and keep
you away!
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|19:
And swapped in that Wiener kid to push through an
attempted murder charge...
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|20: In other words,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}they're trying to cover up the {E041}truth{E040}!
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|21:
Kheh heh heh heh.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}So they really were trying to frame him.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|23: According to the guards,{E108:0010} this...{E108:0008} Knight, was it?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|24:
They tell me he was violently insistent that he had
attempted no assassination.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|25:
...Which would've come out anyway when the case
went to trial.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|26:
I am no expert in legal matters,{E108:0008} but allow me to say
this one thing.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|27:
I know for a certainty that he would not have been the
first inmate imprisoned on false pretenses.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|29:
...An uncomfortable fact,{E108:0010} but a fact nonetheless.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Yes, Helmut.{E108:0010} Yes, it is.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Yeees.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|30:
The courtroom is not always the bastion of truth you
believe it to be, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|32: (I've heard something to that effect before...)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|33:
(Yes,{E108:0008} from a certain Interpol agent who doesn't have
much faith in prosecutors.)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|34:
You're not twisting the truth behind those closed
courtroom doors, too, are you?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|35:
Fueled by that kind of thinking,{E108:0008} is it any wonder that
courts produce nothing but {E280}falsities and lies!?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|36:
Sorry,{E108:0008} but the truth doesn't need the likes of you to
distort it today!
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E48|37:
(I never was able to fully dispel his mistrust of
prosecutors.)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E6E|2:
You wish to water the flowers of the earth with the
blood of your veins.{E108:0010} What a noble request.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E6E|3: I will gladly see to its fulfilment.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E6E|4:
I-I'll thank you not to ascribe such a morbid meaning
to the proof of my profession!
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E73|0:
We have a board and pieces...{E108:0010}
A game,{E108:0008} Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E73|1:
It is rare that I have the chance to play an opponent
face to face these days.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E73|2:
As tempting of an offer as that is,{E108:0008} I'm afraid I'll have to
politely refuse.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E73|3: I don't have time to be playing games.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E73|4: I also doubt you'd stick to the rules.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E73|5:
Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} Your unhealthy relationship with
rules...{E108:0010} I wonder if it's because all you have is work?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E73|6:
Such a shame.{E108:0010} Such a terrible shame.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Isn't it, Helmut?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Yeees...
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E73|8: (Even the dog's feeling sorry for me!)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E7C|0: I'd like to ask you a few questions about your dog.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E7C|1: You can ask him yourself, if you wish.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E7C|4:
(Nnrgh!{E108:0010} This is ridiculous!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}I can't cross-examine a dog!)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E7C|5:
Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Not that he can understand you, 
of course.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Perhaps I should have mentioned that.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E7C|6: Isn't he a silly man?{E108:0010} Hm, Helmut?{E108:0008} Hmmm?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E7C|8: (...They seem to understand each other well enough.)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E7C|9:
(Though I suppose it would be rather sad if they
actually didn't...)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E86|0: I'd like to ask you about this, if I may.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E86|1:
Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}Ask me of killing, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0010} and
you will have more success.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E86|2:
Or is this a hint, perhaps?{E108:0010} A clue as to who you wish
me to...{E108:0010} eliminate?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E86|3: No, it isn't,{E108:0008} and you know it!
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|0:
Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Even Helmut understands.{E108:0010}
Don't you, Helmut?{E108:0010} Yes you do...
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|1:
The "{E041}truths{E040}" revealed in court and your "deductions"...{E108:0010}
It is dangerous to trust either implicitly.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|3:
But I am not bitter.{E108:0010} You are not the first to make me a
subject of unfounded suspicions in recent days.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|4:
In fact,{E108:0008} I was visited by another prosecutor only
yesterday.{E108:0010} He was accompanied by a judge.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|5:
They even dragged the warden along,{E108:0008} her distaste for
me lingering unspoken in the air.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|8:
They went over my cell with a fine-tooth comb.{E108:0010}
But they left empty-handed.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|9:
Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} They were looking for the murder
weapon, I believe,{E108:0008} to no avail.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|10:
But I mustn't take it personally.{E108:0010} Rumor has it that they
searched every cell in the prison...
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|11:
...and still failed to find what they were looking for.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}I pray they weren't too disappointed.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Kheh heh heh.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|12:
Prison Search data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E111:000000000001000000000002}{E111:000A00000003000100000002}{E112:000A}{E12F:000A0001}{E101:000A000B}{E107:0002}Heh.{E108:0010} Well, uh...{E108:0008} that posed more questions than it
answered.{E108:0018} {E12F:000A0009}What do we do now?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|13:
(Sahwit's testimony is flimsy at best.{E108:0010} I'll need more
proper evidence if I want to take Kanis on...)
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|14: Well, I think that's quite enough chit-chat for one day.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|15:
Helmut will show you out.{E108:0018}
Good boy, Helmut.{E108:0010} Go on, now.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|16: Uhh...{E108:0010} He's not showing us out...{E108:0010} "permanently",{E108:0008} right?
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|19:
It does pain me that our brief time must end,{E108:0010} just as
we were becoming reacquainted.
sce1_c1_08.bytes|01000E8A|20:
I await your return, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Kheh heh heh.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|1:
(Now to gather the evidence I need to bolster my
case.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|3: (THAT's the best hiding spot she could find...?)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|4: It's alright, Kay.{E108:0010} You can come down now.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|6:
Uhh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}He ran off somewhere.{E108:0010}
I had no idea he could move that fast.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|8: So?{E108:0010} What do we do now?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|9:
You and I will continue the investigation.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}(And I know just where to start.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|10:
(By solving that one particular mystery that's been
dogging us this whole time.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|11:
(Knight's body was found in one of the prison
workshops.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|13:
(...he was presumably being detained in one of the
detention center's holding cells.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|14:
(So how did he wind up on the other side of those
heavy security doors?)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|15: Let's start by investigating the holding cells.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|16:
And Mr. Knight's room, right!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E150:00020018}But, uhh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}what about Mr. Fender?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|17: ...I'm sure he'll find us when he's ready.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|18:
Sure, but...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}he is kind of our boss, isn't he...?{E108:0018}
Oh, well.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|20: The victim's cell is just over there.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|22: I have just about had it!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|24:
(Warden Laguarde.{E108:0010} She must have come from the
corridor marked "No Entry".)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|26:
Even with the evidence you borrowed from the
precinct?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|27:
No.{E108:0010} And I've tried so many times,{E108:0008} I've lost count.{E108:0018} What
am I supposed to do?{E108:0010} I can't send in a blank report...
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|28:
I guess a killer for hire was always going to be a tough
nut to crack.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|31:
I couldn't help overhearing, Warden Laguarde, but...{E108:0010}
{E284}were you just talking about Bodhidharma Kanis?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|32:
My, my.{E108:0010} You were listening?{E108:0010} {E12F:00150006}{E1D1}How very gauche of you.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}{E188:00340000}A girl's privacy is her armor, you know.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|33:
...Do you normally conduct interrogations of the man
yourself?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|34:
Oh, it's not just him, darling.{E108:0010} I try to have the
occasional tête-à-tête with everyone, you see.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|35:
That's what it means to be a member of the family in
this little {E041}home{E040} of ours!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|36:
There isn't a person who hasn't made the pilgrimage to
my {E041}office{E040} at least once!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|38:
How sweet!{E108:0010} He's angling for an invite!{E108:0010}
Well, I suppose it IS the hottest ticket in town.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|39:
It's down this corridor here, darling.{E108:0010}
But FYI,{E108:0008} I don't let just anybody wander in willy-nilly.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|40: (Let's see...{E108:0010} That would put it...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}right around here.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|41:
Hee hee hee!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It's a wonderful room, if I do say so
myself.{E108:0010} All my guests rave about it.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|42:
And who wouldn't want a view of my fabulous garden
and the yard?{E108:0010} Ooh la la!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|43:
The yard?{E108:0018} If it's anything like the rest of the place,{E108:0008} it's
probably full of adorable animals, right?{E108:0010} Can I see?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|46: Because you're not a member of our {E041}home{E040}.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|47:
If you want to see it that badly, {E108:0008}{E188:00300000}{E1D1}you'll just have to get
convicted for doing something unspeakable!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|48: (That's...{E108:0008} a rather steep price to pay.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|49:
Oh, but just listen to me,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}chattering away like there's
no tomorrow.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|50:
It's time for Ally's lunchie-brunch!{E108:0010}
The poor dear will be DYING.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|52:
The sweetest little dear in all the world!{E108:0010} {E1D1}I know I
shouldn't have favorites, but...{E108:0010} you know how it is.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|53:
Now,{E108:0008} to the yard with me!{E108:0018}
{E280}Ciao for now, darlings!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|54:
(I wanted to ask her more about Kanis,{E108:0008} but she
dominated that conversation from start to finish.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|55:
...*sigh*{E108:0010}{E150:00000029}
Let's go investigate the victim's cell, shall we?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|58: When do you think he was brought in, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|59:
It would had to have been the evening of the 25th,{E108:0008} just
after the events at the lake.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|60:
(And then,{E108:0008} at some point,{E108:0008} he wound up in the prison
proper.{E108:0010} But how?)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F20|61:
(There must be some evidence here that will point us
in the right direction.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|0: I think we've about exhausted this cell.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|1:
We've made significant progress by establishing a
connection between Mr. Kanis and the victim.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|4:
Th-The security camera footage, sir!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E282}I watched it, and...{E108:0018} and...
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|5: What is it!?{E108:0018}{E150:00000029} Can you show it to us?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|6: Y-Yes, sir!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I have a small playback monitor with me.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|7: Then what are you waiting for!?{E108:0010} Let's see it!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|9:
Th-That black thing...{E108:0010}
{E280}It's that dog,{E108:0008} right?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|10:
Until now,{E108:0008} our assumption was that the crime had
taken place inside the prison proper.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F61|11: But it seems that assumption may have been wrong.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F6D|0: Knight had actually been attacked in this location!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F6E|0: Yes!{E108:0010} This is where the attack took place!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F6E|1: What!?{E108:0018} You're saying that's where he was killed?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F6E|2: But what about the video we just saw...?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F6E|3:
Ahem.{E108:0010} Yes.{E108:0010}
Perhaps I should reconsider...
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F72|0: Right here in the detention center.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F72|1:
And the perpetrator was indeed Mr. Kanis's dog.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}(This is just the evidence we need!)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F72|2:
Security Camera Footage data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}(And if this is where Knight was actually murdered...)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F72|3:
(...then one of the pieces of evidence we found here in
his cell {E282}takes on a whole new meaning!)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F77|0:
(If Knight's cell was the crime scene,{E108:0008} which piece of
evidence takes on a new significance?){E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:00330007}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}(Yes...{E108:0010} This piece of evidence now means, er...)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F77|1:
What's wrong, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0010} You're very quiet all of
a sudden.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F77|2:
Ahem.{E108:0010} I'm fine, Kay.{E108:0010}
(Actually,{E108:0008} I'm overthinking this.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F77|3: (If Knight was in fact killed here in his cell...)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F77|4:
(...then one of the pieces of evidence we found here
{E1D1}takes on a whole new meaning!)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|0:
(The floor of Knight's cell was wiped clean,{E108:0008}
presumably to remove something.)
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|2:
Thank you, Officer.{E108:0010}
Would you mind doing me one more favor?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|4:
There's a detective by the name of Gumshoe
somewhere in this facility.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|5: I need you to give him a message.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|6:
Tell him to have this cell tested for traces of blood,{E108:0008}
and to report the results to Edgeworth.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|8:
Wiped Floor data updated
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E172:00020000}{E100:0000}{E150:00020021}{E101:FFFF0002}{E107:0002}{E280}Now we can really go after that Kanis guy,{E108:0008} right,
Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|10:
We still don't know how Knight and the dog moved
between his cell and the prison proper.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|11: Right,{E108:0010} {E1D1}so that's what we need to figure out next!
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|12: What's the play, coach?{E108:0010} Where are we off to?
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|13: I suspect one of the guards might know something.
sce1_c1_09.bytes|01000F7D|14:
We should ask those posted nearby,{E108:0008} and see what they
have to tell us.
sce1_c1_0a.bytes|01000FA0|3:
...Well, well.{E108:0010}
{E188:00200000}{E1D1}{E1D5}Mr. Prosecutor and his little friend.
sce1_c1_0a.bytes|01000FA0|4:
I didn't expect to run into you here.{E108:0010}
Must be my lucky day.
sce1_c1_0a.bytes|01000FA0|5: (This is Agent Shi-Long Lang of Interpol.)
sce1_c1_0a.bytes|01000FA0|6:
(He was in charge of a case I worked on two weeks
back.)
sce1_c1_0a.bytes|01000FA0|7:
(I thought he had gone home to Zheng Fa after that,{E108:0008}
but here he is.)
sce1_c1_0a.bytes|01000FA0|8:
You had some business to take care of, I take it,
Agent Lang?
sce1_c1_0a.bytes|01000FA0|9:

moment ago!
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|3: They've set up a cordon around the entire facility!
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|4:
Good.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}*sigh*{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E280}The first blemish on a prison's spotless
reputation is always the ugliest...
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|6:
(A rather different Warden Laguarde to the one we've
seen so far...)
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|8:
I really can't thank you enough for finding that tunnel,
darling.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|9:
Sadly,{E108:0008} it may have been too little too late.{E108:0010}
It seems he might have already left the building.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|11:
After all, {E108:0008}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}there's a security gate at the exit to the
detention center.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|12: You're not suggesting he simply walked through it?
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|13:
What's to say there was only the one tunnel, sweetie,{E108:0008}
hm?
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|15:
Well,{E108:0008} whatever the case,{E108:0008} this is no time to be standing
around chit-chatting.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D01|16:
Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0008} would you mind continuing with your
investigation?
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|0: And you three can get back to your posts!
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|2:
Detective!{E108:0018} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}The results of the blood tests just came
back from the lab!
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|4:
(Let's see what they have to tell us about the {E041}blood{E042}
found in Knight's cell...)
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|5: What does it say, Mr. Edgeworth!?
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|6: They've identified the blood,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}and it's Knight's.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|8:
We've got {E041}Knight's blood in his holding cell{E040},{E108:0010} a {E041}tunnel{E040} a
dog clearly went through...
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|9:
...and security footage showing {E041}Knight being attacked
by the dog in his cell{E040}.{E108:0018} Case closed!
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|10:
We have all the evidence we need.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00200000}{E1D1}{E1D5}Let's see what Mr. Kanis has to say for himself.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|11:
Kanis?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Oh, darlings...{E108:0010} {E150:0017001D}Are you sure?{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Do be careful around him,{E108:0008} {E1D1}won't you?
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|12: He's as well connected on the outside as he is in here...
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|13:
(I suppose he would have to be.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}How else would the
so-called "fixer" stay in business?)
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|14:
The police have been trying to track down his
accomplices for the longest time.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|15: Even I've had to lend them a hand myself, you know.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|16: (So that's what that was all about...)
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|18:
Even with the evidence you borrowed from the
precinct?
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|19:
No.{E108:0010} And I've tried so many times,{E108:0008} I've lost count.{E108:0018} What
am I supposed to do?{E108:0010} I can't send in a blank report...
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|20:
I guess a killer for hire was always going to be a tough
nut to crack.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|21:
You borrowed evidence from the police to help with
your investigation,{E108:0008} is that correct?
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|22:
Why yes, sweetie.{E108:0010} Everything related to Kanis is with
me now.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|23:
Heaven knows how many times I've hauled the
secretive scoundrel into my office to talk to me.
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|24:
But no matter what I say,{E108:0008} or how much evidence I
present him with,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}he simply won't say a word!
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|25:
(A prison warden conducting interrogations herself?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}That's...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}irregular, to say the least...)
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|26:
Let your guard down and he'll devour you whole!{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Be careful, darlings.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You have been warned!
sce1_c2_03.bytes|01001D13|27:
Hoowee!{E108:0010} {E1D1}And here I thought things couldn't {E188:00310000}{E1D1}get any
spicier!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|1: Judge Gavèlle.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}I didn't expect to find you here.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|2:
We have been conducting enquiries.{E108:0010} Which,{E108:0008} given that
we are in charge of the investigation,{E108:0008} is hardly strange.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|3:
What is strange is that you are still here,
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}I gave you a warning, did I not?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|4:
I told you that your badge was at risk,{E108:0008} {E1D1}should our
paths cross again.{E108:0018} And yet,{E108:0008} here you are.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|5:
I am sorry that you thought that I might be {E1D1}so easily
discouraged, Your Honor.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|6:
But I am not about to let the truth slip from my grasp,{E108:0008}
no matter what you or the Committee might say.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|7:
I am here to present a certain someone with evidence
{E280}that you yourselves should have uncovered!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|8:
Kheh {E1D1}heh {E1D1}heh.{E108:0018} You have more business with me,
I take it, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|9:
I do.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}I promised I would be back to prove that you
were the killer.{E108:0010} And here I am.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|10:
Hm.{E108:0010} This should be amusing.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Very well,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}whenever you are ready.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|11:
Not so fast.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}We have some truths of our own to share!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}First-rate deductions, in fact!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|12:
Indeed.{E108:0010} We are now more certain than ever that
Simeon Saint was the murderer.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|13:
And that only he could have moved Mr. Knight from 
his holding cell to the prison proper.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|14:
We shall prove this to you beyond a shadow of a
doubt.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|15:
But first,{E108:0010} a question:{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Are you quite determined to
continue on this course, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|16:
Should you fail to rebut our deductions...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}there will be
no going back.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|17: Your very career hangs in the balance.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|18:
Wh...!?{E108:0010}{E112:0001} {E12F:00010006}{E1D1}You mean you'll take his badge if you don't like
how this goes!?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|20: Not at all.{E108:0010} If anything,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}I am showing him mercy.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|21:
This is not Mr. Edgeworth's case.{E108:0010} It never was.{E108:0010}
And I am under no obligation to hear him out.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|22:
If he is prepared to accept the potential ramifications
of his actions...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|23: ...I will allow him one last chance.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|24:
Well?{E108:0010} Are you truly willing to take the risk?{E108:0018}{E152:0008000B000C}{E112:0008}
{E1D1}To put your beloved badge on the line?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|28: I am confident of my reasoning.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}And what's more...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|29: ...I am representing the firm of Edgeworth and Co.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|30: And I do not intend to besmirch its name!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|32:
My duty will be done!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}And I will not be intimidated!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|33:
Very well.{E108:0010} Let us see whether you are brave...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}or
simply reckless.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|34:
By the power vested in me by the Almighty Goddess
of Justice...{E108:0010} {E152:000800080007}{E112:0008}{E176:00010000}{E188:00200000}{E1D1}{E1D5}let this judgment commence!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|37: -- How Knight Wound Up in the Prison Proper --
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|38:
You are aware of the incident involving Mr. Knight the
day before yesterday, I assume?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|39: He assaulted an innocent guard{E108:0008} and stole his keys.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|40:
Later,{E108:0008} in the middle of moving a large animal cage,{E108:0008}
Mr. Saint stopped by Mr. Knight's cell for a little visit.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|41:
That's when Mr. Knight stole out of his cell using the
keys he'd stolen.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|42:
He slipped into the cage,{E108:0008} and there he hid as he was
wheeled to one of the prison workshops.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|43:
(It figures she was going to bring up Mr. Saint going to
Knight's cell...)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|44:
Yesterday,{E108:0008} after you so kindly made us aware of the
security camera footage...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|45: ...we decided to take a look at it ourselves.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|46: Perhaps you would like to see what we found?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|47: This is a still from the footage we received.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|48: Mr. Saint speaking with Knight at his cell...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|50:
You will also note that he has positioned the cage in
such a way as to obscure the camera's view.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|51:
It is this blind spot that Mr. Knight exploited in order
to enter the cage undetected.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|52:
A sound deduction based on what can be observed,{E108:0008}
wouldn't you say?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|54:
(...that the camera wouldn't have been able to capture
the moment Knight entered the cage,{E108:0008} if he did at all.)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|55:
(So it's still possible that he didn't actually leave his
cell at this point.)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|56:
I don't get it.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Why would Mr. Knight want to hide in the cage?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|57:
There is really only one possibility:{E108:0018} {E12F:00080005}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}He intended to
{E1D5}{E041}escape{E040}.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|60: ...I have to step up my game!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|61: Kay.{E108:0010} Now is really not the time.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|63:
It is my belief that Mr. Saint helped Mr. Knight with
his escape attempt.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|64: That is to say...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D5}he was his accomplice.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|67:
I understand that the cage was briefly taken to one of
the workshops.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|68:
I imagine that had things gone to plan,{E108:0008} Mr. Knight
would have remained in the cage until after the show...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|69:
...and then removed from the premises along with the
rest of the circus's equipment.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|70:
Unfortunately for Mr. Knight,{E108:0008} Mr. Saint had other
ideas.{E108:0018} {E281}He killed his friend in cold blood...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|72:
(But there must be a fault in her logic somewhere,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}and
I'm going to find it!)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DA0|73: -- How Knight Wound Up in the Prison Proper --
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DEA|0:
You are aware of the incident involving Mr. Knight the
day before yesterday, I assume?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DEB|0: He assaulted an innocent guard and stole his keys.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DEC|0:
Later, in the middle of moving a large animal cage,
Mr. Saint stopped by Mr. Knight's cell for a little visit.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DED|0:
That's when Mr. Knight stole out of his cell using the
keys he'd stolen.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DEE|0:
He slipped into the cage, and there he hid as he was
wheeled to one of the prison workshops.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DEF|0: She says that Mr. Knight stole the keys...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DEF|2:
Indeed.{E108:0010} And if Knight didn't have them,{E108:0008} then her
entire theory falls apart.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DEF|3:
That could be the flaw I've been looking for.{E108:0010}
I should press her on the issue.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF3|0: Would you mind taking a look at this, Judge Gavèlle?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF3|1: Am I expected to accept this as evidence?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF3|2: It appears to have {E188:00310000}{E1D1}no connection to my testimony.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF3|4:
(Judge Gavèlle is a tougher nut to crack than
Mr. Winner.)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF3|5: (But that doesn't mean I should give up!)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF9|0:
There's a clear contradiction in your testimony, Judge
Gavèlle!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF9|1:
Silence!{E108:0010} Such statements will not be tolerated by this
court!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF9|2:
Hmph.{E108:0010} And why not?{E108:0010}
What precisely is wrong with my statement?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF9|3:
For one thing,{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}the fact that you clearly do not believe
it yourself.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DF9|5: (I'm going to have to be more careful next time.)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DFF|0:
Would you care to revise your testimony at all, Judge
Gavèlle?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DFF|1:
No,{E108:0008} why?{E108:0010} Do you believe there is something wrong
with it?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DFF|3:
Then perhaps...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}{E12F:00080007}you could refrain from insinuating
otherwise?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001DFF|4:
Nngh!{E108:0018}
(Well that blew up in my face...)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E04|1: You have heard about it, of course?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E04|2:
Surely any "attorney" worth his salt would have his
sources?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|0:
I take it you believe Mr. Saint had intended to break
Knight out with the cage?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|1:
I do.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}And we know that he brought the cage with him
on his visit to Mr. Knight's cell.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|2:
Because in addition to the evidence,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}he himself has
testified to having done so.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|3:
(So his trip to Knight's cell with the cage really is what
made him the lead suspect...)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|4:
Yeah,{E108:0008} but Simeon,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}he's just...{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D2}{E12F:00020000}absent-minded!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}He probably forgot he even had the cage with him!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|5:
"Mr. Saint dragged an enormous cage all the way to
the holding cells out of absent-mindedness."
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|6:
"Mr. Saint dragged an enormous cage all the way to
the holding cells in order to help someone escape."
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|7:
Which of these interpretations sounds more {E1D5}logical to
you?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E09|9:
"Gnrk!" indeed.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}As it is a fact that Mr. Saint took a little
detour to Mr. Knight's cell with a large animal cage.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E13|0: Do you have any proof that Knight stole the keys?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E13|1:
I can think of no other reason for him to carry out
such a {E188:00310000}{E1D1}brutal attack.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E13|2:
Once the guard he assaulted regains consciousness,{E108:0008}
I am sure he will confirm our suspicions.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E17|0:
(Perhaps I should press her further on her
reasoning...)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E18|2:
As I was saying,{E108:0008} it's clear the keys were vital to
Mr. Knight's escape.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|0: Sorry,{E108:0008} but I believe there is a flaw in your reasoning.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|1:
If Knight had the keys...{E108:0018} {E12F:00000002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}there was nothing to stop him
from leaving whenever he wanted.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|2: Why wait for Mr. Saint?{E108:0010} There was no need, surely?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|3: He chose the option he deemed most likely to succeed.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|4: He stole the keys and hid them somewhere.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|5:
Then waited for an opportune moment to present
itself.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|7:
I am afraid you might have made an uncharacteristic
oversight, Your Honor.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|8:
But Knight wasn't hiding any keys.{E108:0010}
That has been proven already.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E1B|9:
(And this is the piece of evidence that proves Knight
didn't have the keys.)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|0: But why go to so much trouble?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|1: Why else but to effect Mr. Knight's escape?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|3:
The cage is made of metal.{E108:0010} Therefore,{E108:0008} it would have
been exempt from the security gate inspection on exit.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|4: A fact Mr. Saint would have been well aware of...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|5: ...given that the circus visits every month.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|6: (Nnrgh...{E108:0010} I don't have anything to counter that!)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|7:
With a tarp draped over the cage,{E108:0008} he could've wheeled
Mr. Knight out,{E108:0008} right under the guards' noses.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|8:
...That is,{E108:0008} had Mr. Saint not chosen a darker path
instead:{E108:0010} {E1D1}The path of murder.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E25|9: A crime which cannot be allowed to go unpunished!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|0:
Since you know about the incident,{E108:0008} I assume you must
already know this, but...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|1:
...after the assault,{E108:0008} the guards searched both Knight
and his cell,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}and no keys were found.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|2:
And if the whereabouts of the keys cannot be proven,{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E12F:00000009}{E172:000B0000}then neither can your theory!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|3:
I have considered the matter of the missing keys.{E108:0010}
And I do not think it such an issue.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|4:
I still believe he had them.{E108:0010} After all,{E108:0008} the guards only
stated that they were unable to locate them.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|5:
And this is because {E188:00300000}{E1D5}they were cleverly hidden inside
the pocket chess set.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|6:
Knight's chess set...{E108:0010} {E12F:00000008}The same set in which the murder
weapon was also allegedly hidden?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|7: Was it?{E108:0010} I can't help but wonder about that...
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|8: What!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}But YOU'RE the one who proposed it!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|9: Actually,{E108:0008} if you recall,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}{E152:000900020003}that was Eustace's assertion.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|10:
(So the two of them aren't of one mind on this, I take
it.)
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|11: Allow me to restate the facts.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|12:
Mr. Knight hid the keys he stole from the guard inside
his chess set.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|13:
When Mr. Saint came to see him,{E108:0008} Mr. Knight used the
keys to open his cell, and climbed inside the cage.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|14:
He was then moved from his holding cell to that
workshop in the prison proper.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|15: All with the help of his friend and accomplice.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|16:
Had things gone according to plan,{E108:0008} he would have
been taken out of the facility after the show.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|17:
But they did not.{E108:0010} Instead,{E108:0010} {E283}his accomplice murdered
him while the show was taking place in the yard.
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|18: But Mr. Saint was a part of that performance!
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|19:
How would he even have had time to commit the
murder?
sce1_c2_04.bytes|01001E2F|20: How indeed?{E108:0010} Allow me to explain.

sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|20:
The other prisoners had all gone to the yard, you see.{E108:0010}
There was a show of some sort, I believe.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|21:
Here I was,{E108:0008} minding my own business,{E108:0008} when in comes
Helmut,{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}dragging a corpse, of all things.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|22:
Kheh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I had quite the shock,{E108:0010} {E188:00360000}{E1D1}not least because the
murder weapon was still in the poor fellow's neck.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|23:
Of course,{E108:0008} I was none too keen on becoming a suspect,{E108:0010}
so I had Helmut take the body to the workshop.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|24:
Once there,{E108:0008} {E283}he removed the murder weapon and
brought it back to me,{E108:0008} just as I had asked.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|25:
The dog pulled out the murder weapon in the
workshop?
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|26:
Indeed he did.{E108:0010} Removing it here would have made {E188:00310000}{E1D1}an
awful mess, after all.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|27:
You know something,{E108:0010} that makes total sense!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Remember what Mr. Sahwit said, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|29: ...had sunk his terrible teeth into the victim's throat!
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|32:
That beast!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That awful beast...{E108:0010} He killed him!
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|33:
I see...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}So what Mr. Sahwit actually saw was Helmut
removing the murder weapon, then?
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|34:
Precisely.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I can't say I wasn't a little disappointed {E1D5}that
he was spotted, of course.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|35:
Silly boy.{E108:0010} It's not like you to slip up like that, is it,
now?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}{E12F:00120007}{E188:007F0000}Mmm.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|36: And there you have it.{E108:0018} That is about all there is to tell.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|37:
I did not kill the man.{E108:0010} At most,{E108:0008} {E188:00730000}{E1D5}I am responsible for the
removal of the weapon.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|38: Now,{E108:0010} will that be all?{E108:0010} {E1D1}Poor Helmut is growing restless.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|39:
Sorry,{E108:0008} but if you could entertain us for just a little
longer, {E172:001E0001}{E108:0001}{E1D1}Mr. Kanis.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|41:
No offense, pally-o,{E108:0008} but I don't think you've quite told
us everything.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|42:
I'm sure we'd all like to know {E188:002F0000}why you thought you
needed to pull the chisel out in the first place.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|44:
(It makes sense that he would move the body to avoid
suspicion.)
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|45:
(But Kanis had no reason at all to recover the murder
weapon!)
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|46: So the mute one{E108:0008} {E188:00730000}{E1D1}isn't as dumb as I thought.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|47: Please answer the question, Mr. Kanis.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|49:
The one attached to the chisel,{E108:0010} {E1D5}{E12F:0012000B}{E188:00730000}and the one around
Helmut's neck...
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|50: ...have a very {E041}distinctive design{E040}, if you will.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|51:
Of course.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}They were something of a {E041}trademark{E040} of
yours, were they not?
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|52: I don't get it.{E108:0010} How does that even work?
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|53:
Bodhidharma Kanis,{E108:0008} the Blind Butcher.{E108:0010} His appearance
was always announced by the {E041}sound of bells{E040}.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|54: ...The last sound his victims would ever hear.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|55: Kheh heh heh.{E108:0010} You flatter me.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|56:
Though it's been some years since you last saw one of
them,{E108:0008} {E1D1}you remember them well.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|57:
Your knife and its attached bell were one of the pieces
of evidence seized in our case against you.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|60:
Two and only two.{E108:0010} One for my knife,{E108:0008} and one for my
beloved Helmut.{E108:0010} Exquisitely crafted.{E108:0008} Utterly unique.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|61: My ears are my guide, after all.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|62: And I must be able to use my tools...{E108:0010} precisely.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|63:
Of course,{E108:0008} as you said,{E108:0008} the knife has long since been
taken from me.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|64:
Mr. Kanis's Bells data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E100:0000}{E12F:00120002}{E101:00120015}{E107:0002}When Helmut brought the body to my cell,{E108:0008} {E188:00730000}{E1D1}I was
rather surprised to hear a familiar sound.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|65:
At first,{E108:0008} {E1D5}I was sure that my knife had been used to do
the deed.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|66: But no --{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}a chisel.{E108:0010} An ordinary chisel.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|68:
Nonetheless,{E108:0008} {E1D5}the bell would have suggested my
involvement.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|69:
Compounding the matter is the fact that I am the only
person in this prison permitted to use such tools.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|70: It was clear that I would become the prime suspect...
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|71: ...and so,{E108:0008} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}the chisel had to be removed and hidden.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|72:
You still claim that all you did was have the dog move 
the body?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}That you had nothing to do with the killing?
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|73:
How could I?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I told you.{E108:0008} {E1D5}The chisel is not mine.
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|74:
You need not take my word, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0018}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}{E12F:00120004}Why not have it checked for fingerprints?
sce1_c2_07.bytes|010020FC|76:
Huh?{E108:0018} {E1D1}M-Me?{E108:0018}
{E12F:00090008}B-But...{E108:0008} I don't know how to check for prints!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|2:
Uh,{E108:0008} nope!{E108:0010}{E112:0009} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}Just Mr. Knight's...{E172:00100000}{E108:0018} Oh,{E108:0008} and forensics said
there's no sign of any prints having been wiped off!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|5: Uh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Should I get them to check again?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|7: I have never so much as touched that chisel.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|8: Helmut carried it in his mouth.{E108:0010} That is all.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|9:
Therefore,{E108:0010} {E283}{E12F:00120000}any prints must belong to whoever had it
last.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|11:
So the murder weapon...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}{E12F:000A0009}belonged to the victim?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Oooh,{E108:0008} that's not helpful.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|12: As I said,{E108:0008} I have not touched the chisel.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|13:
Therefore,{E108:0008} I cannot be the killer.{E108:0018}
{E12F:00120004}...Or do you wish to suggest otherwise?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|14:
(Gnrk!{E108:0018}
I-{E108:0008}I've got nothing to counter with!)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|15:
(B-But what could this mean!?{E108:0010}
Is he...{E108:0010} Is he not the killer after all?)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|17: I am sure this goes without saying, Mr. Edgeworth...
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|18:
...but if you do not find a solution to your current
predicament,{E108:0008} and quickly...
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|19:
...I will have little choice but to relieve you of your
badge.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|20:
Even my patience has a limit,{E108:0008} and I will not tolerate
you throwing this investigation into chaos.{E108:0008} {E152:000800080007}{E112:0008}{E188:00200000}{E1D5}{E1D1}{E107:0003}Am I clear?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|23:
(...the fingerprints turn everything on its head.{E108:0010}
Without more evidence,{E108:0008} I'm back to square one.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|24:
Wait...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Something doesn't add up.{E108:0010}
A few things, actually.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|25: What would Mr. Knight have needed a chisel for?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|26:
You can do a lot with a chisel, child.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00120004}Break out of prison, for one.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|27: Alright...{E108:0008} then how did he get it in here?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|28:
There's no way the guards would let him bring a
super-sharp tool in with him.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Right, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|32:
You can't stand there hemming and hawing just
because of a little setback!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|33: The important thing is finding the truth, you know!?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|34: It doesn't matter {E1D1}how we get there...
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|35:
...as long as we save Simeon in the end!{E108:0018}
We can't give up now!{E108:0010} Or ever!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|38:
I'll second that!{E108:0010} {E1D1}You won ME around with that, Kay!{E108:0010}
I'm half-tempted to offer you a job for real!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|39: It's like I said:{E108:0010} {E285}"{E041}the defense never rests{E040}".
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|40:
Or rather,{E108:0008} like your pop said.{E108:0018} What do you think lies at
the heart of those words, Miles?{E108:0010} Any guesses?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|42:
It's like this:{E108:0010} As defense attorneys,{E108:0008} our client's fate
rests on our shoulders.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|43: We're the only ones they can turn to.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|44:
Simeon's our client,{E108:0008} and we're the only ones who can
save him.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|45: So we can't rest.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Not while he's counting on us.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|46:
I'm not about to turn my back on your old man's
legacy.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|49:
I'm an associate with the defense now.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}No --{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}I'm an associate with my father's firm.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|50:
That's the role I have chosen.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}And that means...
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|51:
...that if I fail to save my client,{E108:0008} I have failed in my
duties.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|52:
...I will honor my father's vision.{E108:000C}{E177:000B0000}{E108:000C}{E12F:00000009}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}And save Simeon Saint!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|53:
No matter what setbacks I face,{E108:0008} I cannot admit defeat!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00200000}{E1D5}{E1D1}If one {E172:000B0000}path is blocked,{E108:0010} I must simply find another!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|54: There we go!{E108:0018} {E282}That's the Miles Edgeworth I know!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|55: Now let's find that new path forward!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021A0|56:
We can start by trying to figure out {E188:00300000}{E1D1}how Mr. Knight
brought that chisel into the prison!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021D9|0:
(Right.{E108:0010} How would Knight have managed to bring a
chisel in here?){E106}{E163:00010000}{E164:002D0003}{E12F:00000009}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}{E1D1}{E188:00340000}THIS is how Knight brought the chisel into the prison!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021D9|1:
I think you may have to explain exactly how that was
achieved.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021D9|5:
We need to figure out how Mr. Knight got the chisel
through security, right?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021D9|6:
Weren't we talking about something similar not so long
ago?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021D9|8:
(Could the answer be related to how Mr. Saint fell
under suspicion...?)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021D9|10:
Quite the opposite, Your Honor.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00300000}{E1D1}There's another piece
of evidence I'd like to present.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|0:
Usually,{E108:0008} it wouldn't be possible to bring a metal object
into this facility undetected.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|1: Because of the security gates, right?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|2:
Correct.{E108:0010} But we already know that checks at one of the
gates haven't been entirely thorough of late.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|3:
Namely,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}the gate at the entrance to the detention
center.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|4: That gate is only used to scan people.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|5:
Any items they bring into the facility are only
subjected to a cursory check.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|6:
Are you telling me{E108:0008} {E284}that the chess set wasn't put
through the metal detector?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|7:
It should have been.{E108:0010} Alas,{E108:0008} it seems the guards have
grown a little lax in that regard of late.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|8:
Knight took advantage of this little oversight,{E108:0008} and had
Mr. Saint bring him the chisel...
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|10: ...That does answer one of our questions.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|11:
And it suggests that the chisel was indeed
Mr. Knight's,{E108:0008} and not Mr. Kanis's.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|12:
Pocket Chess Set data updated
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E123:0000000100040000}{E112:0000}{E124:0000}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}However,{E108:0008} we still have one rather pressing problem to
address:
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|13:
That of the security footage in which Knight is
attacked by a dog.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|14:
How does one explain it if Mr. Kanis was not the
culprit?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|15:
But then,{E108:0008} how do you explain his prints not being on
the murder weapon?{E108:0010} {E12F:000A0009}This one's a real three-piper.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|16:
The court, too,{E108:0008} finds itself wanting for a satisfactory
explanation.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|17:
Wait, sir!{E108:0018} I think it might be time to show you another
one of my secret weapons!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|19: What sort of name is that, Detective?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|20:
I, uh,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I came up with it myself, sir.{E108:0018}
{E12F:00010000}Anyway,{E108:0008} you can use it to analyze the video footage.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|21:
An excellent idea.{E108:0010} Perhaps then you might finally see
that I am tellng the truth.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|22:
(Who knows if there's anything to be found...{E108:0018}
But it has to be worth a try.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021E6|23:
Alright!{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}Want me to talk you through how to use it, sir?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|010021FF|0:
(Seeing as I'm not exactly familiar with video analysis
techniques,{E108:0008} perhaps I should hear him out...)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|0:
If you could run me through its functions, Detective,{E108:0008}{E177:00160000}{E108:0008}
that would be most appreciated.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|2: So basically,{E108:0008} you just gotta do what you always do.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|3: Examine{E040} anything that catches your eye!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|4: (And I can {E041}Examine{E042} things with {E2B0:0003}, I see.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|5:
Next up,{E108:0008} see those controls at the bottom of the
screen?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|6:
The panels on the left and right let you {E041}Rewind{E040} or {E041}Fast
Forward{E040}.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|7: And you can use the middle one to {E041}Pause{E040}.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|8: Get used to those, and you're golden, sir!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|9:
(It seems I can also press {E2B0:0005} to {E041}Fast Forward{E042} or {E2B0:0004} to
{E041}Rewind{E042} the footage.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|11:
When the video's paused,{E108:0008} you can go to the {E041}Previous
Frame{E040} with {E2B0:0004} or the {E041}Next Frame{E040} with {E2B0:0005}!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|12:
Or just use the same control panels I showed you
earlier!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|13: Lastly,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}I'd better explain how to {E041}Zoom In{E040}!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|14:
Just line up the ol' cursor with the area you want to
{E041}take a closer look at{E040}...
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|15:
...then use the panel in the bottom right,{E108:0010} and {E041}Li'l Vee{E040}'ll
do the rest!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|16:
It's got those {E041}two expanding arrows{E040} right on it.{E108:0010}
Can't miss it, sir!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|17: (It would appear I can Zoom In by pressing {E2B0:0002}, too.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|18:
By the way,{E108:0008} even when you're zoomed in,{E108:0008} you can still
Examine stuff,{E108:0008} just like in regular view!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|19:
Also,{E108:0008} you can make use of {E041}Previous{E040} and {E041}Next Frame{E040} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}to
get a good look at what's really happening!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|20:
Only thing you can't do when you're zoomed in is {E041}Play{E040}
the footage,{E108:0008} so there's that.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|21: I see.{E108:0010} And how do I {E041}Zoom Out{E040} again?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|22: Just use the panel in the lower right again, sir!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|23:
See how it's gone from expanding to {E041}collapsing
arrows{E040} on there?{E108:0010} That's because you're zoomed in.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|24: And that about sums it up!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002200|25: Now let's fire {E041}Li'l Vee{E040} up for real!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221A|0: No,{E108:0008} I'm sure it won't be that complicated.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221A|1:
Whatever you say, sir!{E108:0018}
Now let's fire {E041}Li'l Vee{E040} up!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221C|0:
Remember,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}just examine anything that catches your
eye and you'll do fine!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221C|2:
(Other than the victim being attacked by that dog,{E108:0008}
I can't see what else it might show us.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221C|3:
(But suppose we're wrong.{E108:0010} {E284}What could we be looking
at instead?)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221C|4:
(Could the person in the footage be someone other
than Knight?)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221C|5:
(And if so,{E108:0008} could whatever's attacking them be
something else, too?)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221C|6:
(I should keep both questions in mind while reviewing
the footage.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221C|7:
You never know what you're gonna see once you start
looking at things up close!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100221C|8: Check every detail, sir!{E108:0010} {E1D1}You'll find something, I'm sure!
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002225|2:
(And if nothing seems off at first glance,{E108:0008} zooming in
might help.{E108:0010} The devil is in the details, after all.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002229|1:
(What I need to do is figure out who this person really
is.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|01002229|2:
(Perhaps something else in the footage can provide me
with a clue.)
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100222D|0: The {E041}figure{E040} is reflected in the mirror here, too.
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100222D|2:
Say...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}{E1D1}Doesn't that look like {E041}the hats the guards wear{E040},
sir?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100222D|3:
Aw, geez.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}Is that what I think it is?
sce1_c2_08.bytes|0100222D|4:
Have there been any reports of one of the animals
attacking a guard recently?

...My apologies.{E108:0010} It was my fault for needlessly waving it
in your face.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026D6|6: It's okay.{E108:0010} I forgive you...{E108:0010} this time.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026DE|2:
Patootie, silly!{E108:0018} {E12F:00170002}But I wouldn't try to make friends with
this particular pooch if I were you!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026DE|3:
He doesn't let just anyone in --{E108:0010} the only person he
trusts is his owner.{E108:0010} I can see it in his eyes.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026DE|4:
You can see how smart he is, too!{E108:0010}
A regular wonderpup!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026DE|5: Is that so...?{E108:0018} You can see all that just at a glance?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026DE|6:
Sure I can!{E108:0010} After all,{E108:0008} I'm head of the Animal Taming
Department!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026DE|7: You know,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}you kinda have the same look in your eyes!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026DE|8:
I...!{E108:0018}
(I trust lots of other people...!)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026E7|0:
Huh?{E108:0010} For me?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}Ohhh,{E108:0010} that's sooo sweet!{E108:0018}
You really shouldn't have!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026E7|2:
But I just can't accept it,{E108:0008} I'm sorry.{E108:0010}
I have my hands full with the animals.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026E7|3: I...{E108:0010} wasn't asking you to take charge of it anyway.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|0:
If you're the head of the Animal Taming Department...{E108:0010}
you must be Mr. Saint's boss?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|1: That's right!{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}My dad founded the Berry Big Circus.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|4:
But we have a new Ringmaster now.{E108:0010} And he's made
the circus bigger and better than ever!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|5:
He's SUCH a nice man,{E108:0008} and he was a good friend of my
dad's, too.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|7:
I know, right?{E108:0010} It was his idea to set up departments
like "Animal Taming",{E108:0008} "Magic",{E108:0008} and "Ventriloquy".
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|8:
Only Animal Taming and Ventriloquy have more than
one person right now...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|9:
...but the Berry Big Circus is getting {E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}bigger and better
day by day!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|10: Sounds like you guys are really going places!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026EB|11:
(They're getting on well.{E108:0010}
...I'll leave them to it.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|0: Can you tell me about the show?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|1: Oh,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it's a wonderful thing!{E108:0010} {E1D5}It even has a story!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|2:
And not just any story --{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E173:0000}it's a {E041}love story{E040}!{E108:0010}
{E12F:00170003}Isn't that dreamy?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|3:
Heh heh.{E108:0010} Sounds like a regular riot.{E108:0010}
So who's the star of the show?{E108:0010} Let me guess...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}You?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|5:
And she falls in love with none other than...{E108:0010} {E1CD}{E1CB:004F00000001}{E188:00900000}Regent
the Tiger!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|6:
It's a heart-rending saga of forbidden inter-species
romance!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|7:
Whoa, Nelly!{E108:0010} I've heard of odd couples,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but that takes
the biscuit!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|8:
And that's not all!{E108:0018} There's a love triangle, too!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}It's so romantic!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|9: That sounds pretty incredible,{E108:0008} huh, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|10:
(So the elephant...{E176:00020001} is the heroine?{E108:0010}
