{E188:00310000}{E1D1}I suppose there's a first time for everything.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|12:
Oh,{E108:0008} {E1D1}that would be the big ol' meany who tries to {E188:00360000}{E1D1}tear
our star-crossed lovers apart!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|13:
Ooh!{E108:0010}
What animal do you think it is, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|14: Hmm...{E108:0010} Given that it's a circus,{E108:0008} perhaps...{E108:0010} {E1D5}a lion?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|15: I think {E1D1}a raven would be cool.{E108:0010} Like the Yatagarasu!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|19:
Nope, again!{E108:0010} The role of the monkey is played by
{E284}{E1CB:010E00000001}Simeon!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|20:
Money's far too small to play against Azea and Regent,
silly!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|21:
Anyway,{E108:0008} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}the evil villain tries to tear Azea and Regent
apart!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|22:
What will become of the fated twosome!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D5}...It's SO exciting,{E108:0010} {E1D1}isn't it?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|24:
So,{E108:0008} Mr. Saint was more than just the little helper he
claims to be.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010026F7|25:
Poor Simeon.{E108:0010} It'd be terrible if he couldn't perform
with us anymore.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|0:
Can you tell me about how you set things up for the
performance?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|1:
Oh,{E108:0008} that's not really my area!{E108:0010} Simeon took care of all
the lifting and carrying.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|2:
He's such a sweetie.{E108:0010} He offered to do everything by
telling me to concentrate on the show.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|3: I did see him doing something {E041}near that well{E040}, though...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|4: (A {E041}well{E042}...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}I recall seeing one behind the stage.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|5: (I should examine it in more detail...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|6:
You should have seen him,{E108:0008} moving those huge cages
around all by himself!{E108:0010} {E1D1}He's a total hero!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|7: Uh, yeah...{E108:0010} {E1D1}Sounds like something he would do...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|9:
He was going back and forth between the yard here
and some sort of workshop with all the equipment.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|10:
The prison gave us special permission to use it for
storage.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|11:
But he was the only one who went down there,{E108:0008} so I
don't know much more than that.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|12:
(The workshop must be...{E108:0010} {E284}the one where Knight's body
was found...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|13:
(I guess this confirms that Mr. Saint was the only
performer to have gone into Workshop A.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|14:
Well, this sucks.{E108:0010} All we're getting is information that
works AGAINST us.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|15:
You have to help Simeon, Mr. Attorney!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}We're all counting on you!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|16:
Just leave it to us!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}He may not look it,{E108:0008} but
Mr. Edgeworth knows how to get things done!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002711|17:
(And what exactly is "he may not look it" supposed to
mean...?)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002723|0:
Ah, Mr. Attorney, sir!{E108:0010} And how are you today, if you
don't mind me asking?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002723|1: Today?{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}We just talked to you earlier, Mr. Sahwit!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002723|3:
Ever since I came to call this place home,{E108:0008} I've been
working on my interpersonal skills, you see.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002723|4: (...In order to be as annoying as possible?)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002723|5:
I'm currently helping out with the circus show's stage
teardown and clean up.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002723|6: But if you have need of me,{E108:0008} I'll do my utmost to help!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|0:
I'm just chipping in and doing what I can,{E108:0008} {E285}model
prisoner that I am!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|1:
Yes,{E108:0008} my stay in this prison has seen me reborn!{E108:0010} The
Frank Sahwit you see before you is a changed man!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|2:
A changed man...{E108:0010} {E17A:000400010000}{E284}who now targets the recently
deceased?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|3:
N-No,{E108:0008} you misunderstand!{E108:0010}
That was just...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}a moment of madness...!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|4:
A moment of madness!?{E108:0010} Ugh,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}you're a disgrace to all
thieves everywhere!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|5:
Y-You're right, of course.{E108:0010} I can't deny it.{E108:0010}
I still have a long way to go.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|7:
Anyway,{E108:0008} as you can see,{E108:0008} I have a shiny new bracelet
now.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|8:
So it's the straight and narrow for me.{E108:0010}
Like I say,{E108:0008} {E285}I'm a model prisoner.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100272A|9:
(Not that a real model prisoner would need to keep
telling me that...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|0:
I'm doing everything I can to prepare for my eventual
return to society.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|1:
Yeah,{E108:0008} you even skipped the show to focus on your
training,{E108:0008} didn't you?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|2:
(That's right.{E108:0010} Only two inmates were absent:{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}Sahwit
and Kanis.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|3: Why didn't you tell us about Mr. Kanis sooner?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|4:
Ah,{E108:0008} that...{E108:0008}{E176:00010001}{E108:0008} {E1D1}Look,{E108:0008} I don't think there's an inmate in this
prison who'd talk about him if they didn't have to.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|5:
He's...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Well,{E108:0008} you could say he's the real one in charge
around here.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|6:
You didn't hear it from me, but...{E108:0010} well,{E108:0010} I guess it comes
with being {E284}{E041}the fixer{E040}.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|8: Yes.{E108:0010} Anything you need,{E108:0008} he can get it for you.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|9: But how does he {E1D1}get away with it!?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|10: I'm not sure.{E108:0010} But he's the only one who does.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|11:
I heard he has{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}a secret way of getting things into the
facility...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|12:
(I imagine being {E041}the fixer{E042} affords Kanis certain
privileges...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|13:
Not that I concern myself with such things anymore,
of course.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|14:
I'm far more interested in {E285}perfecting my {E041}mudpack{E040}
application technique.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|15: And what are these mudpacks exactly?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|16:
They're a special type of mud treatment,{E108:0008} rich with
minerals.{E108:0010} It works wonders on their coats!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|17:
I've been practicing on the animals here in the prison.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}I hope to treat them all eventually.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|18:
(Speaking of {E041}mud{E042}...{E108:0008} that reminds me of a certain piece
of evidence.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002734|19: (Maybe I should try presenting it to him...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|0:
!{E108:0018}
That's the rubber glove I dropped.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|2:
Oh,{E108:0008} of course!{E108:0010} That's mud from one of the pet
treatments I've been practicing!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|3:
I was giving one of the animals a mudpack right when
the incident happened.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|4: I see.{E108:0010} Around what time would this have been?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|5:
Let's see...{E108:0010} The show had already started, so...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}around
{E041}9 AM{E040}, perhaps?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|6:
The thing is,{E108:0008} the more mud I applied,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}{E1D5}the more in the
zone I got...{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}and the darker the animal's fur became.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|7:
There's no trance quite like the trance one enters
when one {E188:00340000}{E1D1}slathers an animal with thick,{E108:0008} black mud!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|8: (I think the stress of prison might be getting to him...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002748|9:
Rubber Glove data updated
in my Organizer.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002752|0:
Of course,{E108:0008} it's all thanks to the warden that we have
access to such wonderful distractions.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002754|0:
Oh, how elegant!{E108:0010} How classy!{E108:0010}
Just what I'd expect of a prosecutor's badge.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002754|1:
Not like the ones those awful attorneys wear.{E108:0010}
They have no class whatsoever.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002754|2:
You don't seem to like attorneys.{E108:0010} Were you...{E108:0008}
railroaded into confessing your guilt by one, perhaps?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002754|4: And lemme tell ya,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}if I ever lay eyes on that son of a--
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002754|6:
(Whoever this attorney is,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}they certainly seem to have
made an enemy of our friend Mr. Sahwit...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100275B|0:
Those sensors prevent inmates from moving freely
around the prison.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100275B|4:
You're acting very suspiciously for someone who's
done nothing wrong.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100275B|6:
You mean{E108:0008} "how dare you", I assume?{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}(It's not exactly difficult to push his buttons, is it?)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002762|0: I thought you might like to see this.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002762|1: The bracelet I broke was replaced with a new one.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002762|3: I'm very glad to hear it.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002762|4:
If it hadn't been for you,{E108:0008} you lousy, two-bit--{E108:0010}
I, I mean,{E108:0008} if it wasn't for you...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002762|6:
So, yes.{E108:0010} Thank you.{E108:0010}
I'm just...{E108:0010} {E280}so grateful!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002762|7:
(...He says through gritted teeth,{E108:0008} not sounding the
least bit remorseful.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100276A|0:
You'd like to know where the murder weapon might
be hiding?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100276A|1: Yes.{E108:0010} Do you have any ideas?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100276A|2:
Well,{E108:0008} it's just not possible for us prisoners to hide
things.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100276A|5: Stop staring at my head like that, will you?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100276A|6:
Ack,{E108:0010} sorry.{E108:0010}
I was, uh...{E108:0008} momentarily distracted.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100276A|7:
(I think we can rule out his hairpiece as a hiding
place...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002772|0:
I'm afraid I wouldn't know anything about that.{E108:0010}
As I said,{E108:0008} I have nothing to do with this incident.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002772|1: I don't think that's quite true,{E108:0008} is it?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002772|2:
Oh, but it is!{E108:0018}
What you see is what you get with me.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002772|3: No bluster,{E108:0008} no lies,{E108:0008} {E1D1}no false pretenses!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002772|5:
("No false pretenses"?{E108:0010} That rug on his head would say
otherwise...{E108:0010} but maybe I'd better keep that to myself.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002778|0:
So it's you I have to thank for all the new additions to
the family!{E108:0010} {E1D1}How wonderful!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002778|2:
Yes, darling!{E108:0010} The family here at this happy home of
ours!{E108:0010} It's so lively thanks to people like you!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002778|3:
I look forward to welcoming more!{E108:0010} Let them come in
their hundreds!{E108:0010} {E1D1}No,{E108:0008} their thousands!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002778|4:
I simply love the buzz of activity!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}The joy of a growing,{E108:0010} happy family!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002778|5: With an animal companion for every member?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002778|7:
(Dream big or go home, I guess.{E108:0010} Even if that dream is
for the world's biggest zoo.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002780|0:
It's such an awful,{E108:0008} terrible shame.{E108:0010}
The poor dear had only just joined our happy family...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002780|1:
And now,{E108:0008} if I were to call out to him...{E108:0010} Nothing.{E108:0010}
Only silence.{E108:0010} Oh, it's just TOO tragic.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002780|2:
He was such a good boy, you know.{E108:0010} A gentle man who
loved chess...{E108:0010} What a waste.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002784|0: I've given {E1D1}all my love to this place!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002784|1:
In fact,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}no one who's entered has ever left!{E108:0010}
Our bonds are as strong as iron!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002784|2:
That's a very roundabout way of saying that security
is tight.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002784|3: Oh, you!{E108:0010} "Security" is such an ugly word.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002784|4:
No!{E108:0018} The bonds of love are what keep us here!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}This whole facility is surrounded by them!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002784|5: (Very tall,{E108:0008} very sturdy bonds of love...{E108:0010} made of metal.)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002784|6:
(Though maybe not be so sturdy in the case of
Sahwit's bracelet...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100278B|1:
Um...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}(Well,{E108:0008} that certainly got a response...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100278B|2:
And what can you tell me about this member of your
little "family"?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100278B|3:
Hmph.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Those who don't accept the gift of love we offer
here don't get to be called family.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100278B|5: (So even she couldn't tame this one...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002791|0:
I understand that you handled the search of the
prison.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002791|2: And I had the whole family pitch in!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002791|3:
The whole family...?{E108:0010}
I hope that doesn't include the animals.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002791|4:
Of course it does!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}And the little angels were only too happy to help!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002791|5: Sadly,{E108:0008} their help didn't come to much, it seems...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002791|6:
I'm afraid not.{E108:0010} Such a shame, too.{E108:0010} The dear, sweet
creatures tried so, so hard!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002791|7:
(Honestly,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}I'm not sure I'd trust the animals not to
contaminate anything they might turn up...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002799|0: I'd like your opinion on this, if you would be so kind.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002799|1:
Ha ha!{E108:0008} But of course!{E108:0010}
Don't be shy, darling!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002799|2:
M-Madam,{E108:0018} release my hand at once!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That's NOT what I was asking you to examine!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002799|3: Oh, I do apologize.{E108:0010} Silly me!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002799|4:
But you know how it is!{E108:0010} {E1D1}A little hug and smooch is
entirely de rigueur!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|01002799|5:
Well, I most certainly require neither hugs nor
smooches,{E108:0008} thank you very much!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|0: Do you mind if I ask a little about the prison?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|1:
Oh, not at all!{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}This place is my pride and joy --{E108:0010} my
{E041}home{E040}!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|2:
Sure, it was a prison when I first arrived.{E108:0010}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}And it was AWFUL,{E108:0008} an utter disgrace!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|3:
"Awful"?{E108:0010} I suppose you mean the prisoners were
unruly.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|4:
I most certainly do not.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}They're angels,{E108:0010} every one of
them,{E108:0018} and they always have been!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|5: No,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it was the ambiance that was awful!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|6:
I fretted,{E108:0008} I brooded...{E108:0008} and then it hit me:{E108:0010} {E1D1}the animals!{E108:0010}
If anyone could brighten up the place,{E108:0008} it was them!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|7: It is nice having them around.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|8: Isn't it just!{E108:0010} And now look at my fabulous little family!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|9:
Why,{E108:0008} my darling Frankie is the {E188:00300000}{E1D1}very picture of
rehabilitation!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|0100279F|10:
(Except when he's {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}rifling through dead men's
pockets...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027AA|0:
We have so many success stories among the family,{E108:0008}
{E1D1}but darling Frankie...{E108:0010} really is a marvel!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027AA|1:
He's thrown himself into his vocational training,{E108:0008} and is
always the first to volunteer for everything...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027AA|2: What,{E108:0008} and your other "model prisoners" don't do that?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027AA|3:
Hm?{E108:0018} Oh,{E108:0008} of course they do, my dear!{E108:0008} Of course!{E108:0010}
They're all such tryers!{E108:0008} Such doers!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027AA|4:
I-It's just that...{E108:0010} Frankie, he...{E108:0018}
{E17A:000400010000}{E284}Let's just say he knows what's good for him.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027AA|5: (Hm?{E108:0018} What exactly does she mean by that?)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027AA|6:
Anyway,{E108:0008} he's a very good boy!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}So do try to be nice to him,{E108:0008} won't you?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|0:
Loud,{E108:0008} soaring music!{E108:0018} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}Great leaping animals!{E108:0014}{E172:00340000}{E108:0004}
The Berry Big Circus{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D5}truly has it all!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|1:
Hee {E1D1}hee!{E108:0010} And everybody who comes here gets to see it
once a month!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|2: Really!?{E108:0010} In that case,{E108:0008} let me see...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|3:
(She'd better not be thinking of something to confess
to...)
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|4:
This monthly show --{E108:0008}{E177:00320000}{E108:0008} is it always performed by the
Berry Big Circus?
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|5:
But of course, sweetie!{E108:0018} {E1D1}I'm Regina's biggest fan!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That girl's my little princess!{E108:0008} My superstar!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|6:
She's so wonderfully talented!{E108:0010}
{E12F:00150006}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Yes, she is!{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D2}Yes, she is...
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|7:
And she's so adorable!{E108:0008} So sweet!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}I could just gobble her right up!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|8:
You're not lying when you say you're her biggest fan,
huh!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|9:
Which is why I'm worried about her.{E108:0010} So,{E108:0008} so worried!{E108:0018}
It's all because of poor Simeon, you see.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|10:
If he's found guilty,{E108:0008} why...{E108:0010} darling Regina will be
{E1D1}devastated!
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|11:
So you simply MUST make sure that doesn't happen,
Mr. Lawyer.{E108:0010} Please,{E108:0008} I'm begging you.
sce1_c2_m09_npc.bytes|010027B1|12:
If there's anything I can do to help you clear up this
awful misunderstanding,{E108:0008} you let me know!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028A1|0: Ugh!{E108:0010} I can't believe I missed out!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028A1|2:
The show, duh!{E108:0010}
I always wanted to be in the circus!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028A1|3:
I mean,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I even have an escape act that would drive the
crowd totally wild and everything!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028A1|4: ...Ah, yes.{E108:0010} A great loss, I'm sure.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028A1|5:
Well, I've got an in with Regina now,{E108:0008} so let's wrap this
case up lickety-split.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028A1|6:
Because I'm gonna star in the next show,{E108:0008} {E1D1}if it's the last
thing I do!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028A1|7:
C'mon!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The quicker we investigate,{E108:0008} {E1D1}the quicker we'll
be done!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028AA|0: Being a pet stylist kinda sounds like fun.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028AA|1:
Hey, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
Want me to give you a mudpack?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028AA|2:
Do I want you to cover me in filth?{E108:0010}
No.{E108:0008} I do not.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028AA|3:
Oh,{E108:0008} don't be like that!{E108:0010} Look,{E108:0010} {E1D1}we even have a rubber
glove!{E108:0010} It's a sign!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028AA|4: Kay!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}Stop playing with the evidence at once!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028AA|8: Not all.{E108:0010} In fact,{E108:0008} that was very helpful.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028AA|10: (It seems that Mr. Sahwit has some explaining to do...)
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028B6|1:
As it should be.{E108:0010} After all, it symbolizes both the
sanctity and the strictness of the law.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028B6|3: Love, justice, peace, courage, duty, and compassion!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028BB|0:
So you wanna see some rope tricks, huh?{E108:0010} I could show
you how to stealthily escape when your hands are tied!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028BB|1:
...Surely there are some more everyday uses you can
teach me instead?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028BB|2:
Hmm,{E108:0008} let's see...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D2}{E188:00310000}{E12F:00020008}What about how to make a ladder?{E108:0010}
Or how to tie an evil-doer up super tight?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028BB|3:
There's no end to the cool stuff you can do with a good
piece of rope!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028BB|4: (...Assuming you're a Great Thief,{E108:0008} I suppose.)
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C0|0:
So the doors around here open whenever an animal
tries to go through them, right?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C0|1:
Meaning, if I had a furry friend with me,{E108:0008} I could go
wherever I wanted, huh!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C0|2:
I'd think the bigger problem would be getting in here
in the first place.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C0|3:
Nah,{E108:0008} that's the easy part!{E108:0010} If you know the trick to
opening any door in the world, that is...
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C0|5:
Oh, umm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Sorry, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
{E282}It's a trade secret!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C7|0:
*shudder*{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The sight of that dog sends shivers down
my spine, Mr. Edgeworth...
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C7|3: I'm scared of cops,{E108:0008} {E1D1}guards,{E108:0008} {E1D1}sirens...{E108:0010} {E1D1}All kinds of stuff!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C7|4: The very things that assuage most people's fears.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C7|5: Yeah, well...{E108:0010} I'm not most people!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C7|7: Let me guess,{E108:0010} {E285}"the Great Thief Yatagarasu"?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028C7|9:
Heh,{E108:0010} I see now why you do it.{E108:0010} That was rather
satisfying, I must admit.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|0: You know what I think, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|1:
If the murder weapon can't be found...{E108:0010} {E285}then maybe
there wasn't one to begin with!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|2: Well.{E108:0010} That's certainly an interesting suggestion.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|3: But then{E108:0008} {E284}how did our victim meet his end?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|5: If there's no murder weapon,{E108:0008} there's no murder, right?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|7:
We cannot ignore the facts in front of us,{E108:0008} no matter
how much we might wish to.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|8: You're right...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I know Mr. Knight's dead...
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|9: But I know something else, too!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028D1|10:
We're going to find out who killed him,{E108:0008} if it's the last
thing we do!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|0:
We lucked out finding this tape.{E108:0010}
Can't believe they caught it on camera.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|1:
Indeed.{E108:0010} The actual moment Knight was killed.{E108:0010}
{E285}One couldn't hope for a better clue.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|2:
Hmm...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Can't really see the face of the person being
attacked, though.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|4:
(The video isn't quite the conclusive proof I'd like it to
be...)
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|5:
Ooh,{E108:0010} that gives me an idea!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}What if I deliberately covered my face?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|6:
Then I wouldn't need to worry about security cameras
at all!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|7:
Yeah,{E108:0010} then I can sneak into pretty much anywhere
I want!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|8:
I think your rather unique outfit might give you away.{E108:0010}
You'd have to do something about that first.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|10:
I'm the Great Thief Yatagarasu!{E108:0010}
There ARE rules, you know!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028DC|11: (The type you get to pick and choose at will, I take it?)
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028E8|0: So can a metal detector find any kind of metal?
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028E8|1: I imagine so,{E108:0008} if it's one of those high-spec models.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028E8|2:
I have heard that some metals can be harder to detect
than others, though.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028E8|6:
Thanks, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}You're just a treasure trove of
information!
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028E8|7:
(I hope I haven't just helped further a Great Thief's
career...)
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028F0|0: Hey, I'm a Great Thief.{E108:0010} I totally sympathize.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028F0|1:
If you feel you gotta grab something,{E108:0008} you should just
go ahead and grab it.{E108:0010} Even if it's worthless.
sce1_c2_partner.bytes|010028F0|2:
(She doesn't seem to think much of my little
"treasure"...)
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|1:
Here we are again...{E108:0010} Let's hope we can find something
this time that will finally reveal the truth behind it all.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|2: Although,{E108:0008} that might be easier said than done...
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|5:
There is another possibility,{E108:0008} one you seem to have
overlooked.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|6:
The well in the yard...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Could a body not have entered the tunnel from there?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|7:
In summary,{E108:0010} the body must have been thrown down
the well and moved to the workshop...
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|9: Tell me,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D2}who else could have done that but Mr. Saint!?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|10:
(Had Knight's body really been thrown down the
well?)
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|11:
(The answer to that question will surely show us the
way forward.)
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|12:
(But before we begin,{E108:0008} I should tidy up my Organizer a
little.)
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|13:
Unnecessary evidence has been removed.{E108:000C}
Remaining evidence has been re-arranged.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|16:
A dried-up well slap-bang in the middle of a prison?{E108:0014}
{E1D1}Figures it'd be locked.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|17:
Well, luckily,{E108:0010} {E150:0002001B}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}I'm a master lockpicker!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Want me to do my stuff?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|18: I think not.{E108:0010} We'll do this investigation by the book.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|21:
The lock's broken!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}And from the looks of it...
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|22: ...it's been broken for a long time.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|24:
(...then anyone could have thrown Knight's body down
the well.)
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|25:
Judge Gavèlle's theory was that Mr. Saint carried out
the murder here in the yard.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|26:
And then,{E108:0008} during the performance,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}he threw the body
down the well...
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|27: What are ya thinking, Milesarino?{E108:0010} Plausible, or no?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|28: Oh!{E108:0018} Why don't we see if Missile can help us out again?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|29:
He'll be able to tell us if Mr. Knight's body was here,{E108:0008}
and which way it went!
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|30: Good idea.{E108:0010} I'll call Detective Gumshoe.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|33: Come to the prison yard.{E108:0010} And bring Missile with you.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|34:
You bet, sir!{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}Gumshoe's Seven Secret Weapons to the
rescue again, huh?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|35: (I'm fairly sure Missile belongs to the precinct...?)
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|36: I'd also like you to bring one of our witnesses.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|37:
Call the Berry Big Circus{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}and ask Ms. Regina Berry to
come down here with you.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|38: Yessir!{E108:0018} I'll be there before you know it!
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|39: So!{E108:0010} What shall we do while we're waiting for Gummy?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|40: How about...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E12F:00020008}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}a quick game of hide-and-go-seek?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|41: Fun idea, kiddo,{E108:0010} {E12F:000A0009}but where exactly would we hide?
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|43:
Your game can wait, Kay.{E108:0010} We need to call on one of
your more practical skills.{E108:0010} I think you know the one.
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|44:
Ohhh,{E108:0008} you bet I do!{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E173:0000}One crime scene re-creation,{E108:0008}
coming right up!
sce1_c3_00.bytes|01001620|46:
Let me show you!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Introducing a Great Thief's Great
Secret Weapon...{E108:0010} {E12F:00020008}{E188:00200000}{E1D1}{E1D5}Little Thief!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|0:
Wh-Whoa!{E108:0018} {E1D1}Screens appearing from thin air!?{E108:0018}{E13E:000B}{E150:000B0034}
This is some next-level tech, little sis!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|1:
Wanna talk me through the deets?{E108:0010}
What are you doing now?
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|2: I'm inputting everything we need for the simulation!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|3: Allow me to explain.{E108:0010} {E12F:00000008}{E1CB:005A00020000}This is "Mr. Thief".
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|4:
It's a device that can re-create crime scenes at specific
moments in time based on the data you feed it.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|5:
How about I start us off with a re-creation of what the
yard looked like yesterday?
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|6:
Good idea.{E108:0010} That was when they were in the middle of
tearing down the stage.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|7:
We didn't pay much attention to the well then.{E108:0010}
Who knows?{E108:0010} We may have overlooked something.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|8: Leave it to me!{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}{E1CB:001C00000000}I'll use the photo I took!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|10:
That's all the data!{E108:0010} Just gotta pump the projection
power to max, and...
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|11:
Dark skies of evening,{E108:0008} when no other bird dares take
wing,{E108:0010} {E150:0002001A}one alone remains all-seeing!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|12:
Now,{E108:0008} witness the true power of {E188:00200000}{E1D1}{E1D5}{E173:0000}a real, modern-day
Robin Hood!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|14:
It's a {E041}re-creation of how things were yesterday{E040},{E108:0008}
modeled on the data I gave Little Thief!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|15: This gadget was a tool used by the original Yatagarasu.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|16: But they used it to plan robberies.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|17:
Well,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:0002000B}there's no harm in using it for something on the
right side of the law now.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|18:
Oh,{E108:0008} but keep in mind that it can only re-create what
you tell it to.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|19:
It can't simulate things it doesn't have data for,{E108:0008} and if
the data itself contains mistakes...
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|20:
...then you'll wind up with those same mistakes in the
re-creation, too.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|21:
(But this particular re-creation is based on Kay's
photo,{E108:0008} so we shouldn't run into any problems.)
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|22: ...That's enough preamble.{E108:0010} Shall we get started?
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|24:
Don't forget,{E108:0008} you can Examine stuff in the re-creation,{E108:0008}
just like in real life!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|25:
You can also Present evidence to try to clear up any
inconsistencies you find!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|26: Of course.{E108:0010} Thank you for the reminder.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|27: (Now,{E108:0008} let's take a look at that well!)
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|28:
I suspect that's about all there is to find for now.{E108:0010}
...Detective Gumshoe should be here soon, too.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|29: Kay,{E108:0008} you can power down Mr. Thief now.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|30:
Sure thing!{E108:0018}
Prepare to return to normality!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|31: Sorry, sir!{E108:0018} I came as quick as I could!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|33: Ah, Detective.{E108:0010} That was indeed impressively quick.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|34:
You know me, sir!{E108:0010}
Never did like to keep you waiting!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|35: Thanks for coming all this way, too, Regina.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|36:
No problem!{E108:0010} This seemed way more fun than
rehearsals,{E108:0008} so I ditched them for the day!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|38: Alright, Detective.{E108:0010} Let's get started with Missile.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|40:
What's the matter!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}C'mon, boy!{E108:0010} Come on!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|42: Looks like he's scared of something, sir.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|45: Guess he's not a fan, sir.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|46:
*sigh*{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Well, I doubt he'll be of much help to us like this.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|48:
Yes, actually.{E108:0010}
Ms. Berry,{E108:0010} would you mind lending us a hand?
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|49:
Ooh,{E108:0008} I'd {E1D1}love to!{E108:0010}
Just tell me what you need!
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|50: Do you want me to teach Ally some tricks?
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|51: (I don't doubt she could do it, but...)
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|52:
Nothing quite like that.{E108:0010} I'd simply like an account of
what the yard looked like during the show.
sce1_c3_01.bytes|01001720|53:
I like where this is going!{E108:0010} You're thinking of using
Little Thief again, am I right?
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|0:
Okay,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I've plugged in all the data!{E108:0010}
Firing up the simulation!
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|1:
Here you go!{E108:0010} This is what the yard was like {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E041}during the
show{E040}!
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|2:
The time at which the body was purported to have
been thrown down the well...
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|3:
Oh, wow!{E108:0010} This is sooo amazing!{E108:0018}
It's like magic!
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|4: Eheh!{E108:0010} No magic here.{E108:0010} Just sweet, sweet data.
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|6: Hm?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}The area behind the stage is missing.
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|7:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Regina said she wasn't involved in getting the
stage set up...
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|8:
...so we don't have any data on what it was like back
there.
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|9: No data,{E108:0008} no simulation, huh?{E108:0010} Brutal...
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|10:
I'm so sorry, you guys!{E108:0010} It's all because I let Simeon do
everything by himself...
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|11:
Oh, no, no!{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}It's all my frilly associate's fault!
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|13:
Anyway!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E150:0002002C}We've got a fresh simulation now,{E108:0008} but we still
have the other data, too.
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|14:
I can switch back whenever you want to the
re-creation of them taking down the stage!
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|15:
So we can examine the scene both {E041}during{E040} and {E041}after
the show{E040}...
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|17:
(I can switch between re-creations by using {E2B0:0003} to {E150:00020030}{E041}talk
with Kay{E042}.)
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|18: Now then,{E108:0008} let's continue our investigation,{E108:0010} shall we?
sce1_c3_02.bytes|01002920|20: Alright, Little Thief!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Your work here is done!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|0:
First on the scene!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}The early bird wins the worm!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|2: Wha--!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}You!{E108:0018} How'd you get here before me!?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|3:
Good morning, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
I see you've made an early start.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|4: And I see you've made a late one, Judge Gavèlle.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|5: This is not my only case.{E108:0010} I am a very busy woman.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|6:
...Not all of us enjoy the freedom of a prosecutor
relieved of his only current responsibility.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|8:
Oh,{E108:0008} I do apologize.{E108:0010}{E112:0008} {E12F:00080000}I meant, of course,{E108:0008} an associate
attorney.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|11: Eustace.{E108:0010} Let us begin the investigation of the yard.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|12: Okay!{E108:0010} I'll go get some officers to help.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|15:
We've already finished investigating the yard,{E108:0008} and won
quite the prize in the process.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|16:
W-W-{E041}Won{E040}!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E12F:00090008}{E1D1}But I'm supposed to be the winner!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|17:
Your Honor.{E108:0010}
{E152:000000030004}{E108:003C}{E177:001C0000}{E112:0000}I'd like to revisit your theory from yesterday...
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|20:
I would caution you to choose your words carefully,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|21:
As I am sure you remember...{E108:0010} {E284}{E12F:00080001}your badge is in my
hands.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|22:
How could I forget?{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}You've told me several dozen
times already.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|23: Perhaps you'd care to try a different threat.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|24:
...You have been warned repeatedly, yes.{E108:0010} And each
time,{E108:0008} {E1D1}my words seem to have fallen on deaf ears.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|25: Allow me to make this crystal clear:
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|26:
The Committee cannot and will not tolerate
insubordination.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|27:
The fate of my badge and {E1D1}the whims of the Committee
are of no concern to me now.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|28:
The only thing that concerns me...{E12F:0000000C}{E108:0014} {E107:0002}{E188:00200000}{E1D5}{E1D1}is proving Simeon
Saint's innocence!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|29:
Interesting...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}And spoken like a true defense attorney.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|30: In that case,{E108:0008} I shall be equally uncompromising.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|31:
In the name of the Goddess of Justice...{E108:0008}{E152:000800080007}{E112:0008} {E107:0001}{E188:00200000}{E1D1}{E1D5}I will strike
down your case without mercy.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|32:
And when I am done...{E152:0008000B000C}{E108:000F}{E1D1}{E176:00010000}{E112:0008} your career as a prosecutor
will be over as well.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|33: I hope you do not come to regret this.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|35:
My theory remains the same as when I related it to
you yesterday.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|36:
Mr. Carcerato did not see Mr. Knight's body when he
passed through the tunnel.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|37:
As such,{E108:0008} the body could only have been dropped down
the well {E1D1}during the show.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|38:
We both know the only one who could have dropped
the body down there during the show is {E280}Mr. Saint.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|39:
That's still your assertion?{E108:0010}
And you can prove it, of course?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|41:
...What Eustace means to say is that we received the
final autopsy report just ahead of our arrival.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|42:
(She really is a very busy woman --{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}busy looking after
Baby Winner.)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|43:
The victim appears to have died the night before the
body was discovered...
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|44: In other words,{E108:0008} the night before the show.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|45:
The cause of death is as stated.{E108:0010}
It seems the wound is 4 inches deep.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|46:
Autopsy Report data updated
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E12F:00080000}{E100:0000}{E101:00080009}{E107:0002}Simeon Saint was offstage for a period of 15 minutes.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|47:
That was plenty of time for him to throw the victim's
body down the well.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|48:
(Judge Gavèlle hasn't investigated the yard yet.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Which means...)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|49:
Hmph.{E108:0010} I fear there may be {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}something of a flaw with
your theory, Your Honor.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|50:
You seem very confident of that.{E108:0010}{E152:0008000E000F}{E112:0008}
{E188:00300000}But do you have any evidence to prove it?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017A0|51: Yes.{E108:0010} I think I just might.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017D7|0:
My theory remains the same as when I related it to
you yesterday.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017D8|0:
Mr. Carcerato did not see Mr. Knight's body when he
passed through the tunnel.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017D9|0:
As such, the body could only have been dropped down
the well during the show.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DA|0:
We both know the only one who could have dropped
the body down there during the show is Mr. Saint.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DB|0:
Judge Gavèlle hasn't carried out a full investigation of
the yard yet.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DB|1: Which means we've got the advantage for a change.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DB|2:
(I should review the evidence we gathered during our
investigation of the yard.)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DE|0:
That theory being that Mr. Saint was the killer.{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}You're certainly clinging to it rather stubbornly.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DE|1:
And you are certainly clinging rather stubbornly to
the idea that Mr. Saint wasn't the killer.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DE|2:
Do you have any conclusive evidence that he wasn't?{E108:0010}
Any idea who the "real killer" might be?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DE|3: I'd like to see what evidence you yourself have first.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DE|4:
I am an emissary of the Goddess of Justice.{E108:0010}
My words are her words.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DE|5:
But her words are wasted on you, I see.{E108:0010} {E283}You would
challenge me if I said the sky was blue.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DE|6: (Is this a court or a cult?)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017DE|7:
If you truly mean to refute the word of the divine,{E108:0008} then
come!{E108:0010} {E280}Show me your evidence!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017E6|0:
Isn't it possible that Mr. Carcerato{E108:0008} {E284}simply failed to
notice the body?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017E6|1:
Assistant to the associate attorney,{E108:0008} {E1D1}you have been
through the secret passage, have you not?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017E6|3:
I noticed mud on you yesterday --{E108:0008} {E12F:00080001}on that charming
key in your hair, to be precise.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017E6|4:
That's incredible!{E108:0018} You could be a Great Thief with eyes
like that!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017E6|5: Answer me truthfully,{E108:0008} in the name of the Goddess:
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017E6|6:
Would you or would you not have noticed a body had
one been present?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017E6|8:
There you have it.{E108:0010} Mr. Carcerato did not see a body.{E108:0010}
Which means there was no body there to see.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|0:
Could you talk us through your reasoning on that a
little more?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|1:
The day before the performance,{E108:0008} Mr. Knight borrowed
the keys from Mr. Carcerato.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|2: (Or more specifically,{E108:0008} the key to his cell...)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|3:
Mr. Knight then used the key to leave his cell and
enter Mr. Saint's cage.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|4:
Mr. Saint took Mr. Knight to the yard in that cage...{E108:0008}
and that's where he killed him.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|5:
The following day,{E108:0008} Mr. Carcerato crawled his way
through the tunnel,{E108:0008} but there was no body there yet.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|6: Wait a second!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}That doesn't add up!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|7:
Mr. Carcerato smelled that sweet smell!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}So Mr. Knight must've been in the tunnel already!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|8:
No.{E108:0010} His body did not pass through the tunnel until
{E1D1}{E188:002F0000}sometime after Mr. Carcerato had crawled through it.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|9:
Mr. Carcerato used the tunnel right around the time
the show was starting.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|10:
The body was discovered just after the performance
ended.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|11:
From which you deduced that the the body could only
have been thrown down the well during the show.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017EF|12: Yes,{E108:0008} and who the culprit must be.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|0:
Are you sure about that?{E108:0010}
Could nobody else have done it?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|1:
I understand that Ms. Berry was on stage for the
entire performance.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|2: Most of the prisoners were watching the show.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|3: And those who were not{E108:0008} have plausible alibis.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|5: They too were watching the show.{E108:0010} As was the warden.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|6:
How can you be so sure?{E108:0010} {E1D1}A guard could have easily
approached the well unnoticed.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|7: None of the guards left their posts during the show.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|8:
I have checked this for myself, you know.{E108:0010} I took
statements from each and every one of them.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|9: (Arngh...{E108:0010} She's thorough,{E108:0008} I'll give her that.)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|010017FC|10:
Are you finally ready to accept the truth?{E108:0010}
That the killer could only have been Simeon Saint?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001807|0: Would you mind taking a look at this, Judge Gavèlle?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001807|1: Am I expected to accept this as evidence?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001807|2: It appears to have {E188:00310000}{E1D1}no connection to my testimony.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001807|4:
(Judge Gavèlle is a tougher nut to crack than
Mr. Winner.)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001807|5: (But that doesn't mean I should give up!)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|0100180D|0:
There's a clear contradiction in your testimony, Judge
Gavèlle!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|0100180D|1:
Silence!{E108:0010} Such statements will not be tolerated by this
court!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|0100180D|2:
Hmph.{E108:0010} And why not?{E108:0010}
What precisely is wrong with my statement?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|0100180D|3:
For one thing,{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}the fact that you clearly do not believe
it yourself.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|0100180D|5: (I'm going to have to be more careful next time.)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001813|0:
Would you care to revise your testimony at all, Judge
Gavèlle?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001813|1:
No,{E108:0008} why?{E108:0010} Do you believe there is something wrong
with it?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001813|3:
Then perhaps...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}{E12F:00080007}you could refrain from insinuating
otherwise?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001813|4:
Nngh!{E108:0018}
(Well that blew up in my face...)
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|0:
Sorry, Your Honor,{E108:0010} but there's something else you're
going to have to take into account.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|1:
The well in the yard was {E1D1}rigged up to create a certain
unique contraption.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|3:
You will recall that Mr. Saint was sent flying from the
stage by the elephant.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|4: I do.{E108:0010} Just before he was to be absent for some time.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|5:
He was only able to fly through the air thanks to a
weighted rope he tied around himself.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|6:
Dropping the weighted end down the well allowed him
to complete the trick.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|7:
Wait,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E12F:00090003}{E1D1}wouldn't that send him flying as soon as he set
foot on the stage?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|8:
It's simple, really.{E108:0010} He kept the weight from falling by
using a stake to keep the rope in place.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|9:
With a second rope,{E108:0008} he was able to pull the stake free,{E108:0008}
thereby controlling when the weight was dropped.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|10:
We have found evidence to suggest that {E284}{E176:00030000}the original
weight was replaced with Knight's body.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|11:
This was done by the real killer{E108:0010} {E12F:00000009}{E107:0001}{E282}in order to {E174:00000000}create an
alibi!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|13:
The estimated time of death tells us that the murder
took place early in the morning.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|14:
The killer could have tampered with the contraption in
the time between the murder and the show.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|15:
You're saying Mr. Saint himself set this contraption up,
right?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|16:
Well then,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}who do you think is the {E041}number one{E040},{E108:0008} most
likely person to have used it to dispose of a body, hm?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|17: Even you must see how this looks.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|18:
If Mr. Saint was the killer,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D1}he could've simply done as
Judge Gavèlle theorized --{E108:0008} without these extra steps!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|21: Does anyone else know how Mr. Saint's trick works?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|23:
We had to get the prison's approval on what we were
going to perform...
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|24: So I don't think Simeon's the only one who knows.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|26:
Interesting...{E108:0008}{E177:001C0000}{E108:0008} {E107:0002}You have certainly been diligent in your
investigation.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|27: And yet,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}{E284}I fail to {E172:001C0000}comprehend your actions still.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|28: Why do you not work to do what is right?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|29:
Is what I am doing wrong?{E108:0010}
{E152:0000000A000B}{E112:0000}{E188:002F0000}If so,{E108:0008} who is it that deems it so?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|30:
How can you not grasp even that?{E108:0010} How can you not
see that you are doing wrong at this very moment?
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|31: You are a prosecutor,{E108:0008} and yet you aid the defense.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|32:
This flies in the face of common sense.{E108:0010}
You are breaking every rule in the book.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|33:
I think only of what is right and just,{E108:0008} and act as I see
fit in each situation I am confronted with.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|34:
This is the path I have chosen.{E108:0018} {E1D5}{E12F:00000009}{E1D1}And whether you can
comprehend that choice is immaterial.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|35:
But if you mean to stand in my way...{E108:0020}{E106}{E1E6:0000}{E101:00000000} {E107:0002}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}I will fight back
with all I can bring to bear!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|36: Perhaps the Goddess of Justice is testing me.
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|37: Very well.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}If it is her will that we must fight...
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|38: ...then I shall end this,{E108:0008} once and for all!
sce1_c3_03.bytes|01001818|39:
Listen well, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} {E188:00200000}{E1D1}For there is another
reason why only Mr. Saint can be the killer.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|1:
If the body was moved from the yard to the
workshop...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|2:
...then Mr. Knight must have first been brought here to
the yard from his cell.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|3:
The only person who had the opportunity to do that is
Simeon Saint.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|4: And thus,{E108:0008} he remains the only plausible suspect.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|5: Mr. Saint took a cage with him to Mr. Knight's cell.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|6: But why would he do that?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|7:
Why take such an unwieldy object all the way to the
holding cells?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|9:
But we've all met Mr. Saint.{E108:0010} That's exactly the kind of
thing he would do.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|10:
It's entirely plausible that he took the cage with him
out of absent-mindedness and nothing else.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|12:
...but it is no more or less plausible than him having
helped Mr. Knight to escape.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018A0|13:
(Arngh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I need some real solid evidence if I'm going
to get her to budge...)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018AF|0:
If the body was moved from the yard to the
workshop...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B0|0:
...then Mr. Knight must have first been brought here to
the yard from his cell.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B1|0:
The only person who had the opportunity to do that is
Simeon Saint.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B2|0: And thus, he remains the only plausible suspect.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B3|0:
(Surely Mr. Saint isn't the only person who had the
opportunity.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B3|1:
(I must have some evidence that can help break this
deadlock!)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B5|0:
You seem to think that Mr. Knight was killed here in
the yard.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B5|1: When do you think he was brought here?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B5|2:
Sometime between midnight and 8 AM, the day of the
show.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B5|3: It could only have been during that time.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B5|4:
(In other words,{E108:0008} between the end of rehearsal and the
start of the performance.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018B5|5:
As I was saying,{E108:0008} if the body was moved from the yard
to the workshop...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018BB|0:
Was there really no other way he could have come
here?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018BB|2:
If he,{E108:0008} a random non-inmate,{E108:0008} had openly entered the
prison proper...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018BB|4:
And presumably,{E108:0008} none of your witnesses have testified
to having seen such a thing.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018BB|5:
Precisely.{E108:0018} {E12F:00080003}Praise be to the Goddess of Justice for
granting you this insight.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018BB|6:
So,{E108:0008} as you will agree,{E108:0008} it can only be that Mr. Knight
was brought over here in secret.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|0: You're certain nobody else had the opportunity?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|1: Need I remind you that we are in a prison?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|2:
The entire facility is monitored at all times.{E108:0010}
Anything out of the ordinary would have been spotted.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|3:
But Mr. Saint was under that same scrutiny, was he
not!?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|4:
The warden had granted the members of the circus
troupe special access.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|5:
As a member of that troupe,{E108:0008} {E1D1}under the supervision of
Ms. Berry...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|6:
...he is the only person who was free to wander where
he willed.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|7: It seems you've forgotten something, Your Honor.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|8:
"Forget" is not a word in my vocabulary,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|9: Very well,{E108:0010} then recall this fact, if you will:
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|10:
You claim that Mr. Saint is the only person who was
free to walk around the prison...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|11:
...but there was a brief period of time on the day of the
crime in this prison.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|12:
A time when it would have been possible for anyone to
move through the prison entirely unmonitored!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018C2|13:
(What do I have that shows there was a period on the
day of the crime where oversight was limited?)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|0: This piece of evidence proves that fact!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|1: ...Well, Eustace?{E108:0010} What do you make of this?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|2:
Yes.{E108:0010} Interesting...{E108:0010} Well,{E108:0008} as we all know,{E108:0008} most people
have legs.{E108:0010} Therefore...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|3:
...pretty much anybody could have walked around the
prison that day!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|4: ...Yes.{E108:0010} But could they have walked around freely?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|6: (R-{E108:0008}Rebutted by Mr. Winner, of all people!)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|7:
Ha ha ha!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}Have you learned your lesson yet,{E108:0010}
Edgeworthless!?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|9:
(Judge Gavèlle's latest assertion relies on the prison's
security systems having been in full working order.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018D0|10:
(I must have something that proves that wasn't the
case...)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018DB|0:
The only suspect, you say?{E108:0010}
{E280}Are you really sure of that?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018DB|1:
Stricly speaking...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}{E188:002F0000}Ms. Berry is not entirely beyond
suspicion.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018DB|4:
Uh, Regina...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}You know she just said you could be a
murder suspect, right?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018DB|5: Sure!{E108:0010} But I didn't do it!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018DB|6:
(She didn't even bat an eye.{E108:0010}
A true animal tamer through and through.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018DB|7:
Hah hah hah...{E108:0010} Of course.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00080001}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}That was simply a little joke.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018DB|8: I knew it!{E108:0010} I figured it just had to be!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018DB|9:
(Then why don't either of your smiles{E108:0008} {E12F:00000009}reach your
eyes...?)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018E5|0: Would you mind taking a look at this, Judge Gavèlle?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018E5|1: Am I expected to accept this as evidence?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018E5|2: It appears to have {E188:00310000}{E1D1}no connection to my testimony.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018E5|4:
(Judge Gavèlle is a tougher nut to crack than
Mr. Winner.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018E5|5: (But that doesn't mean I should give up!)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018EB|0:
There's a clear contradiction in your testimony, Judge
Gavèlle!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018EB|1:
Silence!{E108:0010} Such statements will not be tolerated by this
court!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018EB|2:
Hmph.{E108:0010} And why not?{E108:0010}
What precisely is wrong with my statement?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018EB|3:
For one thing,{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}the fact that you clearly do not believe
it yourself.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018EB|5: (I'm going to have to be more careful next time.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F1|0:
Would you care to revise your testimony at all, Judge
Gavèlle?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F1|1:
No,{E108:0008} why?{E108:0010} Do you believe there is something wrong
with it?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F1|3:
Then perhaps...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}{E12F:00080007}you could refrain from insinuating
otherwise?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F1|4:
Nngh!{E108:0018}
(Well that blew up in my face...)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F6|0:
Mr. Saint is far from the only one who had the
opportunity!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F6|1: Um,{E108:0008} which opportunity are we talking about again?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F6|2:
We'd previously established that the time code on the
security footage was off by three hours.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F6|3:
And from this,{E108:0008} we can deduce that there must have
been a power outage lasting for that length of time.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F6|4:
During which,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}anyone could have moved around the
prison undetected.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F6|5:
Do you mean to say that our killer intentionally
created this three-hour gap?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018F6|6:
That it was no simple camera malfunction?{E108:0010}
Is that even possible?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018FD|0:
It was completely possible to create the three-hour
gap...{E108:0010} {E1D1}using this!{E040}{E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:004C0016}{E123:0008000000070000}{E124:0000}{E100:0000}{E101:00080009}{E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}You're saying that this is how the killer created the
three-hour gap?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018FD|1: Indeed.{E108:0010} It would have been all too simple...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018FD|4:
How, indeed!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Perhaps you can show me how you
propose that it was done?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018FD|5:
Nnrgh!{E108:0018}
(I guess it was a bit of a stretch...)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018FD|6:
(The only way to create that gap is to shut down the
security camera somehow.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018FD|7: (And we know how that was done!)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|010018FD|8:
I hope you do not expect us to believe that someone
was able to create this gap through sheer force of will?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|0:
Our investigation of the yard turned up something
rather interesting...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|1:
A panel of breakers,{E108:0008} one which can be used to cut the
power to the security cameras.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|2:
We also learned that the door to the power room{E108:0008} {E176:00010000}{E283}may
have been opened at around the time of the murder!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|5:
...Such a shame.{E108:0010} To see one so capable fall so short of
the mark.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|6: Mr. Edgeworth knows what he's doing!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|7:
Hah hah hah.{E108:0010} Then how does he explain the lock on
the power room door?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|8: Oh, yeah.{E108:0010} It was kinda locked up tight...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|9: And the warden's the only one with the key.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|10: Those breakers are vital to the prison's infrastructure.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|11:
So I very much doubt that anyone could have gained
access to the power room's key so easily.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|14:
That person --{E108:0008} the killer --{E108:0008} had easy access to it, in
fact.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|15:
And what's more,{E108:0008} their position here is such that
nobody would dare question them.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|17:
The breaker to the electric fence is in there!{E108:0010} They
would be questioned in an instant!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|18: (There's only one person who meets these criteria.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001908|19:
(I can hardly believe it myself...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}but I have to follow
where the logic leads!)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|0100191C|1: Indeed.{E108:0010} I can think of no other likely candidate.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|0100191C|2: Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00340000}the court grows tired of your bluffing.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|0100191C|3:
Kindly explain how this person could possibly have
{E1D1}gained access to the key.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|0100191C|5: (Who is in charge of the key?)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|0100191C|6:
(The answer to that question should shed some light
on things.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|0100191C|8: No one could have {E1D1}gotten hold of the key after all!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|0100191C|9: Not so fast, Mr. Winner.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}There is one person...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|2:
Oh, just look at you!{E108:0010} Aren't you the cutest little
poochy-woo!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|3:
He's not just a pretty face.{E108:0010} Missile also has quite the
nose for sweet things.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|4:
It seems he's smelling something very sweet indeed...{E108:0010}
and it's coming from you.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|5:
Oh, darling,{E108:0008} you're making me blush!{E108:0010}
I'm not even wearing perfume!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|6: Then perhaps...{E108:0010} {E12F:0000000B}{E107:0002}{E284}it is the sweet stench of death.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|7: You're a regular poet,{E108:0008} aren't you?{E108:0010} I had no idea!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|8:
But if I didn't know better,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}I'd almost think you were
calling moi the killer!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|9: ...That is precisely what I'm calling you.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|12:
Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Do you realize what you're saying!?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|13:
Oh ho ho!{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Such a naughty boy!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E12F:00150006}{E1D1}How could he suspect
me,{E108:0010} hm?{E108:0018} I'm the one in charge around here!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|14: It's like we're in a murder mystery,{E108:0008} aren't we!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|16:
Sadly,{E108:0008} it is not.{E108:0010} Although I can hardly believe it
myself...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001927|17:
But this is where the evidence points.{E108:0010}
And we must trust in the evidence.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001939|0:
This piece of evidence proves that Warden Laguarde
is the killer...!{E040}{E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:0023001A}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0001}{E1D1}{E188:00340000}This proves that you are the killer.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001939|2:
It has nothing to do with me whatsoever,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}and you
know it!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001939|4:
(Missile smelled something on Warden Laguarde just
now...)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001939|5: (Whatever it was could be the key to this case.)
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001939|6:
You're a hoot, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0008} really you are.{E108:0010}
But can we dispense with the jokes now,{E108:0008} hm?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001939|7:
This is no joke,{E108:0010} {E282}Warden!{E108:0018}
You are the killer!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001939|8:
Ugh,{E108:0008} really?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Well,{E108:0008} could you at least try and present
some plausible evidence?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|3:
We had him track a sweet scent that was lingering
around Knight's body back when it was first found.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|4:
He now appears to be smelling the same scent...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}and
it's {E174:00000000}coming from you.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|5:
Oh ho ho!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00150006}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Darling,{E108:0008} you're priceless,{E108:0010} really you are!{E108:0010}
Your evidence is...{E108:0010} a whiff of suspicion?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|6: ...Verity, dear,{E108:0010} do put him in his place.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|8:
It seems Judge Gavèlle may have reached a similar
conclusion to myself.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|9:
...You believe this to be no mere coincidence,
Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|10:
I do.{E108:0010} After all,{E108:0008} she had the key.{E108:0010} And the scent found
lingering on the body is hers as well.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|11:
Were it just one or the other,{E108:0008} we might be able to
brush it off as coincidence.{E108:0010} However...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|12:
Indeed.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Then it seems a conclusion approaches.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|13:
Perhaps we should hear what the warden has to say
for herself.
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|14: We should.{E108:0010} And when we have...
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|15: ...this case will finally be at an end!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|16:
You're all being simply awful!{E108:0010}
{E280}Stop looking at me like that!
sce1_c3_04.bytes|01001943|17:
Me,{E108:0008} the killer?{E108:0010}{E12F:00150004}{E112:0015}{E108:0010}
{E12F:00150001}How could I possibly do such a thing?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|1:
Verity told me everything she knows about the case,
sweetie.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|2:
The victim died in his cell.{E108:0010} So by your logic,{E108:0008} I would've
had to have killed him {E285}there.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|3:
But how am I supposed to have moved the body?{E108:0010}
Especially as I never went into the prison.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|4:
I was too busy with work, you see.{E108:0010} I was cooped up in
my office until right before the show began.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|5:
Check if you like.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You won't find a record anywhere of
my having entered or left the prison proper.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|6:
I haven't the first idea what harebrained theories you
little scamps have cooked up,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but I'm innocent.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|7: There's simply no way I could be the killer.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|8:
Gimme a break!{E108:0010} Missile doesn't lie!{E108:0018}
{E282}Don't make it hard on everyone and just come clean!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|9:
Oh, dear...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}{E188:00310000}I'm afraid YOU are the one making things
difficult.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|10: As I just said,{E108:0008} I never went into the prison.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|11: If you think I'm lying,{E108:0008} go and check the records.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|12:
(She clearly wants us to check those records.{E108:0008}
Which means they won't help us.)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|13:
(We'll just have to find another way of getting the truth
out of her!)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029A0|14:
Please, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Stop being a big silly!{E108:0010}
You've made a boo-boo,{E108:0008} and you know it!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B0|0:
Verity told me everything she knows about the case,
sweetie.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B1|0:
The victim died in his cell. So by your logic, I would've
had to have killed him there.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B2|0:
But how am I supposed to have moved the body?
Especially as I never went into the prison.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B3|0:
I was too busy with work, you see. I was cooped up in
my office until right before the show began.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B4|0:
Check if you like. You won't find a record anywhere of
my having entered or left the prison proper.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B5|0:
(The only time Knight's body could have been placed
in the well was the night before the show...)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B5|1:
Wh-What's our move, sir?{E108:0010}
{E280}She seems awful sure of herself!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B5|2:
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E284}She seems pretty confident there won't be any
record of her entering the prison.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B5|3:
In which case,{E108:0008} we'll have to rely on something other
than the records in question.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029B5|4:
We should listen carefully to her statements again,{E108:0008} and
ask a few pertinent questions.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029BA|0:
Judge Gavèlle told you "everything"?{E108:0010}
Are you...{E108:0010} {E285}close?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029BA|1:
Thick as thieves, darling!{E108:0010}
Why do you ask?{E108:0010} {E1D1}Are you jealous?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029BA|3:
I had to ask Warden Laguarde for a lot of information
on the first day of our investigation.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029BA|4:
It seemed only right that I share some information in
return.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029BA|5:
Oh, Verity,{E108:0008} do you have to make it sound so awfully
dry!{E108:0010} I thought we had {E282}a lovely chat!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029BA|6:
Hah hah hah.{E108:0010} I simply shared the truth in our
conversation.{E108:0010} It was the least I could do.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029BA|7: (I-I'm not sure what's going on,{E108:0008} but these two...)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029C3|0:
The murder took place in his cell?{E108:0010}
You seem very happy to accept that.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029C3|1:
And why shouldn't I be?{E108:0010} It seems the most likely place
for it to have happened without drawing attention.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029C3|2: And besides,{E108:0008} they found Knight's blood in his cell.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029C3|3:
(Yes...{E108:0008} but that was from being struck by
Mr. Carcerato.)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029C3|4: (Though I needn't tell her that, I suppose.)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029C3|5:
I take it there's also been no testimony to the
contrary?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029C3|6:
What does it matter?{E108:0010} Knight being killed in his cell
doesn't go against any of the facts, anyway.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CA|0:
Do you have any evidence that you didn't enter the
prison?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|0:
So you were in your office the whole time?{E108:0010}
{E284}And you didn't notice anything unusal?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|1: No,{E108:0008} I can't say that I did.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|2: And you didn't notice anything missing?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|3: I must confess,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I'm a rather messy girl.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|4:
And a forgetful one, at that.{E108:0010} I put something down,{E108:0008} and
it's lost forever!{E108:0010} It's a curse, darling.{E108:0008} A curse!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|5:
I even lost some important evidence recently.{E108:0010} It was
gone --{E108:0008} poof! --{E108:0008} just like that!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|7:
Honestly,{E108:0008} if somebody came into my office and took
something,{E108:0008} it might be years before I noticed!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|8:
(Nnrgh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It seems like I'll need more than the power
room key to expose her.)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|9:
On the day of the murder,{E108:0008} I was working in my office.{E108:0010}
Oh,{E108:0008} and looking for something I'd misplaced.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029CC|10:
Even if I'd had a reason to go into the prison,{E108:0010} {E285}I simply
wouldn't have had the time.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029D7|0:
Sure,{E108:0008} maybe you didn't go through the main entrance
to the prison.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029D7|1: But what if you took another route?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029D7|2:
Oh, come now, sweetie.{E108:0010} Surely you don't mean {E188:00300000}that
awful,{E108:0008} filthy tunnel they discovered?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029D7|3: Why,{E108:0008} until yesterday,{E108:0008} I had no idea it even existed!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029D7|4: No.{E108:0010} You had another way in.{E108:0010} I'm certain of it.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029D7|5:
A route that didn't require going through the main
entrance or the tunnel...
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029DD|0: The route you took went through this location...!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029DE|0: This is the route you took to get into the prison!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029DE|1: It is, darling?{E108:0010} {E285}And how would that have worked?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029DE|2:
Didn't you say yourself that I didn't use the entrance
or the tunnel?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029DE|4:
(Think, Miles!{E108:0010} A route from her office that bypasses
the prison entrance and the tunnel...)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029DE|5: (There's one location that she must've gone through!)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029E4|0:
Warden Laguarde.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I'm afraid there's a contradiction in
your testimony.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029E4|4:
(I'd better think carefully before challenging her
again...)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029E9|0:
Take a look at this piece of evidence, if you will,
Warden Laguarde.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029E9|1:
Oh, sweetie,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}aren't you just adorable?{E108:0010}
{E12F:00150005}You don't need an excuse to talk to me, you know!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029E9|3:
If it's a chat and a hug you're fishing for,{E108:0008} {E1D1}all you have
to do is ask!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029E9|6:
(I could swear I saw my life flash before my eyes...{E108:0010}
I'd better try a different approach.)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F0|0: What do you make of this, Warden Laguarde?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F0|1:
What do I make of it?{E108:0010} {E12F:00150001}{E188:002F0000}Oh no, no...{E108:0010}
What do YOU make of it, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F0|2: Because I think we're probably on the same page here!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F0|4: In that we both know you're just {E1D2}{E188:00340000}wasting my time!
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F0|5:
Gnrk!{E108:0018}
(I can admit it,{E108:0008} I messed up...)
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F6|1:
Warden.{E108:0010} You took Knight from his cell and brought
him to your office...
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F6|2: ...which just happens to be connected to the yard.
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F6|3: If you had a way through the fence...
sce1_c3_05.bytes|010029F6|4:
...then you would have been able to circumvent{E108:0008} {E282}both
the entrance and the tunnel!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|0:
Hee hee!{E108:0010} A gold star for creativity, darling!{E108:0010} And how
would I have gotten through the fence, hm?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|1:
The extremely high fence.{E108:0010} Topped with razor wire.{E108:0010}
With thousands of volts of electricity going through it.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|2:
Yeah!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}How's she supposed to have gotten through that,{E108:0010} hm?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|3:
The fence's electricity supply can be cut off from the
power room.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|4:
And only you had the key, Warden!{E108:0010}
No one but you could have done it!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|5:
Utterly ridiculous.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}The power room is on the prison
side of the yard.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|6:
Warden Laguarde was on the detention center side.{E108:0010}
{E284}How would she even have reached the power room?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|7:
...Exactly, Verity, darling.{E108:0018}
Well,{E108:0008} cleverpuss?{E108:0010} {E12F:00150000}You've dug yourself a real hole now.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|9:
If there is no record of Warden Laguarde having
entered the prison proper...
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|10:
...then the idea that she could have shut off the fence
by using the breaker is out of the question.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|11:
(Arngh...!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}But there must be some way she could have
done it...!)
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|12:
Take a deep breath, big guy.{E108:0010} Lose your cool,{E108:0008} and
you've lost everything.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|13:
But if I don't find a solution,{E108:0010} she might still wriggle out
of this!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|14:
Hey.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}I said "take a deep breath,"{E108:0008} not "freak out and
completely lose your cool".
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|15:
There's nothing to be gained by banging your head
against the same wall, yeah?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|16:
(No matter how you look at it,{E108:0008} Warden Laguarde
couldn't have done it alone...)
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|19:
You aren't doing yourself any favors by {E1D1}obstructing
justice with your silence.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|21:
(But now that I've yelled it,{E108:0008} if I don't come up with an
answer,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}it's all over!)
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|22: I have one more thing to add...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:0000000B}{E285}if you'll permit me?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|23:
Something that explains how the warden could have
shut off the breaker from the wrong side of the fence?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A20|24: Yes.{E108:0010} {E12F:00000009}{E1D1}Because it's not as impossible as it seems...!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A3A|0: (What enabled her to shut off the breaker...?)
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A3B|0:
Fifi Laguagrde's position as warden of this prison was
what enabled her to shut off the power.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A3B|1:
Really?{E108:0010} You think a title and an admittedly very chic
uniform enabled me to do that?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A3B|2:
News flash, Mister!{E108:0010} Being the warden doesn't give me
{E282}telekinetic powers!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A3B|4:
(Warden Laguarde couldn't have turned off the
breaker alone...)
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A3B|6:
You are only proving the warden cannot have flipped
the breaker, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A3B|7: No,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}there was one way that she could have done it!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A43|0:
The time of the murder enabled Warden Laguarde to
shut off the power.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A43|6:
