Gnrk!{E108:0010}
(No CORRECT answer, it would seem...)
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A43|7:
(Warden Laguarde couldn't have turned off the
breaker alone...)
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A43|9:
You are only proving the warden cannot have flipped
the breaker, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A43|10: No,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}there was one way that she could have done it!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|0:
She couldn't have done it alone.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}But what if...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E284}{E12F:00000004}she wasn't alone?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|1:
Ooh,{E108:0008} now we're talking!{E108:0010}
Way to flex the old gray matter, kiddo!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|2: I believe...{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E12F:00000009}{E188:00350000}{E1D1}that Warden Laguarde had an accomplice!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|3:
Enough.{E108:0010}
You disappoint me, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|4:
Whaddaya mean!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Mr. Edgeworth has said nothing wrong!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|5:
...The inmates of this prison are all issued with
{E1D5}{E041}security bracelets{E040}.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|6:
The ones that raise the alarm if people go where
they're not supposed to--{E108:0010} {E12F:00020006}{E188:00360000}{E1D1}{E1D5}{E173:0000}{E107:0002}Ah!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|7:
I see that you have realized your error.{E108:0010}
And we are,{E108:0008} of course,{E108:0008} within the prison grounds.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|8:
Where not only are the bracelets worn,{E108:0008} but even the
guards surveil each other for signs of wrongdoing.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|9:
(And despite all that,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}no one noticed Mr. Carcerato's
escape...?)
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|10: The only ones who are free to roam...{E108:0008} are the animals.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|11:
And they most certainly could not have operated the
breaker.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|12: No.{E108:0010} {E285}So our accomplice must be human.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|13:
Then who did it,{E108:0008} {E1D1}given that it cannot have been a
prisoner or a guard?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|14:
I wouldn't be so quick to rule out either, Your Honor!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}The fact is...
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A4E|15:
There is one person.{E108:0018}{E112:0000} {E041}Someone whose movements
weren't restricted{E040}.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A5E|0:
And I have just the evidence to show who that
free-roaming person was!{E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:005C0008}{E100:0000}{E12F:00000009}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}This proves {E1D1}who that person was.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A5E|1: Would you be so good as to {E285}explain your reasoning?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A5E|3: Uh, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0010} {E280}You gonna say something?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A5E|4: I see.{E108:0010} {E1D1}So you cannot explain?{E108:0010} Very well.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A5E|6:
We're looking for somebody who was free to move
around the prison, right?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A5E|7:
Didn't we speak to someone who could do that?{E108:0010}
But who was also keeping it a secret?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A5E|8:
Yes,{E108:0010} and I have something in my possession to show
who it was to Judge Gavèlle.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A5E|9:
So it is as I thought.{E108:0010} You cannot prove the existence of
an accomplice.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|0: This is...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}one of the prisoners' bracelets.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|1:
Indeed.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E12F:0000000B}A broken bracelet belonging to a certain
self-proclaimed "model prisoner".
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|2:
What do you mean...?{E108:0010}{E152:0008000B000C}{E112:0008}
{E107:0001}{E1D5}{E1D1}And who is this prisoner?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|6:
That he was able to keep his broken bracelet hidden,{E108:0008}
and wander freely around the prison all the while?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|7: That is pretty funky...{E108:0010} and I don't mean in a good way.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|9:
It couldn't be the case that he was permitted some sort
of special leeway, could it?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|10:
Although,{E108:0008} you are in the habit of giving such leeway to
certain others.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Bodhidharma Kanis,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}for example.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|12:
Hmph.{E108:0010} In that case,{E108:0008} why don't we ask Mr. Sahwit
himself?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|13:
I'm confident he will confirm for us{E108:0008} {E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}that he and
Warden Laguarde were accomplices in this crime!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|14:
If the two of them had worked together,{E108:0008} a certain route
into the prison becomes viable.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|15:
The real route by which Knight was moved from his
cell to the prison proper!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|16: Recall that there were two big obstacles in her path.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|17: First,{E108:0008} the {E041}security camera{E040} outside Knight's cell.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|18: Second,{E108:0008} the {E041}electrified fence{E040} in the yard.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|19:
But she was able to remove both obstacles in one fell
swoop.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|20:
By having Mr. Sahwit {E283}{E173:0000}shut off the corresponding
breakers!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|21: Alright, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}you've had your fun.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|22: ...And?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Do you still deny it,{E108:0008} Warden Laguarde?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|23: *sigh*{E108:0010} No, darling.{E108:0010} You've got me.{E108:001E} {E107:0003}{E1D1}I admit it.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|25:
Sorry, Verity, honey.{E108:0010} I'm afraid it is.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D5}{E041}Frankie{E040} helped me do it.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|27: You did it, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}You got her!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|28:
Nice shooting, cowboy!{E108:0010}
{E1D5}{E12F:000A0001}She won't be wriggling out of this now!
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|29:
As Mr. Edgeworth said,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I had Frankie switch off the
breaker.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|33:
Oh, Verity, dear...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I doubt your precious Goddess {E1D1}will
want to hear my excuses now...
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|34:
She is all-merciful.{E108:0010} {E285}You have but to confess,{E108:0008} and you
shall be saved.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|35:
Oh, gosh.{E108:0008} Alright.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}I was...{E108:0018} {E1D5}{E12F:00150001}I was being threatened.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|36: I had no choice...{E108:0010} but to do {E1D2}as HE said.
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|40:
How long has it been since that AWFUL man came
here to my beautiful prison?
sce1_c3_06.bytes|01002A6A|41: I'll never forget {E1D2}the day he arrived!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|0: The moment we were alone,{E108:0008} {E1D1}he said this to me:
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|1:
You should know that I have...{E108:0008} {E188:00730000}other dogs.{E108:0010}
Dogs not confined to this fine institution.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|3:
Yes...{E108:0010} Very loyal dogs.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}Dogs who will do anything I ask
of them.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|4: Of course,{E108:0008} he wasn't talking about real {E041}dogs{E040}.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|5: He was talking about his very {E188:00310000}{E1D1}{E041}human cronies{E040}.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|6: And then,{E108:0008} {E1D1}he said one last thing.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|7:
I would recommend that you {E188:00730000}take care in how you
treat me during my stay here...
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|8:
I wouldn't want to have to set my dogs on you.{E108:0010}
{E281}Or your precious "family"...
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|10:
I gave him that cell.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I gave him everything he asked for.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|11:
Everything...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E12F:00000009}{E1D1}Wait,{E108:0018} {E283}is that how he became the {E041}fixer{E040}!?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|12:
Yes, darling.{E108:0010} I obeyed his every command,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}and
smuggled in for him all that he wanted.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|13:
Eventually,{E108:0008} I brought dear, sweet Frankie into our little
conspiracy.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|14:
He agreed right away, of course,{E108:0008} because I made
things...{E108:0010} easier for him, too.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|15:
So you were smuggling in contraband?{E108:0018}
How, exactly?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|16:
Once a week,{E108:0008} {E137:002B0007}late at night,{E108:0008} Frankie would shut off the
breakers.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|17:
That allowed me to go from my office into the yard
without being seen by the cameras.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|18:
Then I simply dropped the packages down the well on
the prison side and went back through the fence.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|19:
Each one of them spritzed...{E108:0008} {E284}with a little of my
perfume.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|20: So that's what the sweet smell was.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|21: Yes.{E108:0010}{E1CD} {E285}It was a signal for Kanis's dog.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|22:
When he picked up the scent,{E1CB:002F00000000}{E108:0008} he would fetch the
packages and bring them back to his master.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|23:
We had to make sure Rocco wasn't in his cell at the
time, of course.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|24: Can't have been easy keeping him from finding out.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|25:
Oh, we're all very much creatures of habit here at the
prison, darling.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|26:
Everything runs to a schedule --{E108:0010} meals,{E108:0008} exercise hours,{E108:0008}
that sort of thing.{E108:0010} We knew when he wasn't there.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|27:
And that adorable little bear of his freezes with fright
at the sight of Kanis's dog,{E108:0008} poor thing.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|28: So there was no risk of him raising the alarm, either.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|29:
(She has oversight over everything here at the prison.{E108:0010}
Which made her the perfect mule.)
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|30: (With her on his side,{E108:0008} Kanis couldn't fail...)
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|31:
Frankie would sneak out again early in the morning to
switch the breakers back on,{E108:0008} and our work was done.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|32:
Apart from fixing the timecodes on the cameras,{E108:0008} which
I would do later, when I got the chance.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|33: You have shared a great deal, Warden.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|34:
The Goddess of Justice will surely take your honesty
into account.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|35:
I've been the most dreadful fool,{E108:0008} I know I have.{E108:0010}
{E280}I'm supposed to be the one in charge!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|36:
The day of Knight's murder was also {E1D2}one of our
delivery days.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|37:
And so,{E108:0008} Frankie, bless his heart,{E108:0008} did his usual work
with the breakers.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|38:
But there was no package for me to deliver that day,{E108:0008}
so I didn't go out into the yard.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|39:
(So that's {E041}the secret behind the fixer's system{E042}.{E108:0010}
And why she was...)
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|40:
The police have been trying to track down his
accomplices for the longest time.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|41: Even I've had to lend them a hand myself, you know.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|42:
Heaven knows how many times I've hauled the
secretive scoundrel into my office to talk to me.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|43:
But no matter what I say,{E108:0008} or how much evidence I
present him with,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}he simply won't say a word!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|44:
That's why you were interrogating Mr. Kanis over and
over...
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|45:
Exactly.{E108:0010} {E282}{E12F:00150008}I was trying to track down those horrible
henchpeople of his.

I borrowed everything the police had on that {E1D1}rotten
scoundrel!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|47:
I watched his every move!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}Intercepted every letter he wrote!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|48:
(His letters...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Then I suppose she must know about {E188:00300000}{E1D5}his
{E041}correspondence chess{E042} games, too...)
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|49:
But no matter what I did,{E108:0008} {E1D2}{E281}I couldn't turn up any clues

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|50:
Living in fear like this,{E108:0008} it's...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Oh, you just can't comprehend it...!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|51: As you have {E1D1}just heard for yourself, Mr. Edgeworth...
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|52:
...the words of Warden Laguarde's confessions have
cleansed her of all suspicion.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AA0|53: Surely there is no need to hound her any longer?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AD6|0:
(Has she really been cleared of all suspicion, though?{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AD7|0:
You're right.{E108:0010} It sounds like Warden Laguarde has been
through enough.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AD7|2: I thought she was the real killer!?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AD7|3:
This isn't like you, sir!{E108:0010} Letting a perp go free?{E108:0018}
It's just not...{E108:0010} {E282}prosecutorial!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AD7|5:
(I do still have my doubts about what the warden told
us...)
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002AD7|6: (I can't give up the chase now!)
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|0:
I'm sorry, Your Honor,{E108:0010} {E1D1}but this conversation isn't over
yet.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|1: And I think the Goddess of Justice...{E108:0008} {E285}would agree.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|2:
So you mean to make her suffer even more than she

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|3: Unfortunately,{E108:0008} her suffering under Mr. Kanis...
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|4:
...does nothing to prove her innocence in Knight's
murder.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|5:
She admitted herself that she knew of,{E108:0008} and even
facilitated,{E108:0008} {E1D5}the so-called {E041}fixer{E040}'s delivery route.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|6:
I believe she used that same route to move Knight's
body!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|7: And where is your evidence, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|8: It's in the fact that {E285}the {E041}sweet smell{E040} on Knight's body...
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|9:
...is {E188:00200000}{E1D1}{E1D5}the {E041}exact same scent{E040} Warden Laguarde uses to

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|10: What do you make of that?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|12:
...we've done it so many times by now that {E285}the whole
well probably smells of it.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|13: Some of it must have just...{E108:0008} rubbed off on his body.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|14:
That does match the statement that Mr. Carcerato
provided.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|15:
A smell.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Yeah,{E108:0008} always smelled kinda...{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}nice down there.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|17: Gee, I don't know.{E108:0010} Smelled sorta like {E1D5}{E041}dessert{E040}, I guess.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|18:
His words would seem to suggest that the smell had
permeated the well.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|20: You've been rendered speechless, I see.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|21:
Then I hereby move to adjourn this session of the
court.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|23: (What CAN I do?{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}Is this as far as we go...?)
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|25: Yes, Eustace.{E108:0010} It seems we are.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|26: By the power vested in me,{E108:0008} this court is adjourned!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|28: C'mon, Judge G,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}things were just getting good.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|30: Are you objecting to my adjourning this session?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|31:
Heh heh!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}No, no, no.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Woulda shouted "OBJECTION!"
if I wanted to do that.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|32:
You do you, G.{E108:0010} Adjourn,{E108:0008} don't adjourn --{E108:0008} whatever
floats your boat.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|34:
Don't worry about what I'm doing.{E108:0010} Let's all just take
a chill pill, shall we?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|35:

Anyone?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|36:
...Are you trying to get yourself charged with contempt

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|37:

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|38: As Simeon Saint's lawyer, that is.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|39:
Ah, yes.{E108:0010} I had forgotten that you were his real

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|40:
How could you!?{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|41:

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|42:

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|43:
Work, you say?{E108:0010} ...Somehow,{E108:0008} {E285}I don't believe you've

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|44:
Then let's say this is me doing some prep work for

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|45:
Now?{E108:0018}
Amusing, but...{E108:0008} what is there left to ask?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|46:
I've got a feeling in my funny bone that Feefs here{E108:0008} {E284}has
something more to tell us about the killer.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|48:
Yes, indeed.{E108:0010} {E1D5}{E174:00010001}See,{E108:0008} as a major player on Team Simeon,{E108:0008}
I can spot a sympathizer when I see one.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|49:
And you don't think he did it, do you?{E108:0018}
So tell us,{E108:0010} {E1D5}who did?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|50: C'mon,{E108:0008} spill the beans.{E108:0010} We're all ears!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|53:
...He's trying to coax Warden Laguarde into giving
something away.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|54:
Ask yourself:{E108:0008} Why would she go to all the trouble of

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|55: It's because she wanted to frame Mr. Kanis.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|57:
If he was convicted of committing murder here,{E108:0008} that

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|59: And where he'd be out of her hair forever, huh!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|60: Precisely.{E108:0010} She saw her opportunity and seized it!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|61: Nonono!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Saint can't NOT be the killer!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|62: That's not fair!{E108:0018} {E1D1}I was all ready to {E1D1}prosecute him!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|63:

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|64:
Heh heh!{E108:0010} Nice!{E108:0010} {E285}{E12F:00020008}Now Mr. Winner has to go along with

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|67: Of course!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}How could I refuse this {E1D2}silver-tongued devil!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|68: Eddiekins!{E108:0010} You have such a way with words!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|70:
Besides,{E108:0010} {E285}one can't tell the truth without telling the
whole truth, can one?
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|71:
I'm simply DYING to tell all, Verity, darling!{E108:0010}
DO say you'll let me!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|73: I can't believe you pulled that off, {E1D1}Mr. Fender!
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|75: Thank you for the timely intervention.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|76:
Hey,{E108:0008} it's the least I could do.{E108:0010} Kay's not wrong.{E108:0010} I've
been leaning on you hard.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}And besides...
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|77:
"The defense never rests"{E040},{E108:0010} {E107:0002}amirite?{E108:0010}
Simeon's depending on us.
sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|78:
Sadly,{E108:0008} I think I just about exhausted my reserves of

sce1_c3_07.bytes|01002ADE|79:
Which means you're up to bat,{E108:0008} Miles McSmiles.{E108:0010}
Show 'em that "never rest" spirit!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|1:
I really don't think anyone could've done it {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}but that
dreadful man Kanis.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|2:
There's no telling what went on between him and the

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|3:
Perhaps he simply took a disliking to him.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}He's certainly the type.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|4:
But whatever the sordid details,{E108:0008} it was him.{E108:0010}
He stabbed that poor man to death.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|5:
And then he had his dog dispose of the body.{E108:0010}
That simply HAS to be what happened.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|7: I did him {E1D1}the most terrible disservice!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|9: ...{E108:0008}{E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}I suppose you could put it that way.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|10:
If I weren't such a sorry excuse for a warden,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}this

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BA0|11:
And that's why...{E108:0010} {E1D1}that's why I have to clean up this

Warden Laguarde...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}As ever,{E108:0008} your honesty is truly to

I am certain Mr. Knight is {E188:00300000}{E1D1}looking down and weeping

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB0|0:
I really don't think anyone could've done it but that
dreadful man Kanis.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB1|0:
There's no telling what went on between him and the
victim.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB2|0:
Perhaps he simply took a disliking to him.

But whatever the sordid details, it was him.

I expect Kanis used the chisel that was hidden in that

(Warden Laguarde's testimony is little more than a

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB7|1:
(I just need to push her on the right statement to
bring it all tumbling down.)

You seem very confident in your assertion.{E108:0010}
Why is that?
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB9|1:
Because all the other children in my little home are
absolute sweethearts!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB9|2:
They have faith in themselves,{E108:0008} and in one another.{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB9|3:
And they work hard every day to better themselves.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}None of them would dare commit murder.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB9|4:
That's a very touching reason indeed.{E108:0010}
(And I don't believe a word of it.)
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BB9|5:
But Kanis?{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}Ooh,{E108:0008} he's rotten to the core!{E108:0010}

Knight was being kept in a holding cell,{E108:0008} while
Mr. Kanis was in the prison proper.

What could possibly have happened between them

Prisons aren't as big as they seem, you know.{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BBF|4:

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BC5|2:
As I said,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}there's no telling what really went on

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BC5|3:
You're so awfully serious, aren't you?{E108:0010}
Not that I mind, of course...
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BC5|4: (Wh-Why is she looking at me...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}like that...!?)
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BC5|5:
So noble!{E108:0010} So dashing in that marvelous suit!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}So clever!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BC5|6:
I can feel myself becoming your biggest fan, darling!{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BC5|9:
Nnrgh...{E108:0010}
(I wasn't prepared for that mental onslaught...)
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|0:
What more can you tell us about those "sordid
details"?

Well,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}we all know what Kanis once did for a "living".{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|2:
Especially as the victim was already injured.{E108:0010}
His neck, I think?
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|3:
Couldn't turn his head to the right, poor dear.{E108:0010} That's

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|4:
(They must make some sort of report for the warden
when new prisoners are admitted...)
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|5:
...You seem keen for us to think you didn't know much

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|6:

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|7:
I expect Kanis used {E188:00300000}{E1D5}the chisel that was hidden in that

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|8:
Just imagine.{E108:0010} The man probably didn't even have time

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|9:

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|10:

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|11:

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BCF|13:

Of course we can talk about them some more.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|0:

body down the well?

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|3:
You mean, he brought someone in from outside the
prison to help him commit the crime!?
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|4:

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|5:
But he's the so-called {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}"fixer", no?{E108:0010}
Exercise that fabulous brain of yours a little.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|6:
How hard would it be for him to recruit a "dog" on the
inside?{E108:0010} Or even plant one?
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|7:
Interesting.{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|8:
Well, if I knew that,{E108:0008} my life would be so much easier
now, wouldn't it?
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|9:
Anyway,{E108:0008} it was just a little thought.{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BDD|10:
(She's a slippery one.{E108:0010} I'm not going to be able to catch
her with this line of questioning, it seems...)

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BE8|1:
Why,{E108:0008} the one the victim brought in, sweetie!{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BE8|2:
The victim was a certified chess fanatic,{E108:0008} or so I'm led

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BE8|3:
But the naughty boy {E284}snuck a chisel inside it!{E108:0010}

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BE8|4:
(How does she know about {E1D5}the chisel in the chess
set?)

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BE8|6:
(After all,{E108:0008} we only learned about it thanks to {E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}certain

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BE8|8:
Of course,{E108:0008} in the hands of a killer like Kanis,{E108:0008} {E188:00360000}{E1D1}even a

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF1|0:
You seem to have very strong feelings about
Mr. Kanis.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF1|1:
W-Well...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Of course I do!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I told you what he said to me!{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}And what an absolute menace he was to interrogate!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF1|2: He could slither out of anything,{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}the snake!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF1|3: He sounds as tough as a rock.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF1|4:
And that INFURIATING self-satisfied look on his face

sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF1|5: AAAH!{E108:0018} My blood boils just thinking about it!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF1|6: (I certainly don't blame her on that count...)
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF8|0:
Warden Laguarde.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I'm afraid there's a contradiction in
your testimony.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BF8|4:
(I'd better think carefully before challenging her
again...)
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BFD|0:
Take a look at this piece of evidence, if you will,
Warden Laguarde.
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BFD|1:
Oh, sweetie,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}aren't you just adorable?{E108:0010}
{E12F:00150005}You don't need an excuse to talk to me, you know!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BFD|3:
If it's a chat and a hug you're fishing for,{E108:0008} {E1D1}all you have
to do is ask!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002BFD|6:
(I could swear I saw my life flash before my eyes...{E108:0010}
I'd better try a different approach.)
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002C04|0: What do you make of this, Warden Laguarde?
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002C04|1:
What do I make of it?{E108:0010} {E12F:00150001}{E188:002F0000}Oh no, no...{E108:0010}
What do YOU make of it, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002C04|2: Because I think we're probably on the same page here!
sce1_c3_08.bytes|01002C04|4: In that we both know you're just {E1D2}{E188:00340000}wasting my time!

Gnrk!{E108:0018}

Oh, umm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Sorry, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
{E282}It's a trade secret!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003305|0:
*shudder*{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The sight of that dog sends shivers down
my spine, Mr. Edgeworth...
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003305|3: I'm scared of cops,{E108:0008} {E1D1}guards,{E108:0008} {E1D1}sirens...{E108:0010} {E1D1}All kinds of stuff!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003305|4: The very things that assuage most people's fears.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003305|5: Yeah, well...{E108:0010} I'm not most people!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003305|7: Let me guess,{E108:0010} {E285}"the Great Thief Yatagarasu"?
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003305|9:
Heh,{E108:0010} I see now why you do it.{E108:0010} That was rather
satisfying, I must admit.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|0: You know what I think, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|1:
If the murder weapon can't be found...{E108:0010} {E285}then maybe
there wasn't one to begin with!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|2: Well.{E108:0010} That's certainly an interesting suggestion.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|3: But then{E108:0008} {E284}how did our victim meet his end?
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|5: If there's no murder weapon,{E108:0008} there's no murder, right?
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|7:
We cannot ignore the facts in front of us,{E108:0008} no matter
how much we might wish to.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|8: You're right...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I know Mr. Knight's dead...
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|9: But I know something else, too!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100330F|10:
We're going to find out who killed him,{E108:0008} if it's the last
thing we do!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100331A|0:
The horrible moment of the murder!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00020009}...Or so we thought.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100331A|1: In the end,{E108:0008} it was just Mr. Carcerato and Teddy, huh.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100331A|2:
Which means that unfortunately,{E108:0008} it wasn't the
conclusive proof we'd hoped for.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100331A|3:
However,{E108:0008} we did learn that the time stamp on the
footage is off by three hours.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100331A|4:
But why would the security cameras have been off for
all that time?
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100331A|5: I bet it was just a blackout.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003321|0: So can a metal detector find any kind of metal?
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003321|1: I imagine so,{E108:0008} if it's one of those high-spec models.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003321|2:
I have heard that some metals can be harder to detect
than others, though.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003321|6:
Thanks, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}You're just a treasure trove of
information!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003321|7:
(I hope I haven't just helped further a Great Thief's
career...)
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003329|0: Doesn't the sight of a well just set your heart racing?
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003329|1: It could be a secret passage,{E108:0008} it could be haunted...
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003329|2: I fear you've been watching too much television.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003329|3:
Anyway,{E108:0008} more importantly than that,{E108:0008} do you have any
thoughts about Mr. Saint's trick?
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003329|4:
I do indeed!{E108:0010} The only thing more exciting than a well...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}is a well fitted with a cool contraption!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100332F|0: Hey, I'm a Great Thief.{E108:0010} I totally sympathize.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100332F|1:
If you feel you gotta grab something,{E108:0008} you should just
go ahead and grab it.{E108:0010} Even if it's worthless.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|0100332F|2:
(She doesn't seem to think much of my little
"treasure"...)
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003332|0:
Alright, sir,{E108:0008} {E1D1}lemme explain how the metal detector
works!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003332|1:
It lets you know how close or far away I am from a
metallic object through its beeps and fancy gauge.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003332|3: The closer I get,{E108:0008} the wilder it goes.
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003332|4:
And when it starts going nuts,{E108:0008} {E282}it's time to {E041}Examine{E040} that
spot!
sce1_c3_partner.bytes|01003332|5:
No need to get your hands dirty though, sir.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}You just stand there and tell me what to do!
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|0:
Well, Fender?{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}Are you finally going to tell me what we're doing here?
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|1:
Why have you brought me to an art gallery, of
all places?
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|3:
Seemed like the perfect chance to come and enjoy the
magic of star sign stuff together.
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|6:
You know about the {E284}{E041}IS-7 Incident{E040}, yeah?{E108:0010}
Your old man's last case?
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|7:
Of course...{E108:0010} Von Karma took great pleasure in showing
me the files as soon as I became a prosecutor.
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|8:
And I reviewed them again last night after your invite.{E108:0010}
See?
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|9:
I...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}{E1D1}was also present at the trial all those years ago.{E108:0010}
Although my memories of it are somewhat hazy...
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|10:
(As a child,{E108:0008} I was completely in awe of my father.{E108:0010}
The sight of him in court was inspirational.)
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|11:
(Gregory Edgeworth,{E108:0008} attorney at law.{E108:0018}
And opposite him...)
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|12:
(...the man who would become my mentor --{E108:0008} Manfred
von Karma.{E108:0010} It was quite a case.)
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|13:
(However,{E108:0008} it ended with the conviction of the
accused...)
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|14:
Ah...{E108:0010} So you were there, too?{E108:0010} You were in the
courtroom for Gregory's final outing?
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|15:
Well,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}that'll make explaining things easier.{E108:0020}{E12F:000A0000}
{E107:0002}I wanted you to know something, see.
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|16:
That something being what really went down.{E108:0010}
Not the "truth" in those files,{E108:0010} {E107:0003}but the capital T truth.
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|17:
It was eighteen years ago,{E108:0008} smack dab in the middle of
a real doozy of a winter...
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|18:
The buildings were covered with a blanket of snow.{E108:0010}
It looked like the streets were lined with popsicles.
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|19:
But things weren't so innocent behind those frozen
doors.{E108:0010} In fact,{E108:0008} some pretty sordid stuff went down.
sce2_c0_01.bytes|02000081|20:
This was back before yours truly was the fine figure of
an attorney you see before you today...
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|1:
Hey, Mr. E.{E108:0018}
This one really came out of the blue, huh?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|2:
It did.{E108:0010} We were called in before the ink on the arrest
papers was even dry.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|3:
My name is Gregory Edgeworth.{E108:0018}
I'm a defense attorney.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|4:
I'm here visiting a client with my assistant,{E108:0008} Eddie
Fender.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|5:
A murder on Christmas Eve?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}What's the world coming to!?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|6:
In the daaark of the niiight,{E108:0008} {E1D1}at the end of the daaay,{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I saw two timely saviors{E108:0008} {E1D2}a-comin' my waaay!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|7:
Welcome, my friends,{E108:0008} {E1D2}to the visitor's rooom,{E108:0010}
{E1D1}And if we're not friends yet,{E108:0008} I'm sure we will be {E1D2}sooon!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|11:
Sorry if I surprised you.{E108:0010}
I'm just so happy to see you both.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000100|12:
Thanks so much for coming out!{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Seriously,{E108:0008} I can't thank you enough!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|0: You're the accused, I take it?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|2: Gregory Edgeworth,{E108:0008} attorney at law,{E108:0010} at your service.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|3: I look forward to representing you.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|4: This is my assistant,{E108:0008} Eddie Fender.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|6: I, uh...{E108:0008} I'll do, umm...{E108:0010} {E280}everything I can to help!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|7:
Come now, Edward.{E108:0010} Calm down, please.{E108:0020}{E12F:00050000}
...You'll have to forgive him.{E108:0008} He's still new to this.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|8:
He's been helping me out part-time.{E108:0010} But he's far from
fully fledged lawyer material yet.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|9:
Nonetheless,{E108:0008} I'm hoping he'll be of some assistance in
investigating the particulars of this case.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|10:
Gregory and Eddie.{E108:0018}
{E12F:001B0001}{E1D1}It's an honor to meet you both.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|11:
(My job as a defense attorney is to save my clients
from wrongful convictions.)
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200010D|12:
(So the first thing to do is {E1D1}establish whether or not he
is truly innocent.)
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200011A|0:
Perhaps we could begin by having you tell us a little
about yourself.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200011A|1: What am I thinking?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I haven't even told you my name.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200011A|4: Samson Tangaroa,{E108:0008} the world's greatest confectioner!?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200011A|5: You flatter me, my young friend.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200011A|6: And call me Samson.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}All my pals do.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200011A|7:
Wooow!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}Thanks, Samson!{E108:0010} I will!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}I can't believe I'm meeting you in person!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200011A|8: (It seems Eddie knows something of our client...)
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200011A|9:
Mr. E!{E108:0010} Mr. E!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}It's THE Samson Tangaroa!{E108:0010} The singing,{E108:0008}
dancing,{E108:0008} confectionery-making sensation!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200012D|0:
No waaay!{E108:0018} I got to sing with Samson Tangaroa!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}This is a dream come true!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200012D|1:
Heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Thanks, little pal.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}It means a lot to hear you say that.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200012D|2:
...My apologies,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}but I think we need to discuss
the matter at hand.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200012D|3: Of course.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I'm sure you're both very busy.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200012D|4: Alright,{E108:0008} where would you like me to start?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000132|0:
So you're not just a confectioner,{E108:0008} but also a singer and
a dancer?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000132|1:
I sure am!{E108:0010} When I'm having fun,{E108:0008} my body just starts
moving.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000132|2: You must really enjoy making desserts.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000132|3: Ha ha...{E108:0010} {E1D1}Wouldn't be much of a confectioner if I didn't.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000132|4: I live to make sweets that will bring joy to others.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000132|5: Hey,{E108:0010} they're not just "things"!{E108:0018} They're works of art!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000132|6:
Sparkling,{E108:0010} dazzling,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}mouth-watering creations!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}The stuff that dreams are made of!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000132|7:
(So he aims to create joyous and inspirational pieces,
does he...?)
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|0:
I understand that the incident in question happened at
your mansion?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|2:
We were holding an international confectionery
contest there when...
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|3: ...a body was found inside one of my creations.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|4: I-Inside one of your--!?{E108:0018} No way!
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|5:
The detective in charge placed me under arrest
because of it,{E108:0008} and now,{E108:0008} here I am.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|6: But I could never take a life.{E108:0010} Never.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|7:
I'm sure the police will see that too in time.{E108:0010}
They'll realize their mistake.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|9: Hmm...{E108:0018} {E12F:00050004}{E107:0002}And what can you tell us about the victim?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200013A|11: He was taking part in the contest.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000146|0:
Mr. Frost was a wonderful confectioner.{E108:0010}
His creations were things of real beauty.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000146|1:
I just don't understand...{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Why did he have to die...!?
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000146|3: (He seems genuinely upset over the victim's death...)
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014A|0: Thank you for agreeing to represent me.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014A|1:
...The scales on my badge mean something,
Mr. Tangaroa.{E108:0010} They represent justice and fairness.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014A|2:
We'll see to it that you get a fair trial.{E108:0010}
And if you're innocent,{E108:0008} you will walk free.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014A|3:
But until then,{E108:0008} I'm going to need you to sit tight and
trust me.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014A|4:
I will.{E108:0010} I do.{E108:0018}
Thank you.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014F|0: ...I'm not sure I see anything out of the ordinary.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014F|1:
(Mr. Tangaroa is exhausted from the interrogation.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}I should try to avoid causing him unnecessary stress.)
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014F|2: Actually,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}don't worry about it.{E108:0010} It's not important.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014F|3: In fact,{E108:0008} you can just forget about it entirely.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|0200014F|4:
I'll try...{E108:0010} But you've worried me a little, I have to
confess...
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|0: (I think I have a pretty good measure of the man now.)
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|1:
Mr. Tangaroa,{E108:0010} there's just one last thing I need to
confirm with you.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|3: Correct.{E108:0010} I swear to you I didn't do it.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|4: Like I told you,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I could never take a life.{E108:0010} Never.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|6: Alright.{E108:0010} I'm going to take you at your word.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|7: Thank you for being so forthright with me.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|8:
Likewise.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It's good to talk to somebody other than
those detectives.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|9:
We'll head to the scene of the crime and see what we
can learn.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|10:
...We'll be in touch when we have something more to
tell you.
sce2_c0_02.bytes|02000154|11:
G'bye, Gregory.{E108:0010}{E13E:001D}{E108:0018} {E150:001D001E}G'bye, Eddie.{E13E:001D}{E108:0018}
{E150:001D0018}I'm counting on you both!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|1:
Brrr!{E108:0010} It's pretty cold out there, huh, Mr. E?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I never saw so much snow!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|2:
Yes.{E108:0010} And it doesn't seem like it will be letting up
anytime soon.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|3:
But just look at this place!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E280}What a sweet house Samson's got!{E108:0010} It's huge!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|4:
Yes.{E108:0010} Big enough to hold an international confectionery
contest, no less.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|5:
Welcome,{E108:0008} welcome, everyonnne!{E108:0010}{E155:000500000001}{E155:002000000001}
Come on in,{E108:0008} we'll have us some funnn!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|9:
Would you happen to be Mr. Gregory Edgeworth, by
any chance?
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|10: I would.{E150:0005002E}{E108:0010} {E107:0003}It's a pleasure to meet you.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|11: I'm Eddie Fender,{E108:0010} Mr. Edgeworth's assistant!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000180|12:
Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0008} {E150:001F0003}Mr. Fender.{E108:0010}{E150:001F0020}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Welcome to our humble abode.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|0200018D|0:
Judy Bound.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}It's an honor to meet you both.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|0200018D|1:
I'm the housekeeper here.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}And Mr. Tangaroa's assistant.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|0200018D|2:
Y-You're no housekeeper!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You're Judy Bound!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}THE Judy Bound!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|0200018D|3: You know a little something of my work?
sce2_c0_03.bytes|0200018D|4: A little!?{E108:0018} I watch you on TV every chance I get!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|0200018D|6:
Hee hee.{E108:0010} {E1D1}It's very kind of you to say so.{E108:0010}
We'd be nothing without our fans!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|0200018D|8:
It's only the biggest show on TV!{E108:0018}
Every kid on the planet loves it!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|0200018D|9:
The dynamic duo of Samson and Judy make delicious
sweet stuff --{E108:0010} {E107:0001}all while singing and dancing!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000198|1: Heh heh!{E108:0018} {E1D1}I dance along every time I watch the show!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000198|2:
............
{E107:0002}{E284}(Perhaps Miles might enjoy it, too?{E108:0010} I'll suggest it later.)
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000198|3: But all this dancing really takes it out of a guy.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000198|4: Oh!{E108:0018} I'm so sorry!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'm the world's worst hostess!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|02000198|5:
Here.{E108:0010} Nothing relaxes the body and mind quite like a
cup of tea.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|1:
Its citrus aroma is said to improve one's ability to
concentrate, as I recall.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|2:
Interesting...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}So this is what Ceylon tea tastes like, huh?
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|4:
Yes,{E108:0008} it's so that the tea cools down more quickly, I'm
afraid.{E108:0010} Some of our guests don't like it too hot.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|5:
I see...{E108:0018} {E12F:00050004}{E107:0002}These teacups are very unique, too.{E108:0010}
The design is really something.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|6: You think so?{E108:0018} {E1D1}Thank you so much!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|7:
I ordered them all the way from France!{E108:0010}
They're my absolute favorite!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|8:
They were designed by a marvelous sculptor named
Paul Halique.{E108:0010} Have you heard of him?
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|9: He makes the most amazing tableware in the world!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|10: ...You're clearly a big fan of his work.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|11: Oh, I am!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}These teacups are my greatest treasure!
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|12:
(She's certainly not afraid to show when she's
passionate about something.)
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|13:
If you don't mind, Ms. Bound...{E108:0010} I'd like to move on to
the reason we're here.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|14:
Can you tell us everything you know about the
unfortunate incident that occurred earlier?
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|15:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Of course.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'm sorry for getting so distracted.{E108:0010}
...I guess I'm still in shock.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|16: Because I'm the one who found the body, you see.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|18:
Is it true that the body was recovered from inside one
of Mr. Tangaroa's creations?
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|19:
It is...{E108:0010} We were in the middle of the contest's final
judgment phase when...
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|20:
...I heard the sound of something big collapsing coming
from Samson's room.
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|23:
I opened the door and went inside and...{E108:0010} there was 
{E1D1}Mr. Frost's body...
sce2_c0_03.bytes|020001A7|24:

sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004D9|9: (Perhaps you should ask a straight question...)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|1: What were you and Mr. Gusto {E12F:00050004}talking about earlier?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|2:
I was going to ask about the piece on the wall here...{E108:0010}
The one in the frame.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|4:
Thought I'd better ask somebody...{E108:0008} who knows about
this stuff.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|5:
...But then you bozos showed up,{E108:0008} and pulled me away
from my very important work...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|6: Perhaps we can take a closer look at it together.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|8: Mr. Gusto,{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}would you mind helping us out?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|9: Of course.{E108:0010} Confectionery is my life.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|10:
If you have any questions,{E108:0008} I'll be happy to answer
them.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004E3|11: Thank you.{E108:0010} {E1D1}That's very kind of you.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004EF|0:
I must scour the scene and inspect anything that
catches my attention.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F0|0: I don't believe there is any more to be found here.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F1|0:
I must scour the scene and inspect anything that
catches my attention.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|0:
Who knew you could make a picture this pretty out of
chocolate?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|1: Samson really is a god among men!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|2:
...Is it really made of chocolate, though?{E108:0010}
It looks far too much like a regular illustration to me.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|3: You have a good eye.{E108:0010} I'm impressed!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|4: That's no piece of candy.{E108:0010} That's the {E041}ultimate cookbook{E040}.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|5:
The {E041}ultimate cookbook{E040}...{E108:0010}
In other words,{E108:0008} the grand prize.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|6: What!?{E108:0018} So it's not made of chocolate after all!?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|7: No.{E108:0010} The book is simply enframed in some.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|8:
Tangaroa showed it to all of us when he gathered us
here to explain the rules.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|9:
(So the participants knew that the grand prize was in
this room the whole time...)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|10:
Anyway...{E108:0008} you see it too, right?{E108:0010}
The frame...{E108:0010} something's missing...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004F3|11:
(Ah,{E108:0008} the oddity Detective Badd was going to ask
Mr. Gusto about earlier...{E108:0008} Yes...)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004FF|0:
The picture is not made of chocolate.{E108:0010}
It's the cover of a book.{E108:0010} The {E041}ultimate cookbook{E040}.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004FF|1:
The {E041}ultimate cookbook{E040}...{E108:0010}
In other words,{E108:0008} the grand prize.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004FF|3:
Tangaroa showed it to all of us when he gathered us
here to explain the rules.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|020004FF|4:
(So the participants knew that the grand prize was in
this room the whole time...)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000504|1:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}...But we don't know whose yet.{E108:0010}
...Still haven't figured it out.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000504|3:
(Finger marks without prints...{E108:0018}
They could certainly be important to the case.)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000504|4:
Frame Finger Marks added
to the Court Record.{E106}{E1CF}{E100:0000}{E101:001E000B}{E107:0003}Hmm...{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E282}It's a real head-scratcher, alright!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000504|5: Not really...{E108:0010} I'm guessing whoever it was wore gloves.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000504|6: Aww,{E108:0008} where's your sense of romance?{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Of adventure?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000504|7:
(There doesn't tend to be much of either at a crime
scene, Eddie...)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200050D|0:
You're right, Detective.{E108:0010} {E285}Something IS missing
from this frame.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000510|0:
(I'd better show Eddie which part of the frame is
missing some chocolate.)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000511|0:
Look closely, Eddie.{E108:0010} Don't you feel that something is
lacking here?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000511|2: And maybe that's just...{E108:0008} an artistic flourish, you know?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000511|3:
(...My glasses must have slipped.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}That's not the part I meant to point out.)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000511|4:
You, uh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}were talking about something being missing
from the frame, right?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000511|5:
That's right.{E108:0010} And you don't need to know anything
about art to see what it is.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000517|0:
Look at the decorative work in the corner here.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Something's missing, no?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000517|1: Oh, yeah!{E108:0018} It's different from the other side!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000517|2:
Hmm...{E108:0010} That's not like Tangaroa.{E108:0010}
The balance is all wrong.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000517|5:
...Every confection in this room is missing some small
bit...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000517|6:
You're right...!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The candle holder,{E108:0008} the nautical stuff...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}They're all like that!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200051F|1:
Or...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}did Tangaroa just want it to look like somebody
messed with his work...?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200051F|2: He'd never do that to his own creations!{E108:0018} Never!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200051F|3: (Could this have some deeper meaning for the case...?)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000523|0:
It's a journal...{E108:0008} belonging to the captain of the
chocolate ship...{E108:0010} Also made of chocolate...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000523|1:
"A Diary of Despair".{E108:0018}
That's some title...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000523|2:
"Come,{E108:0008} hearken,{E108:0008} see how we crossed the sea,{E108:0010}
And rode the red tide to misery..."
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000523|3: Quite a jaunty rhyme for such a tragic-sounding tale...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000527|1: There's a title here...{E108:0010} "The Light of Life"...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000527|2:
(Well, this particular light seems to be missing one of
its life-giving flames.)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000527|3:
(Does it have some sort of symbolic meaning?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Or could it be...?)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200052B|1:
Yeah...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}And before you start prodding it...{E108:0008} {E285}it's not
made of chocolate.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200052B|2:
Push it and bells will start ringing...{E108:0008} people will come
running from the security room...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200052B|3:
A whole buncha hassle...{E108:0010}
So don't.{E108:0010} I know you want to...{E108:0008} but don't.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200052B|4: Honestly,{E108:0008} the thought hadn't even crossed my mind.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200052B|6:
(What does being an attorney have to do with
anything...?)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000532|0: This must be the title of this piece...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000532|2:
Really gets you thinking, huh?{E108:0010}
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}I think I'm a fan!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000532|4:
I'm especially fond of it myself.{E108:0010}
Simply captivating.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000532|5: Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018} Mr. Gusto praised me!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000532|6:
Now, now, Eddie.{E108:0010} Don't make this into a {E284}thorny issue
by bragging about it.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000532|8:
Was that...{E108:0010} a dad joke, Mr. Edgeworth!?{E108:0010}
I'd better make note of this momentous occasion!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000532|9: (...Where did I make a joke,{E108:0008} dad or otherwise?)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200053C|0:
These controls can be used to adjust the room's
temperature and lighting.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200053C|1:
Red,{E108:0008} yellow,{E108:0008} green,{E108:0008} dark blue,{E108:0008} light blue{E108:0008}, white...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}That's a huge range!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200053C|2:
Temperature's set to 59 degrees...{E108:0010}
Light color's set to white.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200053C|3:
The pieces in here are made of chocolate.{E108:0010}
That's why.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200053C|4: White light makes them look better.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|0200053C|5:
(Mr. Tangaroa must see the room itself as a part of his
carefully crafted creations.)
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|3:
Yes.{E108:0010} It wasn't exactly warm out in the fountain room,
either...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|4:
...but it's even colder in here.{E108:0018}
Would you like to borrow my jacket?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|6:
And besides,{E108:0010} {E285}you said you'd give it to me when I
finally got my attorney's badge!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|8: ...Why do they have the heat down so low...?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|9: Chocolate needs to be kept at the right temperature.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|10: ...Take a look behind that panel on the wall.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|12: Look at that!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}It was here this whole time!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|13: There's one in each of the contest rooms.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|14:
Tangaroa hid them so they wouldn't spoil the aesthetic
of our works.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|15: And what do the controls do?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|16: They adjust the temperature and the lighting.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|17:
Goes all the way down to -22 degrees Fahrenheit.{E108:0010}
Cold enough to keep any confectionery from melting.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000542|18: ...So, in effect,{E108:0008} each room is a {E188:00300000}giant freezer.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|0: I-It's 59 degrees in here!{E108:0018} No wonder I'm cold!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|1:
Hey,{E108:0008} Detective Badd.{E108:0010} You, uh...{E108:0008} mind if we turn it up a
little?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|2:
Preservation of the crime scene...{E108:0010} is the foundation of
detective work...!
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|4:
The same goes for attorneys, Eddie.{E108:0010}
We must never disturb the scene of the crime.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|5:
Hrngh.{E108:0010} Get used to the cold.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}It's all part of your training.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|6:
Chocolate needs to be kept between 59 and 65
degrees.{E108:0010} There's no way around it.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|7:
Hmph...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You know the temperatures by heart, huh?{E108:0010}
Guess it is your job...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|8: It's the very least I should know.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|9:
Any real confectioner should be able to tell you that
and more.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|11:
If it's not too hot or too humid,{E108:0008} a lollipop should be
fine just about anywhere.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|12: Cream needs to be kept at around 50 degrees.
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|13:
...Need to watch out for heat and humidity, huh?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}Duly noted...
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|14:
Detective Badd kinda brightened up when he was
talking about lollipops, didn't he?
sce2_c0_m0d_npc.bytes|02000555|15: (I suppose he must be very fond of them...)
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000601|0:
...Attorneys are bad luck...{E108:0010}
Nothing good ever happens with you guys around...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000601|1: You trample the scene...{E108:0008} {E1D1}jump to conclusions...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000601|2: You really think that of all of us?{E108:0010} Me included?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000606|0:
...What a weird seal.{E108:0010}
If you use it like a stamp,{E108:0008} it'd come out as {E284}"{E041}PH{E040}", right?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000606|1:
But if it's just for show like a ring,{E108:0008} it appears to say...{E108:0010}
{E285}"{E041}H9{E040}", I believe?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000606|2:
"H9"...{E108:0010} Hit...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}nine, maybe?{E108:0010} Someone's hitting streak...?{E108:0010}
Nah.{E108:0010} Seems unlikely...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000606|3:
(It sounds like Detective Badd might be a fan of
baseball...?)
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200060A|0:
This case,{E108:0008} it's...{E108:0010} Well...{E108:0010}
I can't get my head around a few parts of it.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200060A|1:
If you wouldn't mind,{E108:0008} I'd like some more information
about the scene of the crime.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200060A|2:
Sure...{E108:0010} You got legs, don't you?{E108:0010}
Try using them...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200060A|4:
Our duties may differ, Detective,{E108:0008} but we both want
to get to the bottom of what happened, don't we?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200060A|5: Wouldn't it be better if we worked together?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200060A|7:
(The detective clearly sees himself as the strong silent
type.)
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200060A|8: (...I suppose that is also "how the pros do it".)
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000613|0: Seems the culprit...{E108:0008} made sure to wear gloves...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000613|1: Couldn't lift squat...{E108:0008} from those finger marks.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000613|2:
But perhaps you can extrapolate something about the
their owner from the size of their fingers, for example?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000613|3:
...It's not as easy as it sounds.{E108:0018} Sorry,{E108:0008} but these finger
marks...{E108:0008} are pretty worthless as evidence goes.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000613|4: There's no need to be hasty, Detective.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000613|5:
After all,{E108:0008} {E1D1}even the absence of fingerprints tells us
something of interest, don't you think?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000613|6:
Hmph.{E108:0010} You lawyers have an answer for everything,
don't you...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000613|7: Heh.{E108:0010} I'll take that as a compliment.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200061B|0:
There seems little doubt that this is the murder
weapon.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200061B|1:
Whacking a guy with something like this...{E108:0010}
Makes me think it was a spur of the moment thing.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200061B|2:
And who had easy access to the lamp...?{E108:0010}
Our little lady friend...{E108:0008} that's who.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200061B|3: Something's rotten in this house of candied sweets.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|0200061B|4: (Hmm...{E108:0010} Could Ms. Scone be hiding something?)
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000620|0: I'd like your opinion on this, if you don't mind.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000620|1:
...I do...{E108:0018}
If there's one thing I hate...{E108:0008} it's small talk...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000620|2:
(It seems he only cares about things that are directly
related to the incident.)
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000623|0:
You're doing this...{E108:0008} all wrong.{E108:0010}
An investigation is like a popsicle...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000623|1:
You walk around the scene...{E108:0010} Look at stuff...{E108:0010}
Talk to witnesses...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000623|2:
Everything you do...{E108:0008} it's like a lick of that popsicle.{E108:0010}
Slowly,{E108:0008} you eat away at it...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000623|3:
...until all that's left is the stick.{E108:0010}
And written on that stick...{E108:0010} is the truth.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000623|4:
...Then I suppose I'd better hope it doesn't say
"GUILTY".
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000628|0:
Nothing has been moved since the body was found,
correct?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000628|1:
...Preserve the scene...{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D2}That's rule number one of any
investigation.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000628|2:
They took the body away,{E108:0008} but everything else...{E108:0010}
untouched...
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000628|3:
Could you tell us a little more about the state of the
body before it was taken away?
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000628|4:
Bound...{E108:0008} took a picture.{E108:0010}
...You'll have to make do with that, Mr. Lawyer.
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000628|5:
(I get the feeling that the good detective is none too
fond of defense attorneys.)
sce2_c0_partner.bytes|02000628|6:
(Probably best not rely too much on him,{E108:0008} and search
the scene for clues and contradictions myself...)
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|1:
Whoa!{E108:0018} {E1D1}A candy castle!{E108:0020} {E155:002000000001}And look,{E108:0010} there are even some
little elves to go with it!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|2:
...Room's laid out...{E108:0010} pretty much the same as
Tangaroa's...
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|3: It's not as cold though.{E108:0010} That's something!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|4:
Let's see...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E285}Yeah,{E108:0008} looks like there's a {E041}temperature
control panel{E040} in here, too...
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|5: Over there where that orange light is, right!?
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|6: We'd better take a closer look at it when we can.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|7: (It's like a fairy-tale storybook in here.)
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|8:
(And this whipped cream-covered construction must
be the work of Ms. Delicia Scone.)
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000700|10: Me?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Why,{E108:0008} I'm just over here, dearie!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|0:
Oh,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}just look at you lovely boys!{E108:0010}
Delicia Scone --{E108:0008} at your service!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|1:
Some cheeky blighters back in Blighty even call me{E108:0008}
Miss Delicious!{E108:0008} {E107:0001}Tee hee!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|2:
(Called a "lovely boy" at 34...{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Unexpected,{E108:0008} to say the least...)
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|4:
Oh, yes, dear!{E108:0010} You,{E108:0008} the detective over there --{E108:0008} {E12F:001F0000}{E280}you're
all lovely boys to me!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|6: (I wonder just how old she is...)
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|7: Finish this up so we can get outta here, Mr. Attorney.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|9:
What's the meaning of this!?{E108:0018} Chit-chatting with the
defense!?
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|10:
M-Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Some scary guy just stepped out of
the castle...!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200070B|15:
It's a pleasure to meet you, Mr. von Karma.{E108:0010}
{E150:0005002E}Gregory Edgeworth.{E108:0010} Attorney at law.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|0:
Hmph!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}I couldn't care less what your name is!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|1:
Your job is to lose to me and disappear,{E108:0008} never to show

sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|3:

sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|4:

sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|5:

sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|7: (This clearly isn't going to be easy...)
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|9:
...So long as your inquiries are limited to this room,{E108:0010}
{E284}I suppose I'll allow it.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|12:
...Name's Badd...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}...Is that so hard to remember?
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|13:
Hmph!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I didn't ask for your opinion!{E108:0010}
The thoughts of a lowly detective do not concern me!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|15: Badd.{E108:0010} See to it that these worms don't step out of line.

sce2_c1_00.bytes|0200071B|18:
I need to go and look over Gusto's room.{E108:0018}
Good day.

(They don't seem to know each other well enough for

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|1:

but at least we can do that much.

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|3:
You're not messing it up...{E108:0008} before I get my chance...{E108:0018}{E12F:00060007}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}You'll have to wait till I'm done.

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|6:

{E107:0002}One of von Karma's pets was on the job before me.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|7:
Right up until just now, in fact.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I got here not long before you did.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|8:
(That answers my question as to why they're working

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|9:

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|10:
Then you won't have to worry about us "messing
things up".{E108:0010} You can keep an eye on us as we go.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|11:
What kinda screwball attorney...{E108:0008} asks to have a

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|12:
...Hmph.{E108:0018} Guess I'm stuck with you...{E108:0008} for a little while
longer.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|14: You have our thanks, Detective Badd.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|15:
...Don't be too grateful.{E108:0010} This is my scene.{E108:0010} The second

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000731|16:
Of course.{E108:0010} We understand.{E108:0018}{E13E:0005}{E150:00050021}
Now,{E108:0008} shall we begin?

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000743|1: Yes,{E108:0010} {E1D1}we've certainly found plenty of interest.
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000745|0: (Something's been bothering me for a while now.)
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000745|1:
(Mr. von Karma would have surely found the murder

(And yet,{E108:0008} he didn't arrest Ms. Scone.{E108:0010} He didn't even

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000745|3:
(I think our first priority should be to find out what

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000745|4:

sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000745|6:
Eek!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}How could you, Baddy Bumpkin!?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}S-Stop staring at me like that!
sce2_c1_00.bytes|02000745|7:
(It appears Detective Badd is just as suspicious of

Mr. von Karma.{E108:0010}
We'd like to speak with you, if that's alright.

It doesn't matter where the weapon was found.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Tangaroa is guilty.
sce2_c1_02.bytes|02000780|8:
...And as long as this is my case,{E108:0008} guilty he shall
remain.
sce2_c1_02.bytes|02000780|9: (How can he be so sure of Mr. Tangaroa's guilt...?)
sce2_c1_02.bytes|02000780|10: You have an explanation, I assume?
sce2_c1_02.bytes|02000780|11: For why the murder weapon was in Ms. Scone's room?
sce2_c1_02.bytes|02000780|12:
Hmph.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Of course I do.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}And I'll be delighted to share it with you.
sce2_c1_02.bytes|0200078D|1:
Tangaroa killed Frost with one of Scone's salt lamps in

sce2_c1_02.bytes|0200078D|2:
To complete the deception,{E108:0008} he took it back to her room

After all,{E108:0008} if it had been found near the victim's body,{E108:0008}
{E1D1}Tangaroa would have seemed doubly suspicious.

A body may be hard to move,{E108:0008} but a murder weapon?{E108:0010}
Considerably less so.
sce2_c1_02.bytes|0200078D|5:
And that is why there was no piece of evidence on the
scene that pointed to a particular suspect.

So it's your assertion that Mr. Tangaroa took the salt

sce2_c1_02.bytes|0200078D|8:

Tsk tsk tsk...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}If you have a rebuttal,{E108:0008} I'll be happy to

Tangaroa killed Frost with one of Scone's salt lamps in

Now,{E108:0008} as I was saying...

You're talking about the lamp made of rock salt that

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007A9|2:

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007A9|6:
I went in there because detectives are an incompetent

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007A9|7:

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007A9|8:

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007A9|9:

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007A9|10:

But he came under suspicion anyway due to the body

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007B4|2: "Even a dog can hold still and stay."
sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007B4|4: (...If only...{E108:0008} I could say the same to you.)
sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007BA|0:
So you think he hid the body in the chest but removed

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007BA|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} {E1D1}He foolishly believed his own creation to be the

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007BA|2: Eek!{E108:0018} I'm sorry!{E108:0010} I had to help myself!
sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007BA|3: (I think you mean{E108:0008} you COULDN'T help yourself, no?)

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007BA|5:

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007C0|0:

Tsk tsk tsk...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Is that the best you can do at pressing me?
sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007C0|2:
Listen here!{E108:0018} The presence of the body in Tangaroa's

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007C0|4:
Perhaps you should take another look.{E108:0010}
You might--
sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007C0|5:
You really don't give up,{E108:0008} do you?{E108:0010} There is no need to

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007C0|6:

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007C0|7:

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007C0|8:
(...then there must be something that points to

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007C9|1:
A von Karma is perfect in every way.{E108:0010}

dent in my logic with that?

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007CD|5: (Gnrk...!{E108:0018} I'm lower than dirt to him...!)
sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007D3|1: That has no bearing on this discussion whatsoever!
sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007D3|3:

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007D8|0:
It's true that the murder weapon and the bloodstained

sce2_c1_02.bytes|020007D8|2:

sce2_c1_03.bytes|020008DC|19: I'm not accusing you of anything just yet.
sce2_c1_03.bytes|020008DC|20: But I do think you're hiding something.
sce2_c1_03.bytes|020008F3|1:
Your assertion is that both the murder weapon and the

And the only person capable of entering his locked

sce2_c1_03.bytes|020008F3|14:

I have had everything I need to get Tangaroa

sce2_c1_03.bytes|0200090E|2:

sce2_c1_03.bytes|0200090E|3: One more thing,{E108:0008} my pathetic friend...
sce2_c1_03.bytes|0200090E|4:

sce2_c1_03.bytes|0200090E|18:
(I don't have enough to disprove any of what he's

{E1D1}And close the door behind you!
sce2_c1_03.bytes|0200090E|22: (I'm not about to just give up...)
sce2_c1_03.bytes|0200090E|23:

sce2_c1_03.bytes|0200090E|30:

sce2_c1_03.bytes|0200092D|0:
