sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|9:
I...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'm ever so sorry, sweeties.{E108:0010} I didn't mean to make
a mess...!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|10:
I just...{E108:0010} I had to take a little bite here and there,
didn't I?
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|11:
...I didn't want poor Sammypoople getting upset,{E108:0008} so it
was just the teensiest bits and pieces.
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|12:
And the stand holding up the ship?{E108:0010} You took a bite out
of that too, I suppose?
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|13: Oh, yes, dear!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Of course I did!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|14:
It was you...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}You brought the whole thing crashing down...!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|15: Eek!{E108:0018} I'm sorry, my lovely,{E108:0010} truly I am!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|16: Hold on,{E108:0010} is that why you left the afternoon tea early?
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|17: You were heading off for a second helping of sweets?
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|18:
I--!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Look,{E108:0008} just please believe me!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I never killed anybody!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}I promise!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000B97|19:
(Her actions were certainly suspicious.{E108:0010}
But that's about all we can say for now...)
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|0:
Ms. Scone,{E108:0010} why is the temperature of your room set
to 68 degrees?
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|1:
Because I hate the cold,{E108:0008} don't I, dearie!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}And besides,{E108:0008} being chilly's no good for a girl!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|2:
If I want to keep my fresh-faced complexion,{E108:0008} I've got
to be careful about these things!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|3: We ladies have to stay young, don't you know?
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|4:
How old is she really, though?{E108:0010} That's what I'd like to
know...
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|5: It's not polite to speculate on a person's age, Eddie.
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|6:
But...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}most of your work is made out of whipped
cream...
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|7:
And whipped cream needs to be kept at 50 degrees,{E108:0008} or
it starts to deflate.
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|8:
Is that so, dearie?{E108:0010} Well, silly me, eh?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}I've only gone and made a whoopsie!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|10:
(Not only did she break the rules by using fake candy,{E108:0008}
she's ignorant of basic facts about her supposed craft.)
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BAC|11: (Ms. Scone grows more mysterious by the minute...)
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BB9|0:
Ahh,{E108:0008} the thick, sweet scent of delicious whipped cream
is in the air.{E108:0010} It's like a fairy tale,{E108:0008} but in real life!
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BB9|1:
And yet,{E108:0008} there he was,{E108:0008} standing in the middle of it all
with that evil look on his face.
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BB9|2:
This whole experience is wasted on the {E1D1}scary old
creep.
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BB9|3:
Come now, Eddie.{E108:0010} You can't call people names like
that.{E108:0010} It's rude.
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BB9|4: S-Sorry, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'll try to be more careful.
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BB9|5:
It's just...{E108:0010} he reminds me of this teacher I once had
who was always super angry with me...
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BB9|6:
(A stern schoolteacher, huh?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Now that he mentions it,{E108:0008}
Mr. von Karma does have the look of one...)
sce2_c1_m0e_npc.bytes|02000BB9|7:
(But I shudder to think what it would be like for Miles
to study under him.)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BDD|0:
...Attorneys are bad luck...{E108:0010}
Nothing good ever happens with you guys around...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BDD|1: You trample the scene...{E108:0008} {E1D1}jump to conclusions...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BDD|2: You really think that of all of us?{E108:0010} Me included?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE2|0:
...What a weird seal.{E108:0010}
If you use it like a stamp,{E108:0008} it'd come out as {E284}"{E041}PH{E040}", right?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE2|1:
But if it's just for show like a ring,{E108:0008} it appears to say...{E108:0010}
{E285}"{E041}H9{E040}", I believe?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE2|2:
"H9"...{E108:0010} Hit...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}nine, maybe?{E108:0010} Someone's hitting streak...?{E108:0010}
Nah.{E108:0010} Seems unlikely...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE2|3:
(It sounds like Detective Badd might be a fan of
baseball...?)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE6|0:
This case,{E108:0008} it's...{E108:0010} Well...{E108:0010}
I can't get my head around a few parts of it.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE6|1:
If you wouldn't mind,{E108:0008} I'd like some more information
about the scene of the crime.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE6|2:
Sure...{E108:0010} You got legs, don't you?{E108:0010}
Try using them...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE6|4:
Our duties may differ, Detective,{E108:0008} but we both want
to get to the bottom of what happened, don't we?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE6|5: Wouldn't it be better if we worked together?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE6|7:
(The detective clearly sees himself as the strong silent
type.)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BE6|8: (...I suppose that is also "how the pros do it".)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BEF|0: Seems the culprit...{E108:0008} made sure to wear gloves...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BEF|1: Couldn't lift squat...{E108:0008} from those finger marks.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BEF|2:
But perhaps you can extrapolate something about the
their owner from the size of their fingers, for example?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BEF|3:
...It's not as easy as it sounds.{E108:0018} Sorry,{E108:0008} but these finger
marks...{E108:0008} are pretty worthless as evidence goes.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BEF|4: There's no need to be hasty, Detective.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BEF|5:
After all,{E108:0008} {E1D1}even the absence of fingerprints tells us
something of interest, don't you think?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BEF|6:
Hmph.{E108:0010} You lawyers have an answer for everything,
don't you...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BEF|7: Heh.{E108:0010} I'll take that as a compliment.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BF7|0:
There seems little doubt that this is the murder
weapon.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BF7|1:
Whacking a guy with something like this...{E108:0010}
Makes me think it was a spur of the moment thing.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BF7|2:
And who had easy access to the lamp...?{E108:0010}
Our little lady friend...{E108:0008} that's who.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BF7|3: Something's rotten in this house of candied sweets.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BF7|4: (Hmm...{E108:0010} Could Ms. Scone be hiding something?)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFC|0: I'd like your opinion on this, if you don't mind.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFC|1:
...I do...{E108:0018}
If there's one thing I hate...{E108:0008} it's small talk...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFC|2:
(It seems he only cares about things that are directly
related to the incident.)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFF|0: Room's laid out the same as Tangaroa's...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFF|1: Does anything else strike you as strange?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFF|2:
Von Karma was inside the castle...{E108:0010}
Must have been looking around in there...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFF|3: ...Who knows.{E108:0010} {E285}Maybe he had a reason to...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFF|4:
And what about Ms. Scone?{E108:0010} Does she seem suspicious
to you?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFF|5:
She's...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}hiding something...{E108:0018}
...I'd bet my badge on it.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFF|7:
(Detective's intuition, huh?{E108:0010} Well, I have to say,{E108:0008} I don't
disagree.{E108:0010} Something's not right here.)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000BFF|8:
(I think we'd better hear Ms. Scone's side of the
story...)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C08|0:
...Now that we know more,{E108:0008} we should probably take
another look at a few things...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C08|1:
Agreed.{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:002F0000}The luminous cloth,{E108:0008} the elves,{E108:0008} and the lamps...{E108:0010}
I think all three might merit a second glance.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C08|2:
Why were they in the castle...?{E108:0018} More to the point...{E108:0010}
why were they hidden inside the castle?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C08|3:
Something stinks...{E108:0008} and it's not all this cream that's
going bad.{E108:0010} It's Scone.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C08|4:
We should look over the scene again and see if we can
uncover anything new.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C0D|0:
So all the so-called "confectionery" in this room...{E108:0008} {E1D1}is
fake...?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C0D|1: The woman's a crook.{E108:0010} {E280}And a phony.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C0D|2:
There's something I still don't understand, though.{E108:0010}
This is a high-profile,{E108:0008} international contest.
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C0D|3:
Why employ methods that were so obviously going to
be found out?
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C0D|4:
...Maybe she foolishly thought she could get away with
it...{E108:0010} That or...
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C0D|5: (I think I'm starting to see what she was trying to do...)
sce2_c1_partner.bytes|02000C0D|6:
(I have the pieces in my head.{E108:0010} I just need to put them
together...)
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|0:
...Whoa,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}went deep on that one.{E108:0010} Sorry, Milesarino.{E108:0010}
Didn't mean to bend your ear for so long.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|1: I had no idea that was how it all came about...
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|2:
I read the files,{E108:0008} but they don't go into anywhere near
that level of detail.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|3:
Heh.{E108:0010} I'll bet they paint things in a much rosier light for
the prosecution, too.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|4: Von Karma was the one in charge, after all.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|5: What happened with the case after that?
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|6:
Well,{E108:0008} what with the ice sculptures vanishing from the
victim's room,{E107:0008} things hit a bit of a rough patch.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|7:
So rough, in fact,{E108:0008} that it took a full year before they
could even reach a verdict in the trial.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|9:
This was back before they brought in the whole "initial
trial" thing.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|10:
You didn't have to finish up in double-quick time like
you do nowadays.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|12:
Did they ever find out how the victim's creations
managed to just disappear?
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|14:
They were sorbets or frozen desserts or whatever you
want to call 'em.{E108:0010} Ice,{E108:0008} in other words.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|15:
And if it's made of ice,{E108:0008} it can melt.{E108:0010} Which is exactly
what they{E108:0008} {E12F:000A0003}{E188:00300000}{E107:0003}"concluded"{E108:0008} {E107:0002}must've happened.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|16:
...But there's a chance that wasn't how things actually
went down.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|18:
So this place is a gallery these days,{E108:0008} but back then, it
was Samson Tangaroa's place, yeah?
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|19: Indeed.{E108:0010} And the site of the IS-7 Incident.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|20:
Well,{E108:0008} {E284}word is Frost's ice sculptures are suddenly back
on display,{E108:0008} eighteen years after that fateful day.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|21: !{E108:0018} The very sculptures the victim made!?
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|22:
Who knows.{E108:0010} Could be they're just modeled on the
originals.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|23:
But I figured it was worth coming down for a little
look-see just in case.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|24:
...Seemed like the least I could do for poor old
Gregory.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|26:
Well, alrighty then!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}Let's go take a look at these icy
marvels,{E108:0008} shall we, kiddo?
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CDD|27:
I believe they're on display in the "Winter Wing",{E108:0008} as it's
very snazzily known!
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CF9|1:
Huh!?{E108:0018}
I don't believe it.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}It's locked.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CF9|2:
The gallery's open for biz,{E108:0008} but the Winter
Wonder-Wing's off limits?{E108:0010} What gives?
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CF9|4:
Perhaps you should look more closely at the pamphlet
we were given.{E108:0010} The Winter Wing is over there.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CFE|0:
It is?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Freaky.{E108:0010} Could have sworn it was this one.
sce2_c2_00.bytes|02000CFE|1:
Anyhoo,{E108:0010} shall we?{E108:0010} Time to dive on in and see what we
should've seen eighteen years ago!
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D5C|1:
Brr...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I see they're still keeping it chilly as all heck in
these rooms.{E108:0010} I'm about to turn into a popsicle stick.
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D5C|2:
It IS the {E041}Winter Wing{E040}, you know.{E108:0010} But you're right --{E108:0008} it's
like a freezer in here.
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D5C|3:
(It could be a trick of the light,{E108:0008} but it feels like the
whole room is made of ice...)
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D5C|4:
The temperature controls will be somewhere at the
back there, if memory serves.
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D61|0: Hey Milester,{E108:0010} can you go peep the degree count?
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D61|1:
I'm thinking a complaint to the management is in
order.{E108:0010} {E1D1}There IS such a thing as too cold, yeah?
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D61|3:
Take your time,{E108:0008} mosey around and take in the sights
while you're at it.
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D61|4: I've got a camera I need to prep for action.
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D61|5:
Feel like your pop might appreciate a picture of all
this.{E108:0010} I'll put it on his grave so he can have a gander.
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D68|0:
Alrighty.{E108:0010} I got the shots I wanted.{E108:0010} Shall we scoot on
over to another wing and see what's cooking?
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D68|1: Might as well do the full tour while we're here!
sce2_c2_01.bytes|02000D68|5:
It came from the fountain room.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Come on,{E108:0010} {E1D1}let's go see what's up!
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DDC|1:
(There's...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}There's someone on the ground!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}And is that...!?)
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DDC|2: Larry!{E108:0018} What are you doing here?
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DDC|3: Actually,{E108:0008} never mind that.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}What on earth is going on!?
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DDC|5: You should have seen it!{E108:0018} It was AWFUL!
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DDC|6:
Just calm down and tell me why there is an
unconscious man on the floor!
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DDC|7: I,{E108:0008} I didn't do anything!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}He just fell down in front of me!
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DE5|1:
Don't you know it's rude to make a racket in an art
gallery,{E108:000C} you naughty boys!
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DE7|1: He's still breathing, but...{E108:0010} I know these symptoms...!
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DE7|2:
It's not safe, Miles!{E108:0018} We need to get everybody out of
here!
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DE7|3: Everyone,{E108:0008} with me!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}There isn't a moment to lose!
sce2_c2_02.bytes|02000DE7|4: There's poison gas coming out of that room!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|1:
Not good.{E108:0010} He inhaled a lot of gas.{E108:0010}
He's still out,{E108:0008} and it sounds like it's pretty serious.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|2:
But the paramedics said there are no signs of external
injury,{E108:0008} and that he was conscious before it happened.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|3:
Anyway,{E108:0008} he's alive.{E108:0010} Just barely.{E108:0010}
He's lucky we found him when we did.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|4:
But like I said,{E108:0008} he's not out of the woods yet.{E108:0010}
They put him in the medical room with a specialist.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|5:
I see.{E108:0018} ...I couldn't help noticing that it seemed like
you knew him, Fender.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|6:
Sure do.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}That was Carmelo Gusto.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E284}He was here back
when the whole IS-7 thing went down.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|7:
The confectioner...!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(So he was here eighteen years ago, too...)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|8:
Anyhoozles,{E108:0008} this guy here seems like he's in rude
health.{E108:0010} Old pal of yours, Milesarino?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|9:
...Yes.{E108:0010} Something like that.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I'm glad you're okay, Larry.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|11:
You've known me since elementary school!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}Crush a guy's feelings, why don't you!?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|12:
Anyway,{E108:0008} you KNOW you're supposed to call me
{E285}Laurice Deauxnim when I'm dressed like this!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|15:
(He's a bit of a troublemaker,{E108:0008} but he's one of my only
friends from back when we were little kids.)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|16:
(Ever since he developed a passion for art,{E108:0008} he's been
trying to make it big as "Laurice Deauxnim".)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E5E|17: (...But new name or not,{E108:0008} he's still the same old Larry.)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|0:
Whoa!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Grade school buddies!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I need to go tell Gregory
about this!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|1:
He'll be over the moon to hear you have a pal!{E108:0010} He was
always worried you'd never click with anybody.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|2:
Hear that, Edgey?{E108:0010} {E107:0001}You're lucky to have a friend like
me!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|3:
(I never knew I was the cause of such worries for my
father...)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|4:
Never mind that now, Larry.{E108:0010}
What are you doing here?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|5:
"Laurice", Edgey!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}How many times do I have to tell you it's "Laurice"!?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|7:
Eek!{E108:0010} {E280}{E107:0001}What's with the demon eyes!?{E108:0018} Alright,{E108:0008} alright,{E108:0010}
I'll talk!{E108:0018} Just stop looking at me like that!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|9:
You want to know why I'm here?{E108:0010}
Why the heck do you think?{E108:0010} For my art, of course!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|10:
Oh,{E108:0008} and I'm coming on a date here with Lulu soon,{E108:0008} so
I thought I'd better scope the place out!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|11: (So,{E108:0008} not actually for your art at all...)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|12:
Laurice, my man!{E108:0010} {E1D1}An artist{E108:0008} and a romantic!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You'll have to introduce me to this ladyfriend of yours!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|13:
Oh,{E108:0008} sure!{E108:0010} It's nice to have somebody take an interest
for once!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|16: Did you notice anything when you found the victim?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|18: Didn't you say you'd seen something "awful"?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|20:
The old guy,{E108:0008} he just appeared, and then --{E108:0008} Splat! --{E108:0008} he
was on the floor.{E108:0010} Scared the life outta me!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|21: But for once,{E108:0008} {E285}{E107:0001}I had nothing to do with any of it!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E70|22:
...Don't look so proud!{E108:0010} That's the least we should be
able to hope for!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E87|0:
Honored guests.{E108:0010} I can only apologize for the trouble
you've experienced.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E87|1: I'm Judy Bound,{E108:0008} the gallery manager.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E8B|0: Mr. Fender.{E108:0010} It's always a pleasure.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E8B|1:
(She was at the reception desk when we arrived.{E108:0010}
So she's the one in charge here...)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E8B|2:
I can't believe you had to go through something so
awful.{E108:0010} And on our first day in business...
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E8B|3: Hey,{E108:0010} quit that.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}It's not your fault.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E8B|4: Oh, wait.{E108:000C} I guess I'd better introduce you guys.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E8B|5:
Judy,{E108:0008} meet Miles Edgeworth...{E108:0010} son of the late,{E108:0008} great
Gregory.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|0:
Isn't this {E107:0002}{E1D1}fabulooous!{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}That great man's son,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}here {E1D1}with uuus!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|1:
Eighteen long years {E1D1}have passed!{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}But now look,{E108:0008} he's here {E1D1}at laaast!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|2:
It's very lovely to {E1D1}meet yooou!{E108:0010}
Mr. Fine Attorney {E1D2}Number Twoooo!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|3:
Judy,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}that was the bomb!{E108:0018}
I see you're in good voice as ever!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|4:
...Miles Edgeworth.{E108:0010} Prosecutor.{E108:0010}
It's a pleasure to meet you.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|5:
Oh...{E108:000C} you're a prosecutor?{E108:0018}
I'm so sorry!{E108:0010} Forgive me for jumping to conclusions.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|6:
(She's very polite...{E108:0010} but there's something strange
about her...)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|7:
Um, hey...{E108:0008} Judy?{E108:0010} Can I, uh...{E108:0010} get an autograph?{E108:0018}
{E280}{E1CB:009800020000}You can write it in here...!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|8: Well,{E108:0008} if you're sure you'd even want such a thing...
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|9: Why DO you want it, Larry?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|10:
RUDE!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You know who she is, right?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|11:
Come on, Milester!{E108:0010} You don't keep up with showbiz
news or nothing?{E108:0010} Guess that's no big surprise...
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|12:
(What's going on?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}Why are they looking at me like
that!?)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|13:
Judy here's a living legend!{E108:0010} It's not just TV --{E108:0010} movies,{E108:0008}
musicals,{E108:0008} chart-topping hits --{E108:000C} {E107:0001}you name it!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|14:
Hee hee...{E108:0010} Oh, don't be silly.{E108:0010} I'm just a humble art
gallery owner now.{E108:0010} I finally quit the biz for good.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|15:
I finished shooting my last movie just the other day, in
fact.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|16:
Some of my co-stars were even kind enough to say
that they would come visit once we opened.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000E92|17:
...Anyway,{E108:0008} here you are.{E1CB:009800000000}{E108:0018}
And good luck with your artistic endeavors.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|0:
Thanks sooo much, Judy!{E108:0018}
I'll treasure it till my dying day!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|1:
Ahh,{E108:000C} you and me are peas in a pod, Laurice!{E108:0010}
Peas in a gosh-danged pod!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|3:
Larry,{E108:0010} could you...{E108:0008} go practice your drawing
somewhere or something?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|4:
...You did come all the way to an art gallery, after all.{E108:0010}
It would be a shame to waste the opportunity.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|5:
A real artist drawing our exhibits?{E108:0018}
What an honor!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|6:
Heh.{E108:0010} Guess even you can have a bright idea once in a
while, Edgey!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|7:
Alright, Judy.{E108:0010} Seeing as you were so nice about it,{E108:0008}
I guess I will.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}Be right back!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|8: Hee hee...{E108:0010} He's a real live wire, that one.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|9: ...That's one way of putting it.{E108:0010} I can only apologize.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|10:
By the way,{E108:0008} there was another woman with you
before.{E108:0010} Where is she now?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|12:
She's in the medical room helping to care for
Mr. Gusto.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|13:
I call it the medical room,{E108:0008} but it's nothing quite so
grand, of course.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|14:
I couldn't stay with them as I'm the only one on staff,{E108:0008}
and I can't leave the gallery unattended for long.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|15:
Delicia Scone...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}We've heard that name before,{E108:0008} haven't
we, Fender?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|16:
Sure have!{E108:0010} Sounds like our IS-7 bingo card is
complete!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|17: Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Something tells me this isn't a coinkydink...
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|19: ...Perhaps I could offer you gentlemen a cup of tea?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EA4|20:
A drop of the old Judy Bound special blend?{E108:0018}
Why not?{E108:0010} For old time's sake!
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBB|0: Now,{E108:0008} if you'll both excuse me.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBB|1: I'd better go and explain things to the other visitors.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBB|2: You go do your thing, Judes.{E108:0010} Thanks again.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBB|3: (This aroma...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Ceylon, I believe.{E108:0010} Let's give it a try...)
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBF|0:
Mmm...{E108:0010} This is a fine blend.{E108:0010} A top-quality Ceylon
indeed.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBF|2:
..."Is said to improve one's ability to concentrate",
right?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBF|4:
Heh heh!{E108:0010} Your old man said those exact words
eighteen years ago.{E108:0010} Really takes me back.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBF|5:
There's just one difference:{E108:0010} Judes cooled the saucers
back then.{E108:0010} Not today, though, it seems.
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBF|7: Don't you think this is all a little odd?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBF|8:
Every single person from an eighteen-year-old case,{E108:0008} all
assembled in the same place at the same time?
sce2_c2_03.bytes|02000EBF|9: Yes.{E108:0010} It almost feels as if an investigation is in order...
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EDC|2:
We heard you got caught up in a poison gas attack,{E108:0008}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}so we came as fast as we could!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EDF|0:
Well, if it isn't the cavalry!{E108:0018}
{E12F:000A0009}{E107:0002}Come on, team,{E108:0008} {E284}bring it in!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EDF|2:
Besides,{E108:0008} you're both doing just fine!{E108:0010} {E280}Gummy and I got
ourselves all worked up over nothing!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EDF|4: What were you thinking, bringing Kay with you?
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EDF|6:
I knew it was dangerous,{E108:0008} what with the poison gas and
all,{E108:0010} but she wouldn't take no for an answer...!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EDF|7:
I ran and I ran and I ran and I ran and I ran,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but I just
couldn't shake her off!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EDF|8:
...Heh heh heh.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D9}When it comes to running away,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D9}{E12F:00020008}the
Great Thief right here is the world champ!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EDF|9: (Then run away.{E108:0010} Don't chase the poor detective...)
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EE9|0:
All set, sir!{E108:0010} Just say the word,{E108:0008} and I'll head in there
and start investigating!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EE9|1: You guys stay here.{E108:0010} That gas could still be dangerous.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EE9|2: Alright.{E108:0010} We're counting on you, Detective.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EE9|4:
No way!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Gummy almost looked like a real detective!{E108:0018}
I'm so proud of him!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EEF|1:
Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Looks like the gas has mostly
dissipated, sir!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|0:
Very good, Detective.{E108:0010} Now calm down and tell me
what you see.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|1:
Yessir!{E108:0010} Uh...{E108:0008} first up,{E108:0008} the exhibits.{E108:0010}
There's a statue of two people on the left side...
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|2: And on the right,{E108:0008} some kind of two-horned animal...
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|3:
(Wait,{E108:0008} a statue of two people, and a two-horned
animal...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}That sounds familiar...)
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|4:
(In fact,{E108:0008} {E284}it sounds identical to the display in the Winter
Wing...)
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|5:
Other than that, uh...{E108:0008} the place is looking pretty damp.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D9}The sprinklers sprayed the place good!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|6: Must be what stopped the gas from spreading.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|7: The sprinklers?{E108:0010} Are there any signs of a fire?
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|8:
No, sir.{E108:0010} And the fire alarm hasn't been triggered,
either.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EF1|9:
Sprinklers look like the type that detect {E1D1}heat and
smoke.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|0:
When they detect something,{E108:0008} they send an alarm --{E108:0008}
either fire or smoke --{E108:0008} to the security room.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|1:
Guess they read the gas as smoke,{E108:0008} and triggered the
smoke alarm that way.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|2:
And was anyone in the security room when that alarm
went off?
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|3:
This place only has one employee,{E108:0008} and that's Judy
Bound,{E108:0008} the manager.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|4:
And she was at the reception desk across from the
security room the whole time since the gallery opened.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|5:
So she heard the alarm from across the way and
turned on the sprinklers...?
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|6:
Yup.{E108:0010} {E285}Seems they can only be switched on manually.{E108:0010}
And only from there.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|7:
Wouldn't want the art getting soaked for no good
reason, I guess.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|8:
And if it's manual,{E108:0008} you could maybe even check how
bad the fire was and try to get some stuff out first.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000EFB|9:
(So the security setup is geared around protecting the
exhibits.{E108:0010} That makes sense in an art gallery, I guess...)
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000F05|0: Brr...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}And one more thing --{E108:0010} {E280}it's freezing in here!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000F05|1:
This isn't the Autumn Wing.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}It's the Deep Midwinter
Wing!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000F05|2: So the Autumn Wing is cold, too...?
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000F05|3:
I checked the temperature.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}It's 26.5 degrees in here,
sir!
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000F05|4:
(Why is the Autumn Wing being kept at the same
temperature as the Winter Wing?)
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000F05|5: That's about all I've got for now.
sce2_c2_04.bytes|02000F05|6: I'll let you know if I find anything else, sir!
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F5D|0: What did Gummy have to say?
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F5D|1: He said that the Autumn Wing is actually quite wintry.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F5D|3:
I'm wondering what it could mean myself,{E108:0008} but it's a bit
hard to tell from out here.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F5D|4:
We should try to get in there as soon as the police are
done with their investigation.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F5D|5:
Amen to that.{E108:0010} We need to see what the deal is for
ourselves.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F5D|6:
Is there anybody else who might know something in
the meantime?
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F5D|7: Oh, yeah!{E108:0010} There is one guy --{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Miles's best bud!
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F5D|9: (Ugh,{E108:0010} if we have to.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}And I guess we have to...)
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|0:
Kay!{E108:0018} {E1D1}Didn't expect to see you here!{E108:0018} You're looking as
fresh-faced as ever!
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|1: Heh.{E108:0010} Yeah,{E108:0008} long time no see, uh...{E108:000C} Larry, right?
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|2: ...{E12F:000C0000}{E107:0002}So, here's the deal, Kay.{E108:0010} {E284}I'm {E041}Laurice{E040} right now.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|3: You see...{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}I'm also a bit of an artist.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|4:
Ahhh,{E108:0008} so it's your alias?{E108:0010} I like it!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Good to see you, Laurice!
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|5: I always knew you were a nice, thoughtful kid!
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|8: I have some questions for you, Larry.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|9: What the--!?{E108:0018} How am I a suspect!?
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|10:
Just because I found the guy,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}that doesn't mean I did
the crime!
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|12: I just need you to tell us what you saw.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|13: You said you saw something "awful".{E108:0010} How so, exactly?
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|14:
Look,{E108:0018} {E107:0001}I didn't see anything,{E108:0010} and I didn't do anything,
okay!?
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|16:
Whoa, chief.{E108:000C} You didn't sound too sure of yourself at
the end there.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|17:
...There's something you should know about him,
Fender.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|18:
"When something smells,{E108:0008} it's usually the Butz."{E108:0018}
We've been saying that about Larry for {E1D1}26 years now.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|19:
His ability to attract trouble is...{E108:0010} legendary,{E108:0008} for want of
a better word.
sce2_c2_05.bytes|02000F68|21: (...I suppose {E1D1}I'd better find out what he did this time.)
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FDC|0:
Our aim is to uncover anything that Larry might be
hiding.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FDC|2:
I didn't see anything,{E108:0010} and I didn't do anything,{E108:0010} {E282}and you
can't prove otherwise!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FDC|3: (It's almost impossible for him to keep his cool.)
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FDC|4:
(I'll need to {E041}bide my time{E042} when he gets agitated,{E108:0008} and
wait for him to calm down.)
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FDC|5:
Let's start by asking him to go into detail about {E285}{E043}what
he's doing here{E040}.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FDC|6:
He shouldn't prove to be too much of a challenge.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}{E283}{E173:0000}So let's get this over with.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FE3|0: Why exactly did you come to the gallery today?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FE3|1:
What kind of question is that!?{E108:0018} What,{E108:0010} you think {E1D2}I don't
belong in a gallery or something!?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FE5|0:
Just admit it!{E108:0010} Admit that your testimony is riddled
with inconsistencies!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FE5|1:
What do you mean, Edgey!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}Why do you always gotta say stuff like that!?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FE5|2:
I,{E108:0008} I didn't think it would upset you so badly...!{E108:0010}
(Guess I should watch what I say...)
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FE5|3:
I need to study my opponent's reactions,{E108:0008} and pick my
responses accordingly.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FE9|1:
Hey!{E108:0018} If you're gonna ignore me,{E108:0008} then I'm gonna paint
your portrait!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FE9|2: And when I'm done,{E108:0010} I'll scribble all over it!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FEC|1:
I,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I'm joking, okay?{E108:0010} I'd never scribble on one of my
pieces!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FEC|3:
According to you, perhaps.{E108:0010} I imagine I might struggle
to agree.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FEC|4:
Oh,{E108:0010} laugh it up, funny guy!{E108:0018}
Luckily,{E108:0010} some people{E108:0010} {E1D1}actually BELIEVE in my work!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF1|1:
She's called Lulu, okay?{E108:0010} And she says my pictures are
{E1D1}masterpieces!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF1|2:
So if she likes something,{E108:0008} {E282}I'll draw it for her!{E108:0010}
Anything!{E108:0010} Anything at all!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF1|3: And where is this Lulu?{E108:0010} How come you're here alone?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF1|4:
What,{E108:0010} a guy can't be apart from his girlfriend for one
second!?{E108:0018} I have my own life too, {E1D1}you know!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF6|1: Fine.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Lulu said she's a Gemini, okay?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF6|2:
So I thought I could do a sketch of the statue to show
her on our date.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF6|3: And I expect you're pretty proud of this sketch?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF6|4: Uh...{E108:0010} Not so much this time, actually.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FF6|5:
But,{E108:0008} you know,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it being her sign and all...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I just thought maybe she might {E1D1}kinda like it...
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FFC|0:
Heh.{E108:0010} How very like you to try to tell me nothing,{E108:0008} and
give so much away in the process.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FFC|1:
So to summarize,{E108:0008} you came here today to draw a
sketch of the Gemini statue for your girlfriend Lulu?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FFC|2:
Wh-{E108:0008}{E281}Whaaaaaaaaaaat!?{E108:0018}
How did you figure all that out!?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FFC|3:
From your {E1D1}incessant prattling!{E108:0018} {E282}You just can't help
yourself, can you!?
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FFC|4: F-Fine!{E108:0010} {E281}Then I won't say another word!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FFC|5:
Larry may want to keep his mouth shut now,{E108:0008} but I'll
have my answers,{E108:0008} {E1D1}one way or another.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FFC|6:
Let's ask him {E043}what he did after he arrived here at the
gallery{E040}.
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02000FFC|7:
We'll soon see what he's hiding.{E108:0018} {E1D1}{E282}{E173:0000}It's just a matter of
time!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02001004|0: Alright,{E108:0008} {E282}tell me what you did once you arrived here!
sce2_c2_06.bytes|02001004|1:
Wh-What's the big idea!?{E108:0010} {E1D2}{E188:00310000}Why are you staring at me

I was simply assisting with the police's investigation as
a witness and bystander.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|15: Detective Gumshoe is entirely in the right.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|16:
Oh.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}He is, huh?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}So you're saying{E108:0008} {E284}I should give him a bonus instead?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|17: ...That's...{E108:0010} not what I'm saying at all.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|18: Hey,{E108:0008} I wouldn't mind a little salary bump!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|19:
Your compassion and generosity are truly
heart-warming, Eustace.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|20:
But we must take into account past transgressions
when making judgments that concern the future.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|21:
And I hereby judge Mr. Edgeworth and his associates...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}unfit to tread the hallowed ground of this scene.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|22: Wh-Whaaat!?{E108:0018} {E1D1}But we only just got here!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|23:
The Goddess of Justice has conferred her blessings on
Eustace,{E108:0008} and Eustace alone.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|24: By which you mean...{E108:0008} this is Mr. Winner's case?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|25:
That's exactly what she means!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}It's time for the warm-up act to get off the stage!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|26:
After all,{E108:0008} I solved this one already.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}I have a suspect
lined up and everything!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|27:
What did you say!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}A suspect!?{E108:0010} Already!?{E108:0010}
Wh-Who!?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001107|28: Who else but...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}your artist friend over there!?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|1:
Your guess is as good as mine.{E108:0010} I can't even begin to
imagine how the boy's mind works...
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|3:
Unsurprising that you {E284}lack the attitude to understand
the winning mindset!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|4:
("Lack the attitude"...?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Something tells me he doesn't
know the real winning turn of phrase.)
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|5:
...Well put, Eustace.{E108:0010} Mr. Edgeworth does indeed{E108:0008} {E285}lack a
certain aptitude.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|6:
Uh, yeah!{E108:0010} Exactly!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D9}Where's your aptitude,{E108:0010} smart guy?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|8:
Underestimate my information-gathering skills {E1D1}at your
own peril!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|9:
Before we came here,{E108:0008} we dropped by the medical
room to ask the doctor there a few questions.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|10: And he told me where the poison gas came from!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|12:
It was, uh...{E108:0010} It's this chemical you find everywhere,
uh...{E108:0010} {E284}{E107:0001}Can't think of the name just now, though.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|13: W-Wait there a second.{E108:0010} Let me just call him real quick.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|14:
Perhaps I can answer your question while Eustace is
on the telephone.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|15:
...Um,{E108:0008} why let him make the call if you know the
answer?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|16: The gas was created by mixing two specific chemicals.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|18: What kind of chemicals are they?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|19:
Ubiquium{E040} is a red liquid used in all manner of
everyday products.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|20:
Paint and dishwashing liquids, among various others.{E108:0018}
On its own,{E108:0008} it is entirely benign.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|21: ...So it's something anyone could get their hands on?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|22: Precisely.{E108:0010} But the same cannot be said for {E041}Asphyxion{E040}.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|23: That does sound nasty.{E108:0010} {E1D1}What is it used for?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|24:
It is the main ingredient in a product called {E284}{E1CB:008D00000000}"Infesticide
Ultra".
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|25:
It is pure white in color,{E108:0008} and is unavailable to the
average consumer.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|26:
In fact,{E108:0008} it is nigh impossible for members of the public
to obtain it here in this country.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|27:
As such,{E108:0008} we are currently investigating where it might
have come from.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|29:
...Don't waste your breath.{E108:0010} Judge Gavèlle informed us
already.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|30:
Huh!?{E108:0010} Oh, uh...{E108:0018} {E12F:00090005}great!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}That'll make this quicker, I guess!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|31:
So the source of the gas,{E108:0008} Ubiquium,{E108:0008} is used in paint
and stuff, right?
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|32:
And there was somebody here at the gallery today
who brought paints with them...
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|34: Y-You can't accuse me just because of that!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|35: Objection!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}To the paints on that palette in your hand!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|36: Uh, Edgey...{E108:0010} {E284}is this kid okay?{E108:0010} He seems a little...
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|37:
Indeed.{E108:0010} I haven't known him long,{E108:0008} but he's a little
prone to jumping to the wrong conclusions.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|38: Hey!{E108:0018} Quit talking about me like I'm not even here!
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|39:
Ignore them, Eustace.{E108:0010} They're simply intimidated by
you,{E108:0008} nothing more.
sce2_c2_08.bytes|02001124|40:
Why not give them yet another reason to fear you with
one of your winning deductions?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|1:
Our friend the artist here won the race to find the
victim,{E108:0008} and was first on the scene, correct?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|2:
And the gas the victim was poisoned with is made
from Ubiquium,{E108:0008} which, as we know,{E108:0008} is found in paint.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|3:
He was carrying paint on his person,{E108:0008} and he was one
winning stride away from the victim.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|4:
Which surely makes him the winner on our list of
suspects!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|5: ...Right, Gavèlle?{E108:0010} You think so too, right?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|6: ...It is a possibility that certainly can't be discounted.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|7:
Well?{E108:0010} {E1D1}Would the artist like to share his version of
events?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|8: Did you leave red paint at the scene of the crime?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|9:
...Or something more sinister?{E108:0010}
The catalyst for a cloud of toxic gas, perhaps?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|10:
Think I might have left my heart there, you know...{E108:0010}
{E285}And you might have picked it up.{E108:0008} Heh...
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|11: ...I would be careful what you say to me.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|12: My gavel is already primed to deliver a guilty verdict.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|13: Ignore him, please, Your Honor.{E108:0010} It's for the best.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|15:
You can't run away from the fact that my reasoning is
flawless!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|16:
So admit defeat and crawl on out of here with your
tails between your legs!{E108:0010} {E1D1}Because I win!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200115C|17:
Hah.{E108:0010} I have better things to do than pick holes in your
faulty logic.{E108:0010} But I don't suppose I have much choice...
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200116F|0:
Our friend the artist here won the race to find the
victim, and was first on the scene, correct?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001170|0:
And the gas the victim was poisoned with is made
from Ubiquium, which, as we know, is found in paint.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001171|0:
He was carrying paint on his person, and he was one
winning stride away from the victim.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001172|0:
Which surely makes him the winner on our list of
suspects!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001173|0: We know that Mr. Winner isn't much of a listener.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001173|1:
And we also know that {E284}his reasoning is likely to be
based on a flawed assumption.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001173|2:
Yeah,{E108:0008} he even phoned the other guy and he's still got
it wrong somehow!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001173|3:
(Let's get this over with as quickly as we can.{E108:0010}
It's a waste of all our time...)
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001177|0:
I'll be the first to admit that he's something of a
suspicious character.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001177|1:
"{E041}First{E040} to admit"...?{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}...Are you trying to {E041}beat me to it{E040}!?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001177|2:
But you can't!{E108:0010} Because I'M {E041}The Winner{E040}!{E108:0018}
I'm the {E041}first{E040}-rate!{E108:0010} Always!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001177|3: Huh?{E108:0010} I'm a {E041}first{E040}-rate artist, you say?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001177|4:
...Larry!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I don't need you to make this any more
convoluted than it already is!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200117D|0:
We do indeed.{E108:0010} It seems it's found in a number of
everyday products.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200117D|1:
Right!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Which makes your friend's paint pretty darned
{E1D1}suspicious!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200117D|2: But isn't it also found in a bunch of other stuff, too?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200117D|3:
Hm,{E108:0008} she has a {E041}winning{E040} point, I guess.{E108:0018}
{E12F:0009000B}...Right, Gavèlle?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200117D|4:
I suppose she does.{E108:0010} As I said,{E108:0008} Ubiquium is also found
in dishwashing liquids,{E108:0008} among other things.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200117D|5:
In other words,{E108:0008} paint isn't the only possible
explanation.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200117D|6:
N-No!{E108:0010} But...!{E108:0018} {E1D1}Just listen to the rest of my amazing
deduction, will you!?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001184|0:
It's by no means certain that paint was the source of
the poison gas.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001184|1:
Hah!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Well, it's by no means certain that it WASN'T,
either!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001184|3:
Copying Mr. Edgeworth's speaking style isn't a
shortcut to {E1D1}looking cool, you know!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001184|4:
...Hmph.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You make it sound as if you think there's
something wrong with how I speak.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001184|5:
Anyway!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}To bring it all home,{E108:0008} {E282}my winning deduction
shows he had paint,{E108:0008} and he was closest to the victim!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118A|0:
That's really all you're basing your suspicion of
Mr. Butz on?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118A|1: What?{E108:0010} You have a problem with that?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118A|2:
...Then show me some proof, loser!{E108:0018}
Put up or shut up!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118A|3: He's literally asking for it, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118A|4:
He is.{E108:0010} So let's find the right piece of evidence and
really give it to him.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118F|0: And what do you think of this piece of evidence?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118F|3:
It proves that there's a contradiction in your
testimony!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118F|5:
Calm yourself, Eustace.{E108:0010} His so-called evidence proves
nothing.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118F|7:
Yes...{E108:0010} Perhaps so.{E108:0010}
(If only Judge Gavèlle weren't here...)
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118F|8:
If you could try to ensure that there is some substance
to your interjections, Mr. Edgeworth...?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|0200118F|9:
Hmph.{E108:0010} Fear not, Your Honor,{E108:0008} for I intend to do just
that.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001199|0: I'm afraid you've contradicted yourself there!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001199|3:
The only contradictions I see are in Mr. Edgeworth's
own baseless claims.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001199|4:
Hah!{E108:0018} So my testimony's completely contradiction-free!{E108:0018}
I KNEW it!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001199|5:
Gnrk!{E108:0018}
(His testimony is riddled with contradictions!)
sce2_c2_09.bytes|02001199|6:
(If only Judge Gavèlle didn't keep covering for him,{E108:0008} I'd
be able to get to the truth...)
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|0:
Your deductions are anything but winning, I'm afraid.{E108:0010}
{E284}Unless you're looking to win a prize for incoherence.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|1: Heh.{E108:0010} So you agree that {E285}I deserve a prize?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|2: ...What you deserve{E108:0008} {E107:0002}is to be set right.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|3:
The gas came from within the case containing the
sculpture of Pisces.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|4: It did!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}And it was created by the artist guy!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|5: With the red paint that we know is full of Ubiquium!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|6:
Allow me to offer you a bit of advice,{E108:0008} one prosecutor to
another:{E108:0010} It always helps to listen carefully to others.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|7:
The gas is created when Ubiquium is mixed with
another substance --{E108:0010} Asphyxion.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|8:
Paint containing Ubiquium alone wouldn't create any
kind of gas at all!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|10:
I thought they said that the guy was {E284}"asphyxiated with
Ubiqium"?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|11:
...So you're telling me{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E280}all this was based on a
mishearing of the forensics report!?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|13:
The gas had already done its work by the time
Mr. Butz found the victim.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|14:
Perhaps it's your own aptitude you should be worrying
about!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|15: My "aptitude"!?{E108:0018} Wh-What does that even mean!?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|16: You literally used the word five minutes ago!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|17:
It means one's ability,{E108:0008} or how suited one is to a
particular task, Eustace.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|18:
And "attitude" --{E108:0008} the other word you misused only
minutes ago as well--{E108:0008} is another thing entirely.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|19:
.........{E107:0001}{E285}{E12F:0009000B}I get what you're doing.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You're making fun of me
again!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011A0|20:
What I am doing is demonstrating that you do not have
the aptitude required to head up this investigation.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|0:
Before you go any further,{E108:0008} you might wish to consider
some of the flaws in your own statements.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|2:
Firstly,{E108:0008} that you cannot prove your artist friend did
not enter the Autumn Wing.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|4:
And secondly,{E108:0008} that you cannot prove the red paint did
not have something to do with the crime.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|5: ...But the paint isn't important on its own, surely?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|6:
What's important is the combination of the {E041}red{E040}
Ubiquium with white Asphyxion...
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|7:
How exactly were the two substances introduced to
one another?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|8: Surely we need to figure that out before anything else?
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|10: And that is what Eustace will be investigating next.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|11:
...Or what he would already be investigating had you
not been here making needless trouble.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|12:
We are not here to make trouble.{E108:0010} Quite the opposite,
in fact.{E108:0010} We're here to help.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|13:
Are you saying you know how the gas was made?{E108:0010}
I don't believe you!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|14:
I can certainly point you toward {E1D1}a vital clue as to how
it was done.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|16:
It's fine, Gavèlle.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}He's clearly lying.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Might as well let
him talk himself even further into a corner.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011B5|18: Come on, then.{E108:0010} Show me what you've got!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011C8|0:
What shows how the gas was created, huh?{E040}{E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:007A0016}{E123:0000000000040000}{E112:0000}{E124:0001}{E100:0000}{E12F:00000008}{E101:00000000}{E107:0001}This piece of evidence shows pretty conclusively how
the gas was made.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011C8|1:
...You would be well advised to steer clear of
Mr. Edgeworth and his little theories, Eustace.
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011C8|2: They can cause dizziness,{E108:0008} nausea...{E108:0010} and perjury...
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011C8|5:
C'mon, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} Don't let them poison the
discourse!{E108:0010} You can do this!
sce2_c2_09.bytes|020011C8|6:
(I should have evidence somewhere of Ubiquium and
Asphyxion having been mixed...)
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|0:
You're saying this somehow shows us how the
chemicals were mixed to make the poison gas?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|1:
Heh.{E108:0010} That's exactly what I'm saying, yes.{E108:0010}
Thank you for noticing.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|2: Well,{E108:0008} they do say I have a good eye!
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|3: The red tears Mr. Butz saw --{E108:0010} that was the Ubiquium.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|5:
You're saying the statue CRIED the stuff out!?{E108:0010}
What,{E108:0008} so our culprit is some kind of evil spirit!?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|6:
(...How much time am I going to have to waste taking
him through this step by step?)
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|7:
The red tears alone would not have been enough to
create the gas.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|8:
They must have mixed with something else inside that
case.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|9:
What!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}And what evidence do you have that that's
what happened!?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011DC|10:
The evidence is right there in the sketch I just showed
you.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E7|0:
(I need to point out the part that shows that the two
liquids had mixed together...!)
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|0:
Observe the pool of pink liquid beneath the Pisces
statue's glass case.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|1: This clearly shows that the two chemicals mixed!
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|3:
How does that prove that some Ubiquium mixed with
some Asphyxion?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|4: We have an artist with us.{E108:0010} Why don't we ask him?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|5:
Larry,{E108:0010} you claim to be something of a painter.{E108:0010}
I imagine you have some experience mixing colors?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|6: ...What happens when you mix red with white?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|7:
Don't treat me like a dumb-dumb, Edgey!{E108:0010}
I did graduate from junior high, you know!
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|8: Any idiot knows that {E1D1}red and white make pink!
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|9:
I mean,{E108:0008} there's variations.{E108:0010} You got your rose pinks and
your baby pinks...
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|10: That will be more than enough, thank you.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|11: Do you see what I'm getting at now, Mr. Winner?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|13:
Ubiquium is red,{E108:0008} Asphyxion is white.{E108:0010}
Mix the two together...
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|14: And you get pink!{E108:0010} That's what the pink liquid is!
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|15:
Yes.{E108:0010} Very good.{E108:0010}
(We got there in the end...)
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|17: I think you finally convinced him.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|18:
Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0010} you have raised a possibility,{E108:0008} nothing
more.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|19:
We cannot know for sure that this shows the result of
the two chemicals having mixed.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|20:
And besides,{E108:0008} the sketch you are attempting to enter as
evidence was drawn by a suspect.
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|21: How can we possibly hope to rely on its veracity?
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|22:
Hey!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I drew everything exactly as I saw it!{E108:0018} A true artist
never lies or embellishes the truth!
sce2_c2_0a.bytes|020011E8|23: Forgive me,{E108:0010} {E1D1}but I did not ask for your opinion.
