pharmacist can offer,{E108:0008} at your service!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|5: Delicia to my pals,{E108:0008} and even Miss Delicious to some!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|6:
You can call me "The Winner".{E108:0010}
And I'll call YOU whatever I want.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|7:
Alright, Winniepooh!{E108:0010} Whatever you say!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}It's lovely to meet you, dearie!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|9:
Oh...{E108:0018}
Umm,{E108:0008} have we met before, young man?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|10:
Heh heh.{E108:0010} Get a load of this, Delicia!{E108:0010}
That's Miles Edgeworth!{E108:0008} Gregory's son!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|11:
Well,{E108:0010} I never!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}It's a pleasure to meet you, Milesy Smiles!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|12:
Nngh...{E108:0010} If you must address me by my given name,{E108:0008}
just "Miles" will do.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|13:
Ooh-hoo-hoo!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}Greggy Pegleg's boy?{E108:0010} And all grown up,
too!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Make me feel my age, why don't you?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013DD|14: (I wonder just how old she is...)
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|0:
Eustace,{E108:0008} I believe we have some questions for our
pharmacist?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|1:
Uh...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Oh, yeah!{E108:0018} {E12F:00090000}{E107:0002}What brings you to the gallery today,
Ms. Scone?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|2: Why,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I came to see dear old Moody Judy, of course!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|3:
We've been fast friends for eighteen long years,{E108:0008} and no
one's going to stop me visiting her now!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|4:
I understand that you helped look after Mr. Gusto in
the immediate aftermath of the attack?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|5:
Oh, I didn't do much, really.{E108:0010} Just whipped up a quick
antidote for the dear old doctor.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|6: Wow!{E108:0018} You can make an antidote just like that?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|7:
Oh yes, dear!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}As long as I have the right ingredients,{E108:0008}
{E107:0001}I can throw together just about any medicine you like!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|8:
It certainly helped that the medical room was {E1D1}well
equipped, though!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|9:
We were much better off treating him here than losing
vital minutes taking him to hospital.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|10:
Anyway,{E108:0008} we did what we could.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}The rest...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Well,{E108:0008} that's up to him.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|11: And do you know the victim, Miss Delicious?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|12:
Oh, yes!{E108:0010} Well,{E108:0008} sort of...{E108:0010}
It's been eighteen years since I last saw him.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|13:
Apparently,{E108:0008} he's famous these days!{E108:0010} One of the best
confectioners in the world,{E108:0008} or so they say.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|14:
Interesting...{E108:0018}{E112:0009}
{E12F:0009000B}{E107:0002}So he's a well-known public figure?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|15:
Oh yes, dear!{E108:0010} He was on the news and everything!{E108:0010}
Confectionery-crafting king of the world, they said!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013EC|16:
Wow.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}So the old dog really went to Zheng Fa and
upped his game,{E108:0008} just like he said he would.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|0:
Perhaps if we could proceed to the matter at hand.{E108:0010}
{E12F:0008000E}...Ms. Scone.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|1:
Are you familiar with a substance known as Infesticide
Ultra?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|3:
Ooh, it's awfully strong, though!{E108:0010}
That's why they don't sell it in the shops.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|4: Might I ask what you mean by{E108:0008} {E284}{E107:0003}"you-know-whats"?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|5:
The little blighters that frighten the life out of poor,{E108:0008}
innocent ladies like yours truly,{E108:0010} that's what!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|6:
...Ghastly little creatures!{E108:0010} Running around people's
nice,{E108:0008} clean kitchens and terrorizing them!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|8:
Thank you, Ms. Scone.{E108:0010}
One more question, if you don't mind:
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|9:
Are you aware of what happens when the chemicals
Asphyxion and Ubiquium are combined?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|11:
It's right there in the Infesticide Ultra instructions:{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E285}"Do
not mix with products containing Ubiquium!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Ever!"
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|12:
Because if you do,{E108:0008} they react with each other and
make a horrible,{E108:0008} poisonous gas!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|13:
What was it again?{E108:0010} "Effects of inhalation include
respiratory complications, and...{E108:0010} well, um...{E108:0010} {E1D9}{E12F:001F0003}death"...
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|14:
And poor old Gusty very nearly didn't make it.{E108:0010}
To make that much gas,{E108:0008} you'd need, ooh...
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|15: ...probably 500 ml of each chemical, I'd say.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|16: (She certainly talks like a skilled pharmacist...)
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|17:
Ubiquim's awfully thick and sticky,{E108:0008} and it heats up
very quickly indeed.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|18:
It's also bright red and smells minty-fresh.{E108:0010} Oh,{E108:0008} and
cheap as chips.{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E107:0001}That's why they use it in everything!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|19: Asphyxion's more watery,{E108:0008} and it's white in color.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|21: ...You are clearly well informed, Ms. Scone.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|22: As well I should be, dearie!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|23:
After all,{E108:0008} {E284}Infesticide Ultra is made by {E1D1}the company I
work for!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|25:
Oh,{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00340000}but before you get the wrong idea,{E108:0008} they don't go
around handing out free samples.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|26:
As I say,{E108:0008} it's awfully,{E108:0008} terribly dangerous!{E108:0010}
You couldn't buy it even if you wanted to.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|27:
Yes, Ms. Scone.{E108:0010} Very interesting indeed.{E108:0018}{E12F:00080001}
I think that tells us all we need to know.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|28: (Strange.{E108:0010} I thought she suspected Ms. Scone.)
sce2_c3_00.bytes|020013FD|29:
(But something in that smile makes me wonder if she
has some other angle in mind...)
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141B|0:
What is it, Detective Flatfoot?{E108:0010} Any developments to
report?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|0:
Turns out the sculptures' glass display cases open
from the top.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|2:
And the temperature inside can be adjusted, too.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}{E188:002F0000}All the way down to zero degrees.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|3:
The Pisces case was kept at 26 degrees.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Dang near got my hand stuck to it!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|4:
We're lucky you escaped alive!{E108:0018}{E12F:00090000}
{E107:0002}...Anything more relevant to the case?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|5:
Yeah.{E108:0010} They found something on the underside of the
top part of the Pisces case.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|8:
That's odd!{E108:0010} If there was Ubiquium stuck to it,{E108:0008} it should
have stayed stuck.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|9:
After all,{E108:0008} at 26 degrees,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it would have been frozen
solid!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|10:
It would, huh?{E108:0018} {E12F:0009000B}{E107:0003}So...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}how did things wind up as they
are now?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|11:
...I think Kay might be able to help us figure out just
that.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|13:
Heh!{E108:0010} You guys are that desperate to get on my good
side, huh?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|14:
Fine!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I don't know what the heck you're talking about,{E108:000C}
{E107:0001}{E280}but take it away!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200141D|15:
Can't believe I'm taking orders from this guy...{E108:0010}
{E12F:00020008}{E107:0001}But whatever --{E108:0010} {E282}anything for the truth!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|1:
The Goddess of Justice has no need of your help.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}We will find the truth ourselves.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|3:
Your baby prosecutor just gave us the big thumbs-up!{E108:0010}
What's the issue here?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|4:
Oooh, wait.{E108:0010} {E284}{E107:0002}Don't tell me the Committee has some
dirty little secret it doesn't want us finding out?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|5: ...I am not required to explain myself to you.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|6:
But if you feel that you absolutely must participate in
the investigation...
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|7:
...perhaps you can prove to me that it will be worth
our while to keep you around.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|8: (...What exactly does she have in mind here?)
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|9: Who triggered the release of the poison gas?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|10:
If you can answer this question,{E108:0008} I will consent to your
participation in the investigation.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|12: Somebody opened the Pisces case and let out that gas.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200142D|13:
Considering what we've learned so far,{E108:0008} there's only
one person it could possibly be, no?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200143C|0: In that case,{E108:0008} please kindly provide it now.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200143D|1:
And I have never been more certain of my decision to
overrule somebody.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200143D|3: I knew you were unworthy of--
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200143D|4:
Whoawhoawhoa!{E108:0010} Hold up, G!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Miles was just pulling your leg!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200143D|5:
Alright, Smiles.{E108:0010} Think over the situation one more
time.{E108:0010} The answer's crystal clear!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200143D|6:
There's only one person who was in this room when
the gas was released,{E108:0010} {E12F:000A0002}{E107:0002}{E1D5}amirite?
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200143D|8: Now then,{E108:0008} I ask you again...
sce2_c3_00.bytes|02001447|0:
The victim,{E108:0008} Carmelo Gusto,{E108:0008} is the only person to have
entered the Autumn Wing.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|02001447|1: Thus,{E108:0008} {E1D1}only he could have opened the case.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|02001447|2: ...Correct.{E108:0010} That appears to be the only logical answer.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|02001447|3:
Very well.{E108:0010} I will permit your participation in this
investigation to continue.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|02001447|4:
However...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}if at any point I feel you are contributing 
nothing of value,{E108:0008} you will be removed.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Immediately.
sce2_c3_00.bytes|02001447|6:
(Even if Mr. Gusto did open the case,{E108:0008} we still have no
idea why...)
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200144E|0:
Alright, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010}
Tell me what you wanna see!
sce2_c3_00.bytes|0200144E|1:
Let's use the data we've collected to recreate the scene
before the poison gas went off.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145C|1:
So this is what you were talking about...{E108:0010}
Your...{E108:0008} "Mr. Thief".
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145C|2: Let's begin by examining the Pisces sculpture.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|0:
There's a generous amount of Ubiquium frozen to the
underside of the top part of the case.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|1: Yeah,{E108:0008} which is what's keeping that lid on real tight.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|2: The actual glass lid is all cracked, though, right?
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|3:
Somebody really went to town on your little house
there,{E108:0010} huh, Pisces!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|4:
...And do we have any idea of how the glass lid might
have come to be so cracked?
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|5:
Uh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}Well,{E108:0008} it doesn't look like the outer-facing side of
the glass suffered any damage.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|6:
I see.{E108:0010} So we have a cracked piece of glass that we
know was ice cold on its inner-facing side.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|7:
And we also know that it wasn't damaged in any direct
way on its outer-facing surface.{E108:0010} Thoughts?
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|8:
Ice cold...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}makes me think of the way you glare at
people, sir!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|9:
Cracks...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}make me think about those deeply-etched
lines on your forehead!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|10:
...It was cracked by heat expansion.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Applying heat to
ice-cold glass from the outside will cause it to crack.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200145F|11:
Huh.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Well, I appreciate the science lesson,{E108:0008} but why's it
all heat-cracked in the first place?
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200146B|0:
Why indeed?{E108:0010} A heat-cracked glass lid,{E108:0008} lined on its
underside with frozen Ubiquium...
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200146B|1:
You look like the cat that got the cream, Milesarino.{E108:0010}
You know what happened, don't you?
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200146B|2:
I certainly do.{E108:0010} And what's more,{E108:0008} I know how Mr. Gusto
opened the case.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200146B|3:
What!?{E108:0018} {E1D1}But you didn't give me a chance to figure it out
first!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200146B|4: (It would have been quite the wait...)
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200146B|5:
Well?{E108:0018} Don't keep it to yourself, Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
I want answers!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001471|2:
You are right to be confused, Eustace.{E108:0010}
I fail to understand this myself.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001471|3:
In fact,{E108:0008} I would say that perhaps only Mr. Edgeworth
understands this leap of so-called "logic."
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001471|5:
(We have a glass lid that was cracked by heat,{E108:0008} and
some frozen Ubiquium...)
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001471|6:
(What Mr. Gusto did must be related to why the glass
cracked!)
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001471|7:
Heh.{E108:0018} You won't convince me without a {E1D1}winning
explanation, Edgeworth!{E108:0010} Now then!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200147A|0:
The blowtorch showed signs of having being used
recently when it was found here in the Autumn Wing.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200147A|1:
I think it's likely that it was used on the glass lid,{E108:0008}
causing it to crack.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200147A|2:
A blowtorch?{E108:0018}{E12F:0009000B}
{E107:0002}Who uses a blowtorch to open a glass case?
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200147A|4:
Mr. Gusto was trying to melt the frozen Ubiquium {E1D1}so
he could open the lid!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200147A|6:
Nngh...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}You beat me to the answer by a second!{E108:0018}{E12F:00090005}
{E280}But we'll see who wins in the end!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200147A|7:
Don't try and tell us you nearly had it.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}You didn't have a clue!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200147A|8:
Nuh-uh!{E108:0018} It was Edgeworth making things hard to
understand!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001483|0:
...Kay,{E108:0010} would you mind updating the re-creation so
that Mr. Winner can follow along, too?
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001483|1:
Sure, sure,{E108:0008} just for him...!{E108:0018}{E13E:0002}
Alright,{E108:0008} here goes!
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001483|2: Mr. Gusto was alone in the Autumn Wing.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001483|3: And while he was in here,{E108:0008} {E1CB:009B00020000}he used this blowtorch...
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001483|4:
...to melt the frozen Ubiqium on the underside of the
lid.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|02001489|0:
As the Ubiquium melted,{E108:0008} it mixed with the Asphyxion
that was already present inside the glass case...
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200148B|0:
When Mr. Gusto had finally managed to open the lid,{E108:0008}
he would've released the gas and poisoned himself.
sce2_c3_01.bytes|0200148B|1:
He made it as far as the fountain room, where he
collapsed.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DC|0: ...So he opened the case...{E108:0008} and out came the gas, huh...
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DC|1: (It seems we got there in the end.)
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|0:
But why the heck-a-doodle-doo did he want to open
the case in the first place?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|1:
I'm not sure.{E108:0010} In fact,{E108:0008} we don't even know what his
ultimate goal was.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|2:
I'm thinking he might've come here for the same
reason I did.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|3:
To check out not the Autumn Wing,{E108:0008} but the Winter
Wing.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|5:
You remember, right?{E108:0010} I thought this was where the
Winter Wing was when we first got here.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|6: Caught you out too, did it,{E108:0010} {E1D1}my little Eddie Lumpkin?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|7:
I was ever so confused,{E108:0008} what with it being where
Chillywinks's room was all those years ago!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|8:
There's even the same little tree in front of the blessed
door.{E108:0008} {E1D1}Who wouldn't be all at sixes and sevens, eh?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|9:
(Did everyone involved with the IS-7 Incident make
the same mistake...?)
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|10:
(I think we need to go and take another look at the
Winter Wing.)
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014DE|11:
(Time to see how quickly I can convince Mr. Winner,
I suppose.)
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EA|0:
Eureka!{E108:0018}
Ladies and gentlemen,{E108:0010} {E1D1}I have the answer!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|0: The man was going to end it all!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|1:
A dramatic,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}"Exit stage left!" sort of artsy-fartsy
farewell!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|3: ...Have you been listening at all this whole time?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|4:
Heh.{E108:0010} At my level,{E108:0008} I barely need to listen to a word,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}and
I still understand exactly half of what's going on!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|5:
Perhaps I can explain a few of the finer details to you
later, Eustace.{E108:0010} Winner's prerogative.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|7:
(Thank you, indeed.{E108:0010} I find it's always best to leave
things like child-wrangling to a professional.)
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|8:
In the meantime,{E108:0008} don't you have something to tell
Mr. Edgeworth and his friends?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|11:
Heh heh.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I took the liberty of investigating our friendly
pink pharmacist here.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|12: Or rather...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}I had one of my underlings do it for me!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|13: That's nothing to brag about, you know.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|15:
Anyway,{E108:0008} let's put a pin in my suicide theory for now.{E108:0010}
Yeah.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|16:
I have something more important to tell you.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}It's,{E108:0010} uh...
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|17: It was Miss Delicious who set up the poison gas trap!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|19: I was greatly saddened to learn of this, Ms. Scone.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|20:
Your profession is one dedicated to saving lives,{E108:0008} {E280}and
yet you used your expertise to try to take one!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|21:
I beg your pudding!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}How dare you!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}{E188:00310000}I did no such thing!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|22: Perhaps you could explain, Mr. Winner?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|24: This is Miss Delicious's pharmacist's license.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|25:
And it says it right here that she's authorized to
handle Infesticide Ultra!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|26:
...A product that we have established contains
Asphyxion,{E108:0008} one of the ingredients of our poison gas.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|28:
It's almost impossible for ordinary people to get a hold
of that stuff.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|29:
...But Miss Delicious is no ordinary person!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}She's a card-carrying pharmacist!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|30:
I,{E108:0008} {E281}I didn't do it!{E108:0018}{E12F:001F0003}
{E1D1}This is all just a terrible misunderstanding!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|32:
There was a bottle of Infesticide Ultra in the victim's
pocket!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|33:
And what do you know?{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}It's covered in YOUR fingerprints!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|35:
We know that you and Ms. Bound took the victim to
the medical room.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|020014EC|36:
What better moment to slip the bottle into his pocket,{E108:0008}
hm!?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|0:
There was only one person on the premises licensed to
carry Infesticide Ultra,{E108:0010} {E107:0003}and that was you, Ms. Scone.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|1:
Furthermore,{E108:0008} you are acquainted with Ms. Bound,{E108:0008} the
owner of the gallery.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|2:
Meaning you would have had access to the building,{E108:0008}
and ample opportunity to prepare your trap.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|3:
No, dear!{E108:0010} {E282}Listen,{E108:0008} you don't understand!{E108:0018}{E12F:001F0002}
{E107:0002}That Infesticide Ultra{E108:0008} {E284}was stolen from me!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|4: ...Lying will only lengthen your sentence, Ms. Scone.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|5:
I'm not lying!{E108:0028}
{E12F:001F0002}{E107:0002}Ohhh,{E108:0008} it's in my bag somewhere,{E108:0008} I'm sure of it!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|12: There's something written on it, I think?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|13:
"April 1:{E108:0008} Complaint filed.{E108:0010} Offense:{E108:0008} Theft.{E108:0010}
Items Stolen:{E108:0008} {E284}Infesticide Ultra,{E108:0008} one bottle."
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|14: It's a crime report!{E108:0010} Relating to a theft!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|16:
See,{E108:0008} you silly billies!{E108:0018} {E12F:001F0002}{E107:0002}I told you {E1D1}somebody pinched it
off me!{E108:0010} A week ago, no less!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|17:
By which you mean to say that...{E108:0010} {E284}it was not in your
possession at any point today?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|18:
That's exactly what I mean to say!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I think the bottle
you found might be the one I lost...
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|19:
I always have some in my medicine bag.{E108:0010}
Just in case, you know.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|20:
And I'm supposed to keep my bag locked up tight,
but...{E108:0010} well,{E108:0008} I'd forget my head if it wasn't screwed on.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|21:
And now,{E108:0008} thanks to silly old me,{E108:0008} {E1D9}someone's gone and
mixed up a cloud of poison gas with the stuff!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|22:
I see...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But why on earth would you carry such a
hazardous substance around with you?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|23:
Like I said,{E108:0008} just in case.{E108:0010} You never know when one of...{E108:0018}
{E12F:001F0003}{E1D1}One of...{E108:0010} {E1D1}THEM might appear!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|24:
You mean the{E108:0008} {E285}"ghastly little creatures that run around
in people's nice,{E108:0008} clean kitchens" type of "THEM"?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|28:
I think perhaps it might be wise to confirm the
authenticity of the crime report,{E108:0008} just to be safe.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|29:
It can't hurt to verify Ms. Scone's story, after all.{E108:0010}
She may be lying to us.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|30:
Good idea!{E108:0018} {E12F:00090005}{E107:0002}Alright,{E108:0008} I'm gonna go give the precinct a
call!{E108:0010} {E1D1}Don't go anywhere!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|31: So Ms. Scone might not be guilty after all.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|32:
Indeed.{E108:0010} If she really were the one who set up the
poison gas trap...
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|33:
...then I highly doubt she would have used a method
that directly implicates her.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|34: ...So who do you think did it, Smiles?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|35:
Someone with knowledge of the victim's likely
behavior...{E108:0010} and the time and the means to prepare.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|36: Two factors which point to one very specific person.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001513|37:
Oh yeah?{E108:0018} {E12F:000A0000}And who might that be?{E108:0020}
{E12F:000A0002}Don't leave us hanging, big guy!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001539|0:
Who had the means to steal the Infesticide Ultra and
dress one room up to look like another?{E040}{E106}{E163:00010001}{E100:0001}{E164:01200008}{E100:0000}{E12F:00000008}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}This person...{E108:0010} Probably.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001539|1:
...Uhh,{E108:0008} don't worry, champ.{E108:0010} We all get a little {E1D1}sleepy on
the job sometimes.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001539|2:
Hey,{E108:0008} I know what might wake you up --{E108:0010} embarrassing
childhood story time!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001539|4: Aww, c'mon!{E108:0020} {E12F:00020009}{E107:0002}I wanted to hear the rest!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001539|5:
(Who knew just how the victim was likely to behave?{E108:0010}
And who had the means to prepare ahead of time?)
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001539|6: (Only one person fits the bill here!)
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|0:
Surely only Ms. Bound,{E108:0008} the proprietor of these
premises,{E108:0008} could possibly have prepared in such a way!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|1:
We'll need some solid evidence to support such a
theory,{E108:0010} nonetheless...
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|5:
Whew!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}Nice shooting, Milesarino!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I might have to make
that associate position a permanent deal!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|6: ...That is NOT what I was hoping for!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|8:
The police have confirmed that the theft really was
reported and logged!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|9:
Which means...{E108:0010} we may have been a little hasty with
some of our conclusions, team!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|10:
Hmph.{E108:0010} You mean that every single one of your
conclusions proved to be hogwash!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|12: Oh?{E108:0010} Then what's our next move?
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|13:
W-Well,{E108:0010} {E1D1}uh...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}First we need to go and talk to Ms. Bound!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|15: And then...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I'll think about what to do after that!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|17:
Mr. Gusto's real destination appears to have been the
Winter Wing.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|18:
Perhaps it would be worth having someone investigate
that room more thoroughly.
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|19: Oh yeah!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}We should totally do that!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|20:
Flatfoot!{E108:0018}
Go investigate the Winter Wing!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|22: Gavèlle!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}We're going to talk to Ms. Bound!
sce2_c3_02.bytes|02001542|24: ...We'll join you,{E108:0008} if you don't mind.
sce2_c3_03.bytes|0200155C|1:
Alright,{E108:0008} you have your orders.{E108:0010}
Go talk to Bound for me!
sce2_c3_03.bytes|0200155C|2:
...Hey, Mr. Winner.{E108:0010} Weren't we going to go talk with
Ms. Bound ourselves?
sce2_c3_03.bytes|0200155C|3:
Sure.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But I thought,{E108:0008} why not let the grunts handle the
grunt work,{E108:0008} you know?
sce2_c3_03.bytes|0200155C|4:
Means I can just sit back and wait for their report.{E108:0010}
{E284}A winning strategy!
sce2_c3_03.bytes|0200155C|6:
Ugh,{E108:0008} he's sooo exhausting.{E108:0018}
I need a break...
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001568|0:
Order!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}Order in the court!{E108:0018}{E150:00090021}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Somebody call forensics!
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001568|2: ORDER!{E108:0018} I will have order, Detective!
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001568|3: Th-The ice sculptures in the Winter Wing...
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001571|0: What is the meaning of this!?
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001571|2:
Eesh...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Talk about déjà vu...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It's just like eighteen years
ago.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Even the ice's melted again!
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001571|4:
...This is like some weird rerun.{E108:0010}
Same people,{E108:0008} same...{E108:0010} everything.
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001571|5:
I said it before, and I'll say it again --{E108:0008} {E1D1}this is no
coinkydink.{E108:0010} You're with me,{E108:0008} right, Milesarino?
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001571|7: And I think the answers lie in the IS-7 Incident itself.
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001571|9:
Heh.{E108:0010} Great minds think alike.{E108:0018}
Alrighty then...
sce2_c3_03.bytes|02001571|10: Time for another trip down Memory Lane...
sce2_c4_00.bytes|020015DC|0:
I still can't believe the IS-7 Incident was Gregory's last
case.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Or that it's been eighteen long years since...
sce2_c4_00.bytes|020015DC|1:
A murder at a confectionery contest,{E108:0008} and of one of the
participants, no less.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Artie Frost...
sce2_c4_00.bytes|020015DC|2:
They pulled his body out of a treasure chest that was a
part of Samson Tangaroa's chocolate tableau.
sce2_c4_00.bytes|020015DC|3:
He'd been hit in the head with a large rock salt lamp,{E108:0008}
and subsequently bled to death.
sce2_c4_00.bytes|020015DC|4:
We found the lamp hidden inside the candy castle
Delicia Scone had made for the contest.
sce2_c4_00.bytes|020015DC|5:
But then...{E108:0010} before anyone had the chance to investigate
Mr. Frost's own room...
sce2_c4_00.bytes|020015DC|6: ...all of his icy creations had melted clean away.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|1:
(Mr. von Karma wasn't very happy.{E108:0010}
He told us to get out --{E108:0008} and in no uncertain terms.)
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|2: So what do we do now, Mr. E?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|3:
I can't believe he just up and kicked us out!{E108:0018}
Von Karma's a total jerk!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|4:
Now, now, Eddie.{E108:0010} It was always the job of the police
and the prosecutor's office to investigate the scene.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|5: Yeah,{E108:0008} but he didn't have to talk to us like that!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|6:
Who cares if we're cops or attorneys?{E108:0010} {E107:0001}We should all be
working together to find the truth!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|7:
You can't assume that everybody's aims are the same
as your own.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|8:
You may wish to expose the truth,{E108:0008} but others might
prefer to accept things at face value.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|9:
Which way of thinking is "right" will depend on the
person.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|10:
But what if somebody innocent ends up behind bars
because {E1D9}no one managed to uncover the truth!?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|11:
It can happen.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}We're all human --{E108:0008} police and
prosecutors included.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|13:
Our job is to help people in just such situations.{E108:0010}
To be friends to the friendless.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|15:
Now,{E108:0008} we may not be able to investigate Mr. Frost's
room as hoped...{E108:0010} but that doesn't mean we give up.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|17:
You're right, Mr. E!{E108:0010} I'm sorry.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I should have thought
more before I opened my big mouth!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|18: Heh.{E108:0010} You're young, Eddie.{E108:0010} You'll learn soon enough.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|0200165D|20:
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} Mr. Fender.{E13E:001E}{E108:0018}{E150:001F0005}{E155:000500000001}{E155:002000000001}
You look like you could use a little pick-me-up.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|0: I'm afraid this is all I have.{E108:0010} But please,{E108:0008} by all means.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|3:
(A little sugar boost might actually help.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Although
these are a little too sweet for my liking...)
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|5: ...I'm sorry if they're not to your taste.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|6: No way,{E108:0010} they're great!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}They're so, so...{E108:0010} sweet!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|8:
*sigh*{E108:0010} Imagine --{E108:0010} me, of all people,{E108:0008} a mediocre
confectioner!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|9: What!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E12F:001E0008}{E1D1}You mean you made these yourself?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|10: Yes.{E108:0010} Samson loves chocolate,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}so I had to learn!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|11:
Keeping him supplied with his favorite treats is just
one of my many duties!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|12:
...Although he does spend most of the time coaching
me on how to improve my technique.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|13: Mr. Tangaroa sure is a lucky guy...
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|14:
Getting to eat homemade sweets made by the one and
only Judy Bound whenever he wants sounds amazing.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|15:
Hm?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}I'm sorry,{E108:0010} did you say something?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|17:
(Dear,{E108:0008} sweet Eddie...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You really do still have a lot to
learn.)
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|18:
It seems you're quite committed to the work you do
for Mr. Tangaroa, Ms. Bound.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|19:
Of course.{E108:0010} {E284}What right would I have to stay here
otherwise?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|20: What do you mean by that?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|21:
I was abandoned as a baby.{E108:0010} And Mr. Tangaroa took me
in.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|23:
That's right.{E108:0010} One snowy Christmas Eve,{E108:0008} many years
ago,{E108:0010} he found me on the steps of this very mansion.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|24: He saved my life...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}and became the father I never had.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|26:
So my work for him is the least I can do.{E108:0010}
And I'll be here for him for as long as he needs me.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|27: That's...{E108:0018} {E12F:001E0001}the most beautiful thing I've ever heard...!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|30: And to think today is Christmas Eve...
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|31: ...and I can't even give him his present in person...
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|32: I'd do anything to save him!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}Anything!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|33: Please,{E108:0008} if there's something I can do to help,{E108:0008} just say it!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|35:
Perhaps you could help us by answering a question:{E108:0010}
Did you know the victim?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001672|37:
Oh,{E108:0008} but if you wanted to see some of his work,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I have
a picture of the sculptures he made for the final!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|1: Aren't they!?{E108:0018} I think they're masterpieces!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|2:
Who would have thought you could make such
{E1D1}intricate statues out of flavored ice!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|5:
...I didn't know you were keen on constellations and
the zodiac, Eddie.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|6: Oh, I love it!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The stories those stars can tell!
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|7:
Take Gemini, for example.{E108:0010} See the lyre?{E108:0010} That's what
the harp is called.{E108:0010} And the arrow and the--
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|8: ...Hold up --{E108:0010} the lyre doesn't have any strings.
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|9: Huh...{E108:0010} Did Mr. Frost forget to add them, maybe?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|10: That doesn't sound like something he'd forget to do...
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|11:
Wait,{E108:0008} really?{E108:0018} But I thought you just said you didn't
know him very well...?
sce2_c4_01.bytes|02001699|13: (...It seems she's got something to hide, too.)
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|0: You took this photograph yourself, Ms. Bound?
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|1: Yes,{E108:0010} {E1CB:007D00000000}I used this instant camera here.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|2:
It develops the pictures as soon as you take them.{E108:0010}
It's so useful!
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|3: Ooh!{E108:0010} I'd love to see it in action.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|4: Hee hee.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Then why don't I take your picture?
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|5:
Yesss!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}C'mon, Mr. E!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}Let's get a shot of the both of us!
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|6:
Well...{E108:0010} alright, then.{E108:0018}
{E285}{E12F:00050005}(It would be a shame to waste a good hair day...)
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|8:
There,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}all done!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}And the picture's yours to keep, Mr. Fender.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|9:
Oh my gosh,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}thank you so much!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}...That's such a cool camera.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|10:
Well,{E108:0008} it's the only one we've got,{E108:0008} so we use it for all our
picture taking needs.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|11:
It's very convenient, but...{E108:0008} the lack of negatives is
something of a shame.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016DC|12:
(So there aren't any negatives for us to reference,
huh...)
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016E9|0:
I assume Mr. Tangaroa used {E1D1}this same camera during
the contest?
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016E9|2:
He used it for some work-in-progress pictures of his
seascape.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016E9|3:
And later,{E108:0008} to take some photos of the other
contestants' works.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016E9|4:
...?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}But didn't you take a picture of the body when you
discovered it?
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016E9|5:
And didn't you discover the body while the judging
was still underway?
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016E9|6:
Ah, yes.{E108:0010} Samson wanted pictures of all the entrants'
completed rooms.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016E9|7:
But the film ran out just as he finished photographing
Mr. Gusto's work.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016F1|0: So he asked me to go put in a new cartridge.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016F1|1:
He seemed to think there should have been more shots
left than there were...
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016F1|2:
In other words,{E108:0008} the film ran out sooner than
expected?
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016F1|3:
Yes.{E108:0008} The number of shots he took didn't line up with
the number of shots remaining.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016F1|4:
But...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}he thought maybe he'd just lost track somewhere
along the way.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016F7|0:
I went to our living area to change the film,{E108:0008} and was
passing through the fountain room on my way back...
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016F7|1:
...when I heard the sound of something break and
collapse in Samson's room.
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016FB|0: Mr. Frost's body was...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}just lying there...
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016FB|1: I was in total shock.{E108:0010} It was all too much...
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016FB|2:
But I remember, I...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I called the police,{E108:0008} and then I went
to tell everybody else...
sce2_c4_02.bytes|020016FB|3: And the camera...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}it's been with me ever since.
sce2_c4_03.bytes|0200175C|1:
I'd be grateful if you could lend us the camera and
this picture, Ms. Bound.
sce2_c4_03.bytes|0200175C|4:
Instant Camera added
to the Court Record.{E106}{E1CF}{E108:001E}{E158:007E}{E1CE:007E}{E100:0000}{E101:FFFF003F}{E042}{E107:0002}Mr. Frost's Room added
to the Court Record.
sce2_c4_03.bytes|02001762|0:
Detective Badd!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Ms. Scone!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Are they done investigating?
sce2_c4_03.bytes|02001762|1:
They're done with me,{E108:0008} that's for certain!{E108:0010}
The big meanie told me to clear off!
sce2_c4_03.bytes|02001762|2:
Honestly,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}that Mannikins will be the end of me!{E108:0010}

Mr. Tangaroa...)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A5C|3: I'm so sorry {E150:001F001C}about what happened yesterday.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A5C|5: Has Mr. von Karma finished interrogating you?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A5C|6:
Yes,{E108:0008} though he really only seemed interested in how I
melted those sculptures.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A5C|7: Are you here to see Mr. Tangaroa, too?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A5C|8: Yes...{E108:0010} I'm terribly worried about him.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|0: Detective Badd...?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}What are you doing back there?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|1:
Oh...{E108:0008} just happened to be here.{E108:0010}
...I'll be heading back to the scene soon.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|2:
Not sure how anyone just "happens" to be at a
detention center, but okaaay...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|6:
Oh...{E108:0010} Oh no!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Samson!{E108:0018} {E1D1}What did they DO to you!?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|7: They...{E108:0008} didn't seem to want to let me sleep...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|8: I had no idea interrogations could be so...{E108:0008} involved...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|9:
Sorry if I seem distracted.{E108:0010} I think I'm a little...{E108:0008} {E1D1}*yawn*{E108:0008}
tired...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|11:
That's not police work,{E108:0008} that's torture!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}What's going on here, Detective Badd!?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|12:
...I'm not the one doing the interviewing.{E108:0010}
It's the guy they put on the case before me...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|13:
I like von Karma's methods about as much as you do...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Which is why I'm doing what I can to help.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|14: It was Detective Badd who got me out of there.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|15:
I'd still be in that interrogation room right now...{E108:0008} if it
weren't for him...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A65|17:
(Detective Badd really is trying to look out for
Mr. Tangaroa in his own way, it seems...)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A77|0:
Alright, Eddie.{E108:0010}
Let's share yesterday's findings with Mr. Tangaroa.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A77|1:
You got it, Mr. E!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}My notepad is at the ready!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A79|0:
Mr. Tangaroa,{E108:0010} we found out quite a bit, if you'd like to
hear it...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A79|2:
Are you alright, Mr. Tangaroa?{E108:0010}
You seem kinda...{E108:0008} spaced out.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A79|3:
I'm fine,{E108:0010} I just...{E108:0010} I think my blood sugar might be
running a little low...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A79|5:
(Do we have anything that might give him a little
energy boost?)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A7F|2: You're kinda swaying all over the place...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A7F|3:
I'm sorry...{E108:0010} Like I said...{E108:0008} I think my blood sugar might
be running a little low...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A7F|4:
(Do we have anything that might give him a little
energy boost?)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A84|0:
You're quite sure it was the lyre you tasted when you
sampled Mr. Frost's work?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A84|1:
I'm certain of it.{E108:0010} It was part of the Gemini sculpture,{E108:0008}
which was the only sculpture in that display case.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A84|2:
...Mr. Tangaroa.{E108:0010} Would you mind taking a look at this
photograph for me?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A84|3:
So the part you tried was the lyre?{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}The one shown here without any strings?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A84|5: That was the part I ate.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|0:
(So the strings were missing because Mr. Tangaroa ate
them all?{E108:0010} And he...{E108:0008} enjoyed them...?)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|1: Ms. Scone told us she ate a part of the lyre as well...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|2: But she said {E284}it was far too salty for her to finish.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|4:
The truth is,{E108:0008} I've...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}suspected for a while that there
might be something wrong with my sense of taste.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|6:
There's a taste disorder characterized by {E041}an inability
to detect salty flavors{E040}.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|7: And I suspect...{E108:0010} I've been suffering from it.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|8:
I eat so many sweet foods on a daily basis that it took
a while for me to even notice.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|9: But there's no denying it now.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|10:
(That would explain why the food here seemed so
bland to him...)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|11: What!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}But your tastebuds are your livelihood!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|12:
...Even if there were some long-term treatment option,{E108:0008}
I highly doubt a total cure for your condition exists.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|13:
Nevertheless,{E108:0008} you should put in a request to the police
for a proper evaluation.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|15: ...I have a recipe for a cure back at my mansion.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|17: I do.{E108:0010} You can take a look at it for yourself, if you like.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|18: Samson!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}We can't show that recipe to just anybody...!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|19:
Judy,{E108:0008} Mr. Edgeworth is hardly "just anybody".{E108:0010}
He's my attorney,{E108:0008} and I have no secrets from him.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001A8A|21:
(What on earth is this secret "recipe" for a miracle cure
that they've been hiding?)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|0:
What can you tell me about the contestants who took
part in the final round of the contest?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|1:
Let's see...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}There was Ms. Scone.{E108:0010}
I loved her design concept...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|2:
Unfortunately,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}her entry was in violation of the rules,{E108:0008}
and so I had to disqualify her.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|3:
Mr. Gusto's creations were a perfect balance of flavor
and design.{E108:0010} At least,{E108:0008} up through the semifinal.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|4:
But, disappointingly,{E108:0008} his entry for the final was
sub-par on {E1D1}both counts.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|5:
And...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}{E284}there was actually something a little unusual
about his entry for the semifinal as well.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|7: It tasted identical to Mr. Frost's.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|8:
...They may have looked different,{E108:0008} but I could've
sworn I was eating the same thing.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|9: Huh...?{E108:0018} And what exactly did his work look like?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|10:
Oh...{E108:0010} There should be a photograph back at my
mansion.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|11: I'll show it to you later, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|13:
But Mr. Frost's entry for the finals --{E108:0010} that was truly
sublime.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|14: Hm...?{E108:0018} So you were able to finish judging it?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|15:
Even though his body had been discovered in the
meantime?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|16:
Yes.{E108:0010} I wasn't aware of what had happened until after
I'd completed my assessment.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|17:
Mr. Frost wasn't in his room when I visited,{E108:0008} so I took
the liberty of sampling a bit.{E108:0010} Part of the lyre, I believe.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|18:
I'd never tasted anything like it!{E108:0010} It was like a dream!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I was so moved that I burst into song!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|19:
!{E108:0018} I'm sorry,{E108:0008} but are you saying that the lyre...{E108:0008} tasted
good?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AA0|20: I'd like to hear more about that, if you don't mind.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AB5|0: ...I'm not sure I see anything out of the ordinary.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AB5|1:
(Mr. Tangaroa is exhausted from the interrogation.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}I should try to avoid causing him unnecessary stress.)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AB5|2: Actually,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}don't worry about it.{E108:0010} It's not important.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AB5|3: In fact,{E108:0008} you can just forget about it entirely.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AB5|4:
I'll try...{E108:0010} But you've worried me a little, I have to
confess...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABA|0: Thank you for agreeing to represent me.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABA|1:
...The set of scales on my badge represents justice and
fairness, Mr. Tangaroa.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABA|2:
If you truly are innocent,{E108:0008} {E1D1}justice will be served.{E108:0010}
We will see to it that you get a fair trial.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABA|3:
But until then,{E108:0008} I'm going to need you to sit tight and
trust me.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABA|4:
I will,{E108:0008} and I do.{E108:0018}
Thank you.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABF|0:
So the grand prize is the title of {E284}"World's Greatest
Confectioner"?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABF|1:
But you're already known as the greatest in the world.{E108:0010}
Do you really need to codify it into a title?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABF|2:
It's not about that.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Titles are an honor, of course.{E108:0010}
And it's flattering to be held in such high regard.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABF|3:
But I'm in this to test myself.{E108:0010} I can't rest on my laurels.{E108:0010}
An artist needs to grow,{E108:0008} and keep on growing.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ABF|4:
That's why I can't ever stop.{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E285}I'll never stop competing.{E108:0010}
With myself or with others.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC5|0: Did you buy this teapot yourself, Mr. Tangaroa?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC5|1:
No,{E108:0008} it was a present from Judy.{E108:0010}
It's a Paul Halique original.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC5|2:
I've been a fan of his ever since I first laid eyes on his
work during one of my trips overseas.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC5|3: (He seems so delighted by this conversation...)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC9|0: That's the camera I gave Judy for her birthday.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC9|1:
Ah,{E108:0008} I see.{E108:0010} That explains why she carries it around with
her everywhere.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC9|2:
I was worried she wouldn't like it.{E108:0010} I didn't know if it
was maybe a little...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}tacky.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC9|3:
You can imagine how relieved I was to see her take to
it so enthusiastically.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC9|4: (Probably because it was a gift from you...)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AC9|5: (But I suppose it'd be quite...{E108:0010} tacky to say so out loud.)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ACF|1: Oh,{E108:0008} those are the chocolates I...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ACF|2: I wish I could just give them to you, Mr. Tangaroa...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ACF|3: ...but the rules here don't exactly allow me to do so.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ACF|4:
Oh...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}That's a shame...{E108:0010}
But...{E108:0008} rules are rules, I suppose...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ACF|6: There must be SOME way we can hand them to him...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ACF|7:
(...I hope Detective Badd is noting the meaningful
looks in his direction.)
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ACF|9:
...Lemme take a look at them.{E108:0010} If they seem legit...{E108:0008} I
might consider passing them on to the suspect.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ADD|1: You don't know how much this means to me...!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ADD|2:
Yeah, yeah...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Keep it down, will ya?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}...For both our sakes.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ADD|3:
Of course, Detective.{E108:0010} I wouldn't wish to put your
livelihood at risk.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ADD|5: Detective,{E108:000C} I apologize for putting you in a tight spot.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ADD|7: Heh heh!{E108:0010} Guess you're not such a{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}Badd guy after all!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001ADD|9: Hah hah...{E108:0010} Were they your handiwork, Judy?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|0:
Heh heh.{E108:0010} They're not exactly beautiful...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}but they're
sweet and oh, so flavorful!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Thank you, Judy.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|1:
!{E108:0018}{E172:00390001}
I'm so glad you like them!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|2: ...And I'm glad you're back to your old self.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|4: The food they serve here is just so flavorless.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|5:
Between that and the lack of sleep,{E108:0008} I was about ready
to collapse from sheer despair.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|6: Wow.{E108:0010} {E284}Is the food here really all that bad?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|7:
...Just the usual.{E108:0010} French fries,{E108:0008} ham sandwich...{E108:0010}
Stuff like that.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|8: Yes...{E108:0010} And yet,{E108:0008} I couldn't taste a thing...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|11:
Before you go, Detective,{E108:000C} do you have any new
information to share?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|12: ...Oh, yeah.{E108:0010} You were right about the victim's identity.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|13: Frost worked as a sculptor in France...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AEB|14: ...where he was known as Paul Halique.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|3:
So the famous French sculptor wasn't a Frenchman
after all, huh.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|4:
This all would certainly explain why "Mr. Halique" was
such a recluse and refused to show his face in public.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|5:
He was busy working on his greatest masterpiece,
apparently...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Bunch of zodiac statues...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|7: He never finished his greatest masterpiece?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|8: Nah...{E108:0010} Seems he was making statues for each season...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|9:
But...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}he never got around to...{E108:0008} the winter
constellations.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|10:
The winter constellations...?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}You mean...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Taurus and
Gemini?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|11:
So the two he made out of ice would have completed
the set.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|12:
Yeah...{E108:0008} and now they're nothing but puddles.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}What a bummer...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|14: Oh no, Ms. Bound!{E108:0010} I wasn't blaming you!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|15:
One last thing...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Seems he had himself a bit of a
spending habit when it came to his work...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|16: Every statue...{E108:0008} cost him millions to make.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|17: Which means...{E108:0008} he was always strapped for cash.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|18:
We're checking to see if there's any chance someone...{E108:0008}
called in a debt.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|19:
I guess not even famous artists are safe from money
problems...
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001AFA|20:
Do you have any idea{E108:0008} {E284}why he entered the
confectionery contest?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B11|1:
I'll go fetch another guard...{E108:0010}
But I can't be hanging around here any longer.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B11|2: Understood, Detective.{E108:0010} We'll see you again shortly.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B11|5:
And an uncompromising one.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Somebody who can be
trusted to stand up for what he believes in.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B11|6: And to scare the pants off of anybody new he meets!
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B11|7:
Heh...{E108:0010} Now,{E108:0010} you were going to tell me about what you
learned yesterday?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B11|8: Of course.{E108:0010} Allow me to give you a full report.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B1A|0:
Thank you for that...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}And allow me to apologize on
Judy's behalf.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B1A|2:
It's fine, Mr. Tangaroa.{E108:0010} As I told her yesterday,{E108:0008} the
important thing is that we learned the truth in the end.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B1A|3: Now,{E108:0010} would you mind if I ask you a question or two?
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B1A|4: By all means.{E108:0010} I'll gladly share all that I can.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B1F|0: Well...{E108:0010} {E150:001F0020}I suppose I should be getting back.
sce2_c5_00.bytes|02001B1F|1: Alright.{E108:0010} We'll be right behind you.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B5C|0: There's...{E108:0018} {E107:0003}There's more to life than just me.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B5C|2: Please, Judy.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Think about the life you want to live.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B5C|3: Because I won't always be around...
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B5C|5: Without you,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I don't have a life to live!
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B5C|6:
So I'll be waiting.{E108:0010} Right there at the mansion.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Until you come home...!
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|0:
Whoa...{E108:0010} She seemed {E1D1}really upset!{E108:0010}
I thought I saw tears in her eyes!
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|1: Why'd you even say all that to her?
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|3: She can't keep putting my needs ahead of her own.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|6:
It's all because she thinks these things will make me
happy.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|8:
She never thinks about what she wants.{E108:0010}
What she likes.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|9:
...I just want her to be her own person and to choose
her own destiny.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|10:
The last thing I want is for her to miss out on all that
life has to offer because of me.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|11: I...{E108:0010} I guess that makes sense...
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|12: (He really does see her as his own child...)
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|13:
(What parent wouldn't want their child to walk their
own path?)
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|14:
(And what parent...{E108:0010} wouldn't do {E1D1}everything they could
to protect them?)
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|15: (I know exactly how he feels in this moment...)
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|16:
I think I've asked of you everything I can for now,
Mr. Tangaroa.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|17: We should be getting back to the scene of the crime.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|19:
I...{E108:0010} suppose I'll be going back to the interrogation room
for...{E108:0010} {E1D1}another session...
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|20: Ah, yes.{E108:0010} We'll have to do something about that.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|21: You'll speak to the police for me?
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|22:
That too,{E108:0010} {E284}but I'll be putting something else in place as
well.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|23: ...An ace up our sleeve for when the time comes.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|24:
Heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I look forward to learning more.{E108:0018}
I'm counting on you, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|25: We'll be back to brief you, Mr. Tangaroa!{E108:0010} {E282}Every day!
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|27: Thank you, Eddie.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'll look forward to it.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|28:
...Mr. Tangaroa.{E108:0010} Your interrogator will do everything
in his power to extract a confession from you.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|29: I hate to see an innocent man suffer like this...
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|30:
...but please,{E108:0010} you have to do everything you can to
hold out.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|31:
If you can't,{E108:0008} {E1D1}Mr. von Karma will use that confession
against you for as long as this case lasts.
sce2_c5_01.bytes|02001B66|32:
