So yeah....{E108:0010} Could be he made that thing, too.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EDC|2:
(Speaking of Santa...{E108:0010} that reminds me,{E108:0008} I still need to
find a present for Miles.)
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EDC|4:
(I wonder if Mr. Tangaroa would make one out of
candy for me if I asked...)
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE1|0: That's the door...{E108:0008} to Gusto's room.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE1|1: I guess the candy reindeer is meant to show the way.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE1|2: Big antlers like that...{E108:0010} Must be a bull...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE1|3: I think not.{E108:0010} Male reindeer shed their antlers in winter.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE1|4: Therefore,{E108:0008} this must be a female.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE1|6:
(They don't teach you about reindeer in law school,
Detective...)
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE8|1:
...Awarded to Tangaroa...{E108:0010} "First Place,{E108:0008} International
Confectioners' Association Annual Spectacular".
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE8|2:
It's made of candy.{E108:0010}
...I guess it wasn't meant to last forever.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE8|3:
Makes sense...{E108:0010} Prizes,{E108:0008} fame...{E108:0010}
None of it lasts forever, right?
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EE8|4: (I doubt it's anything quite that deep...)
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EED|1:
The second floor...{E108:0010}
Tangaroa and Bound live up there...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EED|2:
Sounds like...{E108:0008} they live a pretty charmed life.{E108:0010}
Tea parties,{E108:0008} candy-making,{E108:0008} that kinda thing...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EED|3:
They even have a garden...{E108:0010}
Must be nice on a sunny day...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EED|4:
That does sound nice.{E108:0010} Perhaps they'll invite us when
all this is over.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EED|6:
...Don't get ahead of yourself, now.{E108:0010}
I'm not in the habit of palling around with attorneys...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EF4|0: These trophies all belong to Mr. Tangaroa.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EF4|1:
But they're not all for confectionery contests.{E108:0010}
Some appear to be for charity work.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EF4|2:
A testament to both his character and his professional
achievements.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EF4|4:
"In recognition of Bake 'n' Bop's longstanding
achievement in making children's dreams come true".
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EF4|5: That's so sweet,{E108:0008} it's got me wanting to watch it...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EFA|1:
It's marked by a snowman.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E285}...A candy snowman,{E108:0008} by the look of it.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EFA|3:
(He's really sizing it up...{E108:0018} {E107:0003}He...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}isn't thinking of making
that into his next lollipop, is he?)
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EFE|0: It's a Christmas tree made from candy.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EFE|1: These candy statues...{E108:0008} have everybody on edge...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EFE|2: If ants get in here...{E108:0008} {E1D9}that's our scene ruined...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001EFE|3: (Yes,{E108:0008} it would be pretty disastrous, I suppose.)
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F02|0:
It seems these instruments are used on Mr. Tangaroa
and Ms. Bound's TV show, "Bake 'n' Bop".
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F02|1:
They're some of the few things in here that aren't
made of candy.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F02|3:
Is it just me,{E108:0008} or does the detective seem a little
disappointed...?
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F06|0:
There's a lyre here.{E108:0010} And some maracas designed to
look like ice cream cones.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F06|1:
They're so well made that it's hard to tell what's candy
and what's not just by looking.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F06|2:
I'd reach out and touch them...{E108:0010} but then I'd be
disturbing the crime scene.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F06|3:
Hands off.{E108:0010} I already checked them out...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}They're real...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F06|4:
Checked them out how, exactly?{E108:0018}
{E188:002F0000}Did you manhandle vital evidence, Detective?
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F06|5:
I didn't touch them.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}...Not with my hands, at least.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F0D|0:
There's a drum set here decorated to look as if it were
made out of cakes.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F0D|1: They must play it on "Bake 'n' Bop".
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F0D|3:
...We already checked...{E108:0010} There's nothing inside any of
them.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F0D|4:
And no sign of anything having been put inside or
taken out, either.{E108:0010} {E285}They're not relevant to the case.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F0D|5: ...You've already done your homework, I see.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F0D|6:
Heh.{E108:0010} I may like lollipops a little too much...{E108:0010} {E282}but I'm no
sucker.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F14|0:
The statues on the fountain depict cherubs enjoying
some chocolate fondue.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F14|2:
Gotta hand it to him.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}...They look so real...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F14|3:
Detective,{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}are you saying you have personally seen
cherubs before?
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F14|4:
...Tsk.{E108:0010} Attorneys.{E108:0018}
{E188:00340000}{E1D2}Always poking holes in people's words...
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F1A|0:
This sign shows which artist's work is on display in
which room.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F1A|1:
From left to right...{E108:0010} Mr. Tangaroa,{E108:0008} Mr. Gusto,{E108:0008}
Ms. Scone,{E108:0008} and Mr. Frost.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F1A|2: Incidentally,{E108:0008} this sign is also made from candy.
sce2_c5_m0c_check.bytes|02001F1A|3:
...What were they going to do with all this candy?{E108:0010} Was
somebody going to eat it when the contest was over?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|0: Excuse me,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}may I ask what you're investigating?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|1:
Sir!{E108:0018} I'm analyzing the fountain water {E1D1}to see what might
be in it, sir!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|3:
Chocolate{E108:0010} and what looks like the kind of flavorings
and colorings used in frozen desserts, sir.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|4:
The composition of the chocolate seems to be the same
as that of Mr. Tangaroa's work.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|5:
And the flavorings and colorings {E285}{E041}match the profile{E040} of
those used in Mr. Frost's ice sculptures.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|6:
Those little rivers flow from all four artists' rooms
right here to this fountain...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|7:
Guess that's how the stuff from the melted sculptures...{E108:0008}
wound up in there.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|8: And that's not all, sir!{E108:0010} {E280}We also found blood!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|9: ...What?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Why is there blood in the water...!?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|10:
Think back to our investigation of the murder scene,
Detective.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|11:
Take another look at the scene in front of us,
Detective.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|12:
A very conspicuous {E041}pool of blood{E040} that should be here
is clearly missing!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|14:
You're right.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Don't remember anybody mentioning
they'd removed the blood along with the body...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|15: The victim's blood was mysteriously absent...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F5C|16:
...as was the part of the chocolate chest it had pooled
on.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F6E|0: I believe that the blood probably belonged to...{E040}{E106}{E19C}{E163:00010001}{E100:0001}{E164:011D0003}{E100:0000}{E12F:00050006}{E101:00050005}{E107:0002}I think the blood belonged to this person...?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F6E|1: And I think...{E108:0008} all this blood...{E108:0008} {E1D1}is going to your head...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F6E|5:
(We know of only one person who suffered extensive
hemorrhaging...!)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F75|1:
I'll have the guy compare it....{E108:0008} with the blood on the
murder weapon.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F75|2: ...It's a match.{E108:0010} The blood in the fountain...{E108:0008} is Frost's.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F75|3:
(But why would someone want to send the victim's
blood downstream and into the fountain like this?)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F75|4:
Victim's Blood added
to the Court Record.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7A|0:
(He's busy investigating the fountain.{E108:0010} I probably
shouldn't disturb him again.)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7A|1:
(Traces of Mr. Frost's blood were found in the
fountain water...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7A|2:
(But why would someone want to send the victim's
blood downstream and into the fountain like this?)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|0:
Ms. Bound.{E108:0010}{E156:0005002E001F0000}
We're here to continue our investigation.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|1:
Oh,{E108:0008} Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}{E156:001F001F00050000}
{E107:0003}I'm so sorry about earlier.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|2: She's...{E108:0008} still looking kinda down in the dumps, Mr. E.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|3:
(She must've been greatly taken aback by what
Mr. Tangaroa had to say...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|4:
...I found the photograph of the semifinal entries for
you.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|6: Wow!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Ms. Scone sure knows how to make a cute cake!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|7: Yes.{E108:0010} Samson loved her design for that one.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|8:
And he loved the designs and flavors of Mr. Gusto and
Mr. Frost's entries, too.{E108:0010} Only problem was...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|9:
...as Samson mentioned earlier,{E108:0008} {E284}they tasted exactly
the same.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|10:
However,{E108:0008} their respective entries for the final tasted
nothing alike, it seems.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|11:
...Was there anything else of note that changed
between the semifinal and the final?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|12: Nothing major,{E108:0008} but I guess there was one thing...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|13:
Mr. Gusto's son was always here with him throughout
the contest...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|14: ...but he was nowhere to be seen during the final.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|15:
(Why would his son come and hang out at a contest
venue of all places...?)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|16: You're sure you're happy for us to keep hold of this?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|17: Of course.{E108:0010} I hope it helps with your investigation.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|18:
Semifinal Entries added
to the Court Record.{E106}{E1CF}{E100:0000}{E101:001D001E}{E107:0002}Oh,{E108:0010} {E12F:001D0007}{E107:0002}{E1CB:008400000000}and I also have the book containing the recipe for
the cure Samson mentioned.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|20: It was in the chocolate frame...{E108:0008} in Tangaroa's room...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|21:
That's right.{E108:0010} He put it on display there so that
everybody could see the grand prize.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|22: What!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}The cure is in the {E041}ultimate cookbook{E040}?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|23: So it's...{E108:0010} {E1D9}not a book of dessert recipes, I take it?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|24: Oh, no.{E108:0010} We told the contestants, of course.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|25: But I guess nobody told you yet...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|26:
(So the contestants all knew what the ultimate
cookbook was this whole time...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F7D|27:
Ultimate Cookbook added
to the Court Record.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F9A|0:
I'd like to hear more about the cookbook, if you don't
mind, Ms. Bound.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F9B|0:
That's an interesting badge, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
Does it mean something?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F9B|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} It means that I'm an attorney.{E108:0010}
It's for easy identification purposes that I wear it.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F9B|2:
I see.{E108:0010} I guess that must be quite useful.{E108:0010} Perhaps there
should be a confectioner's badge, too.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F9B|3:
Or a murderer's badge.{E108:0010} I'm sure that would save you a
lot of trouble.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001F9B|4:
...Well, they don't get badges...{E108:0010} but they do get
bracelets.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA0|0:
I still can't believe that Artie Frost and Paul Halique
were the same person...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA0|1: But tell me,{E108:0008} can you prove that you didn't know?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA0|2: I...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}I suppose that would be quite difficult.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA0|3: But why would I need to?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA0|5:
(I've got to stop doing that to people.{E108:0010}
Too much work on the brain is what this is...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA6|1:
Not only did I melt Mr. Frost's work,{E108:0008} I even lied about
it!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA6|2:
I wouldn't worry about it, Ms. Bound.{E108:0010}
Who among us hasn't lied at one time or another?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA6|3:
And as long as there are people like me,{E108:0010} {E282}{E107:0001}those lies
won't go undiscovered.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA6|4:
M-Mr. Edgeworth...!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}You look very serious all of a
sudden.{E108:0010} It's a little...{E108:0008} frightening, I must say...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA6|5:
...Those who would cover up the heinous crime of
murder with lies are the truly frightening ones.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA6|6:
So true...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Oh, you simply must do whatever you can to
uncover their dastardly lies and bring them to justice.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FA6|7: You can count on me, Ms. Bound.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FAE|0: I was hoping to ask your opinion on this, Ms. Bound...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FAE|3:
But I don't know...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}What that's abooout!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|0:
So if I understand correctly,{E108:0008} the ultimate cookbook is
actually a collection of recipes for different medicines?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|1:
Exactly.{E108:0010} Or rather,{E108:0008} {E041}totally new medications that
haven't made it to market yet{E040},{E108:0008} to be precise.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|2:
To the right buyer --{E108:0008} a pharmaceutical company, for
example --{E108:0008} it would be worth a fortune.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|3:
But...{E108:0010} why make that the grand prize in a
confectionery contest...?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|4:
Mr. Tangaroa is {E285}the sole heir to the Tangaroa family
fortune.{E108:0010} Perhaps you've heard of the Tangaroa Group?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|5:
The...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}{E1D1}Tangaroa Group?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Yeah,{E108:0008} I think I've heard of them somewhere before...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|6:
...It's a major pharmaceutical corporation.{E108:0010} Sells all
kinds of pills and poisons...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|7:
Oh yeah!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}That new {E041}Coldkiller Pro{E040} has been making
some real waves since it went on sale!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|8:
I always reach for a Coldkiller when I'm feeling under
the weather!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|9: (Which is...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}never, as far as I've seen...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FB5|10:
I'd like to hear more about the Tangaroa Group, if you
don't mind.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|0:
So did Mr. Tangaroa not want to take over for his
parents and go into the family business?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|1:
No...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}He preferred the idea of making people's lives
better through the power of confectionery.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|2:
And his parents supported him in his quest to become
the best in the world.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|3:
Then, when they passed away,{E108:0008} he inherited the
cookbook.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|4:
But why would he make such a valuable heirloom a
mere contest prize?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|5:
He's been hounded by so many people looking to make
that book their own.{E108:0010} He was tired of it.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|6:
But it would have been an insult to his parents'
memory simply to give it away.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|7:
So he decided to find somebody he felt was worthy of
it.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|8: I'll bet the board of directors loved that...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|9:
Handing over the fruits of all their expensive
research...{E108:0008} to someone else...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|11: Which is why Delicia entered the contest.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|12:
The Tangaroa Group wanted her to win the book back
for them.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|13:
!{E108:0020}
So you knew she was a pharmacist all along?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|14:
...Yes.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}And not only that...{E108:0008} I told her how to appeal to
Samson's tastes.{E108:0010} I...{E108:0008} I tried to help her win.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|16:
I wanted to protect Samson...{E108:0010} by protecting the
Tangaroa Group.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|17:
If that cookbook fell into another company's hands,
the board would never forgive him.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|18:
So I wanted to find a way to keep it with the company,{E108:0008}
but in a way that Samson couldn't object to.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|19:
(So that's how Ms. Scone managed to make it so far in
a contest she had no business taking part in...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|20:
But Ms. Scone wasn't the only one pretending, was
she?{E108:0010} {E1D1}Mr. Frost wasn't really a confectioner, either.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|21:
And he still made it all the way to the final,{E108:0008} just like
she did.{E108:0010} Not bad.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|22:
Yes,{E108:0008} it's unbelievable, isn't it?{E108:0010} Such a talented sculptor,{E108:0008}
{E1D1}and a gifted crafter of desserts, too!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|23:
(Gifted indeed,{E108:0008} judging by the standard of his work in
the final...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FC0|24:
(But how did one man produce pieces of that size and
quality in such a short period of time...?)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FD9|0: I'm not sure I have much more to tell you...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FD9|1:
But if there's anything else I can help you with,{E108:0008} I'd be
happy to, of course.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FD9|2:
(...She's certainly very keen to ensure that she does all
she can for Mr. Tangaroa.)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FD9|3:
I could certainly use a cup of the tea you made us
yesterday, if you wouldn't mind.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FD9|4:
I think that might help move the investigation along
nicely.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FD9|5:
Ooh, I'll have some, too!{E108:0018}
Your tea is to die for, {E1D1}Ms. Bound!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FD9|6:
...Well!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}How could I possibly refuse?{E108:0010}
I'll bring it right out!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FD9|7: You know,{E108:000C} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I think that cheered her up a little!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE1|0:
Authorized personnel only beyond this point, I'm
afraid.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE1|2:
S-Sorry, sir!{E108:0018}
No authorized personnel either!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE1|4:
Let me guess...{E108:0010} von Karma's orders...?{E108:0018}
{E282}Guy's really starting to grind my gears...!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE6|0: A moment of your time, Eddie?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE8|0: Do you have any thoughts on the case?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE8|2:
Mr. Tangaroa's amazing display being used to store {E1D1}the
body...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE8|3:
Ms. Scone's beautiful dreamscape being used to store
{E1D1}the murder weapon...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE8|4:
*sigh*{E108:0018} {E107:0002}We're really seeing some beautiful things beng
used for ugly purposes on this case, huh?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE8|6:
And to make things worse,{E108:0008} Ms. Bound seems super
down...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE8|7:
When I asked if you had any thoughts on the case,{E108:0008}
I was thinking more about useful insights...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FE8|8:
...Oh, uh,{E108:0008} sorry, Mr. E.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Did I do something wrong?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|0:
How are you liking your first crime scene
investigation, Eddie?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|1:
Oh, it's great!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I've been taking notes about everything!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}And I'm learning so much!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|2: I'm so happy you let me tag along, {E1D1}Mr. Edgeworth!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|3: ...So you want to be an attorney, huh...?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|4:
You bet I do!{E108:0010} I'd give anything to be {E188:00300000}{E1D5}a hero of justice --{E108:0008}
to help the helpless and fight for what's right!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|5:
The first time I saw Mr. E. do his thing in court,{E108:0008} I knew
I'd found my calling!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|6: You know...{E108:0010} cops look out for people, too...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|7: Uh, sure...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}But I want to be an attorney!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FF2|9:
(I get the feeling Detective Badd might be pining for an
apprentice of his own...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FFC|0:
A real attorney's badge!{E108:0010} I'll have one of my own one
day,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}just you wait and see!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FFC|1:
Well,{E108:0008} just remember that the scales represent justice
and fairness.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FFC|2: It's not enough to simply wear the badge.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FFC|3: Your job is to prove yourself worthy of wearing it.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02001FFC|5: (And I should make sure to set a worthy example...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002002|0: I wouldn't mind having a tea set this fine for myself!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002002|1:
Sorry, Eddie.{E108:0010} I wish we had something nicer at the
office than bitter old coffee.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002002|2:
My tea-making efforts are focused on the home.{E108:0010}
My son is something of a fan, you see.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002002|3: D-Don't get me wrong, Mr. E!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I love your coffee!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002002|4:
Blacker than a moonless night,{E108:0008} hotter and more bitter
than Hell itself...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002002|5: Ooh, that coffee...{E108:0010} It's strong.{E108:0010} {E1D1}So...{E108:0008} {E280}so strong...!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002002|6: (...Perhaps I should bring some tea into the office, too.)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002009|0:
Ms. Scone sure had some {E1D1}amazing gimmicks to help
make her work stand out, huh?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002009|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} Sadly,{E108:0008} they were all in flagrant violation of the
rules.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002009|2:
She said she loves stuff like that.{E108:0010} Her...{E108:0008} "trinkets",
I think she called them?
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002009|3:
Pillows that light up,{E108:0008} dresses that light up,{E108:0008} sunglasses
that light up...{E108:0010} They're supposed to be super relaxing.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002009|4: They don't sound very relaxing to me...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|0200200E|0: Hard to believe they're made from flavored ice...
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|0200200E|1:
They're certainly very impressive works.{E108:0010} But there's
something about them that makes me...{E108:0010} uncomfortable.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|0200200E|2:
(But what is it?{E108:0010} I just can't shake the feeling that
something is wrong here...)
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|0200200E|3:
Something that makes you uncomfortable?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E285}Ohhh,{E108:0008} I get it.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|0200200E|4:
I guess it does seem like a waste to eat something so
pretty...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}but that's just the way the cookie crumbles.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|0200200E|6:
And they didn't crumble.{E108:0010} They melted not long after
Ms. Scone and Mr. Tangaroa sampled them.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|0200200E|7: Uh...{E108:0010} That was a joke, Mr. E...!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002016|0:
Hm...{E108:0010} This looks like a vital piece of evidence.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}Let me just take a note!
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002016|1: ...I was hoping you might have an opinion to offer.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002016|2:
Uh...{E108:0010} Sorry, Mr. E.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}It's going to take me a while to digest this.
sce2_c5_m0c_npc.bytes|02002016|3:
(Both he and his note still have a long ways to go,
I suppose...)
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200205D|0:
...Attorneys are bad luck...{E108:0010}
Nothing good ever happens with you guys around...
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200205D|1: You trample the scene...{E108:0008} {E1D1}jump to conclusions...
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200205D|2: You really think that of all of us?{E108:0010} Me included?
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002062|0:
...What a weird seal.{E108:0010}
If you use it like a stamp,{E108:0008} it'd come out as {E284}"{E041}PH{E040}", right?
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002062|1:
But if it's just for show like a ring,{E108:0008} it appears to say...{E108:0010}
{E285}"{E041}H9{E040}", I believe?
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002062|2:
"H9"...{E108:0010} Hit...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}nine, maybe?{E108:0010} Someone's hitting streak...?{E108:0010}
Nah.{E108:0010} Seems unlikely...
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002062|3:
(It sounds like Detective Badd might be a fan of
baseball...?)
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002066|0:
This case,{E108:0008} it's...{E108:0010} Well...{E108:0010}
I can't get my head around a few parts of it.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002066|1:
If you wouldn't mind,{E108:0008} I'd like some more information
about the scene of the crime.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002066|2:
Sure...{E108:0010} You got legs, don't you?{E108:0010}
Try using them...
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002066|4:
Our duties may differ, Detective,{E108:0008} but we both want
to get to the bottom of what happened, don't we?
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002066|5: Wouldn't it be better if we worked together?
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002066|7:
(The detective clearly sees himself as the strong silent
type.)
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002066|8: (...I suppose that is also "how the pros do it".)
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200206F|0: Seems the culprit...{E108:0008} made sure to wear gloves...
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200206F|1: Couldn't lift squat...{E108:0008} from those finger marks.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200206F|2:
But perhaps you can extrapolate something about the
their owner from the size of their fingers, for example?
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200206F|3:
...It's not as easy as it sounds.{E108:0018} Sorry,{E108:0008} but these finger
marks...{E108:0008} are pretty worthless as evidence goes.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200206F|4: There's no need to be hasty, Detective.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200206F|5:
After all,{E108:0008} {E1D1}even the absence of fingerprints tells us
something of interest, don't you think?
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200206F|6:
Hmph.{E108:0010} You lawyers have an answer for everything,
don't you...
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200206F|7: Heh.{E108:0010} I'll take that as a compliment.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002077|0:
There seems little doubt that this is the murder
weapon.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002077|1:
Whacking a guy with something like this...{E108:0010}
Makes me think it was a spur of the moment thing.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002077|2:
And who had easy access to the lamp...?{E108:0010}
Our little lady friend...{E108:0008} that's who.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002077|3: Something's rotten in this house of candied sweets.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|02002077|4: (Hmm...{E108:0010} Could Ms. Scone be hiding something?)
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207C|0: I'd like your opinion on this, if you don't mind.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207C|1:
...I do...{E108:0018}
If there's one thing I hate...{E108:0008} it's small talk...
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207C|2:
(It seems he only cares about things that are directly
related to the incident.)
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207F|0: Any thoughts on the case, Detective?
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207F|1:
...Officially,{E108:0008} as a cop?{E108:0010} My thoughts are...{E108:0008} von Karma's
right about everything.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207F|2:
But...{E108:0008} as myself,{E108:0010} I'm not happy.{E108:0010} We need to investigate
more.{E108:0010} Here and elsewhere.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207F|3:
I put a word in for you...{E108:0008} with forensics...{E108:0010}
Ask the guy whatever you want.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207F|4: Much appreciated.{E108:0010} I am in your debt, Detective Badd.
sce2_c5_partner.bytes|0200207F|5:
Hmph...{E108:0010} I didn't do it for you.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I did it for the
investigation.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|0:
...And that's pretty much how things went down.{E108:0010}
Those are the facts of IS-7 as far as I'm concerned.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|1:
(I'm finally learning the truth about my father's last
case...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|2: So what happened at the trial?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|3:
Well...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}we lost.{E108:0010}
Von Karma did a real number on us.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|4:
Really!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You couldn't prove that Mr. Tangaroa was
innocent?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|5:
Oh, we could prove it alright.{E108:0010} Had a decent little pile
of evidence in our favor.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|6:
Problem was,{E108:000C} we underestimated von Karma.{E108:0010}
He fought even dirtier than we'd feared.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|7:
I can imagine...{E108:0010} Secure a conviction at all costs.{E108:0010}
That was always his guiding principle.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|9:
Anyhoo,{E108:0008} the trial dragged on and on...{E108:0010}
Whole thing took about a year in the end.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|10:
I'll never forget the day the verdict came down.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}December 28th that following year...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200215D|11:
It's April now, so...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Ooh, mama.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E285}We're talking over seventeen years ago.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|0:
(December 28th...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I was there that day seventeen
years ago,{E108:0008} sitting in the courtroom gallery...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|1:
Just before the trial got started,{E108:0008} Gregory noticed that
Samson was looking even worse than usual.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|2:
Turns out the poor guy had finally reached his limit.{E108:0010}
It was so bad,{E108:0008} even said he wanted to be found guilty...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|3:
Wait...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}You mean...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}They forced a confession out of him...?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|4:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Von Karma got what he'd been pushing for from
the very beginning.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|5:
And when Gregory tried to drop the bombshell about
there being no body to speak of...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|6:
...he learned that von Karma had used the power of
the police {E188:00340000}{E1D1}to head him off at the pass.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|7:
...{E108:0010}{E107:0003}{E1D1}Even had himself a fake autopsy report.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}But that wasn't the end of it.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|8:
Von Karma had gotten Samson to falsely testify against
himself to being an accessory to murder in court.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|9:
Combined with his confession,{E108:0008} the poor guy's goose
was well and truly cooked.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200216A|10: But Gregory still had {E188:00300000}{E1D1}his ace in the hole, though.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002175|0:
The same "{E041}ace{E040}" he asked Detective Badd to help him
with?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002175|1:
Exactamundo.{E108:0010} He knew he needed one last card to
play if they squeezed a confession out of Samson.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002175|2: So he had Badd record all of Samson's interrogations.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002175|3:
I guess Detective Badd really wanted to know the
truth, too, huh?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002175|4:
We all did.{E108:0010} But he was a trooper.{E108:0010} Stayed with the case
even after von Karma took him off of it.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002175|5:
He was tied up in some other big case, too...{E108:0018} Good old
Badd.{E108:0010} {E1D1}They don't make 'em like that anymore.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|0:
Anyway,{E108:0008} Gregory presented the recordings as proof
that Samson's confession was coerced.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|1:
And you know what?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}It almost worked.{E108:0010}
A cop named Ian Sideman got fired.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|2:
Samson's interrogator and the initial detective before
Badd,{E108:0008} he took the fall for pretty much the whole thing.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|3: ...But von Karma didn't get away scot free.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|4: In fact,{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}he was disciplined by the Chief Prosecutor.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|5: For the one and only time{E108:0010} in his forty-year career.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|6:
Still,{E108:0008} Samson himself couldn't stomach another day in
court.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|7:
So when that guilty verdict came down,{E108:0008} it didn't just
signal the end of that day,{E108:0010} {E1D1}but of the whole sad affair.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|8:
(I don't remember a lot myself,{E108:0008} but my father's face
when they declared Mr. Tangaroa guilty...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200217B|9:
(I was a young child at the time,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but even I could tell
how much he was hurting inside.)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002185|0:
Gregory wanted to appeal the ruling, of course.{E108:0010}
He would've done anything to clear Samson's name.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002185|1: But then...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Well, you know what happened next.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002185|2: Poor guy...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}He never got the chance...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002188|1:
I should have left with him that day.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}I'll always blame myself for not doing that.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002188|2:
But I shoved that aside and obsessed over something
else instead...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002188|3:
...Or rather,{E108:0008} someone else.{E108:0018} I hated what you did.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Hated you for choosing to stick with von Karma.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|1:
No...{E108:0018}
You had every right to hate me.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|2:
I went on to become a prosecutor as planned,{E108:0010} and
that's when Mr. von Karma showed me this case file.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|3:
According to these records,{E108:0008} Mr. Tangaroa was
convicted as the main culprit in Mr. Frost's murder.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|5: Samson was convicted as an {E188:00300000}{E041}accessory{E040} to murder.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|6:
Strange...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1CB:008200020000}The file clearly states that he was {E1D1}the
{E041}perpetrator{E040}.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|7:
Plus,{E108:0008} I'm fairly certain that all of Mr. von Karma's
cases were successfully solved.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|8: ...Mind if I take a peek at those?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|9:
!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}...This file's been doctored.{E108:0010}
The part about the verdict --{E108:0008} it's been changed.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200218C|11: Here,{E108:0008} feast your peepers on this.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|02002198|1:
That's a copy of the file they have on record at the
courthouse.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200219A|0: Then why is my copy so {E1D1}different...?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200219A|1: Well...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}you said it came from von Karma, yeah?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200219A|2:
My guess is he didn't want Gregory's son thinking
there was a murderer out there still at large.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200219A|3:
Didn't want you looking into it again before the statute
of limitations was up.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200219A|4: So everything I believed about the case{E108:0010} was {E1D1}a lie...?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200219A|5:
.........{E107:0002}Like they say,{E108:0008} we all gotta start somewhere.{E108:0010}
{E1D5}What's important is you know what's what now.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|0200219A|7:
The statue of limitations may have run out,{E108:0008} but the
truth's still out there, you know?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|0: I inherited Samson's case when your old man passed.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|1: Prosecution handed it off to somebody else, too.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|2:
The great von Karma wasn't going to bother facing off
against a rookie like me, was he?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|3:
Anyway,{E108:0008} long story short,{E108:0008} the killer was never found...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}and Samson was found guilty instead.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|4:
That's terrible!{E108:0018} Is there really nothing we can do to
help him!?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|5:
Not without the real perp, I'm afraid.{E108:0010}
Until then,{E108:0008} his confession stands.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|6:
Speaking of which,{E108:0008} I didn't find out until after the
verdict had been handed down, but...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|7:
...von Karma had threatened Samson and made him a
deal.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|8:
Told him {E041}if he didn't confess,{E108:0010} {E107:0003}he'd make sure Judy was
convicted instead{E040}...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|10:
Samson knew there was no way Judy could've done it,
of course.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|11:
But he wasn't going to take any chances.{E108:0010} So he did
what he was told and confessed to keep her safe.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|13:
Why do you think your Uncle Eddie just happened to
be in the prison the day Bronco Knight died?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|15: You were there to see Mr. Tangaroa...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|16:
Bingo.{E108:0010} Judy and I both promised we'd visit him every
day.{E108:0010} I didn't quite keep that promise...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|17:
But Judy did.{E108:0010} She never missed one visit in all these
years.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|18: Come rain or shine,{E108:0008} she always showed up.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021A2|19:
But none of that changes the fact that Samson is still
being unduly punished day after day.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|0:
How heartbreaking...!{E108:0018}
We've got to do something, Mr. Fender!
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|1: Well, kiddo,{E108:0008} that's actually why we came here.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|2:
The {E041}ice sculptures{E040} are back on display,{E108:0008} just like they
were all those years ago.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|3:
And we're going to see what we can find out.{E108:0010}
Right, Milesarino?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|4:
I'm a prosecutor, Fender.{E108:0010} I don't look at these things in
the same way as you or my father.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|6:
But that doesn't matter right now.{E108:0010} Speaking not as a
prosecutor, but as Miles Edgeworth...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|7:
...I want to know the truth behind both of these cases.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}And I'm not leaving until I do.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|8:
Heh heh!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You really are ol' Gregory's son,{E108:0008} through and
through.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|9:
Alrighty, then!{E108:0010} Now that that's sorted,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}we can really
get to work!
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|10:
Good thing I brought the IS-7 case file and evidence
with me today, huh!
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|11:
Here.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Documents first.{E108:0010} Who doesn't love paperwork,
amirite?
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|12: The parts in {E041}red ink{E040} are my "annotations".
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|14: And here's some evidence for ya.{E108:0010} Enjoy!
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|15:
There's quite a few,{E108:0008} so I'd take a minute to scope them
out if I were you.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|16:
Small mountain of evidence from the IS-7 Incident
received from Fender.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|17:
Y-Yes...{E108:0010} I see.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00000001}(I'll take a look at them in a bit...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|18:
You know,{E108:0008} our current case is just full of loose
threads, too,{E108:0008} come to think of it.
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021B6|20:
The key players of that incident eighteen years ago
who just happen to get caught up in another incident...
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021CC|0:
(The ice sculptures in the Winter Wing that are perfect
replicas of the ones from eighteen years ago...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021CC|1:
(The poison gas attack in the Autumn Wing,{E108:0008} which has
been disguised to look like the Winter Wing...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021CC|2:
(The two chemicals that were found inside the Pisces
statue's display case,{E108:0008} Ubiquium and Asphyxion...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021CC|3: (...that form a poisonous gas when mixed together...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021CC|4:
(The victim of the gas attack Carmelo Gusto,{E108:0008} who is no
stranger to the events of eighteen years ago...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021CC|5:
(...and who is still unconscious,{E108:0008} and undergoing
treatment in the medical room...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021CC|6:
(And finally,{E108:0008} we come to the body floating face down
in the fountain...)
sce2_c6_00.bytes|020021CC|7:
(...and the fact that the ice sculptures have melted --{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}just as they did all those years ago...)
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|0:
The events of the present day would appear to be
intimately linked with the events of the past.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|1:
Which means they may be able to help us learn more
about what happened eighteen years ago.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|2: Sounds good to me.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}Let's get investigating!
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|3:
Oh, no you don't!{E108:0018}
Aren't you forgetting somebody!?
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|4: I could've sworn this is MY investigation?
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|5:
Eustace is quite right.{E108:0010} I do hope you aren't intending to
obstruct him in his duties, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|6:
I would hate to have to add a{E108:0008} {E188:00350000}"GUILTY" to my report
to the Committee.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|8:
Of course not.{E108:0010} I am simply offering once again to do
what I can to help with this investigation.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|9: Your offer is duly noted.{E108:0010} {E12F:00080001}And duly declined.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|11:
The identity of the body from the fountain is currently
being ascertained.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|12:
It is only a matter of time until we have all the
information we need.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|13: ...Perhaps I can help you speed that process along.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|14:
I think I have an idea of who our mystery victim might
be.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021DC|15:
What?{E108:0010} Really!?{E108:0018}
Then you have to tell me!{E108:0010} It's the law!
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021ED|0:
(Maybe it isn't just the ice sculptures that have
resurfaced after eighteen years...)
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021EE|0:
(The body in the fountain may also be a visitor from
the past!){E106}{E163:00010001}{E100:0001}{E164:011E0005}{E100:0000}{E12F:00000009}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}There is a strong possibility that this is our victim!
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021EE|2:
That is utter nonsense, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I thought I
warned you not to obstruct this investigation!
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021EE|4:
Hyeh heh heh!{E108:0010} Thought you could pull a fast one, huh!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I knew that was a total shot in the dark!
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021EE|5:
(Your unbridled,{E108:0008} "Yes, I see" earlier would suggest
otherwise...!)
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021EE|7:
(What if it isn't just the ice sculptures that have
resurfaced after eighteen years...?)
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|0:
I believe the body in the fountain is that of the man
who was murdered here eighteen years ago.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|2:
WHAAAAAAT!?{E108:0018}
{E12F:001F0003}{E1D1}You're saying that was poor Chillywinks!?
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|3:
Wait, wait,{E108:0010} who the heck is Chillywinks, or...{E108:0010} Artie,
or...{E108:0018} whoever it is you're talking about!?
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|4: Artie Frost was a famous sculptor, Eustace.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|5: Although he was better known as Paul Halique.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|6: The sculptures on display here are all his works.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|7:
No way...{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}{E107:0002}Sounds like he did well for himself.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Always good to encounter a fellow winner!
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|8: ...Mr. Frost was also the victim in the IS-7 Incident.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|10: (Judge Gavèlle knows about the IS-7 Incident?)
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|11:
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} The IS-7 Incident is an
eighteen-year-old case.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|12:
And according to police records,{E108:0008} the victim's body was
recovered,{E108:0008} and an autopsy duly carried out.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|13:
Sure,{E108:0008} that's what the records say.{E108:0010}
But the records can't always be trusted.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|15:
That while the records say stuff like "body totally
recovered",{E108:0008} the defense back then begged to differ.
sce2_c6_01.bytes|020021F7|16:
...Not that it stopped the prosecution from shutting
them down hard, of course.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|0:
Uhh,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}some sculptor called "Frost" or something?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}So, I guess...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D9}Edgeworth called it?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|2:
Hmph...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(So my father's deductions were right all along.)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|3:
Well, Judge Gavèlle?{E108:0010}
I'd say this changes things,{E108:0008} wouldn't you?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|4:
Perhaps now you'll admit that I might be of use to this
case?{E108:0010} More than a certain junior prosecutor, anyway...
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|5:
Nngh...!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E280}No fair!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}You're trying to steal the win!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|6:
I'm doing no such thing.{E108:0010} All I want is to uncover the
truth.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|7:
And if we're going to get to the bottom of what
happened here,{E108:0008} we'll need to work together.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|8:
We do not need to do anything,{E108:0008} and you do not need
to know the truth.{E108:0010} This case is none of your concern.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|9:
Whoa there, Judge G.{E108:0010} I think you might be wrong
about that.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|10: Another of your interruptions, Mr. Fender...!?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|11:
Yup!{E108:0010} See,{E108:0008} I was on the defense team for IS-7,{E108:0008} so this
case is very much my concern.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|12:
I was one of the pesky kids pushing the theory that the
body had actually gone missing.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|14:
The prosecutor at the time may have brushed us off,{E108:0010}
but you can't deny the testimony of your eyes.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|15:
...Or, to put it a little more bluntly,{E108:0010} {E112:000A}{E12F:000A0009}{E282}the prosecution's
case was rotten from the ground up.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|16:
When there's been a miscarriage of justice caused by
the prosecution,{E108:0008} it's the Committee's job to fix it, no?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|18:
And who better to help you unpick the mess than
someone who was there at the time?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|21:
(Judge Gavèlle seems to know the facts of the IS-7
Incident in some detail...)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|22:
(In which case,{E108:0008} I suspect she must be here on the
Committee's behalf.)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|0200225C|23:
Your connection to the case is noted, Mr. Fender.{E108:0010}
But I fail to see how it concerns Mr. Edgeworth.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|0:
He's the son of the original defense attorney,{E108:0008} and the
protégé of the case's lead prosecutor.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|1:
And if that's not enough for you,{E108:0008} he was at the trial,
too.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|2:
I think it's just possible he might have a little
something to bring to the table,{E108:0008} don't you?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|4:
...{E108:0008}{E12F:00080000}{E107:0003}Very well.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}You may both assist in the investigation.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|5:
But only if you refrain from interfering with the work
of others.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|6:
The Winter Wing is off-limits for now.{E108:0010}
This room, however,{E108:0008} is all yours.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|7:
Alrighty!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E282}Great to hear we're on the same wavelength, G!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|8:
Why don't we bring it in,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}to show we're all on the side
of justice?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|9: Do not test me, Mr. Fender.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|10:
Your permission to investigate can be revoked{E108:0008} {E282}at any
time.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|12:
This is a turn up for the books,{E108:0008} huh, Milesey?{E108:0018}
{E12F:000A0001}We get to do our thing after all!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|13: ...Thanks to your immeasurable help as always.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002274|14:
Heh heh.{E108:0010} No sweat.{E108:0010}
Besides,{E108:0008} I was mostly doing it for me.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002284|0:
Hokay!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'll be investigating my own thing,{E108:0008} so just holler
if you find something interesting!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002288|0: We're still unclear on two key facts:
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002288|1:
How Mr. Frost's body came to be where we found it,{E108:0008}
and the source of the Ubiquium.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002288|2: You're right.{E108:0010} {E1D1}We need some more intel!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002288|3:
Indeed.{E108:0010} Let's focus on the Ubiquium first and
foremost.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002288|4: It's used in stuff like dish soap and paint, right?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002288|5:
Correct.{E108:0010} It's also bright red in color and has a
distinctive {E043}minty fragrance{E040}.{E106}{E198:00020023}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E12D:00030879}{E150:0002001A}{E100:0000}{E101:00020002}{E107:0002}Okay!{E108:0010} {E1D1}Sounds like we know what we're looking for!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|3:
Everybody's left the Winter Wing.{E108:0010} It's just me in here
now.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|4: Which means I can tell you what we found out!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|5:
(He really shouldn't be sharing information about the
investigation...)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|6:
(...but after the past week or so,{E108:0008} I'm not about to stop
him now.)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|7: The exhibits in here have all completely melted.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|8:
All that's left in the display cases is some stuff at the
bottom.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|9:
More of it in the Taurus case than in the Gemini case,
though.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|10:
!{E108:0020}
Describe this "stuff" for me, if you can.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|12:
It's like a {E042}pale blue liquid{E040}.{E108:0010}
I had the lab run some tests just now.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|13:
The sample from the Taurus case just had a bunch of
sugar in it.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|14:
But the one from the Gemini case had three different
substances in it.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|18:
(What are salt and blood doing in the Gemini case's
sample...?)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|19: Can't imagine whose blood it could possibly be, but...
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|20: ...I'll get it tested right away, sir!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|22:
Oh,{E108:0008} I also spoke over the radio with the forensics guy
working the fountain room.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|23:
He said he just got word that the sugar they found in
the fountain matches the sugar in the pale blue liquid.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|24:
I see...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}That might well prove to be a significant
development.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|25:
Gemini Case Analysis Results data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E106}{E1CF}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E043}{E107:0002}...Anything else to report, Detective?
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|26:
Yessir!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}We found one of those{E108:0008} {E1CB:009400000000}{E041}light-emitting devices{E040}
here in the Winter Wing, too!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|27:
There were a few of those being used in the Autumn
Wing to disguise it as the Winter Wing, as I recall...
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|28:
(It seems that the equipment from eighteen years ago
is more than just for show...)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|29: (I need to talk to Ms. Scone about this.)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|30: Anyhow,{E108:0008} I better be getting back to it!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|31:
I'll let you know as soon as we hear from the lab about
that blood!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|33: Was that Gummy?{E108:0010} Seemed like he had a lot to say!
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|34: He did.{E108:0010} And all of it very useful.
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|36:
(If I'm going to prove that Ms. Bound's claims about
who could have set up the poison gas trap are false...)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|02002290|37:
(...I'll need to talk to a certain somebody else who
was here eighteen years ago...)
sce2_c6_02.bytes|020022B7|0:
(And that's that.{E108:0010} All that's left now is to await the
results of the tests on the teapot...!)
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022DC|0: Those are tulips by the door,{E108:0008} right, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022DC|1: Yes.{E108:0010} It leads to the Spring Wing.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022DC|2: Ahh, spring...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}a popular time to move house!
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022DC|3: Which makes it open season for Great Thieves!
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022DC|4:
Housebreaking is a little beneath a Great Thief,{E108:0008}
wouldn't you say?
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E2|0:
Hm...?{E108:0010} Why is there a lift cart just sitting here out in
the open?
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E2|1:
Guess somebody must have been moving something
heavy.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E2|2: The top of the platform seems to be wet.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E2|3:
You know...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}I've got a funny feeling I've seen this thing
somewhere before...
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E2|5:
Yeah!{E108:0010} It's all coming back to me now!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I last saw it in Frost's room.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E8|0: He must've used it to move the ice sculptures around!
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E8|1:
It's one of those fancy numbers where you can change
not only the platform's height but even its angle.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E8|2:
If you had one of these,{E108:0008} you could move giant lumps of
ice around no sweat!
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022E8|3:
Lift Cart data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022EC|0:
Ooh,{E108:0018} just think of the possibilities!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I could really use one of these!
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022EC|1:
Still doesn't explain what it's doing here, though.{E108:0010} Bit of
a head-scratcher,{E108:0008} but we should give it a think, yeah?
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022EC|2:
Indeed.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}After all,{E108:0008} it just might have something to do
with our case.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022EF|0: They put sunflowers by the door.{E108:0010} Nice!
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022EF|1:
A fitting adornment for the entrance to the Summer
Wing, I suppose.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022EF|3:
And every Great Thief knows that means {E1D2}{E188:00340000}tourists with
bulging wallets!
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022EF|4:
Pickpocketing, Kay?{E108:0010} Isn't that a little beneath a Great
Thief?
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022F5|0:
It seems the elevator is only accessible to select
individuals.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022F5|2: Among other things,{E108:0008} the medical room.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022F5|3: That's where Mr. Gusto is being treated.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022F5|4:
I hope he's alright.{E108:0018} We've got some questions that need
answering as soon as he wakes up!
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022F5|5:
Since there's no way of knowing when that might be,{E108:0008}
we should explore other avenues in the meantime.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022FB|0:
It's a selection of trophies won by Paul Halique --{E108:0010} or
rather,{E108:0008} Artie Frost.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022FB|1: Evidently,{E108:0008} he was a very well-respected artist.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022FB|2: Well, you've got one, too, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022FB|3:
So it's about time I won one, too!{E108:0010} {E285}Guess I'll have to find
some thieving contests to enter.
sce2_c6_m0a_check.bytes|020022FB|4:
