And even he can't hold out until next Valentine's Day
to enact his outlandish "curse", anyway.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002410|1:
That's what I'll call my next picture book!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}"Verity's Grand Gavelling Gala"!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002410|2:
A worthy sequel to "Franzy's Whippity-Whip Trip",{E108:0008}
and another guaranteed bestselling blockbuster!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002410|3:
Larry!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Could you please focus on the piece of evidence
I'm showing you!?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002410|5: Urngh...{E108:0010} Ignored by Larry of all people...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002416|0: Come on, Larry.{E108:0010} {E1D1}What are you hiding?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002416|5: Look, you two.{E108:0010} {E1D1}This no time for kids games.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002416|7: It's pretty clear Laurice isn't going to talk to you.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002416|8: Oh, he'll talk.{E108:0010} Don't you worry about that...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002416|9:
(I need to know what Larry is hiding.{E108:0010}
And I think I might have an idea of what it is...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002416|10:
(Perhaps presenting him with the right piece of
evidence will force him to come clean...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002421|0:
(I need to know what Larry is hiding.{E108:0010}
Perhaps something around here can give me a clue.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002421|1: (I'd better take another look around the room.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|0:
Alright, Larry.{E108:0010} Enough is enough.{E108:0018}
{E188:00340000}{E1DA}Now, confess!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|1:
Nnghhh...{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E280}Is this any way to treat your best friend, Edgey?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|2:
Hmph.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Is this any way for you treat yours?{E108:0010}
By lying to him?{E108:0010} Hiding things?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|3:
I get the picture, already!{E108:0010} So stop glaring at me like
that!{E108:0018} {E1D1}I'll tell you everything, okay?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|4:
Earlier,{E108:0008} I, uh...{E108:0010} I thought Verity might like a cup of tea,{E108:0010}
so I went to pour one for her...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|5:
But I got distracted,{E108:0008} and my hand slipped,{E108:0008} and...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}SMASH!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|6:
I broke the teapot!{E108:0010} A priceless work of art!{E108:0018}
It's in pieces because of meeeeeee!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|7:
(...No words exist to describe how far away I saw this
coming from.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|8: Ouch...{E108:0010} You really messed up this time, Laurice.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|9: See, Edgey!?{E108:0010} Everyone's going to think less of me now!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|10:
I...{E108:0010} {E1D1}She...{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E281}Judy's never going to forgive me for this!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002423|11:
...Crying to me won't do you any good.{E108:0010}
I think you need to apologize to Ms. Bound.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200242F|1: I'm sorry, Judy!{E108:0018} I'm sooo, sooo sorry!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200242F|2:
I,{E108:0008} I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I don't have any money, but...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D2}I'll paint your
portrait!{E108:0018} I'll paint you fifty portraits!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002432|0:
Please, Mr. Deauxnim.{E108:0010} It's really me who should be
apologizing.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002432|1:
How could I have failed to notice that there were
broken pieces of ceramics on the floor?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002432|2:
Somebody could have been hurt.{E108:0010} {E1CB:008700000000}Here,{E108:0008} let me make
sure that's safely disposed of.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|0:
...The teapot in question was designed by Artie Frost,
correct?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|1:
I understand it was something you've long treasured.{E108:0010}
You must be upset...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|3: But of course...{E108:0008} {E1D1}all things break eventually.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|4:
And as luck would have it,{E108:0008} I have another identical
teapot.{E108:0010} It's far from the end of the world.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|5:
(...Is she less attached to Mr. Frost's work than she
used to be?)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|6:
I can't believe this, Judy!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}You're the sweetest,{E108:0010} the kindest--!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|8:
This other teapot you're talking about...{E108:0010}
It's the one sitting on top of the cart right now, right?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|10:
Yeah, so when I smashed the first one,{E108:0008} I tried to hide
the pieces in the bottom of the cart.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002435|11:
And that's when I saw that other pot under there.{E108:0010} So I
took it out and basically {E043}switched the two pots{E040}.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|1: Yup!{E108:0018} And that's everything I have to tell you!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|2:
I'll be extra careful not to break the other one,{E108:0010}
I promise!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|3: You...{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}{E12F:00000009}You have no shame whatsoever, do you!?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|5:
...It's really quite alright.{E108:0010} Thank you for being so
honest.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|6: See, Edgey?{E108:0010} Isn't Judy{E108:0008} {E1D1}the absolute best...!?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|7:
I trust you won't take advantage of her kindness and
will make amends somehow?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|8:
I sure will!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Once I make it as an artist,{E108:0008} I'm going to give
her one of my paintings!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|9: She was one of my models, after all!{E108:0010} It's only fair!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|10:
(At this rate,{E108:0008} I suspect he's likely to make more trouble
than amends...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|11:
Don't you think it would be better for you to keep out
of her way for a very long while?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|12:
Oh, but I WILL be keeping out of her way!{E108:0018}
Because I sketched her and the others already!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|14:
Keen to see my work, huh?{E108:0010} Yeah,{E108:0008} I drew a few great
sketches of some ravishing beauties!{E108:0010} Wanna see?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|15:
Interested in Laurice's "{E041}ravishing beauties{E040}", huh,
Mr. Edgeworth?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|17:
I simply wish to see if Larry has captured any unusual
details this time, too.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|18:
Unusual details!?{E108:0018} Nothing's unusual about these!{E108:0010}
They're my best work yet!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|19: Really?{E108:0010} Now I want to see them, too!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|21:
Alright,{E108:0008} let me dig them out for you.{E108:0010}
Gimme a sec, okay?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002441|22: (...I suppose we might as well take a look.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002458|1:
Seriously, Edgey!{E108:0018} If you wanted to check out my art,{E108:0010}
you shoulda just said so from the get-go!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|1: I told you already!{E108:0010} Ravishing beauties!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|2:
Just a few of the fair faces that have caught my eye
since I've been here, you know?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|3: There's Verity.{E108:0010} And Judy.{E108:0010} And...{E108:0008} uhh,{E108:0010} somebody else.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|4: Why did you draw them all on the same page?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|5:
Well, I meant to draw the room at first.{E108:0010} Just something
to pass the time.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|6:
And then I saw one beauty,{E108:0008} and another,{E108:0008} and well...{E108:0010}
I just scribbled them all down as I went.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|7: So these were all drawn at different times?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|9:
I did one of you too, Kay!{E108:0010} You're on a different page,
though.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|11:
How true to life are these sketches?{E108:0010} Did you only draw
what you actually saw?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|12:
Of course!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You think I draw things I can't see!?{E108:0010}
Like,{E108:0008} using my {E1D1}imagination!?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|13:
Nope,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}these are 100% true to life,{E108:0010} right down to the
exact shade of each color!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|15:
(Much as it pains me to admit it,{E108:0008} Larry may have
provided me with a useful piece of evidence yet again.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|16:
(The serving cart in the sketch, for example.{E108:0010}
If I compare it to the one here in the room...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|18: (I think a little {E041}deduction{E042} is in order.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|19: Could I borrow this page for a while, Larry?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|20: Sure thing!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You want me to sign it for you?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200245B|22:
Larry's Sketches data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002472|0: Would you mind taking a look at this for me, Larry?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002472|2:
Tell me,{E108:0008} what is it about Ms. Bound's tea set that's got
you so agitated?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002472|4:
If you won't tell me...{E108:0010} then perhaps you'd prefer to
explain it to Judge Gavèlle?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002472|5:
Wait!{E108:0018} Don't make me look bad in front of Verity!{E108:0018}
She thinks I'm a sensible,{E108:0008} cool,{E108:0010} clean-cut guy!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002472|6:
I don't want her to see the real me.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}The real low-down,{E108:0008} dirty me!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002472|7:
I'm not so sure anybody here thinks you're
particularly clean-cut, Larry...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002472|8:
...but if you don't want her to think badly of you,{E108:0008} the
best thing you can do is talk to me.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200247C|0:
Where were you before you rejoined us here,
Ms. Bound?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200247C|1:
I had to go and tell our visitors we're closed.{E108:0010}
Oh,{E108:0008} and hand out a little something in apology.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200247C|2: Was there something you wanted to talk to me about?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200247C|5:
(...the fact that I think you might be {E1D1}the one who set
the poison gas trap...!)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002482|0:
I must admit I was a little surprised to learn that
Gregory Edgeworth's son had become a prosecutor.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002482|1: But then,{E108:0008} I'm sure a lot has happened since.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002482|2:
...Yes.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}That much is certainly true.{E108:0010}
Though I'll spare you the details.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002482|3: Hee hee.{E108:0010} And yet,{E108:0008} {E285}the two of you are so alike.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002482|4:
You may have chosen different paths,{E108:0008} but I can tell
you're every bit as righteous and noble as he was.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002482|5: That's very kind of you to say...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002482|6:
(When it came to his work,{E108:0008} my father always had the
strength of his convictions.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002482|7:
(But right now,{E108:0008} I'm like a ship lost at sea.{E108:0010} I'm not even
sure which way to go,{E108:0008} let alone who I should be...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200248A|0:
You were a very successful actress, Ms. Bound.{E108:0010}
Why did you decide to become a gallery owner?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200248A|1:
...You know,{E108:0008} the two things don't feel all that different
to me.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200248A|2:
Movies,{E108:0008} musicals,{E108:0008} confectionery,{E108:0008} sculptures,{E108:0008} art...{E108:0010}
They're all the same, really.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200248A|3: They all have {E285}the same aim in mind.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200248A|4:
To evoke an emotional response.{E108:0010}
That's what all artists strive for.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200248A|5: So is that what's Laurice is striving for, too?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200248A|6:
...Let's get one thing straight:{E108:0010} Try as Larry might,{E108:0008} a
fancy name does not an artist make.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002491|0:
Delicia gave me a few of these cloths.{E108:0010} They light up
when you attach them to a special device.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002491|1: How many did she give you, exactly?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002491|3:
(There were four luminous cloths in the Autumn Wing,{E108:0008}
but I'm sure I saw another one somewhere else.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002491|4: (I get the feeling Ms. Bound is hiding something...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002496|0:
What kinds of pharmaceutical "recipes" are in
the ultimate cookbook?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002496|1:
Oh, there are so many.{E108:0010} It would take a while to go
through them all.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002496|2:
But if you really {E107:0003}want to know...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Well then let's start the show!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002496|3:
Come join me {E107:0003}as we sing this song!{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}It's a nifty,{E108:0008} thrifty two hours long!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002496|4:
Now one by one, we'll sing the things,{E108:0010}
That the world's best little cookbook brings!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002496|5:
...What do you think, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Wanna listen to the rest?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200249D|0:
This lift cart...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}I heard it was in use eighteen years ago,
too...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200249D|1:
That's right.{E108:0010} It was in another room earlier until I
brought it out here.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200249D|2: It's very useful for moving large, heavy objects around.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200249D|4: (Was it used to carry something wet...?)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024A2|1: Yes.{E108:0010} It was painted by the so-called artist over there.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024A2|2:
It's wonderfully drawn.{E108:0010}
{E12F:001C000C}Would you mind if I kept it?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024A2|3:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}{E188:00310000}I'm sorry, Ms. Bound.{E108:0010} I'm afraid it's an important
piece of evidence.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024A2|5:
(I suppose Larry's charm is something of a talent if he
can impress a gallery owner with sketches like these.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024A8|1: Oh, yeah!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}They were super sweet!{E108:0010} I loved them!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024A8|2: Hee hee...{E108:0010} I'm very happy to hear it.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024A8|3:
Samson has such a sweet tooth,{E108:0008} he wouldn't have them
any other way.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024A8|4:
(They may not look the best at the moment,{E108:0008} but her
love for her family shines through in how they taste.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024AD|2:
But I don't know...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}What that's abooout!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024AD|5:
(...Have I inadvertantly stumbled onto the set of
"Cake Crimes: The Musical" or something?)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|0:
Are there two serving carts here at the gallery,
Ms. Bound?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|2: A certain so-called artist showed us this sketch...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|3:
I couldn't help but notice the color of the tablecloth.{E108:0008}
It's light blue.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|4:
Light blue...?{E108:0018}
I'm afraid your friend must be mistaken.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|5:
I only use white tablecloths,{E108:0008} freshly laundered and
starched.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|6:
Like the perfect, wrinkle-free one on the cart here in
the fountain room, right?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|7:
Exactly.{E108:0010} If I saw so much as a blemish,{E108:0008} I would replace
it right away.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|8:
(Could the color of the tablecloth in the sketch simply
be a mistake on Larry's part...?)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|9:
Do you have any idea of what you might have been
doing when this sketch was drawn?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|10:
Let me see...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I appear to be carrying out my usual
duties.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024B3|11:
I'd like to ask you a little more about these "duties", if
I may.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024BF|0:
What exactly were you doing when this sketch was
drawn?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024BF|1:
Because from what I can see...{E108:0010} your cart doesn't have
a tea set on it.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024BF|2:
I was delivering some chocolates to the investigating
officers.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024BF|4: Well, there were a few left over,{E108:0008} so here.{E108:0010} For you both.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024BF|5: I made them myself.{E108:0010} I hope you like them...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024BF|8:
(They're a little melted,{E108:0008} but I suppose that's because
they've been sitting around in her pocket.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024BF|9:
Chocolates data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024C9|1: Hee hee...{E108:0010} I'm very glad to hear it.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024C9|2:
(They may not be the prettiest,{E108:0008} but I'm grateful for the
energy boost nonetheless.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024C9|3:
(...Though perhaps they could do with a little less
sugar.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|0:
The original ice sculptures melted eighteen years ago,
correct?{E108:0010} How did you manage to recreate them?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|1: Oh!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You know about what happened back then?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|2:
In that case,{E108:0008} you might also know I took pictures of
them during the contest.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|3:
I commissioned the creation of a set of replicas based
on those photographs for this current exhibit.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|4: ...But why go through the trouble of creating replicas?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|5:
Mr. Frost's zodiac series was his great unfinished
masterwork.{E108:0010} I wanted to see it completed at last.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|6:
Or rather...{E108:0010} re-completed.{E108:0010} It was my fault that the
original set melted in the first place, after all.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|7:
...I see.{E108:0010} And is there any particular reason why the
Winter and Autumn Wings look so similar?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|8: Oh, my!{E108:0018} You really think they look alike?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|9:
Perhaps I used some of the decorations from one in
the other by accident?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024CD|11: (But I don't have the evidence to prove it just yet...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024D9|0:
Hello there, dearie!{E108:0018} Still investigating away, are you?{E108:0018}
Found anything interesting?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024D9|1:
No, dearie!{E108:0010}
Well,{E108:0008} nothing much, anyway!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024D9|2:
Silly girl!{E108:0018} That wasn't a "dearie" moment.{E108:0010} {E1D1}That was
more of a "lambkin".
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024D9|3:
"Sweetheart" is for when you're being sympathetic, of
course.{E108:0010} {E1D1}And "treasure" is for when they're in a tizz...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024D9|4:
"Love" is for people you're not that keen on,{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E107:0001}and "petal"
you use when you're trying to get someone's attention.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024D9|5: Wow...{E108:0010} I didn't realize there were so many rules!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024D9|6:
Mr. Edgeworth, petal!{E108:0018} I hope you're getting all this
down!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E2|0:
Ms. Scone.{E108:0010}
I'd like to ask you a few questions, if I may.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E2|2:
Anything for you, Milesy Smilesy{E108:0008} and dear, sweet little
Tooth De-Kay!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E2|3:
...I'd appreciate it if that was the last time you called
me {E041}Milesy Smilesy{E040}.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E2|4: I'm not a fan of {E041}Tooth De-Kay{E040}, either!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E2|5:
Well you'll just have to like it or lump it!{E108:0018} {E1D1}I can't change
a nickname once I've settled on it!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E9|0:
Hold on,{E108:0010} that badge of yours.{E108:0018}
It's not the same as Greggy Pegleg's.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E9|1:
That's right.{E108:0010} My father was a defense attorney.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}took a different path.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E9|3: Well,{E108:0010} I suppose it's to be expected at your age, dearie.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E9|4:
But once you're grown up a bit,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I'm sure you'll start to
appreciate your old man a little more.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E9|6:
Everyone goes through a little rebellious phase.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Lord knows I had mine.{E108:0008} Tee hee!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024E9|7:
My...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}My career path is not the result of some
adolescent "phase", Ms. Scone!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F1|0: That stuff doesn't come cheap, you know!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}{E188:00310000}Or easy!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F1|1:
It's pretty amazing, though!{E108:0018} It looks sooo cool when it's
all lit up!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I wonder how it's made...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F1|2:
Oho!{E108:0018} Well, if you really want to know,{E108:0010} I'll let you in on
a little secret...!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F1|3:
Huh...{E108:0010} {E284}So it was developed by Blue Screens, Inc...{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}I know where the Great Thief is striking next!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F1|4:
With their tech,{E108:0008} I could make a glowing cloak {E285}and
shine brighter than the brightest thief of all!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F1|5: So much for what I wanted to ask...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F7|0: It's true, dearie.{E108:0010} I do know how to make poison gas.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F7|1:
But the fact that someone knows how to hold a gun
doesn't mean they've shot anybody now, does it?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F7|3:
She's right, you know.{E108:0010} Just because I'm a Great Thief,{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D2}that doesn't mean I can't do good!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F7|4:
Exactly, dear!{E108:0010} And just because I'm a confectioner,{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}that doesn't mean I can cook!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024F7|5: (Surely that only applies to fake confectioners...!)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|0: Have you read the ultimate cookbook, Ms. Scone?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|1:
Of course I have!{E108:0018} {E1D1}I am a pharmacist, you know,{E108:0010} even if
I do wear a big, pink hat!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|2: I think it's so cool you're a pharmacist!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|3:
Well, so do I, dearie!{E108:0008} So do I!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}Aren't you a sweetheart,{E108:0008} my little Tooth De-Kay!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|4: Since when were you interested in pharmaceuticals?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|5:
Shh!{E108:0010} I'm working my magic, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010}
Buttering her up so she'll do what I want!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|6:
Anyway, Ms. Scone --{E108:0010} {E1D1}Delicia --{E108:0018} I was wondering if you
could maybe--
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|7:
No!{E108:0018} How many times, you cheeky little imp!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Once your name's decided,{E108:0008} I can't change it!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020024FD|8:
Dang...!{E108:0010} So much for the sneaky approach.{E108:0018}
What kind of Great Thief am I...?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002507|0: Who knew you could make a lamp out of rock salt?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002507|1:
Of course you can, dear!{E108:0010} You wouldn't want to get it
wet,{E108:0008} but it's fireproof!{E108:0010} And ever so sturdy!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002507|2:
...Sturdy enough to make for a surprisingly good
murder weapon, in fact.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002507|4:
(We know that the bulb in this lamp probably broke
because it was used in the murder...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002507|5: (...but then,{E108:0008} what happened to the other one...?)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200250D|0: Ooh, look at that!{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}A picture of silly old me!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200250D|1: That's right.{E108:0010} You seem to have caught the artist's eye.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200250D|2:
You mean lovely Laurie Lambkin?{E108:0010}
I'll have to have a word with him and say thanks!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200250D|3: Heh.{E108:0010} Well, I'll be glad to introduce you.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002512|0: Oho!{E108:0010} Those are Moody Judy's chocolates, aren't they?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002512|1: Oh,{E108:0008} but dearie me...{E108:0010} They're all a bit melted!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002512|2:
You're supposed to eat them before that happens,{E108:0008} {E1D1}you
silly billy!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002512|3:
Actually,{E108:0008} they were already like this when she gave
them to us.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002512|4:
Maybe she was taken in by your sweet face and
became all hot and bothered,{E108:0010} huh, Milesey Smiles!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002512|5: Kay Faraday!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'll thank you never to call me that again!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002518|0:
Ooh,{E108:0008} you really do carry some cute rubbish around
with you, don't you, Milesey Smiles?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002518|1:
What I could do is cover it in whipped cream for you,{E108:0010}
then sprinkle a few--
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002518|2: Th-There'll be no need for that, thank you, Ms. Scone!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|0:
What can you tell us about the various devices used to
decorate the gallery's exhibits?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|1:
There seem to be some pretty specialized items in use.{E108:0010}
Light-emitting devices,{E108:0008} luminous fabrics...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|2: Oh,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I can tell you ALL about those, dearie!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|3: After all,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}I'm the one who gave them to Moody Judy!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|4:
It was my way of saying sorry after I broke the rules
all those years ago...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|5:
I bought her four lovely new salt lamps,{E108:0008} and I gave her
the four pieces of luminous cloth I used for the contest.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|7:
Tee hee hee!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Well, us girls have to do our best, don't
we?{E108:0010} Not everybody understands, of course.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|8:
That had better not be a dig at me, Delish!{E108:0010}
I told you how kind I thought that was!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|9:
Yes,{E108:0008} back when you were a dear,{E108:0008} sweet,{E108:0008} innocent baby
boy!{E108:0010} What happened to you, eh?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|10:
A...{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}{E1D1}dear, sweet, innocent baby boy!?{E108:0010} Mr. Fender?{E108:0018}
{E12F:00020002}{E1D1}Can't quite picture that, I have to say...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|11:
So these decorations --{E108:0008} they're all the same as the ones
you saw eighteen years ago, correct?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|12:
Yup.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Salt lamps,{E108:0008} glowing fabric,{E108:0008} light-emitting
doodads --{E108:0008} the whole bit.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|13:
(There were four luminous cloths in use in the
Autumn Wing.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|14: (But I'm sure I saw another one somewhere...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|15:
I'm not lying!{E108:0028}
{E12F:001F0002}{E107:0002}Ohhh,{E108:0008} it's in my bag somewhere,{E108:0008} I'm sure of it!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200251B|20:
(Maybe I should jog her memory with something so
Ms. Scone will tell us more...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002530|0: Ms. Scone,{E108:0008} you're something of a specialist.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002530|1:
How might someone learn to make the poison gas that
was used in the attack, hm?{E108:0010} Any ideas?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002530|2:
Well, any pharmacist who's ever handled Infesticide
Ultra would know, for a start!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002530|3:
After all,{E108:0008} it says it right there on the label:{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}"{E041}Do not mix
with products containing Ubiquium!{E108:0010} Ever!{E040}"
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002530|4:
But what about a layperson?{E108:0010} It's unlikely they'd know,
wouldn't you say?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002530|6:
Well,{E108:0008} {E1D1}not unless they'd had a nose through the
ultimate cookbook, anyway!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002530|7: (The prize from the contest eighteen years ago...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002530|8:
The recipe for making Infesticide Ultra,{E108:0008} along with that
not mixing with Ubiquium bit,{E108:0008} is {E043}in there{E040}, you know.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002539|0: So you're familiar with the contents of the book?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002539|1: Oh, yes, dear!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I know it inside-out!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002539|2: Because I work for {E188:00300000}{E1D5}the Tangaroa Group, you see.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002539|3:
We're the company behind {E041}Coldkiller X{E040}!{E108:0010}
I'm sure you've heard of it!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002539|4:
(Coldkiller X...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Fights back sniffles and sneezes with
ease...{E108:0008} apparently.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002539|5:
After Sammypoople was found guilty,{E108:0008} the company
took custody of the book.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002539|6:
But they only grant their most trusted people access to
it, of course.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002539|7:
(Which means Ms. Scone is one of these "elites",
I suppose...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|0:
Why didn't you want me to know you had a piece of
luminous cloth in your bag?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|1:
Ohhh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Well, I suppose there's no point hiding it now,
is there...?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|2: If you must know,{E108:0008} I fished it out of the fountain.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|3:
It was right before they called me into the Autumn
Wing.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|4:
(So Larry's sketch of Ms. Scone is of when she was
trying to retrieve the cloth...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|5:
At first,{E108:0008} I thought it was one of the ones I'd given
Moody Judy...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|6: One of the four you'd given to the gallery, correct?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|7:
...Exactly.{E108:0010} But all four were being used in the Autumn
Wing, weren't they?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|9:
...it must be the one that went missing all those years
ago!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|11:
I'd already had my Infesticide Ultra pinched and used
to make poison gas.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|12:
If one of my cloths turned out to have been used in
some sort of dastardly deed, too,{E108:0008} well...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|13:
...I was going to look guilty as sin, wasn't I?{E108:0010} So I kept it
hidden in my bag and hoped for the best!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|15:
Ooh,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}it does feel good to get it off my chest, though!{E108:0010}
Stress is no good for the complexion!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|16:
(So the cloth that disappeared eighteen years ago...{E108:0010}
The one that the victim was wrapped in...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|17:
(...just happens to reappeared in the fountain at the
same time as the body...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002541|18:
Luminous Cloth data updated
in my Organizer.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002554|0:
You had a piece of fabric like this in your bag,{E108:0008} did you
not, Ms. Scone?{E108:0010} Albeit a somewhat...{E108:0008} grimier one.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002554|1:
Grimy!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}How rude!{E108:0010} You won't get people to cooperate
with your little investigation like that, young man!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002554|2:
Shall I call it a {E1D1}dish towel then?{E108:0010} Perhaps you used it to
wipe up some sort of spillage...?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002554|3:
A spillage, he says!{E108:0018} The cheek!{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}That's a piece of highly
specialized luminous cloth!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002554|4: ...Oh.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I probably shouldn't have told you that...!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002554|5:
...I think I'd like to know a little more about this
"highly specialized luminous cloth", if you don't mind.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200255A|0:
M-Mr. Winner was very clear that {E1D1}you're only allowed
to investigate in this room.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200255A|1:
So I'm afraid I can't let you pass!{E108:0018}
Sorry, sir!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200255A|2:
It wouldn't make much difference if you did, Officer.{E108:0010}
You're standing in front of a wall.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200255A|3:
Oh!{E108:0010} {E1D1}B-But we all know a few bricks won't stop you,
Mr. Miles Edgeworth, sir!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200255A|4:
Wow...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}{E188:00310000}He actually sounds kinda scared of you!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200255A|5:
(Just what kind of reputation do I have down at the
precinct...?)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002560|0:
The body's been taken back to the lab, sir.{E108:0010}
Autopsy's underway.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002560|1: And how's the rest of the fountain looking?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002560|2:
Rather beautiful, actually, sir.{E108:0010}
The water's crystal clear, and kind of soothing...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002560|3:
(...Almost as if there wasn't a body floating in it not so
long ago, hm?)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002564|0:
Hey there, Milesarino!{E108:0010}
What's the situation with the investigation?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002564|1:
Things are...{E108:0010} progressing.{E108:0010} I think a fuller picture of
what happened is beginning to emerge.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002564|2:
Good to hear!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Guess I better step up my game, too,
then!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002567|0:
Miles Edgeworth,{E108:0008} prosecutor.{E108:0010} I gotta say,{E108:0008} I never saw
that coming.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002567|2:
Hey, hey!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}That wasn't a dig!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You had your reasons, I'm sure.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002567|3:
I'm just...{E108:0010} glad you'll get to see what the courtroom
looks like from the other side for once.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002567|4: It's a whole different ball game,{E108:0008} let me tell ya.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002567|5:
(Actually,{E108:0008} I have stood at the defense's bench once
before...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002567|6: (And I have to say...{E108:0010} it wasn't bad.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200256E|0:
IS-7's not just another case for me, Miles.{E108:0010}
You know that, right?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200256E|1: ...Of course.{E108:0010} It's important to me, too.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200256E|2:
I've put some serious thought into this little mystery
over the years...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200256E|3:
Like,{E108:0008} just what do the letters "IS" stand for?{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}"Indecent Snacks"?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200256E|5: See!{E108:0010} There are so many options,{E108:0008} I can't pick just one!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200256E|6:
(Sometimes,{E108:0008} I seriously don't know whether Fender is
being serious or not...{E108:0010} And this is one of those times.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002575|0:
One of those pieces of cloth went missing eighteen
years ago now.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002575|1:
Hard to lose something like that, right?{E108:0010}
Lights up like a danged Christmas tree.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002575|2:
It's possible no one just happened to have found it.{E108:0010}
Although,{E108:0008} the more likely scenario is...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002575|3:
...That somebody decided to play hide the thimble.{E108:0018}
{E12F:000A0002}{E188:002F0000}The question is who?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002579|0:
The ultimate cookbook...{E108:0010} I'll bet there's some
humdinging recipes in there, huh?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002579|1: Any you might be interested in, perhaps?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002579|2:
Who, me?{E108:0010} Not that I can think of.{E108:0010}
What about you, Kaysterino?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002579|3:
Uh...{E108:0010} I guess I'd like to be a genius...{E108:0010} and invisible...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E12F:00020008}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Ooh,{E108:0008} and able to fly!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002579|4:
...We're talking about medicines here, Kay.{E108:0010}
Not miracles.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200257E|1:
Perhaps you could take a closer look?{E108:0010}
You might notice something new.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200257E|2:
Thing is, Milesarino...{E108:0010} I've been racking my brains
about this case for eighteen years now.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200257E|3: I wouldn't hold out much hope for a eureka moment.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200257E|4:
You, on the other hand --{E108:0008} fresh eyes, fresh face, fresh
attitude...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}You might spot something.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200257E|6:
I'm gonna take a stab at what His Coolness is saying,
but...{E108:0018} {E12F:00020008}{E188:00300000}"No comment."
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200257E|7:
Eh heh heh.{E108:0010} Alright,{E108:0008} I'll try not to pass the buck next
time.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200257E|8: (...Well,{E108:0008} that was a waste of time.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002587|0:
Ooh,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00300000}Judy's special home-made chocolate delights!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}The sweetest treat a guy could hope to eat!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002587|1:
Heh heh.{E108:0010} You know what goes well with one of these,
Miles-o?{E108:0010} A nice, strong coffee,{E108:0008} that's what.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002587|2: Is that so?{E108:0010} I'll have to give it a try.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002587|3: Did I tell you these are Samson's favorite?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002587|4:
I hope they still bring him some sweet comfort after
everything he's been through...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200258C|1:
So this is it, huh?{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}The key to unraveling this whole
mystery?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200258C|3:
Great.{E108:0010} You, uh...{E108:0008} You keep hold of it, then,{E108:0008} yeah?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Quickly now,{E108:0010} {E1D1}back in your pocket it goes.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200258C|4: (...I guess he doesn't think much of it.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|0:
This case seems to have a lot in common with the
incident from eighteen years ago...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|1:
And how!{E108:0010} It's got the lot!{E108:0018} Melting statues in the Winter
Wing,{E108:0008} and even the murder victim's body!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|2:
But how did nobody ever figure out that the body
had gone missing?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|3: ...Frost had no family apart from his son.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|4:
And, well...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}the kid kinda vanished.{E108:0010} Nobody's seen him
since around the time of the incident.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|5:
Gusto's son, too.{E108:0010} Him and his best pal from school
both just up and disappeared.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|7: Gusto's boy wasn't.{E108:0010} Not as far as I heard, anyhow.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|8:
Guess Frost's kid turned up in the end, though.{E108:0010}
He collected his inheritance at some point.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|9:
But yeah,{E108:0008} with no family around just after the incident,{E108:0008}
Frost got no funeral,{E108:0008} no nothing.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|10:
So no need for the police to release the body.{E108:0010} And no
need for anybody to find out they didn't have it.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|11:
They filed their fake autopsy report,{E108:0008} and nobody was
any the wiser.{E108:0010} Well,{E108:0008} almost nobody...
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|02002591|12:
(I still can't believe Mr. von Karma would've {E1D1}stooped
so low...!)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|0:
Tell me, Fender...{E108:0010}
What kind of person is Ms. Bound?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|2: Don't tell me you've got a thing for her, Milester?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|4: Chill, chill!{E108:0010} I'm just yanking your chain!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|5:
Anyway,{E108:0008} what can I say about Judes?{E108:0018}
Well...{E108:0008} she's a real brave trooper, for one.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|6:
What else do you call someone who waits around for
eighteen whole years like she has for Samson?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|7:
Even after his extended family kicked her out of this
place.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|9:
Yup.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Judes wasn't technically part of the family.{E108:0010}
So there was nothing she could do.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|10:
She had nothing.{E108:0010} Nobody.{E108:0010} And no job after Samson
took the fall.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|11:
So she had no choice but to take what he'd taught her
and make her own way in showbiz.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|12: She's retired from all that now, though.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|14: ...She'd finally made enough to buy the old place back.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|0200259E|15:
She even {E043}got the ultimate cookbook back{E040} from the
Tangaroa Group after they basically stole it.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025AE|0:
Guess this place and everything to do with it was all
she ever cared about.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025AE|1: So she just wanted it back.{E108:0010} All of it.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025AE|2:
(Fender seems very sympathetic to Ms. Bound's
plight...)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025AE|3:
(But from a less charitable perspective,{E108:0008} she has, in a
way,{E108:0008} taken everything of Mr. Tangaroa's for herself.)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B2|0: Do you mind, Mr. Winner?{E108:0010} You're in my way.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B2|1:
I DO mind, actually!{E108:0010} {E1D1}And I'm not going anywhere!{E108:0018}
You'll just have to go around me!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B2|2:
Well, we just thought you might want to move to a
BETTER spot,{E108:0008} that's all!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B2|3:
What better spot!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}I demand you show it to me at once!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B2|4:
(...Is that really all it takes to make you do whatever
we want?)
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B7|0:
Don't think you've gotten away with anything,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B7|1: I'll be reporting your actions to the Committee.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B7|2: ...Do whatever you need to do, Judge Gavèlle.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B7|4: You are the self-styled Great Thief,{E108:0008} correct?
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B7|5:
Mr. Edgeworth's association with such a character will
be of interest to the Committee too, of course.
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B7|6:
Go ahead and report me to your stupid Committee!{E108:0018}
I'll be the toast of the thieving community!
sce2_c6_m0a_npc.bytes|020025B7|8:
(It looks like Judge Gavèlle will have to think up some
new threats if she wants to intimidate Kay...)
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025DD|1:
As it should be.{E108:0010} After all, it symbolizes both the
sanctity and the strictness of the law.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025DD|3: Love, justice, peace, courage, duty, and compassion!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025E2|0: It's so pretty, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E107:0001}I love this color!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025E2|1: Do you think I could make a cape out of it?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025E2|2:
I think it might--{E108:0014}
{E12F:00000001}...No,{E108:0008} never mind.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025E2|4:
(It would definitely make her easier to spot...{E108:0010}
But I'm not about to give her any thieving advice.)
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025E7|0: A Pisces statue that's crying blood?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025E7|1: There's definitely something fishy about that!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025E7|4: Please, Kay.{E108:0010} I'm trying to concentrate here.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025E7|5: I was only trying to lighten the mood...
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025ED|0: "The ultimate cookbook"...{E108:0014} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I like the sound of that.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025ED|2:
C'mon, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} You're starting to sound like a
broken record!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Just what do you think I am!?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025ED|4:
Exactly!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}The Great Thief Yatagarasu!{E108:0010}
{E280}And the only thing I steal is the truth!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025ED|5: Then why does this cookbook appeal to you so much?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025ED|6:
I...{E108:0010} I don't need to have a reason to like something,
okay!?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025F4|0: They're really well drawn.{E108:0010} Laurice has a lot of talent.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025F4|1:
If only he were able to handle himself as skillfully as
he handles his brush...
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025F4|2:
Looks like he can draw normal,{E108:0008} non-freaky pictures
when he picks the right subjects, huh!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025F4|3:
(It's true...{E108:0010} Larry does seem to have a gift for capturing
a scene exactly as he saw it.)
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025F4|4:
(Which means when there IS something "freaky" in one
of his sketches,{E108:0008} there's usually a reason for it.)
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025F4|5:
I spy a contradiction here.{E108:0010} And it's one we cannot
afford to ignore.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025FA|0: Thanks Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} {E12F:00020004}{E1D1}I love sweet stuff!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025FA|2: Then why did you hold them out to me?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025FA|3: I wanted your opinion,{E108:0008} that's all...
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025FA|4:
Okay, well...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}They look sweet, and delicious...{E108:0010}
And they've stolen my heart!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025FA|5:
So hand them over...{E108:0010} Seriously!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E282}{E12F:00020008}GIVE ME THAT CHOCOLATE!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025FA|7:
P-Please,{E108:0010} you have to put it away...!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Can't.{E108:0010} Resist urge to.{E108:0010} Steal...!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|020025FA|8:
A-Alright...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}(I didn't think it would have quite that effect...)
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002603|0: Hey, I'm a Great Thief.{E108:0010} I totally sympathize.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002603|1:
If you feel you gotta grab something,{E108:0008} you should just
go ahead and grab it.{E108:0010} Even if it's worthless.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002603|2:
(She doesn't seem to think much of my little
"treasure"...)
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002606|0:
There's some kind of connection between our case and
the IS-7 Incident,{E108:0008} isn't there, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002606|1:
It's still too early to say for sure,{E108:0008} but I find it hard to
believe there's no connection at all.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002606|2: And IS-7 was your dad's case, right?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002606|3: So this can't be a coincidence --{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}{E285}{E12F:00020008}it's gotta be fate!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002606|4:
The truth is ours for the taking.{E108:0010} So let's go grab it,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}{E188:00310000}and
solve both cases at once!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002606|6:
I think our first order of business should be to find out
where the Ubiquium came from.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002606|7:
Gotcha!{E108:0010} The red liquid with a minty smell!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Let's ask
around and see if anybody has any clues to offer!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200260E|0:
You have to admit,{E108:0008} everyone looks great in Laurice's
picture.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200260E|1:
Can't wait to see what his sketch of me will look like!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}I bet I'll look really good in it, too!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200260E|3: Don't make that face!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Why wouldn't I look good,{E108:0008} huh!?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200260E|5:
You don't have to be a hater{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00350000}just because he didn't do
one of you!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200260E|6:
That's really not what I was thinking about.{E108:0010} It's the
sketches themselves.{E108:0010} Something's not right.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200260E|7: What is it...?{E108:0010} What's bothering me here...?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200260E|8:
(I'm seeing something in these sketches that I'm not
seeing in the room in front of me...)
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002617|0:
If they find Ubiuqium in that teapot,{E108:0008} is that it for
Ms. Bound?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002617|1: She seems way too nice to hurt anybody...
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002617|2: You mustn't judge a book by its cover, Kay.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|02002617|4:
(I should talk to Fender and Ms. Scone and see what
they have to say on the matter.)
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200261C|0: We've learned a lot about our case,{E108:0008} and about IS-7, too.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200261C|1:
Perhaps.{E108:0010} And yet,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}the truth remains shrouded in an
impenetrable mist.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200261C|2: You still don't have enough evidence to pierce the fog?
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200261C|3: In that case,{E108:0010} we'll just have to look for some more!
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200261C|4:
...That won't be necessary, Kay.{E108:0010}
I have all the information I need.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200261C|5:
Now it's just a matter of logically piecing it together in
order to illuminate the truth.
sce2_c6_partner.bytes|0200261C|6:
Sounds good to me.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Have at it, Mr. Edgeworth!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026DC|1: The test results have just come in, sir!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026DC|2: Traces of Ubiquium were found in the teapot!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E1|0:
Curse you!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You'd better not think this means you beat me...!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E1|1:
You really need to drop this obsession with coming in
first, Mr. Winner.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E1|2:
We're all on the same side here,{E108:0008} remember?{E108:0010}
We're all trying to get to the truth.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E1|3:
What...?{E108:0010} But...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}{E12F:00090008}first is best!{E108:0018} Everybody knows it's better
to be a winner than a loser!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E1|4:
That's really no way for a prosecutor to think.{E108:0010}
Not a successful one, anyway...
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E7|0:
Enough.{E108:0018}
Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0010} please refrain from taunting the boy.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E7|1: Ignore him, Eustace.{E108:0010} He isn't worthy of your attention.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E7|3: Why don't I take care of things here for now?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E7|4:
In the meantime,{E108:0008} you can perform the far more
important task of going and checking on the victim.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E7|6: Excellent.{E108:0010} We shall see you shortly, then.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026E7|7:
(Mr. Winner's annoying,{E108:0008} but totally harmless.{E108:0010}
Judge Gavèlle, on the other hand...)
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F0|0:
Ms. Bound,{E108:0010} perhaps you could explain why traces of
Ubiquium were found in your teapot?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F0|1: I,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I had no idea there was anything like that in there!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F0|2:
P-Perhaps it's one of the ingredients in the
dishwashing soap I use...?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F0|3:
...So you are telling the court that you did not
intentionally put Ubiquium in the teapot?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F0|5:
Until today,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I had no idea that it could even be used to
make poison gas!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|0:
You're a trained actress, are you not, Ms. Bound?{E108:0010}
I'd have thought you would be a more convincing liar.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|2: You have access to the ultimate cookbook, correct?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|3:
A book that just happens to contain instructions on
how to create the poison gas used in the attack.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|4:
Meaning,{E108:0008} it's perfectly possible for you to know exactly
how to make it!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|6: Ms. Bound.{E108:0010} Is what Mr. Edgeworth said true?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|7:
...The book does contain information on how to make
the poison gas,{E108:0008} yes.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|8: But the fact that I have seen it doesn't make me guilty.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|9: Can I ask exactly how the gas was triggered?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|10:
The victim used a blowtorch to heat the lid of one of
the display cases,{E108:0008} thereby melting the Ubiquium.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|12:
But he locked himself in the room too, didn't he?{E108:0010}
Surely that and the fact that he triggered it himself...
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|13: ...wouldn't it point to it being a {E285}{E176:00020000}{E041}suicide attempt{E040}?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|14: (So she's not willing to admit to anything...)
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|15:
Furthermore,{E108:0008} where would I have gotten hold of the
Infesticide Ultra?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|16: Oh, I don't know...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}Perhaps you stole it?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|17:
You know...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I did bump into Moody Judy a week or so
ago...
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|18:
And that very evening,{E108:0008} {E1D5}I noticed my Infesticide Ultra
had gone missing!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|20:
D-Delicia...{E108:0008} you carry your bag of pharmaceuticals
with you everywhere,{E108:0008} don't you?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|21:
There would have been any number of opportunities
for someone other than myself to steal it from you.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|020026F6|22:
(That's true...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}And I don't have any hard evidence that
it definitely was Ms. Bound who stole it...!)
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|0:
Judes...{E108:0010} There's clearly something you're not telling
us.{E108:0010} Why don't you just come clean,{E108:0008} hm?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|1:
We all know you'd never hurt somebody for no reason,
so...
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|2:
Not you, too...!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}{E284}You think I'm guilty as well, Mr. Fender?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|3:
Can you blame me?{E108:0010} We've got one wing disguised as
another,{E108:0008} a gas trap in one of the display cases...
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|4:
...and you're the proprietor of the establishment.{E108:0018}
It's looking a lot like you did it, kiddo.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|6:
You have to remember,{E108:0008} the gallery doesn't have any
security cameras,{E108:0008} nor any security personnel.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|7:
If some ill-intentioned person or other wanted to get in
undetected...
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|8: ...I don't think they'd have much of a problem.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|9: Wow!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}You're practically asking to be burglarized!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|10:
You need to be more careful!{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:00020008}A Great Thief could have
a field day in here!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|12:
...And actually,{E108:0008} it seems that Mr. Gusto did, in fact,{E108:0008}
enter the gallery before it opened.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|14: Judy's one tough cookie!{E108:0010} She's not budging an inch!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|15:
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Maybe it's time to rock a little technique
Gregory taught me back in the day...
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|16: And what technique might that be?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|17:
So hear me out.{E108:0010} Everything's connected to what
happened eighteen years back, yeah?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|18:
And since we're not getting anywhere by focusing only
on the here and now...
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|19:
...maybe we ought to approach this from a different
angle and look to the past for clues instead.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|20:
A {E041}turnabout in thinking{E040}...!{E108:0018}
(So my father used this method as well.)
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|21:
Alright,{E108:0008} let's run this through the ol' Thinkatron.{E108:0018}
How was Judes involved in what happened back then?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|23:
(According to Ms. Bound,{E108:0008} it was because of her that
Mr. Frost's flavored ice sculptures melted...)
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|24:
(And yet,{E108:0008} his sculptures are here on display at this
very gallery today.)
sce2_c7_00.bytes|0200270D|26:
...Thank you, Fender.{E108:0010}
I think I know what I need to ask Ms. Bound now.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|0: Heh heh.{E108:0010} Don't thank me,{E108:0008} thank your pops!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|1: Now, take it away, Milesy.{E108:0010} I'll grab the popcorn!
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|3:
You say that you were the one who caused Mr. Frost's
creations to melt eighteen years ago, correct?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|4:
I'm afraid so...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I was young and foolish,{E108:0008} and it was a
terrible accident.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|5:
And yet,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}what you did allowed you to open this
exhibit, no?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|7: Yes,{E108:0008} what do you mean, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|8:
If you are going to ask such questions,{E108:0008} perhaps a
formal testimony from Ms. Bound might be best?
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|9:
Yes,{E108:0008} perhaps it might.{E108:0010} I'd like to know a little more
about Zodiac Hall.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|10:
And about why Ms. Bound decided to dedicate this
space to Mr. Frost's works.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|11:
...Very well.{E108:0010} If you believe it to be relevant to the case,{E108:0008}
I will allow it.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|13:
Not at all...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I'll do whatever it takes to prove that I'm
innocent.
sce2_c7_00.bytes|02002728|14:
Then please,{E108:0008} if you could give us some background on
Zodiac Hall and the pieces on display here.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|1:
It took eighteen years,{E108:0008} but at long last,{E108:0008} I was finally
able to buy Samson's home back a little while ago.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|2:
But a place like this is expensive to maintain,{E108:0008} so I
decided to turn it into an art gallery.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|3:
To that end,{E108:0008} I collected as many Paul Halique pieces as
I could from around the world.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|4:
Because,{E108:0008} if I'm honest,{E108:0008} it's always been something of a
dream of mine to open a space dedicated to his work.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|5:
Thank you for your testimony, Ms. Bound.{E108:0010} How
wonderful it is that you were able to fulfill your dream.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|6:
Well, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0010}
Everything seems entirely above board to me.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|7:
...Judge Gavèlle.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}That was simply the witness's
preliminary statement.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|8:
As you surely know,{E108:0008} the value of that testimony
cannot be evaluated without due cross-examination.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|9: Hah hah...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Spoken like a true attorney.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200275C|10: Very well.{E108:0018} {E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008}{E12F:0008000F}You may do what you must.

Samson,{E108:0010} {E1D1}I did what I had to do,{E108:0010}{E12F:001C0006}

I'll say!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But I wouldn't expect any less from a trained

sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002775|1:
Yes, well,{E108:0008} we only opened today, so I haven't done

sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002775|2:
I have to keep the mansion going.{E108:0010}

sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002775|5: I'm so sorry, Judy...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}I wish I could've done more...
sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002775|6:
!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Oh, you've done plenty, Mr. Fender.{E108:0010}

Paul Halique...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}That was Mr. Frost's pseudonym,{E108:0008}

Yes.{E108:0010} He adopted it while he was working as a sculptor

sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200277D|2:
I see.{E108:0010} I'm curious about some of the pieces in your

A gallery of daaance,{E108:0010} {E12F:001C0005}{E1D1}a gallery of sooong,{E108:0010}
{E12F:001C0006}{E1D1}A gallery of gaiety {E1D1}and candy{E108:0010} {E1D1}all day {E1D1}looong!
sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002784|4:
(And here I thought art was to be appreciated in

sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002784|5:
Alas,{E108:0008} Mr. Tangaroa transgressed against the edicts of

sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002784|6:
And as such,{E108:0008} that part of your dream may go

sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002784|8:
That awful prosecutor refused to listen, but it's true.{E108:0010}

sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002784|9:
(Mr. Tangaroa gave a false confession in order to

sce2_c7_01.bytes|02002784|10:
(The two of them really did what they could to protect

sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200278F|0:
These photos you mentioned,{E108:0008} you mean the ones you

sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200278F|1:

sce2_c7_01.bytes|0200278F|4:

They disappeared because you spirited them away{E108:000C}{E112:0000} {E12F:0000000D}{E283}and

sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|12:

sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|13:
Heh.{E108:0018}{E112:000A} {E12F:000A0009}{E107:0002}It's not the most out-there idea in the world,{E108:0008}
assuming you had a big enough icebox.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|14:
Quiet,{E108:0008} all of you.{E108:0018}
{E12F:0008000D}{E107:0002}Ms. Bound,{E108:0008} have you anything to say in your defense?
sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|16:

sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|18:

sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|19:
And you won't...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}because it would have been

sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|20:

sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|22: I don't yet know exactly how you did it.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|23:

sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|24:
...You're a very persistent man, aren't you,
Mr. Edgeworth?
sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|25: I am indeed.{E108:0010} And I won't stop until I get to the truth.
sce2_c7_01.bytes|020027A8|27:
Then I'd better tell you exactly what I did that day

The whole time before judging began,{E108:0008} I was waiting

sce2_c7_02.bytes|0200285C|2:
During the judging,{E108:0008} I had to go change the camera's

sce2_c7_02.bytes|0200285C|3:
But before I could take the camera back to Samson,
I discovered Mr. Frost's body.

Later,{E108:0008} around when your father arrived,{E108:0008} I began to

That was when I saw Mr. Gusto {E1D1}entering Mr. Frost's

sce2_c7_02.bytes|0200285C|6:
And those were my movements on the day it all

sce2_c7_02.bytes|0200285C|7: I hardly see how you could take issue with any of that.
sce2_c7_02.bytes|0200285C|8: ...That's for us to decide, Ms. Bound.

Are you saying there's a contradiction in her story,

sce2_c7_06.bytes|02002CA1|37:

sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDC|1:
Ms. Bound...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Are you feeling a little calmer now?
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|1:
Good.{E108:0010} Then allow me to get to the point.{E108:0018}

sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|3:

sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|4:

then we have a duty to reinvestigate the case.
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|5:
There is nothing to suggest that anything {E1D1}nefarious

sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|6:
And right now,{E108:0008} there is nothing to suggest that we
should take Ms. Bound at her word, either.
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|7:
So our first order of business should be to arrest the

sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|8:
Official records cannot always be trusted, Judge
Gavèlle.
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|9:
Especially since there are those prosecutors...{E108:0010} {E1D5}who

sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|10:
Are you suggesting that the Committee at the time
{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}{E1D1}overlooked just such a prosecutor...?
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|11:
That's for you and your people to figure out.{E108:0010} However,{E108:0008}
{E285}it is a fact that the autopsy report was faked.
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|12: ...Seeing as Mr. Frost's body was only found just now.
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|14:
There really is something of Mr. von Karma in you,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|16:
By continually defying the will of the Comittee,{E108:0008} and
bending the truth to fit your needs.{E108:0010} That's how!
sce2_c8_00.bytes|02002CDE|17:
Perhaps it is time you understand how I...{E108:0010} no,{E108:0008} the
Committee sees this case.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D5C|1:
The Committee is willing to accept that Mr. von Karma
falsified Mr. Frost's autopsy report.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D5C|2:
Even still,{E108:0008} Mr. von Karma only managed to have
Mr. Tangaroa convicted as an accomplice.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D5C|3:
I personally have come to believe that the real culprit
behind the IS-7 Incident is Ms. Bound.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D5C|4:
Her plan to poison and kill Mr. Gusto today was her
attempt to frame him for Mr. Frost's murder.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D5C|5: And this is how {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E041}the Committee sees things{E040}, is it?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D5C|6: It is.{E108:0010} As always,{E108:0008} I act solely in service of law and order.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D5C|7:
(...It sounds to me like all she's doing is acting in
service of the Committee in covering up the truth.)
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D5C|8:
(And if I can't change her mind,{E108:0008} there will be no

We have all the evidence we need to explain both the

Her verdict remains true,{E108:0008} despite Mr. von Karma's

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D6F|3:
Almost makes you think the Committee might have
{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}other reasons for not wanting this looked into again...
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D6F|4:
...Further investigation is simply unnecessary since

I believe it was a confession that sealed Mr. Tangaroa's

A confession secured by Mr. von Karma,{E108:0010} {E1D9}which should

The official records state that it was his interrogations

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D76|4:
Therefore,{E108:0008}{E112:0008} {E12F:0008000F}all I can say to you is the Goddess of

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D76|5: Unbelievable!{E108:0018} {E1D1}She just won't budge at all!

...In many ways,{E108:0008} they are a prosecutor's worst

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D76|8:

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D76|9:
(Funny how you don't seem to have a problem

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D80|0:
Are you suggesting that Mr. Tangaroa and Ms. Bound
{E284}killed Mr. Frost together?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D80|1:
Why not?{E108:0010} You could even imagine they split their

Mr. Tangaroa could have been the one to commit the

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D80|3:
What...!?{E108:0018} The thought that we could ever {E1D1}kill
Mr. Frost...!{E104}{E100:0001}{E1EC:00020001}{E123:0008000C00070000}{E124:0001}{E10D:000000010002}{E10E}{E12F:0008000C}{E100:0000}{E101:00080009}{E107:0002}You stole his corpse and hid it for eighteen years.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D80|4:
Is it really so surprising that you might be considered

Now is not the time to speculate about {E1D1}what else

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D80|6:

sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|0:
Why would Ms. Bound have chosen to frame
Mr. Gusto for the murder?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|1:
No doubt because he suspected her of being the real
culprit.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|2:
He may have entered what he thought was the Winter
Wing simply to see if the Gemini statue was genuine.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|3:
Little did he know that he would be greeted by a trap
designed to silence him.{E108:0010} A trap that nearly worked.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|4:
Do you have any evidence to support that line of
reasoning?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|5: Unfortunately,{E108:0008} Mr. Gusto remains in critical condition.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|6:
It will be difficult to prove anything until he regains
consciousness.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|7: In other words...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}there is little we can do for now.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|8: On the contrary!{E108:0010} {E108:0002}There is plenty we can do!
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D89|9:
You still have not grasped the situation, have you...?{E108:0010}
Then allow me to spell it out for you.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D93|1:
In the matter of the IS-7 Incident,{E108:0008} we have a body,{E108:0008} a
murder weapon...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}and two suspects.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D93|2:
As for the poison gas attack,{E108:0008} we have the sources of
the two chemicals and Ms. Bound's confession.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D93|3:
And as for you, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0008} we also have enough
evidence...
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D93|4:
...to see that you yourself will have to answer to the
Committee in a formal hearing.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D93|7:
Don't worry, Milesarino.{E108:0010} If nothing else,{E108:0008} you're always
more than welcome at Edgeworth and Co.!
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D93|9:
Your Honor,{E108:0010} I'd greatly appreciate it if we could stay
focused on the matter at hand.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D9E|0:
You really mean to assert that there are no loose ends
left to investigate?{E108:0010} None at all?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D9E|1:
All of the evidence has been examined at length,{E108:0008} and
there is nothing more to be learned from them.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D9E|2: Therefore,{E108:0008} I see no need to further prolong this trial.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D9E|3:
This court finds the defendant,{E108:0008} Ms. Judy Bound...{E104}{E100:0001}{E123:0000000D00010000}{E1EA:0001001F}{E124:0000}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}Your Honor!{E108:0018} I'm certain there's something that still
needs to be examined!
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D9E|4:
The hammer is about to fall, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
Only hard evidence can stop it now.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002D9E|5:
Present what you think requires further deliberation
now.{E108:0010} Assuming there really is anything left, that is...
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DA5|0: Would you mind taking a look at this, Judge Gavèlle?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DA5|1: Am I expected to accept this as evidence?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DA5|2: It appears to have {E188:00310000}{E1D1}no connection to my testimony.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DA5|4:
(Judge Gavèlle is a tougher nut to crack than
Mr. Winner.)
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DA5|5: (But that doesn't mean I should give up!)
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DAB|0:
There's a clear contradiction in your testimony, Judge
Gavèlle!
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DAB|1:
Silence!{E108:0010} Such statements will not be tolerated by this
court!
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DAB|2:
Hmph.{E108:0010} And why not?{E108:0010}
What precisely is wrong with my statement?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DAB|3:
For one thing,{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}the fact that you clearly do not believe
it yourself.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DAB|5: (I'm going to have to be more careful next time.)
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB1|0:
Would you care to revise your testimony at all, Judge
Gavèlle?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB1|1:
No,{E108:0008} why?{E108:0010} Do you believe there is something wrong
with it?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB1|3:
Then perhaps...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}{E12F:00080007}you could refrain from insinuating
otherwise?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB1|4:
Nngh!{E108:0018}
(Well that blew up in my face...)
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB6|0:
I'm afraid there is still one question concerning the
IS-7 Incident that remains unanswered, Your Honor.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB6|1: ...Would you mind taking a look at this?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|1:
They're test results,{E108:0008} carried out on the liquid at the
bottom of the Gemini case in the Winter Wing.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|2: As you can see,{E108:0008} traces of blood were detected.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|4:
Until that question is answered,{E108:0010} {E188:00200000}{E1DA}{E1D5}I hardly think you can
claim to have "all the evidence"!
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|5: There was blood in the Gemini case...?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|6: Why did I not hear about this from Eustace?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|7:
Because Detective Gumshoe informed me of the
results directly.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|8:
...I was planning to tell Mr. Winner about it myself, of
course.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|9:
You...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E282}You kept this to yourself until now!?{E108:0010}
Despite having no jurisdiction here whatsoever!?
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|10:
Mark my words.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1DA}{E1D5}{E188:00200000}The Committee will hear all about
what you have done here today.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|11:
As ever,{E108:0008} my interest is in the truth.{E108:0010} And if mistakes
were made in the past,{E108:0008} they must be rectified.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|13: If you must report me to the Committee,{E108:0008} {E1D5}{E1D1}then so be it.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|14:
But in return,{E108:0008} we must be allowed to investigate this
case to the very end!
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|15: ...That is not my decision to make.
sce2_c8_01.bytes|02002DB8|16: You will need to discuss it with Eustace.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DDC|0: Guess who's back, losers!{E108:0018} And with good news, too!
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DDC|1:
It was a close call for a minute there, but...{E108:0010} Carmelo
Gusto is alive!
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|0: You're the ones who found me?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|3:
You've grown!{E108:0018} And you have an assistant of your own
now?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|5:
Heh heh!{E108:0010} He hasn't got the gig just yet.{E108:0010}
This is Gregory Edgeworth's son.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|8:
I'm in your debt!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}If you hadn't found me in time,{E108:0008}
I wouldn't be here to thank you.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|10:
After all,{E108:0008} if you hadn't lived,{E108:0008} {E1D5}we wouldn't be able to ask
you what really happened eighteen years ago.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|12: We figured out quite a bit while you were out cold.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|13:
Including the fact that you're probably the guy who
offed poor Artie Frost.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|16:
Ms. Bound set up a very elaborate trap to catch
Mr. Frost's murderer.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|17:
...A trap that involved rigging the Pisces case with
poison gas.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|19: Perhaps in light of that fact...
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DE1|20:
...you could tell us in your own words what happened
back then?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DF6|1:
...Or perhaps you'd rather exercise your right to
remain silent?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DF6|2:
Oh,{E108:0008} it's not that.{E108:0010} Gusto here's a fan of the ol'
meditation.{E108:0010} You know,{E108:0008} "om" and all that jazz.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DF6|3:
Wow,{E108:0008} sleeping while standing seems pretty cool!{E108:0010}
{E1D9}That's one heck of a talent!
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DF6|4:
(Except there's no sleeping involved in meditation,
Kay...)
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DF6|5:
Hey!{E108:0010} Gusto, old pal!{E108:0018} How about you snap out of it and
tell us what went down way back when!
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|1:
I was caught in the girl's trap,{E108:0008} so I must be the killer...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}{E12F:00200004}...Is this your idea of a joke?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|3:
Indeed you are, Mr. Gusto.{E108:0010} And there is no evidence
that you have done anything wrong yet.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|4: Mr. Edgeworth and Mr. Fender are merely speculating.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|5:
Rest assured that they have no authority here,{E108:0008} {E1D1}and
that you may pay them no heed.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|6:
Hngh...!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}At least somebody here seems to be on my
side.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|7: Judge Verity Gavèlle.{E108:0010} It's a pleasure, Mr. Gusto.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|8: I will assist you in any way you may require.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|9:
Perhaps you could begin by explaining what actually
happened eighteen years ago to Mr. Edgeworth?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|11:
You want me to prove I'm innocent, Mr. Prosecutor?{E108:0010}
{E282}I'll be happy to.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|12: So this is how you mean to play it,{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Judge Gavèlle?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|13:
You're hoping Mr. Gusto will help you to hide what
happened instead of trying to correct the record!?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|14:
...I believe only in the infallible judgment of the
Goddess of Justice.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|15:
Except it is us humans who make the actual judgment
calls in a court of law.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|16:
And so long as there are those who would use the law
to their advantage,{E108:0008} our rulings are fallible indeed.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|17:
If you would use your position to further obscure the
truth...{E108:0018} {E107:0003}{E1D1}then neither she nor I will forgive you.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|18: Hah hah...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}We shall see about that.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002DFC|19: What do you advise, Judge Gavèlle?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|0:
It would seem that you are under suspicion because it
was you who triggered the poison gas.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|1: Specifically,{E108:0008} by opening the Pisces case's lid.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|2: Would you be so kind as to share why with us?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|4: I came to see Frost's sculptures.{E108:0010} Simple as that.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|5:
I made a mistake with the opening times,{E108:0008} and arrived
a half hour early.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|6:
Ms. Bound,{E108:0010} was there no one at the reception desk at
around that time?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|7:
I had left the main entrance unguarded and unlocked,{E108:0008}
just in case the killer made an appearance.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|8:
I was also busy making preparations elsewhere,{E108:0008} all the
way up until the gallery's opening.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|9: So no,{E108:0008} there was no one here on the first floor then.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|10:
But...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E285}I did make sure that all the wings were locked up
tight --{E108:0010} all except for the Autumn Wing, that is.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|12:
(She did all that just to steer the culprit into the
Autumn Wing...)
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|13: (Which is precisely where Mr. Gusto went.)
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E10|14:
Sneaking into a building's pretty suspicious,{E108:0008} however
you slice it...
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E1F|1:
I will permit no objections or interventions unless
there is {E1D1}some evidence that the witness is lying.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E1F|2:
The courtroom!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You know this is an art gallery, right?
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E1F|3:
Mr. Gusto,{E108:0018} {E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008}{E12F:0008000F}{E107:0002}if you could please continue by explaining
why you opened the Pisces case.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E1F|4: I wanted to see Frost's work up close.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E1F|5:
So I went up to the Gemini--{E108:0010} sorry,{E108:0008} {E284}guess it was
supposed to be the Pisces statue...
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E1F|6:
...and I saw that the lid was frozen on tight.{E108:0010} So I
grabbed a blowtorch from nearby and tried to open it.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E1F|7: When I finally got it open,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D9}gas came pouring out.
sce2_c8_02.bytes|02002E1F|8:
