sce2_c8_05.bytes|0200305B|1: Hrngh!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}He was my biggest fan.{E108:0010} Of course he knew it!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|0200305B|2:
In which case,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}he would have been a good judge of
whether something tasted "on brand", so to speak,{E108:0008} no?
sce2_c8_05.bytes|0200305B|4:
You've already told us that you were suffering from a
taste disorder...
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003060|1:
I'll admit it...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You're good.{E108:0010} I never told anybody any of
this,{E108:0008} but you figured it all out anyway.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003060|2: It's true.{E108:0010} Eighteen years ago,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}I developed {E041}ageusia{E040}.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|0: No one knew about your condition.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|1:
Indeed.{E108:0010} I doubt Mr. Frost would have wanted to
continue collaborating with you had he found out.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|2:
After all,{E108:0008} it was your job to make sure his creations
tasted good.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|4: Therefore,{E108:0008} {E1D1}your son wasn't just here {E1D1}{E1D5}to support you!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|5: He was helping you by taste-testing your work!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|8:
Frost's stuff tasted good because it really was finished
the day before when the kid was still here!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|12: You have a vivid imagination, Mr. Prosecutor.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|13:
But do you seriously think I'd trust a kid to tell me
how to adjust the taste of my masterpieces?
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|14: ...I have some pride, you know.{E108:0010} Even back then.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|16:
My designs may not have been much to write home
about back then...
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|17:
...but I always knew my work tasted better than
anybody else's!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|18:
You think I'd risk everything by putting my reputation
{E1D1}in the hands of a child!?
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|19: This is just more speculation.{E108:0010} {E283}{E107:0002}That's all it is.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|21:
In that case,{E108:0008} I ask to speak with your son this instant!{E108:0018}
Let's see how much of your story he can corroborate!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|22:
Hngeh heh heh heh!{E108:0018}
{E12F:0020000A}Sadly for you...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D9}{E12F:00200004}my son is no longer my concern!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|24:
As soon as I got my sense of taste back,{E108:0008} I went straight
to Zheng Fa to start my training.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|25: ...And cut off all ties with the kid for good!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|28:
And that ain't the half of it...{E108:0018}
{E285}No one knows where he is,{E108:0010} even now.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|29: The cops have looked all over for him,{E108:0008} but no dice.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|30:
...So,{E108:0010} still think you can prove your asinine theory?{E108:0018}
{E12F:00200004}{E1D1}I'd like to see you try!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|31:
Hngehhh hyeh heh heh heh heh!{E108:0018} {E12F:0020000A}{E1D2}You think I care
about anything besides confectionery?{E108:0010} Think again!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|32:
I got my sense of taste back.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}What need do I have for a son?
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|34:
While Mr. Gusto's words and actions may demonstrate
a certain lack of humanity on his part...
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|35: ...the Goddess of Justice...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}cannot judge him for that.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|36:
Therefore, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0010} I believe it is time for you
to admit defeat.
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|37:
Yeah.{E108:0008} Give it up.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}Eighteen years is a long time for
anything to surface now --{E108:0010} proof or otherwise!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|39:
Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
We have to do something!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003063|40: If we don't...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}the truth might be lost forever!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|0200308E|0: Can't imagine whose blood it could possibly be, but...
sce2_c8_05.bytes|0200308E|1: ...I'll get it tested right away, sir!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|0: (That's the last piece of the puzzle,{E108:0008} I'm sure of it.)
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|1: (Once we know whose blood it is...!)
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|2:
Hey, Miles.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Sorry to cut in on your mind palace time,{E108:0008}
but I was pondering something myself...
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|3:
Our friend Gusto didn't come here just to check up on
the body, did he?
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|5: You mean because he tried to open the case?
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|6:
Exactamundo!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Think we have anything that might
explain why he tried to do that?
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|7:
We might.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}If Detective Gumshoe can make it back in
time with a certain piece of evidence...!
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|8:
That's quite enough idle chatter, defense.{E108:0010}
Now,{E108:0008} if you--
sce2_c8_05.bytes|02003091|9: Mr. Edgeworth, sir!{E108:0020} {E188:00340000}{E1D2}Sorry to keep you waiting!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DC|0: I take it you have the test results, Detective?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DC|1: Yessir!{E108:0018} {E1D1}The lab just got back to me!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|1:
Now then,{E108:0008} am I right to assume that you are bringing
us the evidence Mr. Edgeworth was just speaking of?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|2:
What!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Hey,{E108:0008} {E1D1}no fair!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}{E12F:00090008}Why didn't anybody tell me about any of this!?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|4:
It is indeed the evidence in question, Your Honor.{E108:0010}
It needed testing,{E108:0008} so I asked him to carry it out.
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|5:
What the...?{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Why is everybody always helping you!?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|6: I'm supposed to be the one in charge here!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|8:
I'm sorry I didn't involve you,{E108:0008} but this is important.{E108:0010}
Can we at least hear what the detective has to say?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|10:
So, Detective Gumshoe,{E108:0010} what did the tests have to tell
us?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|11: You're not going to believe this, but...!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|12:
The owner of the blood we found in the liquid at the
bottom of the Gemini case is...
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|13: ...Carmelo Gusto,{E108:000C} {E280}the victim of the poison gas attack!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|15:
Thank you, Detective.{E108:0010}
You've been very helpful.
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|16: Well...{E108:0010} {E12F:00000004}{E107:0002}it looks like my suspicions were correct.
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|17: What do you mean, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|18:
Yes.{E108:0010} What DO you mean?{E108:0018}
Explain yourself.
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|19: What is the significance of this blood to this case?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|20:
It's only the very thing the perpetrator of the IS-7
Incident has been trying to hide all these years!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|22:
The fact that your blood was found inside the Gemini
case, Mr. Gusto...
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|23:
...is as good as us finding your blood lying right next to
Mr. Frost's body!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|25:
Wh-Why would there be traces of your blood there, of
all places, Mr. Gusto!?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|27: If you won't answer Her Honor, Mr. Gusto,{E108:0008} then I will.
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|28:
There wasn't just blood in the liquid from the Gemini
case.{E108:0010} There were traces of salt and sugar, too.
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|30:
And if you remember,{E108:0008} one particular part of
Mr. Frost's work was allegedly very salty indeed.
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030DE|32:
You're talking about what Delicia told us back then,
right?{E108:0010} What was it again...?
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030FF|0:
Did they ever!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I've never tried ices so scrumptious in
all my life!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030FF|1: Really?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Man,{E108:0008} I wish I could've had a bite...
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030FF|2:
Well,{E108:0008} scrumptious except for the salty bit, of course.{E108:0010}
That was unbearable!
sce2_c8_06.bytes|020030FF|4:
It's in the other photo you've got there.{E108:0010}
This bit.{E108:0010} The...{E108:0008} harpy thing.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200315C|0:
Yes.{E108:0010} The lyre --{E108:0008} and only the lyre --{E108:0008} tasted as if it had
been flavored with salt.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200315C|1:
There were no traces of salt anywhere else in
Mr. Frost's entry.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200315C|2:
Very interesting.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Then perhaps you can tell us,
Mr. Edgeworth...
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200315F|1:
...It's extremely distressing to watch you flounder so
horribly...
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200315F|2:
But if it's salt you're looking for,{E108:0008} I may be about to
produce some from my eyes!
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200315F|3:
(Nnrgh...!{E108:0010} Thanks,{E108:0008} but I'm already feeling their salty
cold sting as mine run down my cheeks...)
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200315F|4:
Now,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D1}perhaps you could present us with a slightly less
outlandish explanation?
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003165|0:
This is...!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E284}The lamp from the IS-7 Incident...?
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003165|1:
Indeed.{E108:0010} And I believe that the salt that gave the lyre
its flavor{E108:0008} {E285}came from just such a lamp.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003165|2:
Mr. von Karma had established that both salt lamps
were in Mr. Tangaroa's room at the time of the crime.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003165|3: One of them was used to kill Mr. Frost.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003165|4: And it was stained with his blood.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003165|5:
But no corresponding pool of blood was found in
Mr. Tangaroa's room.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003165|6:
Right.{E108:0010} Because the culprit {E285}had chucked the piece of
chocolate with that on it into the little stream.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200316C|0:
Furthermore,{E108:0008} aside from the lyre,{E108:0008} no traces of salt
were found anywhere else in Mr. Frost's room, either.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200316C|2: Hey, come to think of it...
sce2_c8_07.bytes|0200316C|3:
The lamps we found in Delicia's room were both
broken.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003170|0: The lamps appear to be broken.
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003170|1: Bulbs are smashed...{E108:0018} Both of them...
sce2_c8_07.bytes|02003170|2: Maybe they fell and broke on the floor?
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|0:
We never did figure out how the one that wasn't used
to kill Frost got busted, but...
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|1:
Are we thinking...{E108:0010} {E282}{E107:0001}maybe it had Gusto's blood on it at
some point!?
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|3:
Anyone whose blood was found on one of the lamps
would have been a person of interest to the police.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|4:
So the killer needed to hide the blood somehow.{E108:0010}
And in a way that wouldn't arouse suspicion.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|5:
And you are seriously suggesting that {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}the lyre was
used to do just that...?
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|7:
I suspect that the bloody salt was somehow applied to
the lyre so that it could be hidden inside the case.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|8:
Because unlike the fountain water,{E108:0008} the sculptures
would've needed more time and care to test properly.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|9:
And so he waited and waited for his chance to dispose
of the lyre undetected.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|10: Then...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Then the reason he's here today is...
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|11:
Eighteen years ago,{E108:0008} Mr. Frost's body and the evidence
pointing to his killer were taken away together.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|12:
This, of course,{E108:0008} was not part of the perpetrator's plan.{E108:0010}
And thus a new dilemma arose:
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|13:
The possibility that the body,{E108:0008} the incriminating
evidence,{E108:0008} or both{E108:0008} would {E1D1}resurface one day.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|14:
So back he comes eighteen years later,{E108:0008} sneaking in
bright and early to try and cover his tracks.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|16:
Well, Mr. Gusto?{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Are you finally ready to admit it?
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|17: That you are the one {E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}responsible for the IS-7 Incident!
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|19:
Mr. Gusto...!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}It's all because of you that {E188:00310000}{E1D1}Samson...!
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|20:
NGYEHHHH HEH HEH {E282}HEH HEH HEH HEH HEH
{E282}HEH HEH HEH HEH {E1D9}HEH HEH HEHHHHHHHH!!!
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|23: So I finally got caught, huh?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}All these years later?
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|24:
Nobody came close back then!{E108:0010}
Not even the big-shot prosecutor.{E108:0010} Or the attorney.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|25:
That's some impressive work, {E1D1}Mr. Prosecutor.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}{E188:00310000}I have to hand it to you!
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|26: You admit it, then?{E108:0010} That you murdered Artie Frost?
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|29: But...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}he only had himself to blame...!
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|31:
He agreed to help me.{E108:0010} We were supposed to help each
other so that one of us could win.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|32:
And whoever won was supposed to let the other use
the cookbook.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031DC|33:
But on the day of the final,{E108:0008} {E1D9}the rat finally showed his
true colors!
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031FE|1:
Sorry.{E108:0010} I'm not helping you in the final.{E108:0018}
...Our little agreement is over, Gusto.
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031FE|2:
But...{E108:0010} But I helped YOU!{E108:0018} I spent all day yesterday
making the ice for your pieces!
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031FE|3:
...Did you?{E108:0018}
And you can prove that, I suppose?
sce2_c8_08.bytes|020031FE|4:
What do you--?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Wait...{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}You were planning to betray
me right from the start,{E108:0008} weren't you...!?
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|0:
After Frost double-crossed me,{E108:0008} {E282}I had to make my piece
for the final by myself.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|1:
And like you said,{E108:0008} my son wasn't there,{E108:0008} so I didn't
have any help with the flavor, either.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|2:
So much for the pride you claimed to have in your
ability to make delicious desserts.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|3:
Go ahead and judge.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}You have no idea what it was like
for someone like me to lose my sense of taste.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|4:
I gave up everything to become the best!{E108:0010} Everything!{E108:0018}
I take pride in that!
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|5: Something someone like you could {E1D1}never understand!
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|6:
You're right.{E108:0008} {E1D1}I don't understand.{E108:0010} Do you take pride in
the fact that you resorted to murder?
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|7:
Or that you abandoned your son?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Why would I want
to understand someone who could do such things?
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|8:
...A man can't afford to rely on other people.{E108:0010}
I learned that the hard way eighteen years ago.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|9: My son never showed up on the day of the final.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|10:
And in hindsight,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I wouldn't be surprised if Frost was
the reason why.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|11:
Why would you think that...?{E108:0018}
What exactly happened to your son?
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|12:
How am I supposed to know?{E108:0010}
I told you --{E108:0010} {E1D1}he's none of my concern anymore.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|13:
And according to you guys,{E108:0008} nobody knows where he is
now either.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|14:
And you don't care...!?{E108:0018}
You're...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}You're HORRIBLE...!
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|15:
So with his disappearance,{E108:0008} so too went your chances
of winning, correct?
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|16:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I had to find another way of getting my hands 
on that book.{E108:0010} That's when inspiration struck.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200325C|17:
I decided to skip afternoon tea and snuck into
Tangaroa's room.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200326E|0:
It should have been so easy.{E108:0010} {E1D1}All I had to do was
photograph the formulas I needed and get out of there.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200326E|2: I thought I might find you here.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200326E|3:
Stealing recipes from the famous cookbook, hm?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Tut tut tut.
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200326E|5:
What's this?{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}..."A Cure for Taste Disorders"?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Oh, no.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}That's just too tragic!
sce2_c8_09.bytes|0200326E|6:
A confectioner who can't taste anything?{E108:0010}
What will people say?
sce2_c8_09.bytes|02003276|1:
You'll what...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}You can't even hit me, you miserable worm.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|0:
Frost shoved me hard when I went to punch him.{E108:0010}
Knocked me clean off my feet.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|1:
I crashed into one of the lamps.{E108:0010}
Must have been when my blood got on it.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|2: So Mr. Frost wasn't the first to get hurt...
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|3:
When it was all over,{E108:0008} I realized I had to get rid of that
blood somehow,{E108:0008} so I scraped off all the bloodied bits.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|4:
I dissolved those salt shavings in some flavored ice
mixture,{E108:0008} {E1D5}and brushed it all over the harp!
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|5:
And that's how you made the evidence linking you to
the murder vanish...!
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|7:
He would have made me give him money to keep quiet
about my condition.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|8: So you decided you had to kill him!?
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|10:
Why would I let him live?{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Would you want someone
holding something like that over your head?
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|11:
Besides,{E108:0008} he's the one who drew first blood.{E108:0010}
Makes for a solid case of self-defense, don't you think?
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|12: (So that was the impetus behind it all...)
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|13: Anyway,{E108:0008} I initially took the lamp to Frost's room.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|14:
Went straight there once I'd figured out how I was
going to hide the bloody part.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|15:
...Inspired by all the {E285}ice-sculpting tools lying about the
place, I guess?
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|16:
You're not as dumb as you pretend to be.{E108:0018} Yeah,{E108:0008}
{E1D1}figured I could use them to chip it off and grind it up.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|17:
Once that was done,{E108:0008} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}{E107:0001}painting the stuff all over the
harp was easy.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|18:
But...{E108:0010} why Samson?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Why did you have to frame him...!?
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|19: I never meant for the cops to pin it on him.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|20: That was your fault.{E108:0010} {E283}{E107:0001}You and the rest of them.
sce2_c8_0a.bytes|020032DC|22:

I need you to think a little more before you speak.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|1: So do you remember your name, kid?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|3: She's been like this since she came in yesterday.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|4: ...Hmm.{E108:0010} So she's only been in the hospital for a day.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|5:
No way!{E108:0018} Amazing!{E108:0018} How did you figure that out?{E108:0010}
Wowww!
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|6:
(I...{E108:0008} might grow a little tired of our friend here
before too long...)
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|7:
They found her wandering around late at night
and brought her in.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|8:
I wanted to help out, {E108:0010}so I went through her stuff
to see what I could find...
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|9:
And did you find anything apart from my
business card?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|10:
Nothing with her name or her home address or--{E108:0010}
Oh!{E108:0018} Wait a second!
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|11:
She was wearing this!{E108:0010} It's a pretty unique
design, right?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|14:
The Yatagarasu symbol!?{E108:0018} So does that mean...?{E108:0010}
It can't be!
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|0300029A|17:
Yatagarasu Pin data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|0: So, Kay...{E108:0010} Do you mind if we call you that?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|2: What kind of person is this Kay...?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|3: Well, her --{E108:0008} your --{E108:0008} full name is Kay Faraday.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|4:
You're bright, and fun, and full of energy, and...{E108:0010}
Oh yeah!{E108:0008} You're a great thief!
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|6: Well, {E108:0010}there's a little more to it than that, but...{E108:0008} yes.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|7:
You see, thieves generally take things 
without permission.{E108:0008} Stealing, in--
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|8:
No need to overcomplicate things, sir.{E108:0010} It's just
a type of criminal, Kay.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|9:
A...{E108:0010} criminal!?{E108:0018} I'm a...?{E108:0010} But that's...!{E108:0010} That must be so
awful for the people I take things from!
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|10: N-No, that's...{E108:0010} That's not it at all...
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|11:
Gahhh...{E108:0010} Guess maybe oversimplifying things
wasn't a good idea, either...
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|12: Well, that sure explains a couple things!
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|13:
Look at these gloves --{E108:0008} they're just the kind of
thing a, uhh...{E108:0010} person like that would wear.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|15:
You're the Great Thief Yatagarasu.{E108:0008} You're no criminal.{E108:0010}
You've never committed a crime in your life.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|16: I need you to believe me when I say that.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002AC|18: (I think perhaps we'd better leave it there for now...)
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|0: ...I'm sorry.{E108:0010} I wish I could remember who you are.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|1: Uhh...{E108:0010} How do we know each other, exactly?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|2:
Hm.{E108:0010} Well, we...{E108:0008} You, uh...{E108:0010}
(It's not exactly easy to explain...)
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|4:
I am?{E108:0010} So...{E108:0008} a prosecutor is...{E108:0010} the head of some sort
of great thief network...?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|5: Well, uh...{E108:0008} No.{E108:0010} That's not quite it.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|6: (We last saw Kay two days ago...)
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|7:
(Perhaps we should try to find out what she's 
been doing since then.)
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|8:
Was the pin the only item she was carrying,
Miss Niedler?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|9:
Well, no, but I don't think the rest of that stuff will
be of much use to you.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|10: I'll be the judge of that.{E108:0010} Could you show us, please?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|11: Well, alright, then!{E108:0010} In no particular order, I present...
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|12:
Uhh, a Jammin' Ninja mask?{E108:0010} Was she at a show
or something?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|13: Hmm...{E108:0010} A letter.{E108:0010} And it's addressed to Kay.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|14: Next...{E108:0008} a ticket stub.{E108:0010} And finally...
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|15:
A fake flower.{E108:0018} They have these in the men's
room at a place I go to!
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|16:
It's called a corsage, detective.{E108:0010} Your prom date
might have worn one.
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|17: Aaand that's that!{E108:0010} Well?{E108:0008} Anything useful in there?
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|18: Uhh, {E108:0010}kinda hard to tell.{E108:0010} It's a weird bunch of stuff...
sce3_c0_m20_npc.bytes|030002BF|19:
(We should take a closer look at it all when we
have the chance...)

Bigg Building Pamphlet data updated

We heard there was some kind of incident.{E108:0018}
{E12F:00000008}...I'm sorry,{E108:0008} but who might this be?

This?{E108:0010} This is my gramma!{E108:0018}
Hold on one second...
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|12:
"And who the heck might you be?"{E12F:00240000}{E108:0018}
...Ahem.
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|13:
It's a pleasure to meet you.{E108:0018}{E112:0000}{E12F:00000000}
Prosecutor Miles Edgeworth,{E108:0008} at your service.

Nurse Niedler.{E108:0010} Your grandmother's name,{E108:0008} "Hertz"...{E108:0010}
Is she...?

sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|17:
"Don't you 'old fogey' me,{E108:0010} ya danged reprobate!"{E12F:00240000}{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}...Ahem.
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|19:
Whoa!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Sounds like you're kind of a big deal, ma'am!{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Heh heh!
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|21:
Oh,{E108:0008} him?{E108:0010} He's the one looking after the girl.{E108:0010}
The one with amnesia.
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|22: (Hmm...{E108:0010} It seems Dr. Hertz is a bit of an introvert.)
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|23: "Want me to fix those brow furrows o' yours, sonny?"
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|25:
Heh heh heh!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Ohh, there's no fixing those, ma'am!{E108:0010}
They're downright incurable!
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|26:
Wh--!?{E108:0010} You're sure you want me to say that, Gramma?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Well, alright, then...
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|27:
"Now,{E108:0010} I don't got a danged thing more to say to none o'
ya!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}You go on about your business, ya hear?"
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|28:
"As long as that business don't involve messin' with
the deceased's body!{E108:0018} I got work to do!"
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|31:
Hey,{E108:0010} you can't talk to us like that!{E108:0018}
What gives you the right,{E108:0010} huh, pal!?
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|33: She's in charge of this case,{E108:0008} {E12F:00240008}which means--{E108:0008} {E280}OUCH!
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|36:
How am I supposed to know!?{E108:0010}
She said it,{E108:0008} not me!
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|38:
Well,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}we've got a body to be looking at.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:00300000}Catch you later, gang,{E108:0010} and take care!
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|39: What the heck is their deal!?
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|40:
What does it matter,{E108:0008} as long as we have permission to
investigate?
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|41: "What does it matter"!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}It matters a bunch, sir!
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|42: What will you do now, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|43:
Examine the scene of the crime, of course.{E108:0010}
What kind of prosecutor would I be if I didn't?
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|46: That person over there is called Kay, right?
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|47: Surely that means...{E108:0010} {E150:00250020}I can't be the Kay you know...
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|48:
That's what we're looking to figure out.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}But don't worry:
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|49: You're the Kay we know.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'm certain of it.
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|51:
(A Kay who lost her memory,{E108:0008} and a victim who shares
her name.)
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|52:
(Both meeting their respective fates here at the Bigg
Building.)
sce3_c1_00.bytes|03000300|53:
(No doubt this case will be the the key to restoring our
Kay's memories.{E108:0010} I'd stake my life on it!)
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|2:
"I'd know that voice anywhere.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E284}That's von Karma's little girl."
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|3: Oh...{E108:0010} so you two know each other?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|4: It has been too long, Gramma Hertz.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|8:
(She is the daughter of Manfred von Karma and a
prosecutor like myself.)
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|9:
(These days,{E108:0008} she's mainly been working with Interpol.{E108:0010}
Though I thought she was supposed to be abroad...)
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|10:
Don't look so surprised.{E108:0010} Where my investigations lead,{E108:0008}
I follow.{E108:0010} No matter where in the world that might be.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|11:
Which means that there must be some kind of
international angle to this case, yes?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|12:
You know full well that {E188:00300000}I've been pursuing a certain
smuggling ring.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|13:
And that I won't rest until it has been destroyed,{E108:0008} and
its ill-gotten goods recovered!
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|14: So the smuggling ring is involved then?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|15:
...That information is to be shared on a {E1D1}need-to-know
basis.{E108:0010} And you don't need to know.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|16:
............{E107:0002}{E1D1}!{E108:0018}
(I see she means to be as helpful as ever...)
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|17:
Ms...{E108:0008} von Karma, was it?{E108:0018}
Gramma wants to tell you something...
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|18: "I'm about done here.{E108:0010} Scene's all yours."
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|19:
In that case,{E108:0008} we'd like to examine the body ourselves
too,{E108:0010} if you wouldn't mind.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|20:
"I mind plenty!{E108:0018} I remember where I heard about you
now, ya danged varmint!"
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|21:
"Don't need no soon-to-be-ex-prosecutor messin' the
place up!{E108:0018} Go on,{E108:0010} git!"
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|22:
Uh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}just remember {E1D1}it's not me saying this stuff,
okay!?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|25:
Eek...!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}I, I'm sorry!{E108:0010} I didn't mean to offend you!
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|26:
(This is going nowhere.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}I didn't want to have to do this but...)
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|27: Franziska,{E108:0010} I need you to add us to this investigation.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|28:
We have to see that body up close,{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}or we'll never learn
the truth about what happened to Kay.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|30:
Please,{E108:0010} you gotta help us out here!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Kay needs us!
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|32: I don't know what you're up to, but...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E285}{E12F:00040002}very well.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|34:
Of course,{E108:0008} I expect to receive a full explanation when
I grill you later.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|35: We owe you, sir!{E108:0010} Big time!
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|36: I wasn't talking to you,{E108:0008} Scruffy!
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|38:
Well, Gramma Hertz?{E108:0010} Will you allow them to examine
the body?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|39:
"I ain't about to say no to an international bigshot like
yerself, hon.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But are ya sure about this?"
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|40:
...Yeah,{E108:0008} I agree with Gramma.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Are you sure you're sure?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|41:
Of course I'm sure.{E108:0010} It's my prerogative to judge the
whole world in my name.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}That's just common sense.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|43: "Suit yerself.{E108:0010} But don't say I didn't warn ya."
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|44: ...Well, you heard her.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Try not to get fired, okay?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|45:
Don't worry.{E108:0018}{E112:0004} {E283}{E173:0000}{E12F:00040008}It'll take a lot more than this to ruin my
reputation should things turn sour.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|03000380|46: (Unlike me,{E108:0008} who's on the verge of losing my badge.)
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|0:
It seems we're no closer to discovering the identity of
our victim...
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|1: Then...{E108:0010} am I really Kay?{E108:0010} Can you really be sure?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|2: Of course we're sure!{E108:0010} What are you talking about!?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|3:
Th...{E108:0008} Thank you.{E108:0018}
And that person lying there...?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|4:
Is someone you may have murdered.{E108:0010}{E12F:00040009}
But that's all we can say for now.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|5:
No!{E108:0010} There's no way she did it!{E108:0018}
Isn't that right, sir?
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|6:
Indeed.{E108:0010} I don't believe the Kay we know could have
done something like this.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|7: You're becoming a real softie,{E108:0010} {E12F:00040007}Miles Edgeworth.
sce3_c1_01.bytes|030003B0|8: Well, look who it is again!
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|0:
With a winning smile and the number one name in the
business,{E108:0010} it is I --{E108:0010} {E150:000A0018}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E107:0001}Prosecutor Eustace Winner!
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|3:
I didn't call for you,{E108:0010} and I don't need you!{E108:0018} This case is
mine!{E108:0010} It's what the victim would have wanted!
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|6:
But be not afraid, everyone.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}For the Goddess of Justice
will guide us to the truth.
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|7:
She sure will!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Now that I'm here,{E108:0008} everything is going to be alright.
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|8:
Whoever did this will live to regret it!{E108:0010}
I'll show them wh-- {E188:00330001}{E1EA:00070034}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E12F:00090008}{E107:0001}EEEEK!
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|10:
(Wh-Why am I getting the death glare!?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I've got nothing to do with him!)
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|12:
My apologies.{E108:0010} I should have introduced myself sooner.{E108:0018}
{E12F:00080002}Verity Gavèlle,{E108:0010} at your service.
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|13: And the deceased in this case is...
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|14:
Rosie Ringer!{E108:0010} Attorney at law...{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E173:0000}{E12F:00090000}and a member of the
Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence!
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|15: (I see...{E108:0010} That would explain the keycard.)
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|18: You didn't tell me your name yet,{E108:0008} little boy.
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|19:
If you want to know my name,{E108:0008} all you have to do is--
{E107:0001}{E188:00330001}{E1EA:00070034}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E12F:00090008}OWWWWW!!!
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|22:
(I think we've established where the balance of power
lies in this particular room.)
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|25:
Heh{E108:0008} {E1D1}heh{E108:0008} {E1D1}heh!{E108:0020}
{E107:0001}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E12F:00090007}Looks like it's game over for you, Edgeworth!
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|27: "Alright,{E108:0008} that's me done!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}See ya next stiff!"
sce3_c1_02.bytes|03000400|28:
Yeah,{E108:0008} {E1D1}home time!{E108:0018}
I could murder a bowl of noodles right about now!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|0:
...Let's see.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}So the wound on her head is from when
she fell over after she died?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|2:
It was the candle holder that killed her, huh...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}And she died...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}sometime late last night...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|4:
It's very kind of you to share the coroner's findings
with everybody, Eustace.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|5:
But perhaps you should leave it there.{E108:0010}
We wouldn't want you to strain your voice, after all.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|8:
Whaaaa{E107:0003}aaat!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}What the heck are you talking about!?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|9:
I think Eustace's meaning was very clear:{E108:0010}{E152:0008000E000F}{E112:0008}
{E107:0003}Ms. Faraday is the murderer.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|10: And though she is dressed differently than usual...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|11:
...this young lady covered in bandages{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}is Ms. Faraday
{E12F:00230005}herself, correct?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|13: You really mean to arrest her here and now?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|14:
If you do,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}then I'll be forced to object.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}...Loudly{E108:0008} and forcefully.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|15: And as if further confirmation were needed,{E108:0010} there it is.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|16:
The Committee was right to call your conduct into
question.{E108:0018} It is questionable in the extreme.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|17:
Please, Mr. Edgeworth...{E108:0010} Just go...{E108:0018}
It's...{E108:0008} It's fine...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|20:
So...{E108:0008} maybe I did do it.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Maybe I killed that poor
woman,{E108:0010} {E1D1}and I just don't remember...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|21:
The Goddess smiles on those who confess their sins.{E108:0010}
It is her wish that our confessions cleanse us.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|22:
She applauds your commitment to the cause of Justice!{E108:0010}
As do I!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|24:
If you really intend to arrest Kay,{E108:0008} could you at least
explain your grounds for doing so?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|25:
I, for one,{E108:0008} certainly don't intend to yield.{E108:0018} {E283}{E12F:00000009}{E173:0000}{E107:0001}Not until I've
seen some evidence to support your accusations!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|26:
Then allow me!{E108:0018} Prepare to be hit with a faceful of
deductive genius, Edgeworth!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|27: -- Why I Think Kay Did It --
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|28:
They call it the human race because somebody has to
win it --{E108:0010} and that somebody is me!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|29:
I won this race, too!{E108:0018} I saw it before anybody else did!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Kay Faraday is the murderer,{E108:0008} no doubt about it!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|30:
She snuck into the Committee chamber looking to do
some of her trademark great-thieving!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|31:
Which means that nobody but her could have killed
Rosie Ringer!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|33:
(And if Detective Gumshoe is saying that,{E108:0008} you know it
must be bad...)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|34:
I asked you to explain your grounds for arresting Kay.{E108:0010}
Yet you have explained exactly nothing.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|35:
...True.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}But we haven't seen any proof of her
innocence, either.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|37:
It's alright, Kay.{E108:0010} Mr. Edgeworth will pull off a miracle
somehow.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:00010002}{E107:0001}You just gotta believe in him!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|38:
(M-My deductions aren't acts of divine intervention,
you know...)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|39:
Well, Miles Edgeworth?{E108:0018}
I'd hate for you to disappoint me.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|03000480|40:
But in the event that you do...{E108:0010} {E152:000400070008}{E112:0004}I will be sure to freely
let you know.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AA|0: -- Why I Think Kay Did It --
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AB|0:
They call it the human race because somebody has to
win it -- and that somebody is me!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AC|0:
I won this race, too! I saw it before anybody else did!
Kay Faraday is the murderer, no doubt about it!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AD|0:
She snuck into the Committee chamber looking to do

sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AE|0:
Which means that nobody but her could have killed
Rosie Ringer!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AF|0: Hmph...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}This is obviously a set-up,{E108:0008} plain and simple.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AF|2:
It's alright, Kay.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}The truth will come out.{E108:0008} I promise.{E108:0010}
I just need you to give me some time.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AF|4:
(Kay isn't capable of murder.{E108:0010} There's no way she killed
Ms. Ringer.)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004AF|5:
(But I have to prove that somehow,{E108:0008} or she'll remain a
suspect.)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004B5|0:
There are two major flaws with the statement you just
made.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004B5|1:
Flaws?{E108:0010} In a statement of mine?{E108:0018}
I don't make mistakes.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}It's literally impossible!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004B5|2: And that's a third flaw right there.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004B5|3:
You're just trying to confuse me!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}It's a cheap tactic,{E108:0008} even for you!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004B5|4:
Well, it won't work!{E108:0010} Because I'm the world champion of
not getting confused!{E108:0010} So there!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004BA|0:
Would you mind explaining the grounds for your
accusation in a little more detail?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004BA|1:
Heh heh heh.{E108:0010} Well, if you insist!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Prepare to be wowed, Edgeworth!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004BA|2:
I figured it all out before anybody else even had the
chance!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004BA|3:
Before I even saw the scene!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}No --{E108:0010} before I even heard about the case!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004BA|4:
I knew it right away!{E108:0010} She did it!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}{E12F:00090003}She's the murderer!{E108:0010} It can't be anybody else!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004BA|7:
Yes,{E108:0010} sorry!{E108:0018}{E112:0009}
I was just getting to that...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004C2|0: Oh, really?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}And what was it she was trying to steal?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004C2|3:
One pertaining to your professional conduct, in fact,{E108:0018}
{E1D5}{E12F:00080001}Mr. Edgeworth.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004C2|4:
And you can prove that she needed this file badly
enough to steal it?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004C2|5:
Oh,{E108:0008} there'll be no need to go into that.{E108:0010}
{E152:0008000E000F}{E112:0008}...Will there,{E108:0008} Mr. Prosecutor?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004CB|0:
And you have proof that it could only have been Kay
who committed the murder?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004CB|2:
...Then might I suggest you try {E188:00340000}{E1D1}looking into other
possible suspects with all due haste?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004CB|3:
For that, I believe,{E108:0008} would be the {E1D1}winning approach
here.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004CB|5:
According to the reports we've received,{E108:0008} the police
have found no signs of anyone else's involvement.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004CB|6:
So you're accusing Kay based on that alone?{E108:0010}
A little tenuous,{E108:0008} even for you.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004CB|7:
And suggesting that there are other possible suspects
when there clearly aren't,{E108:0008} isn't?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004CB|8:
(Arngh...!{E108:0010} If only I had something that could prove Kay
didn't do it...)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004D4|0: And what do you think of this piece of evidence?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004D4|3:
It proves that there's a contradiction in your
testimony!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004D4|5:
Calm yourself, Eustace.{E108:0010} His so-called evidence proves
nothing.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004D4|7:
Yes...{E108:0010} Perhaps so.{E108:0010}
(If only Judge Gavèlle weren't here...)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004D4|8:
If you could try to ensure that there is some substance
to your interjections, Mr. Edgeworth...?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004D4|9:
Hmph.{E108:0010} Fear not, Your Honor,{E108:0008} for I intend to do just
that.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004DE|0: I'm afraid you've contradicted yourself there!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004DE|3:
The only contradictions I see are in Mr. Edgeworth's
own baseless claims.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004DE|4:
Hah!{E108:0018} So my testimony's completely contradiction-free!{E108:0018}
I KNEW it!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004DE|5:
Gnrk!{E108:0018}
(His testimony is riddled with contradictions!)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004DE|6:
(If only Judge Gavèlle didn't keep covering for him,{E108:0008} I'd
be able to get to the truth...)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|0:
Are you familiar with this room, Mr. Winner?{E108:0010}
It certainly sounds like you are...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|1:
What can I say?{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}{E041}Winners{E040} know where {E041}winners{E040} go.{E108:0018}
I'm number one!{E108:0010} And two!{E108:0010} And three!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|2:
In other words,{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}the majority of your work is second,{E108:0008} if
not third, rate?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|3: Why do you always have to make fun of me!?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|4:
You can take it as a slight if you wish,{E108:0018} {E1CB:00A700020000}{E12F:0000000B}but the fact
remains that you seem unfamiliar with this keycard.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|5:
Who do you take me for?{E108:0010} Of course I'm familiar with it!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You need one of those to get in here...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|10: Mr. Winner.{E108:0010} Do you really even suspect Kay?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|11: O-Of course I do!{E108:0018} She did it!{E108:0010} Faraday's the killer!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|12: Then perhaps you can tell us...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|13: ...how Kay got into such a secure room as this...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|17:
Now,{E108:0008} as we know,{E108:0008} only members of the Committee
have keycards.{E108:0010} Therefore,{E108:0008} only they can enter.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|19:
Hm?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}(Why is she agreeing with me...?)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|20:
Please,{E108:0008} take a look at this.{E1CD}{E108:0010}
I had security pull the data earlier.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|21:
As you can see,{E108:0008} the door to this room was opened at
12:52 AM with Ms. Ringer's keycard.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|23:
...but who's to say {E188:00300000}{E1D1}the culprit didn't enter the room
with Ms. Ringer?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|24:
And then kill her over some sort of subsequent
disagreement?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|25:
It's certainly a plausible theory.{E108:0010}
But that's all it is.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|26:
For one,{E108:0008} it would require the victim and her murderer
to have known one another.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|27:
Yeah!{E108:0010} And Kay didn't know the woman!{E108:0018}
I'm sure of it!
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|28:
How can you possibly be sure of such a thing?{E108:0010}
That's pure speculation on your part, Detective.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|29:
There is no place for guesswork in the courtroom or at
a crime scene.{E108:0010} {E12F:00080001}{E112:0008}Hard evidence is what is required.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|30:
In that case...{E108:0010} {E152:00040009000A}{E112:0004}are you suggesting that you have said
hard evidence to support your theory?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|31:
Evidence that Kay Faraday and Rosie Ringer{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}knew one
another?
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|35: Dr. Hertz found it {E188:00300000}{E1D5}in the victim's chest pocket.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|36:
(...Another of the victim's possessions?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}And you kept this to yourself until now?)
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|39:
It was the candle holder that killed her, huh...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}And she died...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}sometime late last night...
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|41:
It's very kind of you to share the coroner's findings
with everybody, Eustace.
sce3_c1_03.bytes|030004E5|42:
But perhaps you should leave it there.{E108:0010}
We wouldn't want you to strain your voice, after all.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|0: Hah hah hah.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Shall I read it for you?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|1:
"{E043}Rosie,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Thanks so much for agreeing to help
with my plan!{E040}"
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|2: "{E043}Now we can both get what we want.{E040}"
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|3:
"{E043}Good luck getting your revenge for what
happened twelve years ago!{E152:0008000E000F}{E112:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}{E173:0000}{E107:0003}Kay{E040}".
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|4:
This would seem to indicate pretty strongly that the
two of them were {E1D5}accomplices,{E108:0008} wouldn't you say?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|5:
Accomplices in a plot to steal from the very room in
which we are standing!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|8:
Ms. Kay Faraday.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00080003}For this second crime,{E108:0008} as well as
Ms. Ringer's murder.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|10: Don't listen to her!{E108:0018} It's all lies!{E108:0010} All of it!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|11:
You're not like that!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}You'd never do any of the stuff
they're accusing you of!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|12: Then how do you explain {E1CB:00AF00000000}the letter, Detective?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|14:
(Unlike Mr. Winner,{E108:0008} I suspected that Judge Gavèlle
herself had some proof to support her accusation...)
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|15: (...but I didn't expect it to be quite so definitive...!)
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|18:
We're not done here yet!{E108:0010} I still have questions!{E108:0018}
And you'd better have answers!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|19: Would you mind if I handled this, Eustace?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|20:
Be my guest!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Have fun arguing Edgeworth into the ground!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|21:
(I can't let them steamroll me on this.{E108:0010}
I have to find a way to take back the advantage!)
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|23:
As the letter more than adequately proves,{E108:0010}
Ms. Faraday and Ms. Ringer were acquainted.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|24:
It seems Ms. Faraday had asked for Ms. Ringer's help
in a plot of some kind.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|25:
But,{E108:0008} for whatever reason,{E108:0008} their alliance must have
broken down.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|26:
Ms. Ringer lost her life in the resulting disagreement,{E108:0008}
{E188:00360000}{E1D1}{E1D5}but she had one last card to play.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|27:
The letter she kept safe in her left chest pocket,{E108:0008} which
spells out the name of her killer.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|28: She's good...{E108:0010} Better than ever, even.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|29: Think you can take her down, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|31:
Don't do this out of pride, Miles Edgeworth.{E152:00040009000A}{E112:0004} If you're
going to fail,{E108:0008} do it on somebody else's time.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|32: Hey!{E108:0018} Whose side are you on, sir!?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|33:
There is only one side to be on, Scruffy --{E108:0010} {E12F:00040002}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}the side of
the truth.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|34: Uh-oh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Looks like the kid's got something to say...
sce3_c1_04.bytes|03000580|35:
Well, if there's only one side to be on,{E108:0008} then it has to be
on the winning--{E107:0001}{E1EA:00070034}{E152:000900020003}AAAAAGH!!!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005A8|0:
As the letter more than adequately proves,
Ms. Faraday and Ms. Ringer were acquainted.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005A9|0:
It seems Ms. Faraday had asked for Ms. Ringer's help
in a plot of some kind.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005AA|0:
But, for whatever reason, their alliance must have
broken down.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005AB|0:
Ms. Ringer lost her life in the resulting disagreement,

sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005AC|0:
The letter she kept safe in her left chest pocket, which

sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005AD|0: (I can't imagine Kay writing a letter like that.)
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005AD|1:
(But unless we can get more out of Judge Gavèlle,{E108:0008}
I don't think we'll be able to prove that she didn't.)
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005AD|2:
(I should try pressing the good judge on some of her
statements and see if she lets something slip.)

sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B0|1:
Ms. Faraday was grateful for Ms. Ringer's cooperation,{E108:0008}
just as the letter says.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B0|2:
I think that more than adequately describes it,{E108:0008} don't
you?{E108:0018} Now,{E108:0008} as I was saying...
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B3|0: Can you tell us any more about this "plot"?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B3|2:
And it was written by your friend Faraday,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}making her
the prime suspect!{E108:0018} Case closed!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B3|3:
Anybody can forge a letter.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}It's not conclusive proof of anything!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B3|4:
I also seem to recall Ms. Faraday referring to herself as
a {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}{E12F:00080001}"Great Thief" on more than one occasion.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B3|6:
How can you be sure of that?{E108:0010} It's unlikely she would
tell you if she had resumed her activities,{E108:0008} surely?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B3|7:
Perhaps she took up stealing again,{E108:0008} and simply chose
to keep it from you?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B3|8:
(I can't prove that either way right now,{E108:0008} and she
knows it.)
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005B3|9:
As I was saying,{E108:0008} it seems Ms. Faraday and Ms. Ringer
were involved in a plot to steal something.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005BD|0:
"Whatever reason"?{E108:0018}
Could you be a little more specific?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005BD|1:
Not at the the moment.{E152:0008000E000F}{E112:0008} But I am sure our investigation
will uncover any number of possibilities.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005BD|2:
Whereas {E188:00300000}{E1D1}your lack of proof that Ms. Faraday is
innocent continues to be a major problem for you.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005BD|3:
I concede that some of the evidence would seem to
point to Kay's involvement.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005BD|4: But none of it is anywhere near conclusive!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005BD|5:
A letter explicitly outlining a connection to the victim,{E108:0008}
backed up by supporting evidence from the scene?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005BD|6:
How much more conclusive could it be?{E108:0018}
And what's more,{E108:0008} where is your proof to the contrary?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005C4|0:
Is there any actual evidence to show that Kay killed
Ms. Ringer?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005C4|1:
You don't give up, do you!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}What do you call that
letter, huh?{E108:0010} EVIDENCE,{E108:0008} duh!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005C4|2:
I wouldn't be so sure.{E108:0010} For one thing,{E108:0008} it doesn't mention
anything resembling a murder plan.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005C4|3: ...It doesn't?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}...Oh, uhh,{E108:0008} I guess not, huh?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005C4|4:
A-ha!{E108:0018} But it will once we hold a flame to it and reveal
the secret writing!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005C4|5:
I wouldn't place too much hope in that revealing
anything, Eustace...
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005C4|6: And we don't need it to.{E108:0010} Not when we have...
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|0:
We were able to examine the pocket in question for
ourselves.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|1:
And you want to know why the letter wasn't there,
I assume?
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|2:
It's simple!{E108:0010} The police's number one priority was
handing it over to me!
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|3:
The victim had kept it on the left side of her chest.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00080003}Next to her heart, in other words.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|4:
To indicate her heart's desire --{E108:0010} that her killer be
brought to justice.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|5:
I have little interest in sentimental speculations about
Ms. Ringer's desires.{E108:0010} But one thing does interest me...
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|6:
The fact that you said the letter was in the victim's {E188:00300000}{E1D5}left
chest pocket.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|7: It is the truth,{E108:0008} as the Goddess is my witness.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|8:
That is where the letter was found.{E108:0010}
There is no doubt about it.
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|9:
(The same place where she was stabbed with the
candelabrum...)
sce3_c1_04.bytes|030005CB|10: (I think that might prove to be a very important clue.)

{E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}Whoever reported it must have meant their left...

He...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}disappeared, you know...{E108:0008} *sniffle*{E108:0018} I...{E108:0008} I hope he's

I remember being on the viewing platform up on the
