sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300083A|5: And you were pointing your finger at me...
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300083A|7:
And asking me questions with a {E1D1}scary look on your
face!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300083A|8: (...That was only a few minutes ago!)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300083A|10:
Literally her only memory is of you {E1D1}trying to catch
her in a contradiction, sir!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300083A|11:
I'd be scared, too!{E108:0018} {E282}I might've even just given up right
then and there!{E108:0018} {E280}Yeah,{E108:0010} that'd be the end of me for sure!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300083A|12: (If you think that's scary, Detective,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}just you wait...!)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000847|0:
You must remember Detective Gumshoe, Kay.{E108:0010}
You and he were very close.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000847|1: Yeah...{E108:0010} Don't I remind you of anything?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000847|4:
I remember Mr. Edgeworth scolding you!{E108:0018}
{E282}And not just once --{E108:0010} hundreds of times!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000847|5:
...Th-That's no memory, kid.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00300000}{E1D1}That's just the joy of our
day-to-day life together.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000847|7:
("Joy",{E108:0010} {E107:0002}is it?{E108:0018} I must not be doing a good enough of a
job reprimanding you, then.)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000847|8: (I'll just have to try harder next time!)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000850|0:
Sorry,{E108:0008} but we're kinda busy right now.{E108:0010}
Gramma's still looking at the body...
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000850|1:
"You stay the heck outta my way,{E108:0008} y’hear!"{E108:0018}
...Ahem.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000850|2: So could you give us a few more minutes?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000850|3:
Of course.{E108:0010} We'll come back and examine the body
ourselves later after she's done.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000855|0:
That's a prosecutor's badge, right?{E108:0010} I've seen a few of
them be--{E12F:00240008}{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1DB}OUCH!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000855|1:
"Quit flashing that badge around in front of me,{E108:0010} ya
no-good{E108:0008} soon-to-be-ex-prosecutor!"
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000855|2:
"If ya like the danged thing so much,{E108:0010} maybe ya
shoulda tried harder to keep it!"
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000855|3:
...It's not the badge I care about.{E108:0010} I have more
important things to protect.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000855|4:
I don't even need to ask Gramma to know what she'd
say to that:
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000855|5:
"Gettin' wrapped up in some long thing's the only way
for it sometimes."
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000855|6:
...Thank you for such therapeutic advice.{E108:0010}
I'll bear it in mind.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300085C|0:
I'm so glad we found you so quickly.{E108:0010} Bet Kay woulda
been lost without her dear old dad!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300085C|1:
I...!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}I am NOT her father!{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}I'm simply an acquaintance.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300085C|2: Really?{E108:0018} Then why did she have your business card?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300085C|3:
...How many children do you know walk around with
their parents' business cards in their pockets?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300085C|6:
"Who gives a hoot if you're the girl's father!{E108:0018} {E1D2}You took
her in --{E108:0010} you danged well better look after her!"
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300085C|7:
I fully intend to.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You needn't worry about that. {E108:0008}
Kay is safe with me.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000864|0: Oh,{E108:0010} so somebody stabbed the victim with that.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000864|1: You know,{E108:0008} {E285}'cause of the three little holes in her chest?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000864|2:
And how do you think she came by the injury to her
head?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000864|3:
You're asking me?{E108:0018}
Sorry,{E108:0008} not a clue!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000864|4: All we know is it happened after she died.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000864|5:
(Was the head injury inflicted when the body was
moved by the perpetrator, perhaps?)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000864|6:
(Hopefully we'll find some evidence to tell us one way
or the other...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086B|0:
"Never mind whatever the heck that is.{E108:0010}
C'mere and gimme a look at yer ruffles, son."
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086B|1:
I don't need your opinion on my outfit, Dr. Hertz.{E108:0010}
I need your opinion on this piece of evidence.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086B|2:
"Ain't interested!"{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}...I gotta say,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I'm not really interested either.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086B|3:
(Hmm...{E108:0010} Maybe I'll have better luck with something
else...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|0:
Nurse Niedler,{E108:0010} could you tell me a little more about
your relationship with Dr. Hertz?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|1:
Sure!{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Let's see...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Well,{E108:0008} I've lived with her since I was
little.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|2:
If I got lost while I was out playing,{E108:0008} she'd come looking
for me till the sun went down.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|3:
If I fell over and grazed my knee,{E108:0008} she'd watch over me
till I found the strength to pick myself up.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|4:
(That's quite the heartwarming tale.{E108:0010}
A very classic grandmother,{E108:0008} grandchild relationship.)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|5:
And once I became a nurse,{E108:0008} if I stuck a needle in the
wrong place,{E108:0008} she'd say...
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|6:
"Not there, ya bonehead!{E108:0010} THERE!"{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}And then she'd {E1D1}pull it right out {E1D1}and{E12F:00240008}--{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D2}OUCH!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|7:
Yeowch! {E108:0018}{E1D2}I felt that, pal!{E108:0018}{E112:0001}
{E12F:00010006}{E1D1}{E107:0002}Can we stop talking about needles now!?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|8:
Anyway,{E108:0008} so yeah,{E108:0008} I can do any kind of nursing thing I
need for Gramma now.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|9:
Th-Thank you...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}That was a very thorough answer
indeed.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300086F|10:
(Even if the story didn't end on a heartwarming note,{E108:0008}
it's nice that they share such a close bond, I suppose.)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|0: You must be the best coroner in town, Dr. Hertz!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|1:
I'll bet you can spot a cause of death in seconds{E108:0010} {E1D9}and
get it right every time, huh?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|2:
"Whadda you know about coronerin',{E108:0010} ya big galoot!?{E108:0018}
{E282}You don't know the first danged thing!"
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|4:
You'll have to forgive the detective, Dr. Hertz.{E108:0010} I'll make
sure he learns not to say such presumptuous things.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|5:
"Hmph.{E108:0010} As if I care.{E108:0018}
You shut yer piehole and listen, Mister Smartypants!"
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|6:
"Spottin' a cause o' death correctly in seconds is my
bread and butter!"
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|7:
"Which is why the one thing that gets my goat worse
than anything is {E1D1}folks getting in my danged way!"
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|8:
...I think that's all she wanted to say.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Satisfied?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|9: Um,{E108:0008} absolutely.{E108:0010} Thank you very much.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|10:
All we want to do is to examine the body for clues.{E108:0010}
We'll do our best to stay out of your way.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300087A|11:
(I imagine it's because of how seriously she takes her
work that she reacts so...{E108:0010} colorfully to us.)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|0:
Hertz Hospital is the finest medical institution in the
land!{E108:0010} It would have to be with Gramma in charge!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|1:
How about it?{E108:0010}
You look like you could use some R and R!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|2:
"You sure do!{E108:0010} And you're in luck!{E108:0010} We got us an empty
suite or two with fancy hot tubs and all right now!"
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|3:
Thank you,{E108:0008} but as you can see,{E108:0008} we're in perfectly fine
health.{E108:0010} We won't be needing a room at the hospital.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|4:
Yup!{E108:0018} {E1D1}Fit as fiddles{E108:0008} and strong as oxes!{E108:0018}
{E1D2}That's our motto,{E108:0010} right, sir?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|5:
(It may be yours, Detective,{E108:0008} but I'd like to think I have
a little more going for me than that...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|6:
That doesn't matter!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E12F:00240005}Hertz Hospital welcomes {E1D1}the hale
and hearty, too!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|7:
Our "Healthy?{E108:0008} So What!{E108:0008} Stay Anyway!"{E108:0008} campaign is in
full swing, and going great!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|8:
Not sick or injured?{E108:0010} That's nice!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Your room is {E1D1}half the price!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|9:
(Nothing on earth could convince me to spend a night
in the hospital for pleasure...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|10:
This is a one-time offer, you know!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}{E12F:00240005}So how about it?{E108:0018}
{E188:00310000}{E1D2}Come stay at the happiest hospital in town!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000886|11:
A hot tub does sound pretty good...{E108:0010} And half price...?{E108:0018}
This might be too good to miss...
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000894|0: I'd like you to take a look at this, Franziska.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000894|4: I just wanted to show it to you,{E108:0008} that's all.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000894|6: Ah, good.{E108:0010} So you do still feel pain.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000894|7: Hmph...{E108:0010} And what's that supposed to mean?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|03000894|8:
I just wanted to make sure you hadn't foolishly gone
and lost all brain function yet.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|0: So Kay Faraday has lost her memory?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|1: How could you let that happen,{E108:0010} {E1D1}you fool!?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|2:
...Um.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}(I unfortunately have no good answer for that...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|3: Excuse me, but...!{E108:0010} {E1D1}It's not Mr. Edgeworth's fault...
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|4:
!{E108:0018} How are you walking around?{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}You're covered from head to toe in bandages...!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|5:
Oh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Thank you for your concern...{E108:0010}
But I'm fine,{E108:0008} honest.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|6:
.........{E107:0002}Y-{E108:0008}You're really not yourself,{E108:0008} are you?{E108:0010}
I didn't even say anything worth thanking me for.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|7:
Miles Edgeworth!{E108:0018} {E1D1}You'd better get her memory back
ASAP!{E108:0010} Or you'll be sorry!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|0300089D|8:
(You could just say with your words that you're
worried about her, you know...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008A6|0: There's no doubt about it.{E108:0010} This is the murder weapon.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008A6|1:
...What sort of person would stab a woman with
something like this!?{E108:0010} It's pathetic!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008A6|2:
We'll make the killer pay for what they did.{E108:0010}
But we have to find them first.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008A6|3:
...Yes...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I only hope that the killer's identity won't turn
out to be a truth we don't want to hear.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AA|0:
Miles Edgeworth!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You might have plenty of time on
your hands,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but I'm a busy woman!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AA|1:
I don't have the time to look over every piece of
garbage you thrust in front of me!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AA|2:
Now put it away and consider the evidence in your
possession more carefully before bothering me again!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AA|3: (She's every bit as unforgiving as ever, I see...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|0:
A murder in the trial chamber of the Committee for
Prosecutorial Excellence.{E108:0010} This is serious.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|1:
I did you the favor of allowing you to investigate
further.{E108:0010} I'll be expecting results.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|2:
And you'll get them.{E108:0010} Would I still be here if I didn't
think I could deliver?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|3: Hmm...{E108:0010} Come to think of it...
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|4: Why were you here in the first place?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|5:
(!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}...So she doesn't know I was summoned before the
Committee.)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|6:
That's a lonnng story!{E108:0018} Longer than the night time!{E108:0010}
And deeper than the sea!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|7:
How about we save Mr. Edgeworth the trouble and I'll
tell it to you my{E107:0001}{E12F:00010003}{E1EA:00060034}{E1D2}{E1D5}SEEEEELF!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|8: On second thought,{E108:0008} I don't care why you're here.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|9:
What's important is that we solve the case in front of
us.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Agreed?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|11:
Wait,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but you were the one who asked in the first
place, {E107:0001}{E12F:00010003}{E1EA:00060034}{E1D2}{E1D5}SIIIIIIIIIIR!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|12:
What's that saying again?{E108:0010}
{E282}"Whip first,{E108:0008} think later"!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008AE|13: But can't you make it the other way,{E108:0008} just for {E12F:00010003}{E1EA:00060034}{E1D2}{E1D5}MEEEE!?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|0:
What are you doing here, Franziska?{E108:0010} I thought you
were working abroad on something with Interpol?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|1:
Wouldn't you like to know?{E108:0010} But that's top secret,{E108:0008} and
I have neither the need nor the obligation to tell you.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|2: (Hmph.{E108:0010} I thought she'd say as much.)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|3:
Anyway,{E108:0008} never mind that.{E108:0010} Where's the prosecutor in
charge of this case?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|4:
Not that I know who's been assigned,{E108:0008} but I was hoping
they'd take care of the legwork for me.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|5:
Yet they haven't even bothered to show up!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}What in the world could they be doing!?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|6:
Yeowch!{E108:0018}{E12F:00010006}
{E1D1}I'm not the prosecutor's keeper, sir!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|7:
It's hardly fair to whip people who don't deserve it,
Franziska...
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|8: What use is a whip if you don't use it,{E108:0010} hm?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|9:
And who better to use it on than anybody who isn't
giving 110%!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008BC|10:
(I may not know who's been assigned yet, either,{E108:0008} but
I 110% feel for them already...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|0:
I couldn't help but notice that you seem to be
acquainted with Dr. Hertz.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|1:
How very astute of you, Miles Edgeworth.{E108:0018}
Yes,{E108:0008} I know her.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|2:
Once upon a time,{E108:0008} we...{E108:0018}
Never mind.
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|3:
(She doesn't seem keen to talk about it.{E108:0010}
Perhaps I'd better leave it for now...)
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|4:
What happened, sir?{E108:0010} What happened once upon a
time!?{E108:0018} {E1D2}You can't NOT tell us now!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|6:
Only a foolish fool foolishly pries into another person's
business!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|7:
Now hold your tongue, Scruffy,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}or you'll get more than
a mere tongue lashing!
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|8: It's a bit late for that...
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|9:
Spare the whip,{E108:0008} spoil the child!{E108:0010} {E1D1}A whip in time saves
nine!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Didn't you go to school,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D1}you whipless wonder!?
sce3_c1_m10_npc.bytes|030008C7|11:
(...Yes,{E108:0008} it seems that leaving it alone was the right
choice after all.)
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D01|0:
Can't believe a murder just dropped into our laps like
this.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D9}It really came outta nowhere!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D01|1:
I've gotta admit,{E108:0008} I'm not much good with surprises.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}My mind just goes kinda blank,{E108:0008} you know?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D01|2:
So if you're asking what I've noticed so far...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}the
answer's diddly-squat!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D01|3:
Hmph...{E108:0010} Well,{E108:0008} at least you didn't beat around the bush.{E108:0010}
That shows intelligence of a sort...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D01|5: Was that a compliment, sir!?{E108:0018} {E282}I am so honored!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D01|6:
My first ever compliment from Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
{E280}I'll remember those words as long as I live!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D01|7:
(...Thanks for making it awkward to burst your bubble
now, Detective.)
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|0:
Who knew the Committee was right below the viewing
platform?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|1: Saved ourselves a walk, though,{E108:0010} huh, Mr. Edgeworth!?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|2:
Oh,{E108:0008} I was checking out the pamphlet again,{E108:0008} and
spotted a blurb about the Committee.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|3:
It's in this side column --{E108:0010} "Bigg Buildling,{E108:0008} Little Burns".{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}Let's see here...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|4:
"On the fiftieth floor is the trial chamber of the
Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence!"
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|5:
"It's where puffed-up prosecutors are called to get the
deflating of their lives,{E108:0010} and a souvenir 'ex-' title!"
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|7:
"So go on up to see faces so sad,{E108:0010} {E282}they make beached
blobfish look happy!"
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|8: I,{E108:0010} I don't have a face sadder than a beached blobfish!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D09|9:
No, no!{E108:0018} {E1D1}That was the column!{E108:0018}
{E282}I was just reading what it says, sir!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|0:
So we've got a living Kay over here,{E108:0008} and a not-so-living
one over there...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|1:
Why are they both called Kay!?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}It can't just be a coincidence, right!?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|2:
No,{E108:0008} but we'll need to examine the body if we're to find
out more.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|3:
And how are we supposed to do that when Madame
Pompom won't let us near it!?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|4:
She's simply doing her job, Detective.{E108:0010}
We need to patiently wait our turn.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|6:
Maybe I can share a little theory of mine?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Hope you don't mind!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|7:
See,{E108:0008} I keep hearing about this "cloning" stuff they can
do nowadays.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|8:
What if somebody made a copy of Kay!?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}That would explain this whole mess, right!?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|10:
Let's take a look around the room while the coroner
finishes up her examination of the body.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D13|11: I've never been ignored so hard in my life...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D1F|0:
Didn't take long for Ms. von Karma to start waving her
whip around, huh.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D1F|1:
I tried keeping my distance,{E108:0008} but she's too quick.{E108:0010}
I can't get out of the way in time.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D1F|3:
Sometimes,{E108:0008} the more you try to move away,{E108:0008} {E1D1}the more
the whip seems to find its mark.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D1F|4:
Yeah,{E108:0008} it's enough to make you wanna give up
altogether --{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}and I should know!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D1F|5:
I've been smacked around by Ms. von Karma {E1D1}at least
as much as you, sir!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D26|0:
Maybe it's just because they're calling her Kay,{E108:0008} but the
victim is even starting to look like her to me.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D26|1:
You're imagining similarities because of the name,
Detective.{E108:0010} Don't allow it to mold your perceptions.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D26|2:
Mold them...?{E108:0018} {E285}Ugh, yeah,{E108:0008} wouldn't want that!{E108:0010}
Nobody wants their perceptions getting all fusty!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D26|3:
One minute it's moldy perceptions,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E282}next it's dusty
thinking,{E108:0008} damp assumptions,{E108:0008} you name it!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D26|4:
You're imagining similarities because of the word,
Detective!{E108:0018} {E1D1}Don't allow it to mold your perceptions!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D26|6:
We got permission to investigate the scene.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}So let's see
what we can figure out once we've molded things over!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D26|8:
You're imagining similarities because of the word,
Detective...{E108:0010} Don't allow it to mold your perceptions...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D2F|0: So the victim had Kay's old notebook, huh?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D2F|1:
She did.{E108:0010} Which is why they thought her name was
Kay, too.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D2F|2:
Talk about jumping to conclusions!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}I oughta arrest somebody {E1D1}for that!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D2F|3:
If you're keen to arrest somebody, Detective,{E108:0008} how
about you look for and arrest the murderer?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D2F|4:
Ouch...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}I, I was totally gonna help with that, too, sir!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D2F|5: (Yes,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I suppose all he can offer at this point is help...)
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D2F|6: ...In any case,{E108:0008} there may still be clues we've missed.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D2F|7: Let's take another look at the body,{E108:0008} carefully.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|0: I wonder how Kay lost her memory...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I'm afraid we still don't know enough at the
moment to figure that out.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|2:
But the victim did have Kay's promise notebook in her
possession.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|3:
Which suggests that Kay might have some kind of
connection to this case.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|4:
So if Kay gets her memory back,{E108:0010} it might lead to some
{E1D1}huge breakthrough in the investigation!?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|5: (I'm not so sure the outlook is quite that rosy...)
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|6:
Ooh...!{E108:0018} {E1D1}I just thought of a way we could cure Kay's
amnesia!{E108:0018} Wanna hear!?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|7:
I can already tell it's going to be terrible,{E108:0008} so no.{E108:0018}
In fact,{E108:0008} do me a favor and lock it away deep inside.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|9:
First we get a great big mallet!{E108:0010}
Then,{E108:0008} I'll take aim for one big whack, and--
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D37|10:
Turn the key now, Detective.{E108:0010}
Turn it and throw it away.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D42|0:
I don't know what I'd do if you weren't a prosecutor
anymore, sir...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D42|1:
Now's not the time to be thinking about such things,
Detective.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D42|2: But, sir!{E108:0018} {E1D1}The Committee has it out for you!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D42|3:
Even though you never did anything wrong!{E108:0018}
It's not fair!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D42|4:
I mean,{E108:0008} apart from being,{E108:0008} you know...{E108:0010} a little hard to
love and all...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D42|5:
...You're not exactly easy to love yourself when you
make comments like that!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D48|0:
Kay absolutey treasures that thing.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}She always has it pinned to her scarf.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D48|1:
And yet,{E108:0008} she remembered nothing when we showed it
to her.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D48|2: I know.{E108:0010} I'm so used to the bright, upbeat Kay...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D48|3: I don't know what to do with this new one.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D48|4:
Just be yourself, Detective.{E108:0010} It's the best thing you can
do for her right now.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D48|6:
Okay!{E108:0018} One big dose of Gummy's classic Bungling and
Bluster,{E108:0010} {E282}coming right up!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D48|7: (So he's aware that he's a serial bungler...!)
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D50|0:
Letters mean stamps.{E108:0010} And stamps mean stamp
collecting.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D50|1:
I didn't know you had any interest in the pursuit,
Detective.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D50|2: I like to keep a close eye on all the letters I receive, sir!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D50|3:
Then,{E108:0008} when I spot one without a postmark...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}that's
when I pounce!
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D50|4: Please tell me you don't reuse them...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D57|0: I wonder where Kay left all her memories...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D57|1:
Maybe someone's turned them in to lost and found.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Or maybe one of the guards has found them...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D57|3:
No, sir!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I just...{E108:0010} {E1D1}It's driving me crazy not being able to
do anything, you know?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D57|4: I...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I feel so bad for her...
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D57|5:
Then perhaps you should be concentrating your
efforts on this investigation.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D57|6: It's the one thing either of us can do for her right now.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D5F|0:
Heh heh heh!{E108:0020}
Good one, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010} ...I think?
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D5F|1:
You weren't showing me that for a reason, were you?{E108:0010}
Wouldn't know the first thing about it.
sce3_c1_partner.bytes|03001D5F|2: (And yet,{E108:0008} that doesn't seem to bother you at all...)
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|5:
Whoa,{E108:0010} {E280}talk about an unhappy face.{E108:0010}
Everything okay, big guy?
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|6:
You won't earn yourself too many admirers looking
like that.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|7: What are you doing here?{E108:0010} Has something happened?
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|8: Has something happened, he asks?{E108:0018} I'll say!
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|9:
It's been all over the news!{E108:0010} {E12F:000A0002}{E284}A murder in the
Committee chamber?{E108:0010} I'd call that a happening, alright.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|10: And what with your hearing being today,{E108:0008} I thought...
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|11: ...Well,{E108:0008} I couldn't help wondering if you were involved.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|12: They're reporting it on the news already?
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|13:
Heck yeah!{E108:0018} A dead lawyer?{E108:0008} A young woman on the
run?{E108:0010} They're lapping it up!
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|14: It's crazy stuff.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But compelling too, I gotta admit.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|15: So,{E108:0008} are you gonna give me the lowdown, or what?
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|17:
Whoa!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Maybe warn a guy before blowing his mind
next time!{E108:0010} Things are even crazier than I thought!
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|18:
This isn't a joke, Fender.{E108:0010} Kay's out there somewhere,{E108:0008}
all alone and without her memory.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|19:
Not to mention being the suspect in a murder.{E108:0010}
That definitely doesn't make things any easier...
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|20:
But where the heck could she have gotten to?{E108:0018}
You're sure she doesn't remember zip?
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|21: I thought she might have come here, but...
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|22:
No luck, huh?{E108:0010} Can't say I'm surprised.{E108:0010}
Sounds like she thinks she's done you wrong.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|23:
She wouldn't want to cause you even more trouble by
rocking up on your doorstep.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|24:
You think I don't know that!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}But I'm out of places to look...
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|25:
Hey,{E108:0008} take a chill pill, compadre!{E108:0010}
This isn't like you!
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|26:
You're wound up tighter than a clockwork monkey!{E108:0010}
...Which isn't a bad thing, necessarily.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|27:
After all,{E108:0008} it's got even you running from pillar to post
looking to save an innocent from jail.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|28: Acting like the attorney I know you were born to be.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|29:
Look, Fender...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I may have given up my badge
earlier...
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|30:
But that doesn't mean I've decided to become an
attorney.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|31:
However,{E108:0008} Kay isn't just some suspect in a murder to
me.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|32:
She's somebody I've come to know very well,{E108:0010} even if
we've only been acquainted for a short while.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|33: And she'd never harm a fly,{E108:0008} let alone another person.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|34:
...Blow my mind twice in five minutes, why don't you?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Kid's lucky to have you in her corner, champ.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|35: I hope you don't mind me saying this, but...
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|36:
That's quite the bond that's sprung up between the
two of you.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|37:
Enough to give me and your old man's a run for its
money, even.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|39: She just likes to involve herself in my affairs.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|40:
Heh!{E108:0010} You can say that again!{E108:0010} From what I've seen,{E108:0008} she
likes to charge into things no holds barred!
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|41:
But she's done you some good,{E108:0010} I can tell.{E108:0010}
You two make a great team.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|43:
Can't say I'm not a little jealous.{E108:0010}
Seeing as my partner in crime's no longer around...
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|44: Anyway,{E108:0008} you need to track her down.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|45:
Connections like that don't grow on trees.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}I should know...
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|47: Alright,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}how about this for a plan?
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|48:
You're fresh out of ideas about where she could be.{E108:0010}
And you can't just walk the streets shouting her name.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|49:
So why not go back to the source?{E108:0010} {E284}Look into how she
lost her memory in the first place.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|50:
You just might turn up some clues that'll help narrow
things down.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|52:
Based on what she told us,{E108:0008} it sounds like it all started
at the Bigg Building.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|53:
Then that's where we're headed!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Next stop,{E108:0010} {E280}the Bigg time!
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|54:
And maybe you can give your face the good news on
the way.
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|55:
Kay won't come frolicking back into the fold if the first
thing she sees is you scowling like that!
sce3_c2_00.bytes|03000900|56:
............{E107:0003}Very funny.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}(Fender is truly a force of nature all on his own...)
sce3_c2_01.bytes|03000980|2:
Not even a murder on the premises could make this
place close its doors!{E108:0010} Gotta chase that last dollar, huh.
sce3_c2_01.bytes|03000980|3:
There's hardly anybody around, though...{E108:0010}
Guess we've got the whole place to ourselves.
sce3_c2_01.bytes|03000980|4:
(The first step towards proving Kay's innocence is to
figure out how she lost her memory...!)
sce3_c2_01.bytes|03000980|5:
Earth to Miles!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}We've got sleuthing to do!
sce3_c2_01.bytes|03000980|6:
This rooftop paradise is all ours,{E108:0010} so let's focus up and
do what we're good at for Kay,{E108:0008} alright?
sce3_c2_01.bytes|03000980|7:
"Do what we're good at", huh...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I suppose I should be
grateful there's at least something we can do.
sce3_c2_01.bytes|03000989|3:
U-Um...{E108:0010} Don't mind me.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E280}I was just lying in wait!
sce3_c2_01.bytes|03000989|4:
...That would make you a criminal, Kay.{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Perhaps you meant to say{E108:0008} "laying low".
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|0:
Nevertheless,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I doubt people will look kindly on a
suspect haunting the site of her supposed crime.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|1:
Surely you understand that,{E108:0008} even in your current
state?
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|2:
On top of which,{E108:0008} while you've been playing
hide-and-go-seek...
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|3:
...I've been worried sick and frantically trying to find
you.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|6: Now,{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}what were you thinking coming back here?
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|8:
Did you think your amnesia would excuse your
recklessness?
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|10: I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I came to try and help you get your badge back.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|12:
I thought if...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}If I could get my memory back,{E108:0008} I might
be able to...
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|14:
I thought if I came back to where I lost my memory,{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}maybe I could...
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|18: ...There's one thing you haven't lost, you know.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|19: Your ability to surpass my expectations at every turn.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|20:
I couldn't be more certain now that you're the Kay
I know so very well.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|21:
However...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000008}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}I don't appreciate you being so reckless.{E108:0010}
Do you hear me?
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|23: Seriously, Miles!?{E108:0018} You're killing me here!
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|24:
You were banking good-guy points,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}and then you went
and blew it by blowing your top!
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|25:
Good to see you, kiddo.{E108:0010} Glad to see you're safe.{E108:0018}
{E12F:000A0008}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Come on,{E108:0008} bring it in.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|29: Yeesh,{E108:0010} I was just trying to lighten the mood.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|30:
Live news now from the Bigg Building,{E108:0010} where a
shocking murder took place earlier today.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|31:
Police continue their hunt for a young woman known
to have been present at the scene.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|32:
She's considered the prime suspect,{E108:0008} and police say
no effort is being spared in trying to track her down.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|34: Hoo, momma...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}They're not messing around, huh?
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|35:
Well, team,{E108:0008} what's the plan?{E108:0010} Looks like the clock's
ticking down --{E108:0008} and fast.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|36: Indeed.{E108:0010} It's only a matter of time before they find us.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|37:
Alright,{E108:0008} first things first.{E108:0018}
Kay,{E108:0010} {E12F:000A0001}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}you're sticking with us from now on,{E108:0008} capiche?
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|38: But, I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I've caused you so much trouble already...
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|39:
You can hardly make things any worse for me at this
point.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|41:
Then it's settled.{E108:0018}
We're in this together like the three musketeers!
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|42: Miles here will be in charge of proving Kay innocent.
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|44:
So I'm gonna need you to do everything you can to
help him with his investigating,{E108:0010} okay, Kay?
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|46:
Great,{E108:0008} now we've gotta move quick.{E108:0010} Can't be getting
bagged by the boys in blue before we've even started!
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|47:
You two may not have any more to lose,{E108:0008} but your
Uncle Eddie sure does!
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|48:
Gregory would never forgive me if I got the family
office shut down...
sce3_c2_02.bytes|03000A00|49:
(Thank you, Fender...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'm sure I owe you more than I'll
ever really know.)
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|2:
I heard about what happened from Detective
Gumshoe!
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|3:
I was in the area,{E108:0008} {E282}so I thought I'd come by and see
what's going on!
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|5:
(She's a high school student,{E108:0008} currently studying in
Europe to become a forensic scientist.)
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|6:
(The younger sister of a former superior of mine,{E108:0008}
we've also stood in court together.)
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|7: The detective called me up in a panic!
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|8:
He said your badge fell off of the Bigg Building,{E108:0010} {E280}and
that Kay was in a man's suit, and--!
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|10:
Didn't you just leave to go back to Europe a few days
ago?
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|12: Yep!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I'm here with one of my professors!
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|13:
But not to do any school work or anything.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}Just some interpreting.
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|14:
Then shouldn't you be off doing that{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}instead of
galavanting around a crime scene?
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|15:
Oh, it's fine!{E108:0010} {E280}There's this wonderful thing called body
language, after all!
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|17:
Anyway,{E108:0008} never mind me!{E108:0010} {E1D1}This is about Kay!{E108:0018}
{E282}How is she?{E108:0010} Where is she?
sce3_c2_03.bytes|03000B00|18:
Aww, shucks,{E108:0008} isn't that sweet, Kaymeister?{E108:0010}
Your little friend is worried about you!
