Yup,{E108:0008} an' a lily-white suit with a purdy magenta flower!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Man...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}{E188:00310000}Gotta find out more, or this story's dead!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002028|3:
You've always managed to get a story one way or
another, it seems.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002028|4:
And what's so wrong with that, huh?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Chasin' leads
takes time,{E108:0008} an' takin' pictures costs money!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002028|5:
An' a day without pay is a day without dinner!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Ooh, I can feel my belly grumblin' now...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002028|6:
If you're so sure there's a scoop in this,{E108:0008} I'm sure you
can hold out a little longer.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|0: You didn't notice this blood before we found it?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|1: Y'all found it with yer fancy lumi-watchamacallit!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|2:
True...{E108:0010} And you didn't happen to see the murderer
trying to cover their tracks, did you?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|3:
Nope,{E108:0008} didn't see nothin'!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Bupkis!{E108:0010} Diddly-squat!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}{E188:00300000}Maybe they did it while I wasn't lookin'?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|4: I done missed the murder, too, remember?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|5:
How could I forget?{E108:0010} You were busy cowering in terror,
I seem to recall...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|6:
I was busy savin' the life of a future journo hero, thank
you very much!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|7: ...Behind a kind and protective Mr. Alif Red.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300202F|8: Sounds a lot like cowering in terror to me...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002038|0:
No offense, an' all, but...{E108:0010} if yer tryna reel me
in here...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002038|1:
...y'all better have some tasty bait on that hook.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E282}By which I mean scoops!{E108:0010} And plenty of 'em!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002038|2: (She didn't seem interested in that at all...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|0:
Dirty deals in a secret storeroom!{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Talk about a story!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|1:
Was there anything else on sale apart from the items
of evidence in this room?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|2:
Sure,{E108:0008} there was regular ol' stuff, too.{E108:0010} Shady artworks
from who knows where,{E108:0008} that kinda thing.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|3: (In what way are "shady artworks" regular, exactly?)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|4: But the evidence was the big draw, for sure!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|5:
Reckon they were sellin' 'em faster than the crooks
could smuggle 'em outta the cop and prosecutor shops!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|6:
And I'll bet you got pictures of the whole thing,{E108:0008} right,
Ms. Hart?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|7:
Well, you see!{E108:0020} {E12F:000D0000}The main event was down below.{E108:0010}
I hadda try and see what I could from up here.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|8:
Having been up here since yesterday,{E108:0008} I assume you
witnessed the entire auction from start to finish, then?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|9:
It was an underground affair, like I said,{E108:0008} so folks wasn't
exactly givin' much away.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|10:
All them customers came down one at a time from up
on the roof there.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|11:
Threw on masks just as soon as they got down the
ladder.{E108:0010} And that ain't all.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|12:
They had voice changer doodads on 'em, see.{E108:0010}
Teeny tiny ones,{E108:0008} dinkier than a bug's behind.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|13:
It's so ya couldn't see their real faces,{E108:0008} and ya couldn't
hear their real voices!{E108:0010} {E1D1}Syruptitious as all heck!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|15: I surely do!{E108:0010} Sweet,{E108:0008} sweet,{E108:0008} surreptitude!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|17:
Anyhoo,{E108:0008} once they had their gear on,{E108:0008} they went
right on downstairs.{E108:0018}{E137:00330004}{E134:0033}{E137:00330005}{E108:003C} And then,{E108:0018} {E137:00330006}in came the next one.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|18:
When it came time to leave,{E108:0008} they all done the same but
in reverse.{E108:0010} Up they came again,{E108:0008} one by one by one.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|19: Masks back on the hook,{E108:0008} {E137:00330009}{E134:0033}{E108:003C}up the ladder an' away.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300203B|21:
Masks data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002051|0: Hmm...{E108:0010} And how many participants were there?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002051|1:
Eleven altogether.{E108:0010} {E043}I counted 'em when they came
down the ladder{E040}.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|0:
I didn't just hide behind a stupid statue the whole
time, ya know.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|1: You didn't?{E108:0010} Then where were you?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|2:
Well, when I first got here I{E107:0007}.........{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You know what?{E108:0018}
{E12F:000D0007}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}That ain't important right now.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|3:
(So you were hiding behind the statue from the very
beginning.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|4:
Anyhoo,{E108:0010} {E12F:000D0004}{E1D1}I watched all them folks come in from my
spyin' spot there in the shadows.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|5: I see...{E108:0010} So you were watching from behind the statue...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|6: They used {E12F:000D0002}{E1D1}that there elevator to get down below.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|7:
And once they was all down there,{E108:0008} I snuck up an' took
me a peek at what was goin' on.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|8: You mean the elevator remained in the room beneath?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|9:
Naw,{E108:0008} they sent it back up.{E108:0018} {E12F:000D0005}But there's a little
peeky-hole if ya know where to look.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|10: Elevator don't quite sit flush with the floor, see?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|11:
And if you bend down and squint just right,{E108:0008} you can
see the whole shebang!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|12: Did you catch sight of who was in charge!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|14:
Ain't half so good a story if ya don't get a glimpse o'
the evil ringleader, after all!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002053|15:
(I wonder who this "ringleader" is.{E108:0010} I'll have to ask her
some more...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|0:
You mentioned a "ringleader".{E108:0010} Can you tell me any
more about them?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|2:
An' an exclusive ain't much danged good if ya done
spilled the beans already!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|3:
I see...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}So you don't actually know anything about
them.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|4:
You think that's why she won't give us an answer?{E108:0010}
Makes sense, I guess.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|5:
*sigh*{E108:0018} {E174:00000001}{E12F:000D0006}Ya got me.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Couldn't see if it was a man or a
woman,{E108:0008} a kid or an old-timer --{E108:0010} nothin'!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|6: What were they wearing?{E108:0010} Could you see that, at least?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|7:
Sure.{E108:0010} White jacket,{E108:0008} white gloves,{E108:0008} and a magenta flower
on the lapel.{E108:0010} Them three things is what I remember.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|8:
But what good's a description of the outfit if I don't got
a clue who was wearin' it?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|9:
So this ringleader disguised their identity, too,{E108:0008} just like
everybody else?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|10: Yessiree!{E108:0020} Mask,{E108:0008} voice changer --{E108:0010} the whole nine yards!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|11: They were wearing one of the masks...?{E108:0018} {E188:002F0000}Which one?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|13: Z-Zurvan!?{E108:0018} What kind of a name is that!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|14:
Seriously, Mr. Edgeworth!?{E108:0018} {E1CB:00C300000000}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}You've never heard of
Zurvan!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|16: Who hasn't heard of Zurvan the Time Lord!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|17: (I think you might be better off asking who has...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|18: So you didn't get a glimpse of their face at all?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|19:
No,{E108:0008} I danged well didn't!{E108:0018}{E12F:000D0006}
{E107:0002}Which kinda scotches my scoop...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|20:
*sniffle*{E108:0010} This whole mess has been nothin' but a snipe
hunt...{E108:0010} I shoulda never come...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002063|21:
Ringleader's Appearance data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002079|0:
(We know of somebody who was dressed like that.{E108:0010}
Maybe I should try showing that evidence to Ms. Hart.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|0:
You said that the ringleader was wearing a white
jacket,{E108:0008} white gloves,{E108:0008} and a magenta flower, correct?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|1:
Sure did!{E108:0010} Don't ask me why they was dressed up like a
peacock on parade day,{E108:0008} but they was!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|2: Is this the outfit you saw?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|3: Well, holy smokes!{E108:0020} It sure as heck is!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|5:
All we know is that she is the victim in the case we're
investigating.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|6: Her name was Rosie Ringer.{E108:0010} Do you know her?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|7:
Nope...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:000D0006}So the ringleader was a lady?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|8:
Well, ain't that just slippier'n a danged eel!{E108:0018}
Throwin' me off with a man's jacket like that!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|9: (I hardly think she did it to fool you specifically...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|10:
(But setting that aside for now,{E108:0008} what's important is that
we've discovered something vital to the case.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|11:
(Namely that the underground auction was chaired by
none other than our victim.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|12:
So somebody done bumped off the boss, huh...?{E108:0010}
Then,{E108:0008} that's what was happening.........
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|14:
Oh, uh...{E108:0020} Nothin'!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Nothin' at all!{E108:0018}
{E12F:000D0007}Y'all just go on about yer business, now!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|15:
No offense, Ms. Hart,{E108:0008} {E1D1}but that made you sound about
five times more suspicious.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|16: Suspicious my foot!{E108:0018} I told y'all,{E108:0010} it's nothin'!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|17: And you won't get nothin' more outta me than that!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|19:
How many danged times do I gotta tell ya!?{E108:0010} It ain't
nothin', okay!?{E108:0018} An' I ain't sayin' nothin' either way!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|20:
Aww,{E108:0010} you can tell us just a little more?{E108:0010}
Pretty please...?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|21:
I'll tell you this, okay?{E108:0018} I'm a journalist!{E108:0010} A newshound!{E108:0010}
A scoop-hunter, y'hear?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|22:
Exclusive articles go out,{E108:0010} money comes in!{E108:0018}
That's how the game is played!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|23:
Tell you more!?{E108:0010} Heck,{E108:0008} I done told y'all too much
already!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|24:
Wait,{E108:0010} what if I, uh...{E108:0018} examined some fingerprints for
you?{E108:0010} Pro bono!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|25:
What kind of a cockamamie thank-you is that!?{E108:0018}
I'd sooner get a tooth pulled!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|26:
You want intel,{E108:0008} you go dig it up yerselves,{E108:0010} just like
I had to!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|27: Okay...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Guess she isn't going to talk to either of us...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|28:
Oh,{E108:0008} she will.{E108:0018}
I'll handle things from here, Ema.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|29:
There's a certain technique I find useful when dealing
with difficult customers such as her.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300207A|30:
She may not give up the information voluntarily,{E108:0008} but
that doesn't mean she can't be...{E108:0010} {E285}{E173:0000}persuaded to.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002099|0: Let's start by observing our opponent...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002099|1:
I ain't tellin' y'all nothin', y'hear!?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Now quit wastin' my time before I really blow a fuse!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002099|2:
(As we've seen,{E108:0008} she's very {E041}quick-tempered{E042}.{E108:0010} She'll try
to cut the conversation dead wherever possible.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002099|3:
I won't have much time to think,{E108:0008} so I'll need to be swift
and decisive.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002099|4: Ms. Hart is definitely hiding something{E040} from me.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002099|5: So my first move{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E283}{E173:0000}is to discover what that something is!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300209F|0:
I need you to tell me everything you know.{E108:0010}
{E282}And don't you dare leave anything out!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300209F|1: Go jump in a creek,{E108:0010} {E280}ya big bully!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300209F|2:
Why should I tell you anything!?{E108:0010} You don't got nothin'
to do with me!{E108:0010} Nor me with you, neither!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300209F|4:
I don't have a {E041}clue{E040} as to how to proceed with this line
of questioning.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020A6|0:
I don't have anything to do with you?{E108:0010}
That's a little unkind, don't you think?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020A6|1:
After all,{E108:0008} I know your apprentice.{E108:0010}
I know her pretty well, in fact.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020A6|3:
Guess it does seem kinda {E1D1}cold of me to say that if you
know her pretty good...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020A6|4:
Wouldn't want the poor kid thinkin' I don't give a rat's
behind...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020A6|5: Good.{E108:0010} Then you'll tell us what you know?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020A6|6:
...Fine.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}See,{E108:0008} it's like this.{E108:0010} Got me a scoo--{E108:0010}{E104}{E12F:000D0003}{E101:000D000E}{E107:0002}W-Wait!{E108:0010} {E281}What am I thinkin'!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Dangit, Lotta!{E108:0010} {E1D1}You can't
let him bamboozle ya that easy!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|0:
How embarrassing.{E108:0010} A professional journalist making a
careless slip of the tongue.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|1:
You have a scoop, don't you?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Now tell me what it is!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|3:
A-Alright...{E108:0010} I got me a scoop.{E108:0010}
A big one...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|4:
But I can't just go blabbin' about it to y'all!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}I got bills to pay!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|5: She may be hiding {E1D1}something very important.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|6: I have to get it out of her somehow.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|7: We need to know the {E285}{E043}details of this scoop{E040}.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|8:
She's quick to anger.{E108:0010} But she's also quick to let key
information slip.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020B0|9:
Now that we know that,{E108:0008} the rest shouldn't be too hard.{E108:0018}
{E283}{E173:0000}Let's see what else we can get out of her.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020BC|1:
That's better.{E108:0018} {E12F:000D0002}Bein' a newshound's all about keepin' a
cool head no matter what the world throws atcha, see!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020BC|2: Speaking of newshounds,{E108:0010} {E285}this might interest you...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020BC|3:
I met one a few days ago.{E108:0010} She was a very hungry
young reporter indeed.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020BC|4:
A reporter with a very particular turn of phrase,{E108:0010}
similar to your own, in fact.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020BC|5:
O-Oh yeah?{E108:0010} She spoke like me, huh?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Guess that coulda been {E1D1}someone I know...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020C2|1:
And if I had closed my eyes,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I could've believed I was
listening to you.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020C2|2: She told me about somebody she called {E1D1}"the Chief".
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020C2|3: She was talking about you,{E108:0008} wasn't she?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020C2|5:
Well, ain't that somethin'?{E108:0010} Where did y'all bump into
her?{E108:0010} She's a great kid.{E108:0010} Reckon--
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020C2|6:
Wait...{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E280}{E12F:000D0001}Oh, no you don't!{E108:0018} {E1D2}You ain't gettin' on my good
side bringin' her into this, ya sneaky snake!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020C2|8:
(Interesting.{E108:0010} {E043}Talking about Ms. Lloyd seemed to make
her lower her guard a little{E042}...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020C2|9: (I think we can {E285}{E041}use that to our advantage{E042}.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020CC|0:
This scoop of yours,{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00300000}does it have something to do with
the auction?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020CC|1:
Y-You know what?{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}I clean forget!{E108:0010} Heh...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020CC|2: But you tried to infiltrate an underground auction.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020CC|3:
It only stands to reason that you observed something!{E108:0010}
Otherwise,{E108:0008} what would you have to write about!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020CC|4:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I don't know what to tell ya...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I didn't hear nothin'!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D1|0:
If you didn't hear the sound of nothing...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}does that
mean you did hear the sound of something?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D1|1: Something during your time in this room?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D1|2:
Well, see...{E108:0010} That's...{E108:0018}
{E12F:000D0007}{E107:0002}It wasn't nothin', really.{E108:0010} Just a little noise is all.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D1|3:
Wouldn't even make Page Sixteen.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Forget I mentioned it.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D1|5:
(Something that made a noise of some kind.{E108:0010}
This could be a {E285}valuable {E041}clue{E042}...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D7|0:
Your big scoop involves {E188:002F0000}something criminal in nature,
doesn't it?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D7|1: Meh...{E108:0010} {E1D1}Might be it did,{E108:0008} {E1D1}might be it didn't...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D7|2: Which is it!?{E108:0010} This is important!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D7|3:
A-Alright,{E108:0008} alright...{E108:0010} You don't gotta holler at me like
that...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020D7|4:
I ain't done nothin' {E1D1}shameful or nothin'...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Just snuck in and {E1D1}did some undercover reportin'...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020DC|0:
I'll be the judge of whether your actions were shameful
or not.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020DC|1:
And unlawful entry into private property is very
shameful indeed!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}In fact,{E108:0010} it's a crime!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020DC|2: Hey!{E108:0010} {E282}You did the exact same thing, genius!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020DC|3:
Aww, but...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I guess you're a prosecutor, huh...{E108:0010}
You're allowed to do stuff like that...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020DC|4:
(Let's not mention the fact that I handed in my badge,{E108:0008}
shall we...?)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020DC|5:
Still,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it don't amount to a whole hill o' beans, right?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}There's folks out there that've done {E1D1}way worse...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020DC|6:
Murder, for one...{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Next to murder,{E108:0008} trespass ain't hardly nothin'...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020E3|0: From your mutterings about murder just now...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020E3|1:
...I gather that your scoop has something to do with {E282}a
homicide?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020E3|3:
You know,{E108:0008} about murder bein' the big one, an' all.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Ain't nothin' worse than murder!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020E3|4: Not the most skillful evasion I've heard in my career...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020E3|5:
Look,{E108:0008} I done told you, okay?{E108:0010} I snuck into the auction.{E108:0010}
{E282}I'll cop to that!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020E3|6:
But murder?{E108:0010} I don't know nothin' 'bout no murder.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Ain't seen nothin',{E108:0008} {E1D1}ain't heard nothin'!{E108:0010} Scout's honor!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020E3|8:
I don't have a {E041}clue{E040} as to how to proceed with this line
of questioning.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|0: You told me you heard something during the auction.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|1:
You claimed it wasn't important,{E108:0008} but it must have
been.{E108:0010} Otherwise,{E108:0008} why remember it?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|2:
I think it was something very memorable indeed.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}In fact,{E108:0008} {E12F:00000008}I believe it was the cry of a murder victim.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|3:
Ack...!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}How do you keep doin' that...?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|5:
I wound up smack-dab in the middle of a murder
scene.{E108:0010} {E1D1}But only by accident!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|6:
And that's all yer gettin' outta me!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Won't be no scoop left otherwise...!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|8:
It must be {E1D1}the same murder we ourselves have been
investigating.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|9:
That should prove to be a very valuable piece of
information indeed.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|10:
Perhaps we should finish up by {E285}{E043}confirming the
credibility of her claim{E040}.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020EE|11:
I have her on the back foot now.{E108:0018}
{E283}{E173:0000}Time to finish this!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020FA|0:
I need you to describe the murder in detail.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E282}It's vitally important!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020FA|1:
Heh.{E108:0010} Wish I could help y'all, but...{E108:0010} {E1D1}I don't rightly recall
a whole bunch...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020FA|2:
Ain't much I can tell ya.{E108:0008} Sorry.{E108:0010} I mean,{E108:0008} look at me...{E108:0010}
Can't even get my facts straight half the time...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030020FA|4:
I don't have a {E041}clue{E040} as to how to proceed with this line
of questioning.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002101|0:
I can't imagine that being so vague on the facts is a
trait valued among journalists.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002101|1:
Surely accuracy and honesty are what's necessary
when reporting on a story.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002101|3:
It seems your so-called information is not credible
after all.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002101|4:
Look...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}There was a murder...{E108:0008} and I was there...{E108:0018}
{E1D1}...I can even prove it...{E108:0008} *grumble*
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002106|0: You can prove it, can you!?{E108:0010} How!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002106|1:
I've got it right...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E12F:000D0003}{E280}Wait,{E108:0008} you heard that!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002106|2:
I,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I was just talkin' to myself...{E108:0010}
Don't think nothin' of it!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002106|4:
(This is a {E285}very vital {E041}clue{E042}.{E108:0010}
I'll need to use it to maximum effect.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300210B|0:
Be honest, Ms. Hart!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E282}I know there's something you're
still not telling me!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300210B|1:
Ain't nothin' left to tell, dangit!{E108:0018}
{E282}I done spilled my guts already!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300210B|3:
I don't have a {E041}clue{E040} as to how to proceed with this line
of questioning.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002111|0: I know you've been keeping something from me.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002111|1:
And that something is proof.{E108:0010}
{E282}Proof related to the murder you witnessed!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002111|2:
Proof sound enough to form the basis of a story you're
hoping to sell!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002111|4:
Dang it all to heck...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Gimme a break, will ya...!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002111|5:
I'll come clean, okay!?{E108:0010} {E1D1}That's what you want, right!?{E108:0018}
{E1D2}Here!{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}I done snapped me a photo!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002119|0:
You said you wound up "in the middle of a murder
scene".{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Is that really true?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002119|1:
You're callin' me a liar now!?{E108:0018} {E12F:000D0001}Hoowee,{E108:0008} now I'm mad!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}REAL mad!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300211B|1:
I'm a {E1D1}journalist!{E108:0010} How'm I gonna sell stories if folks can't
trust that I'm tellin' the truth?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300211B|2:
I got me a motto, y'know:{E108:0018}
{E1D1}"Faster than anybody,{E108:0010} {E1D1}honester than everybody!"
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300211B|4:
(That could be an {E285}important {E041}clue{E042}.{E108:0010}
I should bear it in mind...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002120|1:
Silent treatment, huh?{E108:0010}
Well, two can play at that game!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002120|2:
Nngh.{E108:0010}
Perhaps a little more proactivity is called for...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002123|0:
Ms. Hart is very quick-tempered.{E108:0010} She'll try to cut the
conversation dead wherever possible.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002123|1:
I don't have much time to think,{E108:0008} so I'll need to be swift
and decisive.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002125|0: You do realize you have nowhere to turn, don't you?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002125|1:
Oh, quit ridin' me, will ya!{E108:0010}
{E281}This whole thing's a waste o' my precious time!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002125|2:
(Arngh...{E108:0010}
I should have picked my words more wisely...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002128|0:
I don't got time for this hogswill!{E108:0018}
That's it!{E108:0010} I'm outta here!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002128|2: I can't give up now.{E108:0010} I have to keep pushing...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212C|0:
I've exhausted this avenue of enquiry.{E108:0010}
Let me try another angle.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|0:
Can't believe {E1D1}I let that happen...{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Betrayed by my own {E1D1}big mouth...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|1: Well, it happened.{E108:0010} So it's time to tell us everything.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|2:
I...{E108:000C} {E107:0002}I saw the whole thing.{E108:0010} Watched that auction from
start to finish...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|3:
But you didn't just watch it, right?{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E188:004E0000}{E1D5}{E1D1}You took pictures, too!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|4:
Uh, yeah,{E108:0018} {E107:0002}about that...{E108:0010} So, like I said,{E108:0008} I was spyin'
on the whole thing, right from the get-go.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|5:
They was all shoutin' out bids, then somebody'd win
somethin', and --{E108:0008} BAM! --{E108:0008} down comes the hammer.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|6:
"Head on upstairs an' pay",{E108:0008} shouts the ol' ringleader,{E108:0010}
an' then the whole thing starts over again.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|7:
Anyhow,{E108:0008} soon as that happened,{E108:0008} I hadda think quick.{E108:0010}
That's when I ran behind that there statue an' hid.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|8: And who was it that eventually appeared?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|9:
Didn't see nothin', but I heard somethin' that made me
pretty sure it was whoever placed the winnin' bid:
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|10: The sweet, sweet sound of cold, hard cash!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|11:
(I'm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}not sure I have any idea what that sounds like...{E108:0010}
The sound of someone counting bills, perhaps?)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|12: Anyhow,{E108:0008} the deal was you settled yer bills up here.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|13: I heard two people yabberin' for a little while...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|14: Wait.{E108:0010} So two people came up on the elevator?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|15:
You betcha!{E108:0010} My guess is the other one was our friend
the ringleader.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|16:
Anyway,{E108:0008} yabber, yabber, yabber,{E108:0008} on it goes for a little
while, then --{E108:000C} {E107:0001}{E1D1}"AAAAAH!" --{E108:0008} a scream!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|17:
Well, that shook me up pretty good,{E108:0010} so I hunkered
down in my hidin' place and tried to stay outta sight.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|18: So you didn't see the moment of the murder?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|19: Naw,{E108:0008} but I heard it real good!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|20: You didn't try and help whoever was being attacked?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|21: Quit tryna be funny, girlie.{E108:0010} It don't suit ya none.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|22:
I'm just a dainty little journalist all on her lonesome.{E108:0010}
Ya think I was fixin' to jump in an' save the day!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|24: Anyhow,{E108:0008} then there was a buncha rustlin' sounds...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|25:
Right about when that was happenin',{E108:0008} I got to feelin'
pretty bad about what I'd done...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|26:
That makes sense, I guess.{E108:0010}
After all,{E108:0008} you didn't--
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|27:
I didn't remember to get out my camera an' snap even
a single picture!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|29:
Scoop like that drops right in my lap,{E108:0008} an' I miss it!{E108:0018}
Somebody oughta tan my hide!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|31:
Anyhow,{E108:0008} then a little more time goes by, and there's
this kinda clatterin' noise.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|32:
I'm there thinkin'{E108:000C} {E107:0001}{E1D1}"Gotta get the shot this time!",{E108:0010} {E107:0002}and so
I grab one real quick from in the shadows there.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|36:
The person in the red raincoat!{E108:0010}
The one who attacked Kay!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|37:
(So Kay's raincoated assailant also attacked the victim
here in the storeroom...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|38:
(Then proceeded up to the roof, where they assaulted
Kay?)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|40: Weird, huh?{E108:0010} I wondered the same thing.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|41:
Heard two people,{E108:0008} but there was only one in the shot
I got.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|42:
And I didn't see nobody nowhere else in the room,
neither.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|43:
But that's the killer, alright.{E108:0010} Leastways,{E108:0008} I'm pretty sure
it is.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|44: (So are we saying the {E043}victim disappeared{E042}...?){E106}{E198:0003000C}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E12F:00000008}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}How did you know it was the killer just by looking?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|45:
Because they're literally red-handed with blood!{E108:0018}
How else would that get there, huh?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|46: And the auction just carried on after that?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|47:
Sure did!{E108:0010} They just went right along like nothin' had
happened!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|48:
Rich folks is crazier than a box o' frogs!{E108:0010}
I'll never understand how they think!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|49:
(Funny.{E108:0010} I find journalists a struggle to understand as
well...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300212D|50:
Ms. Hart's Statement data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002162|0: I hope I've been of help to you so far...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002163|0:
Ahh!{E108:0010} Careful with that!{E108:0018}
You can't go around spraying others with luminol!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002165|0:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}keep feeling like there's something {E107:0003}just on the edge
of my memory...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002165|1: There is!?{E108:0010} It could be the clue we need!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002165|2:
Alright,{E108:0008} just let it float to the top of your mind,{E108:0008} and say
whatever comes into your thoughts.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002165|4:
I'm seeing a small restaurant...{E108:0010} Just a counter and
some seats...{E108:0010} And there's this...{E108:0008} incredible smell...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002165|5:
A beautiful,{E108:0008} golden soup...{E108:0010} Not too thick...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}And it tastes just right...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002165|6:
It's filled with...{E108:0008} delicious noodles...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}They're firm, but...{E108:0008} not too firm...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002165|7: And that's when a thought crossed my mind...!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002165|9:
(A-A captivating memory...{E108:0010} but sadly,{E108:0008} one that has
nothing to do with the case.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300216F|0:
You used to say you were the second Great Thief
Yatagarasu.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300216F|1: A noble outlaw,{E108:0008} dedicated to stealing the truth.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300216F|2: Do you really not remember any of that?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300216F|5: I think you're right!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I was a noble!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300216F|6:
(Not a noble, Kay.{E108:0010} A noble outlaw.{E108:0018}
Still,{E108:0008} I suppose you got halfway there...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002176|1:
I don't remember you well enough to accept a gift like
that just yet.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002176|2:
Th-That's alright.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}I wasn't offering it to you anyway...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002179|0: Is that...{E108:0010} for somebody who protects people?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002179|1: Is it...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}a hero of justice's pin...?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002179|3: I believe you're thinking of an attorney's badge.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002179|5:
I feel like somebody I know used to have one...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Somebody important...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002179|7:
(I suppose perhaps she's recalling flashes of her
childhood...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002181|0: You like pins, huh, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002181|2: Still,{E108:0008} you always seem to have one on you.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002181|3:
It's a part of the job, I'm afraid.{E108:0010}
And this one is also a piece of evidence.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002181|4:
Oh.{E108:0010} So you carry things you don't like around as a
form of willpower training!?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002187|0:
I remember the person in the red raincoat...{E108:0010}
That much I'm pretty sure of...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002187|1:
But were they really coming toward you from beyond
the concession stand?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002187|2: Yes.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}They were walking right toward me.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002187|3:
And I have proof!{E108:0010} Of course I do!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I remember they had legs!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002187|4:
But there's nothing out there beyond the stand.{E108:0010}
How could they have been walking on thin air?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002187|5: I don't know...{E108:0010} Maybe...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}they were a ghost?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002187|6:
...A ghost?{E108:0010} I'm sorry, Kay,{E108:0010} {E12F:00000008}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}but ghosts don't exist.{E108:0010}
They are the very antithesis of science!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002187|7:
Then this...{E108:0010} is one of those "contradiction" things,
huh...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300218F|1:
In a way.{E108:0010} It appears to be a criminal contract of sorts,{E108:0008}
I suppose you could say.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300218F|3:
The letter isn't handwritten,{E108:0008} so it's hard to say who
actually wrote it.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002194|0: That's a really cute toy.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}It's...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}a cow, right?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002194|2:
You and me --{E108:0008} we saw it somewhere else not so long
ago.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002194|3:
It's missing a horn...{E108:0018}
Who would hurt a toy like{E107:0007}.........
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002194|6:
I don't know, but...{E108:0010} {E1D1}looking at the cow toy,{E108:0008} it...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}It made my head hurt really bad...!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|03002194|7: (Nngh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I'd better not make her look at it any longer.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300219C|0: That's them!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}That's the person who pushed me!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300219C|1: You still don't remember their face?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300219C|4: Which is it, Kay?{E108:0010} Are you sure or are you not?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300219C|5:
I,{E108:0008} I don't know...{E108:0010} When you look at me like that, I...{E108:0010}
My mind just goes blank...
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300219C|6:
Never mind me --{E108:0010} what about the person in the
picture?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300219C|7:
I...{E108:0008} don't know...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}The raincoat is all I'm sure of.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300219C|8: (Which means that Kay can't be the murderer.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|0300219C|9: (I just have to find more evidence to support my case.)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021A6|0:
I was carrying this, wasn't I?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}...I'm sorry.{E108:0010} I don't remember anything about it.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021A6|1:
Nothing at all?{E108:0018}
Even the tiniest clue could help.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021A6|3:
I think I might have just grabbed it on reflex when
whatever happened to me happened!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021A6|4:
There's a saying, right?{E108:0010}
"A falling person will clutch at a straw"?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021A6|6: What's the matter?{E108:0010} You're making a strange face.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021A6|7:
...I don't want to dissuade you from trying,{E108:0010} but please,{E108:0008}
I need you to think a little more before you speak.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021AF|0:
Hoo boy,{E108:0008} this whole experience is enough to boggle a
guy's mind!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021AF|1:
Mysterious storerooms,{E108:0008} damsels in distress --{E108:0008} it's got
the lot!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021AF|2:
...Could you at least try to take things a little more
seriously, Fender?
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021AF|3: Heh heh heh!{E108:0010} Hey,{E108:0008} I can TRY!
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021AF|4:
No, but seriously,{E108:0008} I'm as keen to help Kay out as you
are.{E108:0010} She's safe with me.
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021AF|6: (It's not Kay I'm worried about,{E108:0008} it's you...)
sce3_c3_m12_npc.bytes|030021B6|0:
Ahh!{E108:0010} Careful with that!{E108:0018}
You can't go around spraying others with luminol!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002200|0: Ask me anything!{E108:0010} I'm all ears!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002201|0:
I can't believe they suspect poor Kay!{E108:0010}
It's outrageous!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002201|1:
I couldn't agree more.{E108:0010} But the best thing we can do
right now is to stay calm and look for clues.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002201|2:
...Except!{E108:0010} I've been scientifically processing the
situation and I think I've come up with a better idea!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002201|3:
Maybe we could administer some carefully targeted
electric shocks directly to Kay's brain.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002201|4:
What do you say?{E108:0010} Might be just the thing to bring her
memory back online!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002201|5:
Um...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}That sounds more than a little risky.{E108:0010}
It sounds incredibly risky, in fact.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002201|6:
Personally, I'm still of the opinion that searching this
room for clues is the better option.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002201|7: Really?{E108:0010} But a little risk is what science is all about...
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300220A|0:
I'm back for a little while to interpret for my professor,{E108:0008}
but I'm still mostly based in Europe.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300220A|1:
Gotta keep studying until I'm the finest forensic
investigator under the sun!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300220A|2:
I'm very glad to hear you say that.{E108:0010} Dedication to one's
chosen field is a student's greatest responsibility.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300220A|3:
It sure is!{E108:0010} But I don't just want to get ahead
academically.{E108:0010} I've been trying hard at sports, too!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300220A|4:
Especially that one event they have at school athletics
meets --{E108:0010} you know the one!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300220A|5: (Umm,{E108:0008} there are quite a few to choose from...)
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300220A|6:
It's huge over there.{E108:0010} And unlike here,{E108:0008} it's considered a
real hardcore sport for adults!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300220A|7:
That's right!{E108:0008} I'm talking about...{E108:0010} {E285}glasses battles!{E108:0010}
Who hasn't heard of those, right?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002213|0:
Ms. Hart sure seems to have a grudge against you,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002213|1:
"Low-down, dirty, jerk of a prosecuctor"...{E108:0010}
She really wasn't holding back.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002213|2: We've met a few times.{E108:0010} On one case in particular.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002213|3:
But let's not let her attitude and sudden appearance
distract us from the job at hand.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002213|4:
We just need to gather all the facts and apply the
principles of logical reasoning.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002213|5:
By following my methods,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}the truth will present itself 
soon enough.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002213|7: Uhh, don't take this the wrong way, but...
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002213|8:
...did her calling you a low-down dirty jerk get to you,
Mr. Edgeworth?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300221D|0: I wonder why Ms. Hart is here in the first place...
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300221D|1:
Since she brought that huge camera of hers,{E108:0008} I'm
guessing she's on the trail of a story, right?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300221D|2:
We know there's some kind of illicit trade related to
police evidence being operated out of this storeroom.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300221D|3:
I imagine she must have received a lead regarding
that.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300221D|4:
Well,{E108:0008} I know it's tough,{E108:0008} but you're going to have to ask
her about what she knows!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300221D|5:
You're right, Ema.{E108:0010}
(I really don't want to talk with her, though...)
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002223|1:
It is.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It's one of her most prized possessions.{E108:0010}
...And yet,{E108:0008} she doesn't even remember it.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002223|2:
Huh...{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Maybe it just needs...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}a bit more pizzazz.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002223|3: I could customize it a little?{E108:0010} What do you think?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002223|4:
A pink ribbon here,{E108:0008} a white feather there...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}We can have it looking pretty in no time!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002223|5: Thank you, but...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I think we'd better leave it as it is.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002223|6: (Lest we confuse Kay and her memories any further...)
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300222A|0: Now why do you suppose Kay lost her memory?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300222A|1: She probably suffered some kind of huge shock, right?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300222A|2:
Well,{E108:0008} she did manage to get herself wrapped up in a
murder...
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300222A|3:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I remember when it happened to me too,{E108:0008} a long
time ago.{E108:0010} I was so scared.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300222A|4:
If it wasn't for my sister,{E108:0008} I wouldn't be standing here
talking with you right now like this.{E108:0010} That's for sure.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300222A|5:
...You have to help her,{E108:0008} okay, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You have to help Kay!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300222A|6: ...Of course.{E108:0010} That's exactly what I mean to do.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002231|0: Auctioning off evidence!?{E108:0010} That's just wrong!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002231|1:
Indeed.{E108:0010} And inside the Committee for Prosecutorial
Excellence's own house, no less...
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002231|2:
It's not like we don't all want to look at this stuff!{E108:0010}
And play with it!{E108:0010} And spray it with various reagents!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002231|3:
But selling it to the highest bidder?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}That's going too far!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002231|4:
I more or less agree...{E108:0010} with a portion of your
statements.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002231|5:
When we finally catch who's doing this,{E108:0010} I'm going to
punish them,{E108:0010} scientifically!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002231|6: ...As long as you don't break the law while doing so.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002238|0: Are you interested in toys like this, Ema?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002238|1:
Sure!{E108:0010} These materials...{E108:0010} The texture...{E108:0010}
Its density...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}It's pretty fascinating, actually!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002238|2:
Look,{E108:0008} you can tell from the way the fur is worn down
here that it was made quite a while ago!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002238|3: You said he was a "cutie" before...
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002238|4:
Yeah, he's cute,{E108:0008} but that was a totally different
conversation!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002238|5:
(...Maybe I'm just not scientific enough to understand
how she compartmentalizes these features.)
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300223E|0: That's quite the pretty stain, huh?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300223E|1: I'm not sure I feel comfortable rating bloodstains, Ema.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300223E|2:
Why not?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}There's all kinds to choose from!{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}You got your...
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300223E|4:
...and that's just the ones I can think of off of the
top of my head!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Hey,{E108:0008} are you even listening!?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300223E|5: But really,{E108:0008} using luminol to detect--
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300223E|6: Perhaps we should get back to our investigation.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300223E|7: Aww!{E108:0010} But I'm not even halfway done!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002247|0:
I'm afraid there's not a whole lot for me to go on here,
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} Scientifically speaking, I mean.
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002247|1: In other words,{E108:0008} you're not sure what you're looking at?
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|03002247|2:
No!{E108:0010} It's not a matter of not knowing!{E108:0018}
It's a matter of information!{E108:0018} {E280}I need more data!
sce3_c3_partner.bytes|0300224A|0:
Examine what you want to test, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0008} and
let's spray it with some luminol!
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|1:
(Never thought I'd spend another night in here
again...)
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|2:
(And they stripped me of all the evidence we'd so
painstakingly gathered...)
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|3: (Even if they did let me keep Kay's {E1D5}{E1CB:00C400000000}Yatagarasu pin...)
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|4:
(I can't help but worry about her...{E108:0010}
{E284}They'd better be treating her well.)
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|7:
I remember...{E108:0008} looking down, and...{E108:003C}
The person in the red raincoat...{E108:0008} was on the ground...
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|8:
It...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}It was me, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
It was me all along!
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|11: Come on,{E108:0008} let's go.{E108:0010} {E1D1}You've got a visitor.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|13:
Someone by the name of Dick Gumshoe.{E108:0010}
Want me to send 'em away?
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|14:
...No.{E108:0018}
(Though I'm not sure what to even say to him...)
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|21:
What are you doing here?{E108:0010}
I was told it was Detective Gumshoe.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|22: I imagined you wouldn't come if you knew it was me.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001200|23: (What could she possibly want from me now?)
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|0:
Ms. Faraday is currently being interrogated about her
involvement in the murder.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|1:
You and the Committee...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}You know what you're doing, don't you?
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|2:
You know that the wrongful arrest and persecution of
an innocent person is beyond reprehensible!
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|3:
That's quite the slanderous remark...{E108:0010} I would ask that
you frame your outbursts with a little more care.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|4:
Besides,{E108:0008} she is not innocent.{E108:0010}
{E284}You merely wish that she is.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|5: You can't say that.{E108:0010} You don't have conclusive proof.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|6:
Nor do you have conclusive proof to the contrary...{E108:0010} so
let's not retread this tired old topic again.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|8:
She will go to trial,{E108:0008} and the Goddess will pass her
judgment.{E108:0010} There is nothing you can do to stop that.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|9: And there is nothing more to say on the subject.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001219|10: Instead,{E108:0008} let us speak of the matter at hand.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|0:
You may not be aware of this,{E108:0008} but you are only
permitted to meet with specially approved visitors.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|1:
So I'm to be treated like a dangerous criminal, am I?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I suppose my reputation has rather plummeted...
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|2: It has indeed...{E108:0010} For you, of course,{E108:0008} and your friends.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|3:
That attorney and the other girl were raising quite the
fuss earlier.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|5:
I saw them launch some extremely heated words at
one of the guards.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|7:
You may thank the Goddess in that regard.{E108:0010} For even
she is too busy to deal with each and every infraction.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|8: They will not be punished for their bad behavior.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|9:
...Did you come here just to chit-chat with me?{E108:0010}
You must have a lot of time on your hands.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|10:
Oh,{E108:0008} speaking of which,{E108:0010} Ms. von Karma is continuing
the investigation where you left off.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|11:
I just thought you would like to know.{E108:0010} I figured you
would be worried about how they were all doing.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001224|12: (I hate to admit it,{E108:0008} but she read me like a book...)
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|0:
Let's cut to the chase, Your Honor.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00000001}{E284}Why are you really here?
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|1:
I'm here simply to talk.{E108:0010} Nothing more.{E108:0018}
There is something I wish to know about you.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|4:
Objectively speaking,{E108:0008} you are highly intelligent and
quick-witted.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|5: And a born prosecutor, at that.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|6:
Please, Judge Gavèlle.{E108:0010}
Your sarcastic praise is but salt on my wounds.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|7:
But I sincerely mean every word, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
And it is why I fail to understand you.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|8: Take this latest case, for example.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|9:
You were up against the very Committee itself.{E108:0010}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}You had no hope of succeeding.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|10: Even a child could have seen that.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}And yet...
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|12:
I don't imagine the old me would've ever been so
reckless.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|13:
The old me had power.{E108:0010} And because of that,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I thought
that justice was always on my side.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|14: Just as you and the Committee believe now...
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|16:
But a certain person changed my mind.{E108:0010} He made me
reckon with my selfish and skewed sense of justice.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|17:
And once the scales had fallen from my eyes,{E108:0008} I began
to look at people differently.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|18:
I saw that I was only able to be an effective prosecutor
thanks to the efforts of those around me.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|19:
Detective Gumshoe,{E108:0008} the many investigative officers of
the force...{E108:0010} and even Kay.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|20:
It changed me.{E108:0010} The degree to which it changed me still
surprises me to this day.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|21:
I see...{E108:0010} Thank you.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I feel that perhaps I understand you a little better now.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|22: You?{E108:0010} Understand me?{E108:0018} {E1D1}I highly doubt it.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|23:
Someone who is so focused on forcing their idea of
justice onto others{E108:0008} {E1D1}can't possibly see what I see.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|24:
...Is that so?{E108:0018}
Is that what you truly believe?
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|27:
This has been a very interesting conversation.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}{E188:00340000}...That is all.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|29: Before I go...{E108:0010} {E284}there is one remaining matter.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|30:
I was asked to inform you that the date of your hearing
has been confirmed.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|31:
It will be held today.{E108:0010} In the trial chamber.{E108:0018}
The Committee sends its warmest regards.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|32:
...If that was all you had to tell me,{E108:0008} you could have just
sent a message.
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|33:
And entrust the Goddess's words to another?{E108:0010}
That wouldn't do now, would it?
sce3_c4_00.bytes|03001231|34:
Until then, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
I'll see you again very shortly.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|4:
Thank goodness you seem alright.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That's a load off of my mind...
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|5:
Ahh,{E108:0008} such a heartwarming scene...{E108:0018}
It's enough to...{E108:0008} {E1D1}*sniffle*{E108:0010} make a grown man cry...
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|6:
But you're still not your usual cheery...{E108:0018}
I mean...{E108:0010} You have to stay positive, Kay.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|7:
You didn't do anything wrong.{E108:0010}
In fact,{E108:0008} I guarantee you didn't.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|8:
...No.{E108:0008} You have to let it go.{E108:0018}
{E280}I'm the murderer.{E108:0010} I know that now.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|9:
But you're not!{E108:0010} You can't be!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Why don't you have any faith in yourself!?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|10:
How can I, Mr. Edgeworth...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}{E188:00300000}When there is no "me" left to believe in?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|11: None at all?{E108:0018} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}I don't think that's true.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|12:
Before you lost your memory,{E108:0008} we spent quite a bit of
time together.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|13: And I daresay{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}you left quite the impression on me.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|14: So you see,{E108:0008} {E1D1}there's still plenty of you left.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|15:
That's why I believe so much in {E1D1}your innocence.{E108:0010}
And why you should believe in yourself, too.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|17:
But...{E108:0010} I can't.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E280}It would just cause more pain for the both of us.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|18:
Please.{E108:0010} You have to forget her.{E108:0010} Forget that Kay.{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}She's gone.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|20:
You remind me of my younger self, you know.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}So noble...{E108:0010} So bold...
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001280|21:

{E1D1}I'm just smart like that.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001361|2:
Too bad the same can't be said about the way you
handled Kay's arrest.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001365|2:
Do try to remember that I can bring this little chat to
an end whenever I so choose.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001365|3:
It's only taking so long because {E1D1}you won't give me a
straight answer to any of my questions.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001365|4:
If only you'd stop giving me the runaround,{E108:0008} we'd be
done already.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001365|5:
So let's try this again!{E108:0018} You seem to know the details of
the case quite intimately.{E108:0010} Why is that?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001365|7:
Not exactly the most thrilling use of my time, of
course,{E108:0008} but it's part of the job.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001365|8:
I...{E108:0008} *sniffle*{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}have to be a good role model...{E108:0010} I can't be
seen to be slacking...{E108:0020} {E281}{E12F:00250004}{E1D1}It can be so...{E108:0008} {E1D1}so hard...{E108:0008} {E1D1}*sob*
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001365|9:
But I {E1D1}had some time on my hands,{E108:0008} {E1D1}so I read the whole
thing from cover to cover.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300136F|0:
That's strange.{E108:0010} I could have sworn you just told me
you're a very busy man.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300136F|2:
I'd say the cracks are finally starting to show,{E108:0008} wouldn't
you?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300136F|3:
If you're so keen on being an upstanding leader,{E108:0008} {E1D1}you
can start by releasing Kay, you know.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300136F|4:
Y-You really don't give up, do you?{E108:0010}
It's...{E108:0010} {E280}{E12F:00250004}a moving sight indeed, my boy...{E108:0008} *sniffle*
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300136F|5:
But a tragic one, too...{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}After all...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D5}{E1D1}your efforts are for naught.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300136F|6:
I'm afraid your little friend was found unconscious
near the scene of the crime...
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001376|0:
We have yet to hear much about the circumstances
under which Kay was found.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001376|1:
She was...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E285}lying unconscious in the storeroom,
correct?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001376|3:
That's right...{E108:0010} Although I'm not at liberty to tell you
how I know that.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001376|5:
(In fact,{E108:0008} {E043}he seems to be aware of every tiny detail
about this case{E042}...)
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300137D|1:
Hm?{E108:0018} {E1D1}Nothing more to say?{E108:0018}
Wonderful,{E108:0010} {E280}then I'll be on my way.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300137D|2:
Arngk...{E108:0010} It seems the silent treatment won't work every
time...
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001380|0:
I can't just let this happen!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D5}I'm getting answers, if it's the last thing I do!
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001381|0:
I've got you now!{E108:0010} You're backed into a corner and you
don't even know it!
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001381|1:
What are you going on about all by your lonesome
over there?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001381|2:
You need to cut an old man like me some slack.{E108:0010}
I can't keep up with all that youthful energy.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001381|3:
(Curses...{E108:0010} I should have picked my words more
wisely.)
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001385|0:
Miles, my boy.{E108:0010} I'm a VERY busy man.{E108:0010}
So you'll have to excuse me now.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001385|2: I can't give up now.{E108:0010} I have to keep pushing...
sce3_c4_01.bytes|03001389|0:
I've exhausted this avenue of enquiry.{E108:0010}
Let me try another angle.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|0:
You knew Kay wasn't the real murderer...{E108:0010} {E1D1}and yet you
still had her arrested!
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|1:
What's worse,{E108:0008} you thought you could get away with it!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Well, you won't!{E108:0010} Not if I can help it!
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|2:
There you go with that naïveté again, my boy.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}I guess that was always your problem...
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|3:
With the girl arrested and a conviction secured,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}this
whole mess goes away.{E108:0018} And that's what will happen.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|4: But whose interests does a conclusion like that serve!?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|6:
You know,{E108:0008} listening to you just now...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Well,{E108:0008} it really got the tears flowing, I have to say.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|7:
It was poignant and heartfelt and sincere...{E108:0020} {E12F:00250005}{E107:0002}{E282}and utterly
infuriating!
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|8:
Look,{E108:0008} I'm not perfect,{E108:0008} I know that.{E108:0010} {E1D1}But your lack of
sophistication in these matters is beyond the pale.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|9:
You insist that the truth is more important than
anything else.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|10:
But would you say the same if you knew what the real
value of the "truth" is?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|12:
When you get to my level,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}you don't uncover the truth.{E108:0010}
You make it,{E108:0008} little by little.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|13:
Kay Faraday?{E108:0010} Murderer.{E108:0018}
That's the truth.{E108:0010} {E1D1}The truth I created.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|15: ...{E1D1}Yeees, my boy.{E108:0010} {E1D1}That's what I like to see!
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|16:
You're so sincere sometimes, it's painful.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}It just makes me want to put you in your place.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|17: Knowing the real truth will get you nowhere.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|18:
Because that's how much it's worth.{E108:0010} Nothing.{E108:0018}
{E284}Shocking,{E108:0008} I know.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|19:
But why not go after the real killer?{E108:0018} {E282}How much do you
even know about what really happened?
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|20: ...You're still not getting it.{E108:0010} That's YOUR truth.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|21:
And it is worthless.{E108:0018}
Mine is all that matters.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|22:
...You understand what I'm saying, don't you,{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}Mr. EX-Prosecutor?{E108:0018} I have all the power here.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|25:
You and your little friend are just as bad as each
other.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Violent criminals who deserve to be locked up.
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|27:
And with that...{E108:0010} {E1D1}yet another person disappears from
my life...{E108:0008} *sniffle*
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|28: Oh,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it just makes me want to cry...{E108:0010} and cry...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}and cry...
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|29:
(I'm not planning to disappear just yet, Chairman
Winner.{E108:0010} There's still the hearing later today.)
sce3_c4_01.bytes|0300138A|30:
(Just you wait.{E108:0010} One way or another,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E12F:00000009}{E283}I'll prove Kay's
innocence to the world then!)
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|0:
April 6 - 8:30 AM
{E20D}Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence - Chamber
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|1:
Ten members.{E108:0010}
Over a majority are present...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|2: I hereby call this hearing to order!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|3:
We are gathered here today to assess the professional
competency of Prosecutor Miles Edgeworth.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|4:
Here,{E108:0008} in the sight of the Goddess,{E108:0008} {E1D1}we do solemnly
swear to pass fair and frank judgment.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|6:
Verity.{E108:0010} If you would be so kind as to summarize the
case against Mr. Edgeworth.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|7:
On April 5th,{E108:0008} despite having been advised of the
illegality of an investigation he was conducting...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|8:
...the accused refused to desist,{E108:0008} and eventually had to
be detained by myself and Chairman Winner.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|9:
His actions compromised the investigation into the
murder of a certain defense attorney.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|10:
And despite having been presented with copious
evidence of her guilt,{E108:0008} he continues to insist...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|11:
...that the suspect,{E108:0008} one Kay Faraday,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}is innocent of
all charges.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|12:
Perhaps you could explain the details of the murder to
us as well?
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|13:
Of course.{E108:0010} On the morning of the fifth,{E108:0008} the body of the
victim was found here in the Committee chamber.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|14: Further explanation will be provided by...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|16: The floor is yours, Mr. Winner.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|17:
The murder itself happened late on the night of the
fourth.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}The victim was Ms. Rosie Ringer.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|18:
That same night,{E108:0008} {E284}an illicit auction was being held here
in this very room.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|19: Ringer took part in that auction...{E108:0010} I think.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Yeah.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|20:
Meaning that the murder took place{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}sometime during
the auction.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|21:
When she was found,{E108:0008} Ringer was dressed in an outfit
that matched the description of the auctioneer's.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|22:
However,{E108:0008} due to the fact that the auction carried on
after the murder had occurred...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|23: ...I deduced that Ringer was not in fact the auctioneer.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|25:
And what about the basis on which the suspect was
detained, Mr. Winner?
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|26:
Yeah, yeah.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I got this.{E108:0018}
So Faraday was overcome by{E12F:0009000B}{E107:0007}............
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|28:
Yeah, that.{E108:0010} Tons of crushing remorse.{E108:0010}
So she confessed.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|29:
According to her confession,{E108:0008} she was on the roof of
this building...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|30:
...when she encountered a person in a red raincoat on
the viewing platform.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|31: And that person was Ms. Ringer, I take it?
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|32:
Precisely, Mr. Chairman.{E108:0010}{E112:0008} The killer dressed the victim
in the auctioneer's outfit after the fact...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|33:
...but at the time when she was killed,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}Ms. Ringer was
wearing a red raincoat.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|34:
And who won the race to find that raincoat nearby?{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Me,{E108:0008} that's who!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|35:
(Did you...?{E108:0018} I thought it was somebody from
forensics...)
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|36:
Strictly speaking,{E108:0008} it was found by one of the forensic
investigators under Mr. Winner's command.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|38: The blood analysis on the coat showed...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|39: ...that it was indeed Ms. Ringer who had worn it!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|40:
And the suspect's confession was the final nail in the
coffin.{E108:0010} {E1D1}She confirmed having committed the murder!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|41:
So, as you can see,{E108:0008} {E1D1}Kay Faraday was the killer.{E108:0018}{E176:00010000}
{E107:0001}{E283}There's no way anybody else could've done it!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|42:
Alright, Miles.{E108:0010} I expect you have some objections.{E108:0018}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Let's get them out of the way,{E108:0008} shall we?
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|44:
Well now,{E108:0008} is that so?{E108:0010} {E1D1}I thought it would have taken
more than a single night in detention to break you--{E108:0010}{E104}{E100:0001}{E1EA:0001001F}{E113:002500000002}{E112:0025}{E111:0000000D0001000000010002}{E112:0000}{E100:0000}{E100:0000}{E12F:0000000D}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}No objections in the matter of my unauthorized
investigation, that is.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|45:
But in the matter of Ms. Faraday's supposed guilt,{E108:0018}
{E282}I have plenty!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|46:
I can personally attest to the fact that {E1D1}Mr. Winner's
investigation was fair and impartial.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|47: Hyeh heh heh!{E108:0010} {E280}Of course it was!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|48:
When it comes to carefully conducted ops,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}I'm the
Winner every time!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|49:
You know, Miles,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it's within my power to offer you a
plea deal of sorts.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|50:
If --{E108:0008} and this is purely hypothetical, of course --{E108:0010} you
were to withdraw your objections...
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|51:
...you might wake up tomorrow to find yourself the
proud owner of a seat on this Committee.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|53:
So I ask you again:{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Do you have any objections,
Mr. Edgeworth?
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|54: ...If you think you can buy my silence,{E108:0008} think again.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|56: Only if the chairman watches his!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|57:
I didn't come here to talk about Committee seats!{E108:0018}
I came here to talk about the murder case!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|58:
I demand a statement under oath!{E108:0010}
And I won't rest until I have one!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|59:
I want to know{E108:0008} {E176:00010000}{E283}exactly what the Committee's view
on the incident is!
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|60:
You want to put us on trial, my boy?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Very well.{E108:0010} If it will make you happy.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|61:
Verity,{E108:0010} {E284}please provide Mr. Edgeworth with the
materials pertaining to the case.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|63:
This will be his last hurrah.{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}So let's humor him with the send-off he desires.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|65: Evidence data received from Judge Gavèlle.
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|66:
You have no objections to Verity representing the
Committee, I assume?
sce3_c4_02.bytes|03001400|69:
Don't worry, Kay.{E108:0010}
Everything will be fine,{E108:0008} you'll see.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|0: -- The Committee's View of the Case --
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|1: Ms. Ringer attended the auction as a potential buyer.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|2: The red raincoat was one of the items up for sale.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|3:
So our assumption is that after winning and paying for
it,{E108:0008} she left the auction with her purchase.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|4:
The only exit from the storeroom was, of course,{E108:0008} the
hatch leading up onto the roof.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|5:
After she'd emerged onto the viewing platform,{E108:0008} {E280}that's
when Ms. Ringer was attacked by Ms. Faraday.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|6:
Shortly thereafter,{E108:0008} her flame went out.{E108:0010} And thus
concludes {E188:00300000}the Committee's view of the case.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|7:
The raincoat was on offer that night...?{E108:0018}
{E284}Is that really true?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|9:
You remember {E188:00300000}the failed assassination attempt on the
President of Zheng Fa, I assume?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|10: The raincoat is a piece of evidence from that case.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|11:
It should, of course,{E108:0008} have remained safely under lock
and key in the appropriate facility.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|12:
But our enquiries revealed that {E284}it did in fact go
missing under mysterious circumstances.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|13:
And wound up in the auction along with everything
else...{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}That makes sense, I suppose.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|14:
Wonderful work, Verity.{E108:0010} Just wonderful.{E108:0010}
Crystal clear as ever.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|16:
Now, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Perhaps you could save us all
some time and simply admit defeat?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|17: Hmph.{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}I'll do no such thing, thank you very much.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|18:
Very well.{E108:0010} It's good to know that you still have some
fight in you.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|20:
(Come to think of it,{E108:0008} she said some strange things
when she visited me this morning, too...)
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001480|22: -- The Committee's View of the Case --
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001497|0: Ms. Ringer attended the auction as a potential buyer.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001498|0: The red raincoat was one of the items up for sale.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|03001499|0:
So our assumption is that after winning and paying for
it, she left the auction with her purchase.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|0300149A|0:
The only exit from the storeroom was, of course, the
hatch leading up onto the roof.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|0300149B|0:
After she emerged onto the viewing platform, that's
when Ms. Ringer was attacked by Ms. Faraday.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|0300149C|0:
Shortly thereafter, her flame went out. And thus
concludes the Committee's view of the case.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|0300149D|0:
(So their theory is that the victim and her killer met on
the roof,{E108:0008} {E1D1}and that's where the murder took place...)
sce3_c4_03.bytes|0300149D|1:
(In other words,{E108:0008} it assumes the viewing platform was
the scene of the crime.)
sce3_c4_03.bytes|0300149D|3:
(I thought I had evidence that clearly shows the story
of what happened that night.{E108:0010} Time to double-check.)
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A1|0: Would you mind taking a look at this, Judge Gavèlle?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A1|1: Am I expected to accept this as evidence?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A1|2: It appears to have {E188:00310000}{E1D1}no connection to my testimony.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A1|4:
(Judge Gavèlle is a tougher nut to crack than
Mr. Winner.)
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A1|5: (But that doesn't mean I should give up!)
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A7|0:
There's a clear contradiction in your testimony, Judge
Gavèlle!
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A7|1:
Silence!{E108:0010} Such statements will not be tolerated by this
court!
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A7|2:
Hmph.{E108:0010} And why not?{E108:0010}
What precisely is wrong with my statement?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A7|3:
For one thing,{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}the fact that you clearly do not believe
it yourself.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014A7|5: (I'm going to have to be more careful next time.)
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014AD|0:
Would you care to revise your testimony at all, Judge
Gavèlle?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014AD|1:
No,{E108:0008} why?{E108:0010} Do you believe there is something wrong
with it?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014AD|3:
Then perhaps...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}{E12F:00080007}you could refrain from insinuating
otherwise?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014AD|4:
Nngh!{E108:0018}
(Well that blew up in my face...)
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014B2|0:
In other words,{E108:0008} a member of the Committee was
{E1D1}actively involved in the illegal evidence trade?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014B2|1:
It is unfortunate...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}I don't know what else to say.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014B2|2:
And of course,{E108:0008} we'll be looking into any such activities
just as soon as this hearing is over and done with.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014B2|3:
I commend your decision to pursue the matter further,
{E1D1}Mr. Chairman.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014B2|4:
Oh,{E108:0008} don't be silly, Verity.{E108:0010}
It's the least we can do, really.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014B2|5:
Not that it's any of your business, Miles.{E108:0010}
Not anymore.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014B2|6:
If only you had remained a prosecutor...{E108:0008} *sniffle*{E108:0018}
{E282}But you didn't.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014B2|7:
Now,{E108:0008} if we're quite done making an old man cry over
this whole sad affair...
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|0: So the raincoat really was one of the auction lots?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|1:
That's correct.{E108:0010} I believe it originally belonged to a
{E284}Mr. Shelly de Killer.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|2:
Considering its status as a piece of evidence,{E108:0008} it's the
only logical conclusion.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|3:
!{E108:0018} It's from when he made his attempt on the
president's life...!?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|4:
(There was an unexplained mannequin standing

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|5:
(It could well have been used to display the coat prior
to the auction.)

{E284}...And is entirely unrelated to the matter at hand.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|8:
Especially considering that you will soon officially be a

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|9:

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|10:
My personal circumstances aren't important right now.{E108:0018}

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014BB|11:
As I was saying,{E108:0008} the raincoat was one of the items up
for sale...

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014C7|1: Because of the auction house rules.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014C7|2:
Winning bidders are expected to pay for their items
immediately.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014C7|3: (Ms. Hart told us pretty much the same thing.)

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014C7|5:
...probably left immediately afterwards in accordance
with the rules.

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014CD|1:

the main door?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014CD|2: While the auction was still underway...?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014CD|3:

outside the trusted circle of attendees.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014CD|4:
(Given that Ms. Hart found out about it,{E108:0008} I think its

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014CD|5:
The rules of the auction stated that attendees were to
enter and leave via the hatch in the roof.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014CD|6: Ms. Ringer had no reason not to follow those rules.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014CD|7:
And given where the murder took place,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}we know that
she must have done so.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014D5|0: But why?{E108:0018} What possible motive could Kay have had?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014D5|1:
That is exactly what we are hoping to establish in our
{E284}upcoming interviews with Ms. Faraday.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014D5|2:
Coercive interrogation after the fact.{E108:0018}
Something you seem to specialize in...
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014D5|3:
If the murderer knew that the attendees would all be
leaving via the hatch...
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014D5|4:
...then the roof would have been the perfect place to lie
in wait.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014D5|5:
So as I was saying,{E108:0008} after she'd emerged onto the
viewing platform,{E108:0008} that's when Ms. Ringer was attacked.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|1:
The flame of her life, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} Though perhaps,{E108:0008}
{E188:00300000}"her flame was stolen from her" is more apt.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|2:
But the candelabrum that extinguished her life was
one of the auction lots.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|3:
Meaning Kay had no way of getting a hold of it to
begin with.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|4:
Ms. Faraday could not have lain in wait for the victim{E108:0008}
{E188:00300000}without knowing of the storeroom's existence.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|5:
She could easily have snuck down the ladder and
stolen it while the auction was underway.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|6:
If only we knew where the candle holder was during
the auction...
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|7:
That would surely clear the matter up, no?{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}Well?{E108:0010} Either of you?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|8:
...Sadly,{E108:0008} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}we don't have anything that could tell us
much on that front at the moment.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|9:
Forgive me, sir.{E108:0010} This is something we are {E1D1}hoping to
establish through further investigation.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014DB|10:
Well, isn't that a shame, Miles, my boy?{E108:0010} It seems this
line of inquiry's something of a dead end then, isn't it?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|0:
Maybe you can clear something up for me, Judge
Gavèlle.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|1: But what is Ms. Hart doing here at this hearing?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|2:
She is an eyewitness.{E108:0010}

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|3:
Well now,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I ain't really an eyewitness...{E108:0010}
More of an...{E108:0010} {E280}ear witness, I guess...
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|4:
...Heh.{E108:0018} {E188:002F0000}She's not exactly the most confidence-inspiring

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|5:
I like to think {E188:00300000}I choose my allies a little more carefully

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|6:
