Because there's something she hasn't told you.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|7: Take a look at this.{E108:0010} It's a photo taken by Ms. Hart.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|8:
Yes.{E108:0010} In the storeroom, correct?{E108:0018}
{E284}What of it?
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|9:
According to your theory,{E108:0008} the murder occurred up on
the roof.
sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|10:
But according to Ms. Hart's testimony,{E108:0008} {E1D1}she happened

sce3_c4_03.bytes|030014E6|11: Just before she took this picture!
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|0:

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|2:
I sure did!{E108:0010} Clear as day!{E108:0010} An' with my own two eyes,

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|7:

{E188:00340000}{E1D1}the person in question.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|10:
...Eh heh heh heh!{E108:0010} Just my li'l joke!{E108:0018} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}No need to look at

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|11:

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|13:

I assume you're about to raise the issue of the voices

Unrelated!?{E108:0018}

Yer kiddin' me, right?{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Them folks was talkin' crime-

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|19: Ah,{E108:0008} but did you hear them clearly?

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|21:
Gah!{E108:0010} I can't rightly say nothin',{E108:0008} an' you know it!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}They was usin' voice changers!{E108:0010} I done told y'all that!

Precisely.{E108:0010} Ms. Hart heard voices,{E108:0008} but those voices were

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|27:
Nonsense.{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}Verity's the best of us, my boy.{E108:0010}
The very best!

And yet she believes that what Ms. Hart heard might

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|29:

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|30:
The incident happened before the victim was able to

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001500|31: And I can tell you why.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001521|0:
This proves that the incident happened before the
victim went up to the roof!
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001522|0: Take a closer look at this part here.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001522|5:
(This photograph was taken after Ms. Hart heard those
voices.)
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001522|6:
(Which means{E108:0008} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}there must be something tying what she

I should have known you can't point to a link between
the sounds Ms. Hart heard and the murder.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001522|8: Oh, but I can, Your Honor.{E108:0010} {E1D1}And I'm about to.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300152B|0:
We initially thought that the person in the red raincoat

sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300152B|2:
Indeed.{E108:0010} She told us about {E188:00300000}the blood she saw on this

And I doubt many people would have thought

Ergo,{E108:0008} if this person is the killer,{E108:0008} then the blood we see

sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300152B|5:
But knowing what we know now --{E108:0008} that this person is

sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300152B|6:
The presence of the blood{E108:0008} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}still shows that the picture

sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300152B|7:
But now,{E108:0008} it tells us something very important {E188:00300000}{E041}about

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001533|0: This picture tells us that the victim...
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001534|0: The victim was in fact{E108:0008} {E280}the ringleader!
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001534|1: But didn't Ms. Hart say that the auction carried on...

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001534|4:
Which means the victim couldn't have been the
auctioneer...{E108:0010} doesn't it?
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001534|6:
This picture was taken after Ms. Hart heard the sounds
of the attack, right?
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001534|7:
And there's blood dripping from the person's hand,
so...
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001534|8:
You're right.{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}That can mean only one thing about the
victim.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300153D|0: The victim must have {E280}struck the killer!
sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300153D|1:
She must have struck them hard enought to draw
blood.{E108:0010} Thus the blood on her hand.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300153D|2:
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} All the blood at the scene was shown

sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300153D|3: Which means your theory holds no water whatsoever.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300153D|5:
This picture was taken after Ms. Hart heard the sounds
of the attack, right?
sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300153D|6:
And there's blood dripping from the person's hand,
so...
sce3_c4_04.bytes|0300153D|7:
You're right.{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}That can mean only one thing about the
victim.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|0:
There's no doubt in my mind that the victim was
attacked in the storeroom.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|1:
But here we have photographic evidence of her
standing upright and alive,{E108:0008} albeit with a bloody hand.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|4:
The blood on her hand is from the wounds she had
sustained.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|5:
What are you talking about!?{E108:0018}
Who dies from a hand wound!?
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|6:
The wound wasn't on her hand, Mr. Winner.{E108:0010} I imagine

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|7:
That's right.{E108:0010} While it's impossible to tell from this

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|8:
Oh-ho-ho.{E108:0010} Well,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}that certainly would change things,

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|9:
It very much would.{E108:0010} Not least by making it absurd to
suggest that Kay was the attacker.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|10:
Her encounter with the victim happened after this
picture had been taken.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|11:
After the victim had already been attacked and was in
critical condition.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|12:
I put it to you that all Kay witnessed{E108:0008} {E176:00010000}{E282}was the victim
finally succumbing to her wounds.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|13: ...That would have been quite the coincidence.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|14: It's a textbook case of {E188:002F0000}wrong place,{E108:0008} wrong time, I'd say.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|15:
You seem to be forgetting a rather important fact,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|16: Well, that{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}or pretending to not remember it.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|18:
I think it's time to wrap things up,{E108:0008} don't you, Verity?{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Put the boy out of his misery.
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|20:
Why do you keep giving her orders!?{E108:0018}
That's my job!
sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|21:
*sigh* You really are...{E108:0008} *sniffle*{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}a total and utter

sce3_c4_04.bytes|03001545|23: (...I hate to break it to you,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}but you both are.)

sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001580|1:
Ms. Ringer's body was found with {E188:00300000}three wounds in her
chest.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001580|2:
And we all know what those wounds are from, don't
we?

That's right.{E108:0010} {E280}They're from when she was stabbed in

sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001580|8:

Hence my objections.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001580|9:
Come{E108:0010} on!{E108:0018}
Why do you {E1D1}ALWAYS have to undermine me!

sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001580|12:
(Because you do it so well to yourself every single time
already...)
sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001580|13:
O-Of course it isn't.{E108:0010} Yeah.{E108:0010} I knew that.{E108:0010}
Because I'm--
sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001580|14:
Please, Eustace,{E108:0008} just stop, for goodness' sake.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}You've already embarrassed me enough.

Ms. Ringer's body was found with three wounds in her
chest.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001593|0:
And we all know what those wounds are from, don't

sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001594|0:
That's right. They're from when she was stabbed in

sce3_c4_05.bytes|03001597|3: (If I can't,{E108:0008} {E280}Kay's fate will be sealed...!)

sce3_c4_05.bytes|0300159B|2: It appears to have {E188:00310000}{E1D1}no connection to my testimony.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|0300159B|4:
(Judge Gavèlle is a tougher nut to crack than
Mr. Winner.)
sce3_c4_05.bytes|0300159B|5: (But that doesn't mean I should give up!)
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015A1|0:
There's a clear contradiction in your testimony, Judge

sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015A1|1:
Silence!{E108:0010} Such statements will not be tolerated by this

sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015A1|2:

For one thing,{E108:0008} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}the fact that you clearly do not believe

sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015A1|5: (I'm going to have to be more careful next time.)
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015A7|0:

Then perhaps...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}{E12F:00080007}you could refrain from insinuating

sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015A7|4:
Nngh!{E108:0018}

Yes.{E108:0008} {E152:000800080007}{E112:0008}{E108:0008}{E282}Which is why we must see that the perpetrator of

sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015AC|5:
Very well.{E108:0018}
As I was saying,{E108:0008} there were three wounds...

Eustace, my boy...{E108:0010} Make an old man happy and at least

And you're sure the stabs to the chest were the cause

None.{E108:0010} One of the spikes of the candelabrum even
pierced the victim's heart.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015BA|2:
And unless you mean to call Dr. Hertz's professional
opinion into question,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}we can only treat that as fact.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015BA|3:
The coroner's opinion backing up my own winning
ones...{E108:0010} {E12F:00090007}{E282}Now that's what I call a flawless victory!
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015BA|4:
Well, I'm certainly not about to ignore the coroner's
findings...
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015BA|5:
Hey!{E108:0010} What about MY findings!?{E108:0018}
You can't just ignore them!
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015BA|6:
(But if the cause of death really was the puncture
wounds to the chest from the candelabrum...)
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015BA|7:
(...that would seem to contradict one of the pieces of
evidence we've gathered.)
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015BA|8:
He's...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}He's not just ignoring my findings!{E108:0010} He's ignoring
me!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E282}Do something, Gavèlle!
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015BA|9:
As you wish.{E108:0010} At the very least,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I will ensure that he
cannot ignore my own conclusions.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015C4|0:
But the victim may not necessarily have died instantly.{E108:0010}
I think we can say that much, at least.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015C4|1:
Perhaps.{E108:0010} But she would surely not have lived for
longer than a few moments, either.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015C4|2:
So...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E284}there are people who could survive even if you
stabbed them in the chest...?
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015C4|3:
Sure,{E108:0008} there might be.{E108:0010}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}...And there might not be, too.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015C4|5:
...Trust me,{E108:0008} {E1D1}there are not.{E108:0010} And in case you're still
tempted to believe there might be....
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015CA|0:
"Cause of death is the set of three puncture wounds on
the left side of the chest inflicted by a candle holder."
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015CA|1:
Well done for reading, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
{E282}That report forms the basis of my own conclusions.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015CA|2:
In other words,{E108:0008} if I disprove what it says,{E108:0008} I disprove
your conclusions, too?
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015CA|3:
You have the strangest sense of humor...{E108:0018}
{E12F:00080001}{E188:002F0000}But I wouldn't mind seeing you try.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015CA|4:
However,{E108:0008} before you do,{E108:0008} I would advise you to read
that report very carefully.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015CA|5:
After all,{E108:0008} {E285}I am not interested in your opinions.{E108:0010}
Only in solidly grounded deductions.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015CA|6: ...Very well.{E108:0010} Then you shall have my deductions.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|0: Chairman Winner.{E108:0010} {E284}You know what this is, of course?
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|1:
The red raincoat.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That's right,{E108:0008} isn't it, Verity?
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|2: Yes, sir.{E108:0010} The one Ms. Ringer was wearing.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|3:
I warn you, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}you will not be thanked
for retreading old ground here.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|4:
Well, I'm afraid I might have to regardless.{E108:0018}
Now then,{E108:0008} if you'll answer me this, Judge Gavèlle:
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|5:
You told us that the victim's bloodstains were found
on the coat...
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|6:
...but do you remember where exactly they were
found?
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|7: Of course.{E108:0010} They were found on the hood, and...{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E12F:00080005}{E280}N-No!
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|9:
The hood and...?{E108:0010} Was blood found anywhere else on
the raincoat?
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|11:
Doesn't that strike you as odd?{E108:0018}
The victim died of stab wounds to the chest.
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|12:
Wouldn't that lead one to expect to find bloodstains in
that area?
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|13: And yet...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}there was blood only on the hood!
sce3_c4_05.bytes|030015D1|14: That's a glaring contradiction if I ever saw one!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|0:
The head wound the victim suffered {E188:00300000}wasn't just some
incidental injury.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|1: It was inflicted before the stab wounds to her chest.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|2:
...Perhaps you are correct.{E108:0010} Perhaps the victim did
sustain the head injury first.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|3:
As you said,{E108:0008} if she had been stabbed first,{E108:0008} there should
be blood in the chest area of the raincoat.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|4:
Therefore,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}Ms. Ringer cannot have been stabbed
before the head injury had been inflicted on her.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|5:
But even if we concede this point,{E108:0008} that the head injury
came before the chest wound...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|6:
...what difference would it make?{E108:0010} {E284}How does it change
our understanding of the case?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|7:
I'd say it changes things a great deal.{E108:0010} In fact,{E108:0008} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}it raises
an even more fundamental contradiction.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|8:
That is quite the bold claim, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0018}
I have to admit,{E108:0008} you have me intrigued.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001600|9:
Perhaps you could show us this "fundamental
contradiction"{E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008}{E12F:0008000F} {E282}with some evidence!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|0300160A|0:
Which piece of evidence best demonstrates the
contradiction the order of the injuries revealed?{E106}{E163:00010000}{E164:00AB0002}{E100:0000}{E12F:00000009}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}This piece of evidence perfectly highlights the
contradiction!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|0300160A|1: Forgive me,{E108:0008} but that makes no sense whatsoever.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|0300160A|6:
(We now know that it's impossible for the head injury
to have happened after the victim was stabbed.)
sce3_c4_06.bytes|0300160A|7:
(In which case,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}one of our pieces of evidence is
beginning to look very suspect indeed.)
sce3_c4_06.bytes|0300160A|8:
There is no "fundamental contradiction" after all,{E108:0010} is
there, Mr. Edgeworth?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|0300160A|10:
If the victim had been struck on the head before she
was stabbed in the chest...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|0300160A|11: ...then this piece of evidence makes no sense at all!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|2: ...the victim "suffered a head injury post mortem".
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|3:
But the order suggested by the bloodstains on the
raincoat is...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|5:
Bailiff!{E108:0018} This court hereby subpoenas Dr. Hilda Hertz to
the Committee chamber with all due haste!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|6:
Until she testifies,{E108:0010} {E283}this case cannot be brought to a
close!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|7: Yes, Your Honor!{E108:0018} {E1D1}I'll go fetch her at once!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|8:
Unfortunately,{E108:0008} Dr. Hertz is a very busy woman.{E108:0010}
I doubt she will be able to come immediately.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|9:
In the meantime,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}there is another important angle
I would like to explore.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|10:
Frankly,{E108:0008} something has been bothering me about the
person at the heart of this case.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|11: The so-called "ringleader".{E108:0010} Who exactly are they?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|12: Yeah,{E108:0010} good point!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}We never looked into that, huh?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|13:
Despite having been mentioned repeatedly in this
hearing...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|14:
...we still don't know even the most basic facts that
might help us uncover their identity.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|15:
Well, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Do you have any thoughts on
the matter?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|16:
We've seen nothing that might serve as clear
evidence of the auctioneer's identity as of yet...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|17:
...but there is someone involved with the case that I
can name.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|18:
I suspect that at the very least{E108:0008} {E284}they might be able to
point us in the right direction.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|20:
Chairman Winner!{E108:0018}{E112:0000} {E12F:0000000D}{E1D1}I demand that you testify as to what
you know!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|23: Are you crazy!?{E108:0010} Why would you accuse my dad!?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|24:
You would cast doubt on the integrity of the Chairman
of the Committee?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|25: Do you understand the implications of such an act?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|26:
I don't care who or what he is.{E108:0010}
We're talking about the truth here.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|27:
And about a man who seems dead set on framing
Kay at all costs!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|28:
The mask,{E108:0008} corsage,{E108:0008} ticket stub,{E108:0008} and everything else --{E108:0010}
the items Kay was carrying when she was found...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|29:
They were deliberately placed in her possession
somehow...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|32:
A shocking accusation,{E108:0008} and one I find hard to believe.{E108:0010}
But for the sake of completeness,{E108:0008} I must ask...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|33: Why would he do such a thing?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|34: To cast suspicion on Kay, of course.{E108:0010} Why else?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|35:
I even managed to get him to say something to that
effect.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|38: I think the good Chairman might be in shock.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|41: Did you hear me, dear boy?{E108:0010} I said,{E108:0008} {E285}"So what if I did?"
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|42:
You say you got me to admit as much?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}But where is your proof,{E108:0008} hm?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|43:
With no witnesses to speak of,{E108:0008} your word alone is
hardly enough to make an accusation like that stick.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|44:
Or do you mean to tell us that you have {E188:00300000}something
more to base your outburst on?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|45:
(He still has the arrogance he showed back at the
detention center,{E108:0008} and yet...)
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|46:
Mr. Edgeworth.{E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008} {E12F:0008000F}{E188:00300000}I am going to have to ask you to
explain yourself.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|48: Not at all.{E108:0010} I'll be very interested to hear this for myself.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|49:
I'm intrigued to learn where Miles might have gotten
the idea that I'm some sort of criminal.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|50:
Because you'll never find a more fine and upstanding
citizen than myself.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|51: (He has a lot of nerve,{E108:0008} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}acting all innocent like that.)
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|52: Very well.{E108:0010} Let's start at the very beginning.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|53:
The fact that the auction took place right here in this
hallowed trial chamber is a point of suspicion.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|54:
A location that should, by rights,{E108:0008} {E1D1}only be accessible to
members of the Committee.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|55: Yeah...{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}They all have keycards to the room, after all.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|56:
Furthermore,{E108:0008} these auctions seem to be held on a
somewhat regular basis.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|57: And for that to be possible...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|59:
Th-That's right, Mr. Winner.{E108:0010}
That the auctioneer is a member of the Committee.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|61:
Arngk...!{E108:0010}
(What on earth is wrong now!?)
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|62: Wh-{E108:0008}{E1D1}What do I do, Dad!?{E108:0010} {E282}I played right into his hands!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|63: Ohhh-ho-ho-ho.{E108:0010} You did indeed, you utter nitwit.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|64:
But Miles, my boy,{E108:0008} you do realize that you've {E285}cast
quite the wide net with your explanation?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|65:
That's true.{E108:0010} There are eleven members of the
Committee altogether.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|66:
Ten,{E108:0008} given Ms. Ringer's unfortunate passing.{E108:0010}
{E284}Ten potential suspects in total.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|68:
A-A-And...{E108:0010} {E1D1}it CAN'T be the Chairman!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}...C-C-Can it...?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|69: Whoever it is,{E108:0008} {E282}speak up!{E108:0010} Right now!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|70: Come, come.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Calm down, all of you.{E108:0010} Please.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|71: Well, Miles?{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Is that all the proof you've got against me?
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|73: Heh.{E108:0018} {E1D1}You're very quiet all of a sudden.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|74: But it's too late to back out now.
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|75:
You accused a former chief prosecutor{E108:0008} {E282}and current
Committee chairman of a crime!
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|77: I would tell you to prepare for the worst...
sce3_c4_06.bytes|03001617|78:
...but there's no preparing for what you're about to
face!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|1:
You've been forcing us to argue over every little detail
for a while now.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|2:
Where the murder happened,{E108:0008} the order of the victim's
injuries,{E108:0008} some...{E108:0010} {E1D1}other things I hardly even remember.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|3:
But you needn't have bothered, my boy.{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}Because it's all irrelevant in the end.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|4:
Think about it:{E108:0010} {E188:00360000}{E1D1}{E1D5}The suspect herself has already said
she did it.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|5:
That's all that matters at the end of the day,{E108:0008} and her
sentence will be lighter for it.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}So rejoice!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|6:
And there you have it.{E108:0010}
Feel free to pick holes in it as you see fit.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|7:
(How can I,{E108:0008} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}when that was barely a testimony to begin
with!?)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|8: That man...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}He's a very powerful person, isn't he?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|9:
It's...{E108:0010} {E1D1}It's okay, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0018}
{E12F:00230004}{E1D1}Please,{E108:0010} just let it go.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|10:
I did it...{E108:0010} I'm the murderer...{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}I even...{E108:0010} remember doing it...
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|11:
You saw a flash of something half-remembered, Kay,{E108:0008}
nothing more.{E108:0018} If you must believe in something...
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|12:
...believe me when I say you should believe in your
own innocence instead!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|14:
(I'm up against the head of the Committee here.{E108:0010}
This isn't going to be easy.)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001680|15:
(But he seems to think he's already won.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00000002}Perhaps I can use that against him!)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001691|0:
You've been forcing us to argue over every little detail
for a while now.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001692|0:
Where the murder happened, the order of the victim's
injuries, some... other things I hardly even remember.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001693|0:
But you needn't have bothered, my boy.
Because it's all irrelevant in the end.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001694|0:
Think about it: The suspect herself has already said
she did it.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001695|0:
That's all that matters at the end of the day, and her
sentence will be lighter for it. So rejoice!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001696|0:
(I'm not going to find any contradictions in a testimony
like that.)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001696|1:
(And he seems to think he's already won.{E108:0010}
But just maybe I can use that against him...!)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|0:
Chairman Winner!{E108:0018} {E1D1}{E188:00340000}Please take a look at this piece of
evidence!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|1:
Well, you certainly seem fired up about it, my boy.{E108:0010}
I'm not entirely sure why, though.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|2:
Perhaps you ought to cool your head a little and think
things over again.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|3:
Before I lose my cool from wasting my time on
meaningless theories.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|4:
Arngh!{E108:0010}
(I must have made a mistake!)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|5:
Ha!{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}You think you can win against a Winner!{E108:0018}
Think again!{E108:0018} My dad's invincible!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|6: He's the top of the top!{E108:0010} The winningest Winner of all!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|7:
Yes, yes.{E108:0010} The cheerleading is a little cringe-inducing
though, Eustace.{E108:0010} Maybe you could give it a rest?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|8: (He's no ordinary opponent,{E108:0008} that's for sure.)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|03001698|9: (I'll need to plan my approach with the utmost care.)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016A2|0:
Surely this piece of evidence {E188:002F0000}completely contradicts
your testimony?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016A2|1:
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I don't know, Miles.{E108:0018}
Any thoughts, Eustace?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016A2|2:
Um,{E108:0008} beats me.{E108:0010}
But I guess it doesn't?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016A2|6: I'm not about to give up just yet, Kay.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016A2|7:
I'm going to prove that you're innocent.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}One way or another.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016AB|0:
What do you think of this piece of evidence, Chairman
Winner?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016AB|1:
Ooh, let's see...{E108:0010} I think...{E108:0010} it's absolutely nothing.{E108:0010}
And I'm sure Eustace agrees.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016AB|3:
Nnghoooh!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}(To get swatted down by the lesser Winner...!)
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016AB|4: Mr. Winner is really enjoying this, huh...?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016AB|5: Of course he is.{E108:0010} He has his father here to back him up.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016AB|6:
But that's just fine.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}I'll just take the both of them down together!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B2|0:
Even if the broad strokes are correct, {E1D1}it doesn't make
something true.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B2|1:
Oh, don't be such a stick-in-the-mud.{E108:0010} I'd say the
bigger picture {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}is more than enough here.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B2|2:
After all,{E108:0008} every case has its {E1D1}little inconsistencies and
contradictions.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B2|3:
If we let ourselves get bogged down in every single
one,{E108:0008} we'd never make any arrests.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B2|4:
And once we did,{E108:0008} the trials would drag on forever.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}Even you understand that, right?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B2|5: Not in the slightest.{E108:0010} Hence my inquiry into the details.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B2|6:
Oh, to be so young and pig-headed...{E108:0008} *sniffle*{E108:0018}
Anyway,{E108:0008} you keep digging into these little details.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B9|0:
I seem to recall the ringleader's identity and the faulty
coroner's report being critical points of contention.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B9|1:
Yes, yes...{E108:0008} I was listening, my boy...{E108:0018}
{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}{E12F:00250002}But "critical" is a matter of opinion.
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B9|2:
How can you possibly suggest that such fundamental
issues are not important!?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B9|3:
Perhaps it is your ability to make sound judgments
that should be on trial here today?
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B9|4:
Ohhh-{E108:0008}{E1D1}ho-{E108:0008}{E1D1}ho-{E108:0008}{E1D1}ho!{E108:0018} Bravo, my young hothead!{E108:0010}
Wonderfully cutting stuff!
sce3_c4_07.bytes|030016B9|5: You do like to try, though,{E108:0008} don't you?

murder had happened in this chamber.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|2:
But it was simply a ruse{E108:0008} {E17A:000000020001}{E107:0001}{E1D1}designed to cover up the
blood that had dripped down from the storeroom!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|3:
In order to conceal the existence of the underground
auction, correct?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|5:
If the culprit had nothing to do with the auction,{E108:0008} they
would've had no reason to cover up that blood.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|6:
Which further supports the theory that the ringleader
and the killer{E108:0008} {E283}were one and the same!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|7:
And as to the identity of the ringleader,{E108:0008} do you have
anyone you'd like to name?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|8:
The auction is always held in this {E188:00300000}{E1D1}{E041}Commitee chamber{E040},{E108:0008}
with its {E1D1}{E041}storeroom{E040} located just overhead.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|9:
So at the very least,{E108:0008} {E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E107:0001}{E112:0000}{E12F:0000000D}we know the murderous
ringleader has some connection to the Committee!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|12:
As the Committee's most powerful member,{E108:0008} that
should hardly be a surprise, right?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|13:
...You're a fine prosecutor.{E108:0010}
That much I'll give you.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|14:
But as I think I may have mentioned already...{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}{E1D5}{E12F:00250005}you're
also hopelessly naive.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|15:
.........{E107:0002}{E112:0025}{E12F:00250000}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}You've got nothing, dear boy,{E108:0008} have you?{E108:0010}
No evidence whatsoever.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|0300179B|16: Unless,{E108:0008} you've got something to share after all...?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017AD|0:
Do I have any evidence to show that Chairman Winner
is the murderer...?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017AE|0:
I have the evidence, alright.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Evidence that proves you're the culprit.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017AE|2: This right here proves that you're the killer!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017B1|0: Could you take a look at this for me, please?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017B1|1: I'm looking, my boy.{E108:0010} But I fear I'm not quite seeing it.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017B1|2:
You don't understand why this piece of evidence is so
crucial?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017B1|4: I can't see how it's relevant at all.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017B1|7: (But do I have any evidence to prove that...?)
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017B1|8: Face it, dear boy.{E108:0010} You don't have anything on me.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|0:
(It was Chairman Winner himself who brought up the
fact that I suspected him...)
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|1:
(And he's seemed confident right from the get-go that
he's untouchable.)
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|2: (Which means he knows.{E108:0018} He knows I have nothing.)
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|3: Oh-ho-ho.{E108:0018} {E12F:00250000}Well, Miles, my boy,{E108:0010} {E283}time to pay the piper.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|8:
Naw,{E108:0008} it just done came to me.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D5}Flash of inspiration,{E108:0010} you know how it is!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|11:
Mr. Edgeworth has made it clear that he won't give up
until every last lick of hope has been extinguished.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|12:
So extinguish we must.{E108:0010} Lest he try to drag us through
this excruciating process again in the future.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|15:
Yeah,{E108:0008} what she said!{E108:0018}{E112:0009}
{E12F:00090007}I don't quite get it, but...{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}it sounded pretty cool!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|16:
Don't worry, Dad!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I'll help Gavèlle bring this to a
winning finish!{E108:0018} {E1D2}We'll show them how wrong they are!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|17: ...Fine.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Let's hear what the witness has to say.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|18:
You heard the chairman, Ms. Hart.{E108:0010}
If you would be so kind...
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|20: ...The facts, Ms. Hart,{E108:0008} and nothing but the facts, please.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|21:
Don't you worry yer pretty little head on that front!{E108:0018}
{E12F:000D0004}I'm a journalist!{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Truth's my middle name!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|23:
...So the ringleader's the killer, right?{E108:0010} Which makes {E041}the
victim one o' them auction-goers{E040}.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|24:
Thing is,{E108:0008} that don't add up.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I counted eleven people
comin' down that hatch, see.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|25:
Then the murder happened,{E108:0008} and then the auction
started back up again.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|26:
Now,{E108:0008} I had me a look back downstairs right after
that...
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|28:
An' wouldn't you know it?{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}There were {E041}eleven{E040} li'l
duckies,{E108:0008} all lined up in a row again!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|30:
Sure as sure can be, Yer Gavelship!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Saw 'em with my own two peepers!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|31:
Sooo...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E041}eleven{E040} before the murder...{E108:0010} and {E041}eleven{E040} again
right after means...
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|33: A {E041}contradiction{E040}, Eustace.{E108:0010} Do try to keep up.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|34: Ms. Hart...{E108:0010} Did nothing really change at all?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|35:
I done told you already --{E108:0008} they carried right on again
like nothin' even happened!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|36:
Oh,{E108:0010} 'cept for...{E108:0018}
It wasn't nothin' much, but...
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|38:
That little ol' {E041}mallet{E040} doodad.{E108:0010}
Can't have yerself an auction without one.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|39: Kinda like the one Missy over there's got,{E108:0008} but different.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|42:
I done heard that thing bangin' and clangin' right the
way through,{E108:0008} then {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}nothin'.{E108:0010} Just like that.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|43:
(So the noise of the hammer stopped midway through?{E108:0010}
Could it have something to do with the murder?)
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|44:
Ms. Hart's Statement data updated
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E108:0010}{E176:00020000}{E1EC:00020001}{E123:0008000C00070001}{E124:0001}{E10D:000000010000}{E10E}{E100:0000}{E101:00080009}{E107:0002}If what Ms. Hart is telling us is true,{E108:0008} we have
something of a problem.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|45:
Namely,{E108:0008} that if the victim is neither the auctioneer nor
one of the attendees...
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|46: ...your entire theory cannot stand, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|48:
Chalk one up for justice!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}Eat that, Edgeworth!
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|49:
See, Mr. Edgeworth...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}There really was nothing we could do...
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|50:
(No!{E108:0010} {E1D1}There must be something we're overlooking!{E108:0010}
Something we still don't have an explanation for!)
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|51:
(I just need to think!{E108:0018}
If I can't,{E108:0008} {E1D2}{E1D5}Kay is...!)
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|52:
Alright, kids.{E108:0010} Do we finally have all our answers now?{E108:0010}
If so,{E108:0008} then I expect you to make good on--
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|53:
One moment, sir.{E108:0010}{E112:0008} {E12F:00080000}I worry that it might still be a little
early to pass judgment.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|54: After all,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D1}{E12F:00080001}we have one more matter yet to resolve.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|55:
And until we do,{E108:0008} {E283}we cannot claim complete and total
victory over Mr. Edgeworth.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|57:
Is that not so, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0018} Frankly,{E108:0008} I expected you
to have {E1D1}raised your voice by now.
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|60:
(And once again...{E108:0008} {E1D1}she has rescued us from the jaws of
defeat...)
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|61:
Very well.{E108:0010} Let's get this over with, shall we?{E108:0010}
What is this one matter that still remains?
sce3_c4_08.bytes|030017BA|62: Why,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}{E173:0001}the {E041}contradiction in the coroner's report{E040}, sir.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|0: I'm back with the witnesses, Your Honor!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|1:
Wh-What's this all about?{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Why'd you call us back down here?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|2:
Did somebody suddenly fall ill!?{E108:0010}
I'll have a compress ready in two shakes of a--{E12F:00240008}{E108:001E} OUCH!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|3:
"This better be good!{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Did somebody else drop dead!?{E108:0010}
Well,{E108:0008} they might soon wish they had!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|4:
Dr. Hertz.{E108:0010} Ms. Niedler.{E108:0010} Thank you for coming on such
short notice.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|5: Let me assure you,{E108:0008} this won't take long.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|6: "Quit tryna butter me up an' cut to the chase, will ya!?"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|7:
Hah hah hah...{E108:0010} Of course.{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}We summoned you here to confirm something.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|9:
Dr. Hertz!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}This court asks that you provide the
unabridged truth regarding the following:
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|10:
Do you stand by your preliminary findings?{E108:0010}
Can you vouch for their complete and total accuracy?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|14:
In the course of this trial,{E108:0008} an error was indeed found in
her report.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|15: And so I ask again for {E1D1}the truth, Dr. Hertz.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|16:
Did you alter,{E108:0008} tamper with,{E108:0008} or in any way falsify your
findings?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|17:
That's awful!{E108:0018}
How can you even say that!?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|18:
"What are ya asking me for?{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Why the heck would I wanna do that?"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|19: To help the true culprit, of course.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|20:
"As if I'd know anythin' about all that!{E108:0018}
I just know {E1D1}I didn't do anythin' o' the sort!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|22:
What other explanation could there be for the
{E188:00300000}discrepancy in your report?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|23:
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} {E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008}{E12F:0008000F}{E284}I wonder if you might have any
thoughts on the matter?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|25: It's not like you to be coy, I must say.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|26: (Why does she keep taking charge and helping me?)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|27:
(I still don't know what she's trying to do...{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}but I'll
happily take what I can get.)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|28:
If everything was recorded accurately and then
handed off to Mr. Winner according to protocol...
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|29: ...then the report shouldn't contain any mistakes.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|30:
W-Wait, wait, wait!{E108:0018}
For the record,{E108:0010} {E280}I didn't do anything to the report!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|31: I guess we'll see,{E108:0008} won't we?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|32:
Dr. Hertz.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Perhaps we could begin with your side of
the story?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|33: Why do we even need to!?{E108:0018} This is pointless!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|34:
I'll be the judge of what's pointless, thank you very
much.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|35: We have patients waiting back at the hospital!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|36:
...B-But, {E12F:00240008}Gramma--{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E107:0001}YOWCH!{E108:0018}{E12F:00240005}
{E1D1}We really don't have time for this!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|37:
Won't you please help us?{E108:0010}
I can't stress how important this is.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|39: But could you please make it quick?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|40: If we're not back soon,{E108:0008} {E280}people will suffer!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|41:
(And yet you had no qualms about taking your time
and buying cotton candy the last time we saw you...)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|42: We'll let you go as soon as we can.{E108:0010} I promise.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|43: (Assuming you tell us the truth, that is.)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|44: -- The So-Called Mistake in the Report --
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|45:
No way there's a mistake in Gramma's report!{E108:0018}
Not never!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|46:
"I been dealin' with the dead longer’n you been alive,
Sonny Jim!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|47:
"Me writin’ somethin' wrong is about as likely as"{E12F:00240008}--{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}OUCH!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|48:
"And what the heck d'you think I'd stand to gain by
doctorin' a file, hm?{E108:0010} Don't make a lick o' sense!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|49:
...And that's all she has to say.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}Nothing funky here!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|50:
See!{E108:0018} {E1D1}It's just as I thought.{E108:0010} There's no chance the good
doctor doctored her findings.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|51:
...And you swear by the Holy Goddess that this
testimony is true?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|52: Of course!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Gramma's never told a lie in her--
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|53:
Your opinions are not necessary, Nurse Niedler!{E108:0010} Your
grandmother is the subject of this inquiry,{E108:0008} not you!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|54:
"Not necessary"!?{E108:0018} That's not fair!{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}I'm the only ally poor Gramma has!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|55:
"Go ahead an' shout 'objection' left an' right,{E108:0008} but you
best be prepared then...{E108:0010} {E280}Mr. Ex-Prosecutor!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|56:
(Oh, I'm more than prepared!{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00340000}{E107:0001}I'm ready to expose the
truth behind the error in the report!)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001800|57: -- The So-Called Mistake in the Report --
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300183A|0:
No way there's a mistake in Gramma's report!
Not never!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300183B|0:
"I been dealin' with the dead longer’n you been alive,
Sonny Jim!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300183C|0:
"Me writin’ somethin' wrong is about as likely as"{E12F:00240008}--
OUCH!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300183D|0:
"And what the heck d'you think I'd stand to gain by
doctorin' a file, hm? Don't make a lick o' sense!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300183E|0:
...And that's all she has to say.
Nothing funky here!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300183F|0:
"I diligently dictated that report to Florence.
Anythin' after that, weren't nothin' to do with me."
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001840|0: Dr. Hertz...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}doesn't sound like she's lying.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001840|2:
(But she only communicates through her
granddaughter.)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001840|3:
(I should probably try to make sure that Nurse Niedler
is being truthful, too.)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001844|0:
Dr. Hertz.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Would you mind looking at this piece of
evidence for me?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001844|1:
"Lookin I won't charge ya for.{E108:0010}
But what am I lookin' at?"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001844|3: Heh.{E108:0010} If you don't understand,{E108:0008} then never mind.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001844|4:
"If you don't wanna have to explain yerself,{E108:0010} then don't
get that junk out in the first place, y'hear?"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001844|5:
Arngh!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(She has a point, I guess...)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300184C|0:
Dr. Hertz!{E108:0018} {E282}There is a fundamental problem with your
testimony!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300184C|1:
Gramma's just a frail old lady.{E108:0018} You should be nicer to
her, {E12F:00240008}you kn--{E108:0010} OUCH!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300184C|2:
"Call me a 'frail old lady' one more time!{E108:0010}
I dare ya!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300184C|3:
"Mr. Slick here's bluffin'.{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}Even this frail old lady can
see that!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300184C|4:
Ack!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(It wasn't meant to be a bluff...)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300184C|6:
Yes,{E108:0008} a little too spirited, perhaps.{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}{E12F:00000002}{E1D1}I can't help but wish she would turn it down a hair.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300184C|7: ...Please don't be mean to old people, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001854|0: Tell me, Nurse Niedler,{E108:0008} what do you think of this?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001854|2:
"Hey, I'm the one testifyin' here, sonny!{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Whatcha askin' her for?"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001854|4:
(Your overly complicated way of communicating is the
problem here,{E108:0008} not me!)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001854|5:
(But perhaps because of that,{E108:0008} I may have missed
something important.)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001854|6:
(I should take another careful listen to "Dr. Hertz's"
testimony again...)
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300185B|0: Never?{E108:0010} You're saying that Dr. Hertz is infallible?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300185B|1: She has to be!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}A doctor can't afford to make mistakes!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300185B|2:
Even a veteran like Gramma would be out of a job if
she messed up even once!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300185B|3: So there's no way she of all people would--
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300185B|4:
"I got a whole hospital relyin' on me!{E108:0018} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}Might be you can
bungle yer work an' survive, Mister,{E108:0010} but I can't!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|0:
And you've really never made a single mistake in all
that time?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|1:
"...Doctorin's all about experience.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}The longer you
been at it,{E108:0008} the better you get."
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|2:
Heh.{E108:0010} If only the same were true of prosecuting.{E108:0010}
Chairman Winner would be the best in the business.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|3: But I think we can all agree that's not the case.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|4: Ooh,{E108:0008} you really are a devil, Miles.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|5:
But you're also quite wrong.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}I've never once made a
mistake either.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|6: After all,{E108:0008} {E280}I have people to do that for me.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|7:
I'm too busy for foul-ups.{E108:0010} And luckily for me,{E108:0008} I don't
have to make them.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Isn't having people just grand?
sce3_c4_09.bytes|03001860|8:
"Don't you go tryin' to make doctorin' and lawyerin'
sound the same!{E108:0010} They ain't nothin' alike!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300186A|0:
The victim appears to have put this raincoat on after
sustaining the head injury.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300186A|1:
And yet,{E108:0008} there was not a single drop of her blood in
the chest area of the raincoat.
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300186A|2:
Therefore,{E108:0008} {E282}she must have been hit in the head before
she was stabbed in the chest,{E108:0008} making it pre-mortem!
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300186A|4:
"I don't need you to teach me how to suck eggs,
young man!"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300186A|5:
"My danged report already says what you just said,
don't it!?"
sce3_c4_09.bytes|0300186A|6:
Your report states that the head injury appears to

As we've seen,{E108:0008} Ms. Ringer and Nurse Niedler are about

sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|1:
What's more,{E108:0008} the auction rules required attendees to
wear their masks at all times.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|2:
If Nurse Niedler were wearing the same clothes as
Ms. Ringer,{E108:0008} nobody would have been any the wiser.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|5:
"And left the poor child in her smalls!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D2}Have you no respect, girl!?"
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|6:
No, Gramma, I...{E108:0010} I thought the same thing.{E108:0010} It wouldn't
be nice to leave her like that.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|7:
So when the ringleader wasn't looking,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}I put that
raincoat on her.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|8: (So that's how Ms. Ringer came to be wearing it...)
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|9: Thus,{E108:0008} the auction was able to carry on as before.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|10:
Guess the part where I caught the red raincoat on film
came just after.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|11: Yeah,{E108:0008} must be.{E108:0010} Then it all makes sense.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|12:
Right after that was when I went on over and looked
downstairs through the gap in the elevator.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|13:
Spied me eleven happy little auction-goers,{E108:0008} then back
I snuck to my little hidey-hole!
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|14:
Don't tell me you were hiding back there the entire
time after that...?
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|17:
So maybe I oughta have mentioned this before, but...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I fell asleep for a few winks after that.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|18: Well,{E108:0008} passed out...{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}unconscious, ya might say...
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|21:
There was this sudden loud noise,{E108:0008} and I, uh...{E108:0010}
It startled me,{E108:0008} just a liiiiittle bit, you know.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|22:
Alright,{E108:0008} maybe more than a little.{E108:0010} But I just witnessed
a murder.{E108:0010} Can't blame a girl for gettin' jumpy...
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|23:
Guess that got my heart shook and my head faint.{E108:0010}
Before I knew it,{E108:0008} I was out like a light.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|24:
By the time I came to,{E108:0008} it was the next danged day,{E108:0008} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}and
there y'all were clankin' down that ladder!
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|25:
I see.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}So you were startled by a loud noise and fell
unconscious?
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|26:
I suppose that means you don't know what happened
after that?
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|27:
Not per se, but...{E108:0018} {E12F:000D0005}{E107:0002}Well,{E108:0008} after the auction was over,{E108:0008} all
the masks were back on the rack...
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|28:
So I reckon the guests done finished up an' filed out
one by one like they was supposed to!
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|30:
Nurse Niedler,{E108:0010} once the auction had restarted,{E108:0008} what
exactly were you doing?
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|31:
I was pretending to be Ms. Ringer and placing bids,{E108:0008}
just as the ringleader wanted.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|32: I had to win the clothes box as I'd been instructed...
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|33: It had a dead body inside, after all.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|34:
Imagine if somebody else had won it.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}We would've been in real trouble then...
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|35:
So you had no idea that the victim had vacated the box
in the meantime?
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|36:
No,{E108:0008} not until we came back up so I could "pay" for it.{E108:0010}
That was when we noticed.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|37: The ringleader told me to go look for her right away.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|38:
Except,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E280}I found some other girl collapsed at the foot of
the ladder instead!
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|40:
Yes.{E108:0010} {E1D1}She must've fallen from up on the roof and been
knocked unconscious.
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|41:
Guess the victim must've left that hatch wide open,
huh?
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|43:
Kay would've been so shocked by seeing Ms. Ringer
fall motionless right in front of her...
sce3_c4_0a.bytes|030019BC|44:
...that she wouldn't have seen the open hatch {E188:00300000}and
fallen right through it.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|0:
That explains the noise that caused you to faint as
well, Ms. Hart.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|1:
It was the sound of Kay crash landing onto the
storeroom floor.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|2:
Yeah,{E108:0008} I suppose...{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E188:00310000}Can't believe somethin' like that
done knocked me out for so long, though...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|3: So in summary,{E108:0008} by the time Ms. Niedler found Kay...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|4: ...you were already sound asleep behind the statue.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|5:
I think we've got a good grasp on what occurred up to
this point now.{E108:0010} Nurse Niedler,{E108:0008} if you would continue?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|6:
Sure.{E108:0010} So, I found Kay...{E108:0008} and next I found Ms. Ringer.{E108:0010}
And I put them both in the clothes box.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|7:
We couldn't risk any of the auction-goers seeing them.{E108:0010}
That would have caused a real hullabaloo!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|8: Was that your idea?{E108:0010} Or the ringleader's?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|10:
But putting the raincoat on Ms. Ringer was my own
idea...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|11:
So I tried to get rid of it before they found out what I'd
done.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|12:
Heh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I imagine they were none too pleased when it
showed up as a surprise piece of evidence in this case.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|14:
...the ringleader and I put her in an auctioneer's outfit
we'd prepared.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|15:
Of course.{E108:0010} Which completed the deception and made
everyone think she was the auctioneer.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|16:
All in all,{E108:0008} {E1D1}the auction finished up without anybody
noticing anything.{E108:0010} And...{E108:0008} that was that.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|17:
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Now that we know the extent of your crimes,
Nurse Niedler...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|18:
...if you have anything further to share,{E108:0008} I'd advise you
to do so immediately.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|19:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I wish I could tell you more, but...{E108:0010}
I'm sorry,{E108:0010} that's all I know.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|20:
Oh, umm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E284}Except for one other thing.{E108:0010}
It did seem a little strange, I guess...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|21: When I was borrowing Ms. Ringer's clothes...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|22:
...I took everything I could, but...{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}I couldn't take her
hair, obviously, {E12F:00240008}so--{E108:0010} {E1D1}OUCH!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|23:
"You're danged right, you couldn't take her hair!{E108:0010}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}What kinda medical professional are you!?"
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|24:
(That's where you draw the line?{E108:0010}
So taking her clothes was okay...?)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|25:
Our hair was totally different --{E108:0008} the style,{E108:0008} the length,{E108:0008}
everything.{E108:0010} I kinda panicked...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|26:
But the ringleader thought of everything,{E108:0008} including
wigs.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|28:
There was a straight one and a wavy one.{E108:0010}
They were both stashed in the clothes box.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|30:
Right?{E108:0010} I wondered that, too.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}I thought maybe they
were worried she might have changed up her style.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|31:
Anyway,{E108:0008} I took the straight one.{E108:0010} That was the one that
matched her hair on the day.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|32: (Leaving a wavy wig in the box...)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|35:
And I take it{E108:0008} {E284}that you really have no idea who the
ringleader might be?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|36:
...Sorry,{E108:0008} I only know that they were in charge of the
auction.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|37: I didn't see them without their mask on.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|38:
And they were pretty careful to keep their identity a
secret {E188:00300000}from everyone.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|39:
...Arngh!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(If I can't get something concrete on them...!)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|40:
Ohhh-hohohohooo!{E108:0018}
Well, Miles?{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Are we about done?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|41:
You've proven the nurse was part of the murder plot.{E108:0010}
But sadly for you,{E108:0008} it doesn't change a whole lot.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|42:
Because it does nothing to prove{E108:0008} {E282}that Kay Faraday
isn't the ringleader.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|43:
And justice must prevail.{E108:0010}
We can't change the law --{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E176:00010000}{E283}even for your sake.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|44:
(Is this it...?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Am I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}not going to be able to save
Kay...?)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|45:
Franziska!{E108:0018}
What are you doing here!?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|46:
As I told you before, Miles Edgeworth,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}where the case
leads,{E108:0008} I follow.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|47: Your dedication...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}is an inspiration to us all.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|48: But don't go getting the wrong idea, little brother.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|49:
I'm only here to deliver the truth regarding the
suspect.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|50:
I'm certainly not here to forgive you...{E108:0008} {E12F:00040007}{E112:0004}{E12F:00040008}{E282}for abandoning
the way of the prosecutor!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|52:
.........{E188:002F0000}{E107:0002}You should thank your "former" subordinate for
what I'm about to share.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|53:
In his desperation to help Kay Faraday,{E108:0008} he gave me a
valuable piece of information.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|55:
Prepare yourself,{E108:0008} {E1D1}Miles Edgeworth,{E108:0018} {E12F:00040009}{E112:0004}{E12F:0004000A}for the final piece
of the puzzle!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|56:
Rosie Ringer's head wound...{E108:0010} {E176:00010000}{E107:0001}{E283}was the first of the
injuries she suffered,{E108:0010} not the second!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|60:
Yes,{E108:0008} {E1D1}um...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}There's no easy way to say this Franziska, but...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|64: Well, why didn't you say so sooner!?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|65: (You didn't exactly give us a chance...!)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|66:
And...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}I suppose you know about the murder weapon,
too?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|69:
The victim was struck on the head with a blunt object
bearing a circular surface.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|70:
And the wounds to the chest were actually inflicted
post-mortem.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|72:
And you're certain of that, I assume?{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}Your sources are above board?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|73:
Two trusted medical professionals reached the same
conclusion independently.{E108:0010} You couldn't ask for more.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|75: And this murder occurred during that auction.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|76:
It would be negligent of me NOT to pursue leads
pertaining to related parties.{E108:0010} {E12F:00040007}{E112:0004}{E12F:00040008}{E282}Especially the victim.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|77:
.........{E107:0002}{E1D1}My, my.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}You've really become quite the force to
be reckoned with,{E108:0008} haven't you, my dear?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|78:
Then all parties are in agreement.{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}The victim died
from a blow to the head.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|79:
Autopsy Report data updated
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E111:000400010002000100000002}{E112:0004}{E100:0000}{E12F:00040000}{E101:00040004}{E107:0002}Sadly,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}the murder weapon itself has yet to be
identified.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|80: Heh.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Based on the shape,{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}I might have an idea or two.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|81:
B-But guys!{E108:0018} I didn't turn up any other weapon during
my investigation!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A00|82:
And yet,{E108:0008} one need only think about the setting and an 
auctioneer's tools,{E108:0008} and the answer should be obvious.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A56|0:
An object with a circular surface used in an auction.{E108:0010}
We're obviously talking about...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A57|0:
That's right, Judge Gavèlle,{E108:0010} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}we're talking about your
hammer!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A57|1: Forgive me, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0008} but I don't think I follow.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A57|2:
But you are more than welcome to examine it as
closely as you like!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A57|3:
Th-That won't be necessary.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(I already got more than a faceful...)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A57|5:
(If I think about the items an auctioneer uses,{E108:0008} the
answer readily presents itself.)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A57|6: Wait, so...{E108:0018} {E280}What was the murder weapon!?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A5E|0: A judge's hammer.{E108:0010} There's nothing else it could be.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A5E|1:
Miles, my boy.{E108:0010} I don't think I ever realized you had a
comedic streak.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A5E|2:
Well, Eustace?{E108:0010} What do you think?{E108:0010}
Is it a judge's hammer?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A5E|6:
(If I think about the items an auctioneer uses,{E108:0008} the
answer readily presents itself.)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A5E|7: Wait, so...{E108:0018} {E280}What was the murder weapon!?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A66|0: What would an auctioneer have readily at hand?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A66|2: But we never found one of those!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A66|3:
If the auctioneer was indeed the killer,{E108:0008} it does seem a
likely candidate for the murder weapon.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A66|4:
But without the evidence to support your theory,{E108:0008} it
remains nothing more than that.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A66|5: Oh,{E108:0008} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}I have just the evidence you need {E1D1}right here!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A6C|0:
This piece of evidence strongly suggests that the
auctioneer's hammer was the murder weapon!{E040}{E106}{E163:00010000}{E164:00B30006}{E100:0000}{E12F:0000000B}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}Look closely at this piece of evidence.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A6C|1:
It clearly points to the auctioneer's hammer as having
been the murder weapon!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A6C|2: What on earth are you talking about, Miles Edgeworth?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A6C|3: Put that thing away before I sic my whip on you!
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A6C|4:
Nnrgh!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}("Before"!?{E108:0010} Then what was that just now!?)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A6C|5:
(If the hammer really is the murder weapon,{E108:0008} did
anything change from before it was used...?)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A6C|6:
(I need to look over the evidence again and focus on
that.)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A6C|8:
Can you really show us evidence that the auctioneer's
hammer was the murder weapon?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|0:
Ms. Hart told us something very important about the
auction after the murder occurred.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|1:
She said that the very prominent sound of the
auctioneer's hammer could no longer be heard.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|3:
I'll tell you why:{E108:0010} Because it had just been used in a
murder,{E108:0008} and was covered in the victim's blood.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|4:
It would need to be disposed of.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Isn't that right...
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|7: I'll have our people look into this right away.
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|8:
Ohhh-ho-ho-ho-ho-hooo!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You really are like a dog
with a bone, aren't you, dear boy?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|9:
But if you can't dedicate yourself to a cause when
you're young,{E108:0008} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}when can you, hm?
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|10: (He seems very confident we'll never find it...!)
sce3_c4_0b.bytes|03001A77|11:
Very well.{E108:0010} A search for the murder weapon will be
conducted.{E108:0018} In the meantime,{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}this court is in recess.
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002280|0: There's a poster in the corridor outside.
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002280|1:
"We regret to announce that, due to the warden's
arrest,{E108:0008} {E284}the Die of Destiny game will be discontinued."
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002280|2:
"Inmates will no longer need to roll a die every
morning to determine their meals for the day."
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002280|3:
"We wholeheartedly apologize to those who were
looking forward to their daily casting of the die."
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002280|4:
(Did anyone really need an apology for the cessation
of such a ridiculous idea in the first place!?)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002285|0:
(I've barely spent any time in here,{E108:0008} and already I can
feel my personal appearance slipping.)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002285|1:
(I may have given up my badge,{E108:0008} but I mustn't give up
on myself.)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002285|3:
.........{E107:0002}{E1D1}There.{E108:0018}
A tidy outside begets a tidy inside.
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002285|4:
(Which is why it's more important now than ever to
take care of myself!)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|0300228A|0: (There's a menu here on the table.)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|0300228A|1:
(It seems that detainees are able to pay to have their
meals brought to their cells.)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|0300228A|3:
"Spaghetti and mac and cheese lunch.{E108:0010}
Add linguine for only $1!"
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|0300228A|4:
"Basmati and brown rice special.{E108:0010} For a limited time
only,{E108:0008} add regular white rice at no extra cost!"
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|0300228A|5: (It's probably for the best that I'm not very hungry...)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002290|0: (There's a note on the wall next to the toilet.)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002290|1: "Sorry.{E108:0010} We're currently out of toilet paper."
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002290|2:
"Please make the necessary mental preparations before
using the toilet."
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002290|3:
(What sorts of "mental preparations" can one even
make...!?)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002294|0: The window is barred with heavy steel.
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002294|1: (That reminds me of a movie I once saw.)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002294|2:
(A prison inmate hatched a plot to escape by using a
file to cut his cell bars.)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002294|3:
(I won't be doing that, of course.{E108:0010} For one thing,{E108:0008} I don't
have a file on me at the moment.)
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002294|4:
...What am I saying!?{E108:0018}
I wouldn't do it even if I did have one!
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002299|0:
A very basic bed.{E108:0010} I can't say it was very comfortable to
sleep on, however.
sce3_c4_m05_01_check.bytes|03002299|1:
