sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|0:
Recall Nurse Niedler's testimony, if you will.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}There was one thing we never quite resolved.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|1: The second {E041}wig{E040}.{E108:0010} The one that was wasn't used.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|2: I seem to remember it being...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}wavy...?
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|4:
Nurse Niedler apparently found some very interesting
items when she went to swap places with the victim.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|5: And!?{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}What do they have to do with the burn mark!?
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|7:
One was intended to make her look more like the
victim.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|8: But what was the other one for?
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|9: ...I don't suppose it was meant to be a spare.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|10:
It doesn't take a huge leap of imagination to see the
truth.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|11:
Compare Chairman Winner's current appearance to
that of the ringleader as it was described to us.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|13: One very prominent difference presents itself.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|17:
Indeed.{E108:0010} Not a wig intended to go on the top of the
head, in any case.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|18:
It was a fake beard all along,{E108:0010} wasn't it, Excelsius
Winner!?
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|20: How very unkind of you to suggest otherwise.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|21:
We saw how your son reacted when he realized the
truth.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|22:
And how he desperately tried to cover for you,{E108:0008} even in
light of his realization.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|23: Yet you still feared that he might expose you.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|24:
So rather than take that risk,{E108:0008} you bullied him until he
couldn't take it anymore.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|25:
Because he knew!{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}He knew that your beard hides a
prominent burn mark!
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|28: I insist that you remove your beard{E108:0010} {E283}{E173:0001}{E12F:0000000D}this instant!
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|32:
For bringing evil to justice before the eyes of the
Goddess,{E108:0018} {E12F:00080002}you have my thanks.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|33:
...No.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Thank you.{E108:0018}
{E12F:0000000E}I couldn't have done it without you.
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|34:
Excelsius Winner!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}In the name of the Goddess,{E108:0010}
I hereby pronounce my verdict!
sce3_c5_03.bytes|03002424|35:
In the matter of the murder of Ms. Rosie Ringer,{E108:0008} this
court finds you...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D5}guilty!
sce3_c5_04.bytes|03002480|0:
April 6, 9:44 AM
{E20D}Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence - Chamber
sce3_c5_04.bytes|03002480|1: Mr. Edgeworth...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}{E12F:00230004}I can't thank you enough.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|03002480|2:
You never gave up on me,{E108:0008} even when I gave up on
myself...{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}That was very kind of you.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|03002480|6:
I've learned that Chairman Winner has been safely
delivered to the detention center.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|03002480|7:
The search for the missing auction hammer continues.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E12F:00080005}However...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|03002480|8:
...we are talking about Chairman Winner here,{E108:0010} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}so it's
highly likely that it has already been destroyed.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|03002480|9:
In addition,{E108:0008} there is one other matter I must inform
you of.{E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008} {E12F:0008000F}The chairman made a rather strange statement.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|03002480|10: According to him,{E108:0008} {E284}the {E041}letters{E040} were not part of his plan.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|0:
He claims that he and Ms. Niedler found this letter on
Ms. Ringer's person.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|1:
And that they then found a second letter on Kay's
unconscious body.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|2:
From their contents,{E108:0008} the letters seemed to ones of
correspondence...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|3:
So he {E285}lept to the conclusion that they must have been
working with each other.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|4: (That's quite the conclusion to jump to.)
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|5:
As he read the letters,{E108:0008} that's when he came up with
the idea to frame Ms. Faraday for Ms. Ringer's murder.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|6:
So he decided to place the victim's in a very
conspicuous place.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|7: Namely,{E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008} in her left chest pocket.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|8:
Sounds to me like he's just trying to make excuses for
himself.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|9:
Yes,{E108:0008} I certainly thought the same.{E108:0018}
Perhaps it was some sort of last-ditch ploy on his part.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|10: But it matters not.{E108:0010} He will answer to the Goddess now.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|11:
And under her scrutiny,{E108:0008} such strategies cannot hope
to succeed.{E108:0010} He will not escape justice.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|12:
And with that,{E108:0008} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}one of the duties with which I have
been entrusted with is complete at last.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|14: Before you go,{E108:0008} can you tell us what you know...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|15:
...about how Chairman Winner came to murder
Ms. Ringer?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|17:
Yes,{E108:0010} {E107:0002}and I suppose you have earned the right to the
whole truth.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|18: Ms. Ringer once had a lover.{E108:0010} A press photographer.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|19:
He was investigating the underground auctions as a
freelance journalist.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|20:
But before he could uncover the truth behind the
auctions,{E108:0008} he was...{E108:0010} {E188:00360000}{E1D5}{E1D2}disappeared.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|22:
All Ms. Ringer was left with were the memories and
personal effects of her lover...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|23:
And so,{E108:0008} seeking revenge on Chairman Winner,{E108:0008} she
made her appearance at the auction.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|24: .........{E108:0010}{E107:0003}{E1D1}Unfortunately for her,{E108:0008} her opponent struck first.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|25: I see...{E108:0010} So that's the story behind this case.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|26:
While the Goddess does not condone acts of wanton
vengeance...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|27:
...Ms. Ringer's actions{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:00080001}have exposed Chairman
Winner's crimes at last.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|29:
(You were tasked with exposing Excelsius Winner and
the {E041}corruption at the heart of the Committee{E042}.)
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|30:
Umm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}Does anyone know what happened to
Mr. Winner...?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|31:
.........{E107:0002}I am afraid I haven't been able to get in touch
with him.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|32: Do you have any idea why?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|33:
Probably because...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E12F:00080003}I wasn't there for him just now
when he needed me most.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|34:
Oh...{E108:0018}
{E12F:00230004}I really feel bad for him...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|35:
...Well, don't pity him too much.{E108:0010}
At least he knows the truth now.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|36:
And no matter how hard it might be,{E108:0008} {E1D1}he'll need to
learn to accept it.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|37:
If he can't...{E108:0010} he'll never be able to move on with his
life.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|40: But in time,{E108:0008} he can hopefully try and change his ways.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|42:
Can I change too, I wonder...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Can I...{E108:0008} move on with my life...?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|43:
Are you okay, Kay?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E283}How's that head feeling!?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|45: I'm so sorry, Kay!{E108:0018} {E12F:00240000}You were my patient!
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|46:
I had a responsibility to you!{E108:0010} And instead,{E108:0008} I let them
accuse you {E12F:00240008}of--{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D1}YOWCH!
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|47:
"Danged right!{E108:0010} We ain't just in the business o' fixin'
bodies, Missy!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}The mind's where it all begins!"
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|48:
You're right, Gramma.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E12F:00240000}Speaking of which...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}how's your memory?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|49:
It's...{E108:0010} It's like...{E108:0010} with a little more time...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}maybe I'll be
able to remember some more...?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|50: ...Please forgive me,{E108:0008} but I had better be on my way.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|51: I am to preside over the trial of {E188:00300000}{E1D5}Fifi Laguarde in a bit.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|52:
The Bronco Knight case, huh...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Who's the defense attorney?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|53:
It was supposed to be Ms. Ringer,{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}but as she is no
longer with us...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|54: ...we are still in the process of finding her replacement.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|55:
(Ms. Ringer was scheduled to represent {E1D1}Warden
Laguarde...!?)
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|56:
And of course,{E108:0008} until we find Eustace,{E108:0008} there is nobody
to act for the prosecution, either...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|57: In any case,{E108:0008} I must take my leave...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|59: What's going to happen to it now...?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|60:
With its chairman under arrest,{E108:0008} the Committee's
activities have been suspended for the time being.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|61: So to answer your question...{E108:0010} it's complicated.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|0300248C|62: It's all up to the Goddess now.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|0:
.........{E107:0003}Don't worry about it, Kay.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00000001}It's a consequence of my own making.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|1: And I assume you do not mean to change your mind?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|2:
Of course not.{E108:0010} I chose the path of the truth.{E108:0010}
And I chose it willingly.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|3:
...With Chairman Winner out of the picture,{E108:0008} justice is
in the hands of the righteous once more.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|4:
If you did wish to follow the path of the prosecutor
again, Mr. Edgeworth...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|5:
...I would be more than happy to facilitate such a
decision.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|6:
It's very kind of you to offer...{E108:0010} but I can't accept your
help at this time.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|7:
I can't ask for my badge back when {E1D1}I'm not even sure
if I want it anymore.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|9:
It seems we are destined to continue on different
paths then.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|10:
...Heh.{E108:0018} Well, I trust you'll keep my badge safe until
they converge again.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|13:
...In the meantime,{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}{E173:0001}I have here a token of the
Goddess's mercy.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|14: You may return this notebook to its rightful owner.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|16: It seems it was due to be sold in the auction.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|17: And with the name "Kay" written on its cover...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|18:
...Chairman Winner made the connection immediately,{E108:0008}
and knew who it belonged to.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|19:
It was the same name as the one in the letters, after
all.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|20: The letters he claimed to know nothing about?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|21: I suppose he insisted he didn't prepare them?
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|22:
Yes.{E108:0018}
He also had something else to say.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|23:
Apparently,{E108:0008} he thought that Ms. Faraday was after her
notebook,{E108:0008} and that Ms. Ringer was after his life.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|24:
And that their respective goals are what led them to
cooperate and infiltrate the auction together.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|25:
Unfortunately for him,{E108:0008} {E285}he misread the situation
completely.{E108:0010} It was all just happenstance.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|26:
If Kay had known a defense attorney who was also a
member of the Committee...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|27:
...there's no way she wouldn't have told me.{E108:0010}
That just isn't like her.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|28: Hah hah.{E108:0010} Your belief in her is touching.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|30:
While the notebook did become part of Chairman
Winner's cover-up scheme...
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|31: ...it is also a treasured possession of Ms. Faraday's.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|32:
Which is why I would like for her to have it back.{E108:0010}
As, I am sure,{E108:0008} would the Goddess.
sce3_c5_04.bytes|030024CC|34: I pray that it helps her to recover her lost memories.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|1:
...Judge Gavèlle wanted me to return something
important to you.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|3:
Always greet people with a smile,{E108:0008} even people you
don't know.{E108:0018} {E1D1}Never cry in front of strangers.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|4: Daddy!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}I wrote them all down, Daddy!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|5:
Yeah!{E108:0010} I'm gonna keep all my promises,{E108:0008} and be a real
hero when I grow up,{E108:0010} {E1D5}just like you!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|7:
I forgot to write one down!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}The most important promise of all!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|8:
Promise Number Five...{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}Always try your hardest to
learn about things you don't understand!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|9:
Hee hee!{E108:0010} I remembered it just how you said it!{E108:0018}
And now I'll never forget it!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|10:
...Always try your hardest...{E108:0010} to learn about things you
don't understand...
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|13:
Heh heh...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Can't say I'm not a liiittle bit embarrassed, but...
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|14:
Yeah!{E108:0010} I'm back!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}And I couldn't have done it without
you, Mr. Edgeworth!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|15:
You never stopped helping me,{E108:0008} {E107:0001}even when I was
totally lost, and couldn't remember anything!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|16: Thank goodness...{E108:0010} You certainly seem to be back.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|17:
Kay!{E108:0018} So this is the real you, huh?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Welcome back!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|18:
It's so good to know you're better!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00240000}I can sleep easy now!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|19:
"Now that ya found it,{E108:0008} {E1D1}don't you dare go losin' that
memory o' yours again, young lady,{E108:0008} y'hear?"
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|20:
Ms. Niedler,{E108:0008} Dr. Hertz!{E108:0010}
Thanks a lot for looking after me!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|21:
"An' if ya really are better,{E108:0008} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}how about ya get outta
them danged hospital duds?"
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|22: Oh, yeah!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}I washed all your clothes for you.{E108:0018} Here!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|23: I thought they were with Detective Gumshoe?
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|24:
He handed them over to us after they came back from
forensics.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|25:
...And did he happen to mention if forensics found
anything of note?
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|27:
Anyway,{E108:0010} never mind that now!{E108:0018}
Put them on, Kay!{E108:0010} I want to see!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|28:
Wait.{E108:0010} What about her bandages?{E108:0010}
Surely it's too soon to remove them?
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|30:
She may have taken {E12F:00240009}a big old bump to the head,{E108:0008}{E12F:00240000} but
she wasn't really hurt otherwise!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|31: But then...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D1}why all the bandages in the first place?
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|32:
Prevention is better than cure!{E108:0018} {E188:00310000}{E1D1}{E1D5}{E107:0001}{E12F:00000007}A stitch in time saves
nine!{E108:0018} {E12F:00240000}Those are just a few of my mottos!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|33:
(Both of which sound like painfully annoying practices
for your patients...)
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|35:
Yeah,{E108:0008} now this is what I'm talking about!{E108:0018}
{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}{E12F:00020004}Fits like a stolen glove!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|38:
Thanks to you, too, Ms. von Karma!{E108:0010}
I'm so glad you showed up when you did!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|40:
I'm sure he'll be very happy to see that you're back to
your old self, too.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|41: Speaking of Gummy...!{E108:0010} Where is he?
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|43:
Perhaps the well of his devotion ran dry when a
certain someone threw away his badge.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|45:
...Anyway,{E108:0008} I have to be going.{E108:0010}
And I'll be taking those two with me.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|46: Wait...{E108:0010} {E12F:00020005}What's going to happen to them?
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|47:
Acting as an accomplice in a murder,{E108:0008} and forging an
autopsy report eighteen years ago...
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|48: Their crimes can't be allowed to go unpunished.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|49:
But the fact that Excelsius Winner coerced them into
cooperating will, of course,{E108:0008} be taken into account.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|50:
Don't you worry about us, Kay!{E12F:00240009}{E108:0018} {E107:0002}As long as Gramma
and me are together,{E108:0008} we'll be alright!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|51: ...Take care, Kay Faraday.{E108:0010} Until we meet again.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|53:
I know you only just got your memory back,{E108:0008} but I need
to ask you some questions.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|55:
What happened the day you lost your memory?{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}What were you doing?
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|56:
Let's see...{E108:0010} Somebody asked me to meet them at Gourd
Lake.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|57: But I didn't know who it was.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|58: So there I was,{E108:0008} just looking up at the moon when...
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|59:
...somebody in a red raincoat{E108:0008} {E188:00310000}{E1D5}{E1D1}started walking toward
me!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|60:
They must have drugged me somehow,{E108:0008} because that's
when I fell unconscious!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|62: (Kay was at Gourd Lake,{E108:0008} looking up at the moon...?)
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|63:
Anyway,{E108:0008} when I came to,{E108:0008} I was on the roof of this
building.
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|64: I was in a daze and stumbling around up there when...
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|65:
I saw the person in the red raincoat again!{E108:0018}
But they were lying on the ground!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|66: I was so surprised,{E108:0008} I stumbled backward...
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|67: And then I was falling,{E108:0008} {E188:00360000}{E1D1}and everything went dark!
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|68:
When I came to the second time,{E108:0008} {E1D5}I couldn't remember
anything...
sce3_c5_05.bytes|03002500|69:
The person in the red raincoat...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}Who in the world were they?

Just before you found yourself here,{E108:0008} you were at

There's only one reason I can think of for your

...Oh, wait!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}I just remembered there was something
I wanted to ask you!
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|0400069C|2:
Could you maybe light me up when I'm doing
my next robbery?{E108:0010} Help me look super cool?
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|0400069C|3:
You want me to shine a light on you
while you're committing a crime?
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|0400069C|4: You bet I do!{E108:0010} What's so weird about that!?
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|0400069C|5:
What's the point in me doing my Great Thief-ing
in the dark?
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|0400069C|6:
The folks in the cheap seats won't be able to
see a thing!
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|0400069C|7:
(Wait,{E108:0008} you're imagining you'll be committing this
robbery in front of an audience...?)
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|0: Ms. Nichols.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Where does this exit lead?
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|1: That?{E108:0010} Oh, uh...{E108:0008} onto the grounds of the {E041}Bigg Building{E040}.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|2:
(Yet another case with direct ties to that
same building...)
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|3:
(The building with the hidden fifty-first floor used
to store the lots for illicit auctions...)
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|4:
(I guess it wouldn't be much of a surprise if it turned
out to be hiding yet more secrets...)
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|5:
Bigg Building data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E106}{E1CF}{E150:00000020}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}{E285}(Huh.{E108:0014} Look at this chain and padlock...)
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|6: Oh, look at that.{E108:0018} Somebody cut the chain!
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|7:
They did?{E108:0018} I'm sure it was still intact when I
left yesterday.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|10: Look at that huge dent!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}How did that get there!?
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|11: ...You're right.{E108:0010} That is a big dent.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|12:
It would have taken a sizeable object to make
it --{E108:0008} and a heavy one, too.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|13: That wasn't like that yesterday, either...
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006A4|15:
(I guess that means the {E043}dent{E042} must have 
been made last night at some point...)
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006B6|0:
So the grounds of the Bigg Building lie beyond
this gate.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006B6|1:
To look at it from here, you'd think it was just
an ordinary building, huh?
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006B6|2:
And there's no one really special around to speak of,
either.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006B6|3:
Well, no one from our current vantage point, at any
rate.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006B6|4:
...Anyway, we don't have time to ponder such things.{E108:0010}
We need to investigate this entire lot.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006BB|0:
This thing in front of the trailer here --{E108:0008}
it looks like a monster costume.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006BB|2:
You're sure the creature that made these huge
footprints didn't just...{E108:0008} shrink or something?
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006BB|4:
This thing in front of the trailer here --{E108:0008} it looks like{E108:0008}
{E107:0001}{E280}a monster costume.{E108:0010} A COSTUME.
sce4_c0_m14_check.bytes|040006C0|1: (Now to use my powers of {E041}logic{E042} to put it all together.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000700|0: So, Mr. Prosecutor.{E108:0010} We meet again.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000700|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} We saw you at the Detention Center
the other day, too.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000700|2:
You had some business to take care of, I take it,
Agent Lang?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000700|3:
You could say that.{E108:0010}
Nothing that need concern you, though.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000700|4:
Pah.{E108:0010} Yeah, you really have a habit of showing up
in the wrong place at the wrong time.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000700|5:
You're a {E108:000C}{E107:0002}{E12F:00070009}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}bad penny, {E108:0008}a bad omen, {E108:0008}and a bad smell
all rolled into one.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000700|6: Just stay out of my way, okay?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000700|7: I've got a president to avenge.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|0: That's the pin your assistant always wears, right?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|1:
Yup!{E108:0010} It represents nature's toughest and fiercest
creature --{E108:0008} the Yatagarasu!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Pretty cool, right?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|2:
"Toughest and fiercest"?{E108:0010} Isn't it just a bird?{E108:0020}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00070004}Sorry, {E108:0010}but I'm not about to let that pass.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|3:
Lang Zi {E108:000C}says: {E901}{E107:0003}{E283}"The wolf outstrips the raven in
every respect!"
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|4:
That little black bird of yours wouldn't survive
even a single swipe of a wolf's claws.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|5: Those are big words, Sir Howlsalot!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|6:
But do you know {E108:000C}what us thieves say?{E108:0020}
{E107:0003}{E12F:0002000A}{E283}"The raven is pretty darned amazing!"
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|7:
I could peck you to bits and then fly off before
your stupid claw swipe ever got close!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|8:
You think a wolf can't jump?{E108:0018} I'd snap you out of
the sky before you could fly away like a coward!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|9:
Hah!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}I'd just flap my wings super hard and blast
you across the room!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000708|12:
(I haven't had to endure an argument like this
since elementary school...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000715|1:
What are you showing me that for!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Curse whoever killed President Wang...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000715|2: I'll find them!{E108:0018} {E1D1}You see if I don't!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000715|3:
(Forgive me, Agent Lang.{E108:0010} I didn't mean to
upset you...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000715|4:
(He seems to find it hard to keep a cool head where
the president is concerned.{E108:0010} Unsurprisingly, I guess...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000715|5:
Can't help but feel a little sorry for him, huh?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Isn't there something we can do?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000715|6:
Yes.{E108:0010} Listen carefully to what he has to say, and try
to help solve the president's murder.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|0:
What?{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}You want to talk about Taurusaurus?{E108:0018}
With everything else that's going on?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|1:
I'm certainly not saying that the creature could be
our culprit.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}But he's not...{E108:0008} {E107:0002}unrelated to the case.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|2:
If there's anything you can tell us, I'd be very
much obliged.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|3:
Hmph.{E108:0010} Well, President Wang had a Taurusaurus
toy from way back when.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|4:
I saw it a couple of times over the years.{E108:0010}
That's why I recognized it.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|6: (We saw it in the presidential plane, too...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|7:
If even the leaders of other countries love
Taurusaurus, {E108:0008}{E107:0001}he must be famous everywhere!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|8:
Dogs go...{E108:0008} {E1D1}"bau bau" in other languages, right?{E108:0010}
And cats go {E1D1}"miaou".{E108:0010} And roosters go, uh...{E108:0008} {E1D1}"cocorico"!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|9:
So what noise would a Taurusaurus from another
country make?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400071C|10:
(We don't even know what noise our own
Taurusaurus makes, do we?)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000727|0: Why are you shoving this in my face?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000727|1: You ought to be careful I don't bite it!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|0: You were already at the scene when we got here.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|1: Why?{E108:0010} What were you doing in the area?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|4:
Look, I heard a scream and came running, okay?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Guess it was our friend from the crew.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|5: Came in from that gate over there.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|6: Somebody already got rid of the lock{E040} for me.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|7:
(Not completely.{E108:0010} I can still see it on the floor there.{E108:0018}
Perhaps I should take a closer look...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|9: ...I saw movie girl running out of the other gate.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|10:
(In other words, he arrived right around the same
time we did...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|11: So you had business here at the Bigg Building?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|12: Something like that.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}A date with destiny, let's call it.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|13:
(He was similarly enigmatic when we 
saw him at the Detention Center...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|14:
Let me guess --{E108:0008} you're a huge creature feature fan, so 
you came to see them filming the Taurusaurus movie?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|15: ...Creature features?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00070003}{E1D1}What do you think I am?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400072A|16:
(Not the type of person who thinks a "creature"
might have done this, I hope...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|0:
I'm sorry about the president.{E108:0010}
You have my deepest condolences.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|1:
...Thanks.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}He was a great man.{E108:0018} Zheng Fa will be
lost without him.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|2: You and he were close, correct?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|3:
It all started when he hired my father.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}That was our big break.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|4:
Our family kept him safe.{E108:0010} That was our most
important duty.{E108:0008} And our most sacred.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|5:
He gave my father medal after medal.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}They had to
come up with new ones just for him.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|6:
In the end there were no medals left to give.{E108:0010} {E1D1}So he
made us the keepers of his last will and testament.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|7:
Those medals?{E108:0008} That duty?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}They're our greatest
pride.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Our family jewels.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|8:
Gah...{E108:0010} Never thought we'd be unsealing that will{E108:0010}
{E1D1}so soon...!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|9:
Wow.{E108:0010} It sounds like your family and the president
were super close...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|10:
But wait...{E108:0018} when that whole thing happened back at
the lake...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|11: You weren't with the president then, right?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|13:
My father and the president being friends...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Our family being the ones who kept him safe...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|14:
He just...{E108:0008} changed one day.{E108:0010} It was like he became{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}a different person.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|15: Now, he...{E108:0008} He doesn't trust the police one bit...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|16: (I wonder what happened twelve years ago...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|17:
But regardless of what happened, I still
respected him.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|18: Zheng Fa may not be a big country...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|20: Dammit!{E108:0020} What was his security detail thinking!?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|21: I imagine you've already contacted the embassy?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|22:
Of course I have.{E108:0010} And the government.{E108:0010}
{E107:0004}...And my family.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|23:
They'll be going crazy right now {E108:0008}{E107:0003}thinking about
what needs to happen with that will...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|24:
And things will be getting crazy here soon, too.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Those bodyguards will be all over the place.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400073B|25:
If you're not a fan of trouble, I'd leave before
they get here.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000755|1:
These days, {E108:0010}{E1D1}I'm a one-man outfit.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}A lone wolf.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000755|2: They won't be letting me lead this investigation.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000755|3: But I've still {E108:0010}{E12F:00070001}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}{E1D5}got fangs!{E108:0020} And I can still {E108:0008}{E1D1}bite back!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000755|4:
I'll find whoever did this.{E108:0020}
And I won't let you or anybody else get in my way!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|0:
What is it now!?{E108:0020} Can't y'all see I'm busy!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Girl needs room to work, y'know!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|1:
Why are you so obsessed with the idea that
this was a monster attack?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|2: Monsters don't exist.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Surely even you know that.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|3:
What did you--!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E280}You don't know what the heck
yer talkin' about!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|4:
Taurusaurus is real, dangit!{E108:0018}
I know that for a fact!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|5: For a fact, hm?{E108:0010} And how is that possible, exactly?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|8:
Heck yeah I seen him!{E108:0020} {E1D5}{E188:00200000}{E1D2}The big, bad bull hisself!{E108:0010}
Right there in fronta me!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|9:
I was up on fifty-one over at that there Bigg Building
just yesterday, right?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|10:
Gathering materials for your story on the
underground auction.{E108:0010} Yes.{E108:0008} We remember.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|11:
Well, ain't you just Mr. Memory Man!{E108:0018} That's right --{E108:0008}
I done seen him right when I took that photo!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|12:
The person in the red raincoat!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Ms. Ringer, right?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|13:
Yup!{E108:0010} Y'all see that blind right there next to
Li'l Miss Redcoat?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|14:
Well, guess who was on the other side of it at that
very moment?{E108:0018} That's right --{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E280}Taurusaurus!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|16:
Well, I can't rightly capture every danged thing!{E108:0010}
I was just a little too far away, that's all!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|17: But I seen it alright!{E108:0010} Boy, did I!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|18:
Taurusaurus's big ol' eye, starin' right at me!{E108:0010}
Peekin' right in at the window!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|20:
Anyhow, {E108:0020}I don't got time to be shootin' the breeze
with y'all!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|21:
I got snaps to snap!{E108:0018} Reportage to...{E108:000C} {E1D1}report!{E108:0018}
Quit buggin' me, will ya!?{E108:0018} {E1D1}Go on!{E108:0018} {E1D1}Git!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400075A|23:
You didn't believe a word she said, did you,{E108:000C}
Mr. Edgeworth?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000773|1: (Now to use my powers of {E041}logic{E042} to put it all together.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000775|0: I'm...{E108:0018} sorry I got a little...{E108:0010} {E12F:00180002}{E1D1}upset before...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000776|0:
Taurusaurus is kind of a symbol of nature.{E108:0010}
That's why he destroys the city.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000776|1: (That...{E108:0008} doesn't make a whole lot of sense...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000776|2:
He can attack with his horns, but that's not the
only trick up his sleeve!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000776|3:
He can bellow out shockwaves, {E108:0008}drown people in
drool, {E108:0008}squirt them with milk...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000776|4:
He can suffocate them with barbecue smoke,{E108:0008}
make cute little items out of leather...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000776|6:
But they'll sure look good!{E108:0010} It's our job to make
sure of that!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000776|7:
(...And I hope you succeed.{E108:0010} For the sake of
your entire industry.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400077E|0: Oh.{E108:0010} That's the picture Shaun gave me.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400077E|2:
There were only three of us, {E108:0010}so we used
the self-timer.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400077E|3: Who's the third person?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}In the Taurusaurus suit?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400077E|4:
Who indeed?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Hey, tell you what --{E108:0008} why don't you
go see for yourselves?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400077E|5:
They should be somewhere just outside the gate.{E108:0010}
Go say hello if you get the chance!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400077E|6: Hmm.{E108:0018} Very well.{E108:0010} {E12F:00000000}I think we might.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000785|0:
Whoa!{E108:0010} A plushie of the original Taurusaurus!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}...You know who that is by now, right?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000785|1:
I've seen the creature before.{E108:0010} But I never
watched any of the movies.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000785|2:
This one is so much cuter than that big, ugly
head up on the roof!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000785|4:
That can't be helped.{E108:0010} They haven't sold them
for a while now, but...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000785|6:
They sold a ton of them.{E108:0010} It was a super popular
gift for a while there.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000785|7:
If it was me, I'd want something a little...{E108:0008} cooler,
y'know?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000785|8:
You know, like...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E280}if somebody happened to want
to buy me a gift...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Ahem...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000785|9: (Why is she looking at me like that?)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400078F|0:
...Taurusaurus really does have hooves that
split in two like that.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400078F|1:
Please don't tell me you think the president was
trampled to death by Taurusaurus, too?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400078F|2: N-No!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}I...{E108:0008} I'm a member of the movie crew, remember?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400078F|3: I don't believe he'd ever kill anybody!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400078F|4:
No creature inside a movie should ever harm
anybody outside of a movie!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400078F|5:
That's a golden rule of the creature
feature community!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000796|2:
Huh...?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Oh, uh...{E108:000C} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Sorry.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I must have been
thinking of something else...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000796|3: I really do need new glasses...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000796|5: (It's really not something to get so upset about...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|1:
That's right.{E108:0010} I came before everybody else so I
could get everything ready.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|2:
But as soon as I walked through the gate, {E108:0010}{E107:0003}{E12F:00180002}{E285}I saw
the footprints.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|3:
Monster prints first thing in the morning!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That must have been a real shock!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|4:
It was.{E108:0010} They weren't there when I left yesterday
evening, I'm sure of it.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|5:
(So the footprints must have appeared late
last night...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|6:
At first glance, {E108:0010}I thought maybe they were{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}part of the set.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|7:
But then I got closer, and I saw that somebody
was lying in the middle of one of them.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|8: You didn't notice until you were right up close?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|9:
Yeah.{E108:0010} My eyesight just seems to be getting worse
and worse lately.{E108:0010} I think I need new glasses.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|10:
I didn't notice it was...{E108:0008} a body until I was right by it.{E108:0010}
Which is why I got so shocked and ran away.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400079C|11: (That must be when we bumped into her...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007A8|1: (Now to use my powers of {E041}logic{E042} to put it all together.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|0:
So you're shooting a movie?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}{E12F:00000009}{E1D1}...It wouldn't happen
to be a...{E108:0010} {E107:0004}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}Steel Samurai movie, would it?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|6:
You'll have to forgive Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0008} {E107:0001}{E1D1}He only
cares about the Steel Samurai!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|8:
Hey, that's alright.{E108:0010} Not everyone's a fan.{E108:0010}
But they soon will be!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|9:
"He's back, after twelve years of silence!{E108:0018}
{E188:00DA0000}{E1DA}The big, bad bull himself:{E108:0008} Taurusaurus!"
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|10:
It's the first Taurusaurus movie in a long time,
so the crew's super excited about it!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|11:
And parts of it are set here at the Bigg Building,
so we've been shooting on location.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|13:
What's happening here?{E108:0018} {E1D1}What's going on with the
building?{E108:0018} Just stay calm and talk to me, kid!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|15:
I, {E108:0008}{E1D1}I'm sooo sorry!{E108:0018} {E188:00300000}We're shooting a movie!{E108:0010}
Could you, uh...?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|16: (That must be what they were filming.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|17:
So does Taurusaurus smash the Bigg Building
to pieces in the movie!?{E108:0010} I bet he does, right?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|18:
Hee hee.{E108:0010} Wouldn't you like to know?{E108:0018} {E1D1}But you'll just
have to wait to find out in the theater!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|19: Here.{E108:0010} You can have this if you like.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|23:
That's right!{E108:0010} It's not just Taurusaurus on his own
this time around!{E108:0010} He has an arch nemesis!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|24:
You know Gourdy, right?{E108:0018}
The monster from Gourd Lake?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|25:
Oh, yeah!{E108:0018} Wasn't everybody talking about that
a couple of years back?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|26:
The mysterious creature in the lake!{E108:0018}
It showed up in that one couple's photo!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|27:
(Not only were people talking about it, it played
a major part in one of my cases...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|28:
(Hmm...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Not a name I'm too wild about
hearing again...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|29:
The director's fascinated by the stories,
which is how Gourdy wound up in the movie!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|30:
(A little behind the times, but...{E108:0008} better late than never,
I suppose...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|31:
Just wait till you see those two legends tearing{E108:000C}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}into each other on the big screen!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007AA|32:
Creature Feature Flyer data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CB|0: (This reminds me of something I've seen already...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CC|0:
(I think we need to learn a little more about the
security situation here on set.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CC|1: Ms. Nichols,{E108:0018} {E12F:00000008}is the set kept locked overnight?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CC|3:
A combination lock, huh?{E108:0010} So anybody who
knows the code can get in and out!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CC|4:
And was the lock in place when you 
arrived this morning?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CC|5:
Yup!{E108:0010} Everything was locked up tight when I
got here.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CC|7:
Oh, the producer, {E108:0008}the director, {E108:0008}the crew,{E108:0008}
the actors...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CC|8: Basically, everybody who's working on the movie.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007CC|9:
(So any member of the cast or crew could have
opened the {E043}lock{E042} and entered...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007D6|2:
Oh, that's part of one of Taurusaurus's horns.{E108:0010}
It's from a model we use for promotional stuff.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007D6|4: On the ground near the side entrance.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007D6|6:
We keep a replica of {E041}Taurusaurus's head{E040} up on 
the roof of the trailer over there.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007D6|7: And it's...{E108:0008} quite large, I assume?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007D6|8:
Oh, yeah!{E108:0018} Well, not as big as the real thing,
obviously.{E108:0008} But it's still pretty big!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007D6|9: It's just up there.{E108:0010} See it?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E2|0: There's a {E108:0008}{E107:0001}{E1D1}bunch of really cool stuff around here, huh?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E2|1:
Hee hee.{E108:0010} I guess there is.{E108:0010} It's all for making the
movie --{E108:0008} the costumes, the equipment, everything.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E2|2: Treasures{E040} aplenty!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}I'm in heaven right here!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E2|3:
(Some of this {E041}equipment{E042} could be related to the
murder, too...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E2|4: (I'd better look it all over carefully...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E7|1: (Now to use my powers of {E041}logic{E042} to put it all together.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E9|1:
It was Shaun, wasn't it?{E108:0010}
Do you mind if I ask you some questions?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E9|2:
...Are you really a prosecutor?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}You just look like an old guy to me.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E9|5: I don't...{E108:0008} have my badge right now.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E9|6:
Hmph.{E108:0010} Then how do you expect people to believe 
you're a prosecutor?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E9|9: You want me to try talking to him?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007E9|10:
Why not?{E108:0010} I doubt it can hurt.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}(I never was good with children...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007F4|0: Taurusaurus is just a movie character.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007F4|1: How did he wind up involved in a murder?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007F4|2: That's exactly what I'd like you to help us figure out.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007F4|3: Heh.{E108:0018} Then give me a reason to, old man.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007F4|5:
How about some delicious candy, huh?{E108:0020}
I bet you'd like that, wouldn't you?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007F4|7:
Bah...{E108:0018} {E107:0003}The old candy gambit usually works like
a charm.{E108:0010} So near and yet so far...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007FD|0: ...So I covered for my mom.{E108:0010} So what?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007FD|1: Are you trying to tell me I shouldn't have?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007FD|2: I applaud your desire to protect your mother, Shaun.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007FD|3:
But that doesn't mean I approve of your decision 
to dispose of vital evidence.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007FD|5:
They were going to accuse her of murder!{E108:0010}
You want me to just stand back and do nothing!?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007FD|7:
What Mr. Edgeworth is trying to say is that you're
super brave.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007FD|8:
He just...{E108:0008} wishes you could have owned up to
everything a little sooner, {E108:0010}that's all.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|040007FD|11: There.{E108:0010} Isn't it nice when people are nice?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080A|0:
What's this?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}If you're trying to bribe your way
onto the movie, {E108:0008}{E107:0002}it's not going to work.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080A|1: (That's not what I was trying to do at all.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080A|2: Huh.{E108:0010} So, uh...{E108:0008} {E284}how would I get a part in the movie?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|0: So you're an actor, right, Shaun?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|3: ...I-It's not that big of a deal.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|4:
(Heh.{E108:0010} Kay's approach seems to be having
an effect.)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|7: Oh, those?{E108:0010} The make-up department made them.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|8:
The character he plays has a special psychic
link with Taurusaurus!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|9:
And the horns allow him to communicate with his
giant friend.{E108:0018} {E12F:00180000}Isn't that right, {E108:0018}Shaun?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|11: They don't need to know all that stuff!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|13:
(Well, the power dynamic here seems
pretty obvious...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|14:
Still, that's kind of amazing, huh?{E108:0018}
The lead character in a movie?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|15:
While you're still in elementary school?{E108:0010}
That's crazy!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|18:
Uh, {E108:000C}{E280}Shaun's actually thirteen.{E108:0010} He...{E108:000C} {E107:0002}{E1D1}He just looks
a little younger...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|20:
The backpack's part of his costume.{E108:0010}
He's playing a role, remember?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|21:
Y-Yeah, I guess he is, huh?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}But...{E108:0010} he is kinda...{E108:0014} {E107:0002}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}small, you have to admit.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|22:
Oh, uh...{E108:000C} {E1D1}we try not to talk about that too much
in front of him...
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|23:
I said, STOP TELLING PEOPLE STUFF THEY
DON'T NEED TO KNOW!!!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400080E|25:
(So it's all part of the role?{E108:0010}
Except for the carton of milk, maybe...?)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|0: The dead guy...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}that's the president, right?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|4:
...Peh.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Guy was a real piece of work.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|5: H-Hey, you can't say that!{E108:0010} It's not nice!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|6: What was so bad about him, anyway?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|8: Huh?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Don't want to talk about it?{E108:0010} Fine...{E108:0008} I guess.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|9:
O-Oh, uh...{E108:0020} {E107:0002}President Wang was working with
us on the movie.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|11: He had a part.{E108:0010} Just a cameo --{E108:0008} nothing big.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|12:
So he came to look around the set one time.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}That would have been when Shaun met him.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|13: Why put the president in your movie?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|14:
We heard he was a huge fan of the
original Taurusaurus.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|15:
So the studio offered him a little role.{E108:0010}
They figured it would be good PR.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|16: ...Last thing I need is amateurs on my set.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|17:
I told you before, {E108:0010}Shaun --{E108:0010} you can't talk about
people like that!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|18: ...And I told you to shut your mouth!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000828|19:
(I guess he's none too thrilled about the idea of
performing alongside non-professionals...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400083C|4:
...Yeah.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I just got them printed.{E108:0010}
...You can keep it if you want.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400083C|5: Wow!{E108:0010} It's such a great picture!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400083C|6:
And you brought it specially for me?{E108:0010}
That's so kind!{E108:0008} Thank you!
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400083C|7:
...No, I just...{E108:0010} happened to have a spare.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That's all.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400083C|8:
I hope you don't mind me asking, but...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00000008}can we take a look, too?
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400083C|10:
(So it was taken yesterday...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}No "footprints"...{E108:0010}
And certainly no body...)
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|0400083C|11:
Behind-the-Scenes Photo data jotted down
in my Organizer.
sce4_c0_m14_npc.bytes|04000848|1: (Now to use my powers of {E041}logic{E042} to put it all together.)
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000901|0: Yesss!{E108:0018} Seeing my pin {E108:0010}{E107:0001}{E12F:00020008}{E282}just gave me an amazing idea!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000901|1:
You really looked after me when I was sick,
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} I owe you big-time!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000901|2:
So I'm going to carve you a super-cool badge
of your own out of an eraser!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000901|3:
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E1D1}Should it be of your profile, though?{E108:0018}
Or face-on?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}{E12F:00020002}Ooh, {E108:0008}{E107:0002}maybe halfway in between...
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000901|4:
(Who said I wanted this "super-cool" badge to be
of my face?)
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000901|5:
Ooh, {E108:0018}{E107:0001}or we could go for something a little more
edgy --{E108:0008} {E1D2}{E188:00340000}like, from underneath?
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000901|6: (That sounds less edgy than...{E108:0008} plain surreal...)
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000908|1: ...walking through a cold rain that just wouldn't stop.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000908|2: But getting it back --{E108:0008} {E107:0003}that was like...
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000908|5:
...It wasn't me who helped you get your memory
back, {E108:0010}Kay.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000908|6:
If you want to thank somebody, thank the person
who made you write those promises down.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000908|7:
Thanks, Dad!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E282}But thanks to you, too, {E108:0018}{E107:0001}{E1D1}Mr. Edgeworth!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000908|8: ...Heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E188:00300000}I feel a lot better for saying that.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000908|9:
Could you have said it a little more quietly, perhaps?{E108:0010}
This is hardly the time or the place...
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000912|1:
We foiled a fake assassination attempt,
only for him to be killed in a real one.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000912|2:
Yes.{E108:0008} It's a tragedy.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But he's gone for good
this time.{E108:0010} There's no denying that.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000912|3:
All we can do for him now is help solve the{E108:0008}
{E107:0002}mystery of how he met his fate.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000912|4: You're right!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Let's give him {E108:0008}{E107:0001}{E282}{E12F:00020008}the send-up he deserves!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000912|5: I think you mean "send-off".{E108:0010} But yes.{E108:0008} Let's.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000918|0:
Taurusaurus versus Gourdy!{E108:0018}
{E12F:00020006}{E280}What a fight that'll be!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000918|1:
Gourdy will probably try to swallow Taurusaurus
whole!{E108:0018} {E12F:00020009}{E107:0003}But the horns will get stuck in his throat!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000918|2:
Then Taurusaurus will try to bite Gourdy!{E108:0018} {E12F:00020009}{E107:0002}But his skin
is so slimy and slippery, {E108:0008}{E107:0003}it'll probably slide right off!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000918|3:
That one's really gonna get my heart pumping,
I can tell already!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000918|4: (It...{E108:0008} is?{E108:0010} I fail to understand young people these days...)
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400091D|0: A case that's been unsolved for twelve whole years...
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400091D|1:
That's a long time, huh?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I wasn't much more
than a baby when it happened.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400091D|2: And Agent Lang has been {E108:0010}sad that whole time...
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400091D|3:
We have to solve it, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}I'm going to try extra hard on this one!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400091D|4:
As will I.{E108:0010} I hope I can call on you to refer to the
case notes for me from time to time.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400091D|5:
Yes, sir!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'll read every word to you loudly, clearly,{E108:0008}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}and with plenty of feeling!
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400091D|6:
(I don't think we'll need the feeling, thank you.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Just the facts will suffice.)
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000924|0:
Hmm...{E108:0010} Seems only this part of the yard was
doused with kerosene and set alight...
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000924|2: Indeed.{E108:0010} It seems they had a lucky escape.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000924|3:
Still, some things just aren't funny, right?{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}What kind of a prank is that?
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000924|4: (One in very poor taste, I'd say.)
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|04000924|5:
(Especially if even a self-proclaimed Great Thief
isn't prepared to endorse it...)
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400092A|0: Hey, I'm a Great Thief.{E108:0010} I totally sympathize.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400092A|1:
If you feel you gotta grab something,{E108:0008} you should just
go ahead and grab it.{E108:0010} Even if it's worthless.
sce4_c0_partner.bytes|0400092A|2:
(She doesn't seem to think much of my little
"treasure"...)

I'm almost certain of it.
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|0:
(The trash is collected at 11 AM.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I guess that's why the enclosure is empty.)
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|1: There was a ton of stuff here earlier.{E108:0010} Big stuff, too.
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|2: Today must be the day they take the big stuff away!
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|4:
I'll bet the big squisher machine {E108:000C}{E1D1}squished it all
up good anyhow!
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|5:
They don't do that with the larger items.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}They just take them away as they are.
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|6: They do, huh?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}How do you even know that, sir?
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|7:
Wait --{E108:0018} Mr. Fender's pretty keen for you to join
him, right?
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|8:
I'll bet he sent you some kind of pamphlet on how to
throw your stuff away for when you move office!
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001707|9:
(You're spookily insightful sometimes, Kay.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}But only sometimes...)
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001711|0: So they keep it locked up tight, huh?
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001711|1:
I guess they don't want non-residents disposing 
of their trash here.
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001713|1: Yes.{E108:0010} Because the garbage was just collected.
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001713|2: You think?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Or did somebody...{E108:0008} steal it all!
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001713|3: I smell a crime here, Mr. Edgeworth!
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001713|4:
I certainly smell something as well.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(But is it really the scent of a crime...?)
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001718|0:
Based on what we've seen, and what
Detective Gumshoe told us...
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001718|1:
...I think there's a strong possibility that Shaun
was abducted from the {E043}garbage disposal area{E040}.{E106}{E198:0004000F}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E12D:00051037}{E111:000200000003000100000002}{E122:000000010002}{E112:0002}{E112:0000}{E100:0000}{E101:00020002}{E107:0002}Yeah, it's kind of out of the way of prying
eyes, huh?
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001718|2:
But why would Shaun {E108:000C}{E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}even come here in the
first place?
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001718|3: I imagine he must have had something to dispose of...
sce4_c1_m13_check.bytes|04001718|4:
But the truck's already come and gone.{E108:0010}
Guess we'll never know what that something was now.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|0:
Oh uh, hey Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
Long time no see.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|3: He's an action star I met on an old case.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|4:
He's also the man behind the mask of the
one and only Steel Samurai.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|6: Nice to meet you!{E108:0018} {E107:0004}I'm Kay Faraday, {E108:0010}{E107:0002}{E1D1}Great Thief!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|7: Mr. Edgeworth has been working as my assistant!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|8:
Good to meet you.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}But...{E108:0008} {E107:0003}{E284}{E12F:00220002}thief?{E108:0018}
Mr. Edgeworth has been assisting a thief?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|9:
Let's not worry about that for now.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}We'd like to ask
you about what happened this morning if that's alright.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|10:
Ah, {E108:0008}{E107:0004}uh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Sure.{E108:0010} I don't know if I can be of much
help to you, but...{E108:0008} sure.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|11: (Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}So he'll be one of Shaun's work colleagues.)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001782|12: (I guess we'd better just dive right in...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400178F|1:
I was thinking maybe I should give you one of
those, but...{E108:0008} I guess you already have one.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400178F|2:
Indeed we do.{E108:0010} It's quite a concept --{E108:0008} an enormous,
fantastical monster fighting Gourdy.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400178F|4: Yeah.{E108:0010} To tell you the truth, I kinda thought so, too.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400178F|5:
Especially when I heard about their 
original plan.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400178F|6:
They were talking about trawling the lake for
the real Gourdy!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400178F|7:
(That would present...{E108:0008} problems on a number
of levels...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001797|0: Feels like you're right there behind the scenes, huh?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001797|1:
This has been such a great shoot.{E108:0010} Everybody's so
into it.{E108:0010} Crew, cast --{E108:0008} everybody.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001797|2:
Sure, it's not always been easy, {E108:0010}but we kept smiling
right through it all.{E108:0008} What an atmosphere!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001797|3: And now...{E108:0008} this.{E108:0010} How did this happen?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001797|4:
(There's not much we can do right now about
the fact that shooting has been suspended.)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001797|5:
(But if we can solve the case, maybe there's a
chance the movie can get back on schedule.)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001797|6:
(Another reason to do what we came here
to do!)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|0:
*sigh*{E108:0010} So the Taurusaurus head is broken,
and the lot's been torn up by huge footprints?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|1: This production is running over budget as it is...
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|2: And Global Studios is risking a lot on this one.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|3:
Sorry.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I know this isn't the right time to be talking
about money.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}People are...{E108:0008} dead.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|5:
The shoot has been thoroughly disrupted.{E108:0010}
That can't be easy for you.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|6:
Global Studios makes the Steel Samurai shows, too,
right?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|7:
...Oh, man!{E108:0010}
You know what this means, Mr. Edgeworth!?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|8:
If we don't solve this case soon,{E108:0008} you can kiss the
Steel Samurai goodbye!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400179E|9:
(Nnrgk!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}As if we weren't under enough
pressure already...!)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|0:
Hey, that's the original Taurusaurus, right?{E108:0010} These
things were super popular ten years or so back.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|1:
Is this one of the ones with the voice recorder
built in?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|2:
(It is indeed.{E108:0010} A function that saved my skin only
a short while ago...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|3: Dang.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}One of the horns is missing.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|4: It is.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Does that mean anything to you?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|5: Uh, only that there should be two.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|6:
But I guess it's over a decade old.{E108:0010}
These things happen, huh?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|7:
Do they?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I suppose they do if the build
quality is--
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|8:
Steel Samurai merchandise would never break
like that!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017A8|9:
(Heh...{E108:0010} My thoughts exactly.{E108:0010} But I guess not
everybody can be the Steel Samurai.)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B2|1:
You think I could use it in a performance or an
action scene or something?{E108:0010} That would be cool.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B2|2:
It would.{E108:0010} Sadly...{E108:0008} I don't think it would be suitable
for that.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|0:
I heard you were investigating this one,
Mr. Edgeworth.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|1:
Well, {E108:0010}I...{E108:0010} {E107:0004}Yes.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(But I'm not the prosecutor in charge, of course...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|2:
But if you're Kay here's assistant, I guess this
is...{E108:0008} {E284}her case?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|5:
Alright,{E108:0008} I'll need you to give me straight answers.{E108:0010}
First of all, this case...
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|6:
Have you noticed anything weir--{E108:0008} {E107:0003}I mean, uhh...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00020002}Perhaps you could give me your...{E108:0010} {E285}{E12F:00020003}impressions.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|7: (Is that supposed to sound like me...?)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|8:
My impressions?{E108:0010} {E107:0004}Heh, {E108:0010}{E1D1}uh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I guess my main concern
is --{E108:0008} {E107:0003}no offense to the victim, and all, but...
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|9:
...Is it all over for the production?{E108:0010} Are we done?{E108:0010}
I can't help but worry.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|10:
I think it's probably safe to assume that you are.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}At least for now.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|11: Right?{E108:0010} Argh, I knew it.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}What a bummer.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|12: We don't have the location for much longer, either.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|13: Because you were due to finish shooting soon?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|14:
No.{E108:0010} Because they're {E041}due to start building{E040}.{E108:0010}
That lot won't be empty for long.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|15:
They were letting us use it while they got ready
to make a start.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|16:
(I guess the plan was to shoot the rest on a lot
back at Global Studios...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|17:
I've been so worried about everything.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}What with
people spreading all these rumors, too...
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|20:
"Y'all've been hidin' real monsters on that
there set o' yours!"
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|21:
"Y'all can't do that! I'm gonna expose y'all!"{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00220002}...She's always saying stuff like that.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|22: I think I know exactly who this "journalist" might be...
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|23:
Yeah, {E108:0010}the photographer, right?{E108:0010} I thought you maybe
knew her.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|24: But you're not, are you?{E108:0018} {E1D1}Hiding real monsters, I mean.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017B7|25:
Are you kidding!?{E108:0020} {E107:0003}{E12F:00220002}If they had real monsters to call on,{E108:0008}
{E107:0002}I'd be out of a job!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|0: So you've all been working hard on the movie?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|1:
Yeah.{E108:0010} It's the first time I've been on a reboot
of an old series.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|2:
This one's been a real challenge for me and
everybody else over at Global Studios.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|3:
(If only they'd put this kind of energy into making
a new Steel Samurai show or something...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|4: What role are you playing in this one?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|6: No way!{E108:0020} So you're the star!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|8:
I'm in a costume, see.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}My face won't ever
appear on screen...
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|9:
Really?{E108:0010} Still, that's pretty amazing!{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}I wish I could
wear a costume like that.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|10:
Hey,{E108:0010} do you think I could try it on sometime?{E108:0010}
{E285}I'd settle for just climbing inside one of the horns!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|11:
I'd love to say yes, but...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}that's not how it works.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}You can't really "climb inside" that part.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|12: Oh, {E108:0010}{E107:0003}I get it.{E108:0010} Because {E284}I'm an outsider, right?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017D2|13: (That's not the issue at all here, Kay.)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|0: Can I ask you a couple of questions about Shaun?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|1: Shaun?{E108:0020} {E12F:00220001}{E1D1}Oh, sure.{E108:0010} Penny told me what happened.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|2: He just disappeared, right?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00220001}Yeah.{E108:0010} Sounds like him.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|3: Does he do that a lot?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|5:
If we take five mid-shoot, you look around sometimes,
and he's just...{E108:0008} gone.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|6:
Do you have any idea where he might have
headed off to?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|8: I did see him leaving the set, though.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|11: He got on the site bus.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|12:
But I was checking some equipment over, and by
the time I looked back up, he was gone.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|13: (The site bus?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I wonder if he left any clues behind...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|14:
Do you mind if we take a look inside the bus,{E108:0010}
Mr. Powers?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|15: Sure!{E108:0010} You'll have to excuse the mess, though.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017E0|16: (Alright.{E108:0010} Let's see what we can find...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F1|0:
Mr. Powers.{E108:0010} Can I ask you a somewhat
impertinent question?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F1|2: Are they planning on making any more Steel Samurai?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F1|3:
I, ah...{E108:0010} {E1D1}Sorry --{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E156:0024000000000000}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}does this have something to do
with your case?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F1|4: No.{E108:0010} I was simply asking out of interest.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F1|5:
I'm sorry, {E108:0010}{E107:0002}Mr. Edgeworth, {E108:000C}{E107:0003}{E1D1}but they don't
let us talk about this stuff with just anybody...
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F1|6:
Ngrk!{E108:0020} {E107:0003}I...{E108:000C} {E107:0002}I'm sorry to have put you on the spot...{E108:0018}
(I knew it was a long shot.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Ah well...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F1|7:
(But he didn't say they WEREN'T planning on
making anything new...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}Interesting...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F9|0: A very good day to you, {E108:0020}Prosecutor Edgeworth, sir!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F9|1:
(Huh?{E108:0020} I'm...{E108:0008} not a prosecutor anymore.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}But he doesn't need to know that, I guess...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F9|2:
Good day to you too, Officer.{E108:0018}
{E156:00000028002C0000}Can I ask why you've been posted here?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F9|3: Me?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D2}Oh, {E108:0020}I'm just keeping an eye on things!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F9|4:
Excellent.{E108:0010} Then perhaps you can tell me if any
vehicles have come in or out of here this morning.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F9|5:
None except the taxi and that blue truck over
there, sir!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|040017F9|6:
({E043}Only two vehicles have come in or out{E042}.{E108:0010}
That could be useful to know...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001800|0:
How are things looking here, Officer?{E108:0010}
All good?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001800|2:
I haven't just been keeping my eyes and ears
peeled, {E108:000C}{E107:0003}but my nose, tongue and fingers, too!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001800|3:
It's a whole new kind of guard duty, and I must
say, I'm really relishing the challenge it presents!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001800|4:
No offense, but would you mind concentrating on
more...{E108:0008} traditional methods?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001805|0: What the heck are y'all still doin' here?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001805|1: Lurkin' and a-loiterin' like a bad danged smell!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001808|0:
No offense, an' all, but...{E108:0010} if yer tryna reel me
in here...
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001808|1:
...y'all better have some tasty bait on that hook.{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E282}By which I mean scoops!{E108:0010} And plenty of 'em!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001808|2: (She didn't seem interested in that at all...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400180B|2:
Well who the heck else would I be talkin' to?{E108:0010}
{E188:002F0000}What's that thing you got stuck on yer scarf there?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400180B|3:
This?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Oh, {E108:0008}{E107:0002}it's my Yatagarasu pin.{E108:0010} The Yatagarasu
is the greatest thief in the world, and--
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400180B|5:
How come it's all wrapped up in gold paper is what
I wanna know!{E108:0010} I'll bet it's fixin' to melt any second!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400180B|6:
...Hello?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Anybody home?{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}I'm talkin' 'bout that big ol' chocolate bird right there!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400180B|7:
Didn't your momma ever teach you to treat your
food with respect!?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400180B|8: M-Mr. Edgeworth...{E108:0010} Uhh, what do I do?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400180B|9:
(Just keep quiet and weather the storm, Kay.{E108:0010}
She'll get bored eventually...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001815|0:
Seems y'all solved that there underground auction
case thanks to yours truly.{E108:0010} You're welcome.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001815|1: Yeah!{E108:0018} We owe you big time for all your help, Ms. Hart!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001815|3: My memory's completely back now and everything!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001815|4:
...Huh?{E108:0018} Yer what now?{E108:0010} You're sayin' you done lost
yer memory back there someplace?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|04001815|5: (I know whose memory I'm more worried about...)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400181B|0:
Now listen here, ya low-down dirty prosecutor!{E108:0018}
Taurusaurus is mine!{E108:0010} Mine, y'hear?
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400181B|1:
I'll track down every last lead there is to find about
that big, bad bull!{E108:0010} You see if I don't!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400181B|2:
From footprints to the finest strand o' stray hair,{E108:0008}
{E1D2}{E188:00310000}ain't a single teeny-tiny thing about to pass me by!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400181B|3:
Strands of stray hair...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(That's what you were focused on...?)
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400181B|4:
H-Hey, Mr. Edgeworth --{E108:0008} don't worry!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E285}{E12F:00020008}You're
nowhere near that stage just yet!
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400181B|5:
And besides, your dad had a fine head of
hair, right?{E108:0010} Thick and healthy and...{E108:0008} yeah.
sce4_c1_m13_npc.bytes|0400181B|6:

I'm particularly interested in what happened{E108:000C}
