misunderstanding gets huge...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Interesting...
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020C4|7:
I think I sorta kinda understand now.{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Thanks!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020C4|8: (I'm really not sure that you do...)
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|1: What is it, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Let me see!{E108:0010} Let me see!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|3:
What is it?{E108:0020} What's the matter!{E108:0018}
Show me!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|4:
Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0020} The court asks that you share
your findings!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|5:
...Zoom in on the top-right part of the image
and look closely.
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|10: Well, {E108:0018}{E107:0003}{E1D1}I'd say that's pretty decisive, wouldn't you?
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|11: (This doesn't look good for Shaun at all...!)
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|12:
W-Wait!{E108:0020} This doesn't prove anything!{E108:0018}
{E1D1}I didn't know he was there!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|13:
I don't believe you.{E108:0010} And the image does 
in fact prove something very important:
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|14:
That you and the president were here at the scene
of the crime together!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|15: Admit it, kid!{E108:0020} You murdered President Wang!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|18:
What do we do, Mr. Edgeworth!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00020005}It's hard to push back
against footage like that...
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|19:
Surely even you can't deny that this looks pretty 
bad for the kid, {E108:0010}Mr. Prosecutor.
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|21: He claimed he knew nothing about what happened.
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|22: But the president is right there with him!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|24:
Shaun!{E108:0020} What are you not telling us?{E108:0010}
We have to know!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|25:
He's right, Shaun!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E282}Be honest, now!{E108:0010}
It's the only way!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|27: The truth is...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}it was all my fault!
sce4_c2_05.bytes|040020CD|29:
I-It...{E108:000C} {E107:0002}{E1D1}It was my fault {E108:000C}{E107:0001}{E283}the Taurusaurus head
fell off of the trailer!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|0: -- What Happened While I Was Rehearsing --
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|1:
I went up on the roof of the trailer to prep the kit I was
using.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}And I turned on the heater while I was there.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|2:
I must have left it burning when I came back
down to run my lines.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|3:
Then my mom called, and I left the set to go
talk to her.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|4: When I came back after the call...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|5:
...the Taurusaurus head had fallen from
the roof and...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|6: ...the president was just there, lying next to it.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|8:
Hmm...{E108:0010} We did find evidence {E108:0008}{E107:0003}of a fire having
broken out up on the roof...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|9: I-It was just a tiny one.{E108:0010} So I put it out myself.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|10:
So we're saying the president died...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E12F:00020005}because
of Shaun?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|11:
If he did, that would make this whole thing
just an accident.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|12:
...What did you do with the head after you found
it on the ground?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|13:
I took it apart, carried the pieces up to the roof,{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00190001}and put it back together again.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|14:
You're saying you put out the fire {E108:0008}{E1D1}{E107:0002}AND moved
the head back to where it fell from?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|15:
In other words, you tried to cover your tracks!{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E282}You're a real piece of work, kid!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|16:
It's not like I did any of this on purpose!{E108:0020}
{E12F:00190004}{E107:0002}I really did just forget to turn the heater off...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|17:
Yes, and when the fire had burned through the legs,{E108:0008}
the table would've collapsed,{E108:0010} {E1D2}and the head...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|18:
...Would've fallen down onto the ground below!{E108:0028}
{E107:0003}You're right!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E285}{E041}The fire caused the head to fall{E040}!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|19:
Indeed.{E108:0010} And I also happen to have an idea about
how the fire may have started.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|20:
Those cans of paint thinner by the heater are
pretty flammable.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Not a great place to keep them...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|21: ...And you swear it was an accident?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|22:
Seems a little convenient.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}What was the president
even doing here in the first place?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|23:
H-How the heck am I supposed to know!?{E108:0020} I didn't
see anybody, I swear!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|25:
Why would President Wang come to a place 
like this in the middle of the night?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|26:
(His reasons for coming here are something of{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}a mystery, it's true...)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|27:
(He met Judge Gavèlle up on the roof two
nights ago...)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|28:
(...but he was also here on the movie set last night.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}Did he come to meet Shaun?)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002102|29:
(I think we'll need to go over the boy's statement
very carefully indeed!)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002120|0: -- What Happened While I Was Rehearsing --
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002121|0:
I went up on the roof of the trailer to prep the kit I was
using. And I turned on the heater while I was there.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002122|0:
I must have left it burning when I came back
down to run my lines.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002123|0:
Then my mom called, and I left the set to go 
talk to her.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002124|0: When I came back after the call...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002125|0:
...the Taurusaurus head had fallen from
the roof and...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002126|0: ...the president was just there, lying next to it.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002127|0:
I didn't know he was dead at first. There was no
blood, and nothing on his clothes, either.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002128|0:
But then I saw he wasn't breathing. That's how
I knew for sure.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002129|0:
Must have been quite a shock coming back and
seeing a dead body just lying there, huh?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002129|1:
And this was a dead body with a giant Taurusaurus
head right next to it!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002129|2: Yes.{E108:0010} I'm sure it must have been very upsetting.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002129|3: But...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00020002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}it does sound like it was an accident, right?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002129|4: Yes.{E108:0010} At least, it does the way Shaun tells it.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002129|5:
(I'd like to know a little more about exactly how
things looked around here at the time...)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400212F|0: You're a fit and hardy young man, {E108:0010}Shaun.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400212F|1:
It's spring now.{E108:0008} Surely you didn't really need
to fire up that stove?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400212F|2:
He is a fit and hardy young man who needs to
look after himself!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400212F|3:
Really, Your Honor?{E108:0010} But if he resorts to such
measures even during warm weather--
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400212F|5:
You two are going to argue over something like that
right now?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400212F|7:
You've made your point, {E108:000C}Shaun.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}But I've told you
before to watch how you talk to people.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400212F|8:
(I think he was criticizing you as much as he was
me, Your Honor...)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400212F|9:
Y-Yes, Mom...{E108:0018}
{E12F:00190000}Anyway, uh, where was I...?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002139|0:
You left it burning?{E108:0020} {E12F:00000008}You didn't think to check
before you came back down to the lot?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002139|1:
I meant to.{E108:0010} {E1D1}But...{E108:0008} I was thinking about my lines
and the scene and everything else...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002139|2: It's not my fault I forgot!{E108:0010} Everybody forgets stuff!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002139|3: I sure do!{E108:0020} Sooooo much stuff!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002139|4:
I leave the air conditioner on in Mr. Edgeworth's
office...{E108:0010} And the lights...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002139|5:
I forget that he told me never to jump off the ladder
on his bookshelves, or make prank calls...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002139|6:
But the one thing I would never, ever, forget
to do is to turn off an unattended heater!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|0:
It was the middle of the night, {E108:0018}{E107:0002}and the set
was deserted.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|1:
Why did you need to leave in order to talk
to your mother?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|2:
I forgot I was supposed to talk to her.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}I got...{E108:0008} confused, I guess...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|3:
I thought if I didn't leave, she'd find out I was
out of the hotel at night on my own.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|4: That doesn't make sense.{E108:0010} You know that, don't you?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|5:
...Fine.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Look, the camera was rolling, and the
mics were all live, okay?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|6:
I didn't want our conversation on that tape where{E108:000C}
{E107:0001}{E280}anybody could hear it!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|7:
(He was embarrassed about being recorded
speaking on the phone to his mother...?)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002142|8:
So I ditched the rehearsal and ran off set as
quick as I could.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400214B|0:
You pretended to your mother that you were
back at the hotel during the call, correct?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400214B|1:
How come you couldn't tell her you were coming 
back to the set to practice your lines?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400214B|2:
Because she'd have phoned the hotel and asked
them to send a car to get me or something...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400214B|3:
Of course I would have!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}A child your age
shouldn't be out on his own late at night!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400214B|5:
Hmm.{E108:0010} Children really can't seem to see things
from their parent's perspective, can they?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400214B|6:
It's true the other way around too, you know,
Mr. Edgeworth!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400214B|7:
Alright, {E108:0008}{E107:0002}Shaun --{E108:0010} can you tell us what happened
when you came back after speaking to your mother?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002154|0:
Were there any signs that it was about to fall
before you left?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002154|1:
I...{E108:000C} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I don't remember.{E108:0010}
I was concentrating on my lines.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002154|2:
But a fire had broken out on the roof because of
the heater you forgot to turn off.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002154|3: Did you really hear nothing the entire time?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002154|6:
I was playing the soundtrack to the movie to help me
concentrate.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}And I was playing it loud.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002154|7: So, yeah.{E108:0008} I definitely didn't hear anything.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002154|8:
Except for the sound of your phone ringing when
Judge Gavèlle called you.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002154|9:
You know that cell phones vibrate these days, right?{E108:0010}
Anyway...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400215E|0: Did you notice anything unusual about the body?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400215E|3:
(Hm?{E108:0018} He suddenly seems even more reticent
than usual...)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400215E|4:
I don't think he wants to go back over that memory
any more than he has to, {E108:0010}Mr. Edgeworth.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400215E|5: (...I'm sure he doesn't.{E108:0010} But is that really all it is?)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400215E|6: (Should I push him a little more on this?)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|0: It was dark?{E108:0018} But you knew it was a body nonetheless?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|2: (He's hiding something.{E108:0010} {E12F:00000002}I'd better find out what.)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|3:
Most people would cry out for help if they saw 
somebody lying on the ground.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|6:
So you said.{E108:0010} What I'm interested in is how you
were able to be so sure.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|7: Why were you certain that he was dead?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|8:
He was lying on the ground, and that huge head
was right next to him.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|9:
Didn't take much to figure out what must
have happened.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|10:
You couldn't have guessed that the impact would have
killed him!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D2}{E188:00310000}How did you really know!?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|11: I'll tell you how --{E108:0008} because you checked!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|13:
I was scared, but...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Yeah, I went up to the body,
and I looked, and he wasn't breathing.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|15:
(But why try to hide that fact?{E108:0018} There must be
a reason...)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|16:
...Could you tell me how the body looked
at that point?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|17: I, {E108:0010}{E1D1}I couldn't tell {E108:0010}{E107:0002}if he was dead at first...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|18:
There was no blood or anything, so it was
hard to be sure.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|19:
Nothing on his clothes, either.{E108:0010}
He was completely clean.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|21: So that's how {E108:0008}{E1D1}I knew he was dead...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002165|22:
...Thank you.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I'd like you to add that statement to
your testimony, if you don't mind.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400217C|0:
(Seeing a dead body like that must have shocked
him badly.)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400217C|1:
(It's understandable that he wouldn't want to talk
about it.)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400217E|0:
Did you realize that it was the president
right away?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400217E|1:
Not right away, no.{E108:0010} It was dark.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}I didn't realize it was him until I got closer.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400217E|2:
We...{E108:0010} worked together a little.{E108:0010}
But only a little.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400217E|3:
You {E108:0010}{E107:0001}worked with the president!?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E280}Who exactly ARE you, Shaun?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400217E|4:
I think you might be forgetting the president's
cameo in the movie, {E108:0010}Kay.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400217E|6:
Of course you had.{E108:0010} Now, Shaun, tell us --{E108:0018}
were you able to tell if he was alive or dead?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|0:
...So there was no blood or any other markings that
would have told you if he was alive or dead?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|1:
Would you say that my characterization of
your statement is correct?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|2:
You know I would!{E108:0010} And you saw the body, too,{E108:0018}
{E280}{E12F:00190002}so you know I'm telling the truth!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|3:
You also told us {E108:0008}{E188:002F0000}that the lot was dark at the time.{E108:0010}
And yet you were still able to confirm all this?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|4:
What is {E108:0010}{E282}your problem!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}There was nothing on
his face, and nothing on his clothes, {E108:0008}{E1D1}okay!?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|5:
Heh.{E108:0010} Thank you, Shaun.{E108:0010} I think that tells us
everything we need to know.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|6:
Why all the focus on how clean his clothes were?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E285}{E12F:0002000B}Mine are freshly washed, at least!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|7:
Perhaps you could give us a few details {E108:0010}about how
exactly you confirmed that the president was dead?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002185|8: Well, {E108:0010}I couldn't tell just from standing there...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400218E|0: How did you confirm that he was no longer breathing?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400218E|1:
They taught us how at school.{E108:0010} You put your cheek
next to the person's nose.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400218E|2:
If they're breathing, you can feel it.{E108:0010} Never thought
I'd actually have to do it in real life...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400218E|3:
I mean, it's good that they teach them this stuff,
but yeah,{E108:0008} {E1D1}it takes guts to do it for real.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400218E|4: Not bad...{E108:0010} {E12F:00020003}{E285}for an elementary school kid.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400218E|5:
He's in junior high, Kay.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00020004}Try to remember at least that much...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002194|0: Shaun,{E108:0010} would you mind looking at this?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002194|2:
Heh.{E108:0010} Don't think for a second that your bratty
behavior will wash with me.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002194|3:
I'm not being bratty.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}{E12F:00190003}It's just obvious that would
be a waste of my time.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002194|5:
Is a kid really getting the better of you,{E108:0010}
Mr. Prosecutor?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|04002194|6:
Heh.{E108:0010} Not for long.{E108:0010} Watch as I present him with
a piece of genuinely relevant evidence.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400219B|0:
I'm sorry, Shaun, {E108:0010}but there's a clear contradiction
in your statement.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400219B|2: I hate to overwhelm you with such shocking truths.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400219B|3:
I have literally no idea what you're talking about,{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}old man.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400219B|4:
Mngyrk!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(I fear I might be the one who's overwhelmed...)
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400219B|5:
Come on, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}He's only a little kid!{E108:0010}
How come he's getting to you so badly?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400219B|7: He just...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000009}needs to be sternly disciplined, is all.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|0400219B|8:
Or maybe you should go easy on him, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
Everything in moderation and all that...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021A4|0:
Admit it, Shaun.{E108:0010} You're mistaken.{E108:0010}
There's no shame in owning up to that.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021A4|2: Stop drinking milk and listen to me!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021A4|3:
Or do they teach children to drink and listen at
the same time nowadays!?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021A4|4: ...Oh, wait.{E108:0010} Were you talking to me, old man?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021A4|6:
Sorry, Mr. Edgeworth, {E108:0010}but I think Shaun might
be messing with you.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021A4|7:
Then I need to teach him a lesson about what
happens to children who "mess with" adults.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021A4|8:
But first, I'll stun him into silence with a piece
of evidence he can't possibly ignore.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|0: Nothing on his clothes?{E108:0010} Nothing at all?
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|2:
There's something you're clearly hoping that
we've forgotten.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|3:
Wh-What {E108:0010}{E282}are you talking about!?{E108:0018}
There isn't!{E108:0010} That's not true!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|4: Unluckily for you, we remember it rather well.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|5:
I'm talking, of course, {E108:0008}{E285}about the {E108:0006}{E1CB:00C800020000}{E041}yellow speckles{E040}{E108:0006}
on the president's chest.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|7:
You've studiously avoided mentioning them
throughout your testimony.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|8: An absence I find suspicious {E108:0008}{E107:0001}{E1D2}to say the least!
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|10:
I hope for your sake that you have a
satisfactory explanation.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|15: The yellow residue on the president's chest...
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|16:
...I imagine it was from a bouquet of flowers.{E108:0010}
{E285}{E041}Lion lilies{E040}, to be precise.
sce4_c2_06.bytes|040021AD|18:
Two nights ago, when I met the president on
the roof of the Bigg Building...
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|1: They're a type of lily with large, yellow petals.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|2:
I imagine that the substance on President Wang's
chest was pollen from those flowers.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|4:
They're not there in the printout from the
security camera.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|5: Only because the president is in the way.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|7: That...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}is not something I am at liberty to divulge.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|9:
First you wouldn't tell us why you met with him, and{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}now you can't even tell us about the flowers?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|10:
...My sincerest apologies.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00080000}But all I can tell you is that
I gave him the bouquet.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|11:
A bouquet that was nowhere near the body when
it was discovered.{E108:0010} How do you explain that?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|14:
Some things you won't explain, the rest you can't!{E108:0010}
Come on --{E108:0008} you've got to give us something here!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|15:
You wouldn't let this fly in the courtroom.{E108:0008}
What makes you think we'll accept it?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|19:
You did?{E108:0018} So they were there when you first
found the body?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|20: ...Yeah.{E108:0010} They were right there on his chest.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|21: And they were squashed completely flat.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|22:
Oh?{E108:0018} I guess that makes sense, right?{E108:0018} They would
have gotten crushed along with the president...
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|23:
And the pollen would have been smeared across his
jacket front.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}That does explain things rather neatly...
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|24: But why remove the bouquet and dispose of it?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|26: (He's almost as evasive as his mother...)
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|27: More secrets?{E108:0010} They're quite a pair...
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|29: I know exactly why Shaun disposed of the bouquet.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|31: You saw me leave the house with it, didn't you?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|34:
When you saw the flowers on the president's body,{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}you remembered seeing your mom with them!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|35:
...And felt the need to prevent her from coming
under suspicion.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|38:
Bouquet data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E182:00C800C9}{E1CE:00C9}{E100:0000}{E101:FFFF003F}{E107:0003}{E042}President Wang's Autopsy Report data updated
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E111:000000010004000100000002}{E112:0000}{E108:001E}{E123:0008000000070001}{E124:0000}{E100:0000}{E101:00080009}{E107:0002}I often decorate our home with lion lilies.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|39: I imagine that's why he remembered.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|40:
So the flowers his mother was {E108:000C}{E107:0003}carrying showed
up on the president's body.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|41:
And because of that, he got rid of the bouquet and
kept quiet about having discovered the corpse?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|42:
Heh!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}Well that ties everything up nicely, doesn't it?{E108:0010}
A little too nicely for my tastes.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|45:
The kid also told us that he was responsible for
the head falling in the first place.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|47: So he's still our only suspect!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|48:
(Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}The finger of suspicion still seems to
be pointing firmly in Shaun's direction.{E108:0008} However...)
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|50: I can think of a far more likely culprit than the boy!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002202|52:
The person who was holding Shaun captive until only
a short while ago!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|0:
That's right!{E108:0010} We had to rescue him from a warehouse
refrigeration unit down by the harbor!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|1: A refrigeration unit in a depot?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|3:
Lucky it wasn't switched on.{E108:0010}
Poor kid mighta frozen into a popsicle otherwise.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|4:
He was doing his best to call out for help,{E108:0008} {E1D1}which is
how we found him!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|5:
The sedatives had worn off by then, so he
was wide awake and plenty loud!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|6: Sedatives...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000008}Isn't that what you were given, too?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|7: Yup!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}{E12F:00020002}We found the bottle on the floor of the unit!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|8: It was even the same brand!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|10:
Sedative data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E100:0000}{E12F:0000000B}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}Well, {E108:0010}Agent Lang?{E108:0018} Surely that suggests that
Shaun is a victim, not a suspect?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|11:
Somebody else was responsible!{E108:0010}
And I think {E108:000C}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E041}they've been behind all of this{E040}!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|12:
Oh, yeah?{E108:0010} And this {E041}secret mastermind{E040}
of yours was here last night, too?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|14: Ha!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}It's not like you to be so vague, {E108:0018}{E107:0001}{E1D1}Mr. Prosecutor!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|15:
(...Sadly, we just don't have anything to tie our
mysterious kidnapper to the murder of the president.)
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|17:
(Somebody other than Shaun {E108:000C}{E1D1}who could have
committed the murder...?)
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|19: ...So I was right.{E108:0010} The kid is still our only suspect.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|20: Not quite.{E108:0010} I can think of another.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|22:
Somebody who we just recently proved{E108:0010}{E106}{E1E6:0000}{E101:00000000}
{E107:0001}{E188:00200000}{E1DA}was right here on the movie set last night!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|24: Why not?{E108:0010} We've proven that he was present.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|25:
And if he was here, he's as viable a suspect 
as anybody else, wouldn't you say?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|27: It's certainly another possibility to consider.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|32:
My father and the president being friends...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Our family being the ones who kept him safe...
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|33: Lang...{E108:0020} Like the Lang from...{E108:0010} {E1D1}twelve years ago...?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|34:
Yup.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Good to see that you're finally about to pay
for your crimes.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|35:
Even if it did take a while for you to get what was
coming to you.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|36: Agent Lang --{E108:0020} {E107:0002}what happened twelve years ago?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|38:
I think it has everything to do with me.{E108:0010} It's clearly
connected to this case!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|39: ...Heh.{E108:0020} {E12F:00070004}And you can prove that, can you?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|40:
Go ahead --{E108:0008} show me some proof that what happened{E108:0008}
{E1D1}twelve years ago has anything to do with this!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002239|42: If you can't prove it, this conversation's over.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002266|2: Lang Zi {E108:000C}says: {E901}{E283}{E107:0002}"The sun sets quickly in Zheng Fa."
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002266|3:
Which means we don't have time to deal with
meaningless trivialities!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002266|4:
Oof!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(That had nothing to do with anything...)
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002266|5:
Come on!{E108:0010} We have to take a look back
over all the evidence we've gathered!
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002266|6:
Haven't we seen something about twelve 
years ago written down somewhere?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002266|7:
Well, Mr. Prosecutor?{E108:0018} Ready to admit that you
have nothing?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400226F|0:
This letter was sent to Rosie Ringer, the victim of
a murder that happened the night before last.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400226F|1: We don't know who sent it...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}but it does say this:
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400226F|2:
"{E041}Good luck getting your revenge for what
happened twelve years ago!{E040}"
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400226F|4: And that's not all.{E108:0010} Take a look at this...
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400226F|5:
It's a report about Bronco Knight written by Warden
Laguarde.{E108:0010} It was addressed to Chairman Winner.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400226F|6: This last part in particular should be of interest to you.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400226F|7:
"...retrieve the package we laid to rest twelve years
ago...{E108:0010} {E284}{E041}in front of the planter{E040}"...?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002277|0:
This is a report about Bronco Knight.{E108:0010} It was sent
to Chairman Winner by Warden Laguarde.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002277|1: This last part in particular should be of interest to you.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002277|2:
"...retrieve the package we laid to rest twelve years

sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002277|3: And that's not all.{E108:0010} Take a look at this...
sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002277|4:
This letter was sent to Rosie Ringer, the victim of
a murder that happened the night before last.

sce4_c2_07.bytes|04002277|6:
"{E041}Good luck getting your revenge for what
happened twelve years ago!{E040}"
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400227F|0: Something strange is going on, {E108:0018}{E107:0003}Agent Lang.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400227F|1:
Ms. Ringer was murdered the night before last,{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}and President Wang not long afterward.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400227F|2:
There's a connection between the two murders.{E108:0010}
There has to be.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400227F|3:
And I believe we can trace that connection to events
twelve years in the past.{E108:0010} Am I wrong?
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400227F|4:
...These are old wounds you're opening here.{E108:0010}
Insults to my family name.
sce4_c2_07.bytes|0400227F|5: Please, Agent Lang.{E108:0010} We need to know.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|2:
H-Huh!?{E108:0020}
What are you all doing here!?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|3: We came to find you, sir!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|4:
We heard you were looking into the incident
from twelve years ago...
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|6:
I'm not your boss anymore!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}Get back to your duties right now!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|8: What!?{E108:0018} You're disobeying a direct order!?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|9: Please, sir!{E108:0020} I'm begging you!{E108:0010} We all are!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|10:
You have to reopen the investigation into the{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E041}SS-5 Incident{E040}!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|11:
We know you can't let it go until you've figured out
what happened!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}And we can't either!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|13:
Well, Agent Lang.{E108:0010} It seems your former underlings
want the events of the past explained, too.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|14:
You think it's that easy?{E108:0018} That you could solve the
case just like that?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|18: Nice!{E108:0020} {E107:0001}{E12F:00020008}{E280}Then I guess {E108:0008}{E1D1}it's my turn to step up!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|20:
You're looking into a case from the past, right?{E108:0018}
I just happen to have something that'll help with that!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|22:
Sure do!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}If you can give me the details of the incident,{E108:000C}
{E107:0001}I can rustle up a little simulation for you!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|23: Sadly...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E176:00010000}{E284}we don't have the files relating to the case.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|25:
Access to those files is restricted.{E108:0020}
They're top secret.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|27: Beats me.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Somebody must have something to hide.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|29:
Everything I know, I read in newspaper articles
{E1D1}from the time.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|30: That's fine.{E108:0018} {E12F:0000000B}Just tell us what you can.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|33:
...happened on a winter's day twelve years ago.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}February tenth, to be precise.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|34:
Your police received a call directly from the
kidnapper.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|35: "{E041}I've got the president of Zheng Fa.{E040}"
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|37:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E041}SS-5{E040} is the official designation of
the president's kidnapping case.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|38: The kidnapper wanted {E108:0010}{E107:0004}{E285}{E041}a hundred million dollars{E040}.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|39: A hundred million!?{E108:0020} {E107:0002}{E12F:00020002}{E1D1}...How much money even is that!?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|40: (More than you can imagine, it seems...)
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|41:
The last person to see the president that night
was my father.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|42:
They were together at the embassy of Zheng Fa
until midnight on the tenth.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|43:
And nobody knows what happened with the president
after that until he was kidnapped.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|44:
Our government did {E108:0008}{E1D9}{E107:0001}everything they could to scrape
together the money.{E108:0028} {E107:0002}They were desperate to save him.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|45:
And in the end, they succeeded.{E108:0010}{E112:000E} {E107:0003}The money was
handed over, and the president came home safely.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|46:
So President Wang was head honcho, even back then?{E108:0018}
{E12F:00020004}{E1D9}Wow!{E108:0010} Go, Mr. President!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|47:
Heh.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00070004}The length of time he stayed in power isn't
even close to the most impressive thing about him.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|48:
(Agent Lang was clearly very fond of
President Wang...)
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|49: I assume the kidnapping was thoroughly investigated?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|50:
It was.{E108:0010} But the investigation was top secret.{E108:0010}
As was the trial.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|52: Yeah.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D5}None other than our friend {E108:0010}{E107:0002}{E282}{E041}Fifi Laguarde{E040}.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|54: Is that why you visited the prison...?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|55:
It is.{E108:0020} I was put on what you might call extended
leave from Interpol.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|56:
So I thought I'd use the time to look into what
happened twelve years back.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|57: And I wanted to see who I was dealing with.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|58: She was found not guilty then, wasn't she?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|60:
My father was in charge of the president's
security at the time.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|61:
But they held him responsible for the kidnapping, and{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}stripped him of his duties as presidential bodyguard.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|62:
He stayed on the force, though.{E108:0010} And he worked the
case alone.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E282}...Until eventually he found a suspect.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|63:
Laguarde{E040}.{E108:0018} And if he thought she did it,{E108:0008}
{E107:0001}{E12F:00070001}{E280}there's no way she was innocent!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|64:
But they declared her not guilty, {E108:0020}and the case
went cold.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|65:
My father couldn't take it.{E108:0010} He was broken, mentally
and physically.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}...Finally, he quit the force altogether.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|66: So he had solid grounds to suspect Warden Laguarde?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|67:
He must have had evidence.{E108:0010} He wouldn't have
charged her otherwise.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|68:
But I've never been able to see the materials
from the case.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|69: I'm sorry...{E108:0010} {E107:0004}{E1D1}but that's all I know.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|70:
What do we do, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}This is useful information, but...
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|71:
...I don't think it's enough for {E041}Little Thief{E040} {E108:0008}{E1D2}{E188:00310000}{E107:0001}to recreate
the scene.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|04002302|72: (Nnrgh...{E108:0020} {E107:0003}Is there really nothing we can do...?)
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|0: You look like you could use a hand.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|4:
We finally wrapped things up over at the courthouse,
so we thought we'd see what you kids were up to.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|8:
SS-5 Incident Case File data jotted down
in my Organizer.{E040}{E106}{E1CF}{E111:000400010002000000000002}{E112:0004}{E100:0000}{E101:00040004}{E107:0002}When Fifi Laguarde mentioned an incident from
twelve years ago earlier,{E108:0008} I couldn't help but wonder.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|9:
So I decided to look into it.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}And this was what Interpol provided.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|12: You're no longer a prosecutor.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}I didn't do this for you.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|13:
I did it so that a colleague could solve his father's
final case.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|15:
But...{E108:0008} everything related to the SS-5 Incident was
supposed to be top secret...
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|16:
Yes.{E108:0010} But that classification was applied by the
prosecutor in charge of the case,{E108:000C} {E176:00010000}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E041}Excelsius Winner{E040}.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|17: HE was the prosecutor in charge!?
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|20:
Due to the outcome of this morning's case, he's been
stripped of his authority.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|21:
An outcome that was in no small part thanks to{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}the efforts of his own son.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|23:
(So in defeating his father, he made the old case file
available to us?{E108:0010} It sounds like we owe him...)
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|24:
Prosecutor Eustace Winner is busy wrapping things up
after the conclusion of the Laguarde trial.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|25: But he asked me to give you a message.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|27: "You focus on your case over there."
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|28: Heh.{E108:0018} {E12F:0000000B}He's even starting to sound like a prosecutor.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|31:
Now that we have the case file, {E108:0018}I can recreate the
scene no problem!
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|34:
...the incident occurred exactly {E108:0008}{E285}where the plaza
is now.
sce4_c2_08.bytes|0400234B|35:
Then what are we waiting for?{E108:0010}
{E280}With me, everybody!
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|1: Alright, Kay.{E108:0010} If you could set Mr. Thief in motion...
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|2:
Sure!{E108:0020} Looks like there's more than enough here{E108:000C}
{E1D1}to work with!
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|3: Where do you want to start?
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|5: It seems there was an eyewitness.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|6: A freelance journalist by the name of Alf Aldown.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|8:
...he was killed by the culprit for witnessing
the kidnapping.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|9: So {E285}{E041}this{E040} is where he saw it all happen, huh.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|11:
No.{E108:0010} Construction of the Bigg Building only began
a year ago.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|12:
Before that, it had been a piece of abandoned
property.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|14: Heh!{E108:0010} Now we're getting to the stuff I know.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|16: Twelve years ago, this place would have been...
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|19: No, it was a place for children without parents.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|22: Yeah.{E108:0010} And the place was run by {E108:000C}{E1D1}{E188:00340000}Fifi Laguarde.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|23: She called it her {E108:0008}{E284}"{E041}happy little home{E040}".
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|25:
As the proprietor of the institution, I suppose it's
understandable that she came under suspicion.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|27:
(Surely the SS-5 Incident MUST be related to our
current case...)
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|28:
Kay, {E108:0010}could you enter the data relating to the
murder of Mr. Aldown?
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|29:
It seems sensible to assume that he was killed by
whoever kidnapped the president.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|30:
So if we solve the murder, we solve the kidnapping!{E108:0010}
Nice!
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|33:
(When did I grow to become so blasé towards
people's reactions to Mr. Thief...?)
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|34:
What we're seeing here is the front yard of
the orphanage as it was twelve years ago.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|35: At least, as far as the police reports describe it.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|36:
Yeah!{E108:0010} This is how it looked when they started
investigating at 7 AM the morning after the murder!
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|37: ...And it seems it had been snowing.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|38:
Yeah.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}From what I heard, the footprints wound up
being pretty important evidence.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|39: The snow fell in the daytime the previous day.
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|41:
(Meaning that none of the relevant footprints would
have been obscured by new snow.)
sce4_c2_09.bytes|04002402|42:
(I think we'll need to pay these footprints some
special attention...)
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|0:
I think that's about all we can learn from the
scene for now.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|1:
Alright!{E108:0020} {E150:0002001D}How about I try to show you how things
looked earlier on that night?
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|3:
Could you take us back to the moment at which
the victim witnessed the kidnapping?
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|4:
Sure!{E108:0020} I'll use the photograph he took.{E108:0010}
Here goes nothing!
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|5: There's Mr. Aldown in the middle of the planters.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|6:
And there's the president and his kidnapper
out by the road.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|7:
My father based his investigation on the evidence
Aldown provided.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|8:
That was why he thought the kidnapping and the
orphanage were connected somehow.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|9:
And how he wound up suspecting Fifi Laguarde --{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}she was the one running the orphanage at the time.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|11:
But when the case went to trial, Excelsius Winner
put a big hole in that theory.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|13:
Yeah.{E108:0010} After all, the president and the kidnapper 
weren't actually on the grounds of the orphanage.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|14:
So it was hard to conclusively prove any 
kind of connection.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|15:
Huh...{E108:0010} So they were never seen inside
the gates of the orphanage...
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|16:
Tch!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Detectives bust a gut to find evidence
on the scene...
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|17:
And then prosecutors come along and twist it
for their own ends!
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|18: Winner and Laguarde were working together.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|19:
They had some kind of deal.{E108:0018}
I'm sure of it.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|20:
So you're saying that {E108:000C}{E107:0003}{E043}Chairman Winner was
working with the kidnapper{E040}?{E106}{E198:00040017}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E113:000200000002}{E112:0002}{E111:000000010000000000000002}{E112:0000}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0003}Your father was convinced that Laguarde was the
culprit, correct?
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|21:
And you say he was a gifted and
thorough investigator.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|22:
Then he must have had more to support his theory
than just Mr. Aldown's message, surely?
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|23: Yeah.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}He must have.{E108:0010} I just don't know what it was.
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|24: It wasn't exactly a case he liked talking about...
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|26: (Trusted ally and confidant of President Wang.)
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|27:
(He discovered {E041}truths{E042} that were subsequently
suppressed by Chairman Winner.)
sce4_c2_0a.bytes|04002482|28: (Our first priority should be to find out what they were!)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|1:
I brought everything the police had on the fire!{E108:0010} And
I also brought the picture from your father's office!
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|3:
(Let's take a look at this mysterious picture,
shall we...?)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|4: This is it!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}This is the picture I remember!
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|5:
...Could this be a depiction of something that
happened on the night of the incident?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|6: It sure looks like a kid drew it, huh?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|7:
Yes...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}and I'm willing to bet it's the work of the child
who set the fire.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|9:
What now?{E108:0018} Look, it'll have to wait, okay?{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E150:00070029}Well, Mr. Prosecutor...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|10: Why do you think my father kept this?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|11:
I imagine he acquired it at some point during
his investigation.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|12:
Although I have no idea why he would have
chosen to keep it to himself...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|13: Could we see the case file for the fire, too?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|15: If you'll just give me a moment to read through it...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|16:
It seems the boy who started the fire snuck out
of bed on the evening of the incident.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|17: Hm?{E108:0020} And then disappeared several days later.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|18:
What?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Must have been because he saw
something, right?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|22:
Looks like the kid left something behind that
was put into evidence.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|24:
Th-That's...!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(But what's it doing in that case file?)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|25:
What is it, {E108:0010}Mr. Prosecutor?{E108:0020} Have you seen this
somewhere before?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002502|26:
Something very much like it, {E108:0010}yes.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}We have a piece
of evidence that could well be connected.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|0400251F|0:
Which item of evidence relates to the item
the boy left behind?{E040}{E106}{E163:00010000}{E100:0001}{E164:00CF0002}{E100:0001}{E113:000000000002}{E112:0000}{E111:000700040002000100000002}{E112:0007}{E100:0000}{E101:00070007}{E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}You're trying to tell me that has something
to do with this thing here?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|0400251F|1: Yes.{E108:0010} I'm almost certain of it.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|0400251F|3: Lang Zi says:{E108:0018} {E901}{E107:0003}{E283}"Cream puffs and soy sauce".
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|0400251F|4: That item and the boy's don't go together either!
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|0400251F|5:
...Gnrrrk!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(I must have made a mistake somewhere.)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|0400251F|6:
(One of the pieces of evidence we've collected
has a part that looks just like this.)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|0400251F|7:
(I should probably go over everything one
more time...)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|0400251F|8:
Well, Mr. Prosecutor?{E108:0010} Do you have some relevant
evidence or not?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|0:
I don't know what it was doing in the evidence
for that case...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|1:
...but it looks like that might be {E108:0008}{E285}the missing
horn from this soft toy.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|4: Of course.{E108:0010} He always kept it somewhere close by.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|5: I remember it because of the missing piece.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|6:
I see.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It has a special device inside it that plays
recorded sound when you twist the horn.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|7:
Hey,{E108:0008} do you think maybe putting the horn back{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E12F:00020008}{E188:00340000}{E1DA}on might unlock more recordings?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|8:
Heh...{E108:0018} You never know.{E108:0010} The toy itself should still be
up on the fifty-first floor.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|10: Yes, Shifu!{E108:0018} I'll go fetch it right away!
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|11:
Here it is, Shifu!{E108:0018} The Taurusaurus doll,
just like you asked!
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|12: Good work.{E108:0010} Hand it to the prosecutor over there.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|13:
(Well?{E108:0010} Does the horn found at the orphanage
fit the president's plushie...?)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|16:
...Hi, Di-Jun.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Sorry --{E108:0008} President Wang.
It's me.{E108:0010} Amelie.{E108:0010} I know it's been a while...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|17:
I...{E108:0008} saw on the news that you were visiting
the country soon.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|18:
And I didn't know whether I should get in touch
at all, but...{E108:0008} in the end I decided I had to.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|23:
You see, I...{E108:0008} I had a baby.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}A beautiful little boy.{E108:0010}
...Your beautiful little boy.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|24:
I'm sorry, that's...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}That's pretty much all
I wanted to tell you...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|25:
Oh, except...{E108:0010} I called him {E108:0008}Shaun.{E108:0018} {E107:0004}"Shaun Fenn"...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}It has a nice ring to it, don't you think?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|29:
And...{E108:0008} also that...{E108:0010} I'll be at the orphanage on the
evening of the ninth.{E108:0010} I'll be waiting in the front yard.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|30:
I thought...{E108:0008} you could meet him if you like.{E108:0010}
Even if it's only just this once...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|31:
I know you're...{E108:0008} a very busy man, but...{E108:0010}
{E107:0004}Anyway, that's where we'll be...{E108:0010} Goodbye.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|34: Care to explain what the heck is going on, {E108:0018}{E107:0003}Gavèlle?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|37: And he was aware of this?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|39:
His mother.{E108:0010} {E107:0004}Amelie --{E108:0008} Amelie Fenn...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}She died five years ago.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|41:
But we were also friends.{E108:0010} The best of friends.{E108:0010}
People often mistook us for sisters.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|43:
...it seemed only natural that Shaun should
come and live with me.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|44:
Of course...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}we had to keep his father's
identity secret...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|45:
And I decided that the best way to do that...{E108:0008}
would be for him never to know in the first place...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|47:
(That's quite a lot to learn from a recording made{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}on a seemingly innocent toy...)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|48:
(I guess Shaun's mother must have recorded the
message and then sent the plushie to the president...)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|53:
Before you were born, {E108:0010}your mother worked for a
time as a diplomat in Zheng Fa.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|54:
(Makes sense.{E108:0010} That line of work might well have
brought her into contact with the president...)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|55: What!?{E108:0010} You told me {E108:0008}{E107:0001}{E188:00310000}{E1D2}she worked at the orphanage!
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|56:
She did.{E108:0010} But only after she returned.{E108:0010}
After she quit the diplomatic service.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|57:
She always loved helping others.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}The orphanage was perfect for her.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|59: Sorry, Judge Gavèlle...{E108:0010} but I have to ask...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|60: Amelie --{E108:0008} the lady who asked the president to come...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|61:
Why didn't she show up herself!?{E108:0010} {E1D2}Why isn't she
anywhere in the files related to the {E041}SS-5 Incident{E040}?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|62:
She...{E108:0010} {E284}never made it to the rendezvous that night.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Someone was tailing her...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|63:
I'll bet that was {E108:0008}{E107:0003}Chairman Winner's doing.{E108:0020}
Though sadly we can't prove it...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|64:
And...{E108:0008} because she couldn't make it...{E108:0008} she never
saw the president again...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|65:
(Then she died five years ago.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}This can't be easy for Shaun...)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|67:
My treat, okay?{E108:0010} C'mon, I think I saw a vending
machine over--
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|68:
You think {E1D1}I can't buy myself a soda?{E108:0010}
{E1D9}This is important.{E108:0018} And it's about me.{E108:0010} I'm staying.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|70:
...Shaun.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Perhaps now you can guess why I
met with the president two nights ago.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|71: (So that's it!{E108:0010} That was the big secret!)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|72:
I wanted to tell him face to face.{E108:0020}
{E107:0002}That Amelie was...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}gone...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|73:
But also that you were alive and well.{E108:0010}
More than well...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|75:
It makes sense now.{E108:0010} No wonder Judge Gavèlle was so
keen to avoid sharing the details of their meeting.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|76:
Yeah...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}She would have had to share the truth
about Shaun, too...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|77: That was why I took the {E041}lion lilies{E040} with me.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002529|78:
So there would be no doubt that I knew Amelie --{E108:0008}
{E107:0002}and that I knew her well.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|0:
These flowers bore a special significance for
the two of them, you see.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|1:
President Wang gave Amelie a bouquet of lion lilies{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}in the early days of their romance.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|2: But now...{E108:000C} he, too, is dead...{E108:0018} {E107:0003}If only he had lived...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|3:
Shaun might finally have been able to get to
know him...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|6: I've been waiting {E108:0008}{E107:0002}for the right time to say this, but...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|7:
WHAT!?{E108:0010} What is it!?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}You've been hovering there
this whole time!{E108:0010} Can't it wait!?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|8:
They...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}They sent something else from
Zheng Fa...
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|12:
He gave my father medal after medal.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}They had to
come up with new ones just for him.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|13:
In the end there were no medals left to give.{E108:0010} {E1D1}So he
made us the keepers of his last will and testament.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|14:
Those medals?{E108:0008} That duty?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}They're our greatest
pride.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Our family jewels.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|17:
What is it, Agent Lang?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Does it have anything to{E108:0008}
{E107:0002}do with our current case?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|18:
You could say that.{E108:0028} {E107:0003}Seems he was planning on{E108:0010}
{E283}{E12F:00070001}publicly {E041}acknowledging Shaun as his son{E040}.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|19: Sh-Shaun's name appears {E108:0008}{E107:0003}{E1D1}in the president's will...?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|20:
And we're certain that the document is authentic?{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D9}That President Wang wrote it himself?
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|21:
Sure we are.{E108:0010} It's old, but it's real.{E108:0010} My family took
charge of it back before the {E041}SS-5 Incident{E040} happened.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|22:
They'll want to analyze it back home to be sure, but I'd{E108:0008}{E12F:00070008}
{E107:0003}stake my name on it {E108:0008}{E1D9}being the genuine article.
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|23:
(Wang was a renowned world leader.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}A child nobody
knew about would have been sure to cause a stir.)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|24:
(And yet he chose to mention the child in his
will nonetheless.)
sce4_c2_0b.bytes|04002578|25:
Well that's that, I guess.{E108:0028} {E12F:00070001}{E107:0003}I still can't quite believe it,
but...{E108:0008} {E1D1}the president confirmed it with his own hand...

Brighter socks would have really made that

The crimes committed in the incident at the

To sin so gravely in full view of the Goddess is{E108:0008}

I cannot thank you all enough for returning{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Shaun safely to me.

Bah...{E108:0018} {E107:0003}The old candy gambit usually works like

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028CE|3:

Shaun.{E108:0010} I wonder if you could tell us a little more

They took you when you went to the garbage

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028DF|4:
I went to the garbage disposal to throw away

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028DF|5:

I tried to get in there last night, too.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}But it was locked.

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028DF|10:

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028DF|11:

{E107:0003}But...{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}I never saw their face...

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028EC|2:

(And that's where Kay and Detective Gumshoe

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028EC|6:

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028EC|7: Anyway, they didn't take my phone for some reason.
sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028EC|8: So I used that to call for help.
sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028EC|9:
I see.{E108:0018} {E12F:0000000B}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Well, we're all very glad that you found

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028EC|11: (...Hmph.{E108:0010} He's not the most gracious child I've met.)

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028F9|0: Shifu.{E108:0018} I know it's rude of me to ask, but...
sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028F9|1:

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028F9|7:

Fool!{E108:0010} It shouldn't matter if there's one of you

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028F9|9:
You may be on your own here right now, {E108:000C}{E156:0007002A00430000}but the pack

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|040028F9|10:
So quit whining about being lonely, {E108:000C}{E1D2}and howl

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|0400290A|0:
How DARE you, Scruffy!{E108:0020} {E107:0002}Don't you DARE tell

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|0400290A|1:
Eeek!{E108:0018} Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}Y-You gotta help me out here, sir!
sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|0400290A|3:
It's about the {E041}SS-5 Incident{E040}!{E108:0018}
What else!?
sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|0400290A|4:
I know Chairman Winner isn't in charge anymore

...but a top secret file being available to us so quickly

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|0400290A|6:
So that got me to thinking and I put in a call,

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|0400290A|7:
Well, that Ms. von Karma went to some{E108:000C} {E107:0003}pretty

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|0400290A|10:
(...It sounds like you went to a lot of trouble for
our sake, Franziska.)
sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|0400290A|11:
(Don't worry.{E108:0010} Your efforts won't be for nothing.{E108:0010}

Boy howdy, is this ever a scoop!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E1D1}Whole world's

They must be real sick if even their

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|04002916|3:
Looks like we wound up slap-bang in the middle o'{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E282}the right dang place at the right dang time!

...I don't think we're going to get a word in edgewise

sce4_c2_m15_00_npc.bytes|04002916|6: (And I don't think we want to...)

The president's double knew that his employer

But in order to find her, he needed to enlist the
help of locals.

Once Ms. Fenn had been located, they simply
needed to find the right time to lay their trap.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|23:
The meeting she arranged so the president could meet

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|24:
Indeed.{E108:0010} And with the head of the orphanage brought

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|26: Now, {E108:0010}{E107:0002}quid pro quo --{E108:0008} where might I find the pup?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|27:
What makes you think the boy who helped you and{E108:0010}
{E284}our {E041}mysterious string-puller{E040} are one and the same?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|28:
...He set a little fire that night.{E108:0010} Out there in the

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|29:
Oh!{E108:0018} Yeah, we saw that!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}It was some kind of a

No, as I understand it, {E108:0008}{E107:0003}he had taken refuge{E108:000C}
in the igloo by the entrance.

From there, he happened to see Winner

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|33:
He also overheard them hatching a certain

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|34:
A plot to remove me --{E108:0008} the only other person who

Thankfully, he was kind enough to come and inform

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|36: He also happened to mention later on...
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|37: ...that he was wearing his favorite {E284}{E041}red raincoat{E040}.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|38: In any case, he escorted me from the premises.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|40:
...thought to erase both our footprints from
the scene of the crime.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|41:
It seems he had a little kerosene set aside in
the igloo for just such an occasion.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|42:
So he spread it liberally about the place...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E280}and set himself a little fire.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|43: No way!{E108:0020} So THAT's what the fire was for!
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|44:
It must have been ever so beautiful.{E108:0010}
Winner and Laguarde were positively enchanted.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|45:
And while they were distracted by the show, {E108:000C}{E107:0003}he took
the opportunity to usher me out of a side entrance.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F02|46:
You never answered my question.{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}{E1D5}You really
think he's {E041}the one behind all this{E040}?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F33|0:
As you have surmised, it was I who killed
President Wang.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F34|0:
But that meant that I, too, became an
inconvenience in need of removal.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F35|0:
The impostor president, Winner, Laguarde -- all
three were keen to... guarantee my silence.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F36|0:
And if I hadn't met my friend the young pup again,
they might even have succeeded.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F37|0: I wonder what he's doing now...
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F38|0:
Sounds like kind of an interesting relationship
Mr. Kanis has with his "young pup", huh?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F38|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} I wonder if something in it might hold the key

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F38|2:
I doubt we'll meet many other people {E108:0008}{E107:0002}with a direct

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F38|3: Let's see what we can convince him to share...
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|0:
You were pretty forthcoming with that
particular admission.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|1:
If I'm honest, Mr. Edgeworth, I'm tired of all
the killing.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}{E12F:00120004}{E1D1}Keh heh heh.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|2:
But back then, I felt that death was my path.{E108:0010}

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|3:
I have made my peace with that.{E108:0010} And I am happy

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|4:
I'm not sure what he's talking about, {E108:000C}{E107:0001}{E12F:00020001}{E280}but I definitely

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|5:
Basically, {E108:0008}{E107:0003}he thought nothing of murdering

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|6:
(And not only is he an assassin, he's now a prison
escapee.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Not someone to be trifled with.)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|7:
(But we can't afford for him not to talk.{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}I'll need

Very well.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}You killed the president.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000001}And you're

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F3C|9:
Oh, very much so.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}I wouldn't want you thinking

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F46|0: You, a target?{E108:0018} But you're an assassin.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F46|1:
Sometimes the hunter {E108:0008}{E107:0003}must become the hunted.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00020003}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Sometimes the living must become the dead.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F46|2:
Please, Kay.{E108:0010} Don't feel the need to add a
proverb of your own.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F46|3:
...Impermanence is inherent to the way of the

Wait, does that mean the people you're sent to kill

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F46|5:
It happens.{E108:0010} Occasionally.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00120000}But it is not what happened this time.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F4C|0:
But Mr. Kanis,{E108:0008} {E107:0002}you're a professional killer.{E108:0010}
And a famously skilled one, at that.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F4C|1:
Surely escaping even three attackers would have
been little more than a minor inconvenience?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F4C|2: Keh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}You overestimate me, Mr. Edgeworth.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F4C|3:
You seem to forget that without Helmut here,{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}I couldn't even walk down the street.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F4C|4:
Against three assailants, I wouldn't have lasted
more than a few moments.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F4C|5:
I see.{E108:0010} So even the most proficient assassins are
ill-equipped to face a full frontal assault?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F4C|6:
We're...{E108:0008} not hugely fond of such situations, shall we
say?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00120004}{E1D1}I certainly wouldn't have liked my chances.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|0: "Again"?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}So the two of you had met before?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|1:
Yes.{E108:0010} On a cold and lonely {E108:0008}{E1D5}{E041}Christmas Eve
eighteen years back{E040}.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|3: But on that occasion, {E108:0018}{E12F:00120004}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E173:0000}it was I who saved his life.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|4:
It was snowing --{E108:0008} more than it had in years --{E108:0008} and cold
enough that death by freezing was a real possibility.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|5: I had taken Helmut out for a little walk.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|6:
He noticed something, {E108:0008}{E1D1}and bounded off through
the snow.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|7:
When I caught up to him, {E108:000C}{E107:0003}he was sniffing at
a car.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|8:
The doors had frozen shut.{E108:0010} It took all the strength I
had, but eventually I managed to open one.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|9:
And inside I found two young boys, {E108:0010}shivering
and semi-conscious.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|11:
Yes.{E108:0010} And had I found them even an hour later,
the poor wretches would never have made it.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|12: I took them both to a nearby orphanage...
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F53|13:
(Is it me, or is there something significant
about what he just told us...?)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F63|0: Is that why you're looking for him?{E108:0010} Surely not.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F63|1:
Don't tell me you're trying to find him just to say
thank you?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F63|2:
Keh heh heh.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Wouldn't you like to know?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F63|3:
I certainly owe him a debt of gratitude, {E108:000C}{E107:0002}I think we
can all agree on that.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F63|4:
And Helmut took a liking to the child.{E108:0008} He even did

Wait --{E108:0008} but your dog tricks are different from the

mouth around the subject's leg, and--
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F63|7:
Eeek!{E108:0014} I'm not listening, {E108:0014}I'm not listening!{E108:0020}
{E12F:00020001}{E1D1}That's enough, okay?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F63|8:
Keh heh heh.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}I'm teasing, of course.{E108:0010} The tricks he

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F63|9:
(...Huh.{E108:0010} I guess he really did feel that he owed

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|0: Mr. Kanis.{E108:0010} What do you make of this?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|1:
Of what, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}You do remember that

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|2:
But may I suggest that you simply put it away,

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|3:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Mmrgh.{E108:0010}
(Is he trying to tell me I picked the wrong thing?)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|4:
Of course, the question is, why did he get it out 
in the first place, Helmut, hm?{E108:0010} Hmmm?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|5:
Seems a little strange, doesn't it, boy?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Yesss.{E108:0010} Yes it doesss.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|6: Are you sure the guy's really blind, Mr. Prosecutor?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|7: (Well, I put it away already, so does it really matter...?)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F6D|8: (I have to think about this more carefully.)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F76|0:
Your statements clearly contradict one another,{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Mr. Kanis.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F76|1:
I don't think they do at all.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00120007}{E1D1}Do you, boy?{E108:0010} Hmm?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F76|2:
Hmm...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00120004}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Yes, Helmut thinks you're wrong, too,

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F76|3:
Gyurk!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(Even the dog is against me!)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F76|4:
Do you speak to your monster friends like he
does to that dog, Shaun?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F76|5: Heck no.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00190000}I'm nothing like that weird old man.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F76|6:
(We can worry about the dog later.{E108:0018}
I need to rethink my approach here...)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F7D|0:
Come, Mr. Kanis!{E108:0020} Even you must see the

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F7D|1:
There's really no need to raise your voice,

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F7D|2:
Although I do rather wish that I couldn't.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}{E1D5}Why embarrass yourself like this?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F7D|3:
...Grk!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}(It sounds like I was way off!)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F7D|4: You can't let the old guy beat you, sir!
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F7D|5: (He's not just any old man, Detective.)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F7D|6: (But I'll wear him down in the end, you'll see.)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F84|0:
(What is it about Kanis's statement that's especially 
noteworthy?)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F85|0:
This was on {E041}Christmas Eve eighteen years ago{E040}?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E12F:00000008}You're certain of that?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F88|0:
(We have something that shows {E108:0018}{E107:0002}{E1D1}why that date
is so significant...)
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F89|0: You're certain there were {E108:0018}{E107:0002}{E12F:00000008}{E1D1}two children in that car?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F89|1:
It was a long time ago, but I remember it as clearly

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F89|2: There were two of them.{E108:0010} No doubt about it.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F89|3:
Why do you ask, Mr. Prosecutor?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}Is there some

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F89|4:
(He's right.{E108:0010} Perhaps there isn't anything particularly

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F89|5: Well?{E108:0010} Will that be all on the matter?
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F8F|0:
Do you remember the make and model of the

It was a car like any other.{E108:0010}

Other than the two children {E108:0008}{E107:0002}inside it frozen half

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F8F|4:
(Hmm...{E108:0010} Maybe the make of car isn't important

Which piece of evidence relates to the date on

I must admit, I'm not entirely certain what that

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F95|3:
I would ask you not to test my patience,
Mr. Edgeworth...

sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F95|6:
Why not look back through the evidence and

That was the same day {E108:0010}{E107:0002}on which a certain incident
occurred --{E108:0018} the murder of a well-known sculptor.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F9D|2:
An incident in the aftermath of which two children

The son of the victim, Artie Frost, and the 
son of the murderer, Carmelo Gusto.
sce4_c3_03.bytes|04002F9D|4:
Yeah, now that you mention it, the little guys did
go AWOL, huh?
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|0:
Intriguing.{E108:0010} The son of a murderer, and the son of
his victim.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00120004}I suppose that would make sense.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|2: One of the boys was bound hand and foot, you see.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|3:
That must've been part of Mr. Frost's plan to stop

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|4:
Indeed.{E108:0010} Because without his son to taste his creations,

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|5: Keh heh heh.{E108:0018} {E107:0002}So that was what was behind it all.

Sadly, neither of the boys were able to remember

No.{E108:0010} When we met each other again on that night

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|9:
It seems that they really were on the brink of death{E108:0008}
{E107:0002}when I found them.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|10:
And the shock of the experience caused them both to

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|11: They weren't even able to remember their names.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|12:
Wow.{E108:0010} So they wouldn't have known they were

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|13:
If what he's telling us is true, that would seem
likely, yes.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|14:
(Which means we still don't have enough to tell us{E108:000C}
{E107:0003}who our {E041}mastermind{E042} might be...)
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|15:
Mr. Kanis --{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E12F:00000008}{E188:00300000}{E1D5}would you mind telling us what

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|18:
The pup and I remained in contact even after
I was sent to prison.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|19:
But then {E108:000C}{E188:002F0000}{E1D5}I stopped hearing from him.{E108:0010}
I couldn't help but worry.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|20:
And then people from twelve years ago started
cropping up all over the place.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|21:
It rather piqued my curiosity.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}So I thought I'd...{E108:0008}
temporarily regain my freedom and look into things.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|23:
You mean Laguarde, {E108:000C}Winner, {E108:000C}{E107:0003}{E1D1}and the president,

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|24:
Well, Warden Laguarde was in charge of the prison

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|25:
Keh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I fear I wasn't as kind to

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|26:
But then, she did try to have me killed.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E284}You already know why, of course.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|27:
Because you murdered President Wang, {E108:0010}but they

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|28:
If somebody had exposed the "president" as
a fake...
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|29:
...it would have been bad for Laguarde and
Chairman Winner, too.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|30:
Exactly.{E108:0010} And not only that, {E108:0010}{E107:0003}I happened to overhear

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|31:
I'll be at the orphanage on the evening of
the ninth.{E108:0010} I'll be waiting in the front yard.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|32:
I thought...{E108:0008} you could meet him if you like.{E108:0010}

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|34:
Keh heh heh.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}I know you are...{E108:0010} {E107:0004}President Wang.{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}I couldn't help overhearing the news.{E108:0010} Congratulations.
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|35:
But please don't worry about your son.{E108:0010} I only kill those

sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|37: W-Wait --{E108:0010} this is my first chance to meet him!
sce4_c3_04.bytes|04003002|38:
And it might be my only chance!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Please --{E108:0008}

N...{E108:0010}{E177:003D0001}{E108:0014} {E107:0001}{E281}Nnghoooooooooooooh!{E108:0018}

Gyark!{E108:0018}

You just need to find the right piece of evidence and

(If something left its mark on the balloon,

THAT's your proof?{E108:0018} {E107:0003}A bunch of flowers that will{E108:0010}

A bunch of flowers that Shaun threw away?{E108:0010} So much{E108:0008}

sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|7:
But the bond they represented remains as{E108:0010}

The president held onto them until the last.{E108:0010} An act

The flowers Shaun disposed of had been squashed

If we examine the basket for traces of {E041}lion lily pollen{E040},{E108:0008}
{E107:0003}what do you think we might find?
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|12:
Nonononono!{E108:0018} You don't need to do that!{E108:0010}
You looked over the basket just now!
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|13:
Anyway, if there was pollen stuck to it, you would

sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|18:
I'd like to call on your scientific skills once again,

sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|19:
Leave it to me!{E108:0020} Alright --{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}{E1D5}{E12F:00030002}let's take a look at this

sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|22:
If it's from the same flowers, {E108:0010}{E107:0001}{E1D5}it shouldn't take more

sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|25:
You murdered the president!{E108:0010}{E172:000C0000}{E108:0001}
{E107:0001}And this murder, you carried out yourself!

sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|28:
Then you loaded his body into the basket,
and took him to the refrigeration unit!

But why?{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D5}{E12F:00070001}Why go to the trouble of removing

Because he knew {E108:0010}{E107:0003}another incident was scheduled

sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|32:
Exactly.{E108:0010} If he had left the body there, it would

sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|33:
I get it.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}And he couldn't leave the body in the
refrigeration unit for too long either, right?
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|34:
Indeed not.{E108:0010} So, while returning to the Bigg Building to
drop the body off again the following night...
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|35:
...he must have observed the fire Shaun caused,
and the Taurusaurus head falling as a result!
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|36:
That's what gave you the idea, wasn't it?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}To frame Shaun for the murder?
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|38:
You made it seem as if the falling head was what
killed him so that my son would take the blame!
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|40:
In order to achieve your aim, you lowered the
president's body from the balloon to the lot below.
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|41: And while he was dangling from the rope you used...
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|42: ...he was caught on Shaun's rehearsal tape!
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|44:
How did you see through it all!?{E108:0020}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}How!?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E280}HOWWWWW!!!
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|45:
You manipulated people, and you manipulated this
case, {E108:0008}{E107:0003}just as you manipulate animals on the stage.
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|47: But {E108:0008}{E107:0003}your reign is at an end.
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|48:
The animals look like they're mad with you, {E108:0010}Simeon.{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}{E188:006E0000}Even Money {E108:0010}{E188:00870000}and Azea...
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|49:
They thought you were their friend.{E108:0008} {E107:0003}But you're not.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}They're sad and mad all at the same time...
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|50: St-Stop it!{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E280}Stop looking at me {E1D2}{E188:00340000}like that!
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|51:
Heh.{E108:0010} Perhaps they will {E108:0010}{E107:0003}{E284}when you finally stop
clowning around.
sce4_c4_08.bytes|04003980|52:
You're not cut out for comedy.{E12F:0000000C}{E108:0020}{E106}{E101:00000000}
{E1D2}{E1D5}{E12F:0000000D}{E188:00200000}{E176:00000000}{E107:0001}Your tale is destined to end with a whimper!
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|0: It seems the game is up at last.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|2:
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
May I be the first to congratulate you.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|3:
You have unmasked {E041}the person behind this{E040}
entire sorry affair.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|6: Guns are so clumsy, {E108:0010}don't you find?
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|8:
Please.{E108:0018} {E107:0003}Not only are you carrying one, you were
just about to draw it.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|9:
(He must have stolen it from the president after
murdering him...!)
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|10: This gentleman betrayed a bond of trust.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|11:
He knew the so-called president was an impostor,{E108:0008}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}and yet he employed me to kill him nonetheless.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|12:
There is nothing more dangerous for an assassin than
to be lied to about the nature of one's target.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|13:
If one does not know what cards one's opponent is
holding, {E108:0008}{E188:002F0000}{E1D1}one can be very unpleasantly surprised.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|15: But that was {E108:000C}not your true crime.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|16: No.{E108:0010} {E285}Thinking you could deceive me,{E108:0010} manipulate me...
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|17: That is the crime for which you are about to pay...
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|21: Step aside, Kanis.{E108:0010} That man is {E108:0008}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}my target.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|22:
I would politely ask that you call off this
particular job.
sce4_c4_09.bytes|04003A02|23:
He'll pay for his crimes.{E108:0010} {E1D5}But in prison, not at
